t: Start on all fours with your wrists under your shoulders and your knees under your hips, fingers spread wide. | Tuck your toes, lift your hips up and back, and straighten your legs to come into a steady Downward-Facing Dog with your body in an inverted V. | Press the floor away through your palms, draw your shoulders away from your ears, and let your heels reach toward the ground. | Set both hands and the standing foot firmly, then brace your core to keep the pose stable. | Lift one leg straight back and up in line with your spine, keeping the hips level and square to the floor. | Reach through the lifted heel and hold, breathing steadily while keeping length through the spine and both arms. | Lower the lifted leg back down with control and return to a balanced Downward-Facing Dog. | Repeat on the other side so both legs lift for an equal time.

t: Set the foot and hip pads of a 45 degree hyperextension bench to your height and lie back on it with your torso supported and legs free. | Place your hands lightly behind your head with your elbows wide, and brace your core to flatten your lower back against the pad. | Crunch your torso up and rotate one shoulder across your body while drawing the opposite knee in toward that shoulder. | Bring your elbow and the opposing knee close together at the top, twisting through your obliques rather than yanking on your neck. | Extend that leg back out as you rotate to the other side, drawing the other knee in toward the opposite shoulder in a cycling motion. | Keep the movement controlled and continuous, alternating sides like pedaling a bicycle while maintaining the crunch. | Continue alternating for your target reps, then lower your torso back under control to finish the set.

t: Stand tall on one leg with a soft bend in the knee, lifting the other foot slightly off the floor. Brace your core and keep your eyes forward. | Imagine a small plus-sign on the floor with your standing foot at the center: forward, backward, left, and right positions around you. | Hop forward off your standing foot, landing softly on the same foot with a bent knee to absorb the impact. | Hop back to the center, landing under control and re-stabilizing before the next rep. | Hop backward, then return to center, keeping the same soft, quiet landing each time. | Hop out to the side, return to center, then hop to the opposite side and back, completing one full four-direction cycle. | Stay on the same leg for the prescribed reps or time, then switch and repeat the cycle on the other leg. | Finish by stepping down and resting both feet flat before your next set.
tRu: Stand tall on one leg with a soft bend in the knee, lifting the other foot slightly off the floor. Brace your core and keep your eyes forward. | Представьте небольшой крестик на полу с вашей опорной ногой в центре: позиции вперёд, назад, влево и вправо вокруг вас. | Отталкивайтесь вперёд с опорной ноги, приземляясь мягко на ту же ногу с согнутым коленом, чтобы поглотить удар. | Прыгните обратно в центр, приземляйтесь контролируя равновесие и стабилизируясь перед следующим повторением. | Отскакивайте назад, затем возвращайтесь в центр, сохраняя одинаковое мягкое и тихое приземление каждый раз. | Отталкивайтесь в сторону, возвращайтесь в центр, затем отталкивайтесь в противоположную сторону и обратно, завершая один полный цикл в четырёх направлениях. | Stay on the same leg for the prescribed reps or time, then switch and repeat the cycle on the other leg. | Завершите упражнение, сойдите и отдохните, обе стопы полностью на полу перед следующим подходом.
tHe: Stand tall on one leg with a soft bend in the knee, lifting the other foot slightly off the floor. t: Lie flat on your back and raise your legs so your hips and knees form a 90 degree angle, with your shins roughly parallel to the floor. | Lift your head and shoulder blades slightly off the floor to engage your abs, with your arms extended down by your sides. | Reach your right hand toward your right heel by crunching your torso laterally to the right. | Lightly touch your heel, then return your shoulder to the centre under control. | Crunch laterally to the left and reach your left hand toward your left heel. | Touch the heel, return to centre, and continue alternating sides for your target reps. | After your final rep, lower your shoulders and then your legs to the floor with control.
tRu: Лягте на спину и поднимите ноги так, чтобы таз и колени образовали угол 90 градусов, голени примерно параллельны полу. | Поднимите голову и лопатки немного с пола, чтобы напрячь пресс, с вытянутыми вдоль тела руками. | Reach your right hand toward your right heel by crunching your torso laterally to the right. | Легко коснитесь пола пяткой, затем поднимите плечо обратно в центр под контролем. | Сделайте боковое скручивание влево и дотроньтесь левой рукой до левой пятки. | Touch the heel, return to centre, and continue alternating sides for your target reps. | После последнего повторения подконтрольно опустите на пол сначала плечи, затем ноги.
tHe: Lie flat on your back and raise your legs so your hips and knees form a 90 degree angle, with your shins roughly parallel to the floor. | Lift your head and shoulder blades slightly off the floor to engage your abs, with your arms extended down by your sides. | Reach your right hand toward your right heel by crunching your torso laterally to the right. | Lightly touch your heel, then return your shoulder to the centre under control. | כורך לצד שמאל והגיע עם יד שמאל לעבר עקב שמאל. | Touch the heel, return to centre, and continue alternating sides for your target reps. | לאחר החזרה האחרונה, הורד בשליטה קודם את הכתפיים ואז את הרגליים לרצפה.

t: Sit on the floor and set up the 90/90 position: bend your front leg in front of you with the knee and ankle at roughly 90°, and bend your back leg out to the side, also at about 90°. | Square your hips and torso toward your front shin, sitting up tall with a long spine rather than slumping back. | Brace your core lightly and place both hands on the floor in front of your front shin for support. | Inhale, then slowly press and hinge your torso forward over the front shin, leading with your chest and keeping your back flat. | Lower until you feel a firm but comfortable stretch in the front hip and glute, stopping before any sharp pinch. | Hold the position and breathe slowly, exhaling to let the front hip sink a little deeper on each breath. | Hold for 20–40 seconds, then slowly press back up to tall sitting. | Switch your legs so the other leg is in front, and repeat the stretch on the second side.
tRu: Sit on the floor and set up the 90/90 position: bend your front leg in front of you with the knee and ankle at roughly 90°, and bend your back leg out to the side, also at about 90°. | Square your hips and torso toward your front shin, sitting up tall with a long spine rather than slumping back. | Легко напрягите пресс и поставьте обе руки на пол перед голенью передней ноги для опоры. | Сделайте вдох, затем медленно проведите обе руки вперёд и по диагонали в одну сторону — перекатываясь под углом примерно 30–45 градусов от центральной линии — пока руки не окажутся почти над головой. | Опустите, пока вы не почувствуете сильное, но комфортное растяжение в передней части бедра и ягодице, останавливаясь до появления резкой боли. | Задержите позицию и дышите медленно, выдыхая, чтобы переднее бедро могло опуститься ещё глубже с каждым вдохом. | Удерживайте 20–40 секунд, затем плавно вернитесь в положение сидя. | Switch your legs so the other leg is in front, and repeat the stretch on the second side.
tHe: Sit on the floor and set up the 90/90 position: bend your front leg in front of you with the knee and ankle at roughly 90°, and bend your back leg out to the side, also at about 90°. | Square your hips and torso toward your front shin, sitting up tall with a long spine rather than slumping back. | הדק קלות את הליבה והנח את שתי הידיים על הרצפה לפני השוק הקדמית לתמיכה. | Inhale, then slowly press and hinge your torso forward over the front shin, leading with your chest and keeping your back flat. | Lower until you feel a firm but comfortable stretch in the front hip and glute, stopping before any sharp pinch. | Hold the position and breathe slowly, exhaling to let the front hip sink a little deeper on each breath. | Hold for 20–40 seconds, then slowly press back up to tall sitting. | Switch your legs so the other leg is in front, and repeat the stretch on the second side.

t: Sit tall on the floor and bring your front leg out in front of you, bending the knee to 90 degrees so your shin runs roughly parallel to your hips. | Place your back leg out to the side with the knee also bent to 90 degrees, so the inside of that thigh and shin rest toward the floor. | Square your torso and sit upright over your hips, keeping both sit bones grounded and your spine long. | Press both knees gently toward the floor to feel the stretch in the front-leg glute and the back-leg hip flexor. | Hold this position and breathe steadily, relaxing into the stretch without forcing the range. | To deepen it, hinge forward over the front leg with a flat back while keeping your chest tall. | Hold for the set time, then switch the position of your legs and repeat on the other side.
tRu: Sit tall on the floor and bring your front leg out in front of you, bending the knee to 90 degrees so your shin runs roughly parallel to your hips. | Поставьте заднюю ногу в сторону, согнув колено под углом 90 градусов, чтобы внутренняя часть бедра и голени были направлены к полу. | Square your torso and sit upright over your hips, keeping both sit bones grounded and your spine long. | Press both knees gently toward the floor to feel the stretch in the front-leg glute and the back-leg hip flexor. | Удерживайте это положение и дышите ровно, расслабляясь в растяжке, не форсируя амплитуду. | To deepen it, hinge forward over the front leg with a flat back while keeping your chest tall. | Удерживайте заданное время, затем поменяйте положение ног и повторите с другой стороны.

t: Set up on the floor on all fours, placing your hands directly under your shoulders and your knees directly under your hips, with shins and toes resting on the floor. | Spread your fingers and press the floor away to set your shoulder blades, keeping your arms straight but not locked. | Set your spine in neutral — a flat back from head to tailbone, with your neck long and your gaze toward the floor just ahead of your hands. | Brace your abdominals as if bracing for a light punch, and gently draw your belly button up toward your spine without rounding your back. | Hold this braced four-point position with steady, controlled breathing, keeping your hips level and your weight evenly spread across both hands and both knees. | Maintain the brace for the prescribed time or reps, resisting any sag or twist in your trunk. | Release the brace under control, lower your hips back to a rest position, and reset before the next repetition.
tRu: Set up on the floor on all fours, placing your hands directly under your shoulders and your knees directly under your hips, with shins and toes resting on the floor. | Spread your fingers and press the floor away to set your shoulder blades, keeping your arms straight but not locked. | Set your spine in neutral — a flat back from head to tailbone, with your neck long and your gaze toward the floor just ahead of your hands. | Напрягите мышцы пресса, как перед лёгким ударом, и мягко подтяните пупок к позвоночнику, не скругляя спину. | Задержитесь в этом напряжённом четырёхточечном положении с ровным и контролируемым дыханием, сохраняя бёдра на одном уровне и вес равномерно распределённым между обеими руками и коленями. | Сохраняйте напряжение в течение назначенного времени или повторений, сопротивляясь любому провисанию или скручиванию в туловище. | Release the brace under control, lower your hips back to a rest position, and reset before the next repetition.

t: Lie face down on the floor with your legs extended behind you and your hands placed flat under your shoulders. | Press through your hands to lift your chest and head upward, letting your hips and pelvis stay in contact with the floor. | Straighten your arms only as far as feels comfortable, opening up the front of your waist and rectus abdominis. | Keep your shoulders relaxed and down, away from your ears, and your neck long as you breathe steadily. | Hold the stretch for 20–30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull across the front of your abdomen. | To target the obliques, slowly turn your head and upper torso to look over one shoulder, then return to center and repeat on the other side. | Lower your chest back to the floor under control to release the stretch.
tRu: Лягте на живот на пол с ногами, вытянутыми назад, и руками, положенными ладонями под плечами. | Press through your hands to lift your chest and head upward, letting your hips and pelvis stay in contact with the floor. | Straighten your arms only as far as feels comfortable, opening up the front of your waist and rectus abdominis. | Держите плечи расслабленными и опущенными, вдали от ушей, и шею длинной, дыша ровно. | Держите растяжку 20–30 секунд, ощущая мягкое натяжение по передней поверхности живота. | To target the obliques, slowly turn your head and upper torso to look over one shoulder, then return to center and repeat on the other side. | Под контролем опустите грудь обратно на пол, чтобы растянуть.

nE: Abduction Of One Leg Flexion Stretch
nR: Растяжка отведения со сгибанием одной ноги
nH: מתיחת הרחקה עם כפיפת רגל אחת
t: Sit on the floor with your back tall and both legs extended in front of you. | Slide one leg out to the side as far as is comfortable, keeping that knee facing the ceiling and the toes pointed up. | Bend the opposite leg, drawing that foot in toward your inner thigh so the sole rests against the straightened leg. | Sit tall and brace your core, then hinge forward from the hips toward the extended leg rather than rounding your back. | Slide your hands along the straight leg until you feel a comfortable stretch through the inner thigh and hip. | Hold the position for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and easing a little deeper on each exhale. | Return to the starting position under control, then switch sides and repeat with the other leg.
tRu: Sit on the floor with your back tall and both legs extended in front of you. | Slide one leg out to the side as far as is comfortable, keeping that knee facing the ceiling and the toes pointed up. | Согните противоположную ногу, подтянув стопу к внутренней поверхности бедра так, чтобы подошва упиралась в выпрямленную ногу. | Sit tall and brace your core, then hinge forward from the hips toward the extended leg rather than rounding your back. | Slide your hands along the straight leg until you feel a comfortable stretch through the inner thigh and hip. | Задержите положение на 20-30 секунд, дыша медленно и позволяя растяжке немного углубляться с каждым выдохом. | Return to the starting position under control, then switch sides and repeat with the other leg.
tHe: Sit on the floor with your back tall and both legs extended in front of you. | Slide one leg out to the side as far as is comfortable, keeping that knee facing the ceiling and the toes pointed up. | כופף את הרגל הנגדית, משוך את אותה כף רגל פנימה לכיוון המפשעה הפנימית כך שהסוליה נשענת על הרגל הישרה. | Sit tall and brace your core, then hinge forward from the hips toward the extended leg rather than rounding your back. | Slide your hands along the straight leg until you feel a comfortable stretch through the inner thigh and hip. | Hold the position for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and easing a little deeper on each exhale. | Return to the starting position under control, then switch sides and repeat with the other leg.

t: Sit on the floor and place the ab mat under your lower back so the thicker edge sits just below your waistband, supporting the natural arch of your spine. | Bend your knees and either plant your feet flat on the floor or bring the soles together in a butterfly position for a more stable base. | Lie back over the mat until your shoulders touch the floor and your lower back is gently extended over the contour. | Place your hands across your chest or extend your arms overhead, and brace your core by drawing your ribs toward your hips. | Curl up by contracting your abs, lifting your shoulders and then your back off the mat one segment at a time. | Sit all the way up until your torso is upright and your hands reach toward or past your knees or feet. | Lower under control back over the mat until your shoulders touch down again, keeping tension on your abs. | Repeat for your target reps, then rest with your back flat over the mat.
tRu: Sit on the floor and place the ab mat under your lower back so the thicker edge sits just below your waistband, supporting the natural arch of your spine. | Согните ноги и либо поставьте стопы на пол, либо соедините подошвы вместе в позе «бабочки» для более устойчивой опоры. | Лягте на ковёр, пока плечи не коснутся пола, а поясница не будет мягко прогибаться по контуру. | Положите руки на грудь или вытяните их над головой, и напрягите корпус, подтягивая ребра к бедрам. | Поднимайтесь вверх, сокращая мышцы пресса, поднимая плечи, а затем спину с матрицы по одному сегменту. | Sit all the way up until your torso is upright and your hands reach toward or past your knees or feet. | Опустите под контролем обратно через мат, пока ваши плечи снова не коснулись пола, сохраняя напряжение в мышцах живота. | Repeat for your target reps, then rest with your back flat over the mat.
tHe: Sit on the floor and place the ab mat under your lower back so the thicker edge sits just below your waistband, supporting the natural arch of your spine. | כופף את הברכיים והנח את כפות הרגליים שטוחות על הרצפה או הבא את הסוליות זו לזו בתנוחת פרפר לבסיס יציב יותר. | Lie back over the mat until your shoulders touch the floor and your lower back is gently extended over the contour. | Place your hands across your chest or extend your arms overhead, and brace your core by drawing your ribs toward your hips. | כופף כלפי מעלה על ידי מתיחת שרירי הבטן, מרים את הכתפיים ואז את הגב מהמשטח מקטע אחר מקטע. | Sit all the way up until your torso is upright and your hands reach toward or past your knees or feet. | Lower under control back over the mat until your shoulders touch down again, keeping tension on your abs. | Repeat for your target reps, then rest with your back flat over the mat.

t: Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart, knees soft, and your core gently braced. | Reach both arms straight up overhead and interlace your fingers with your palms turned up toward the ceiling. | Roll your shoulders down and back, drawing your shoulder blades together to open the chest. | Press your palms upward and slightly back, easing your arms behind your ears until you feel a stretch across the chest and front of the shoulders. | Lift your sternum and keep your ribs from flaring, breathing slowly into the stretch. | Hold the position for 20–30 seconds while continuing to breathe steadily. | Release your hands and lower your arms under control, then repeat for 2–3 rounds.
tRu: Встаньте прямо, поставив ноги примерно на ширине бёдер, колени мягкие, мягко напрягите корпус. | Reach both arms straight up overhead and interlace your fingers with your palms turned up toward the ceiling. | Roll your shoulders down and back, drawing your shoulder blades together to open the chest. | Press your palms upward and slightly back, easing your arms behind your ears until you feel a stretch across the chest and front of the shoulders. | Поднимите грудную клетку и не давайте ребрам выпирать, медленно дышите в растяжку. | Задержите положение на 20-30 секунд, продолжая дышать ровно. | Release your hands and lower your arms under control, then repeat for 2–3 rounds.
tHe: עמוד זקוף עם רגליים בערך ברוחב האגן, ברכיים רכות, והליבה בעדינות מכווצת. | Reach both arms straight up overhead and interlace your fingers with your palms turned up toward the ceiling. | Roll your shoulders down and back, drawing your shoulder blades together to open the chest. | Press your palms upward and slightly back, easing your arms behind your ears until you feel a stretch across the chest and front of the shoulders. | Lift your sternum and keep your ribs from flaring, breathing slowly into the stretch. | Hold the position for 20–30 seconds while continuing to breathe steadily. | Release your hands and lower your arms under control, then repeat for 2–3 rounds.

t: Sit on the floor and position the ab roller cradle behind your head, resting your neck and the back of your head against its padded support. | Lie back and grip the handles on either side of the frame so your head stays cradled and your neck stays neutral. | Bend your knees and plant your feet flat on the floor about hip-width apart. | Brace your core and press your lower back into the floor to set your starting position. | Curl your shoulders and upper back up off the floor, rocking the cradle forward as you crunch toward your knees. | Squeeze your rectus abdominis hard at the top, keeping the movement driven by your abs rather than your arms or neck. | Lower under control back to the start, letting the cradle rock back without resting your shoulder blades fully down. | Complete your reps, keeping each one slow and controlled, then set the frame aside.
tRu: Sit on the floor and position the ab roller cradle behind your head, resting your neck and the back of your head against its padded support. | Лягте на спину и возьмитесь за рукоятки с обеих сторон рамы так, чтобы ваша голова была зафиксирована, а шея оставалась в нейтральном положении. | Согните ноги и поставьте стопы на пол примерно на ширине бёдер. | Напрягите корпус и прижмите поясницу к полу, чтобы занять исходное положение. | Поднимите плечи и верхнюю часть спины с пола, наклоняя колыбель вперед, когда вы скручиваетесь к коленям. | Squeeze your rectus abdominis hard at the top, keeping the movement driven by your abs rather than your arms or neck. | Под контролем опуститесь в исходное положение, позволяя опоре качнуться назад, не опуская лопатки полностью вниз. | Выполните все повторения, сохраняя каждое движение медленным и контролируемым, затем отставьте рамку.
tHe: Sit on the floor and position the ab roller cradle behind your head, resting your neck and the back of your head against its padded support. | Lie back and grip the handles on either side of the frame so your head stays cradled and your neck stays neutral. | כופף את הברכיים ונטע את כפות הרגליים שטוחות על הרצפה בערך ברוחב האגן. | הדק את הליבה ולחץ את הגב התחתון לרצפה כדי לקבוע את תנוחת ההתחלה. | קפוץ עם שכמותיך ועם גבך העליון מהרצפה, הנע את העריסה קדימה כשאתה מתכווץ לעבר ברכיך. | Squeeze your rectus abdominis hard at the top, keeping the movement driven by your abs rather than your arms or neck. | Lower under control back to the start, letting the cradle rock back without resting your shoulder blades fully down. | בצע את כל החזרות, שומר על כל אחת איטית ומבוקרת, ואז הנח את המסגרת בצד.

t: Sit on the floor or the edge of a bench with your torso leaning back slightly and your hands resting beside your hips for balance. | Brace your core and lift both feet off the floor, balancing on your sit bones with your knees bent and shins roughly parallel to the ground. | Extend your legs out in front of you without letting your feet touch the floor, lowering your upper body back at the same time. | Pause briefly in the extended position, keeping your core tight and your lower back from rounding excessively. | Draw your knees back toward your chest while crunching your torso up, squeezing your abs as the knees and chest meet. | Control the tuck at the top, then reverse smoothly into the next rep. | Complete your reps, then lower your feet to the floor and sit up to finish.
tRu: Sit on the floor or the edge of a bench with your torso leaning back slightly and your hands resting beside your hips for balance. | Напрягите корпус и оторвите обе стопы от пола, балансируя на седалищных костях со согнутыми коленями и голенями примерно параллельно полу. | Вытяните ноги вперед, не давая стопам касаться пола, одновременно наклоняя верхнюю часть тела назад. | Задержитесь на мгновение в положении разгибания, сохраняя корпус напряжённым и не допуская сильного округления поясницы. | Приведите колени к груди, одновременно поднимая корпус вверх, сжимая пресс, когда колени и грудь встречаются. | Контролируйте подтягивание в верхней точке, затем плавно переходите к следующему повторению. | Выполните все повторения, затем опустите ноги на пол и сядьте для завершения.
tHe: Sit on the floor or the edge of a bench with your torso leaning back slightly and your hands resting beside your hips for balance. | הדק את הליבה והרם את שתי הרגליים מהרצפה, תוך איזון על עצמות הישיבה כשהברכיים כפופות והשוקיים בערך מקבילות לקרקע. | פשוט את רגליך לצד כך שגופך ייצור קו ישר מהראש עד לכפות הרגליים, עם כפות הרגליים אחת מעל השנייה או עם הברך התחתונה על הרצפה ליציבות. | Pause briefly in the extended position, keeping your core tight and your lower back from rounding excessively. | משוך את הברכים לעבר החזה בזמן שכופפים את הגוף קדימה, מכווצים את שרירי הבטן כשהברכים והחזה נפגשים. | שלוט בכיפוף בראש התנועה, ואז הפוך בחלקות לחזרה הבאה. | בצע את החזרות שלך, ואז הורד את רגלייך לרצפה והתיישב כדי לסיים.

t: Stand or sit tall with your chest up, shoulders relaxed, and feet about hip-width apart. | Raise one arm straight out in front of you to about shoulder height, keeping it relatively straight. | Bring that arm horizontally across the front of your chest, reaching toward the opposite shoulder. | Use your other hand to cradle the upper arm just above the elbow, then gently draw it closer to your chest. | Keep both shoulders down and level — avoid shrugging the stretching shoulder up toward your ear. | Hold the stretch where you feel a comfortable pull across the back of the shoulder, breathing slowly and steadily for 20–30 seconds. | Release the arm gently, then repeat on the other side, aiming for 2–3 holds per shoulder.
tRu: Stand or sit tall with your chest up, shoulders relaxed, and feet about hip-width apart. | Raise one arm straight out in front of you to about shoulder height, keeping it relatively straight. | Потяните эту руку горизонтально перед грудью, направляя к противоположному плечу. | Use your other hand to cradle the upper arm just above the elbow, then gently draw it closer to your chest. | Держите оба плеча опущенными и на одном уровне — не поднимайте растягиваемое плечо к уху. | Держите растяжку в положении, где вы чувствуете комфортное натяжение по задней части плеча, дыша медленно и ровно в течение 20–30 секунд. | Release the arm gently, then repeat on the other side, aiming for 2–3 holds per shoulder.
tHe: Stand or sit tall with your chest up, shoulders relaxed, and feet about hip-width apart. | Raise one arm straight out in front of you to about shoulder height, keeping it relatively straight. | הבא את היד אופקית לאורך חזית החזה, מגיע לעבר הכתף הנגדית. | Use your other hand to cradle the upper arm just above the elbow, then gently draw it closer to your chest. | Keep both shoulders down and level — avoid shrugging the stretching shoulder up toward your ear. | Hold the stretch where you feel a comfortable pull across the back of the shoulder, breathing slowly and steadily for 20–30 seconds. | Release the arm gently, then repeat on the other side, aiming for 2–3 holds per shoulder.

nE: Adduction Hand With Elbow Extended Stretch
nR: Растяжка приведения кисти с выпрямленным локтем
nH: מתיחת קירוב כף יד במרפק ישר
t: Stand or sit tall and extend one arm straight out in front of you at shoulder height, keeping the elbow fully locked out. | Turn the palm so it faces down toward the floor, with the fingers pointing forward. | Reach across with your free hand and grip the fingers or the back of the extended hand. | Gently draw the hand inward and downward, bending it at the wrist until you feel a mild stretch through the top of the forearm. | Hold the position for 20 to 30 seconds while breathing slowly and keeping the elbow straight throughout. | Ease out of the stretch under control, shake out the arm, then repeat on the other side. | Perform 2 to 3 holds per arm, easing slightly deeper into the range on each one.
tRu: Stand or sit tall and extend one arm straight out in front of you at shoulder height, keeping the elbow fully locked out. | Turn the palm so it faces down toward the floor, with the fingers pointing forward. | Reach across with your free hand and grip the fingers or the back of the extended hand. | Плавно ведите руку внутрь и вниз, сгибая ее в запястье, пока не почувствуете легкую растяжку в верхней части предплечья. | Задержите позицию в течение 20–30 секунд, дыша медленно и сохраняя локоть выпрямленным на протяжении всего времени. | Постепенно выйдите из растяжки под контролем, встряхните руку, затем повторите с другой стороны. | Выполняйте 2–3 задержки на каждую руку, немного углубляясь в амплитуду при каждой задержке.
tHe: Stand or sit tall and extend one arm straight out in front of you at shoulder height, keeping the elbow fully locked out. | Turn the palm so it faces down toward the floor, with the fingers pointing forward. | Reach across with your free hand and grip the fingers or the back of the extended hand. | משוך בעדינות את היד פנימה ומטה, וכופף אותה בפרק היד עד שתרגיש מתיחה קלה לאורך גב האמה. | Hold the position for 20 to 30 seconds while breathing slowly and keeping the elbow straight throughout. | צא מהמתיחה בשליטה, נער את הזרוע, אז חזור על הצד השני. | Perform 2 to 3 holds per arm, easing slightly deeper into the range on each one.

nE: Adduction Of Arm In Back Stretch
t: Stand tall with your feet about shoulder-width apart and your shoulders relaxed away from your ears. | Reach one arm behind your back, moving it across toward the opposite hip. | Use your other hand to gently grasp the wrist or forearm of the reaching arm. | Draw the reaching arm further across your back until you feel a comfortable stretch through the back and rear shoulder. | Keep your chest open and avoid rounding or hunching your upper back as you pull. | Hold the stretch for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and steadily. | Release gently, then repeat on the opposite side.
tRu: Stand tall with your feet about shoulder-width apart and your shoulders relaxed away from your ears. | Reach one arm behind your back, moving it across toward the opposite hip. | Use your other hand to gently grasp the wrist or forearm of the reaching arm. | Дотяните вытянутую руку дальше за спину, пока не почувствуете комфортное растяжение в спине и заднем плече. | Держите грудь открытой и избегайте округления или сутуления верха спины, когда тянетесь. | Держите растяжку в течение 20-30 секунд, дыша ровно и позволяя груди расслабляться ещё больше с каждым выдохом. | Release gently, then repeat on the opposite side.
tHe: Stand tall with your feet about shoulder-width apart and your shoulders relaxed away from your ears. | Reach one arm behind your back, moving it across toward the opposite hip. | Use your other hand to gently grasp the wrist or forearm of the reaching arm. | משוך את היד המושטת עוד לרוחב הגב עד שאתה מרגיש מתיחה נוחה בגב ובכתף האחורית. | Keep your chest open and avoid rounding or hunching your upper back as you pull. | Hold the stretch for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and steadily. | Release gently, then repeat on the opposite side.

t: Stand tall with your feet wider than shoulder-width and your toes pointing forward or slightly out. | Place your hands on your thighs or hips for balance and keep your back straight. | Shift your weight to one side, bending that knee and pushing your hips toward it while keeping the opposite leg straight. | Keep the heel of the straight leg planted so you feel a stretch along its inner thigh and groin. | Hold the position for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and keeping your torso upright. | Return to center under control, then shift your weight to the other side and repeat. | Complete the stretch on both sides, easing out of each hold gently rather than bouncing.
tRu: Stand tall with your feet wider than shoulder-width and your toes pointing forward or slightly out. | Положите руки на бёдра или на бёдра для баланса и держите спину прямо. | Shift your weight to one side, bending that knee and pushing your hips toward it while keeping the opposite leg straight. | Держите пятку прямой ноги прижатой к полу, чтобы вы чувствовали растяжку вдоль внутренней поверхности бедра и паха. | Задержите положение на 20-30 секунд, дыша медленно и сохраняя корпус прямым. | Return to center under control, then shift your weight to the other side and repeat. | Выполните растяжку на обе стороны, плавно выходя из каждого удержания, а не отскакивая.
tHe: Stand tall with your feet wider than shoulder-width and your toes pointing forward or slightly out. | Place your hands on your thighs or hips for balance and keep your back straight. | Shift your weight to one side, bending that knee and pushing your hips toward it while keeping the opposite leg straight. | Keep the heel of the straight leg planted so you feel a stretch along its inner thigh and groin. | Hold the position for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and keeping your torso upright. | Return to center under control, then shift your weight to the other side and repeat. | בצע את המתיחה בשני הצדדים, וצא מכל החזקה בעדינות במקום לקפוץ.

t: Place a stability ball on the floor in front of you and stand a short step away with your feet hip-width apart and knees softly bent. | Drop into an athletic stance — chest up, hips back, weight on the balls of your feet — so you can move quickly in any direction. | Begin a steady, quick footwork pattern, tapping the top of the ball with alternating feet or shuffling your feet from side to side around it. | Keep your core braced and your arms loose so you stay balanced and react smoothly as you change direction. | Drive each foot down and back up at a brisk, controlled tempo, staying light on your feet and keeping your eyes forward, not on the ball. | Maintain the pace for a timed work interval, breathing in a steady rhythm rather than holding your breath. | Slow to a stop, reset your stance, and rest briefly before starting the next interval or pattern.
tRu: Поставьте мяч для стабилизации на пол перед собой и встаньте на короткий шаг назад с ногами на ширине таза и колени softly bent. | Примите положение спортивной стойки — грудь вверх, бёдра назад, вес на носках — чтобы быстро двигаться в любом направлении. | Начните устойчивую быструю работу ног, поочерёдно касаясь верхней части мяча стопами или перемещая стопы из стороны в сторону вокруг него. | Держите корпус напряжен и руки расслабленными, чтобы вы сохраняли баланс и плавно реагировали при смене направления. | Отталкивайте каждую ногу вниз и вверх в быстром, контролируемом темпе, оставаясь на носках и сохраняя взгляд вперед, а не на мяче. | Сохраняйте темп в течение рабочего интервала, дыша в устойчивом ритме, а не задерживая дыхание. | Slow to a stop, reset your stance, and rest briefly before starting the next interval or pattern.
tHe: Place a stability ball on the floor in front of you and stand a short step away with your feet hip-width apart and knees softly bent. | רד לתנוחה אתלטית — חזה פרוס, ירכיים אחורה, משקל על כפות הרגליים — כדי שתוכל לנוע במהירות בכל כיוון. | התחל בדפוס צעדים מהיר ויציב, טפח על ראש הכדור עם רגליים מתחלפות או דלג עם הרגליים מצד לצד סביבו. | Keep your core braced and your arms loose so you stay balanced and react smoothly as you change direction. | דחוף כל רגל למטה וחזרה למעלה בקצב מהיר ומבוקר, נשאר קל על הרגליים ושומר על מבטך קדימה, לא על הכדור. | Maintain the pace for a timed work interval, breathing in a steady rhythm rather than holding your breath. | Slow to a stop, reset your stance, and rest briefly before starting the next interval or pattern.

t: Lie flat on your back on a mat with your lower back pressed gently into the floor and your knees bent. | Place your hands lightly behind your head with your elbows pointing out wide. Do not lace your fingers or pull on your neck. | Lift your shoulder blades off the floor and raise your knees to about a 90-degree angle so your shins are roughly parallel to the floor. | Brace your core, then rotate your torso to bring your right elbow toward your left knee while extending your right leg straight out. | Pause briefly when your elbow and opposite knee meet, squeezing your obliques. | Switch sides in a smooth cycling motion, bringing your left elbow toward your right knee while extending your left leg. | Continue alternating sides under control for the desired number of reps, keeping your shoulders off the floor throughout. | Finish by lowering your shoulders, head, and feet back to the mat with control.
tRu: Лягте на спину на коврик с слегка прижатой поясницей к полу и согнутыми коленями. | Положите руки легко за головой, локти широко расставлены. Не скрещивайте пальцы и не тяните за шею. | Поднимите лопатки с пола и поднимите колени примерно под углом 90 градусов, чтобы голени были примерно параллельны полу. | Напрягите корпус, затем поверните туловище, bringing your right elbow toward your left knee while extending your right leg straight out. | Задержитесь на мгновение, когда ваш локоть и противоположное колено встречаются, сжимая косые мышцы. | Switch sides in a smooth cycling motion, bringing your left elbow toward your right knee while extending your left leg. | Продолжайте поочередно выполнять движения на разные стороны под контролем в течение назначенного количества повторений, удерживая плечи от пола на протяжении всего упражнения. | Завершите, опустив плечи, голову и ноги обратно на коврик под контролем.
tHe: Lie flat on your back on a mat with your lower back pressed gently into the floor and your knees bent. | Place your hands lightly behind your head with your elbows pointing out wide. Do not lace your fingers or pull on your neck. | Lift your shoulder blades off the floor and raise your knees to about a 90-degree angle so your shins are roughly parallel to the floor. | הכן את שרירי הליבה, ואז סובב את הגוף כדי להביא את המרפק הימני לכיוון הברך השמאלית בעת שמושך את הרגל הימניי ישר החוצה. | Pause briefly when your elbow and opposite knee meet, squeezing your obliques. | Switch sides in a smooth cycling motion, bringing your left elbow toward your right knee while extending your left leg. | המשיל להחליף צדדים בשליטה למספר החזרות הרצוי, תוך שמירה על כתפיים מורמות מהרצפה לכל אורך. | סיים בהורדת הכתפיים, הראש והרגליים בחזרה למזרן בשליטה.

t: Lie flat on your back on a mat with your lower back pressed gently into the floor. | Place your hands lightly behind your head, fingers supporting but not pulling on your neck. | Lift both feet off the floor and bring your knees up so your thighs are roughly vertical. | Curl your shoulders up off the mat to engage your abdominals and begin the movement. | Rotate your torso to bring one elbow toward the opposite knee while extending the other leg out straight. | Switch sides in a smooth pedaling motion, drawing the opposite elbow to the now-bent knee as the other leg extends. | Keep alternating sides under control, breathing steadily, until you complete your reps. | Lower your feet and shoulders back to the mat to finish the set.
tRu: Лягте на спину на коврик с слегка прижатой поясницей к полу. | Положите руки легко за головой, пальцами поддерживая, но не тяня за шею. | Приподнимите обе стопы от пола и поднимите колени так, чтобы бёдра были примерно вертикальны. | Поднимите плечи с коврика, чтобы напрячь мышцы пресса и начать движение. | Rotate your torso to bring one elbow toward the opposite knee while extending the other leg out straight. | Switch sides in a smooth pedaling motion, drawing the opposite elbow to the now-bent knee as the other leg extends. | Чередуйте стороны под контролем, дышите ровно, пока не выполните все повторения. | Под контролем опустите ноги и плечи обратно на коврик, чтобы закончить подход.
tHe: Lie flat on your back on a mat with your lower back pressed gently into the floor. | Place your hands lightly behind your head, fingers supporting but not pulling on your neck. | Lift both feet off the floor and bring your knees up so your thighs are roughly vertical. | קפוץ עם שכמותיך מהשטיח כדי להפעיל את שרירי הבטן ולהתחיל את התנועה. | Rotate your torso to bring one elbow toward the opposite knee while extending the other leg out straight. | Switch sides in a smooth pedaling motion, drawing the opposite elbow to the now-bent knee as the other leg extends. | Keep alternating sides under control, breathing steadily, until you complete your reps. | Lower your feet and shoulders back to the mat to finish the set.

t: Stand with your feet roughly shoulder-width apart, toes pointed slightly outward, and let your arms hang at your sides. | Brace your core, lift your chest, and keep your weight balanced over your mid-foot. | Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower yourself, raising your arms forward for balance as you descend. | Lower until your hip crease drops below the top of your knees, keeping your heels flat on the floor. | Keep your knees tracking in line with your toes and your back in a neutral, upright position at the bottom. | Drive through your heels and mid-foot to stand back up, extending your hips and knees together. | Squeeze your glutes at the top and return to the starting position, then repeat for reps.
tRu: Stand with your feet roughly shoulder-width apart, toes pointed slightly outward, and let your arms hang at your sides. | Напрягите корпус, поднимите грудь и удерживайте вес сбалансированным над серединой стопы. | Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower yourself, raising your arms forward for balance as you descend. | Опустите, пока линия бёдер не опустилась ниже верха колен, сохраняя пятки прижатыми к полу. | Держите колени вровень с носками и спину в нейтральном, вертикальном положении в нижней точке. | Отталкивайтесь пяткой и серединой стопы, чтобы встать обратно, разгибая тазобедренный сустав и колено вместе. | Squeeze your glutes at the top and return to the starting position, then repeat for reps.
tHe: Stand with your feet roughly shoulder-width apart, toes pointed slightly outward, and let your arms hang at your sides. | הדק את הליבה, הרם את החזה ושמור על משקל מאוזן מעל אמצע כף הרגל. | Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower yourself, raising your arms forward for balance as you descend. | Lower until your hip crease drops below the top of your knees, keeping your heels flat on the floor. | Keep your knees tracking in line with your toes and your back in a neutral, upright position at the bottom. | דחוף דרך עקביך והאמצע הכף כדי לקום חזרה, מרחיב את הירכיים והברכיים יחד. | Squeeze your glutes at the top and return to the starting position, then repeat for reps.

t: Lie flat on your back and lift your legs so your hips and knees are bent at roughly 90 degrees, shins parallel to the floor. | Place your hands lightly behind your head with your elbows pointing out to the sides. | Brace your core and pull your lower back gently into the floor to remove any arch. | Curl your shoulder blades off the floor and rotate your torso, bringing one elbow toward the opposite knee. | Pause briefly at the top and squeeze your obliques, keeping your neck relaxed. | Lower under control back to the start without letting your shoulders fully rest on the floor. | Repeat to the other side, alternating each rep, then set your feet down to finish.
tRu: Лягте на спину и поднимите ноги так, чтобы таз и колени были согнуты под углом примерно 90 градусов, голени параллельны полу. | Положите руки легко за головой, локтями направленными в стороны. | Напрягите корпус и мягко прижмите поясницу к полу, убрав прогиб. | Поднимите лопатки с пола и поверните корпус, bringing one elbow toward the opposite knee. | Пауза в верхней точке и сжатие косых мышц живота, сохраняя шею расслабленной. | Под контролем опуститесь в исходное положение, не позволяя вашим плечам полностью отдохнуть на полу. | Repeat to the other side, alternating each rep, then set your feet down to finish.
tHe: Lie flat on your back and lift your legs so your hips and knees are bent at roughly 90 degrees, shins parallel to the floor. | Place your hands lightly behind your head with your elbows pointing out to the sides. | הדק את הליבה והצמד בעדינות את הגב התחתון לרצפה כדי לבטל כל קשת. | כרוח את הלחיים מהרצפה וסובב את הגוף, מביט את המרפק אחד לעבר הברך הנגדית. | Pause briefly at the top and squeeze your obliques, keeping your neck relaxed. | Lower under control back to the start without letting your shoulders fully rest on the floor. | Repeat to the other side, alternating each rep, then set your feet down to finish.

t: Stand on the middle of the band with your feet about shoulder-width apart, holding one end of the band in each hand with your palms facing forward. | Let your arms hang straight down at your sides so there is light tension in the band at the bottom. | Keep your elbows pinned close to your torso and your chest up with a tall, braced posture. | Curl one hand up toward your shoulder by bending the elbow, keeping the upper arm still. | Squeeze the biceps at the top, then lower that hand under control back to the starting position against the band's resistance. | Repeat the curl with the other arm, alternating sides one rep at a time. | Continue alternating until you complete your target reps on each arm, then slowly step off the band.

tHe: Stand tall with your back against a wall, heels a few inches out, and your head, upper back, and glutes lightly touching the wall. | הדק בעדינות את הליבה והשטח את הגב התחתון כך שלא יתקשת מהקיר. | Let both arms hang at your sides with your palms facing your thighs. | Raise one arm forward and up overhead in a smooth arc, keeping the elbow straight and the back of your hand reaching toward the wall above you. | Move only as far as you can without your lower back arching off the wall, then pause briefly at the top. | Lower that arm under control back to your side along the same path. | Repeat with the other arm, alternating sides for the prescribed number of reps. | סיים עם שתי הזרועות רפויות לצדדים וצעד הרחק מהקיר.

t: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, core braced and arms relaxed at your sides. | Step one foot back into a long lunge stance, balancing on the ball of your rear foot with your heel lifted. | Bend both knees to lower into the lunge, keeping your front shin near vertical and your torso leaning slightly forward. | Drive your opposite arm forward and the same-side arm back, as a sprinter would at the start line. | Push hard through your front heel to drive back up, swinging your rear knee forward and up toward your chest. | Pause briefly balancing on the standing leg, then step the driven leg back down into the next lunge. | Repeat on the same leg for your reps, or alternate legs each rep, keeping the movement controlled and rhythmic. | Finish by stepping both feet together and standing tall.
tRu: Встаньте прямо, поставив ноги на ширине бёдер, напрягите корпус, руки свободно вдоль тела. | Step one foot back into a long lunge stance, balancing on the ball of your rear foot with your heel lifted. | Согните обе ноги, опускаясь в выпад, удерживая переднюю голень почти вертикально и слегка наклонив корпус вперёд. | Вытяните противоположную руку вперёд и ту же руку назад, как спринтер на старте. | Push hard through your front heel to drive back up, swinging your rear knee forward and up toward your chest. | Задержитесь на мгновение на опорной ноге, затем сделайте шаг назад для следующего выпада. | Repeat on the same leg for your reps, or alternate legs each rep, keeping the movement controlled and rhythmic. | Завершите упражнение, поставьте обе ноги вместе и встаньте прямо.
tHe: עמוד זקוף עם רגליים ברוחב האגן, ליבה מכווצת וידיים רפויות לצדי הגוף. | Step one foot back into a long lunge stance, balancing on the ball of your rear foot with your heel lifted. | כופף את שתי הברכיים ורד ללאנג׳, תוך שמירה על שוק קדמית כמעט אנכית ופלג גוף עליון נוטה קלות קדימה. | דחוף את הזרוע הנגדית קדימה ואת הזרוע באותו הצד אחורה, כמו רצה בקו הפתיחה. | Push hard through your front heel to drive back up, swinging your rear knee forward and up toward your chest. | Pause briefly balancing on the standing leg, then step the driven leg back down into the next lunge. | Repeat on the same leg for your reps, or alternate legs each rep, keeping the movement controlled and rhythmic. | סיים בחבירת שתי כפות הרגליים ועמידה זקופה.

nE: Alternate Straight Leg Raise (on bosu ball)
t: Sit on the dome of the bosu ball and lie back so your lower back and hips are supported on the curved surface, with your head and shoulders relaxed. | Extend both legs out straight along the floor and place your hands at your sides or lightly on the bosu for stability. | Brace your core and press your lower back gently into the dome to lock in a stable, neutral position. | Keeping the leg straight, raise one leg upward until it points toward the ceiling, leading with the heel. | Pause briefly at the top while keeping your hips level and the opposite leg extended on the floor. | Lower the leg under control back to the starting position without letting it drop or your back arch. | Repeat with the opposite leg, alternating sides for the prescribed reps. | Finish by lowering both legs, then carefully sit up and step off the bosu ball.
tRu: Sit on the dome of the bosu ball and lie back so your lower back and hips are supported on the curved surface, with your head and shoulders relaxed. | Вытяните обе ноги прямо вдоль пола и поставьте руки по бокам или lightly на bosu для равновесия. | Напрягите корпус и мягко прижмите поясницу к полусфере, зафиксировав устойчивое нейтральное положение. | Держа ногу прямой, поднимите одну ногу вверх до тех пор, пока она не будет указывать на потолок, ведя пяточкой. | На мгновение остановитесь в верхней точке, сохраняя бедра на одном уровне, а противоположную ногу выпрямленной на полу. | С контролем опустите ногу в исходное положение, не бросая её и не прогибая спину. | Repeat with the opposite leg, alternating sides for the prescribed reps. | Завершите, опустив обе ноги, затем аккуратно встаньте и сойдите с bosu-мяча.
tHe: Sit on the dome of the bosu ball and lie back so your lower back and hips are supported on the curved surface, with your head and shoulders relaxed. | פשוט את שתי הרגלייי ישר לאורך הרצפה ומקם את ידיך בצדדיך או בעדינות על הבוסו ליציבות. | הדק את הליבה ולחץ את הגב התחתון בעדינות לכיפה כדי לנעול תנוחה יציבה וניטרלית. | Keeping the leg straight, raise one leg upward until it points toward the ceiling, leading with the heel. | Pause briefly at the top while keeping your hips level and the opposite leg extended on the floor. | Lower the leg under control back to the starting position without letting it drop or your back arch. | Repeat with the opposite leg, alternating sides for the prescribed reps. | סיים בהורדת שתי הרגליים, ואז שב בזהירות ורד מכדור הבוסו.

nR: Попеременные подъёмы ног с касанием носков
nH: הרמות רגליים עם נגיעות אצבעות לסירוגין
t: Lie flat on your back on a mat with your arms resting at your sides and your lower back lightly pressed toward the floor. | Brace your core and lift both legs until your hips and knees are bent to roughly 90°, shins parallel to the floor (tabletop position). | Keeping your core tight, lower one foot under control until your toe lightly taps the floor. | Tap the toe down without letting your lower back arch up off the mat. | Return that leg to the starting tabletop position by driving through your hip flexors. | Repeat with the opposite leg, alternating one side at a time in a steady, controlled rhythm. | Continue alternating until you complete your reps, then lower both feet to the floor with control.
tRu: Лягте на спину на коврик с руками вдоль тела и слегка прижатой поясницей к полу. | Напрягите корпус и поднимите обе ноги, согнув бёдра и колени примерно до 90°, удерживая голени параллельно полу (положение столешницы). | Держа корпус напряжённым, плавно опустите одну ногу, пока кончики пальцев не коснутся пола. | Tap the toe down without letting your lower back arch up off the mat. | Return that leg to the starting tabletop position by driving through your hip flexors. | Repeat with the opposite leg, alternating one side at a time in a steady, controlled rhythm. | Продолжайте чередовать, пока не выполните все повторения, затем с контролем опустите обе ноги на пол.
tHe: Lie flat on your back on a mat with your arms resting at your sides and your lower back lightly pressed toward the floor. | הדק את הליבה והרם את שתי הרגליים עד שהאגן והברכיים כפופים לכ-90°, כשהשוקיים מקבילות לרצפה (תנוחת שולחן). | Keeping your core tight, lower one foot under control until your toe lightly taps the floor. | Tap the toe down without letting your lower back arch up off the mat. | Return that leg to the starting tabletop position by driving through your hip flexors. | Repeat with the opposite leg, alternating one side at a time in a steady, controlled rhythm. | המשיל להחליף עד שתשלים את החזרות שלך, ואז הורד את שתי הרגליים לרצפה בשליטה.

t: Stand under a sturdy pull-up bar set high enough that your feet clear the floor when you hang. Use a box or jump up to reach it. | Grip the bar with both hands roughly shoulder-width apart, palms facing away, thumbs wrapped around the bar. | Let your body hang freely with your arms fully extended, allowing your shoulders to relax and your spine to lengthen. | Keep a slight, active tension in your shoulders rather than hanging completely limp, so the joints stay supported. | Slowly shift most of your weight onto one hand, letting that side stretch a little deeper while the other hand lightly supports you. | Hold for a few seconds, then smoothly transfer your weight across to the other hand. | Continue alternating side to side in a controlled rhythm, breathing steadily throughout. | When you finish, set your feet down or lower onto the box gently rather than dropping from the bar.
tRu: Stand under a sturdy pull-up bar set high enough that your feet clear the floor when you hang. Use a box or jump up to reach it. | Возьмитесь за штангу обеими руками примерно на ширине плеч, ладонями от себя, обхватив её большими пальцами. | Пусть ваше тело свободно свисает с полностью выпрямленными руками, позволяя плечам расслабиться и позвоночнику вытянуться. | Держите лёгкое, активное напряжение в плечах, а не полностью расслабленные, чтобы суставы оставались поддержанными. | Slowly shift most of your weight onto one hand, letting that side stretch a little deeper while the other hand lightly supports you. | Удерживайте несколько секунд, затем плавно перенесите вес на другую руку. | Продолжайте попеременно выполнять движения вправо и влево в контролируемом ритме, дыша ровно. | When you finish, set your feet down or lower onto the box gently rather than dropping from the bar.
