t: Get into a high plank with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width and your body in a straight line from head to heels. | Brace your core and squeeze your glutes so your hips neither sag nor pike up. | Have a partner place a weight plate or weight vest across your upper back and hold it steady over your shoulder blades. | Lower your chest toward the floor under control, keeping your elbows tucked at roughly a 45° angle to your torso. | Stop when your chest is just above the floor, keeping your wrists stacked under your shoulders. | Press back up by driving through your palms until your arms are fully extended, keeping your body in one rigid line. | Complete your reps, then have your partner lift the weight off before you stand up.
tRu: Примите положение высокой планки с руками, поставленными немного шире плеч, и прямым линией тела от головы до пяток. | Напрягите корпус и сожмите ягодицы, чтобы бёдра не провисали и не поднимались вверх. | Попросите партнера поместить весовую пластину или жилет с весами на верхнюю часть спины и удерживайте ее устойчиво над лопатками. | Подконтрольно опустите грудь к полу, удерживая локти прижатыми под углом примерно 45° к корпусу. | Stop when your chest is just above the floor, keeping your wrists stacked under your shoulders. | Press back up by driving through your palms until your arms are fully extended, keeping your body in one rigid line. | Выполните все повторения, затем пусть ваш партнёр снимет вес, прежде чем вы встанете.
tHe: היכנס לפלאנק גבוה כשהידיים מעט רחבות מרוחב הכתפיים והגוף בקו ישר מהראש ועד העקבים. | הדק את הליבה וכווץ את הישבן כך שהאגן לא ישקע ולא יתרומם. | קבל משותף הנחת לוחית משקולת או וסט משקולות על הגב העליון, והחזק אותם יציבים מעל השכמות. | הורד את החזה לכיוון הרצפה בשליטה, תוך שמירה על מרפקים צמודים בזווית של כ-45° לגוף. | Stop when your chest is just above the floor, keeping your wrists stacked under your shoulders. | Press back up by driving through your palms until your arms are fully extended, keeping your body in one rigid line. | בצע את כל החזרות, ואז בקש מהשותף שלך להרים את המשקל לפני שתקום.

t: Stand tall with your feet together, arms relaxed at your sides, and your core lightly braced. | Bend your knees slightly and jump both feet out to the sides into a wide astride position, landing softly on the balls of your feet. | Keep your knees soft and tracking over your toes as you absorb each landing. | Immediately jump both feet back together to return to the starting position. | Land lightly and rebound into the next repetition, keeping a steady, continuous rhythm. | Breathe in a relaxed, consistent pattern and keep your torso upright throughout. | Continue for your target time or rep count, then slow to a stop and recover.
tRu: Встаньте прямо, поставив стопы вместе, руки свободно вдоль тела, слегка напрягите корпус. | Слегка согните ноги и прыжком расставьте стопы широко в стороны, мягко приземляясь на подушечки стоп. | Держите колени мягкими и следите, чтобы они двигались в линии с носками, когда вы amortизируете каждое приземление. | Сразу же прыгните обеими ногами обратно вместе, чтобы вернуться в исходное положение. | Приземляйтесь мягко и оттолкнитесь в следующее повторение, сохраняя устойчивый, непрерывный ритм. | Дышите в расслабленном, устойчивом ритме и держите корпус прямо на протяжении всего времени. | Продолжайте до целевого времени или количества повторений, затем плавно остановитесь и восстановитесь.
tHe: עמוד זקוף עם רגליים צמודות, ידיים רפויות לצדי הגוף, והליבה קלות מכווצת. | כופף קלות את הברכיים וקפוץ עם שתי הרגליים הצידה לעמדה רחבה, נחת ברכות על כריות כפות הרגליים. | Keep your knees soft and tracking over your toes as you absorb each landing. | Immediately jump both feet back together to return to the starting position. | Land lightly and rebound into the next repetition, keeping a steady, continuous rhythm. | נשור בקצב מרגיע ועקבי, ושמור על גופך זקוף לאורך כל התרגיל. | המשך לזמן היעד או למספר החזרות, ואז האט עד לעצירה והתאושש.

t: Stand tall next to a wall, rack, or sturdy support and rest one hand on it for balance. | Shift your weight onto the leg nearest the support and let the outside leg hang relaxed off the floor. | Brace your core and keep your torso upright and still so the movement comes only from the hip. | Swing the free leg forward in a smooth, controlled arc, leading with the heel and letting the hip flexors lift it to a comfortable height. | Let the leg swing back down and continue behind you, squeezing the glute as it travels backward. | Keep the swinging knee soft and the standing leg slightly bent throughout the arc. | Complete your reps on one side, then turn around and repeat with the other leg.
tRu: Stand tall next to a wall, rack, or sturdy support and rest one hand on it for balance. | Shift your weight onto the leg nearest the support and let the outside leg hang relaxed off the floor. | Напрягите корпус и держите корпус вертикально и неподвижно, чтобы движение шло только от бедра. | Swing the free leg forward in a smooth, controlled arc, leading with the heel and letting the hip flexors lift it to a comfortable height. | Дайте ноге качаться вниз и продолжать движение за вами, сжимая ягодицу, когда она движется назад. | Держите качающееся колено мягким, а опорную ногу слегка согнутой на протяжении всего движения. | Выполните все повторения на одну сторону, затем развернитесь и повторите с другой ногой.
tHe: Stand tall next to a wall, rack, or sturdy support and rest one hand on it for balance. | Shift your weight onto the leg nearest the support and let the outside leg hang relaxed off the floor. | הדק את הליבה ושמור על גו זקוף ויציב כך שהתנועה תבוא רק מהירך. | Swing the free leg forward in a smooth, controlled arc, leading with the heel and letting the hip flexors lift it to a comfortable height. | Let the leg swing back down and continue behind you, squeezing the glute as it travels backward. | Keep the swinging knee soft and the standing leg slightly bent throughout the arc. | בצע את כל החזרות בצד אחד, ואז הסתובב וחזור על התרגיל עם הרגל השנייה.

t: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, knees soft, and your core gently braced. | Let your arms hang at your sides, then rotate your forearms so the backs of your hands face forward and your thumbs point outward. | Pull your shoulder blades down and slightly together to set your upper back before you move your arms. | Raise both arms out to the sides and slightly behind you, leading with the backs of your hands as if brushing them backward through the air. | Lift until your arms reach roughly shoulder height, keeping your elbows nearly straight and your shoulders pressed down away from your ears. | Pause briefly at the top and squeeze your rear shoulders and upper back without shrugging. | Lower your arms under control back to your sides, resisting the descent rather than letting them drop. | Complete your reps, keeping the tempo slow and the motion smooth throughout.
tRu: Встаньте прямо, поставив ноги на ширине бёдер, колени мягкие, мягко напрягите корпус. | Пусть ваши руки свободно свисают по бокам, затем поверните предплечья так, чтобы тыльные стороны кистей были направлены вперед, а большие пальцы — наружу. | Pull your shoulder blades down and slightly together to set your upper back before you move your arms. | Raise both arms out to the sides and slightly behind you, leading with the backs of your hands as if brushing them backward through the air. | Поднимайте, пока ваши руки не достигнут уровня плеча, сохраняя локти почти прямыми и опустив плечи вниз от ушей. | Пауза в верхней точке и сжатие задних дельт и верхней части спины без подъма плеч. | Медленно опустите руки обратно в стороны, контролируя опускание, а не давая им упасть. | Выполните все повторения, сохраняя темп медленным, а движение плавным на протяжении всего подхода.
tHe: עמוד זקוף עם רגליים ברוחב האגן, ברכיים רכות, והליבה בעדינות מכווצת. | Let your arms hang at your sides, then rotate your forearms so the backs of your hands face forward and your thumbs point outward. | Pull your shoulder blades down and slightly together to set your upper back before you move your arms. | Raise both arms out to the sides and slightly behind you, leading with the backs of your hands as if brushing them backward through the air. | Lift until your arms reach roughly shoulder height, keeping your elbows nearly straight and your shoulders pressed down away from your ears. | Pause briefly at the top and squeeze your rear shoulders and upper back without shrugging. | Lower your arms under control back to your sides, resisting the descent rather than letting them drop. | בצע את כל החזרות, שומר על קצב איטי ועל תנועה חלקה לכל אורך.

t: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, knees soft, and arms relaxed at your sides. | Brace your core and shift your weight slightly onto your supporting leg. | Drive one leg back and up behind you in a controlled kicking motion while keeping your torso upright. | At the same time, press both arms overhead, reaching tall through your fingertips. | Return the kicking leg and your arms back to the start position under control. | Repeat on the same side or alternate legs each rep, keeping a steady, rhythmic pace. | Continue for your target time or rep count, then slow to a stop and recover.

t: Sit on top of a stability ball with your feet flat on the floor, roughly shoulder-width apart for a stable base. | Slowly walk your feet forward, letting the ball roll under your back as you ease your torso backward. | Continue until your upper back, shoulders, and head are draped over the ball and your spine follows its curve. | Let your arms fall out to the sides or overhead, allowing your erector spinae to relax and lengthen. | Breathe slowly and deeply, releasing tension along your back with each exhale, and hold the position for 20–30 seconds. | To finish, tuck your chin, engage your core, and walk your feet back in to roll up to a seated position with control.
tRu: Sit on top of a stability ball with your feet flat on the floor, roughly shoulder-width apart for a stable base. | Slowly walk your feet forward, letting the ball roll under your back as you ease your torso backward. | Продолжайте, пока ваша верхняя часть спины, плечи и голова не окажутся обвисшими над мячом, а позвоночник повторял его изгиб. | Дайте вашим рукам уйти в стороны или над головой, позволяя разгибателям позвоночника расслабиться и удлиниться. | Дышите медленно и глубоко, используя каждый выдох, чтобы расслабиться глубже в растяжку, не добавляя амплитуду. | To finish, tuck your chin, engage your core, and walk your feet back in to roll up to a seated position with control.
tHe: Sit on top of a stability ball with your feet flat on the floor, roughly shoulder-width apart for a stable base. | Slowly walk your feet forward, letting the ball roll under your back as you ease your torso backward. | המשך עד שהגב העליון, הכתפיים והראש משתלשלים מעל הכדור והחוטשן עוקב את עקמומיותו. | Let your arms fall out to the sides or overhead, allowing your erector spinae to relax and lengthen. | נשיר לאט ועמוק, משחרר מתח לאורך הגב בכל נשימה, והחזיקו את המצב למשך 20–30 שניות. | To finish, tuck your chin, engage your core, and walk your feet back in to roll up to a seated position with control.

t: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees soft, and your arms hanging loosely at your sides. | Brace your core lightly and keep your chest lifted so the movement comes from the shoulders, not the lower back. | Swing both arms open wide to the sides and slightly back, feeling a stretch across your chest and the front of your shoulders. | Reverse the motion and swing your arms forward and across your body so your hands wrap around and slap the opposite sides of your upper back. | Let your upper back round slightly as the arms wrap, spreading the shoulder blades apart. | Swing back open into the wide position, allowing momentum to carry the arms smoothly rather than forcing the range. | Continue swinging open and wrapped in a steady, controlled rhythm for the desired number of reps, then return to a neutral standing position.
tRu: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees soft, and your arms hanging loosely at your sides. | Легко напрягите пресс и держите грудь поднятой, чтобы движение шло от плеч, а не от поясницы. | Swing both arms open wide to the sides and slightly back, feeling a stretch across your chest and the front of your shoulders. | Reverse the motion and swing your arms forward and across your body so your hands wrap around and slap the opposite sides of your upper back. | Позвольте вашей рабочей руке свисать сбоку с локтем, прижатым к ребрам и ладонью, обращенной вперед. | Swing back open into the wide position, allowing momentum to carry the arms smoothly rather than forcing the range. | Продолжайте раскачиваться в стороны и обернув в устойчивом, контролируемом ритме для нужного количества повторений, затем вернитесь в нейтральное положение стоя.

t: Stand facing a sturdy upright, such as a squat-rack post, a pole, or a door frame, with your feet about hip-width apart. | Grip the upright with one hand at roughly chest to head height, keeping your arm extended. | Step your feet back slightly and hinge at the hips so your torso angles away from your hand. | Let your hips sit back and down on the same side as the gripping arm, allowing your upper back to round gently. | Feel the stretch spread along the side of your back, from your armpit down toward your lower ribs. | Hold the position for 20 to 30 seconds while breathing slowly and steadily. | Release your grip, return to standing, then switch hands and repeat on the other side.
tRu: Stand facing a sturdy upright, such as a squat-rack post, a pole, or a door frame, with your feet about hip-width apart. | Возьмитесь за вертикальную стойку одной рукой на уровне от груди до головы, сохраняя руку выпрямленной. | Step your feet back slightly and hinge at the hips so your torso angles away from your hand. | Позвольте вашим бедрам отодвинуться назад и вниз на той же стороне, что и рука, выполняющая хват, позволяя вашей верхней части спины слегка округлиться. | Почувствуйте, как растяжка распространяется по боку спины, от подмышки вниз к нижним рёбрам. | Задержите позицию в течение 20–30 секунд, дыша медленно и ровно. | Release your grip, return to standing, then switch hands and repeat on the other side.
tHe: Stand facing a sturdy upright, such as a squat-rack post, a pole, or a door frame, with your feet about hip-width apart. | אחוז בעמוד המכשיר ביד אחת בגובה החזה עד הראש בקירוב, תוך שמירה על הזרוע פשוטה. | Step your feet back slightly and hinge at the hips so your torso angles away from your hand. | Let your hips sit back and down on the same side as the gripping arm, allowing your upper back to round gently. | הרגיש את המתיחה מתפשטת לאורך צד הגב, מבית השחי לעבר הצלעות התחתונות. | Hold the position for 20 to 30 seconds while breathing slowly and steadily. | Release your grip, return to standing, then switch hands and repeat on the other side.

t: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, knees soft, and core lightly braced. | Place your hands on your lower back with your fingers pointing down for support. | Lift your chest and draw your shoulder blades together to start opening the front of your torso. | Slowly lean backward by extending through your upper and mid-back, letting your abs lengthen as your hips press gently forward. | Go only as far as feels comfortable and pain-free, keeping your knees soft and your hips supported by your hands. | Hold the stretch for 15–30 seconds, breathing slowly and steadily into your belly. | Return to standing under control by re-engaging your abs and stacking your ribs back over your hips.

t: Choose a flat, open, obstacle-free path — a track, empty field, or quiet stretch of pavement — and scan it for hazards before you start. | Stand tall with a slight forward lean from the ankles, soft knees, and your weight balanced over the balls of your feet. | Glance over one shoulder to check the path behind you, then begin stepping backward with short, controlled strides. | Land on the ball of your foot first and let the heel come down lightly, rolling through each step to absorb impact. | Drive your knees back and pump your arms in rhythm to build momentum while keeping your torso upright. | Keep checking over alternating shoulders every few strides so you always know what's behind and beside you. | Settle into a steady, sustainable pace and breathe rhythmically through your nose and mouth. | To finish, gradually shorten your strides until you slow to a walk, then stop and face forward.
tRu: Выберите ровную, открытую, свободную от препятствий трассу — дорожку, пустое поле или тихий участок дорожного покрытия, и осмотрите её на наличие опасностей перед началом. | Stand tall with a slight forward lean from the ankles, soft knees, and your weight balanced over the balls of your feet. | Бросьте взгляд через одно плечо, чтобы проверить путь позади вас, затем начните делать шаги назад с короткими и контролируемыми шагами. | Приземляйтесь сначала на переднюю часть стопы, а затем плавно опустите пятку, перекатываясь с каждой ноги на другую для амортизации удара. | Отводите колени назад и ритмично двигайте руками, чтобы создать импульс, удерживая корпус прямо. | Периодически проверяйте, что происходит сзади и сбоку, оглядываясь через плечо. | Settle into a steady, sustainable pace and breathe rhythmically through your nose and mouth. | To finish, gradually shorten your strides until you slow to a walk, then stop and face forward.

t: Place the balance board on a flat, non-slip floor next to a wall, rail, or sturdy chair you can reach for support. | Step onto the center of the board one foot at a time, positioning your feet roughly shoulder-width apart. | Keep your knees soft and slightly bent, brace your core, and stand tall with your weight centered over the board. | Find your balance by making small adjustments through your ankles, calves, and inner thighs rather than swinging your arms or upper body. | Hold the balanced position for your target time, keeping your eyes fixed on a point ahead and breathing steadily. | Lower the edges of the board under control as you tire, resisting the wobble instead of letting it drop. | Step off one foot at a time, then rest before your next set.

t: Anchor the band low behind you, near floor level, and hold one handle in each hand with your palms facing forward. | Step forward to take up the slack, stagger your feet for balance, and brace your core with a slight forward lean from the hips. | Start with both arms down and slightly out to your sides, elbows softly bent and locked at that angle throughout. | Sweep one arm up and across your body toward the opposite shoulder in a wide arc, squeezing the lower chest at the top. | Pause briefly at the top with the working hand near chest height, feeling the contraction in the lower-chest fibers. | Lower that arm under control back to the starting position without letting the band snap you back. | Repeat with the other arm, alternating sides for the full set while keeping the non-working arm stable. | After your last rep, control the band back to the anchor and release the tension safely.

nE: Band Alternate Low Row wtih Twist

t: Anchor a resistance band at or near floor level and stand or sit facing the anchor, holding one handle in each hand with your arms extended toward it. | Step back to take the slack out of the band, then hinge slightly at the hips with a flat back, soft knees, and a braced core. | Set your shoulders down and back so the work starts from your mid-back, not your hands. | Drive one elbow back along your side, pulling the handle toward your hip and squeezing your shoulder blade in toward your spine. | As you row, rotate your torso open toward the working side to add the twist, keeping your hips stable. | Pause briefly at the top with your elbow behind your torso, then return the handle under control as you twist back to center. | Repeat the row and twist with the other arm, alternating sides for the full set. | After your last rep, step forward to release the band tension safely.

tHe: עגן גומייה בגובה הרצפה או לידה ועמוד או שב מול העוגן, תוך אחיזת ידית אחת בכל יד עם ידיים ישרות לעברו. | Step back to take the slack out of the band, then hinge slightly at the hips with a flat back, soft knees, and a braced core. | Set your shoulders down and back so the work starts from your mid-back, not your hands. | דחוע מרפיון אחורי לאורך הצד, מושך את הידית לכיוון הירך ומכווץ את לוחית הכתף לכיוון עמוד השדרה. | בחתירה, סובב את הגו פתוח לעבר הצד העובד להוספת הפיתול, תוך שמירה על אגן יציב. | Pause briefly at the top with your elbow behind your torso, then return the handle under control as you twist back to center. | Repeat the row and twist with the other arm, alternating sides for the full set. | לאחר החזרה האחרונה, צעד קדימה כדי לשחרר את מתח הגומייה בבטחה.

t: Loop a resistance band over the pull-up bar and pull the loose end down through itself to anchor it securely. | Grip the bar with an underhand (supinated) grip, hands roughly shoulder-width apart, palms facing you. | Place one foot or knee into the bottom of the band, then step off and let it stretch to support part of your bodyweight. | Hang at full extension with your arms straight and shoulder blades engaged, keeping your core braced and body still. | Pull your chest toward the bar by driving your elbows down and back, leading with your back muscles rather than your arms. | Continue until your chin clears the bar, squeezing your lats and lower traps at the top. | Lower yourself under control back to a full dead hang, resisting the band's upward pull the whole way down. | Complete your reps, then carefully remove your foot from the band and step down.
tRu: Оберните эспандер через перекладину для подтягиваний и пропустите свободный конец вниз через себя, чтобы надежно его закрепить. | Возьмитесь за штангу супинированным (хватом снизу) хватом, руки примерно на ширине плеч, ладонями направлены к вам. | Поставьте одну ногу или колено в нижнюю часть эспандера, затем шагните вперёд и позвольте ему растянуться, чтобы поддержать часть вашего веса. | Повисните в нижней точке с прямыми руками и задействованными лопатками, удерживая корпус напряженным и тело неподвижным. | Pull your chest toward the bar by driving your elbows down and back, leading with your back muscles rather than your arms. | Продолжайте, пока ваш подбородок не окажется выше перекладины, сильно сжимая широчайшие и нижние трапеции в верхней точке. | Под контролем вернитесь в полный вис на прямых руках, сопротивляясь натяжению эспандера на всём протяжении опускания. | Выполните все повторения, затем осторожно уберите ногу с эспандера и сойдите.

t: Loop a resistance band over the chin-up bar and pull the bottom of the band down so it hangs in the centre. | Grip the bar with an underhand (supinated) grip about shoulder-width apart, palms facing you. | Place one knee into the bottom of the band so it supports part of your bodyweight, then hang with your arms fully extended. | Brace your core and pull your shoulder blades down and back to set your starting position. | Pull your body up by driving your elbows down toward your ribs until your chin clears the bar. | Squeeze your lats and biceps briefly at the top without swinging or kicking off the band. | Lower yourself under control until your arms are fully extended and your shoulder blades reset. | Complete your reps, then carefully remove your knee from the band and step down.

t: Loop a resistance band across the two dip bars so it forms a sling, or hook it to one bar and pull it across — a thicker band removes more body weight and gives more assistance. | Kneel or place your feet into the band so it supports you, then grip the bars with your palms facing in and your arms locked out, supporting your body at the top. | Pull your shoulders down and back, brace your core, and keep a slight forward lean to involve the chest or stay upright to bias the triceps. | Bend your elbows to lower your body under control until your upper arms are roughly parallel to the floor, keeping your elbows tracking close to your sides. | Pause briefly at the bottom without letting your shoulders shrug up toward your ears. | Press through your palms and extend your elbows to drive back up to the locked-out start position, letting the band help you through the sticking point. | Complete your reps, then step or lift out of the band and lower yourself off the bars under control.

t: Loop a resistance band across both dip bars so it spans the gap, then test that it holds your weight when you press down on it. | Grip the parallel bars with your palms facing in and press up to lock out your arms, supporting yourself at the top. | Place your knees (or feet) into the band so it cradles your lower body and takes part of your weight. | Brace your core, keep your chest up, and let your shoulders sit down and back away from your ears. | Bend your elbows to lower your body under control until your upper arms are roughly parallel to the floor. | Keep your elbows tracking back at a slight angle rather than flaring wide out to the sides. | Press through your palms to drive back up to a full lockout, squeezing your triceps at the top. | Complete your reps, then step or lift out of the band and bring your feet back to the floor with control.

t: Kneel on a soft pad with your knees together and your ankles anchored under a fixed surface, partner, or loaded support so your feet cannot lift. | Loop a resistance band around your chest or upper arms and anchor it to a sturdy point in front of you at roughly torso height to provide upward assistance. | Set your hips fully extended so your knees, hips, and shoulders form a straight line, and brace your core and squeeze your glutes. | Lower your torso toward the floor slowly and under control, letting your knees act as the hinge while you keep your body straight. | Resist the descent with your hamstrings as far as you can, then catch yourself lightly with your hands just before your chest reaches the floor. | Drive back up by contracting your hamstrings and glutes, using the band's tension to help pull your torso upright. | Return to the fully extended kneeling position with a straight line from knees to shoulders, then begin the next rep. | Complete your reps, then carefully unloop the band and release your ankles.

t: Loop a resistance band over a pull-up bar and pull the bottom of the loop down so you can place one foot or both knees into it. | Reach up and take a false grip on the bar, hooking your wrists over the top so your palms face roughly down and the bar sits on the heel of your hand. | Step or kneel into the band and hang at full stretch with your shoulders engaged, letting the band support part of your bodyweight. | Pull explosively, driving your elbows down and back to bring your chest toward the bar while the band assists the upward drive. | As your chest reaches the bar, lean forward over it and roll your shoulders ahead of your hands to begin the transition. | Press down through your hands and straighten your arms to push your torso up and over the bar into the support position. | Lower under control by reversing the motion: shift back, drop your chest below the bar, and return to a dead hang. | Complete your reps, then carefully step out of the band and lower to the floor.

t: Loop a resistance band over the middle of the pull-up bar and pull the end through itself so it hangs securely. | Choose a thicker band for more assistance or a thinner one for less; the stronger the band, the more bodyweight it offsets. | Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width with an overhand grip, wrapping your thumbs around the bar. | Place one foot (or both knees) into the bottom of the band loop and let it support your weight as you hang with arms fully extended. | Pull your shoulder blades down and back, then drive your elbows toward your ribs to lift your chest up to the bar. | Continue until your chin clears the bar, keeping your core braced and your body from swinging. | Lower yourself under control until your arms are fully extended again, resisting the band's pull on the way down. | Complete your reps, then step out of the band carefully and remove it from the bar.

t: Anchor one end of the band to a stable post or have a partner hold it, then loop the other end around your waist or hold it at hip height. | Walk forward until the band has light tension and take up your sprint start position with one foot staggered behind the other. | Lean your torso forward from the ankles, brace your core, and pull your elbows to roughly 90 degrees. | Drive off the back foot and accelerate forward, punching your knees up and pumping your arms front-to-back in time with your legs. | Keep your steps short and powerful through the first few strides, staying low and pushing against (or driving with) the band's tension. | Continue sprinting for the set distance or time, keeping your foot strikes under your hips and your head and neck relaxed. | Decelerate smoothly under control rather than stopping abruptly, letting the band slacken as you slow. | Walk back to the start, reset the band tension, and repeat for your planned number of rounds.

t: Anchor a resistance band to a sturdy point ahead of and slightly above you, then loop the free end around the ab wheel or your forearms. | Kneel on a mat with the wheel under your shoulders, hands gripping the handles and the band drawn taut so it pulls back toward the anchor. | Brace your core and squeeze your glutes so your hips, spine, and shoulders form one straight line from knees to head. | Roll the wheel slowly forward, extending your hips and reaching your arms out as your torso lowers toward the floor. | Go only as far as you can while keeping your lower back flat — do not let your hips sag or your spine arch. | Pause briefly at full extension, keeping tension through your abs and hip flexors. | Pull the wheel back toward your knees, letting the band assist as you flex your hips and draw your torso upright. | Finish stacked over the wheel with your core still braced, then reset for the next rep.

t: Anchor the resistance band securely at floor level in front of you, or stand on it with both feet to set the tension. | Bend forward at the hips and grasp the band so it runs along the front of your torso, keeping your back flat and your core braced. | Set your feet about hip-width apart with a slight bend in your knees, hinged forward so you feel tension in the band. | Extend at the hips and lift your torso upward by contracting your lower back, raising until your body is upright and aligned. | Squeeze your erector spinae briefly at the top without arching past a neutral spine. | Lower your torso back down under control, hinging at the hips against the band's resistance. | Complete your reps, then release the band's tension slowly and step off the anchor.

t: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and the middle of a resistance band under the balls of both feet. | Hold an end of the band in each hand and raise your hands to shoulder height, or hook the band over your shoulders, so it is taut when you stand upright. | Set your posture: chest up, core braced, and a slight bend in your knees, with your weight over the balls of your feet. | Press through the balls of your feet and lift your heels as high as you can, squeezing your calves at the top against the band's resistance. | Pause briefly at the top with your ankles fully extended, keeping your balance steady. | Lower your heels under control back toward the floor until you feel a gentle stretch in your calves. | Complete your reps, then relax your heels to the floor and release the tension on the band.

tHe: עגן את הגומייה בגובה החזה מאחוריך ואחוז בידית אחת בכל יד, ואז צעד קדימה עד שהגומייה מתוחה. | Stand tall with a slight forward lean, one foot ahead of the other for balance, and brace your core. | Start with your arms open out to the sides at chest height, elbows kept soft with a slight bend. | Keeping that fixed elbow bend, bring both hands together in a wide arc in front of your chest as if hugging a barrel. | Squeeze your chest hard at the top when your hands meet, holding briefly for peak contraction. | Open your arms back out under control, resisting the band until you feel a stretch across your chest. | סיים את החזרות, ואז צעד אחורה לכיוון העוגן כדי לשחרר את מתח הגומייה בבטחה.

nR: Сгибания на бицепс узким хватом с эспандером
nH: כפיפות דו-ראשי באחיזה צרה עם גומייה
t: Stand on the middle of the band with feet about hip-width apart, holding one end in each hand with your palms facing forward. | Bring your hands close together so they sit inside shoulder width, keeping a narrow grip throughout the set. | Set your posture: chest up, shoulders back, and elbows pinned to your sides. | Curl your hands up toward your shoulders by flexing at the elbows, keeping your upper arms still. | Squeeze your biceps hard at the top, where band tension is highest. | Lower under control back to full extension, resisting the band on the way down. | Complete your reps, then step off the band and release the tension safely.
tRu: Stand on the middle of the band with feet about hip-width apart, holding one end in each hand with your palms facing forward. | Сведите руки вместе, чтобы они находились внутри ширины плеч, сохраняя узкий хват на протяжении всего подхода. | Set your posture: chest up, shoulders back, and elbows pinned to your sides. | Поднимите руки вверх к плечам, сгибая локти, удерживая верхние руки неподвижными. | Squeeze your biceps hard at the top, where band tension is highest. | Опустите под контролем обратно в полное выпрямление, сопротивляясь эспандеру на опускании. | Выполните повторения, затем сойдите с эспандера и безопасно снимите натяжение.
tHe: Stand on the middle of the band with feet about hip-width apart, holding one end in each hand with your palms facing forward. | הבא את ידיך קרוב זו לזו כך שישבו בתוך רוחב הכתפיים, שומר על אחיזה צרה לאורך כל הסט. | Set your posture: chest up, shoulders back, and elbows pinned to your sides. | כופף את הידיים לעבר הכתפיים על ידי כיפוף המרפקים, שומר על הזרוע העליונה סטטית. | Squeeze your biceps hard at the top, where band tension is highest. | Lower under control back to full extension, resisting the band on the way down. | סיים את החזרות, ואז רד מהגומייה ושחרר את המתח בבטחה.

t: Anchor the band securely at roughly chest height to a sturdy post or door anchor, then sit or stand facing the anchor with feet about hip-width apart. | Grip the band with both hands set close together, palms facing each other, and step back until the band has light tension at full arm extension. | Brace your core, set a tall chest, and pull your shoulder blades down and slightly together. | Drive your elbows straight back along your sides, keeping them tucked close to your torso as you row the band toward your lower ribs. | Squeeze your back at the end range until your hands reach the sides of your abdomen, keeping your wrists straight. | Pause briefly while keeping the shoulder blades retracted, then control the band back to full extension without letting it snap you forward. | Reset your posture and complete your reps with the same controlled tempo. | On the final rep, return the band under control and step forward to release the tension safely.
tRu: Надёжно закрепите эспандер примерно на высоте груди к прочной стойке или дверному креплению, затем сядьте или встаньте лицом к креплению, стопы примерно на ширине бёдер. | Возьмите эспандер обеими руками, близко друг к другу, ладонями друг к другу, и отступите назад, чтобы в положении полностью выпрямленных рук был легкий натяж. | Напрягите корпус, поднимите грудь высоко, опустите лопатки вниз и слегка сведите вместе. | Отведите локти прямо назад вдоль тела, удерживая их близко к корпусу, когда вы тяга эспандера к нижним ребрам. | Squeeze your back at the end range until your hands reach the sides of your abdomen, keeping your wrists straight. | Задержитесь на мгновение, сохраняя лопатки сведёнными, затем контролируйте эспандер обратно в полное растяжение, не давая его резко дернуть вас вперёд. | Reset your posture and complete your reps with the same controlled tempo. | На последнем повторении верните эспандер с контролем и сделайте шаг вперед, чтобы безопасно снять напряжение.
tHe: עגן את הגומייה היטב בערך בגובה החזה לעמוד יציב או לעוגן דלת, ואז שב או עמוד מול העוגן עם רגליים בערך ברוחב האגן. | אחוז בגומייה בשתי הידיים קרובות זו לזו, כפות פונות זו לזו, וצעד לאחור עד שהגומייה תחת מתח קל בפשיטת זרועות מלאה. | הדק את הליבה, קבע חזה גבוה ומשוך את השכמות למטה ומעט יחד. | דחוף את המרפקים ישר אחורה לאורך הצדדים, שומר עליהם צמודים לגוף בזמן שאתה מושך את הגומיה לכיוון הצלעות התחתונות. | Squeeze your back at the end range until your hands reach the sides of your abdomen, keeping your wrists straight. | Pause briefly while keeping the shoulder blades retracted, then control the band back to full extension without letting it snap you forward. | Reset your posture and complete your reps with the same controlled tempo. | On the final rep, return the band under control and step forward to release the tension safely.

t: Loop a resistance band around both ankles, or anchor one end to a fixed point at floor level and the other around your working ankle. | Stand tall next to the anchor with the band on the inside leg, feet roughly hip-width apart so there is light tension on the band. | Brace your core and shift your weight onto the standing leg, keeping a slight bend in that knee for balance. | Keeping the working leg straight, sweep it out to the side and slightly across the front of your standing leg against the band's pull. | Pause briefly at the top of the abduction, squeezing the outer hip of the working leg. | Lower the leg back under control to the start without letting the band snap it inward. | Complete all reps on one side, then switch the band to the other leg and repeat.
tRu: Оберните эспандер вокруг обеих лодыжек, или закрепите один конец на фиксированной точке на уровне пола, а другой — вокруг рабочей лодыжки. | Stand tall next to the anchor with the band on the inside leg, feet roughly hip-width apart so there is light tension on the band. | Напрягите корпус и перенесите вес на опорную ногу, сохраняя лёгкий сгиб в колене для равновесия. | Держа рабочую ногу прямую, ведите ее в сторону и немного перед опорной ногой против тяги эспандера. | Пауза в верхней точке отведения, сжимая наружную сторону бедра рабочей ноги. | С контролем опустите ногу в исходное положение, не позволяя эспандеру резко подтянуть её внутрь. | Выполните все повторения на одной стороне, затем поменяйте эспандер на другую ногу и повторите.

nE: Band Cross Body One Arm Chest Press
nR: Жим одной рукой через корпус с эспандером
nH: לחיצת חזה ביד אחת לרוחב הגוף עם גומייה
t: Anchor a resistance band at about chest height behind you, then face away from the anchor. | Hold the handle in one hand and step forward to take the slack out of the band so there is tension at the start. | Stagger your stance for balance, bring the handle to the front of your shoulder, and point your elbow back at roughly 45 degrees to your torso. | Brace your core and squeeze your chest as you press the handle forward and slightly across the midline of your body. | Finish with your arm nearly extended and your hand reaching across toward the opposite shoulder, feeling the chest fully contract. | Pause briefly, then return the handle under control to the front of your shoulder, resisting the band the whole way back. | Complete all reps on one side, then switch the handle to the other hand and repeat for an even number of sets.

tHe: עגן גומייה בערך בגובה החזה מאחוריך, ואז עמוד עם הפנים הרחק מהעוגן. | Hold the handle in one hand and step forward to take the slack out of the band so there is tension at the start. | Stagger your stance for balance, bring the handle to the front of your shoulder, and point your elbow back at roughly 45 degrees to your torso. | הדק את הליבה וכווץ את החזה תוך לחיצת הידית קדימה ומעט לרוחב קו האמצע של הגוף. | סיים עם הזרוע כמעט פשוטה והיד חוצה אל הכתף הנגדית, תוך תחושת כיווץ מלא של החזה. | Pause briefly, then return the handle under control to the front of your shoulder, resisting the band the whole way back. | בצע את כל החזרות בצד אחד, ואז העבר את הידית ליד השנייה וחזור על מספר סטים זוגי.

t: Stand on the middle of the band with feet hip- to shoulder-width apart, splitting the band's length evenly under both arches. | Push your hips back and hinge forward to grip the top of the band with both hands, keeping a long, neutral spine. | Brace your core, pull your shoulder blades down, and take the slack out of the band so you feel tension before you move. | Drive your feet into the floor and push your hips forward, standing up tall as the band stretches. | Finish standing fully upright with your hips and knees extended and glutes squeezed, without leaning back. | Push your hips back again and lower under control, letting the band shorten as you hinge. | Return to the starting hinge position with tension still on the band, then repeat for your target reps.
