tHe: עגן את הגומייה לנקודה יציבה מולך בערך בגובה החזה ובדוק שהיא בטוחה. | Kneel on both knees (or a half-kneeling stance) facing the anchor, far enough back that the band is under light tension with your arm extended. | אחוז בגומייה ביד אחת, כף היד פונה פנימה, והדק את הליבה כך שהגו נשאר זקוף ונייח. | Pull the band straight back toward the side of your torso, leading with your elbow and driving it past your ribs. | Squeeze your back at the end of the pull while keeping your shoulder down and away from your ear. | Lower the band under control back to full arm extension without letting your shoulder roll forward. | בצע את כל החזרות בצד אחד, ואז החלף ידיים וחזור על אותו מספר חזרות עבור היד השנייה.

t: Stand on the middle of the resistance band with your feet about shoulder-width apart, holding one end or handle in each hand. | Let your arms hang at your sides with a slight bend in the elbows and your palms facing your thighs. | Brace your core, keep your chest up, and pull your shoulder blades down to set a stable base. | Raise both arms out to the sides in a smooth arc, leading with your elbows rather than your hands. | Continue until your upper arms reach roughly shoulder height, forming a wide "T" with your torso. | Pause briefly at the top, keeping your wrists in line with or slightly below your elbows. | Lower your arms under control back to your sides, resisting the band the whole way down. | Complete your reps, then step off the band carefully to release the tension.
tRu: Stand on the middle of the resistance band with your feet about shoulder-width apart, holding one end or handle in each hand. | Пусть ваши руки свободно свисают по боками с небольшим сгибанием в локтях и ладонями, обращенными к бедрам. | Напрягите корпус, держите грудь вверх и опустите лопатки вниз, чтобы создать устойчивую опору. | Raise both arms out to the sides in a smooth arc, leading with your elbows rather than your hands. | Продолжайте движение, пока ваши верхние руки не достигнут примерно уровня плеч, образуя широкий "Т" с вашим корпусом. | На вершине движения сделайте короткую паузу, удерживая запястья на линии с локтями или немного ниже. | Медленно опустите руки обратно в стороны, сопротивляясь эспандеру на всём пути вниз. | Выполните повторения, затем осторожно сойдите с эспандера, чтобы снять натяжение.
tHe: Stand on the middle of the resistance band with your feet about shoulder-width apart, holding one end or handle in each hand. | Let your arms hang at your sides with a slight bend in the elbows and your palms facing your thighs. | הדק את הליבה, שמור על חזה מורם, ומשוך את שכמות הכתפיים למטה כדי לקבע בסיס יציב. | Raise both arms out to the sides in a smooth arc, leading with your elbows rather than your hands. | המשך עד שהזרועות העליונות מגיעות לגובה הכתפיים, יוצרות צורת T רחבה עם הגו. | Pause briefly at the top, keeping your wrists in line with or slightly below your elbows. | Lower your arms under control back to your sides, resisting the band the whole way down. | סיים את החזרות, ואז רד בזהירות מהגומייה כדי לשחרר את המתח.

t: Stand on the middle of the resistance band with your feet about shoulder-width apart, distributing your weight evenly. | Hold one band handle in each hand with your arms hanging straight down at your sides and palms facing your thighs. | Brace your core, keep your chest up, and maintain a slight bend in your elbows. | Raise both arms out to the sides against the band's tension, leading with your elbows rather than your hands. | Lift until your arms reach roughly shoulder height, forming a wide T with your body, without shrugging your shoulders up toward your ears. | Pause briefly at the top while keeping tension on the side deltoids. | Lower your arms slowly and under control back to your sides, resisting the band on the way down. | Complete your reps, then step off the band carefully to release the tension.
tRu: Stand on the middle of the resistance band with your feet about shoulder-width apart, distributing your weight evenly. | Возьмите ручки эспандера в каждую руку, руки опущены вдоль тела, ладони обращены к бёдрам. | Напрягите корпус, держите грудь вверх и сохраняйте лёгкий сгиб в локтях. | Raise both arms out to the sides against the band's tension, leading with your elbows rather than your hands. | Поднимайте, пока ваши руки не достигнут уровня плеча, образуя широкий T с вашим телом, не поднимая плечи к ушам. | На мгновение остановитесь в верхней точке, сохраняя напряжение на боковых дельтовидных мышцах. | Медленно опустите руки обратно в стороны, сопротивляясь эспандеру на пути вниз. | Выполните повторения, затем осторожно сойдите с эспандера, чтобы снять натяжение.
tHe: Stand on the middle of the resistance band with your feet about shoulder-width apart, distributing your weight evenly. | Hold one band handle in each hand with your arms hanging straight down at your sides and palms facing your thighs. | הדק את הליבה, שמור על חזה מורם ושמור על כיפוף קל במרפקים. | Raise both arms out to the sides against the band's tension, leading with your elbows rather than your hands. | Lift until your arms reach roughly shoulder height, forming a wide T with your body, without shrugging your shoulders up toward your ears. | Pause briefly at the top while keeping tension on the side deltoids. | Lower your arms slowly and under control back to your sides, resisting the band on the way down. | סיים את החזרות, ואז רד בזהירות מהגומייה כדי לשחרר את המתח.

nH: לחיצת חזה תחתונה לסירוגין עם גומייה
t: Anchor a resistance band low to a sturdy point behind you, near floor or ankle height. | Take a handle in each hand and step forward into a staggered stance until the band is taut, facing away from the anchor. | Raise your hands to chest height with your elbows bent and tucked, palms facing down and slightly forward. | Brace your core and pull your shoulder blades down to set a stable pressing base. | Press one arm forward and slightly upward until it is fully extended in front of your chest, squeezing the pec at the top. | Lower that hand under control back to chest height while keeping tension on the band. | Press the opposite arm forward in the same way, alternating sides without rotating your torso. | Continue alternating for your target reps, then release the band tension under control.
tRu: Закрепите эспандер низко за надёжную опору позади вас, примерно на высоте пола или лодыжек. | Take a handle in each hand and step forward into a staggered stance until the band is taut, facing away from the anchor. | Raise your hands to chest height with your elbows bent and tucked, palms facing down and slightly forward. | Напрягите корпус и опустите лопатки вниз, чтобы создать устойчивую опору для жима. | Press one arm forward and slightly upward until it is fully extended in front of your chest, squeezing the pec at the top. | Опустите эту руку под контролем обратно на высоту груди, сохраняя напряжение в эспандере. | Press the opposite arm forward in the same way, alternating sides without rotating your torso. | Продолжайте поочерёдно работать в течение целевого количества повторений, затем с контролем ослабьте натяжение эспандера.
tHe: עגן גומייה נמוך לנקודה יציבה מאחוריך, קרוב לגובה הרצפה או הקרסול. | Take a handle in each hand and step forward into a staggered stance until the band is taut, facing away from the anchor. | Raise your hands to chest height with your elbows bent and tucked, palms facing down and slightly forward. | הדק את הליבה ומשוך את השכמות למטה כדי ליצור בסיס לחיצה יציב. | Press one arm forward and slightly upward until it is fully extended in front of your chest, squeezing the pec at the top. | Lower that hand under control back to chest height while keeping tension on the band. | Press the opposite arm forward in the same way, alternating sides without rotating your torso. | המשילו להחליף לפי מספר החזרות המטרה, ואז שחררו את מתח הגומייה באופן מבוקר.

t: Anchor the band low to a sturdy point near the floor, and stand facing away from the anchor with a handle in each hand. | Take a staggered or shoulder-width stance, brace your core, and lean your torso slightly forward to keep tension on the band. | Start with your arms down and out to your sides, palms facing forward and elbows kept soft with a slight, fixed bend. | Sweep your hands up and toward each other in a wide arc, leading with your chest and keeping the slight elbow bend throughout. | Bring your hands together in front of your upper chest at roughly eye-to-chin height and squeeze your pecs at the top. | Pause briefly in the fully contracted position without letting your elbows straighten or your shoulders shrug up. | Lower your hands back down along the same arc under control, feeling a stretch across your chest at the bottom. | Complete your reps, then step back toward the anchor to release the tension before unhooking the band.
tRu: Закрепите эспандер низко к прочной точке у пола и встаньте спиной к креплению с рукоятью в каждой руке. | Take a staggered or shoulder-width stance, brace your core, and lean your torso slightly forward to keep tension on the band. | Start with your arms down and out to your sides, palms facing forward and elbows kept soft with a slight, fixed bend. | Sweep your hands up and toward each other in a wide arc, leading with your chest and keeping the slight elbow bend throughout. | Сведите руки перед верхней частью груди на уровне от глаз до подбородка и сожмите грудь в верхней точке. | Задержитесь на мгновение в полном сокращении, не разгибая локти и не поднимая плечи к ушам. | Опустите руки обратно вниз по той же дуге под контролем, чувствуя растяжение в груди в нижней точке. | Выполните все повторения, затем шагните назад к точке крепления, чтобы снять напряжение, прежде чем отсоединить эспандер.
tHe: עגן את הגומייה נמוך לנקודה יציבה ליד הרצפה, ועמוד עם הגב לעוגן עם ידית בכל יד. | Take a staggered or shoulder-width stance, brace your core, and lean your torso slightly forward to keep tension on the band. | Start with your arms down and out to your sides, palms facing forward and elbows kept soft with a slight, fixed bend. | Sweep your hands up and toward each other in a wide arc, leading with your chest and keeping the slight elbow bend throughout. | הבא את ידיך יחד בקדמת החזה העליון בגובה עיניים עד לסנטר וכווץ את שרירי החזה בחלק העליון. | Pause briefly in the fully contracted position without letting your elbows straighten or your shoulders shrug up. | Lower your hands back down along the same arc under control, feeling a stretch across your chest at the bottom. | בצע את כל החזרות, וצעד אחורה לעבר העוגן כדי לשחרר את המתח לפני שתתרגם את הגומי.

t: Anchor the band low and behind you — a door anchor near the floor or a sturdy fixture at ankle height. | Grip a handle in each hand and face away from the anchor, then step forward to take the slack out of the band. | Bring your hands to chest height beside your lower pecs, elbows bent and pointing down and back, with one foot staggered forward for a stable base. | Brace your core and pull your shoulder blades down and slightly together to set a stable pressing platform. | Press the handles up and forward along a rising diagonal toward eye level, extending your arms without locking the elbows hard. | Squeeze your upper chest as your hands meet near the top, keeping the movement under control against the band's pull. | Lower the handles back to your lower chest under tension, resisting the band the whole way. | Complete your reps, then step back toward the anchor to safely release the band tension.
tRu: Закрепите эспандер низко позади вас — дверное крепление у пола или прочный фиксатор на высоте лодыжек. | Возьмите по одной рукоятке в каждую руку и развернитесь спиной к точке крепления, затем сделайте шаг вперед, чтобы убрать slack из эспандера. | Переместите руки на уровень груди у нижней части груди, локти согнуты и направлены вниз и назад, одна нога впереди для устойчивости. | Напрягите корпус и опустите лопатки вниз, слегка сведя их вместе, чтобы создать устойчивую опору для жима. | Press the handles up and forward along a rising diagonal toward eye level, extending your arms without locking the elbows hard. | Squeeze your upper chest as your hands meet near the top, keeping the movement under control against the band's pull. | Опустите рукоятия обратно к нижней груди под напряжением, сопротивляясь эспандеру на протяжении всего движения. | Выполните все повторения, затем шагните назад к точке крепления, чтобы безопасно снять напряжение с эспандера.
tHe: עגן את הגומייה נמוך ומאחוריך – עוגן דלת ליד הרצפה או מתקן יציב בגובה הקרסול. | אחוז בידית בכל יד ופנה בגב אל העוגן, ואז צעד קדימה כדי להוציא את הרפיון מהגומייה. | הבא את ידיך לגובה החזה ליד החזה התחתון, מרפי מרפיים כפופים ומכוונים למטה ואחורה, עם רגל אחת מוקדמת קדימה לבסיס יציב. | הדק את הליבה ומשוך את השכמות למטה ומעט זו לזו כדי ליצור משטח לחיצה יציב. | Press the handles up and forward along a rising diagonal toward eye level, extending your arms without locking the elbows hard. | Squeeze your upper chest as your hands meet near the top, keeping the movement under control against the band's pull. | Lower the handles back to your lower chest under tension, resisting the band the whole way. | בצע את כל החזרות, וצעד אחורה לעבר העוגן כדי לשחרר בבטחה את מתח הגומי.

t: Anchor a band low to the ground behind you, near floor level, and grab one handle in each hand. | Step forward to remove the slack, then stagger your stance for a stable base with a slight forward lean from the hips. | Start with your arms out to your sides and slightly below shoulder height, elbows softly bent and palms facing forward and up. | Brace your core and keep your shoulder blades set down and back against your ribs. | Sweep both arms upward and inward in a wide arc, leading with your hands until they meet in front of your upper chest or face. | Squeeze your upper chest hard at the top, keeping the elbow bend fixed throughout the arc. | Lower under control along the same path until you feel a stretch across your chest. | Complete your reps, then walk back toward the anchor to safely release the band tension.
tRu: Закрепите эспандер низко у пола за спиной и возьмите по рукояти в каждую руку. | Step forward to remove the slack, then stagger your stance for a stable base with a slight forward lean from the hips. | Start with your arms out to your sides and slightly below shoulder height, elbows softly bent and palms facing forward and up. | Напрягите корпус и зафиксируйте лопатки внизу и сзади, прижав их к рёбрам. | Sweep both arms upward and inward in a wide arc, leading with your hands until they meet in front of your upper chest or face. | Squeeze your upper chest hard at the top, keeping the elbow bend fixed throughout the arc. | Опустите под контролем по тому же пути, пока не почувствуете растяжку в груди. | Выполните свои повторения, затем идите к якорю, чтобы безопасно ослабить натяжение эспандера.
tHe: עגן גומייה נמוך לקרקע מאחוריך, קרוב לגובה הרצפה, ואחוז ידית אחת בכל יד. | Step forward to remove the slack, then stagger your stance for a stable base with a slight forward lean from the hips. | Start with your arms out to your sides and slightly below shoulder height, elbows softly bent and palms facing forward and up. | הדק את הליבה ושמור על השכמות למטה ולאחור צמוד לצלעות. | Sweep both arms upward and inward in a wide arc, leading with your hands until they meet in front of your upper chest or face. | Squeeze your upper chest hard at the top, keeping the elbow bend fixed throughout the arc. | Lower under control along the same path until you feel a stretch across your chest. | בצע את כל החזרות, ואז הלך אחורה לכיוון העוגן כדי לשחרר בבטחה את מתח הגומייה.

t: Stand on the middle of the band with one foot, feet hip-width apart, and grip a handle in each hand. | Bring the handles up to your shoulders so the band runs behind your arms, and stand tall with your chest up and core braced. | Take a controlled step forward into a lunge stance, keeping your torso upright. | Lower your hips straight down until your front thigh is roughly parallel to the floor and your back knee hovers just above the ground. | Keep your front knee tracking over your toes and your weight balanced through your whole front foot. | Drive through your front heel against the band's tension to push back up to the standing start position. | Complete your reps on one leg, then switch the band to the other foot and repeat.
tRu: Stand on the middle of the band with one foot, feet hip-width apart, and grip a handle in each hand. | Поднимите рукояти до плеч, чтобы эспандер проходил за руками, и встаньте прямо, грудь выпячена, корпус напряжен. | Take a controlled step forward into a lunge stance, keeping your torso upright. | Опустите бёдра строго вниз, пока переднее бедро не станет примерно параллельно полу, а заднее колено не окажется чуть выше пола. | Следите, чтобы колено передней ноги было направлено над носками, а вес был распределен равномерно на всю переднюю стопу. | Отталкивайтесь передней пяткой против сопротивления эспандера, чтобы встать в исходное положение. | Выполните повторения на одну ногу, затем поменяйте эспандер на другую ногу и повторите.
tHe: Stand on the middle of the band with one foot, feet hip-width apart, and grip a handle in each hand. | הבא את הידיות לכתפיים כך שהגומי עובר מאחורי הזרועות, ועמוד ישר עם החזה פרוס ושרירי הליבה מתוחים. | Take a controlled step forward into a lunge stance, keeping your torso upright. | הורד את האגן ישר למטה עד שהירך הקדמית כמעט מקבילה לרצפה והברך האחורית מרחפת ממש מעל הקרקע. | Keep your front knee tracking over your toes and your weight balanced through your whole front foot. | דחוף עם עקב הרגל הקדמית כנגד מתח הגומייה כדי לחזור לעמידה בתנוחת ההתחלה. | בצע את כל החזרות ברגל אחת, ואז העבר את הגומייה לכף הרגל השנייה וחזור על התרגיל.

nR: Наружная ротация бедра лёжа с эспандером
nH: רוטציה חיצונית של ירך בשכיבה עם גומייה
t: Loop a resistance band around both legs just above the knees and lie on your side with your hips and shoulders stacked vertically. | Bend both knees to roughly 90° and stack your feet and ankles together in front of you. | Brace your core and keep your hips still so the movement comes only from the top hip rotating, not from rolling backward. | Keeping your feet touching, slowly raise your top knee toward the ceiling against the band's resistance. | Rotate the top knee up only as far as you can without your pelvis tilting back or your lower spine arching. | Pause briefly at the top and feel the contraction deep in the glute of the working hip. | Lower the knee back down under control, resisting the band the whole way rather than letting it snap shut. | Complete all your reps on one side, then roll over and repeat with the other hip on top.
tRu: Оберните эспандер вокруг обеих ног чуть выше колен и лягте на бок, чтобы таз и плечи были расположены вертикально. | Согните обе ноги примерно до 90° и соедините стопы и лодыжки вместе перед собой. | Напрягите корпус и удерживайте бёдра неподвижно, чтобы движение шло только за счёт вращения верхнего бедра, а не заваливания назад. | Держа ноги соприкасающимися, медленно поднимайте верхнее колено к потолку, преодолевая сопротивление эспандера. | Rotate the top knee up only as far as you can without your pelvis tilting back or your lower spine arching. | На мгновение остановитесь в верхней точке и ощущайте сокращение глубоко в ягодичной мышце рабочей ноги. | С контролем опустите колено вниз, сопротивляясь эспандеру на всем пути, а не позволяя ему резко сомкнуться. | Выполните все повторения на одну сторону, затем перевернитесь и повторите, положив другую ягодицу вниз.
tHe: Loop a resistance band around both legs just above the knees and lie on your side with your hips and shoulders stacked vertically. | כופף את שתי הברכיים לערך ל-90° והצמד את כפות הרגליים והקרסוליים זו לזו לפניך. | הדק את הליבה ושמור על האגן יציב כך שהתנועה תבוא רק מסיבוב הירך העליונה, בלי להתגלגל אחורה. | Keeping your feet touching, slowly raise your top knee toward the ceiling against the band's resistance. | Rotate the top knee up only as far as you can without your pelvis tilting back or your lower spine arching. | Pause briefly at the top and feel the contraction deep in the glute of the working hip. | Lower the knee back down under control, resisting the band the whole way rather than letting it snap shut. | בצע את כל החזרות שלך בצד אחד, ואז הטב את גופך וחזור עם הירך השנייה למעלה.

nE: Band lying leg and hip raise
nR: Подъёмы ног и таза лёжа с эспандером
nH: הרמות רגליים ואגן בשכיבה עם גומייה
t: Anchor a resistance band to a low, sturdy point behind your head, or loop it around your feet for self-resistance. | Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and the band running along your shins or hooked over your feet. | Press your lower back into the floor and brace your abs to remove any arch before you begin. | Keeping your legs straight or slightly bent, raise them together against the band's resistance until they point toward the ceiling. | Continue by lifting your hips a few inches off the floor, curling your pelvis toward your ribs at the top. | Pause briefly, keeping tension on the band and your core fully engaged. | Lower your hips back down with control, then lower your legs slowly until they hover just above the floor. | Complete your reps, then release the band tension under control.
tRu: Закрепите эспандер в низкой прочной точке позади головы или накиньте его вокруг стоп для самостоятельного сопротивления. | Лягте на спину с выпрямленными ногами и эспандером, идущим вдоль голеней или закреплённым на ступнях. | Press your lower back into the floor and brace your abs to remove any arch before you begin. | Держа ноги прямыми или слегка согнутыми, поднимите их вместе, преодолевая сопротивление эспандера, пока они не указывали бы на потолок. | Продолжайте, поднимая бёдра на несколько дюймов от пола, сводя таз с рёбрами в верхней точке. | Задержитесь на мгновение, сохраняя напряжение на эспандере и полностью задействовав мышцы кора. | Опустите бёдра обратно вниз с контролем, затем медленно опустите ноги, пока они не окажутся чуть выше пола. | Выполните все повторения, затем ослабьте натяжение эспандера под контролем.
tHe: עגן גומייה לנקודה נמוכה ויציבה מאחורי הראש, או לפף אותה סביב כפות הרגליים להתנגדות עצמית. | Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and the band running along your shins or hooked over your feet. | Press your lower back into the floor and brace your abs to remove any arch before you begin. | Keeping your legs straight or slightly bent, raise them together against the band's resistance until they point toward the ceiling. | המשך על ידי הרמת הירכיים מספר אינצ'ים מהרצפה, מקפל את האגן לכיוון הצלעות בשיא התנועה. | Pause briefly, keeping tension on the band and your core fully engaged. | Lower your hips back down with control, then lower your legs slowly until they hover just above the floor. | בצע את החזרות שלך, ואז שחרר את המתח בפס בשליטה.

t: Anchor one end of the band to a low, sturdy point behind your feet, then loop the free end around your ankles or the back of your heels. | Lie face-down on the floor or a bench with your legs extended and the band pulling your feet away from your hips, creating tension at the start. | Rest your forehead on your hands or grip the bench edge, and brace your core so your hips stay flat throughout the set. | Curl your heels toward your glutes by bending at the knees, keeping your thighs pressed into the surface. | Squeeze your hamstrings hard at the top, where band tension is highest, holding briefly without letting your hips rise. | Lower your feet under control back to the start, resisting the band rather than letting it snap your legs straight. | Complete your reps, then release the band tension slowly and unhook it from the anchor.
tRu: Закрепите один конец эспандера в низкой прочной точке позади стоп, затем накиньте свободный конец вокруг лодыжек или задней части пяток. | Лягте на живот на пол или на скамью с вытянутыми ногами и эспандер, оттягивающий ваши ноги от таза, создавая напряжение в исходном положении. | Rest your forehead on your hands or grip the bench edge, and brace your core so your hips stay flat throughout the set. | Согните пятки к ягодицам, сгибая колени, при этом удерживайте бедра прижатыми к поверхности. | Squeeze your hamstrings hard at the top, where band tension is highest, holding briefly without letting your hips rise. | Опустите ноги под контролем обратно в исходное положение, сопротивляясь эспандеру, а не позволяя ему резко выпрямить ваши ноги. | Выполните все повторения, затем медленно ослабьте натяжение эспандера и снимите его с якоря.
tHe: עגן קצה אחד של הגומייה לנקודה נמוכה ויציבה מאחורי כפות הרגליים, ואז לפף את הקצה החופשי סביב הקרסוליים או אחורי העקבים. | Lie face-down on the floor or a bench with your legs extended and the band pulling your feet away from your hips, creating tension at the start. | Rest your forehead on your hands or grip the bench edge, and brace your core so your hips stay flat throughout the set. | כרוח את העקבים לעבר הישבן על ידי כיפוף בברכים, שומר על הירכיים לחוצות לעבר המשטח. | Squeeze your hamstrings hard at the top, where band tension is highest, holding briefly without letting your hips rise. | Lower your feet under control back to the start, resisting the band rather than letting it snap your legs straight. | בצע את החזרות שלך, ואז שחרר את המתח בפס לאט ונתק אותו מהעוגן.

t: Anchor the band to a low, sturdy point and loop the other end around your ankles or feet. | Lie flat on your back facing away from the anchor, legs extended so the band is taut at the start. | Press your lower back gently into the floor and brace your core to lock your pelvis in place. | Keeping your legs straight or with a slight bend, raise them together toward the ceiling by flexing at the hips. | Lift until your legs are roughly vertical or as high as you can without your lower back arching off the floor. | Pause briefly at the top, feeling the contraction in the front of your hips. | Lower your legs under control against the band's resistance until they return to the starting position. | Complete your reps, then release the band tension before unlooping your feet.
tRu: Закрепите эспандер к низкой прочной точке, а другой конец накиньте вокруг лодыжек или стоп. | Лягте на спину спиной к якорю, ноги выпрямлены, эспандер натянут в начале движения. | Press your lower back gently into the floor and brace your core to lock your pelvis in place. | Держа ноги прямыми или с небольшим сгибом, поднимите их вместе к потолку, сгибаясь в тазобедренных суставах. | Поднимайте, пока ваши ноги не станут примерно вертикальными или насколько высоко вы сможете, не прогибая поясницу. | На вершине движения сделайте короткую паузу, ощущая сокращение передней части бёдер. | Опустите ноги под контролем, сопротивляясь сопротивлению эспандера, пока они не вернутся в исходное положение. | Выполните все повторения, затем ослабьте натяжение эспандера, прежде чем снять ноги.
tHe: עגן את הגומייה לנקודה נמוכה ויציבה ולפף את הקצה השני סביב הקרסוליים או כפות הרגליים. | Lie flat on your back facing away from the anchor, legs extended so the band is taut at the start. | Press your lower back gently into the floor and brace your core to lock your pelvis in place. | Keeping your legs straight or with a slight bend, raise them together toward the ceiling by flexing at the hips. | Lift until your legs are roughly vertical or as high as you can without your lower back arching off the floor. | Pause briefly at the top, feeling the contraction in the front of your hips. | Lower your legs under control against the band's resistance until they return to the starting position. | בצע את החזרות שלך, ואז שחרר את המתח בפס לפני שפושט את רגליך.

nR: Разгибания вниз обратным хватом лёжа с эспандером
nH: פשיטות למטה באחיזה הפוכה בשכיבה עם גומייה
t: Anchor a resistance band to a sturdy point above and behind your head, then lie on your back on the floor or a bench with your head near the anchor. | Grip the band with both hands using a reverse (underhand, palms-up) grip, hands roughly shoulder-width apart. | Bend your elbows and bring your hands up toward your shoulders, keeping your upper arms vertical and tucked close to your torso. | Brace your core and pin your elbows in place so only your forearms will move. | Press your hands down toward your hips by extending your elbows until your arms are fully straight, squeezing the triceps at the bottom. | Pause briefly in the fully extended position without locking out aggressively. | Bend your elbows under control to let the band pull your hands back toward your shoulders. | Complete your reps, then slowly release the tension and unhook the band.
tRu: Закрепите эспандер к прочной точке выше и позади головы, затем лягте на спину на пол или скамью головой к креплению. | Возьмите эспандер обеими руками обратным хватом (снизу, ладонями вверх), руки примерно на ширине плеч. | Согните локти и поднимите кисти к плечам, удерживая плечи вертикально и близко к корпусу. | Напрягите корпус и зафиксируйте локти на месте, чтобы двигались только предплечья. | Press your hands down toward your hips by extending your elbows until your arms are fully straight, squeezing the triceps at the bottom. | Задержитесь на мгновение в полном разогнутом положении, не фиксируя локти агрессивно. | Подконтрольно согните локти, позволяя эспандеру притянуть кисти обратно к плечам. | Выполните все повторения, затем медленно расслабьте напряжение и снимите эспандер.
tHe: עגן גומייה לנקודה יציבה מעל הראש ומאחוריו, ואז שכב על הגב על הרצפה או על ספסל כשהראש קרוב לעוגן. | אחוז בגומייה בשתי הידיים באחיזה הפוכה (מלמטה, כפות מעלה), הידיים ברוחב הכתפיים בקירוב. | כופף את המרפקים והבא את הידיים למעלה לכיוון הכתפיים, תוך שמירה על זרועות עליונות אנכיות וצמודות לגוף. | הדק את הליבה וקבע את המרפקים במקום כך שרק האמות יזוזו. | Press your hands down toward your hips by extending your elbows until your arms are fully straight, squeezing the triceps at the bottom. | Pause briefly in the fully extended position without locking out aggressively. | כופף את המרפקים בשליטה כדי לתת לגומייה למשוך את הידיים חזרה לכיוון הכתפיים. | בצע את החזרות שלך, ואז שחרר באיטיות את המתח ונתק את הגומייה.

t: Anchor a band at roughly chest height on each side, or loop one band around a fixed point so both ends sit level with your chest. | Grip a handle in each hand and step forward to the middle, away from the anchor, until the bands are taut with your arms out to the sides. | Stand tall with a soft bend in your elbows, feet shoulder-width apart, and brace your core to keep your torso stable. | Set your shoulder blades down and back, then start with your arms open wide and level with your chest. | Pull the handles horizontally inward in a wide arc, bringing your hands together in front of the middle of your chest. | Squeeze your chest hard at the end of the arc, keeping the slight elbow bend fixed throughout. | Return your arms out to the sides slowly under control, feeling the stretch across your chest. | Complete your reps, then step back toward the anchor to release the band tension safely.
tRu: Закрепите эспандер примерно на высоте груди с каждой стороны или оберните один эспандер вокруг опоры так, чтобы оба конца оказались на уровне груди. | Возьмите по одной рукоятке в каждую руку ладонями вверх и сделайте шаг назад, пока эспандер не натянется, а руки будут выпрямлены перед вами. | Stand tall with a soft bend in your elbows, feet shoulder-width apart, and brace your core to keep your torso stable. | Set your shoulder blades down and back, then start with your arms open wide and level with your chest. | Pull the handles horizontally inward in a wide arc, bringing your hands together in front of the middle of your chest. | Squeeze your chest hard at the end of the arc, keeping the slight elbow bend fixed throughout. | Return your arms out to the sides slowly under control, feeling the stretch across your chest. | Выполните повторения, затем шагните назад к точке крепления, чтобы безопасно снять натяжение эспандера.
tHe: עגן גומייה בערך בגובה החזה בכל צד, או כרוך גומייה אחת סביב נקודה קבועה כך ששני הקצוות בגובה החזה. | אחוז בידית בכל יד וצעד קדימה אל המרכז, הרחק מהעוגן, עד שהגומיות מתוחות והזרועות לצדדים. | Stand tall with a soft bend in your elbows, feet shoulder-width apart, and brace your core to keep your torso stable. | Set your shoulder blades down and back, then start with your arms open wide and level with your chest. | Pull the handles horizontally inward in a wide arc, bringing your hands together in front of the middle of your chest. | Squeeze your chest hard at the end of the arc, keeping the slight elbow bend fixed throughout. | Return your arms out to the sides slowly under control, feeling the stretch across your chest. | סיים את החזרות, ואז צעד אחורה לכיוון העוגן כדי לשחרר את מתח הגומייה בבטחה.

nR: Высокая тяга узким хватом с эспандером
nH: חתירה גבוהה באחיזה צרה עם גומייה
t: Anchor a resistance band securely at or above head height, then step back to take the slack out of it. | Take a narrow, overhand grip on the band or handles with your hands roughly shoulder-width apart or closer. | Stand or kneel facing the anchor with your arms extended up toward it, feet hip-width apart and core braced. | Set your posture by drawing your shoulder blades down and back slightly before you pull. | Pull the band down and back toward your upper chest, leading with your elbows and keeping them high and flared out. | Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the pull, holding the contraction briefly. | Reverse the movement under control, letting your arms extend back toward the anchor without losing tension. | Complete your reps, then step toward the anchor to release the band tension safely.
tRu: Надёжно закрепите эспандер на высоте головы или выше, затем отойдите назад, чтобы убрать слабину. | Take a narrow, overhand grip on the band or handles with your hands roughly shoulder-width apart or closer. | Stand or kneel facing the anchor with your arms extended up toward it, feet hip-width apart and core braced. | Set your posture by drawing your shoulder blades down and back slightly before you pull. | Pull the band down and back toward your upper chest, leading with your elbows and keeping them high and flared out. | Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the pull, holding the contraction briefly. | Reverse the movement under control, letting your arms extend back toward the anchor without losing tension. | Выполните повторения, затем шагните к точке крепления, чтобы безопасно снять натяжение эспандера.
tHe: עגן גומייה היטב בגובה הראש או מעליו, ואז צעד לאחור כדי למתוח אותה. | Take a narrow, overhand grip on the band or handles with your hands roughly shoulder-width apart or closer. | Stand or kneel facing the anchor with your arms extended up toward it, feet hip-width apart and core braced. | Set your posture by drawing your shoulder blades down and back slightly before you pull. | Pull the band down and back toward your upper chest, leading with your elbows and keeping them high and flared out. | Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the pull, holding the contraction briefly. | Reverse the movement under control, letting your arms extend back toward the anchor without losing tension. | סיים את החזרות, ואז צעד לכיוון העוגן כדי לשחרר את מתח הגומייה בבטחה.

nR: Высокая тяга узким хватом с эспандером (вариант 2)
nH: חתירה גבוהה באחיזה צרה עם גומייה (גרסה 2)
t: Anchor the band at or above head height and face the anchor point. | Take a narrow, neutral grip on the handles or band, hands roughly hip-width apart, and step back until the band is taut with your arms extended forward and slightly upward. | Hinge slightly at the hips, brace your core, and set your shoulder blades down and back. | Pull the band toward your upper chest, driving your elbows back and down along your sides. | Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the pull while keeping your wrists straight. | Pause briefly with the band near your sternum, feeling the contraction in your upper back. | Return the band forward under control until your arms are fully extended again. | Complete your reps, then step toward the anchor to release the tension safely.
tRu: Закрепите эспандер на высоте головы или выше и встаньте лицом к креплению. | Take a narrow, neutral grip on the handles or band, hands roughly hip-width apart, and step back until the band is taut with your arms extended forward and slightly upward. | Слегка наклоняйтесь в бёдра, напрягите корпус и опустите лопатки вниз и назад. | Pull the band toward your upper chest, driving your elbows back and down along your sides. | Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the pull while keeping your wrists straight. | Задержитесь на мгновение с эспандером у груди, чувствуя сокращение в верхней части спины. | Return the band forward under control until your arms are fully extended again. | Выполните повторения, затем шагните к точке крепления, чтобы безопасно снять натяжение.
tHe: עגן את הגומייה בגובה הראש או מעליו ועמוד מול נקודת העיגון. | Take a narrow, neutral grip on the handles or band, hands roughly hip-width apart, and step back until the band is taut with your arms extended forward and slightly upward. | כופף מעט בציר הירכיים, הדק את הליבה וקבע את השכמות מטה ולאחור. | Pull the band toward your upper chest, driving your elbows back and down along your sides. | Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the pull while keeping your wrists straight. | Pause briefly with the band near your sternum, feeling the contraction in your upper back. | Return the band forward under control until your arms are fully extended again. | סיים את החזרות, ואז צעד לכיוון העוגן כדי לשחרר את המתח בבטחה.

nE: Band one arm overhead biceps cur
nR: Сгибания на бицепс одной рукой над головой с эспандером
nH: כפיפת דו-ראשי ביד אחת מעל הראש עם גומייה
t: Anchor one end of the band securely overhead, slightly to one side, and grip the free end with the working hand. | Step out until the band is taut, then raise the working arm out to the side so your upper arm is roughly parallel to the floor and your palm faces your head. | Keep your upper arm fixed in this overhead position throughout the set; only the forearm should move. | Curl the band by bending your elbow, bringing your hand toward the side of your head against the band's resistance. | Squeeze the upper arm at the top of the curl while keeping the elbow stable. | Lower the hand under control back to the start, resisting the band as your arm straightens. | Complete your reps, then switch sides and repeat with the other arm.
tRu: Надёжно закрепите один конец эспандера над головой чуть сбоку и возьмите свободный конец рабочей рукой. | Step out until the band is taut, then raise the working arm out to the side so your upper arm is roughly parallel to the floor and your palm faces your head. | Держите верхнюю часть руки параллельно полу и локоть зафиксирован на уровне плеч на протяжении всего движения. | Подтяните эспандер, сгибая локоть, приближая руку к боку головы, преодолевая сопротивление эспандера. | Squeeze the upper arm at the top of the curl while keeping the elbow stable. | Плавно опустите руку в исходное положение, сопротивляясь эспандеру по мере выпрямления руки. | Выполните повторения, затем поменяйте стороны и повторите другой рукой.
tHe: עגן קצה אחד של הגומייה היטב מעל הראש, מעט הצידה, ואחוז בקצה החופשי ביד העובדת. | Step out until the band is taut, then raise the working arm out to the side so your upper arm is roughly parallel to the floor and your palm faces your head. | Keep your upper arm fixed in this overhead position throughout the set; only the forearm should move. | גלול את הגומייה על ידי כיפוף המרפק, הבאת ידך לעבר צד הראש כנגד התנגדות הגומייה. | Squeeze the upper arm at the top of the curl while keeping the elbow stable. | Lower the hand under control back to the start, resisting the band as your arm straightens. | סיים את החזרות, ואז החלף צדדים וחזור על התרגיל עם היד השנייה.

nE: Band One Arm Standing Wide Grip Low Row
nR: Нижняя тяга одной рукой стоя широким хватом с эспандером
nH: חתירה תחתונה ביד אחת בעמידה באחיזה רחבה עם גומייה
t: Anchor the band at roughly waist or hip height to a sturdy fixture and check that it is secure before loading it. | Stand facing the anchor and grip one end of the band with one hand, palm facing down or slightly inward for a wide-grip path. | Step back to put light tension on the band, set your feet about hip-width apart, and brace your core with a tall, neutral spine. | Start with your working arm extended toward the anchor and let your shoulder blade reach slightly forward. | Pull the band back and out toward your hip, leading with your elbow and driving it wide rather than tucked tight to your side. | Squeeze your shoulder blade down and toward your spine as your hand reaches the side of your torso. | Pause briefly at the contracted position, keeping your shoulder down and away from your ear. | Lower the band under control back to full extension, then complete your reps and switch arms.
tRu: Закрепите эспандер примерно на высоте талии или бёдер к прочному креплению и проверьте надёжность перед нагрузкой. | Stand facing the anchor and grip one end of the band with one hand, palm facing down or slightly inward for a wide-grip path. | Step back to put light tension on the band, set your feet about hip-width apart, and brace your core with a tall, neutral spine. | Start with your working arm extended toward the anchor and let your shoulder blade reach slightly forward. | Pull the band back and out toward your hip, leading with your elbow and driving it wide rather than tucked tight to your side. | Squeeze your shoulder blade down and toward your spine as your hand reaches the side of your torso. | На мгновение остановитесь в конечной точке, удерживая плечо опущенным и отведенным от уха. | Опустите эспандер под контролём обратно в положение полного разгибания, затем завершите повторения и поменяйте руки.
tHe: עגן את הגומייה בערך בגובה המותניים או האגן למתקן יציב ובדוק שהיא בטוחה לפני שתעמיס עליה. | Stand facing the anchor and grip one end of the band with one hand, palm facing down or slightly inward for a wide-grip path. | Step back to put light tension on the band, set your feet about hip-width apart, and brace your core with a tall, neutral spine. | Start with your working arm extended toward the anchor and let your shoulder blade reach slightly forward. | Pull the band back and out toward your hip, leading with your elbow and driving it wide rather than tucked tight to your side. | Squeeze your shoulder blade down and toward your spine as your hand reaches the side of your torso. | Pause briefly at the contracted position, keeping your shoulder down and away from your ear. | Lower the band under control back to full extension, then complete your reps and switch arms.

nR: Наклоны в сторону над головой с эспандером
nH: כפיפות צד מעל הראש עם גומייה
t: Stand on the middle of the band with the foot on the side you want to train, feet about hip-width apart. | Hold the other end of the band in the same-side hand and press it straight overhead until your arm is fully extended. | Place your free hand on your hip and brace your core, keeping your hips and shoulders square to the front. | Keeping your overhead arm locked, bend your torso slowly to the opposite side, letting the band stretch as your ribcage moves away from your hip. | Bend only as far as you can without rotating or leaning forward, feeling a stretch along the loaded side of your waist. | Contract your obliques to pull your torso back upright, controlling the band on the way up. | Complete all reps on one side, then switch the band and hand to train the other side. | Step off the band and release the tension under control to finish.

tHe: Stand on the middle of the band with the foot on the side you want to train, feet about hip-width apart. | Hold the other end of the band in the same-side hand and press it straight overhead until your arm is fully extended. | Place your free hand on your hip and brace your core, keeping your hips and shoulders square to the front. | Keeping your overhead arm locked, bend your torso slowly to the opposite side, letting the band stretch as your ribcage moves away from your hip. | התכופף רק עד כמה שאתה יכול בלי להסתובב או להישען קדימה, תוך תחושת מתיחה לאורך הצד העמוס של המותן. | כווץ את השרירים האלכסוניים כדי למשוך את גופך בחזרה למצב זקוף, שולט בגומייה בעת העלייה. | בצע את כל החזרות בצד אחד, ואז החלף את הגומייה והיד כדי לעבוד את הצד השני. | Step off the band and release the tension under control to finish.

nE: Band Overhead Single Arm Triceps Extension

t: Anchor one end of the band securely under your foot or beneath a stable, low fixed point. | Grip the free end with one hand and raise that arm overhead, keeping your elbow pointing forward and your upper arm close to your head. | Brace your core and stand tall so your torso stays upright and your lower back does not arch. | Let your forearm bend down behind your head until you feel a stretch in the triceps, keeping your elbow high and still. | Press your hand up toward the ceiling by straightening your elbow against the band's resistance. | Fully extend the arm at the top and squeeze the triceps without locking the joint forcefully. | Lower under control back to the stretched position, resisting the band on the way down. | Complete your reps, then switch the band to the other hand and repeat on the opposite arm.
tRu: Надёжно закрепите один конец эспандера под стопой или под стабильной низкой фиксированной точкой. | Возьмите свободный конец одной рукой и поднимите эту руку над головой, сохраняя локоть направленным вперед и верхней частью руки близко к голове. | Напрягите пресс и встаньте прямо, чтобы корпус оставался вертикальным, а поясница не прогибалась. | Пусть ваше предплечье сгибается за головой, пока вы не почувствуете растяжение в трицепсе, держа локоть высоким и неподвижным. | Press your hand up toward the ceiling by straightening your elbow against the band's resistance. | Полностью выпрямите руку в верхней точке и сильно сожмите трицепсы, но не блокируйте сустав. | Под контролем опуститесь в положение растяжения, сопротивляясь эспандеру на пути вниз. | Выполните свои повторения, затем перенесите эспандер в другую руку и повторите с другой рукой.
tHe: עגן קצה אחד של הגומייה היטב מתחת לכף הרגל או מתחת לנקודה נמוכה ויציבה. | אחוז בקצה החופשי ביד אחת והרם את הזרוע מעל הראש, תוך שמירה על המרפק מצביע קדימה והזרוע העליונה קרובה לראש. | הדק את הליבה ועמוד זקוף כך שהגו יישאר זקוף והגב התחתון לא יתקשת. | Let your forearm bend down behind your head until you feel a stretch in the triceps, keeping your elbow high and still. | Press your hand up toward the ceiling by straightening your elbow against the band's resistance. | פשוט את הזרוע לגמרי בשיא וכווץ את הזרוע האחורית (טרייספס) מבלי לנעול את המפרק בכוח. | Lower under control back to the stretched position, resisting the band on the way down. | בצע את כל החזרות, ואז העבר את הגומייה ליד השנייה וחזור על היד השנייה.

t: Anchor one end of the band securely under your foot or to a low fixed point behind you. | Grip the other end with one hand and raise that arm overhead, elbow pointing up and the band running down behind your back. | Set your stance shoulder-width apart and brace your core so your torso stays upright and still. | Keeping your upper arm vertical and close to your head, lower your hand behind your neck by bending only at the elbow. | Extend your elbow to press the band straight up overhead until your arm is fully locked out. | Squeeze the triceps at the top, then lower under control back to the stretched position. | Complete all reps on one side, then switch the band to the other hand and repeat.
tRu: Надёжно закрепите один конец эспандера под стопой или к низкой фиксированной точке позади вас. | Возьмитесь за другой конец одной рукой и поднимите эту руку над голову, локоть направлен вверх, а эспандер проходит по спине. | Set your stance shoulder-width apart and brace your core so your torso stays upright and still. | Держа верхнюю руку вертикально и близко к голове, опустите руку за голову, сгибая только локоть. | Разогните локоть, чтобы поднять эспандер прямо вверх над головой до полного выпрямления руки. | Squeeze the triceps at the top, then lower under control back to the stretched position. | Выполните все повторения на одной стороне, затем поменяйте эспандер на другую руку и повторите.
tHe: עגן קצה אחד של הגומייה היטב מתחת לכף הרגל או לנקודה נמוכה וקבועה מאחוריך. | אחוז בקצה השני ביד אחת והרם את הזרוע מעל הראש, המרפק מצביע מעלה והגומייה יורדת מאחורי הגב. | Set your stance shoulder-width apart and brace your core so your torso stays upright and still. | Keeping your upper arm vertical and close to your head, lower your hand behind your neck by bending only at the elbow. | פשוט את המרפק כדי ללחוץ את הגומייה ישר למעלה מעל הראש עד שהזרוע ננעלת לחלוטין. | Squeeze the triceps at the top, then lower under control back to the stretched position. | בצע את כל החזרות בצד אחד, ואז העבר את הגומייה ליד השנייה וחזור על התרגיל.

nR: Разгибания на трицепс над головой с эспандером

t: Anchor one end of the band low to a sturdy point, or stand on the middle of the band with one foot to fix it to the floor. | Grip the free end (or both ends) with both hands and raise your arms straight overhead, palms facing forward or each other. | Bend your elbows to lower your hands behind your head, keeping your upper arms vertical and close to your ears. | Brace your core and keep your torso upright so the work stays on the triceps, not your lower back. | Extend your elbows to drive your hands back up overhead until your arms are fully straight and you feel the triceps contract. | Pause briefly at the top without locking out aggressively, keeping tension on the band. | Lower your hands under control back behind your head, resisting the band's pull on the way down. | Complete your reps, then step off the band or release the anchor with control.
tRu: Закрепите один конец эспандера низко к прочной точке или наступите на середину эспандера одной стопой, чтобы зафиксировать его на полу. | Возьмитесь свободный конец (или оба конца) обеими руками и поднимите руки прямо над головой, ладони обращены вперед или друг к другу. | Согните локти, опуская кисти за голову и удерживая плечи вертикально близко к ушам. | Напрягите корпус и держите корпус вертикально, чтобы нагрузка оставалась на трицепсах, а не на пояснице. | Разогните локти, чтобы поднять руки вверх над головой до полного выпрямления рук и почувствовать сокращение трицепса. | Задержитесь на мгновение в верхней точке, не выпрямляя локти агрессивно, сохраняя напряжение на эспандере. | Опустите руки под контролем назад за голову, сопротивляясь натяжению эспандера на пути вниз. | Выполните свои повторения, затем сойдите с эспандера или безопасно контролируйте ослабление якоря.
tHe: עגן קצה אחד של הגומייה נמוך לנקודה יציבה, או דרוך על אמצע הגומייה עם רגל אחת כדי לקבע אותה לרצפה. | אחוז בקצה החופשי (או בשני הקצוות) בשתי הידיים והרם את הזרועות ישר מעל הראש, כפות פונות קדימה או זו לזו. | כופף את המרפקים כדי להוריד את הידיים מאחורי הראש, תוך שמירה על זרועות עליונות אנכיות וקרוב לאוזניים. | הדק את הליבה ושמור על גו זקוף כדי שהעבודה תישאר על התלת-ראש ולא על הגב התחתון. | פשוט את המרפקים כדי לדחוף את הידיים אחורה למעלה מעל הראש עד שהזרועות ישרות לחלוטין ואתה מרגיש את הזרוע התלת-ראשית מתכווצת, כשכפות הידים פונות למטה. | Pause briefly at the top without locking out aggressively, keeping tension on the band. | Lower your hands under control back behind your head, resisting the band's pull on the way down. | בצע את כל החזרות, ואז צעד מהגומיה או שחרר את העוגן עם שליטה.

nR: Разгибания на трицепс над головой с эспандером (вариант 2)

t: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart and a slight bend in your knees. | Hold the band with both hands, palms facing down and arms extended straight out in front of you at about chest height. | Set your grip so there is light tension on the band with your arms fully extended. | Brace your core and pull your shoulder blades down and away from your ears. | Stretch the band apart by drawing your hands out to the sides, leading with the backs of your hands. | Pull until your arms are out wide and the band touches or nearly touches your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together. | Pause briefly, then return your hands to the start under control, resisting the band the whole way. | Complete your reps, keeping the tension smooth and continuous throughout the set.

tHe: עמוד זקוף עם רגליים ברוחב הכתפיים וכיפוף קל בברכיים. | Hold the band with both hands, palms facing down and arms extended straight out in front of you at about chest height. | Set your grip so there is light tension on the band with your arms fully extended. | הדק את הליבה ומשוך את השכמות למטה והרחק מהאוזניים. | Stretch the band apart by drawing your hands out to the sides, leading with the backs of your hands. | Pull until your arms are out wide and the band touches or nearly touches your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together. | Pause briefly, then return your hands to the start under control, resisting the band the whole way. | בצע את כל החזרות, שומר על מתח חלק ורציף לכל אורך הסט.

t: Anchor a resistance band to a sturdy point above head height, such as a pull-up bar or the top of a door. | Stand facing the anchor and grip the band with both hands using an overhand grip, palms facing down. | Step back if needed so the band has tension, and tuck your elbows firmly against your sides. | Brace your core and keep your upper arms still as you extend your elbows to push the band down toward your thighs. | Fully straighten your arms and squeeze your triceps hard at the bottom of the rep. | Slowly bend your elbows to let the band rise back up under control until your forearms are roughly parallel to the floor. | Complete your reps, then step toward the anchor to release the tension safely.

tHe: עגן גומייה לנקודה יציבה מעל גובה הראש, למשל מתח או החלק העליון של דלת. | Stand facing the anchor and grip the band with both hands using an overhand grip, palms facing down. | Step back if needed so the band has tension, and tuck your elbows firmly against your sides. | הדק את הליבה ושמור על הזרועות העליונות יציבות בזמן שאתה מיישר את המרפקים כדי לדחוף את הגומייה למטה לכיוון הירכיים. | יישר את הזרועות לגמרי וכווץ את הזרוע האחורית (טרייספס) בחוזקה בתחתית החזרה. | Slowly bend your elbows to let the band rise back up under control until your forearms are roughly parallel to the floor. | סיים את החזרות, ואז צעד לכיוון העוגן כדי לשחרר את המתח בבטחה.

t: Anchor a resistance band to a sturdy point above head height, such as a pull-up bar or a closed door at the top. | Stand facing the anchor and grip the band with both hands, palms facing down, at about chest height. | Step back slightly to take up the slack and brace your core with a small forward lean from the hips. | Pin your upper arms against your sides so only your forearms will move, keeping your elbows tucked in. | Extend your elbows and push your hands down until your arms are fully straight, squeezing your triceps at the bottom. | Pause briefly in the locked-out position without letting your shoulders round forward. | Return your hands under control to chest height, resisting the band so it does not snap back. | Complete your reps, then step toward the anchor to release the tension safely.

t: Loop a resistance band across your upper back, just below the shoulder blades, and hook one end under each thumb or palm. | Set your hands on the floor slightly wider than shoulder-width, with the band pinned firmly under your palms so it can't slip. | Walk your feet back into a high plank: body in a straight line from head to heels, core braced and glutes tight. | Lower your chest toward the floor under control, keeping your elbows tucked at roughly a 45° angle to your torso. | Stop when your chest is just above the floor and your upper arms are about parallel to it, keeping the band taut. | Press back up by driving through your palms, extending your arms fully against the band's resistance until you reach the top. | Keep your hips level and body rigid throughout, then repeat for your target reps.

t: Anchor a resistance band at roughly chest height to a sturdy post or door anchor. | Face the anchor and grip the band with both hands using a pronated (palms-down) overhand grip, hands about shoulder-width apart. | Step back until the band is taut with your arms extended in front of you, then set a soft bend in your knees and brace your core. | Stand tall with your chest up and shoulder blades neutral, keeping your wrists in line with your forearms. | Pull the band toward your upper chest by driving your elbows up and out to the sides, flaring them wide rather than tucking them in. | Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the pull, feeling the contraction across your rear delts and mid-back. | Pause briefly in the fully contracted position without shrugging your shoulders toward your ears. | Lower the band under control back to the extended start position, resisting the pull the whole way. | Complete your reps, then step toward the anchor to safely release the band tension.

tHe: עגן גומייה בערך בגובה החזה לעמוד יציב או לעוגן דלת. | פנה אל העוגן ותפוס את הגומיה עם שתי הידיים באמצעות אחיזה מלמעלה (כפות יד למטה), ידיים ברוחב כתף. | Step back until the band is taut with your arms extended in front of you, then set a soft bend in your knees and brace your core. | Stand tall with your chest up and shoulder blades neutral, keeping your wrists in line with your forearms. | Pull the band toward your upper chest by driving your elbows up and out to the sides, flaring them wide rather than tucking them in. | Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the pull, feeling the contraction across your rear delts and mid-back. | Pause briefly in the fully contracted position without shrugging your shoulders toward your ears. | Lower the band under control back to the extended start position, resisting the pull the whole way. | בצע את כל החזרות, ואז צעד כלפי העוגן כדי לשחרר בבטחה את מתח הגומיה.

t: Loop one end of the resistance band over the pull-up bar and feed it through itself so it hangs securely. | Step or kneel into the bottom loop so the band sits across your hips or over your thighs, then take an underhand (supinated) grip on the bar about shoulder-width apart. | Hang from the bar with your arms fully extended, shoulder blades set down and back, and your core braced so the band holds you taut. | Pull your elbows down toward your ribs and drive your chest up to the bar, leading with your upper back rather than just your arms. | Continue until your chin clears the bar, squeezing your lats and biceps at the top against the added band tension. | Lower yourself under control back to a full hang, resisting the band as it tries to snap you up. | Reset your shoulder blades and repeat for your target reps, then carefully step out of the band when finished.
tRu: Оберните один конец эспандера через перекладину для подтягиваний и пропустите его через себя, чтобы он надежно висел. | Step or kneel into the bottom loop so the band sits across your hips or over your thighs, then take an underhand (supinated) grip on the bar about shoulder-width apart. | Повисните на перекладине с полностью выпрямленными руками, лопатки опущены назад, и корпус напряжен, чтобы эспандер держал вас в натянутом состоянии. | Pull your elbows down toward your ribs and drive your chest up to the bar, leading with your upper back rather than just your arms. | Продолжайте, пока ваш подбородок не окажется выше перекладины, сильно сжимая широчайшие и бицепсы в верхней точке, преодолевая дополнительное напряжение от эспандера. | Под контролем вернитесь в полный вис, сопротивляясь эспандеру, который пытается резко поднять вас. | Reset your shoulder blades and repeat for your target reps, then carefully step out of the band when finished.
tHe: Loop one end of the resistance band over the pull-up bar and feed it through itself so it hangs securely. | Step or kneel into the bottom loop so the band sits across your hips or over your thighs, then take an underhand (supinated) grip on the bar about shoulder-width apart. | תלה מהמוט עם זרועות פשוטות לגמרי, שכמות מקובעות מטה ולאחור וליבה מהודקת כך שהגומייה מחזיקה אותך מתוח. | Pull your elbows down toward your ribs and drive your chest up to the bar, leading with your upper back rather than just your arms. | המשך עד שסנטרך עובר מעל המוט, מכווץ את השריר הרחב בגב והזרועות בשיא התנועה כנגד מתח הגומי. | Lower yourself under control back to a full hang, resisting the band as it tries to snap you up. | Reset your shoulder blades and repeat for your target reps, then carefully step out of the band when finished.

t: Anchor a resistance band to a low, sturdy point behind your head, then lie on your back on the floor with your head closest to the anchor. | Loop the band around the tops of your feet or ankles, bend your knees to about 90°, and bring your thighs up so they point toward the ceiling. | Reach overhead and hold the anchor, a bench leg, or the floor for stability, and press your lower back gently into the floor to brace your core. | Exhale and curl your knees toward your chest, contracting your abs to peel your hips and tailbone off the floor against the band's pull. | Pause briefly at the top with your hips lifted and your knees over your chest, keeping the movement driven by your abs rather than swinging your legs. | Inhale and lower your hips back down slowly and under control, resisting the band as your tailbone returns to the floor. | Stop just before your feet touch down to keep tension on the abs, then begin the next repetition. | Complete your reps, then release the tension and unhook the band carefully.
tRu: Закрепите эспандер в низкой прочной точке позади головы, затем лягте на спину на пол головой ближе к креплению. | Оберните эспандер вокруг верхней части стоп или лодыжек, согните колена примерно под углом 90° и поднимите бедра так, чтобы они были направлены к потолку. | Reach overhead and hold the anchor, a bench leg, or the floor for stability, and press your lower back gently into the floor to brace your core. | Выдохните и подтяните колени к груди, сокращая пресс, чтобы оторвать таз и копчик от пола, противодействия натяжению эспандера. | Задержитесь на мгновение в верхней точке с поднятыми бёдрами и коленями над грудью, сохраняя движение за счёт мышц пресса, а не раскачивая ноги. | Выдохните и медленно опустите таз обратно вниз под контролем, сопротивляясь эспандеру, пока ваш копчик вернется на пол. | Stop just before your feet touch down to keep tension on the abs, then begin the next repetition. | Выполните все повторения, затем ослабьте натяжение и осторожно снимите эспандер.
tHe: עגן גומייה לנקודה נמוכה ויציבה מאחורי הראש, ואז שכב על הגב על הרצפה כשהראש קרוב ביותר לעוגן. | Loop the band around the tops of your feet or ankles, bend your knees to about 90°, and bring your thighs up so they point toward the ceiling. | Reach overhead and hold the anchor, a bench leg, or the floor for stability, and press your lower back gently into the floor to brace your core. | נשוף וכופף את הברכיים לכיוון החזה, כופף את שרירי הבטן כדי להרים את הירכיים ועצם הזנב מהרצפה נגד המתיחה של הגומייה. | Pause briefly at the top with your hips lifted and your knees over your chest, keeping the movement driven by your abs rather than swinging your legs. | Inhale and lower your hips back down slowly and under control, resisting the band as your tailbone returns to the floor. | Stop just before your feet touch down to keep tension on the abs, then begin the next repetition. | בצע את החזרות שלך, ואז שחרר את המתח ונתק בזהירות את הפס.

t: Stand on the middle of the resistance band with your feet about shoulder-width apart so the band is anchored securely under both feet. | Grab one end of the band in each hand with an overhand (palms-down) grip, knuckles facing forward. | Let your arms hang straight down at your sides with a slight bend in your elbows and your wrists in line with your forearms. | Keep your elbows pinned close to your torso and brace your core. | Curl your hands up toward your shoulders by bending at the elbows, keeping your palms facing down throughout the movement. | Squeeze the top of your forearms at the top of the rep without letting your wrists roll over or your elbows drift forward. | Lower your hands back down under control, resisting the band until your arms are nearly straight. | Complete your reps, then step off the band carefully to release the tension.

tRu: Sit tall on the floor with your legs extended and loop the resistance band around the soles of your feet. | Возьмите один конец эспандера в каждую руку нижним, ладонями вверх (супинированным) хватом и вытяните руки вперед, пока почувствуете напряжение. | Set your posture: chest up, core braced, and shoulders pulled down away from your ears. | Row the band toward your lower ribs by driving your elbows back close to your sides, keeping your wrists straight. | Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the pull and hold briefly to feel the contraction across your back. | Опустите эспандер под контролём вперёд, пока ваши руки не выпрямятся, а лопатки слегка разведутся. | Repeat for your target reps, keeping your torso upright and avoiding any rocking back and forth.
