t: Anchor the battle rope securely around a fixed post or weight and step back until the rope is almost taut, with no slack dragging on the floor. | Set your feet roughly shoulder-width apart, bend your knees, hinge your hips back slightly, and keep your back flat. | Grab one rope end in each hand near the tip with a firm grip, holding your arms in front of your thighs. | Brace your core and keep your chest up so force can transfer from your legs and back into the rope. | Drive both arms in fast, inward circles toward your body's midline, leading from the shoulders and chest so each hand carves a continuous loop. | Keep the circles tight and the waves even, staying low in your stance and breathing in a steady rhythm. | Maintain the inward circling for the full work interval, keeping constant tension on the rope. | To finish, slow the circles, let the waves settle, and set the rope ends down under control.

t: Anchor the battling rope around a sturdy fixed point and pick up one end in each hand with a neutral grip. | Step back until the rope has just a slight slack, then stand tall with your feet together and your arms hanging down in front of your hips. | Brace your core and bend slightly at the knees and hips to set an athletic, springy stance. | Begin driving each arm up and down to send steady, continuous waves down the rope. | As the waves start, jump your feet out to about shoulder-width and land softly on the balls of your feet. | Jump your feet back together while keeping the rope waves unbroken and even. | Keep the jump-out and jump-in rhythm matched to the waves so your legs and arms move as one unit, breathing steadily. | Continue for the prescribed time or interval, then slow the waves to a stop, let the rope settle, and set both ends down under control.

t: Anchor the battling rope securely around a fixed post and grab one end in each hand, gripping near the capped tips with a neutral (palms-facing) grip. | Step back until there is a slight tension in the rope, then face the anchor point. | Set a low athletic stance: feet a little wider than shoulder-width, knees bent, hips pushed back, and chest up. | Brace your core and keep your back flat, with your weight balanced over the middle of your feet. | Drive one arm up quickly and snap it back down to send a wave through that rope, keeping the movement low and compact. | As the first arm comes down, drive the other arm up so the ropes alternate in a fast, continuous rhythm. | Stay low throughout, keeping your arms close to your sides and the waves short and powerful rather than wide and loose. | Continue alternating for the full work interval, then slow the ropes under control and stand up.

t: Anchor the rope securely around a sturdy post and grab one end in each hand with a firm, neutral grip. | Step back until the rope is taut with a slight slack, set your feet a little wider than shoulder-width, and bend your knees into an athletic quarter-squat. | Brace your core and hinge slightly at the hips, keeping your chest up and your back flat. | Drive through your legs and extend your hips as you swing both rope ends explosively up overhead to full reach, rising onto the balls of your feet. | Slam both ends straight down to the floor in front of you with maximum force, snapping your hips and bracing your waist on impact. | Let your knees re-bend to absorb the slam, keeping your weight centered over your feet. | Reload to the overhead position and repeat at a fast, continuous pace for the prescribed time or reps. | On your final slam, control the ropes to a stop, set them down, and step back to recover your breath and grip.
tRu: Надёжно закрепите канат вокруг прочной стойки и возьмите по концу в каждую руку крепким нейтральным хватом. | Step back until the rope is taut with a slight slack, set your feet a little wider than shoulder-width, and bend your knees into an athletic quarter-squat. | Напрягите корпус и слегка наклонитесь в бёдрах, удерживая грудь расправленной, а спину — прямой. | Отталкивайтесь ногами и тазом, чтобы начать движение, затем мощно поднимите оба конца каната над головой до полного выпрямления, вставая на носки. | Slam both ends straight down to the floor in front of you with maximum force, snapping your hips and bracing your waist on impact. | Позвольте вашим коленям снова согнуться, чтобы поглотить удар, сохраняя ваш вес centered над стопами. | Reload to the overhead position and repeat at a fast, continuous pace for the prescribed time or reps. | На вашем последнем ударе контролируйте канаты до остановки, положите их и отойдите, чтобы восстановить дыхание и хват.
tHe: עגן את החבל היטב סביב עמוד יציב ואחוז בקצה אחד בכל יד באחיזה ניטרלית וחזקה. | Step back until the rope is taut with a slight slack, set your feet a little wider than shoulder-width, and bend your knees into an athletic quarter-squat. | הדק את הליבה וכופף מעט באגן, תוך שמירה על חזה מורם וגב שטוח. | דחוף דרך הרגליים והירכיים כדי ליצור תנופה, אז משך את שני קצות החבל בפיצוץ כלפי מעלה מעל הראש למרחק מלא, קמים על כפות הרגליים. | Slam both ends straight down to the floor in front of you with maximum force, snapping your hips and bracing your waist on impact. | Let your knees re-bend to absorb the slam, keeping your weight centered over your feet. | Reload to the overhead position and repeat at a fast, continuous pace for the prescribed time or reps. | On your final slam, control the ropes to a stop, set them down, and step back to recover your breath and grip.

t: Anchor the battle rope securely, then sit on the floor facing the anchor with your knees bent and heels planted (or hovering for more difficulty). | Grip the ends of the rope together with both hands and lean your torso back slightly to find a stable, braced position. | Brace your core and lift your chest, keeping your spine long rather than rounded. | Rotate your trunk to one side and bring the rope across your body toward the floor beside your hip. | Reverse the motion smoothly and rotate to the opposite side, carrying the rope across to the other hip. | Keep the rope moving from your core rotation, not just your arms, so the obliques drive each twist. | Continue alternating sides at a steady, controlled pace for the full work interval. | Slow the rope under control, return to center, and set the ends down to finish.
tRu: Надёжно закрепите боевой канат, затем сядьте на пол лицом к креплению, согнув колени и уперев пятки или удерживая их на весу для сложности. | Возьмитесь за EZ-штангу обеими руками на наклоненных частях, ладонями вверх, руки примерно на ширине плеч. | Напрягите корпус и приподнимите грудь, сохраняя позвоночник вытянутым, а не округлённым. | Rotate your trunk to one side and bring the rope across your body toward the floor beside your hip. | Reverse the motion smoothly and rotate to the opposite side, carrying the rope across to the other hip. | Держите движение каната за счёт поворота корпуса, а не только рук, чтобы косые мышцы живота задавали каждый поворот. | Продолжайте попеременно менять стороны в устойчивом, контролируемом темпе на протяжении всего рабочего интервала. | Slow the rope under control, return to center, and set the ends down to finish.
tHe: עגן את חבל הקרב היטב, ואז שב על הרצפה מול העוגן עם ברכיים כפופות ועקבים נעוצים (או מרחפים לדרגת קושי גבוהה יותר). | אחוז בקצות החבל יחד בשתי הידיים ונטה את הגו לאחור מעט כדי למצוא עמדה יציבה ומהודקת. | הדק את הליבה והרם את החזה, תוך שמירה על עמוד שדרה ארוך ולא מעוגל. | Rotate your trunk to one side and bring the rope across your body toward the floor beside your hip. | Reverse the motion smoothly and rotate to the opposite side, carrying the rope across to the other hip. | Keep the rope moving from your core rotation, not just your arms, so the obliques drive each twist. | המשילו להחליף צדדים בקצב יציב ומבוקל לאורך כל רצועת העבודה. | Slow the rope under control, return to center, and set the ends down to finish.

t: Anchor the battling rope securely around a fixed post or rack and take up most of the slack. | Sit facing the anchor on a bench, box, or the floor, with your torso upright and your core braced. | Hold one rope end in each hand with a relaxed, neutral grip and let your elbows bend slightly. | Begin driving both arms up and down in fast, alternating waves, snapping the rope from your arms. | Keep the waves continuous and even, moving the rope through its full range without letting the slack die out. | Breathe in a steady rhythm and hold the pace for your work interval, typically 20–40 seconds. | Slow the waves to a stop, rest, then repeat for the planned number of rounds.
tRu: Надёжно закрепите боевой канат вокруг фиксированной стойки или рамы и уберите большую часть слабины. | Sit facing the anchor on a bench, box, or the floor, with your torso upright and your core braced. | Держите по одному концу каната в каждой руке с расслабленным, нейтральным хватом и слегка согните локти. | Начните быстро двигать обе руки вверх и вниз попеременными волнами, резко работая канатом от рук. | Держите волны каната непрерывными и ровными, двигая канат по полной амплитуде, не давая ослабнуть напряжению. | Дышите в устойчивом ритме и поддерживайте этот темп для вашего рабочего интервала, обычно 20–40 секунд. | Slow the waves to a stop, rest, then repeat for the planned number of rounds.
tHe: עגן את חבל הקרב היטב סביב עמוד קבוע או מתקן ומתח את רוב הרפיון. | Sit facing the anchor on a bench, box, or the floor, with your torso upright and your core braced. | Hold one rope end in each hand with a relaxed, neutral grip and let your elbows bend slightly. | התחל להניע את שתי הזרועות מעלה ומטה בגלים מהירים ומתחלפים, תוך הצלפת החבל מהזרועות. | Keep the waves continuous and even, moving the rope through its full range without letting the slack die out. | נשור בקצב יציב ושמור על הקצב לרבע העבודה שלך, בדרך כלל 20-40 שניות. | Slow the waves to a stop, rest, then repeat for the planned number of rounds.

t: Anchor the middle of the rope around a sturdy post or fixed point and walk back until the slack is taken up and you feel slight tension. | Hold one rope end in each hand with a firm, neutral grip and your palms facing your body. | Set your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width, soften your knees into an athletic stance, and brace your core. | Keep a tall chest and flat back, letting your shoulders settle down and back before you start. | Sweep both rope ends out to the sides and up toward shoulder height, sending waves traveling along the rope. | Bring the rope ends back toward your hips under control, then immediately repeat to keep continuous motion on the line. | Drive the ropes in a fast, even rhythm for the full work interval, breathing steadily throughout. | Slow the ropes to a stop, set the ends down, and recover before your next round.
tRu: Закрепите середину каната вокруг прочной стойки или фиксированной точки и отойдите назад, пока слабина не уйдёт и не почувствуется лёгкое натяжение. | Держите по одному концу каната в каждой руке с уверенным, нейтральным хватом и ладонями, обращенными к телу. | Set your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width, soften your knees into an athletic stance, and brace your core. | Держите грудь выпяченной и спину прямой, позволяя вашим плечам опуститься и отодвинуться назад перед началом. | Sweep both rope ends out to the sides and up toward shoulder height, sending waves traveling along the rope. | Подтяните концы каната к бедрам под контролем, затем сразу повторите, чтобы сохранить непрерывное движение. | Оттолкните канаты в быстром, равномерном ритме на протяжении всего рабочего интервала, дыша ровно. | Slow the ropes to a stop, set the ends down, and recover before your next round.
tHe: עגן את אמצע החבל סביב עמוד יציב או נקודה קבועה וצעד לאחור עד שהרפיון נמתח ואתה מרגיש מתח קל. | Hold one rope end in each hand with a firm, neutral grip and your palms facing your body. | Set your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width, soften your knees into an athletic stance, and brace your core. | Keep a tall chest and flat back, letting your shoulders settle down and back before you start. | Sweep both rope ends out to the sides and up toward shoulder height, sending waves traveling along the rope. | הבא את קצות החבל בחזרה לכיוון המותניים בשליטה, ואז חזור מיד כדי לשמור על תנועה רציפה. | דחוף את החבלים בקצב מהיר ושווה לכל פרק העבודה, נושם בצורה יציבה לאורך כל הזמן. | Slow the ropes to a stop, set the ends down, and recover before your next round.

nE: Battling Ropes Side to Side Arms
nR: Руки из стороны в сторону с канатами
t: Anchor the rope around a sturdy post and pick up one end in each hand, palms facing each other. | Step back until the ropes are taut, then set your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width with a soft bend in your knees. | Hinge slightly at the hips, brace your core, and keep your chest tall with both arms in front of you. | Sweep both rope ends together to one side, rotating through your waist while keeping your hips and knees stable. | Reverse the motion and swing both ends across to the opposite side, letting the back and chest help control the path. | Keep the waves continuous and rhythmic, rotating only through the trunk rather than swinging the arms loosely. | Maintain a fast, steady tempo for the full work interval, breathing in a controlled rhythm. | Slow the ropes to a stop, set both ends down, and rest before the next round.
tRu: Закрепите канат вокруг прочной стойки и возьмите по концу в каждую руку ладонями друг к другу. | Step back until the ropes are taut, then set your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width with a soft bend in your knees. | Слегка наклоняйтесь в бёдра, напрягите корпус и держите грудь прямо, обе руки перед собой. | Sweep both rope ends together to one side, rotating through your waist while keeping your hips and knees stable. | Reverse the motion and swing both ends across to the opposite side, letting the back and chest help control the path. | Держите волны каната непрерывными и ритмичными, поворачиваясь только за счёт торса, а не раскачивая руки. | Держите быстрый, устойчивый темп на протяжении всего рабочего интервала, дыша в контролируемом ритме. | Slow the ropes to a stop, set both ends down, and rest before the next round.
tHe: עגן את החבל סביב עמוד יציב והרם קצה אחד בכל יד, כפות הידיים פונות זו לזו. | Step back until the ropes are taut, then set your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width with a soft bend in your knees. | כופף מעט בציר הירכיים, הדק את הליבה ושמור על חזה זקוף עם שתי הזרועות לפניך. | Sweep both rope ends together to one side, rotating through your waist while keeping your hips and knees stable. | Reverse the motion and swing both ends across to the opposite side, letting the back and chest help control the path. | Keep the waves continuous and rhythmic, rotating only through the trunk rather than swinging the arms loosely. | Maintain a fast, steady tempo for the full work interval, breathing in a controlled rhythm. | Slow the ropes to a stop, set both ends down, and rest before the next round.

t: Anchor the battle ropes and stand facing the anchor with the slack removed. Hold one rope end in each hand using a neutral grip. | Drop into a split stance with one foot forward and one foot back, both knees bent toward 90°, and brace your core. | Begin driving the ropes up and down in fast, alternating waves, keeping your arms moving continuously throughout the set. | Without stopping the waves, push explosively through both legs and jump up off the floor. | Switch your legs in mid-air so the back foot lands forward and the front foot lands back. | Absorb the landing softly into a split stance, keeping your chest tall and knees tracking over your toes. | Continue jumping and switching legs each rep while the ropes keep moving, breathing in a steady rhythm. | Finish the work interval, slow the ropes to a stop, and step out of the split stance to recover.
tRu: Закрепите боевые канаты и встаньте лицом к креплению, убрав слабину. Возьмите по концу каната в каждую руку нейтральным хватом. | Примите положение выпада с одной ногой впереди и другой сзади, оба колена согнуты под углом примерно 90°, и напрягите мышцы кора. | Начните двигать канаты вверх и вниз быстрыми попеременными волнами, не останавливая движение рук в течение всего подхода. | Without stopping the waves, push explosively through both legs and jump up off the floor. | Switch your legs in mid-air so the back foot lands forward and the front foot lands back. | Мягко поглотите приземление в разножку, удерживая грудь высоко, а колени над носками. | Продолжайте прыгать и менять ноги при каждом повторении, пока канат находится в движении, дыша в устойчивом ритме. | Завершите рабочий интервал, замедлите движение канатов до остановки и выйдите из выпада для восстановления.
tHe: עגן את חבלי הקרב ועמוד מול העוגן כשהרפיון מתוח. החזק קצה אחד בכל יד באחיזה ניטרלית. | רד לתנוחת פיצול עם רגל אחת קדימה ואחת אחורה, שתי הברכיים כפופות לכ-90°, ותתוח את שרירי הליבה. | התחל להניע את החבלים מעלה ומטה בגלים מהירים ומתחלפים, ושמור על תנועה רציפה של הזרועות לאורך כל הסט. | Without stopping the waves, push explosively through both legs and jump up off the floor. | Switch your legs in mid-air so the back foot lands forward and the front foot lands back. | ספוג את הנחיתה ברכות לעמידת פיצול, תוך שמירה על חזה זקוף וברכיים בקו האצבעות. | המשך לקפוץ ולהחליף רגליים בכל חזרה, תוך שהחבלים ממשיכים לנוע, ונשא בקצב יציב. | סיים את מקטע המאמץ, האט את החבלים עד עצירה וצא מעמדת הפיסוק להתאוששות.

t: Start on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and your knees under your hips, feet hip-width apart with toes tucked. | Lift your knees about an inch off the floor and set your hips low, roughly level with your shoulders, with a flat back and braced core. | Spread your fingers and grip the floor, keeping your weight balanced evenly between your hands and the balls of your feet. | Move your right hand and left foot forward at the same time, taking a short, controlled step. | Follow immediately with your left hand and right foot, keeping the contralateral (opposite arm, opposite leg) rhythm. | Keep your knees hovering just above the ground and your hips low throughout — avoid letting your back round or your hips pike up. | Continue crawling forward for the prescribed distance or time, breathing steadily and keeping each step small and stable. | To finish, lower your knees to the floor, release the brace, and stand up under control.
tRu: Start on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and your knees under your hips, feet hip-width apart with toes tucked. | Поднимите колени примерно на сантиметр от пола и опустите таз низко, примерно на уровне плеч, с прямой спиной и напряженным корпусом. | Spread your fingers and grip the floor, keeping your weight balanced evenly between your hands and the balls of your feet. | Одновременно двигайте правой рукой и левой ногой вперёд, делая короткий, контролируемый шаг. | Сразу же следуйте этим левой рукой и правой ногой, сохраняя контралатеральный (рука и нога с противоположной стороны) ритм. | Держите колени чуть над полом и бёдра низко на протяжении всего движения — не позволяйте спине округляться или бёдрам подниматься вверх. | Продолжайте ползти вперёд на заданное расстояние или время, дыша ровно и выполняя каждый шаг маленьким и устойчивым. | To finish, lower your knees to the floor, release the brace, and stand up under control.
tHe: Start on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and your knees under your hips, feet hip-width apart with toes tucked. | Lift your knees about an inch off the floor and set your hips low, roughly level with your shoulders, with a flat back and braced core. | Spread your fingers and grip the floor, keeping your weight balanced evenly between your hands and the balls of your feet. | Move your right hand and left foot forward at the same time, taking a short, controlled step. | מיד לאחר מכן הצטרף עם יד שמאל ורגל ימין, תוך שמירה על קצב נגדי (יד נגדית, רגל נגדית). | Keep your knees hovering just above the ground and your hips low throughout — avoid letting your back round or your hips pike up. | המשך לזחול קדימה למרחק או לזמן המוגדר, נשם באופן יציב ושמור על כל צעד קטן ויציב. | To finish, lower your knees to the floor, release the brace, and stand up under control.

t: Start on all fours with your hands stacked directly under your shoulders and your knees under your hips, toes tucked into the floor. | Spread your fingers and press the floor away, rounding your upper back slightly so your shoulder blades stay flat and wide. | Brace your core as if bracing for a punch and tuck your tailbone slightly so your lower back stays flat, not arched. | Lift your knees one to two inches off the floor, keeping your shins roughly parallel to the ground. | Hold the hover with your back flat from head to hips, breathing steadily and keeping your hips level with your shoulders. | Keep your gaze a few inches ahead of your hands so your neck stays in line with your spine. | Hold for the prescribed time, then lower your knees back to the floor under control to finish.
tRu: Start on all fours with your hands stacked directly under your shoulders and your knees under your hips, toes tucked into the floor. | Spread your fingers and press the floor away, rounding your upper back slightly so your shoulder blades stay flat and wide. | Напрягите пресс как перед ударом и слегка подкрутите копчик, чтобы поясница оставалась ровной, не прогибаясь. | Поднимите колены на один-два сантиметра от пола, сохраняя голени примерно параллельными полу. | Подержите положение зависания с ровной спиной от головы до таза, дыша ровно и сохраняя бедра на уровне плеч. | Держите взгляд немного впереди рук, чтобы шея оставалась на одной линии с позвоночником. | Удерживайте предписанное время, затем плавно опустите колени на пол для завершения.
tHe: Start on all fours with your hands stacked directly under your shoulders and your knees under your hips, toes tucked into the floor. | Spread your fingers and press the floor away, rounding your upper back slightly so your shoulder blades stay flat and wide. | הדק את הליבה כאילו אתה עומד לספוג מכה ואסוף מעט את עצם הזנב כך שהגב התחתון נשאר שטוח, לא מקושת. | Lift your knees one to two inches off the floor, keeping your shins roughly parallel to the ground. | Hold the hover with your back flat from head to hips, breathing steadily and keeping your hips level with your shoulders. | Keep your gaze a few inches ahead of your hands so your neck stays in line with your spine. | Hold for the prescribed time, then lower your knees back to the floor under control to finish.

t: Start on all fours with your hands stacked under your shoulders and your knees under your hips, toes tucked into the floor. | Brace your core, press into the floor, and lift your knees about an inch off the ground to find the bear plank position with a flat back. | Keep your hips level and your weight balanced evenly between both hands and your supporting foot. | Extend one leg straight back and up in a controlled kickback, squeezing the hip at the top without arching your lower back. | Pause briefly at the top, keeping the rest of your body still and your hips square to the floor. | Lower the leg back to the bear plank hover under control, returning the knee toward the start without resting it on the floor. | Complete your reps on one side, then switch legs and repeat for equal work on both sides. | Set both knees down gently to finish.
tRu: Start on all fours with your hands stacked under your shoulders and your knees under your hips, toes tucked into the floor. | Напрягите корпус, упритесь в пол и приподнимите колени примерно на дюйм над полом, чтобы занять положение «медвежьей» планки с прямой спиной. | Держите бёдра на одном уровне и вес распределённым равномерно между обеими руками и опорной ногой. | Вытяните одну ногу прямо назад и вверх в контролируемое движение маха, сжимая ягодицы в верхней точке, не прогибая поясницу. | На вершине движения сделайте короткую паузу, удерживая остальное тело неподвижным, а бёдра параллельными полу. | С контролем опустите ногу в положение планки на запястьях, возвращая колено к исходному положению, не опуская его на пол. | Выполните все повторения на одну сторону, затем поменяйте ноги и повторите для равной нагрузки на обе стороны. | Set both knees down gently to finish.
tHe: Start on all fours with your hands stacked under your shoulders and your knees under your hips, toes tucked into the floor. | הדק את הליבה, דחוף לתוך הרצפה והרם את הברכיים כסנטימטר מהקרקע כדי להיכנס לתנוחת פלאנק דוב עם גב שטוח. | Keep your hips level and your weight balanced evenly between both hands and your supporting foot. | פשוט רגל אחת ישר אחורה ולמעלה בבעיטה מבוקרת, לחיצה על הירך בשיא התנועה מבלי לכופף את הגב התחתון. | Pause briefly at the top, keeping the rest of your body still and your hips square to the floor. | Lower the leg back to the bear plank hover under control, returning the knee toward the start without resting it on the floor. | בצע את כל החזרות בצד אחד, ואז החלף רגליים וחזור על אותו מספר חזרות לעבודה שווה בשני הצדדים. | Set both knees down gently to finish.

t: Sit or stand tall with your spine long, shoulders relaxed, and core gently braced, with your partner positioned behind you. | Clasp your hands or interlace your fingers behind your head, resting your palms against the back of your skull with your elbows pointing out to the sides. | Keep your chin level and your neck neutral so the stretch stays in your chest, not your neck. | Have your partner take hold of your elbows and slowly draw them back and out until you feel a comfortable stretch across the front of your chest. | Lift your chest slightly and let your shoulder blades draw together to deepen the opening through the pectorals. | Hold the stretch for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and evenly while your partner maintains light, steady pressure. | Signal your partner to ease off gradually, then bring your elbows forward and lower your arms to relax. | Repeat for 2–3 holds, easing a little deeper only as the muscle relaxes.
tRu: Sit or stand tall with your spine long, shoulders relaxed, and core gently braced, with your partner positioned behind you. | Соедините руки или переплетите пальцы за головой, положив ладони на затылок, локти направлены в стороны. | Держите подбородок на уровне и шею нейтральной, чтобы растяжка была в груди, а не в шее. | Попросите партнера взять ваши локти и медленно отведите их назад и в стороны, пока вы почувствуете комфортное растяжение в передней части груди. | Поднимите грудь слегка и позвольте лопаткам сведься вместе, чтобы углубить растяжение в грудных мышцах. | Держите растяжку в течение 20-30 секунд, дыша медленно и сохраняя движение статичным, а не покачивающимся. | Signal your partner to ease off gradually, then bring your elbows forward and lower your arms to relax. | Repeat for 2–3 holds, easing a little deeper only as the muscle relaxes.
tHe: Sit or stand tall with your spine long, shoulders relaxed, and core gently braced, with your partner positioned behind you. | חבר את ידיך או ערבב את אצבעות ידיך מאחורי הראש, שמור עם כפות ידיך על חלקו האחורי של הגולגולת עם המרפקים פונים הצידה. | Keep your chin level and your neck neutral so the stretch stays in your chest, not your neck. | תן לשותף לאחוז במרפקים שלך ולמשוך אותם לאט לאחור והצידה עד שתרגיש מתיחה נוחה לאורך קדמת החזה. | Lift your chest slightly and let your shoulder blades draw together to deepen the opening through the pectorals. | Hold the stretch for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and evenly while your partner maintains light, steady pressure. | Signal your partner to ease off gradually, then bring your elbows forward and lower your arms to relax. | Repeat for 2–3 holds, easing a little deeper only as the muscle relaxes.

t: Sit on the edge of a sturdy bench and place your hands on the edge beside your hips, fingers pointing forward and about shoulder-width apart. | Walk your feet out in front of you and slide your hips off the bench so your weight is supported on your hands, arms fully extended. | Keep your legs straight or slightly bent with your heels on the floor, chest tall, and shoulders pulled down away from your ears. | Bend your elbows and lower your body straight down, keeping your elbows pointing back and tracking close to your body. | Descend under control until your elbows reach roughly a 90-degree angle and your back stays close to the bench. | Press through your palms to drive your body back up until your arms are fully extended. | Complete your reps, then walk your feet in and sit back on the bench to finish.
tRu: Sit on the edge of a sturdy bench and place your hands on the edge beside your hips, fingers pointing forward and about shoulder-width apart. | Walk your feet out in front of you and slide your hips off the bench so your weight is supported on your hands, arms fully extended. | Держите ноги выпрямленными или слегка согнутыми с пятками на полу, грудь поднятой, а плечами опущенными и отведёнными от ушей. | Согните локти и опустите тело строго вниз, направляя локти назад и удерживая их близко к корпусу. | Опускайтесь под контролем, пока локти не образуют примерно прямой угол, а спина остаётся близко к скамье. | Оттолкнитесь ладонями и поднимите тело вверх, пока руки полностью не выпрямятся. | Выполните свои повторения, затем подойдите ногами и сядьте на скамью, чтобы закончить.
tHe: Sit on the edge of a sturdy bench and place your hands on the edge beside your hips, fingers pointing forward and about shoulder-width apart. | Walk your feet out in front of you and slide your hips off the bench so your weight is supported on your hands, arms fully extended. | Keep your legs straight or slightly bent with your heels on the floor, chest tall, and shoulders pulled down away from your ears. | כופף את המרפקים והורד את הגוף ישר למטה, תוך שמירה על מרפקים פונים לאחור וצמודים לגוף. | רד בשליטה עד שהמרפקים שלך מגיעים לזווית של כ-90 מעלות והגב שלך נשאר קרוב לספסל. | לחץ דרך כפות הידיים כדי לדחוף את הגוף חזרה למעלה עד שהידיים ישרות לגמרי. | בצע את כל החזרות, ואז הלך עם רגליך קדימה ושב לספסל כדי לסיים.

t: Sit just in front of a sturdy bench or low edge and place your hands on it behind you, shoulder-width apart, with your fingers pointing toward your body. | Walk your feet out and rest your heels on the floor, then press through your hands to lift your hips clear of the bench with your arms extended. | Set your shoulders down away from your ears and keep your chest tall and your torso close to the bench. | Lower your hips straight down by bending your elbows back, keeping them tucked close to your body rather than flaring out to the sides. | Descend until your elbows reach about a 90° angle, keeping your back near the bench the whole way down. | Press back up by straightening your elbows, driving through your palms until your arms are nearly fully extended. | Stop just short of locking out to keep tension on the triceps, then begin the next rep. | Complete your reps, then lower your hips, sit back, and release your hands under control.
tRu: Sit just in front of a sturdy bench or low edge and place your hands on it behind you, shoulder-width apart, with your fingers pointing toward your body. | Walk your feet out and rest your heels on the floor, then press through your hands to lift your hips clear of the bench with your arms extended. | Set your shoulders down away from your ears and keep your chest tall and your torso close to the bench. | Прямо опустите бёдра, сгибая локти назад, держа их близко к телу, а не разведёнными в стороны. | Опускайтесь, пока переднее бедро окажется примерно параллельно полу, а заднее колено опустится к полу, сохраняя корпус прямым. | Press back up by straightening your elbows, driving through your palms until your arms are nearly fully extended. | Stop just short of locking out to keep tension on the triceps, then begin the next rep. | Выполните все повторения, затем опустите бёдра, сядьте и с контролем отпустите руки.
tHe: Sit just in front of a sturdy bench or low edge and place your hands on it behind you, shoulder-width apart, with your fingers pointing toward your body. | Walk your feet out and rest your heels on the floor, then press through your hands to lift your hips clear of the bench with your arms extended. | Set your shoulders down away from your ears and keep your chest tall and your torso close to the bench. | Lower your hips straight down by bending your elbows back, keeping them tucked close to your body rather than flaring out to the sides. | רד עד שהמרפקים מגיעים לזווית של כ-90 מעלות, שמור על כך שהגב קרוב לספסל לכל אורך הירידה. | Press back up by straightening your elbows, driving through your palms until your arms are nearly fully extended. | Stop just short of locking out to keep tension on the triceps, then begin the next rep. | בצע את כל החזרות, ואז הורד את האגן, ישב לאחור ושחרר את הידיים בשליטה.

t: Sit on the edge of a sturdy bench and place your hands beside your hips, fingers pointing forward and gripping the front edge. | Set a stability ball about a leg's length in front of the bench and rest your heels on top of it with your legs extended. | Slide your hips forward off the bench so your weight is supported by your hands and your heels, keeping your arms straight. | Brace your core and squeeze your glutes to keep your hips and the ball steady before your first rep. | Bend your elbows to lower your hips straight down, keeping them pointing back rather than flaring out, until they reach about 90°. | Pause briefly at the bottom while keeping the ball from rolling, then press through your palms to extend your arms. | Lock out at the top by fully straightening your elbows and squeezing your triceps without shrugging your shoulders. | Complete your reps, then place your feet on the floor and sit back onto the bench to finish.
tRu: Sit on the edge of a sturdy bench and place your hands beside your hips, fingers pointing forward and gripping the front edge. | Set a stability ball about a leg's length in front of the bench and rest your heels on top of it with your legs extended. | Slide your hips forward off the bench so your weight is supported by your hands and your heels, keeping your arms straight. | Напрягите корпус и сожмите ягодицы, чтобы удерживать бёдра и мяч неподвижно перед первым повторением. | Согните локти, опуская бёдра строго вниз до угла около 90°, направляя локти назад, а не в стороны. | Пауза на мгновение в нижней точке, удерживая мяч от скатывания, затем нажмите ладонями, чтобы выпрямить руки. | Зафиксируйте положение в верхней точке, полностью выпрямляя локти и сжимая трицепсы, не поднимая плечи. | Выполните все повторения, затем поставьте ноги на пол и сядьте на скамью для завершения.
tHe: Sit on the edge of a sturdy bench and place your hands beside your hips, fingers pointing forward and gripping the front edge. | Set a stability ball about a leg's length in front of the bench and rest your heels on top of it with your legs extended. | Slide your hips forward off the bench so your weight is supported by your hands and your heels, keeping your arms straight. | הדק את הליבה וכווץ את הישבנים כדי לשמור על האגן והכדור יציבים לפני החזרה הראשונה. | כופף את המרפקים כדי להוריד את האגן ישר למטה, תוך שמירה עליהם פונים לאחור ולא פתוחים החוצה, עד שיגיעו לערך ל-90°. | Pause briefly at the bottom while keeping the ball from rolling, then press through your palms to extend your arms. | Lock out at the top by fully straightening your elbows and squeezing your triceps without shrugging your shoulders. | בצע את כל החזרות, ואז הנח את כפות הרגליים על הרצפה וישב לאחור על הספסל כדי לסיים.

nE: Bench Dip with legs on bench
nR: Обратные отжимания с ногами на скамье
t: Set up two benches roughly the length of your legs apart, one behind you for your hands and one in front for your feet. | Sit on the edge of the rear bench and place your hands beside your hips, fingers pointing forward and gripping the edge. | Walk your heels onto the front bench so your legs are straight and your hips are lifted off the bench, supporting your weight on your hands. | Keep your chest up, shoulders pulled down away from your ears, and your core braced. | Bend your elbows to lower your hips straight down until your upper arms are roughly parallel to the floor, keeping your elbows pointing back, not flaring out. | Pause briefly when your shoulders reach about elbow height, keeping the weight over your hands. | Press through your palms to extend your elbows and drive your hips back up to the start, stopping just short of locking out to keep tension on the triceps. | Complete your reps, then bend your knees and bring your feet down to step out of the position safely.
tRu: Set up two benches roughly the length of your legs apart, one behind you for your hands and one in front for your feet. | Sit on the edge of the rear bench and place your hands beside your hips, fingers pointing forward and gripping the edge. | Walk your heels onto the front bench so your legs are straight and your hips are lifted off the bench, supporting your weight on your hands. | Держите грудь поднятой, плечи отведены вниз и远离 ушей, и корпус напряжен. | Согните локти, опуская бёдра строго вниз, пока плечи не станут примерно параллельны полу, направляя локти назад, не разводя их в стороны. | Задержитесь на мгновение, когда ваши плечи достигают уровня локтей, сохраняя вес над руками. | Press through your palms to extend your elbows and drive your hips back up to the start, stopping just short of locking out to keep tension on the triceps. | Выполните все повторения, затем согните колени и опустите ноги, чтобы безопасно выйти из положения.
