t: Stand in front of a bench with your back to it, feet shoulder-width apart and toes turned slightly out. | Brace your core, keep your chest up, and extend your arms in front of you for balance. | Push your hips back and bend your knees, lowering under control toward the bench. | Keep your knees tracking in line with your toes and your weight balanced over your mid-foot. | Lower until your glutes lightly touch the bench, keeping your spine neutral and chest tall. | Pause briefly without resting your full weight on the bench or rocking backward. | Drive through your heels and extend your hips and knees to stand fully upright. | Squeeze your glutes at the top, then repeat for your target reps.
tRu: Stand in front of a bench with your back to it, feet shoulder-width apart and toes turned slightly out. | Напрягите корпус, держите грудь вверх и вытяните руки вперёд для равновесия. | Push your hips back and bend your knees, lowering under control toward the bench. | Держите колени вровень с носками и вес распределён равномерно по средней части стопы. | Опустите, пока ваши ягодицы не коснулись скамьи, сохраняя позвоночник нейтральным и грудь поднятой. | Задержитесь на мгновение, не опираясь всем весом на скамью и не раскачиваясь назад. | Отталкивайтесь пятками и разгибайте тазобедренный сустав и колено, чтобы встать полностью прямо. | Squeeze your glutes at the top, then repeat for your target reps.
tHe: Stand in front of a bench with your back to it, feet shoulder-width apart and toes turned slightly out. | הדק את הליבה, שמור על חזה מורם, והושט את הידיים קדימה לשמירת שיווי משקל. | Push your hips back and bend your knees, lowering under control toward the bench. | Keep your knees tracking in line with your toes and your weight balanced over your mid-foot. | Lower until your glutes lightly touch the bench, keeping your spine neutral and chest tall. | Pause briefly without resting your full weight on the bench or rocking backward. | דחוף דרך עקביך והרחב את הירכיים והברכיים כדי לעמוד במלוא הגובה. | Squeeze your glutes at the top, then repeat for your target reps.

nR: Обратные скручивания по кругу на скамье
t: Lie on your back along a flat bench with your hips near the end of the bench and your head supported. | Reach overhead and grip the edge of the bench behind your head with both hands to anchor your upper body. | Raise your legs and bend your knees so your thighs are roughly vertical over your hips, feet relaxed. | Brace your abs and draw your knees up toward your chest, curling your hips slightly off the bench. | Begin tracing a slow circle with your knees — guide them to one side, down and around, and back up toward your chest. | Keep the movement driven by your abs and hips, not by swinging your legs, so your lower back stays controlled. | Complete your reps in one direction, then reverse the circle for the same number of reps the other way. | Lower your feet under control to finish, keeping tension on your core until your legs are down.
tRu: Лягте на спину и поднимите бёдра и колени до 90 градусов, чтобы голени были параллельны полу — это положение 3 месяца. | Reach overhead and grip the edge of the bench behind your head with both hands to anchor your upper body. | Raise your legs and bend your knees so your thighs are roughly vertical over your hips, feet relaxed. | Напрягите пресс и подтяните колени к груди, слегка отрывая бёдра от скамьи. | Начните описывать коленями медленный круг — ведите их в сторону, вниз и по кругу обратно вверх к груди. | Держите движение, инициируемое прессом и бедрами, а не раскачиванием ног, чтобы ваша поясница оставалась под контролем. | Выполните повторения в одном направлении, затем измените направление круга для того же количества повторений в другую сторону. | Опустите ноги под контролем, чтобы завершить упражнение, сохраняя напряжение в корпусе, пока ваши ноги не будут на полу.
tHe: Lie on your back along a flat bench with your hips near the end of the bench and your head supported. | Reach overhead and grip the edge of the bench behind your head with both hands to anchor your upper body. | Raise your legs and bend your knees so your thighs are roughly vertical over your hips, feet relaxed. | הדק את הבטן ומשוך את הברכיים לכיוון החזה, תוך גלגול קל של האגן מהספסל. | התחל לצייר עיגול איטי עם הברכיים – הובל אותן לצד אחד, מטה ובסיבוב, ובחזרה מעלה לכיוון החזה. | Keep the movement driven by your abs and hips, not by swinging your legs, so your lower back stays controlled. | בצע את החזרות שלך בכיוון אחד, ואז הפך את המעגל לאותו מספר של חזרות בכיוון ההפוך. | Lower your feet under control to finish, keeping tension on your core until your legs are down.

t: Stand tall next to a doorway, wall, or upright post, with your feet about hip-width apart. | Raise one arm to shoulder height and bend the elbow to 90° so your forearm is vertical, like a goalpost. | Place your forearm and palm flat against the surface, with your elbow roughly in line with your shoulder. | Keep your chest lifted and your shoulder blade gently drawn back and down, not shrugged toward your ear. | Slowly rotate your torso away from the fixed arm until you feel a comfortable stretch across the chest and front of the shoulder. | Hold the position for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and evenly without bouncing. | Ease out of the stretch, lower the arm, and repeat on the opposite side.
tRu: Stand tall next to a doorway, wall, or upright post, with your feet about hip-width apart. | Raise one arm to shoulder height and bend the elbow to 90° so your forearm is vertical, like a goalpost. | Положите предплечье и ладонь плашмя на поверхность, локоть примерно на одной линии с плечом. | Держите грудь приподнятой и лопатку мягко оттянутой назад и вниз, а не к уху. | Slowly rotate your torso away from the fixed arm until you feel a comfortable stretch across the chest and front of the shoulder. | Задержите положение на 20-30 секунд, дыша медленно и ровно, без рывков. | Постепенно выйдите из растяжки, опустите руку и повторите с противоположной стороны.
tHe: Stand tall next to a doorway, wall, or upright post, with your feet about hip-width apart. | Raise one arm to shoulder height and bend the elbow to 90° so your forearm is vertical, like a goalpost. | Place your forearm and palm flat against the surface, with your elbow roughly in line with your shoulder. | Keep your chest lifted and your shoulder blade gently drawn back and down, not shrugged toward your ear. | Slowly rotate your torso away from the fixed arm until you feel a comfortable stretch across the chest and front of the shoulder. | Hold the position for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and evenly without bouncing. | צא מהמתיחה, הורד את הזרוע, וחזור על הצד הנגדי.

t: Grab a pull-up bar with an underhand (supinated) grip, hands roughly shoulder-width apart and palms facing you. | Pull yourself up until your arms are bent and your chin is at or above the bar, setting your starting flexed-arm position. | Brace your core and pull your shoulder blades down and back to engage your upper back. | Lower yourself under control only until your arms are partially extended, stopping before they fully straighten so your elbows stay bent. | Pull back up smoothly until your chin returns above the bar, leading with your elbows driving down toward your ribs. | Keep your body steady and avoid swinging, moving only through the bent-arm range. | Complete your reps, then lower under control and step down from the bar safely.
tRu: Возьмитесь за перекладку для подтягиваний нижним (супинированным) хватом, руки примерно на ширине плеч, ладонями к себе. | Pull yourself up until your arms are bent and your chin is at or above the bar, setting your starting flexed-arm position. | Напрягите корпус и опустите лопатки вниз и назад, чтобы включить мышцы верхней части спины. | Под контролем опуститесь только до частичного выпрямления рук, останавливаясь до полного разгибания, чтобы локти оставались согнутыми. | Pull back up smoothly until your chin returns above the bar, leading with your elbows driving down toward your ribs. | Держите тело неподвижным и избегайте раскачивания, двигаясь только в амплитуде сгибания рук. | Выполните все повторения, затем опуститесь под контролем и безопасно сойдите со штанги.
tHe: אחוז במוט משיכה באחיזה מלמטה (סופינציה), הידיים ברוחב הכתפיים בקירוב וכפות הידיים פונות אליך. | Pull yourself up until your arms are bent and your chin is at or above the bar, setting your starting flexed-arm position. | הדק את הליבה ומשוך את השכמות למטה ולאחור כדי להפעיל את הגב העליון. | Lower yourself under control only until your arms are partially extended, stopping before they fully straighten so your elbows stay bent. | Pull back up smoothly until your chin returns above the bar, leading with your elbows driving down toward your ribs. | Keep your body steady and avoid swinging, moving only through the bent-arm range. | בצע את החזרות שלך, ואז הורד בשליטה וצא מהמוט בבטחה.

t: Stand or sit tall with your feet about shoulder-width apart and your spine in a neutral, upright position. | Relax your shoulders down and away from your ears, then take a slow breath in to set your posture. | Bring one arm up to shoulder height and bend it slightly across the front of your body. | Place the opposite hand on the back of your bent upper arm, just above the elbow. | Gently draw the bent arm across your chest until you feel a comfortable stretch in the back of the shoulder. | Keep your shoulders level and avoid twisting your torso or shrugging the working shoulder up. | Hold the position for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and evenly throughout. | Release the arm under control, then repeat on the other side.
tRu: Stand or sit tall with your feet about shoulder-width apart and your spine in a neutral, upright position. | Relax your shoulders down and away from your ears, then take a slow breath in to set your posture. | Поднимите одну руку на уровень плеч и слегка согните ее, перекрестив перед телом. | Положите противоположную руку на заднюю часть согнутого плеча, чуть выше локтя. | Плавно ведите согнутую руку через грудь, пока не почувствуете комфортную растяжку в задней части плеча. | Держите плечи на одном уровне и избегайте скручивания корпуса или поднимания рабочего плеча. | Удерживайте положение 20–30 секунд, дыша медленно и равномерно в течение всего времени. | Release the arm under control, then repeat on the other side.
tHe: Stand or sit tall with your feet about shoulder-width apart and your spine in a neutral, upright position. | Relax your shoulders down and away from your ears, then take a slow breath in to set your posture. | הרם יד אחת לגובה הכתף וכפוף אותה קלות לאורך חזית הגוף. | Place the opposite hand on the back of your bent upper arm, just above the elbow. | משוך בעדינות את הזרוע הכפופה מעל החזה עד שתרגיש מתיחה נוחה בחלק האחורי של הכתף. | Keep your shoulders level and avoid twisting your torso or shrugging the working shoulder up. | החזק את התנוחה 20–30 שניות, תוך נשימה איטית ושווה לאורך כל הזמן. | Release the arm under control, then repeat on the other side.

nE: Bent Knee Back to Side Kick
nR: Удары ногой назад и вбок с согнутым коленом
t: Start on all fours with your hands stacked under your shoulders and your knees under your hips, keeping your back flat and your core braced. | Keep your working knee bent at roughly 90 degrees throughout the movement, with your foot flexed and sole facing the ceiling. | Press the bent leg straight back and up behind you, squeezing your glute until your thigh is in line with your torso. | Without dropping the leg, sweep that same bent knee out to the side, opening at the hip and lifting your thigh away from your body. | Pause briefly at the top of the side position, keeping your hips square and your supporting arm and knee steady. | Return the leg from the side back through the rear position under control, resisting gravity rather than letting it fall. | Complete all reps on one side, then switch and repeat with the other leg.
tRu: Start on all fours with your hands stacked under your shoulders and your knees under your hips, keeping your back flat and your core braced. | Держите рабочее колено согнутым под углом примерно 90 градусов на протяжении всего движения, с вытянутой стопой и подошвой, обращённой к потолку. | Press the bent leg straight back and up behind you, squeezing your glute until your thigh is in line with your torso. | Without dropping the leg, sweep that same bent knee out to the side, opening at the hip and lifting your thigh away from your body. | На мгновение остановитесь в верхней точке бокового положения, сохраняя бедра параллельными полу и опорную руку и колено неподвижными. | Return the leg from the side back through the rear position under control, resisting gravity rather than letting it fall. | Выполните все повторения на одну сторону, затем поменяйтесь и повторите с другой ногой.
tHe: Start on all fours with your hands stacked under your shoulders and your knees under your hips, keeping your back flat and your core braced. | Keep your working knee bent at roughly 90 degrees throughout the movement, with your foot flexed and sole facing the ceiling. | Press the bent leg straight back and up behind you, squeezing your glute until your thigh is in line with your torso. | Without dropping the leg, sweep that same bent knee out to the side, opening at the hip and lifting your thigh away from your body. | Pause briefly at the top of the side position, keeping your hips square and your supporting arm and knee steady. | Return the leg from the side back through the rear position under control, resisting gravity rather than letting it fall. | בצע את כל החזרות בצד אחד, ואז החלף וחזור על התרגיל עם הרגל השנייה.

t: Lie flat on your back on a mat with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. | Extend your arms out to the sides at shoulder height, palms down, to anchor your upper back to the floor. | Brace your core gently and keep your shoulders pinned to the mat throughout. | Exhale and lower both knees together to one side, rotating from the hips until you feel a stretch through the outer hip and lower back. | Pause briefly at the end range, keeping both shoulder blades in contact with the floor. | Inhale and use your obliques to draw the knees back up through the center under control. | Lower the knees to the opposite side in the same way, moving slowly rather than letting them drop. | Continue alternating sides for your target reps, then return your knees to the center to finish.
tRu: Лягте на спину на коврик, согните колени и поставьте ступни на пол на ширине бёдер. | Вытяните руки в стороны на уровне плеч, ладонями вниз, чтобы зафиксировать верхнюю часть спины на полу. | Слегка напрягите пресс и удерживайте плечи прижатыми к коврику в течение всего движения. | Выдыхайте и опустите оба колена вместе в одну сторону, вращаясь от бёдер, пока не почувствуете растяжение в наружной стороне бедра и поясницы. | На мгновение остановитесь в конечной точке амплитуды, сохраняя обе лопатки прижатыми к полу. | Выдохните и используйте косые мышцы, чтобы плавно вернуть колени вверх через центр. | Аналогично опустите колени в другую сторону, двигаясь медленно, а не позволяя им резко опуститься. | Продолжайте поочередно выполнять движения на разные стороны в течение целевого количества повторений, затем верните колени в центр для завершения.
tHe: Lie flat on your back on a mat with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. | פשוט את ידיך לצדדים בגובה הכתפיים, כפות ידיים למטה, כדי לעגן את הגב העליון לרצפה. | הדק בעדינות את הליבה ושמור על כתפיים צמודות למזרן לאורך כל התנועה. | שחרר אוויר והורד את שתי הברכים יחד לצד אחד, תוך סיבוב מהאגן עד שתרגיש מתיחה באגן החיצוני ובגב התחתון. | Pause briefly at the end range, keeping both shoulder blades in contact with the floor. | Inhale and use your obliques to draw the knees back up through the center under control. | Lower the knees to the opposite side in the same way, moving slowly rather than letting them drop. | המשיל להחליף צדדים לחזרות היעד שלך, ואסיים בהחזרת ברכיך למרכז.

nR: Скрутки лёжа с согнутыми коленями (на фитболе)
nH: פיתולים בשכיבה בברך כפופה (על כדור פיזיו)
t: Sit on the stability ball, then walk your feet forward until your upper back and shoulders rest on the ball and your hips are lifted into a bridge. | Plant your feet flat on the floor, knees bent at about 90 degrees and roughly hip-width apart, so your thighs and torso form a stable tabletop. | Extend your arms straight up over your chest, palms together, or fold them across your chest. | Brace your core and keep your hips level with your shoulders throughout the movement. | Slowly rotate your torso to one side, rolling your shoulders across the ball while keeping your hips lifted and feet fixed. | Pause briefly when your arms point out to the side, feeling the oblique on the working side contract. | Rotate smoothly back through the center and continue to the opposite side under control. | Complete your reps to each side, then walk your feet back in and sit up on the ball to finish.
tRu: Sit on the stability ball, then walk your feet forward until your upper back and shoulders rest on the ball and your hips are lifted into a bridge. | Поставьте ноги на пол на ширине бёдер, колени согнуты примерно под 90 градусов, чтобы бёдра и корпус образовывали устойчивую поверхность стола. | Выпрямите руки прямо над грудью, ладони вместе или скрестите их перед грудью. | Напрягите корпус и удерживайте бёдра на одном уровне с плечами в течение всего движения. | Slowly rotate your torso to one side, rolling your shoulders across the ball while keeping your hips lifted and feet fixed. | Задержитесь на мгновение, когда руки разведены в стороны, чувствуя сокращение косой мышцы на рабочей стороне. | Rotate smoothly back through the center and continue to the opposite side under control. | Выполните все повторения на каждую сторону, затем верните ноги в исходное положение и сядьте на мяч.
tHe: Sit on the stability ball, then walk your feet forward until your upper back and shoulders rest on the ball and your hips are lifted into a bridge. | Plant your feet flat on the floor, knees bent at about 90 degrees and roughly hip-width apart, so your thighs and torso form a stable tabletop. | הושט את זרועותיך ישר מעל החזה, כפות ידים זו לזו, או קפל אותן על החזה. | הדק את הליבה ושמור על האגן בקו אחד עם הכתפיים לאורך כל התנועה. | Slowly rotate your torso to one side, rolling your shoulders across the ball while keeping your hips lifted and feet fixed. | Pause briefly when your arms point out to the side, feeling the oblique on the working side contract. | Rotate smoothly back through the center and continue to the opposite side under control. | בצע את כל החזרות לכל צד, ואם הזז את הרגליים חזרה פנימה ושב במושב על הכדור כדי לסיים.

t: Lie on your side on a mat with your knees bent to roughly 90 degrees and stacked on top of each other. | Place your bottom forearm flat on the floor with the elbow directly under your shoulder, forearm pointing forward. | Brace your core and squeeze your glutes, then lift your hips off the floor so your weight rests on your forearm and the side of your bottom knee. | Form a straight line from your shoulders through your hips to your knees, keeping your neck long and your head in line with your spine. | Hold this position while breathing steadily, keeping your hips lifted and level for the target time (for example, 20 to 40 seconds). | Avoid letting your hips sag or rotate forward or back throughout the hold. | Lower your hips to the floor under control to finish the hold. | Switch to the other side and repeat for the same hold time to train both obliques evenly.
tRu: Лягте на бок на мате, колени согнуты под углом примерно 90 градусов и лежат одна на другой. | Положите нижнее предплечье на пол, локоть прямо под плечом, предплечье направлено вперед. | Напрягите корпус и сожмите ягодицы, затем поднимите бёдра от пола, перенеся вес на предплечье и боковую часть нижнего колена. | Вытяните прямую линию от плеч через бёдра до колен, сохраняя шею длинной, а голову на одном уровне с позвоночником. | Удерживайте это положение, дыша ровно, и удерживайте бедра поднятыми и на одном уровне в течение заданного времени (например, 20-40 секунд). | Не давайте бёдрам провисать или вращаться вперёд-назад в течение всего удержания. | Медленно опустите бёдра на пол под контролем, чтобы закончить удержание. | Switch to the other side and repeat for the same hold time to train both obliques evenly.
tHe: Lie on your side on a mat with your knees bent to roughly 90 degrees and stacked on top of each other. | Place your bottom forearm flat on the floor with the elbow directly under your shoulder, forearm pointing forward. | הדק את הליבה וכווץ את הישבנים, ואז הרם את האגן מהרצפה כך שהמשקל נשען על האמה וצד הברך התחתונה. | צור קו ישר מהכתפיים דרך הירכיים ועד הברכיים, תוך שמירה על צוואר ארוך וראש בקו עמוד השדרה. | Hold this position while breathing steadily, keeping your hips lifted and level for the target time (for example, 20 to 40 seconds). | הימנע משקיעת האגן או מסיבובו קדימה או אחורה לאורך כל ההחזקה. | Lower your hips to the floor under control to finish the hold. | Switch to the other side and repeat for the same hold time to train both obliques evenly.

t: Start on all fours with your hands under your shoulders, knees under your hips, and your spine in a neutral line. | Brace your core and keep your back flat so your torso stays still throughout the movement. | Lift one knee off the floor, keeping that leg bent at roughly 90 degrees with the foot flexed. | Drive the bent knee out to the side and up, opening the hip as far as your control allows. | Continue tracing a smooth circle by sweeping the knee back and around toward the start position. | Keep the circle slow and deliberate, moving only at the hip while your hips and shoulders stay square to the floor. | Complete your reps, then reverse the direction of the circle for the same number of reps. | Lower the knee back to the floor with control and repeat on the other leg.
tRu: Start on all fours with your hands under your shoulders, knees under your hips, and your spine in a neutral line. | Напрягите корпус и удерживайте спину прямой, чтобы корпус оставался неподвижным в течение всего движения. | Приподнимите одно колено от пола, удерживая это колено согнутым под углом примерно 90 градусов, стопа вытянута. | Вытолкайте согнутое колено в сторону и вверх, максимально отводя тазобедренный сустав под вашим контролем. | Продолжайте рисовать плавный круг, двигая колено назад и вокруг в исходное положение. | Держите круг медленным и осознанным, двигаясь только за счет тазобедренных суставов, в то время как ваши бедра и плечи остаются параллельны полу. | Выполните все повторения, затем измените направление круга на противоположное и выполните такое же количество повторений. | С контролем опустите колено на пол и повторите движение на другой ноге.
tHe: Start on all fours with your hands under your shoulders, knees under your hips, and your spine in a neutral line. | הדק את הליבה ושמור על גב שטוח כך שהגוף נשאר יציב לאורך כל התנועה. | Lift one knee off the floor, keeping that leg bent at roughly 90 degrees with the foot flexed. | הנע את הברך הכפופה החוצה לצד ולמעלה, פותח את הירך ככל שהשליטה שלך מאפשרת. | המשך לעקוב אחרי מעגל חלק על ידי הזזת הברך אחורה וסביבה לכיוון תחילת התנועה. | Keep the circle slow and deliberate, moving only at the hip while your hips and shoulders stay square to the floor. | בצע את החזרות שלך, ואז הפך את כיוון המעגל לאותו מספר של חזרות. | Lower the knee back to the floor with control and repeat on the other leg.

t: Kneel on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and your knees under your hips. | Brace your core and set your back flat, keeping a neutral spine with your head in line with your torso. | Keeping your working knee bent at about 90 degrees, lift that leg back and up, driving the heel toward the ceiling. | Raise the thigh until it is roughly level with your torso and your glute is fully contracted at the top. | Pause and squeeze the glute for a moment at the top of the movement. | Lower the leg under control back toward the start without letting the knee touch the floor. | Complete your reps on one side, then switch and repeat with the other leg.
tRu: Встаньте на колени на четвереньках, руки под плечами, колени под тазом. | Напрягите корпус и держите спину ровной, сохраняя нейтральное положение позвоночника и удерживая голову на одной линии с корпусом. | Держа рабочее колено согнутым под углом примерно 90 градусов, поднимите эту ногу назад и вверх, отводя пятку к потолку. | Raise the thigh until it is roughly level with your torso and your glute is fully contracted at the top. | Сделайте паузу и сожмите ягодицу на мгновение в верхней точке движения. | С контролем опустите ногу в направлении исходного положения, не позволяя колену касаться пола. | Выполните все повторения на одну сторону, затем поменяйте сторону и повторите с другой ногой.
tHe: Kneel on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and your knees under your hips. | הדק את הליבה וקבע גב שטוח, תוך שמירה על עמוד שדרה ניטרלי כשהראש בקו אחד עם הגוף. | Keeping your working knee bent at about 90 degrees, lift that leg back and up, driving the heel toward the ceiling. | Raise the thigh until it is roughly level with your torso and your glute is fully contracted at the top. | Pause and squeeze the glute for a moment at the top of the movement. | Lower the leg under control back toward the start without letting the knee touch the floor. | בצע את כל החזרות בצד אחד, ואז החלף וחזור עם הרגל השנייה.

t: Start on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and your knees under your hips, keeping your back flat and your core braced. | Keep the working leg bent at roughly a 90° angle at the knee throughout the movement. | Without rotating your torso or hips, lift the bent leg out to the side, leading with the knee as your thigh moves away from the midline. | Raise the leg until your thigh reaches about hip height or until you feel a strong contraction on the side of your hip. | Pause briefly at the top, keeping your pelvis level and your hips square to the floor. | Lower the leg back down under control without letting the knee touch the ground between reps. | Complete all reps on one side, then switch to the other leg.
tRu: Start on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and your knees under your hips, keeping your back flat and your core braced. | Держите рабочую ногу полностью прямой с зафиксированным коленом и стопой в нейтральном положении; оставьте другую ногу расслабленной на коврике. | Without rotating your torso or hips, lift the bent leg out to the side, leading with the knee as your thigh moves away from the midline. | Raise the leg until your thigh reaches about hip height or until you feel a strong contraction on the side of your hip. | На вершине движения сделайте короткую паузу, удерживая таз на одном уровне, а бёдра параллельными полу. | С контролем опустите ногу вниз, не позволяя колену касаться пола между повторениями. | Выполните все повторения на одну сторону, затем перейдите на другую ногу.
tHe: Start on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and your knees under your hips, keeping your back flat and your core braced. | Keep the working leg bent at roughly a 90° angle at the knee throughout the movement. | Without rotating your torso or hips, lift the bent leg out to the side, leading with the knee as your thigh moves away from the midline. | Raise the leg until your thigh reaches about hip height or until you feel a strong contraction on the side of your hip. | Pause briefly at the top, keeping your pelvis level and your hips square to the floor. | Lower the leg back down under control without letting the knee touch the ground between reps. | בצע את כל החזרות בצד אחד, ואז עבור לרגל השנייה.

nE: Bent Over Back Extension Scapular Adduction
nR: Разгибания спины в наклоне со сведением лопаток
nH: פשיטות גב בכפיפה עם קירוב שכמות
t: Stand with your feet about hip-width apart and a slight bend in your knees. | Hinge forward at the hips with a flat, neutral spine until your torso is roughly parallel to the floor, letting your arms hang down. | Brace your core and keep your neck in line with your spine, looking at the floor a short distance ahead. | Extend your back, lifting your chest and raising your torso while keeping the movement controlled. | At the top, squeeze your shoulder blades down and together (scapular adduction), pinching the muscles of your mid-back. | Hold the squeeze for a beat, keeping your shoulders away from your ears. | Lower under control back to the bent-over starting position, releasing the squeeze. | Complete your reps, then stand up tall to finish.
tRu: Stand with your feet about hip-width apart and a slight bend in your knees. | Отводите бёдра вперёд с плоским, нейтральным позвоночником, пока ваш торс не окажется примерно параллельно полу, позволяя вашим рукам свободно висеть. | Напрягите корпус и держите шею на одной линии с позвоночником, глядя в пол на небольшом расстоянии впереди. | Выпрямите спину, поднимая грудь и корпус, сохраняя движение контролируемым. | Вверху сожмите лопатки вниз и вместе, сводя мышцы середины спины. | Держите сжатие в течение счёта, сохраняя плечи远离 ушей. | Под контролем опуститесь в исходное согнутое положение, ослабив напряжение. | Выполните все повторения, затем встаньте прямо, чтобы завершить.
tHe: Stand with your feet about hip-width apart and a slight bend in your knees. | כופף קדימה בציר הירכיים עם עמוד שדרה שטוח וניטרלי עד שהגו בקירוב מקביל לרצפה, ותן לזרועות לתלות מטה. | הדק את הליבה ושמור על הצוואר בקו אחד עם עמוד השדרה, תוך מבט לרצפה במרחק קצר קדימה. | פשוט את גבך, הרם את החזה והעלה את הגוף תוך שמירה על תנועה מבוקרת. | בשיא כווץ את שכמות הכתפיים מטה ויחד, תוך צביטת שרירי אמצע הגב. | Hold the squeeze for a beat, keeping your shoulders away from your ears. | Lower under control back to the bent-over starting position, releasing the squeeze. | בצע את כל החזרות, ואקום בעמידה ישרה כדי לסיים.

t: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand with your feet about hip-width apart, knees slightly bent. | Hinge forward at the hips, pushing your butt back until your torso is close to parallel with the floor, and brace your core. | Set your back flat (the right position) rather than letting it round forward (the wrong position), and let the dumbbells hang straight down at arm's length. | Pull the dumbbells up toward your lower ribs by driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades together. | Keep your elbows close to your body and avoid using a jerking, momentum-driven swing of the torso to lift the weight. | Pause briefly at the top with your back muscles fully contracted. | Lower the dumbbells under control back to the starting position, keeping tension in your back. | Complete your reps, then stand back up by driving through your hips and set the dumbbells down with a flat back.
tRu: Возьмите по гантели в каждую руку и встаньте, поставив ноги примерно на ширине бёдер и слегка согнув колени. | Отводите бёдра вперёд, отталкивая таз назад, пока ваш торс не окажется почти параллельно полу, и напрягите корпус. | Set your back flat (the right position) rather than letting it round forward (the wrong position), and let the dumbbells hang straight down at arm's length. | Pull the dumbbells up toward your lower ribs by driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades together. | Держите локти близко к телу и избегайте использования рывкового, инерционного движения корпуса для подъема веса. | Задержитесь на мгновение в верхней точке с полностью сокращёнными мышцами спины. | Плавно опустите гантели в исходное положение, сохраняя напряжение в спине. | Выполните все повторения, затем встаньте, отталкиваясь бёдрами, и поставьте гантели на пол, держа спину ровно.
tHe: החזק דאמבל בכל יד ועמוד עם רגליים בערך ברוחב האגן, ברכיים מעט כפופות. | כופף קדימה בציר הירכיים, תוך דחיפת הישבן לאחור עד שהגו קרוב למקביל לרצפה, והדק את הליבה. | Set your back flat (the right position) rather than letting it round forward (the wrong position), and let the dumbbells hang straight down at arm's length. | Pull the dumbbells up toward your lower ribs by driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades together. | Keep your elbows close to your body and avoid using a jerking, momentum-driven swing of the torso to lift the weight. | Pause briefly at the top with your back muscles fully contracted. | Lower the dumbbells under control back to the starting position, keeping tension in your back. | בצע את החזרות שלך, ואז קום מהר על ידי דחיפה דרך הירכיים והנח את הדאמבלים עם גב שטח.

t: Loop the middle of a towel under both feet, or anchor it so you can pull against it, and grab an end in each hand. | Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back until your torso is roughly parallel to the floor, knees softly bent. | Let your arms hang straight toward the floor and pull your shoulder blades down to set your back. | Brace your core and pull both ends of the towel up toward your lower ribs, driving your elbows back and close to your sides. | As you row, apply tension through the towel so each rep meets resistance rather than swinging freely. | Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top and hold the contraction for a moment. | Lower under control back to the hanging start position, keeping tension on the towel throughout. | Complete your reps, then release the towel and stand up by pushing your hips forward.
tRu: Оберните центр полотенца под обе стопы или закрепите его так, чтобы вы могли тянуться, и возьмите по одному концу в каждую руку. | Отводите бёдра вперёд с плоской спиной, пока ваш торс не окажется примерно параллельно полу, колени мягко согнуты. | Пусть ваши руки выпрямлены и свисают к полу и опустите лопатки вниз, чтобы занять положение. | Напрягите корпус и подтяните оба конца полотенца вверх к нижним рёбрам, отводя локти назад и близко к бокам. | Выполняя тягу, держите полотенце в натяжении, чтобы каждый повтор шёл через сопротивление, а не болтался свободно. | Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top and hold the contraction for a moment. | Под контролем опуститесь в исходное висячее положение, сохраняя натяжение на полотенце на протяжении всего движения. | Выполните все повторения, затем отпустите полотенце и встаньте, отталкивая бёдрами вперёд.
tHe: Loop the middle of a towel under both feet, or anchor it so you can pull against it, and grab an end in each hand. | כופף קדימה בציר הירכיים עם גב שטוח עד שהגו בקירוב מקביל לרצפה, ברכיים כפופות רכות. | Let your arms hang straight toward the floor and pull your shoulder blades down to set your back. | הדק את הליבה ומשוך את שני קצות המגבת למעלה לכיוון הצלעות התחתונות, תוך דחיפת המרפקים לאחור וצמוד לצדדים. | בחתירה, הפעל מתח דרך המגבת כך שכל חזרה תפגוש התנגדות ולא תתנדנד בחופשיות. | Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top and hold the contraction for a moment. | Lower under control back to the hanging start position, keeping tension on the towel throughout. | בצע את החזרות שלך, ואז שחרר את המגבת וקם על ידי דחיפת המותניים קדימה.

t: Stand next to a bench or sturdy support and place your free hand on it for balance. | Hinge forward at your hips until your torso is roughly parallel to the floor, keeping your back flat and your knees slightly bent. | Let your working arm hang straight down from the shoulder, completely relaxed, so it dangles toward the floor. | Begin swinging the hanging arm gently forward and back in a small pendulum motion, letting momentum carry it rather than muscling it. | After several swings, switch to small side-to-side arcs across your body and back out. | Finish with slow, relaxed circles in each direction, gradually widening the range as the shoulder loosens. | Stand up under control, switch sides, and repeat with the other arm.
tRu: Stand next to a bench or sturdy support and place your free hand on it for balance. | Отводите бёдра вперёд, пока ваш торс не окажется примерно параллельно полу, сохраняя спину плоской и колени слегка согнутыми. | Позвольте вашей рабочей руке свисать прямо вниз, прижмите локоть к боку и напрягите мышцы кора. | Начните мягко качать висящую руку вперёд-назад малым маятниковым движением, позволяя инерции вести её, а не напрягая мышцы. | После нескольких махов перейдите к малым дугам из стороны в сторону поперёк тела и обратно наружу. | Завершите медленными, расслабленными круговыми движениями в каждом направлении, постепенно увеличивая амплитуду по мере расслабления плеча. | Stand up under control, switch sides, and repeat with the other arm.
tHe: Stand next to a bench or sturdy support and place your free hand on it for balance. | כופף קדימה בציר הירכיים עד שהגו בקירוב מקביל לרצפה, תוך שמירה על גב שטוח וברכיים כפופות מעט. | Let your working arm hang straight down from the shoulder, completely relaxed, so it dangles toward the floor. | התחל להניף את הזרוע התלויה בעדינות קדימה ואחורה בתנועת מטוטלת קטנה, ותן לתנופה לשאת אותה ולא לשרירים. | אחרי כמה הנפות, עבור לקשתות קטנות מצד לצד לרוחב הגוף ובחזרה החוצה. | סיים בהקפות איטיות ורפויות לכל כיוון, תוך הרחבה הדרגתית של הטווח ככל שהכתף משתחררת. | Stand up under control, switch sides, and repeat with the other arm.

t: Stand tall with your feet roughly shoulder-width apart and a soft bend in your knees. | Brace your core lightly and hinge forward at the hips until your torso is close to parallel with the floor. | Extend both arms straight out to the sides so your body forms a wide 'T'. | Keeping your back flat, rotate your torso and reach your right hand down toward your left foot. | Let your left arm rise toward the ceiling and follow the movement with your eyes for a fuller stretch through the waist. | Rotate back through the center under control, returning both arms to the wide 'T' position. | Repeat to the other side, reaching your left hand toward your right foot. | Continue alternating sides for the prescribed time or reps, moving smoothly and breathing throughout. | Finish by rotating back to center and standing up slowly to avoid dizziness.
tRu: Stand tall with your feet roughly shoulder-width apart and a soft bend in your knees. | Легко напрягите пресс и наклонитесь вперёд за счёт бёдер, пока корпус не окажется почти параллельно полу. | Вытяните обе руки прямо в стороны, чтобы ваше тело образовывало широкую букву «Т». | Держа спину прямой, поверните корпус и дотянитесь правой рукой до левой стопы. | Позвольте вашей левой руке подняться к потолку и следите за движением глазами для большей растяжки в талии. | Rotate back through the center under control, returning both arms to the wide 'T' position. | Repeat to the other side, reaching your left hand toward your right foot. | Продолжайте поочередно выполнять движения на разные стороны в течение назначенного времени или повторений, двигаясь плавно и дыша на протяжении всего упражнения. | Завершите упражнение, повернувшись обратно в центр, затем медленно поднимитесь, чтобы избежать головокружения.
tHe: Stand tall with your feet roughly shoulder-width apart and a soft bend in your knees. | הדק קלות את הליבה והתכופף קדימה מהאגן עד שהגו כמעט מקביל לרצפה. | פשוט את שתי הידיים ישר לצידים כך שהגוף ייצור T רחב. | Keeping your back flat, rotate your torso and reach your right hand down toward your left foot. | Let your left arm rise toward the ceiling and follow the movement with your eyes for a fuller stretch through the waist. | Rotate back through the center under control, returning both arms to the wide 'T' position. | Repeat to the other side, reaching your left hand toward your right foot. | המשיל להחליף צדדים למספר החזרות או הזמן המומלצים, זז בחלקות ונשוף לאורך כל התרגיל. | סיים בסיבוב חזרה למרכז וקימה איטית למניעת סחרחורת.

t: Kneel on the floor and set your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width, fingers pointing forward, then walk your hands out into a knee push-up position with your weight on your knees rather than your toes. | Brace your core and squeeze your glutes so your body forms a straight line from your head to your knees. | Bend your elbows and lower your chest toward the floor under control, keeping your elbows at roughly a 45° angle to your torso. | Lower until your chest is just above the floor, keeping your wrists stacked under your shoulders. | Press through your palms to push your body back up until your arms are fully extended. | At the top, lift one bent knee out to the side, opening the hip while keeping the knee flexed and your torso square to the floor. | Lower the knee back to the start under control, then repeat the push-up and alternate the knee lift to the other side each rep. | Complete your reps, then lower your hips to the floor to finish.
tRu: Встаньте на колени на полу и поставьте руки немного шире плеч, пальцами вперёд, затем шагните руками вперёд в положение отжимания на коленях, вес тела на коленях, а не на носках. | Напрягите корпус и сожмите ягодицы, чтобы тело образовало прямую линию от головы до коленей. | Согните локти и подконтрольно опустите грудь к полу, удерживая локти под углом примерно 45° к корпусу. | Опустите, пока ваша грудь не оказалась прямо над полом, сохраняя запястья под плечами. | Отожмитесь ладонями и поднимите тело вверх, пока руки полностью не выпрямятся. | Вверху отведите одно согнутое колено в сторону, раскрывая бедро, удерживая колено согнутым, а корпус ровным к полу. | С контролем опустите колено в исходное согнутое положение, затем выполните отжимание и чередуйте подъем колена на другую сторону при каждом повторении. | Выполните все повторения, затем опустите бёдра на пол для завершения.
tHe: Kneel on the floor and set your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width, fingers pointing forward, then walk your hands out into a knee push-up position with your weight on your knees rather than your toes. | הדק את הליבה וכווץ את הישבנים כך שהגוף יוצר קו ישר מהראש עד הברכיים. | כופף את המרפקים והורד את החזה לכיוון הרצפה בשליטה, תוך שמירה על מרפקים בזווית של כ-45° לגוף. | Lower until your chest is just above the floor, keeping your wrists stacked under your shoulders. | לחץ דרך כפות הידיים כדי לדחוף את הגוף חזרה למעלה עד שהידיים ישרות לגמרי. | בשיא הרם ברך כפופה אחת הצידה, תוך פתיחת האגן ושמירה על הברך כפופה ופלג הגוף מרובע לרצפה. | Lower the knee back to the start under control, then repeat the push-up and alternate the knee lift to the other side each rep. | בצע את כל החזרות, ואז הורד את האגן לרצפה כדי לסיים.

nR: Сгибания на бицепс: руки у корпуса (НЕПРАВИЛЬНО-ПРАВИЛЬНО)
t: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging at your sides with palms facing forward. | Pin your upper arms against your ribs and lock your elbows to a fixed point close to your body. | Brace your core and keep your shoulders down and back so your torso stays still. | Curl the dumbbells up by bending only at the elbow, keeping the upper arms motionless against your sides (the right way). | Avoid letting the elbows drift forward or the upper arms swing away from the body to hoist the weight (the wrong way). | Squeeze the biceps at the top, with your forearms vertical and elbows still tucked in. | Lower the dumbbells under control until your arms are fully extended again, keeping the upper arms fixed. | Complete your reps, then set the dumbbells down with control.
tRu: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging at your sides with palms facing forward. | Прижмите верхние руки к ребрам и зафиксируйте локти в фиксированной точке близко к телу. | Напрягите корпус и опустите плечи вниз и назад, чтобы корпус оставался неподвижным. | Поднимите гантели вверх, сгибая только локоть, удерживая верхние руки неподвижно у боков (правильный способ). | Не давайте локтям уходить вперёд, а плечам — отрываться от корпуса и закидывать вес. | Squeeze the biceps at the top, with your forearms vertical and elbows still tucked in. | Плавно опустите гантели в исходное положение до полного выпрямления рук, сохраняя верхние руки неподвижными. | Выполните повторения, затем подконтрольно опустите гантели.
tHe: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging at your sides with palms facing forward. | Pin your upper arms against your ribs and lock your elbows to a fixed point close to your body. | הדק את הליבה ושמור על הכתפיים למטה ולאחור כדי שהגו יישאר יציב. | כופף את הדאמבלים למעלה על ידי כיפוף במרפק בלבד, שומר שהזרועות העליונות נייחות ליד הגוף (הדרך הנכונה). | הימנע מנדידת המרפקים קדימה או מהתרחקות הזרועות מהגוף כדי להניף את המשקל. | Squeeze the biceps at the top, with your forearms vertical and elbows still tucked in. | Lower the dumbbells under control until your arms are fully extended again, keeping the upper arms fixed. | סיים את החזרות, ואז הנח את הדאמבלים בשליטה.

nR: Сгибания на бицепс с шагом вперёд
t: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, knees soft, and arms hanging at your sides with your palms facing forward. | Brace your core and keep your chest up and shoulders relaxed down away from your ears. | Step one foot forward and plant it as you curl both hands up toward your shoulders, leading with your forearms. | Lower your hands back down with control as you step that foot back to the start position. | Repeat on the other side, stepping the opposite foot forward and curling again, finding a steady rhythm. | Keep alternating legs and timing each curl with the front step, breathing steadily throughout. | Continue for your set time or rep count, then slow the pace and return to a tall, neutral stance to finish.
tRu: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, knees soft, and arms hanging at your sides with your palms facing forward. | Напрягите корпус, держите грудь вверх, а плечи расслабленно опущенными вдали от ушей. | Step one foot forward and plant it as you curl both hands up toward your shoulders, leading with your forearms. | Опустите руки обратно вниз под контролем, когда вы перемещаете эту ногу назад в исходное положение. | Repeat on the other side, stepping the opposite foot forward and curling again, finding a steady rhythm. | Чередуйте ноги и синхронизируйте каждое сгибание руки с шагом вперёд, дышите ровно на протяжении всего движения. | Продолжайте в течение заданного времени, затем сведите колени вместе и выпрямите ноги, чтобы завершить.
tHe: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, knees soft, and arms hanging at your sides with your palms facing forward. | הדק את הליבה ושמור על חזה מורם וכתפיים רפויות למטה, הרחק מהאוזניים. | Step one foot forward and plant it as you curl both hands up toward your shoulders, leading with your forearms. | Lower your hands back down with control as you step that foot back to the start position. | Repeat on the other side, stepping the opposite foot forward and curling again, finding a steady rhythm. | Keep alternating legs and timing each curl with the front step, breathing steadily throughout. | המשך למשך זמן הסט או מספר החזרות שלך, אז האט את הקצב וחזור לעמידה זקופה נייטרלית כדי לסיים.

t: Find a sturdy, heavy table that will not tip or lift, and sit or kneel underneath its edge with your back straight. | Position your knees bent and your torso upright so your forearms can reach the underside of the tabletop. | Place your palms flat against the underside of the table, hands roughly shoulder-width apart, with your elbows tucked close to your sides. | Brace your core and set your shoulder blades down and back to create a stable base. | Curl upward by pressing your palms into the table as if trying to lift it, squeezing your biceps hard while your elbows stay pinned at your sides. | Hold the peak contraction for a slow count, keeping the upward pressure steady and controlled. | Ease off the pressure gradually rather than letting go all at once, returning to a relaxed start. | Repeat for your target reps or timed holds, then rest.
tRu: Найдите прочный, тяжёлый стол, который не перевернётся и не сдвинется, и сядьте или kneel под его краем с прямой спиной. | Position your knees bent and your torso upright so your forearms can reach the underside of the tabletop. | Положите ладони плоско под столом, руки примерно на ширине плеч, локти прижаты к бокам. | Напрягите корпус и опустите лопатки вниз и назад, чтобы создать устойчивую опору. | Поднимитесь вверх, надавливая ладонями на стол, как будто пытаетесь его приподнять, сильно сжимая бицепсы, пока локти остаются прижатыми к бокам. | Задержитесь в пиковом сокращении на медный счёт, сохраняя устойчивое и контролируемое давление вверх. | Постепенно ослабьте давление, а не отпускайте всё сразу, вернувшись в расслабленное исходное положение. | Repeat for your target reps or timed holds, then rest.
tHe: מצא שולחן יציב וכבד לא יכול להתהפך או להרים, וישוב או כרע תחת קצהו עם גב ישר. | Position your knees bent and your torso upright so your forearms can reach the underside of the tabletop. | Place your palms flat against the underside of the table, hands roughly shoulder-width apart, with your elbows tucked close to your sides. | הדק את הליבה וקבע את השכמות למטה ולאחור כדי ליצור בסיס יציב. | כופף כלפי מעלה על ידי לחיצת כפות הידים לשולחן כאילו מנסים להרים אותו, מתח בחוזקה את הזרוע הפנימית בזמן שהמרפקים נשארים צמודים לצדדים. | Hold the peak contraction for a slow count, keeping the upward pressure steady and controlled. | הפחת מהלחץ בהדרגה במקום לשחרר את כל המאמץ בבת אחת, חוזר להתחלה מרגיה. | Repeat for your target reps or timed holds, then rest.

t: Loop a folded bed sheet under both feet and grip an end in each hand, palms facing up and arms hanging straight down at your sides. | Stand tall with feet about shoulder-width apart, knees soft, and brace your core to keep your torso upright. | Pin your elbows close to your sides so the upper arms stay fixed throughout the movement. | Curl your hands up toward your shoulders, bending only at the elbows while pulling firmly against the sheet to create resistance. | Keep tension in the sheet by pressing down through your feet as your hands rise, squeezing the biceps at the top. | Pause briefly at the top with your forearms near your upper arms, keeping the wrists straight. | Lower your hands back to the start under control, resisting the sheet on the way down rather than letting it drop. | Complete your reps, then ease the tension and step out of the sheet.
tRu: Проденьте сложенную простыню под обе ступни и возьмите один конец в каждую руку, ладонями вверх и прямыми руками вдоль тела. | Stand tall with feet about shoulder-width apart, knees soft, and brace your core to keep your torso upright. | Прижмите локти близко к бокам, чтобы верхние руки оставались неподвижными на протяжении всего движения. | Согните руки к плечам, сгибая только в локтях, при этом сильно тяните против эспандера, чтобы создать сопротивление. | Сохраняйте напряжение в эспандере, нажимая ногами вниз, когда поднимаете руки, и сжимая бицепсы в верхней точке. | Задержитесь на мгновение в верхней точке с предплечьями у верхней части рук, сохраняя запястья прямыми. | Опустите руки обратно в исходное положение под контролем, сопротивляясь полотну на пути вниз, а не позволяя ему упасть. | Выполните все повторения, затем плавно снимите напряжение и выйдите из листа.
tHe: Loop a folded bed sheet under both feet and grip an end in each hand, palms facing up and arms hanging straight down at your sides. | Stand tall with feet about shoulder-width apart, knees soft, and brace your core to keep your torso upright. | Pin your elbows close to your sides so the upper arms stay fixed throughout the movement. | כרוח ידיך לעבר הכתפיים, כפוף רק במרפקים בעת משיכה חזקה נגד הבד כדי ליצור התנגדות. | Keep tension in the sheet by pressing down through your feet as your hands rise, squeezing the biceps at the top. | Pause briefly at the top with your forearms near your upper arms, keeping the wrists straight. | Lower your hands back to the start under control, resisting the sheet on the way down rather than letting it drop. | בצע את כל החזרות, ואז הפחת את המתח וצא מהשמיכה.

t: Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart and your chest lifted. | Reach both arms behind your back and clasp your hands together below your glutes. | Straighten your elbows so your arms are fully extended behind you, palms facing inward or down. | Slowly raise your clasped hands away from your body until you feel a gentle stretch along the front of your upper arms. | Keep your shoulders relaxed and down, your chest open, and your back straight as you lift. | Hold the stretch in a still position for 20–30 seconds, breathing steadily without bouncing. | Lower your hands under control, release the clasp, and shake out your arms before repeating if desired.
tRu: Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart and your chest lifted. | Reach both arms behind your back and clasp your hands together below your glutes. | Straighten your elbows so your arms are fully extended behind you, palms facing inward or down. | Slowly raise your clasped hands away from your body until you feel a gentle stretch along the front of your upper arms. | Держите плечи расслабленными и опущенными, грудь — открытой, и спину прямой, поднимаясь. | Держите растяжку в неподвижном положении 20–30 секунд, дыша ровно без рывков. | Опустите руки под контролем, разожмите ладони, встряхните руки и повторите при желании.
tHe: Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart and your chest lifted. | Reach both arms behind your back and clasp your hands together below your glutes. | Straighten your elbows so your arms are fully extended behind you, palms facing inward or down. | Slowly raise your clasped hands away from your body until you feel a gentle stretch along the front of your upper arms. | Keep your shoulders relaxed and down, your chest open, and your back straight as you lift. | Hold the stretch in a still position for 20–30 seconds, breathing steadily without bouncing. | Lower your hands under control, release the clasp, and shake out your arms before repeating if desired.

t: Lie flat on your back on a mat with your lower back gently pressed into the floor and your knees bent. | Place your hands lightly behind your head with your elbows wide, and lift your shoulder blades just off the mat. | Raise both feet off the floor and bring your knees up so your shins are roughly parallel to the ground. | Draw one knee in toward your chest while extending the opposite leg out straight at a slight upward angle. | Rotate your torso to bring the opposite elbow toward the bent knee, feeling the stretch through your waist and the front of the extended leg. | Smoothly switch sides, drawing the other knee in and extending the first leg as your torso rotates the other way. | Continue alternating in a slow, controlled pedalling rhythm, breathing steadily throughout. | To finish, bring both knees in, lower your feet to the floor, and rest your head and shoulders back down.
tRu: Лягте на спину на коврик с слегка прижатой поясницей к полу и согнутыми коленями. | Положите руки легко за головой, локти широко расставлены, и слегка приподнимите лопатки над матом. | Raise both feet off the floor and bring your knees up so your shins are roughly parallel to the ground. | Приведите одно колено к груди, выпрямляя противоположную ногу прямо под небольшим углом вверх. | Rotate your torso to bring the opposite elbow toward the bent knee, feeling the stretch through your waist and the front of the extended leg. | Smoothly switch sides, drawing the other knee in and extending the first leg as your torso rotates the other way. | Продолжайте поочерёдно выполнять в медленном, контролируемом ритме педалирования, дыша ровно на протяжении всего движения. | To finish, bring both knees in, lower your feet to the floor, and rest your head and shoulders back down.
tHe: Lie flat on your back on a mat with your lower back gently pressed into the floor and your knees bent. | Place your hands lightly behind your head with your elbows wide, and lift your shoulder blades just off the mat. | Raise both feet off the floor and bring your knees up so your shins are roughly parallel to the ground. | משוך ברך אחת לעבר החזה בזמן שהרגל הנגדית מתישרעת החוצה בזווית מעט כלפי מעלה. | Rotate your torso to bring the opposite elbow toward the bent knee, feeling the stretch through your waist and the front of the extended leg. | Smoothly switch sides, drawing the other knee in and extending the first leg as your torso rotates the other way. | המשילו להחליף בקצב פדלים איטי ומבוקר, נשימה יציבה לאורך כל התרגיל. | To finish, bring both knees in, lower your feet to the floor, and rest your head and shoulders back down.

t: Lie flat on your back with your lower back pressed into the floor and your hands resting lightly behind your head, elbows pointing out to the sides. | Lift both feet off the floor and raise your knees to about a 90-degree angle, shins roughly parallel to the ground. | Curl your shoulder blades off the floor to engage your abs, keeping your neck relaxed and your chin slightly off your chest. | Rotate your torso to bring your right elbow toward your left knee while extending your right leg out straight. | Reverse the movement smoothly, returning to center as you switch sides. | Rotate to bring your left elbow toward your right knee while extending your left leg out straight. | Continue alternating sides in a controlled, pedaling rhythm, keeping your lower back down throughout. | Finish the set, then lower your feet and shoulders back to the floor under control.
tRu: Лягте на спину с поясницей, прижатой к полу, и руками, лёгкими положенными за голову, локтями, разведёнными в стороны. | Приподнимите обе стопы от пола и поднимите колени до угла примерно 90 градусов, голени примерно параллельны полу. | Поднимите лопатки с пола, чтобы напрячь мышцы пресса, сохраняя шею расслабленной и подбородок немного от груди. | Rotate your torso to bring your right elbow toward your left knee while extending your right leg out straight. | Reverse the movement smoothly, returning to center as you switch sides. | Rotate to bring your left elbow toward your right knee while extending your left leg out straight. | Продолжайте поочередно выполнять движения на разные стороны в контролируемом, педальном ритме, удерживая поясницу прижатой к полу на протяжении всего упражнения. | Завершите подход, затем с контролом опустите ноги и плечи обратно на пол.
tHe: Lie flat on your back with your lower back pressed into the floor and your hands resting lightly behind your head, elbows pointing out to the sides. | Lift both feet off the floor and raise your knees to about a 90-degree angle, shins roughly parallel to the ground. | קפוץ עם שכמותיך מהרצפה כדי להפעיל את שרירי הבטן, שמור על צווארך מרוגע ועל סנטרך קלוט מעט מהחזה. | Rotate your torso to bring your right elbow toward your left knee while extending your right leg out straight. | Reverse the movement smoothly, returning to center as you switch sides. | Rotate to bring your left elbow toward your right knee while extending your left leg out straight. | המשיל להחליף צדדים בקצב מדויק ופדלינג, תוך שמירה על גבך התחתון על הרצפה לכל אורך. | סיים את הסט, ואז הורד את הרגליים והכתפיים בחזרה לרצפה בשליטה.

t: Sit back into the reclined seat so your lower back is fully supported and the backrest is set at a comfortable angle. | Adjust the seat distance so that, with a foot on a pedal, your knee keeps a slight bend at full extension and never fully locks out. | Place your feet flat on the pedals and secure any foot straps so your feet stay centered throughout. | Rest your hands lightly on the side handles and keep your torso relaxed against the backrest. | Begin pedaling at an easy pace for two to three minutes to warm up, breathing steadily and evenly. | Settle into your target pace, keeping the pedal stroke smooth and continuous through the full circle rather than just pushing down. | Hold this conditioning pace for your planned duration, adjusting the machine resistance to keep your effort comfortable and sustainable. | Ease off into a slower pace for a few minutes to cool down, then bring the pedals to a stop and step off the machine.
tRu: Sit back into the reclined seat so your lower back is fully supported and the backrest is set at a comfortable angle. | Отрегулируйте расстояние до сиденья так, чтобы со стопой на педали колено сохраняло лёгкое сгибание в крайнем выпрямлении и никогда полностью не разгибалось. | Поставьте ноги на педали и закрепите ремни, чтобы стопы оставались по центру на протяжении всего движения. | Rest your hands lightly on the side handles and keep your torso relaxed against the backrest. | Начните крутить педали в лёгком темпе две-три минуты для разминки, дыша ровно и спокойно. | Settle into your target pace, keeping the pedal stroke smooth and continuous through the full circle rather than just pushing down. | Задержите этот темп тренировки на запланированное время, регулируя сопротивление тренажёра, чтобы поддерживать усилие комфортным и устойчивым. | Перейдите на более медленный темп на несколько минут для заминки, затем остановите педали и сойдите с тренажера.
tHe: Sit back into the reclined seat so your lower back is fully supported and the backrest is set at a comfortable angle. | כוון את מרחק המושב כך שעם כף רגל על הדוושה הברך תשמור על כיפוף קל בפשיטה מלאה ולעולם לא תינעל לגמרי. | Place your feet flat on the pedals and secure any foot straps so your feet stay centered throughout. | Rest your hands lightly on the side handles and keep your torso relaxed against the backrest. | התחל לדווש בקצב קל במשך שתיים עד שלוש דקות לחימום, תוך נשימה סדירה ואחידה. | Settle into your target pace, keeping the pedal stroke smooth and continuous through the full circle rather than just pushing down. | Hold this conditioning pace for your planned duration, adjusting the machine resistance to keep your effort comfortable and sustainable. | הפחת מהמאמץ לקצב איטי יותר למספר דקות כדי להתקרר, אז עצור את הדוושים וירד מהמכונה.

t: Stand tall with your feet about shoulder-width apart, knees soft and core lightly braced. | Raise both arms out to the sides at roughly shoulder height, palms facing forward to pre-open the chest. | Keeping your hips facing forward and feet planted, slowly rotate your torso and arms to one side through a large, controlled arc. | Turn as far as feels comfortable until you feel a gentle stretch across the chest, front of the shoulder, and upper back. | Hold the end position for 15–30 seconds, breathing slowly and keeping your shoulders down away from your ears. | Return smoothly to the center without jerking or bouncing. | Repeat the rotation to the opposite side and hold for the same duration. | Complete 2–3 controlled holds per side, then relax your arms and stand tall to finish.
tRu: Stand tall with your feet about shoulder-width apart, knees soft and core lightly braced. | Raise both arms out to the sides at roughly shoulder height, palms facing forward to pre-open the chest. | Держа бёдра направленными вперёд и стопами на полу, медленно поворачивайте корпус и руки в одну сторону по большой, контролируемой дуге. | Turn as far as feels comfortable until you feel a gentle stretch across the chest, front of the shoulder, and upper back. | Зафиксируйте конечное положение на 15–30 секунд, дыша медленно и удерживая плечи опущенными,远离 ушей. | Return smoothly to the center without jerking or bouncing. | Repeat the rotation to the opposite side and hold for the same duration. | Выполните 2–3 контролируемых удержания на каждую сторону, затем расслабьте руки и выпрямитесь для завершения.

t: Start on all fours with your hands stacked under your shoulders and your knees under your hips, arms and thighs vertical. | Set a neutral spine and brace your core, drawing your belly button gently toward your spine without rounding or arching your back. | Spread your fingers and press the floor away to keep your shoulders stable and your torso level like a tabletop. | Slowly extend your right arm straight forward and your left leg straight back until both are in line with your torso. | Reach actively through your fingertips and heel, keeping your hips and shoulders square to the floor without letting either side dip or twist. | Hold the extended position for two to three seconds while breathing steadily and keeping the core braced. | Return the hand and knee to the start under control, then repeat on the opposite side with your left arm and right leg. | Continue alternating sides for your target reps, then lower back to the all-fours position to finish.

t: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders, feet about hip-width apart, and your body in a straight line from head to heels. | Brace your core and squeeze your glutes so your hips stay level and your spine is neutral. | Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows to about a 45° angle from your torso, keeping your body rigid. | Press back up through your palms until your arms are fully extended, returning to the plank position. | Without rotating your hips, extend your right arm straight forward and your left leg straight back until both are level with your torso. | Hold the bird-dog extension briefly, keeping your shoulders and hips square to the floor. | Return your hand and foot to the start, perform another push-up, then extend the opposite arm and leg. | Continue alternating sides for your target reps, then lower your knees to finish.

nE: Bird of Paradise Pose Svarga Dvijasana
nH: תנוחת ציפור גן עדן סווארגה דוויג'אסאנה
t: Warm up first with hip openers and hamstring stretches, then begin in a bound extended side-angle pose with your front knee bent and one arm wrapped under the front thigh to clasp the other hand behind your back. | Keeping the bind, walk your back foot in toward the front foot so your weight shifts onto your front (standing) leg. | Square your hips forward and begin to stand upright, drawing the bound leg in close to your chest as you rise. | Press firmly through the standing foot and engage your core to find your balance before going further. | Slowly straighten the bound leg, extending it up and out to the side as far as your hamstring flexibility allows. | Lift through the crown of your head, open your chest, and fix your gaze on a still point to steady the balance. | Hold the pose for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and evenly without forcing the lifted leg straight. | To exit, re-bend the lifted knee, lower the foot back to the floor under control, release the bind, and repeat on the other side.

t: Lie face-down on a mat with your legs straight, the tops of your feet on the floor, and your forehead resting down. | Extend your arms out in front of you, palms down, and draw your shoulder blades gently down your back. | Brace your core lightly and press your hips into the mat to protect your lower back. | On an exhale, lift your chest, arms, and legs off the floor at the same time so your body forms a shallow boat-like arch. | Raise only as high as feels comfortable, keeping your neck long and your gaze toward the floor. | Feel the stretch along the front of your hips, thighs, and stomach, and hold while breathing steadily for 15–30 seconds. | Lower your chest, arms, and legs back to the mat with control and relax fully before repeating.
tRu: Лягте на живот на коврик с прямыми ногами, верхними сторонами стоп на полу и лбом, лежащим на полу. | Вытяните руки перед собой, ладонями вниз, и плавно опустите лопатки вдоль спины. | Легко напрягите пресс и прижмите бёдра к коврику для защиты поясницы. | На выдохе одновременно поднимите грудь, руки и ноги от пола, чтобы тело образовало неглубокую арку в форме лодочки. | Raise only as high as feels comfortable, keeping your neck long and your gaze toward the floor. | Почувствуйте растяжку по передней части бёдер, живота и бёдер, и удерживайте положение с ровным дыханием в течение 15–30 секунд. | Под контролем опустите грудь, руки и ноги обратно на коврик и полностью расслабьтесь перед повторением.
tHe: Lie face-down on a mat with your legs straight, the tops of your feet on the floor, and your forehead resting down. | פשוט את ידיך קדימה, כפות ידיים למטה, ומשוך את שקעי הכתף בעדינה לאורך הגב. | הדק קלות את הליבה ולחץ את האגן למזרן כדי להגן על הגב התחתון. | On an exhale, lift your chest, arms, and legs off the floor at the same time so your body forms a shallow boat-like arch. | Raise only as high as feels comfortable, keeping your neck long and your gaze toward the floor. | הרגיש את המתיחה לאורך חזית הירכיים, הירכיים והבטן, והחזק תוך נשימה יציבה למשך 15–30 שניות. | Lower your chest, arms, and legs back to the mat with control and relax fully before repeating.

t: Stand tall with your feet roughly hip-width apart and your weight balanced evenly across both feet. | Brace your midsection gently and tuck your tailbone slightly under to protect your lower back before you extend. | Reach your arms overhead and inhale as you lengthen up through your spine. | Exhale and ease into a gentle backward extension, opening through the chest, waist, and front of the hips. | Press your hips slightly forward to feel a stretch along the hip flexors and the front of your thighs. | Hold the lengthened position and breathe slowly, letting the stretch deepen a little with each exhale. | Keep the movement smooth and avoid bouncing or forcing the range. | Inhale as you return to standing tall, then relax and repeat for the desired number of holds.

t: Set up in a forearm plank: elbows under your shoulders, forearms flat, and your toes on sliders, a towel, or a smooth floor. | Brace your core, squeeze your glutes, and form a straight line from your heels through your hips to your head with a neutral spine. | Press your forearms into the floor and engage your lats and serratus to lock the shoulders in place. | Slowly slide your body backward by pushing through your forearms, letting your shoulders move behind your elbows. | Pause briefly at the end of the range, keeping your hips level and your core tight against the pull of extension. | Pull your body forward to return to the start, drawing your shoulders back over your elbows under control. | Move in a slow, deliberate rhythm, exhaling as you saw forward and keeping the motion small and smooth. | Repeat for your target reps or time, then lower your knees to the floor to finish.

t: Start in a low support position with your forearms or hands on a stable surface and your upper body lowered, elbows bent and tucked close to your sides. | Brace your core and keep your back flat so your torso and hips move as one unit. | Press firmly through your hands, driving your body upward by extending your elbows. | Keep your elbows tracking back rather than flaring wide as you push. | Continue pressing until your arms are nearly fully extended and your chest and shoulders are lifted. | Pause briefly at the top with your triceps fully engaged, without locking out aggressively. | Lower under control by bending your elbows back to the bottom support position. | Complete your reps, then lower fully and rest.

nR: Присед со скамьёй с собственным весом
t: Set a sturdy bench behind you and stand in front of it with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointed slightly out. | Stand close enough that the bench is just behind your heels, with your weight balanced over your midfoot. | Brace your core, keep your chest up, and extend your arms in front of you for balance. | Push your hips back and bend your knees, lowering under control until your glutes lightly touch the bench. | Pause briefly on the bench without fully sitting down or relaxing, keeping tension in your thighs. | Drive through your heels and stand back up, squeezing your glutes at the top until your hips and knees are fully extended. | Repeat for your target reps, keeping each rep smooth and controlled.

nE: Bodyweight Bent Over Rear Delt Fly
nR: Разводка на заднюю дельту в наклоне с собственным весом
nH: פרפר דלתא אחורית בכפיפה במשקל גוף
t: Stand with your feet about hip-width apart and a soft bend in your knees. | Hinge forward at the hips, pushing your hips back until your torso is close to parallel with the floor, and keep your back flat. | Let your arms hang straight down beneath your shoulders with your palms facing each other and a slight, fixed bend in your elbows. | Brace your core and keep your neck in line with your spine, looking at the floor a short distance ahead. | Raise both arms out to the sides in a wide arc until they reach roughly shoulder height, leading with your elbows. | Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top and pause briefly, keeping your arms in line with your torso rather than swinging them back. | Lower your arms slowly under control back to the starting position without letting them simply drop. | Complete your reps, then stand up by driving your hips forward to finish.
tRu: Встаньте, поставив ноги примерно на ширине бёдер, колени слегка согнуты. | Отводите бёдра вперёд, отталкивая бёдра назад, пока ваш торс не окажется почти параллельно полу, и сохраняйте спину плоской. | Пусть ваши руки выпрямлены и свисают под плечами с ладонями, обращенными друг к другу, и небольшим, зафиксированным сгибанием в локтях. | Напрягите корпус и держите шею на одной линии с позвоночником, глядя в пол на небольшом расстоянии впереди. | Raise both arms out to the sides in a wide arc until they reach roughly shoulder height, leading with your elbows. | Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top and pause briefly, keeping your arms in line with your torso rather than swinging them back. | Медленно опустите руки обратно в исходное положение, не давая им просто упасть. | Выполните все повторения, затем встаньте, отводя бёдры вперёд, чтобы завершить.
tHe: עמוד עם רגליים בערך ברוחב האגן וכיפוף קל בברכיים. | כופף קדימה בציר הירכיים, תוך דחיפת הירכיים לאחור עד שהגו קרוב למקביל לרצפה, ושמור על גב שטוח. | Let your arms hang straight down beneath your shoulders with your palms facing each other and a slight, fixed bend in your elbows. | הדק את הליבה ושמור על הצוואר בקו אחד עם עמוד השדרה, תוך מבט לרצפה במרחק קצר קדימה. | Raise both arms out to the sides in a wide arc until they reach roughly shoulder height, leading with your elbows. | Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top and pause briefly, keeping your arms in line with your torso rather than swinging them back. | Lower your arms slowly under control back to the starting position without letting them simply drop. | בצע את כל החזרות, ואקום על ידי דחיפת האגן קדימה כדי לסיים.

nR: Доброе утро в Б-стойке с собственным весом

t: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, then slide one foot back so its toes line up roughly with the heel of your front foot. | Keep the front foot flat and plant most of your weight through it; let the rear foot rest lightly on its toes as a kickstand for balance only. | Place your hands behind your head or cross them over your chest, and brace your core to set a neutral spine. | Soften the knee of your front leg slightly and keep that soft bend fixed for the whole rep. | Push your hips straight back as if closing a door behind you, hinging at the hip while keeping your back flat and chest proud. | Lower your torso until you feel a strong stretch in the hamstring of the front leg, stopping before your lower back rounds. | Drive your hips forward and squeeze the glute of the front leg to stand back up to a tall finish. | Complete all reps on one side, then switch the stance and repeat with the other leg leading.

t: Set up a stable, low raised surface — a wedge, weight plate, or board about 1–2 inches high — and stand with the balls of your feet on the floor and your heels resting on the surface. | Position your feet about shoulder-width apart with your toes pointing slightly out, and stand tall with your chest up and arms reaching forward for balance. | Brace your core, take a breath, and pull your shoulders back to set a tall, stable torso. | Sit straight down by bending your knees and hips together, keeping your torso upright and your heels pressed into the raised surface. | Let your knees travel forward and track in line over your toes as you descend to at least thigh-parallel or as deep as you can control. | Keep your weight balanced over your midfoot and your chest lifted at the bottom, avoiding any rounding of the lower back. | Drive up through your whole foot, extending your knees and hips together until you return to a tall standing position. | Exhale near the top, reset your brace, and repeat for the desired number of reps.

nR: Фронтальный присед с приподнятой пяткой с собственным весом
nH: סקוואט קדמי בעקב מוגבה במשקל גוף

t: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes turned slightly out, and your arms ready to swing or held loosely in front of you. | Brace your core and pull your shoulders back, keeping your chest tall and your weight over your midfoot. | Lower into the squat slowly, taking about three to four seconds to descend as you push your hips back and bend your knees. | Continue until your thighs reach at least parallel, keeping your knees tracking in line with your toes and your heels flat. | Pause briefly at the bottom without losing tension in your hips and legs. | Drive up explosively through your heels and midfoot, extending your hips and knees as fast as you can — let your heels leave the floor or jump if that matches your intent. | Land softly with bent knees and absorb the impact, then reset your stance before the next rep.

nE: Bodyweight Standing Around World Wall Supported
nR: Круги стоя у стены с собственным весом
nH: מסביב לעולם בעמידה בתמיכת קיר במשקל גוף
