t: Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart, knees slightly soft, and your core braced. | Let your arms hang at your sides with your palms facing forward and your elbows close to your torso. | Begin the rep by curling toward your shoulders, leading with your biceps and keeping your upper arms fairly fixed. | When you reach the sticking point partway up, add a brief, controlled dip and drive of the hips to help the rep continue moving upward. | Finish the curl at the top by squeezing your biceps hard, with your forearms close to your upper arms. | Lower under full control over 2–3 seconds, resisting the descent and keeping your biceps loaded the entire way down. | Return to a full hang, reset your posture, and repeat for your target reps. | Stop the set when your lowering phase becomes uncontrolled rather than chasing extra reps with bigger swings.
tRu: Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart, knees slightly soft, and your core braced. | Пусть ваши руки свободно свисают по боками с ладонями, обращенными вперед, и локтями, близкими к корпусу. | Начните повторение со сгибания к плечам, ведя движение бицепсами и удерживая плечи почти неподвижными. | When you reach the sticking point partway up, add a brief, controlled dip and drive of the hips to help the rep continue moving upward. | Завершите сгибание в верхней точке, сильно сжимая бицепсы, предплечья близко к плечам. | Опустите под полным контролём в течение 2–3 секунд, сопротивляясь опусканию и сохраняя бицепсы напряжёнными на протяжении всего движения вниз. | Return to a full hang, reset your posture, and repeat for your target reps. | Stop the set when your lowering phase becomes uncontrolled rather than chasing extra reps with bigger swings.
tHe: Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart, knees slightly soft, and your core braced. | Let your arms hang at your sides with your palms facing forward and your elbows close to your torso. | התחל את החזרה בכפיפה לכיוון הכתפיים, בהובלת הדו-ראשי תוך שמירה על זרועות עליונות כמעט קבועות. | When you reach the sticking point partway up, add a brief, controlled dip and drive of the hips to help the rep continue moving upward. | סיים את הכפיפה בשיא בכיווץ חזק של הביצפס, עם האמות קרובות לזרועות העליונות. | Lower under full control over 2–3 seconds, resisting the descent and keeping your biceps loaded the entire way down. | Return to a full hang, reset your posture, and repeat for your target reps. | Stop the set when your lowering phase becomes uncontrolled rather than chasing extra reps with bigger swings.

nE: Chest and Front of Shoulder Stretch
t: Stand tall in a doorway or beside a wall, feet about hip-width apart, with your core gently braced and shoulders relaxed. | Raise one arm to roughly shoulder height and bend the elbow to about 90 degrees, placing your forearm flat against the door frame or wall. | Step the foot on the same side forward to create a stable, balanced stance. | Slowly turn your chest and torso away from the anchored arm until you feel a gentle stretch across the front of your chest and shoulder. | Keep your shoulder down and away from your ear, and avoid letting your lower back arch. | Hold the position for 20 to 30 seconds, breathing slowly and evenly without bouncing. | Ease out of the stretch, lower the arm, and switch sides to stretch the other shoulder. | Repeat for 2 to 3 holds per side, easing slightly deeper only as the tissue relaxes.
tRu: Stand tall in a doorway or beside a wall, feet about hip-width apart, with your core gently braced and shoulders relaxed. | Raise one arm to roughly shoulder height and bend the elbow to about 90 degrees, placing your forearm flat against the door frame or wall. | Step the foot on the same side forward to create a stable, balanced stance. | Slowly turn your chest and torso away from the anchored arm until you feel a gentle stretch across the front of your chest and shoulder. | Держите плечо опущенным и вдали от уха и избегайте прогиба в пояснице. | Задержите позицию в течение 20–30 секунд, дыша медленно и ровно, не делая рывков. | Постепенно выйдите из растяжки, опустите руку и поменяйте стороны, чтобы растянуть другое плечо. | Repeat for 2 to 3 holds per side, easing slightly deeper only as the tissue relaxes.

t: Lie flat on the bench with your eyes directly under the bar. tHe: שכב על הגב עם ברכיים כפופות וכפות רגליים שטוחות על הרצפה, ברוחב האגן. | הנח את הידיים קלות מאחורי הראש או שלב אותן על החזה, תוך שמירה על מרפקים פתוחים. | הדק את הבטן ונשוף כשאתה מכופף את הראש, הכתפיים והחזה מהרצפה. | בעלייה, סובב את הגו בחלקות לצד אחד, בהובלת הכתף ולא המרפק. | Pause briefly at the top of the rotation, feeling the contraction along the side of your waist. | Inhale and lower your torso back to the floor under control, returning to a neutral, centered position. | Repeat the lift and rotate to the opposite side, alternating evenly for the desired number of reps.

t: Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart, knees soft, and your core gently braced. | Reach both arms behind your back and clasp your hands together at the base of your spine. | Pull your shoulder blades down and back, squeezing them toward each other. | Push your chest forward and up so you feel a stretch across the front of your chest and shoulders. | Straighten your arms behind you and lift your clasped hands slightly to deepen the chest opening. | Keep your chin level and your ribs from flaring out as you hold the position. | Breathe slowly and hold the stretched, chest-out position for your target time. | Lower your hands, release the clasp, and relax your shoulders to finish.
tRu: Встаньте прямо, поставив ноги примерно на ширине бёдер, колени мягкие, мягко напрягите корпус. | Reach both arms behind your back and clasp your hands together at the base of your spine. | Pull your shoulder blades down and back, squeezing them toward each other. | Push your chest forward and up so you feel a stretch across the front of your chest and shoulders. | Straighten your arms behind you and lift your clasped hands slightly to deepen the chest opening. | Держите подбородок на уровне и не позволяйте ребрам выпирать, когда вы удерживаете позицию. | Дышите медленно и позвольте окружающим мышцам расслабиться в течение 20–30 секунд, когда начальное напряжение начинает ослабевать. | Опустите руки, разожмите ладони и расслабьте плечи, чтобы завершить упражнение.
tHe: עמוד זקוף עם רגליים בערך ברוחב האגן, ברכיים רכות, והליבה בעדינות מכווצת. | Reach both arms behind your back and clasp your hands together at the base of your spine. | Pull your shoulder blades down and back, squeezing them toward each other. | Push your chest forward and up so you feel a stretch across the front of your chest and shoulders. | Straighten your arms behind you and lift your clasped hands slightly to deepen the chest opening. | Keep your chin level and your ribs from flaring out as you hold the position. | נשם לאט והחזק את התנוחה המתוחה, חזה קדימה, למשך זמן המטרה שלך. | Lower your hands, release the clasp, and relax your shoulders to finish.

t: Set up in a high plank with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width, fingers spread, and your body in a straight line from head to heels. | Brace your core and squeeze your glutes so your hips do not sag or pike up. | Lower your chest toward the floor under control, keeping your elbows tucked at roughly a 45° angle to your torso. | Press explosively through your palms so your hands leave the ground at the top of the rep. | As you push off, shift your weight onto one arm and quickly tap your opposite hand to your chest or front shoulder. | Return the tapping hand to the floor and absorb the landing softly with both arms, bending the elbows to cushion the impact. | Reset into a stable plank, then repeat, alternating which hand taps on each rep. | Complete your reps, then lower your knees to the floor and rest.
tRu: Set up in a high plank with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width, fingers spread, and your body in a straight line from head to heels. | Напрягите корпус и сожмите ягодицы, чтобы бёдра не провисали и не поднимались вверх. | Подконтрольно опустите грудь к полу, удерживая локти прижатыми под углом примерно 45° к корпусу. | Press explosively through your palms so your hands leave the ground at the top of the rep. | Отталкиваясь, перенесите вес на одну руку и быстро коснитесь противоположной рукой груди или переднего плеча. | Return the tapping hand to the floor and absorb the landing softly with both arms, bending the elbows to cushion the impact. | Reset into a stable plank, then repeat, alternating which hand taps on each rep. | Выполните все повторения, затем опустите колени на пол и отдохните.
tHe: Set up in a high plank with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width, fingers spread, and your body in a straight line from head to heels. | הדק את הליבה וכווץ את הישבנים כך שהאגן לא ישמוט ולא יתרומם. | הורד את החזה לכיוון הרצפה בשליטה, תוך שמירה על מרפקים צמודים בזווית של כ-45° לגוף. | Press explosively through your palms so your hands leave the ground at the top of the rep. | בדחיפה, העבר משקל לזרוע אחת וטפח במהירות ביד הנגדית על החזה או הכתף הקדמית. | Return the tapping hand to the floor and absorb the landing softly with both arms, bending the elbows to cushion the impact. | Reset into a stable plank, then repeat, alternating which hand taps on each rep. | בצע את כל החזרות, ואז הורד את הברכיים לרצפה ונוח.

t: Kneel on a mat with your knees roughly hip-width apart and the tops of your feet flat on the floor, big toes touching behind you. | Sit your hips back onto your heels and lengthen your spine, keeping the back of your neck long. | Fold forward from the hips, walking your hands out in front of you and lowering your torso toward the floor. | Rest your forehead lightly on the mat and let your chest sink toward your thighs. | Extend your arms forward with palms down to stretch the shoulders, or lay them alongside your body with palms up to relax them. | Breathe slowly and deeply into your back and ribs, letting your hips settle a little closer to your heels with each exhale. | Hold the pose for 30 seconds to a few minutes, staying relaxed and still. | To come out, walk your hands back toward your knees and slowly rise to a tall kneeling position.
tRu: Встаньте на колени на коврике, колени примерно на ширине бедер, верхняя часть стоп flat на полу, большие пальцы ног соприкасаются сзади. | Sit your hips back onto your heels and lengthen your spine, keeping the back of your neck long. | Наклонитесь вперёд из бёдер, вытягивая руки перед собой и опуская корпус к полу. | Rest your forehead lightly on the mat and let your chest sink toward your thighs. | Вытяните руки вперёд ладонями вниз для растяжки плеч, или положите их вдоль тела ладонями вверх, чтобы расслабить их. | Дышите медленно и глубоко, позволяя мышцам задней поверхности бедра поднятой ноги еще больше расслабиться в растяжке с каждым выдохом. | Задержите позу в течение 30 секунд до нескольких минут, оставаясь расслабленным и неподвижным. | To come out, walk your hands back toward your knees and slowly rise to a tall kneeling position.
tHe: Kneel on a mat with your knees roughly hip-width apart and the tops of your feet flat on the floor, big toes touching behind you. | Sit your hips back onto your heels and lengthen your spine, keeping the back of your neck long. | כופף קדימה מהירכיים, הלך בידיים קדימה והורד את הגו לכיוון הרצפה. | Rest your forehead lightly on the mat and let your chest sink toward your thighs. | פשוט את ידיך קדימה עם כפות ידיים למטה כדי למתוח את הכתפיים, או שכב אותם לצד גופך עם כפות ידיים למעלה כדי להרגיע אותם. | נשיר לאט ועמוק לתוך הגב והצלעות, מאפשר לירכיים להתיישב קצת יותר קרוב לעקבים עם כל נשימה. | Hold the pose for 30 seconds to a few minutes, staying relaxed and still. | To come out, walk your hands back toward your knees and slowly rise to a tall kneeling position.

t: Start on all fours with your knees under your hips and your hands under your shoulders on a mat. | Sink back into Child's Pose: send your hips toward your heels, lower your chest between your thighs, and stretch your arms forward as you exhale. | Pause in Child's Pose for one full breath, feeling the stretch through your back, hips, and shoulders. | On an inhale, glide your chest forward and low to the floor, sliding past your hands until you lie face down with legs extended behind you. | Press lightly through your hands and lift your chest into Cobra Pose, keeping your elbows soft and your shoulders drawn down away from your ears. | Hold Cobra for one breath, lengthening your spine and opening your chest without crunching your lower back. | Exhale and reverse the motion, pushing your hips back over your knees to return to Child's Pose. | Continue flowing between the two poses, moving with your breath for the desired number of rounds, then rest in a neutral position.
tRu: Start on all fours with your knees under your hips and your hands under your shoulders on a mat. | Sink back into Child's Pose: send your hips toward your heels, lower your chest between your thighs, and stretch your arms forward as you exhale. | Пауза в позе ребёнка на один полный вдох, почувствуйте растяжение в спине, бёдрах и плечах. | На вдохе продвиньте грудь вперед и вниз к полу, скользя мимо рук, пока не ляжете животом на пол с ногами, вытянутыми назад. | Press lightly through your hands and lift your chest into Cobra Pose, keeping your elbows soft and your shoulders drawn down away from your ears. | Держите каждую гирю за ручку с прочным хватом сверху, основание гири лежит на задней части предплечья. Ваши верхние руки лежат на полу, локти примерно под углом 45 градусов к корпусу. | Выдыхайте и выполните движение в обратном направлении, отводя таз назад через колени, чтобы вернуться в Позицию Ребенка. | Продолжайте плавно переходить между двумя позами, двигаясь в унисон с дыханием в течение заданного количества кругов, затем расслабьтесь в нейтральной позе.
tHe: Start on all fours with your knees under your hips and your hands under your shoulders on a mat. | Sink back into Child's Pose: send your hips toward your heels, lower your chest between your thighs, and stretch your arms forward as you exhale. | Pause in Child's Pose for one full breath, feeling the stretch through your back, hips, and shoulders. | On an inhale, glide your chest forward and low to the floor, sliding past your hands until you lie face down with legs extended behind you. | Press lightly through your hands and lift your chest into Cobra Pose, keeping your elbows soft and your shoulders drawn down away from your ears. | Hold Cobra for one breath, lengthening your spine and opening your chest without crunching your lower back. | נשוף והפכו את התנועה, דחפו את האגן אחורה מעל הברכים כדי לחזור לתנוחת הילד. | המשך לעבור בין שתי התנוחות, זז בהרמוניה עם הנשימה עבור מספר הסטים הרצוי, ואז הירגע בתנוחה נייטרלית.

t: Set up two sturdy, stable benches roughly a body-length apart and check that neither will slide before you load them. | Sit between them and place your upper back and the tops of your shoulders on one bench, with the back of your head supported or relaxed neutral. | Rest your heels on the second bench, legs straight, so your body is suspended over the gap. | Brace your core, squeeze your glutes, and lift your hips until your body forms one straight line from shoulders to heels. | Hold this rigid position, breathing steadily, without letting your hips sag toward the floor or pike upward. | Keep your neck neutral and avoid arching your lower back or pushing your chin up to overextend. | Hold for your target time, then lower your hips under control and sit back down between the benches to finish.
tRu: Set up two sturdy, stable benches roughly a body-length apart and check that neither will slide before you load them. | Sit between them and place your upper back and the tops of your shoulders on one bench, with the back of your head supported or relaxed neutral. | Rest your heels on the second bench, legs straight, so your body is suspended over the gap. | Напрягите корпус, сожмите ягодицы и поднимите бёдра, пока ваше тело не образует одну прямую линию от плеч до пяток. | Удерживайте это жесткое положение, дыша ровно, не давая бедрам провисать к полу или подниматься вверх. | Держите шею нейтральной и избегайте прогиба в пояснице или запрокидывания подбородка для чрезмерного разгибания. | Удерживайте заданное время, затем плавно опустите таз и сядьте между скамьями для завершения.
tHe: Set up two sturdy, stable benches roughly a body-length apart and check that neither will slide before you load them. | Sit between them and place your upper back and the tops of your shoulders on one bench, with the back of your head supported or relaxed neutral. | Rest your heels on the second bench, legs straight, so your body is suspended over the gap. | תכווץ את שרירי הליבה, כווץ את השרירים הגלוטיאליים, והרם את הירכיים עד שהגוך ייצור קו ישר אחד מהכתפיים עד העקבים. | Hold this rigid position, breathing steadily, without letting your hips sag toward the floor or pike upward. | Keep your neck neutral and avoid arching your lower back or pushing your chin up to overextend. | Hold for your target time, then lower your hips under control and sit back down between the benches to finish.

t: Sit or stand tall with your spine long, shoulders relaxed and down, and your gaze straight ahead. | Take a slow breath in, then exhale and gently nod your head forward, lowering your chin toward your chest. | Let the weight of your head do the work — avoid pulling or forcing — until you feel a light, comfortable stretch along the back of your neck. | Keep your shoulders relaxed and your jaw loose so the stretch stays in the neck and upper spine. | Hold the position for 15–30 seconds, breathing slowly and evenly throughout. | To deepen it slightly, you may rest your fingertips lightly on the back of your head, but never pull hard. | Slowly raise your head back to a neutral, upright position to finish. | Repeat for 2–3 gentle holds, easing off the moment you feel any pinching or pain.
tRu: Sit or stand tall with your spine long, shoulders relaxed and down, and your gaze straight ahead. | Take a slow breath in, then exhale and gently nod your head forward, lowering your chin toward your chest. | Дайте весу вашей головы выполнять работу — избегайте тяги или принуждения — пока вы не почувствуете лёгкое, комфортное растяжение по задней части шеи. | Держите плечи расслабленными и челюстью расслабленной, чтобы растяжка ощущалась в шее и верхней части спины. | Задержите позицию в течение 15–30 секунд, дыша медленно и ровно на протяжении всего времени. | To deepen it slightly, you may rest your fingertips lightly on the back of your head, but never pull hard. | Slowly raise your head back to a neutral, upright position to finish. | Repeat for 2–3 gentle holds, easing off the moment you feel any pinching or pain.

t: Sit or stand tall with your spine neutral, shoulders relaxed down, and your gaze level with the horizon. | Without tilting your head up or down, slowly draw your chin straight back, as if making a double chin. | Imagine sliding your whole head backward over your shoulders, keeping your eyes and jaw level the entire time. | Stop at the point of a gentle stretch at the base of the skull and a mild contraction at the front of the neck, without forcing the range. | Hold the retracted position for 3 to 5 seconds, breathing normally. | Release slowly and return your head to the neutral starting position under control. | Repeat for your target reps, keeping every movement smooth and free of jerking.
tRu: Sit or stand tall with your spine neutral, shoulders relaxed down, and your gaze level with the horizon. | Without tilting your head up or down, slowly draw your chin straight back, as if making a double chin. | Представьте, что ваша голова скользит назад за плечи, сохраняя глаза и челюсть на уровне всё это время. | Stop at the point of a gentle stretch at the base of the skull and a mild contraction at the front of the neck, without forcing the range. | Держите зафиксированное положение в течение 3-5 секунд, дыша нормально. | Release slowly and return your head to the neutral starting position under control. | Repeat for your target reps, keeping every movement smooth and free of jerking.
tHe: Sit or stand tall with your spine neutral, shoulders relaxed down, and your gaze level with the horizon. | Without tilting your head up or down, slowly draw your chin straight back, as if making a double chin. | Imagine sliding your whole head backward over your shoulders, keeping your eyes and jaw level the entire time. | Stop at the point of a gentle stretch at the base of the skull and a mild contraction at the front of the neck, without forcing the range. | Hold the retracted position for 3 to 5 seconds, breathing normally. | Release slowly and return your head to the neutral starting position under control. | Repeat for your target reps, keeping every movement smooth and free of jerking.

t: Grip the pull-up bar with an underhand (supinated) grip about shoulder-width apart, wrapping your thumbs around the bar. | Hang from the bar with your arms fully extended, shoulders engaged, and core braced to limit swinging. | Pull yourself up by driving your elbows down and back, leading with your chest toward the bar. | Continue pulling past the normal top position, raising your chin and head up and over the bar. | Tilt your head slightly back as you clear the bar, keeping your neck relaxed and your shoulders stable. | Pause briefly at the top with the bar below your chin, staying in control. | Lower yourself slowly and under control until your arms are fully extended again. | Reset your hang, then repeat for reps before dropping off the bar safely.
tRu: Возьмитесь за перекладину для подтягиваний хватом снизу (supinated) на расстоянии примерно ширины плеч, обхватив большие пальцы вокруг перекладины. | Повисните на перекладине с полностью выпрямленными руками, плечи задействованы и корпус напряжен, чтобы ограничить раскачивание. | Pull yourself up by driving your elbows down and back, leading with your chest toward the bar. | Продолжайте тянуть за обычную верхнюю точку, поднимая подбородок и голову вверх и через штангу. | Tilt your head slightly back as you clear the bar, keeping your neck relaxed and your shoulders stable. | Задержитесь на мгновение в верхней точке со штангой подбородка, сохраняя контроль. | Опуститесь медленно и под контролем до полного выпрямления рук. | Reset your hang, then repeat for reps before dropping off the bar safely.
tHe: אחוז במוט המשיכה באחיזה מלמטה (סופינציה) ברוחב הכתפיים בקירוב, תוך עטיפת האגודלים סביב המוט. | תלה מהמוט עם זרועות פשוטות לגמרי, כתפיים מופעלות וליבה מהודקת כדי להגביל ניפוף. | Pull yourself up by driving your elbows down and back, leading with your chest toward the bar. | המשך למשוך מעבר לנקודת הסיום הרגילה, והרם את הסנטר והראש מעל המוט. | Tilt your head slightly back as you clear the bar, keeping your neck relaxed and your shoulders stable. | Pause briefly at the top with the bar below your chin, staying in control. | Lower yourself slowly and under control until your arms are fully extended again. | Reset your hang, then repeat for reps before dropping off the bar safely.

t: Set a bar at about chest height — a power-rack pin, Smith bar, or low fixed bar works. | Sit into a squat directly under the bar and take an underhand (supinated) grip about shoulder-width apart. | Brace your core, keep your chest up, and let your arms extend so your weight hangs partly from the bar. | Pull your chest toward the bar by driving your elbows down and back, squeezing your back muscles at the top. | Press lightly through your legs only as much as needed to complete each rep cleanly. | Pause briefly with your chin near or above the bar, keeping your shoulders down away from your ears. | Lower yourself under control back into the squat until your arms are fully extended. | Repeat for your target reps, then stand up and step away from the bar.
tRu: Set a bar at about chest height — a power-rack pin, Smith bar, or low fixed bar works. | Sit into a squat directly under the bar and take an underhand (supinated) grip about shoulder-width apart. | Напрягите корпус, держите грудь вверх и выпрямите руки, чтобы вес частично висел на перекладине. | Pull your chest toward the bar by driving your elbows down and back, squeezing your back muscles at the top. | Press lightly through your legs only as much as needed to complete each rep cleanly. | Задержитесь на мгновение с подбородком рядом или над перекладиной, удерживая плечи вниз,远离 ушей. | Опуститесь под контролем обратно в приседание до полного выпрямления рук. | Repeat for your target reps, then stand up and step away from the bar.
tHe: Set a bar at about chest height — a power-rack pin, Smith bar, or low fixed bar works. | Sit into a squat directly under the bar and take an underhand (supinated) grip about shoulder-width apart. | הדק את הליבה, שמור על חזה מורם ותן לידיים להתיישר כך שהמשקל נתלה חלקית מהמוט. | Pull your chest toward the bar by driving your elbows down and back, squeezing your back muscles at the top. | Press lightly through your legs only as much as needed to complete each rep cleanly. | Pause briefly with your chin near or above the bar, keeping your shoulders down away from your ears. | Lower yourself under control back into the squat until your arms are fully extended. | Repeat for your target reps, then stand up and step away from the bar.

t: Grip a pull-up bar with an underhand (supinated) grip, hands roughly shoulder-width apart and thumbs wrapped around the bar. | Use a box, a controlled jump, or a partner's help to get your chin up over the bar so your elbows are fully bent. | Hold this top position with your chin above the bar, chest up and shoulder blades pulled down and back — squeeze hard and brace your core. | Maintain the isometric hold for 3–10 seconds, keeping your elbows tucked and your body from swinging. | Begin the negative by slowly straightening your arms, lowering yourself under full control over 3–5 seconds. | Keep tension in your lats and upper back the whole way down, resisting gravity rather than dropping. | Finish with your arms fully extended in a dead hang, then step back onto the box and reset. | Repeat for the planned reps, then drop off the bar safely with control.
tRu: Возьмитесь за перекладину для подтягиваний снизу (супинацией), руки примерно на ширине плеч и большие пальцы обхватывают перекладину. | Use a box, a controlled jump, or a partner's help to get your chin up over the bar so your elbows are fully bent. | Удерживайте это верхнее положение, подбородок над перекладиной, грудь поднята, лопатки опущены и сведены назад — сильно сожмите мышцы и напрягите корпус. | Задержитесь в статическом положении в течение 3-10 секунд, держа локти прижатыми и не давая телу раскачиваться. | Начните негативную фазу с медленного выпрямления рук, опускаясь полностью подконтрольно за 3–5 секунд. | Сохраняйте напряжение в широчайших мышцах и верхней части спины на всем протяжении движения вниз, сопротивляясь гравитации, а не просто опускаясь. | Завершите с полностью выпрямленными руками в висе, затем шагните на платформу и повторите. | Repeat for the planned reps, then drop off the bar safely with control.
tHe: אחוז במוט משיכה באחיזה מלמטה (סופינציה), הידיים ברוחב הכתפיים בקירוב והאגודלים עוטפים את המוט. | Use a box, a controlled jump, or a partner's help to get your chin up over the bar so your elbows are fully bent. | Hold this top position with your chin above the bar, chest up and shoulder blades pulled down and back — squeeze hard and brace your core. | Maintain the isometric hold for 3–10 seconds, keeping your elbows tucked and your body from swinging. | התחל את הירידה האקסצנטרית ביישור איטי של הזרועות, והורד את עצמך בשליטה מלאה במשך 3–5 שניות. | Keep tension in your lats and upper back the whole way down, resisting gravity rather than dropping. | סיים עם הזרועות פשוטות לגמרי בתלייה חופשית, ואז עלה בחזרה על התיבה והתאפס. | Repeat for the planned reps, then drop off the bar safely with control.

t: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart, core braced and knees soft. | Raise both arms out to your sides until they are level with your shoulders, forming a straight line from fingertip to fingertip. | Keep your elbows extended and your palms facing down, with shoulders relaxed and away from your ears. | Begin drawing small forward circles with both arms, moving from the shoulders rather than the elbows. | Gradually widen the circles, keeping the motion smooth and controlled with no momentum or swinging. | Continue forward circles for the set time or rep count, breathing steadily throughout. | Reverse direction and draw circles backward for an equal duration to work the muscles evenly. | Lower your arms slowly to your sides to finish and rest the shoulders.

t: Stand an arm's length from a wall and place a stability ball against it at about shoulder height. | Press one palm flat into the ball so it stays pinned to the wall, with your arm nearly straight and elbow soft. | Set your shoulder down and back, and brace your core so your torso stays still. | Keeping steady pressure on the ball, draw a slow, controlled circle with your hand, moving the ball through a smooth path on the wall. | Complete your reps in one direction, then reverse and trace circles the other way. | Switch arms and repeat, keeping the same constant pressure and tempo throughout. | Finish by easing off the ball and lowering your arm under control.

t: Stand or jump up to reach the first bar and take a firm overhand grip with both hands, wrapping your thumbs around the bar. | Hang from the bar with your arms extended, letting your shoulders settle into an active, slightly engaged position rather than hanging fully loose. | Brace your core and avoid excessive swinging so your body stays under control before you move. | Reach one hand forward to the next bar while the other hand keeps you supported, then close your grip on the new bar. | Release the trailing hand and swing it forward to the following bar, moving hand-over-hand in a steady rhythm. | Use a small, controlled body swing to carry momentum between bars, timing each reach with the swing. | Continue traveling along the bars to the end of the structure, keeping your grip secure on each rung. | Lower yourself under control or drop to the ground with bent knees to absorb the landing.

t: Stand tall with your feet about shoulder-width apart and cup your hands together at chest height, elbows tucked, as if cradling a goblet against your sternum. | Brace your core, keep your chest up, and squat straight down at the 12 o'clock (neutral) position until your thighs are roughly parallel to the floor. | Drive through your mid-foot to stand back up, keeping your hands fixed at your chest throughout. | Step your lead foot out toward the 3 o'clock position to widen and angle your stance, then squat down and return to standing. | Reset to center, then step toward the 6 o'clock position (a longer stance) and perform another controlled squat. | Reset again and step toward the 9 o'clock position to mirror the 3 o'clock angle, squatting and standing with control. | Return your feet to center to complete one full clock circuit, keeping your torso upright the whole time. | Repeat the circuit for your target reps, then lower your hands and stand tall to finish.

t: Set up in a high plank with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width, fingers forward, and your body in a straight line from head to heels. | Brace your core and squeeze your glutes so your hips neither sag nor pike up. | Bend your elbows and lower your chest toward the floor, keeping your elbows at roughly a 45° angle to your torso. | Press back up to full arm extension to complete one push-up at the 12 o'clock position. | Keeping one hand planted as the pivot, step the other hand a short arc clockwise to the next clock position, resetting into a solid plank. | Perform another full push-up at the new angle, then walk the hand to the next position and repeat. | Continue around the clock until you complete the circle, then reverse direction or rest. | Lower your knees to finish the set and shake out your wrists and shoulders.

t: Lie face down on a mat with your legs extended and the tops of your feet pressing into the floor. | Place your hands flat under your shoulders, fingers spread and pointing forward, with your elbows tucked close to your ribs. | Press the tops of your feet, thighs, and pubic bone into the mat, and gently engage your glutes to support your lower back. | Inhale and slowly straighten your arms, lifting your head and chest off the floor while keeping your hips grounded. | Draw your shoulders down and back, opening the chest, and lengthen through the crown of your head without crunching the neck. | Keep a slight bend in the elbows and only lift as high as feels comfortable in your lower back. | Hold the stretch for 15–30 seconds, breathing slowly and evenly throughout. | Exhale and lower your chest, forehead, and head back to the mat with control to release the pose.

t: Lie flat on your back on a mat with your legs extended and your arms reaching overhead on the floor. | Brace your abs and press your lower back gently into the floor to remove the gap. | In one smooth motion, curl your knees toward your chest while crunching your head and shoulders up off the mat. | Reach your hands toward your shins or knees as you tuck into a tight cocoon position, exhaling fully. | Pause briefly at the top, feeling the squeeze through your abs and hip flexors. | Reverse under control, lowering your shoulders and extending your legs back out long without letting your feet or upper back slam down. | Hover your legs and arms just above the floor at full extension to keep tension, then begin the next rep.

t: Stand under the bar so it runs front-to-back relative to your shoulders, then grip it with both hands in line with the bar, palms facing each other, one hand in front of the other a few inches apart. | Hang with your arms fully extended, brace your core, and pull your shoulder blades down to set your back. | Pull yourself up and slightly toward one side, leading with the hand in front so your head clears past that side of the bar. | Continue until your shoulder or collarbone reaches bar height on that side, keeping your obliques tight to control the lean. | Lower under control back to a full dead hang with your arms straight. | Repeat the pull-up to the opposite side, passing your head past the other side of the bar. | Alternate sides each rep, keeping movement smooth, until you complete your set, then lower to a dead hang and step down.

t: Sit on the end of a bench with your feet planted wide and hold a dumbbell in one hand with an underhand (supinated) grip. | Lean forward slightly from the hips and brace the back of that arm's upper elbow against the inside of the same-side thigh. | Let the dumbbell hang straight down with your arm fully extended, keeping a small bend so the elbow stays loaded. | Curl the dumbbell up toward your shoulder by flexing only at the elbow, squeezing the biceps as you rise. | Pause briefly at the top with the biceps fully contracted, keeping your upper arm pinned against your thigh. | Lower the dumbbell under control back to the start, resisting the weight through the full range of motion. | Complete all reps on one arm, then switch the dumbbell to the other hand and repeat.

t: Set out your cones (or any small markers) in the pattern you want to run — common layouts are a straight line, an L-shape, or three cones spaced 5 yards apart. | Start in an athletic stance at the first cone: feet shoulder-width apart, knees bent, weight on the balls of your feet, and hips low. | Drive off explosively toward the next cone, keeping your steps short and quick rather than long and floaty. | As you reach each cone, drop your hips and decelerate under control, planting your outside foot to change direction. | Push off the planted foot to accelerate toward the next marker, staying low through the turn. | Pump your arms in rhythm with your legs to drive speed and keep your balance through each cut. | Complete the full pattern at a controlled but brisk pace, touching or rounding each cone as your layout requires. | Walk back to the start to recover, then repeat for the planned number of runs.

t: Stand facing an open corner, a doorway, or a flat wall, about one stride away from it. | Raise your forearms and place them flat against the surfaces, with your elbows bent roughly 90 degrees and at about shoulder height. | Step one foot forward into a short staggered stance and set your feet for stable balance. | Keeping your chest tall and your spine neutral, slowly lean your body forward until you feel a gentle stretch across your chest and the front of your shoulders. | Stop at the point of mild tension, not pain, and keep your shoulders down away from your ears. | Breathe slowly and hold the stretch for 20 to 30 seconds. | Ease back to the starting position under control, reset, and repeat for 2 to 3 rounds.

t: Stand next to a wall or open doorway, side-on, with your feet about hip-width apart. | Raise the arm closest to the wall to roughly shoulder height and bend the elbow to 90°, like a goal-post. | Place your forearm and palm flat against the wall, keeping the elbow level with your shoulder. | Step the inside foot forward slightly to create a stable, staggered base. | Slowly rotate your chest and torso away from the wall until you feel a comfortable stretch across the front of the chest and shoulder. | Keep your shoulder pulled down and back, your chest tall, and breathe steadily as you hold the position for 20–30 seconds. | Gently rotate back to release the stretch, lower the arm, and turn to face the other way. | Repeat the stretch on the opposite side, matching the time and intensity.

t: Lie flat on your back with your arms by your sides, palms down, and legs extended. | Brace your abdominals and roll your legs up and overhead until your toes reach toward the floor behind your head, supporting your weight on your shoulders and upper back. | Reach your hands back to lightly hold one ankle or shin for stability, keeping your neck long and relaxed. | Lengthen your top leg straight up toward the ceiling, squeezing the glute and hamstring to control the lift. | Switch legs smoothly, lowering the raised leg overhead as you reach the other leg to the ceiling, keeping your hips steady. | Continue alternating legs in a slow, controlled scissor-like rhythm, breathing evenly throughout. | To finish, bring both legs together overhead, then roll your spine down to the mat one vertebra at a time and lower your legs with control.
