tHe: Set two flat benches a little narrower than shoulder-width apart, leaving a gap between them for your head to pass through. | Place a hand on each bench just outside shoulder-width, then walk your feet up onto a third bench, box, or wall behind you. | Raise your hips high so your torso is nearly vertical and your hips are stacked over your shoulders in an inverted-V pike position. | הדק את הליבה ושמור על רגליים ישרות, כשהראש, האגן והידיים יוצרים קו הדוק. | כופף את המרפקים כדי להוריד את הראש למטה בין הספסלים, תן לו לרדת מתחת לגובה הידיים בשליטה. | Pause briefly when your head dips below your hands, keeping your forearms roughly vertical and elbows tracking slightly forward. | Press back up by extending your arms until your elbows lock out and you return to the full pike position. | בצע את כל החזרות, ואז הורד את רגליך לרצפה וקום בשליטה.

nH: שכיבות סמיכה בשיפוע שלילי מול קיר
t: Stand facing away from a wall and place your hands on the floor slightly wider than shoulder-width, fingers pointing forward. | Walk your feet up the wall one at a time until your body forms a straight, downward-sloping line with your hips higher than your shoulders. | Brace your core and squeeze your glutes so your torso stays rigid from head to heels, with your hands set a little ahead of your shoulders. | Bend your elbows and lower your chest toward the floor under control, keeping your elbows tucked at roughly a 45° angle to your torso. | Lower until your chest is just above the floor, keeping your neck neutral and your gaze a little ahead of your hands. | Press firmly through your palms to push your body back up until your arms are fully extended. | Complete your reps, then walk your feet back down the wall and return to standing under control.
tRu: Stand facing away from a wall and place your hands on the floor slightly wider than shoulder-width, fingers pointing forward. | Walk your feet up the wall one at a time until your body forms a straight, downward-sloping line with your hips higher than your shoulders. | Напрягите корпус и сожмите ягодицы, чтобы корпус оставался жёстким от головы до пяток, удерживая кисти чуть впереди плеч. | Согните локти и подконтрольно опустите грудь к полу, удерживая локти прижатыми под углом примерно 45° к корпусу. | Опустите, пока ваша грудь не оказалась прямо над полом, сохраняя шею нейтральной и взгляд немного перед руками. | Press firmly through your palms to push your body back up until your arms are fully extended. | Выполните свои повторения, затем отойдите ногами вниз по стене и вернитесь в положение стоя под контролем.
tHe: Stand facing away from a wall and place your hands on the floor slightly wider than shoulder-width, fingers pointing forward. | Walk your feet up the wall one at a time until your body forms a straight, downward-sloping line with your hips higher than your shoulders. | הדק את הליבה וכווץ את הישבנים כך שהגוף יישאר נוקשה מהראש עד העקבים, כשהידיים ממוקמות מעט לפני הכתפיים. | כופף את המרפקים והורד את החזה לכיוון הרצפה בשליטה, תוך שמירה על מרפקים צמודים בזווית של כ-45° לגוף. | Lower until your chest is just above the floor, keeping your neck neutral and your gaze a little ahead of your hands. | Press firmly through your palms to push your body back up until your arms are fully extended. | בצע את כל החזרות, ואז הורד את רגליך באיטיות במורד הקיר וחזור לעמידה בשליטה.

t: Kneel in front of a low bench or sturdy platform and place the tops of your feet up on it behind you. | Walk your hands forward and set them on the floor slightly wider than shoulder-width, fingers pointing forward. | Straighten your body from knees to head so your hips and torso form one line, with your shoulders stacked over your hands. | Brace your core and pull your shoulder blades down and together to set a stable pressing base. | Bend your elbows and lower your chest toward the floor under control, keeping your elbows at roughly a 45° angle to your torso. | Lower until your chest is just above the floor, keeping your neck neutral and your hips from sagging. | Press through your palms to push your body back up until your arms are fully extended. | Complete your reps, then lower your knees and step your feet down to finish.
tRu: Встаньте на колени перед низкой скамьей или sturdy platform и поместите верхнюю часть стоп на нее сзади. | Walk your hands forward and set them on the floor slightly wider than shoulder-width, fingers pointing forward. | Straighten your body from knees to head so your hips and torso form one line, with your shoulders stacked over your hands. | Напрягите корпус и опустите лопатки вниз, сведя их вместе, чтобы создать устойчивую опору для жима. | Согните локти и подконтрольно опустите грудь к полу, удерживая локти под углом примерно 45° к корпусу. | Опустите, пока ваша грудь не оказалась прямо над полом, сохраняя шею нейтральной и не давая тазу провисать. | Отожмитесь ладонями и поднимите тело вверх, пока руки полностью не выпрямятся. | Выполните все повторения, затем опустите колени и поставьте ноги для завершения.
tHe: Kneel in front of a low bench or sturdy platform and place the tops of your feet up on it behind you. | Walk your hands forward and set them on the floor slightly wider than shoulder-width, fingers pointing forward. | Straighten your body from knees to head so your hips and torso form one line, with your shoulders stacked over your hands. | הדק את הליבה ומשוך את השכמות למטה וזו לזו כדי ליצור בסיס לחיצה יציב. | כופף את המרפקים והורד את החזה לכיוון הרצפה בשליטה, תוך שמירה על מרפקים בזווית של כ-45° לגוף. | Lower until your chest is just above the floor, keeping your neck neutral and your hips from sagging. | לחץ דרך כפות הידיים כדי לדחוף את הגוף חזרה למעלה עד שהידיים ישרות לגמרי. | בצע את כל החזרות, ואז הורד את הברכיים וצעד עם הרגליים למטה כדי לסיים.

nH: שכיבות סמיכה בשיפוע שלילי (על כדור פיזיו)
t: Place a stability ball on the floor and kneel in front of it with your hands planted on the ground, slightly wider than shoulder-width. | Walk your hands forward and rest the tops of your feet or your shins on the ball so your body forms a straight line from head to heels. | Brace your core and squeeze your glutes to keep your hips level and stop them from sagging or piking. | Lower your chest toward the floor under control, keeping your elbows tucked at roughly a 45° angle to your torso. | Stop when your chest is just above the floor, keeping your neck neutral and your gaze slightly ahead. | Press back up through your palms until your arms are fully extended, keeping the ball steady throughout. | Complete your reps, then carefully walk your hands back and lower your feet off the ball.
tRu: Поставьте мяч для стабилизации на пол и kneel in front of it with your hands planted on the ground, slightly wider than shoulder-width. | Walk your hands forward and rest the tops of your feet or your shins on the ball so your body forms a straight line from head to heels. | Напрягите корпус и сожмите ягодицы, чтобы удерживать бёдра на одном уровне и не давать им провисать или подниматься вверх. | Подконтрольно опустите грудь к полу, удерживая локти прижатыми под углом примерно 45° к корпусу. | Stop when your chest is just above the floor, keeping your neck neutral and your gaze slightly ahead. | Press back up through your palms until your arms are fully extended, keeping the ball steady throughout. | Выполните все повторения, затем осторожно передвигайте руки назад и опустите ноги с мяча.
tHe: Place a stability ball on the floor and kneel in front of it with your hands planted on the ground, slightly wider than shoulder-width. | Walk your hands forward and rest the tops of your feet or your shins on the ball so your body forms a straight line from head to heels. | הדק את הליבה וכווץ את הישבנים כדי לשמור על אגן מאוזן ולמנוע שמיטה או התרוממות. | הורד את החזה לכיוון הרצפה בשליטה, תוך שמירה על מרפקים צמודים בזווית של כ-45° לגוף. | Stop when your chest is just above the floor, keeping your neck neutral and your gaze slightly ahead. | Press back up through your palms until your arms are fully extended, keeping the ball steady throughout. | בצע את כל החזרות, ואז הוביל את ידיך אחורה בזהירות והורד את רגליך מהכדור.

t: Set your hands on the floor slightly wider than shoulder-width and place your feet on a bench or box behind you, forming a decline plank with your body in a straight line. | Spread your fingers, stack your shoulders over your wrists, and brace your abs so your hips don't sag or pike. | Squeeze your glutes and set your feet about hip-width apart for a stable base. | Lift one hand off the floor and tap it to the opposite shoulder while pressing firmly through the supporting arm. | Keep your hips level and resist any twisting as you return the hand to the floor under control. | Repeat with the other hand, tapping it to the opposite shoulder. | Continue alternating hands at a slow, even tempo for the full set, keeping your torso square throughout. | Finish by returning both hands to the floor, then step your feet down off the bench.
tRu: Set your hands on the floor slightly wider than shoulder-width and place your feet on a bench or box behind you, forming a decline plank with your body in a straight line. | Spread your fingers, stack your shoulders over your wrists, and brace your abs so your hips don't sag or pike. | Squeeze your glutes and set your feet about hip-width apart for a stable base. | Приподнимите одну руку от пола и коснитесь её противоположного плеча, плотно опираясь на опорную руку. | Держите бёдра на одном уровне и сопротивляйтесь любому скручиванию, когда вы контролируратно возвращаете руку на пол. | Repeat with the other hand, tapping it to the opposite shoulder. | Продолжайте поочерёдно работать руками в медленном, равномерном темпе на протяжении всего подхода, удерживая корпус развёрнутым вперёд. | Завершите упражнение, вернув обе руки на пол, затем поставьте ноги со скамьи.
tHe: Set your hands on the floor slightly wider than shoulder-width and place your feet on a bench or box behind you, forming a decline plank with your body in a straight line. | Spread your fingers, stack your shoulders over your wrists, and brace your abs so your hips don't sag or pike. | Squeeze your glutes and set your feet about hip-width apart for a stable base. | Lift one hand off the floor and tap it to the opposite shoulder while pressing firmly through the supporting arm. | Keep your hips level and resist any twisting as you return the hand to the floor under control. | Repeat with the other hand, tapping it to the opposite shoulder. | המשילו להחליף ידיים בקצא איטי ואחיד לכל אורך הסט, שומרים על הגוף ישר לאורך כל התרגיל. | סיים בהחזרת שתי הידיים לרצפה, ואז הורד את הרגליים מהספסל.

nR: Сит-ап и русские скручивания на наклонной
t: Set the bench to a moderate decline and hook your feet securely under the foot pads or roller so your lower body stays anchored. | Lie back with your knees bent, keeping a slight bend rather than letting your spine fully extend over the end of the bench. | Cross your arms over your chest or hold your hands near your chest, and brace your abs to start the rep. | Curl your torso up by contracting your abs, lifting your shoulders and back off the bench until your upper body is at roughly an upright sit-up position. | At the top, hold the elevated position and rotate your torso to one side, leading with your shoulders rather than just swinging your arms. | Rotate back through center and twist to the opposite side to complete one full Russian twist. | Return to center, then lower your torso back down to the bench under control, resisting the descent with your abs. | Repeat for your target reps, then sit up and unhook your feet to finish.
tRu: Set the bench to a moderate decline and hook your feet securely under the foot pads or roller so your lower body stays anchored. | Лягте на спину, согнув колени, сохраняя небольшой сгиб, а не позволяя позвоночнику полностью выгибаться за пределами скамьи. | Перекрестите руки на груди или держите руки у груди, и напрягите пресс для начала повторения. | Поднимите корпус, сокращая мышцы пресса, поднимая плечи и спину со скамьи, пока верхняя часть тела не окажется в положении полусидя. | Вверху удерживайте поднятое положение и поверните корпус в сторону, ведя плечами, а не просто махая руками. | Rotate back through center and twist to the opposite side to complete one full Russian twist. | Return to center, then lower your torso back down to the bench under control, resisting the descent with your abs. | Repeat for your target reps, then sit up and unhook your feet to finish.
tHe: Set the bench to a moderate decline and hook your feet securely under the foot pads or roller so your lower body stays anchored. | Lie back with your knees bent, keeping a slight bend rather than letting your spine fully extend over the end of the bench. | חצה את ידיך מעל החזה שלך או החזיק אותן קרוב לחזה, ותגבש את הבטן כדי להתחיל את החזרה. | קפוץ את גופך למעלה על ידי התכווצות שרירי הבטן, הרם את הכתפיים והגב מהספסל עד שפלג גופך העליון בזווית של כמו עמידה זקופה בשכיבה. | בשיא החזק את המיקום המורם וסובב את פלג הגוף לצד אחד, תוך הובלה עם הכתפיים ולא רק הנפת הידיים. | Rotate back through center and twist to the opposite side to complete one full Russian twist. | Return to center, then lower your torso back down to the bench under control, resisting the descent with your abs. | Repeat for your target reps, then sit up and unhook your feet to finish.

t: Set the bench to a moderate decline and hook your feet securely under the foot pads or roller. | Lie back with your lower back and hips on the pad, then extend your arms straight out, reaching toward your knees or holding them overhead. | Brace your core and exhale as you curl your torso up, leading with your chest and keeping your arms straight throughout. | Continue lifting until your torso is upright or near vertical, keeping the movement controlled rather than swinging. | Pause briefly at the top while keeping tension on your abs. | Inhale and lower your torso back down under control until your shoulders lightly touch the bench. | Repeat for your target reps, then sit up and carefully unhook your feet to dismount.
tRu: Set the bench to a moderate decline and hook your feet securely under the foot pads or roller. | Лягте на спину, поясница и бёдра на опоре, затем выпрямите руки прямо, тянущихся к коленям или удерживая их над головой. | Напрягите корпус и на выдохе поднимите корпус вверх, начиная движение грудью и удерживая руки прямыми в течение всего движения. | Продолжайте поднимать, пока ваш корпус не станет прямым или почти вертикальным, сохраняя контроль над движением, а не раскачивая корпус. | На мгновение остановитесь в верхней точке, сохраняя напряжение на мышцах пресса. | Выдохните и опустите корпус обратно вниз под контролем, пока плечи не слегка коснутся скамьи. | Repeat for your target reps, then sit up and carefully unhook your feet to dismount.
tHe: Set the bench to a moderate decline and hook your feet securely under the foot pads or roller. | Lie back with your lower back and hips on the pad, then extend your arms straight out, reaching toward your knees or holding them overhead. | הדק את הליבה ונשוף כשאתה מכופף את הגוף למעלה, עם החזה מוביל ותוך שמירה על ידיים ישרות לאורך כל התנועה. | המשך להרים עד שהגוף זקוף או כמעט אנכי, שומר על תנועה מבוקרת ולא מתנדנדת. | Pause briefly at the top while keeping tension on your abs. | Inhale and lower your torso back down under control until your shoulders lightly touch the bench. | Repeat for your target reps, then sit up and carefully unhook your feet to dismount.

t: Set the decline bench to a moderate angle and hook your feet securely under the foot pads or roller at the high end. | Lie back with your knees bent and your lower back flat against the bench, then cross your arms over your chest or place your fingertips lightly at the sides of your head. | Brace your core and tuck your chin slightly toward your chest to start the movement. | Curl your torso up by contracting your abs, rolling your spine off the bench one segment at a time until you are sitting upright. | Squeeze your abdominals at the top without yanking on your neck or rounding forward into your thighs. | Lower yourself back down under control, resisting gravity until your upper back and shoulders return to the bench. | Stop just short of fully relaxing to keep tension on your abs, then begin the next rep. | Complete your reps, then carefully unhook your feet and sit up to dismount the bench.
tRu: Set the decline bench to a moderate angle and hook your feet securely under the foot pads or roller at the high end. | Лягте на спину, согните колени и прижмите поясницу к скамье, затем скрестите руки на груди или lightly положите пальцы по бокам головы. | Напрягите пресс и слегка прижмите подбородок к груди для начала движения. | Поднимите корпус, сокращая мышцы пресса, сворачивая позвоночник со скамьи сегмент за сегментом, пока не сядете прямо. | Squeeze your abdominals at the top without yanking on your neck or rounding forward into your thighs. | Опуститесь обратно вниз под контролем, сопротивляясь силе тяжести, пока ваша верхняя часть спины и плечи не вернутся на скамью. | Stop just short of fully relaxing to keep tension on your abs, then begin the next rep. | Выполните все повторения, затем осторожно отсоедините ноги и сядьте, чтобы сойти со скамьи.
tHe: Set the decline bench to a moderate angle and hook your feet securely under the foot pads or roller at the high end. | Lie back with your knees bent and your lower back flat against the bench, then cross your arms over your chest or place your fingertips lightly at the sides of your head. | הדק את הליבה ואסוף קלות את הסנטר לכיוון החזה כדי להתחיל את התנועה. | קפוץ את גופך למעלה על ידי התכווצות שרירי הבטן, הגלגל את עמוד השדרה שלך מהספסל חוליה אחר חוליה עד שאתה יושב זקוף. | Squeeze your abdominals at the top without yanking on your neck or rounding forward into your thighs. | Lower yourself back down under control, resisting gravity until your upper back and shoulders return to the bench. | Stop just short of fully relaxing to keep tension on your abs, then begin the next rep. | בצע את כל החזרות, ואז הסר את רגליך מהגומייה בזהירות וישב כדי לרדת מהספסל.

t: Set a decline bench to a moderate angle and hook your feet securely under the foot pads or roller at the high end. | Lie back so your torso runs down the bench, then place your fingertips lightly at the sides of your head with your elbows pointing out. | Brace your core and exhale as you curl your torso up off the bench, leading with your shoulders rather than yanking on your neck. | As you reach the top of the sit-up, rotate your torso to bring one elbow toward the opposite knee. | Pause briefly at the top with your abs fully contracted, feeling the obliques on the twisting side. | Untwist back to center and lower your torso slowly under control until your back returns toward the bench. | Repeat the curl, alternating the direction of the twist on each rep so both sides are worked evenly. | Finish your set, then sit up, release your feet, and step off the bench carefully.
tRu: Set a decline bench to a moderate angle and hook your feet securely under the foot pads or roller at the high end. | Лягте на спину так, чтобы туловище лежало вдоль скамьи, затем lightly положите пальцы по бокам головы, локтями в стороны. | Напрягите корпус и на выдохе поднимите корпус от скамьи, начиная движение плечами, а не тягой за шею. | В верхней точке подъёма корпуса разверните торс, потянув один локоть к противоположному колену. | Задержитесь на мгновение в верхней точке с полностью сокращёнными мышцами живота, ощущая косые мышцы на стороне скручивания. | Untwist back to center and lower your torso slowly under control until your back returns toward the bench. | Repeat the curl, alternating the direction of the twist on each rep so both sides are worked evenly. | Завершите подход, затем сядьте, снимите ноги и сойдите со скамьи.
tHe: Set a decline bench to a moderate angle and hook your feet securely under the foot pads or roller at the high end. | Lie back so your torso runs down the bench, then place your fingertips lightly at the sides of your head with your elbows pointing out. | הדק את הליבה ונשוף כשאתה מכופף את הגוף למעלה מהספסל, עם הכתפיים מובילות ולא במשיכה בצוואר. | בהגעה לשיא כפיפות הבטן, סובב את הגו כדי לקרב מרפק אחד לעבר הברך הנגדית. | Pause briefly at the top with your abs fully contracted, feeling the obliques on the twisting side. | Untwist back to center and lower your torso slowly under control until your back returns toward the bench. | Repeat the curl, alternating the direction of the twist on each rep so both sides are worked evenly. | סיים את הסט, ואז שב, שחרר את הרגליים ורד מהספסל בזהירות.

t: Stand tall with your feet about shoulder-width apart and your toes pointed slightly out. | Brace your core, lift your chest, and keep your gaze forward. | Bend your knees and push your hips back and down, keeping your weight balanced over your mid-foot. | Lower under control as far as you comfortably can, ideally until your hips drop below your knees. | Pause briefly at the bottom while keeping your torso upright and your heels down. | Drive through your feet to extend your knees and hips and return to a tall standing position. | Repeat for your target reps, keeping each rep smooth and controlled.

nR: Глубокий выпад в растяжку задней поверхности

t: Set up two parallel bars or parallettes slightly wider than shoulder-width and grip them firmly with a neutral grip, palms facing each other. | Walk or jump your feet back into a high plank so your body forms a straight line from head to heels, arms fully extended over the bars. | Brace your core and squeeze your glutes to lock your hips and avoid sagging or piking. | Bend your elbows and lower your chest between the bars, letting it sink below hand level until you feel a stretch across the chest. | Keep your elbows tracking back at roughly a 45° angle to your torso rather than flaring straight out to the sides. | Pause briefly at the bottom without resting your weight on the bars, keeping tension on the chest. | Press through your palms and drive your chest back up until your arms are fully extended again. | Complete your reps, then step your feet forward and release the bars under control.

t: Set up between sturdy parallel or dip bars, gripping one bar in each hand with your palms facing inward. | Press down through your hands to lift your feet off the floor, supporting your full bodyweight with your arms straight and locked. | Relax your shoulders and let them rise up toward your ears, allowing your body to sink slightly between the bars. | Feel the gentle stretch and decompression across the tops of your shoulders and your upper back. | Now actively depress your shoulders — pull your shoulder blades down and away from your ears without bending your elbows. | Hold the depressed position for 2–3 seconds, keeping your chest tall and your neck long. | Breathe slowly and cycle between the relaxed (shrugged) and the depressed position for the desired time. | Lower your feet gently back to the floor to finish, then step off the bars under control.

t: Set a sturdy box roughly knee-height (around 30–45 cm to start) and stand on top of it with your toes near the front edge. | Step off the box — don't jump up or out — and let both feet drop straight down toward the floor. | Land on the balls of your feet with knees and hips slightly bent, absorbing the impact in a soft, athletic stance. | As soon as your feet touch down, reverse the movement and drive up into a maximal vertical jump. | Swing your arms upward as you extend your hips, knees, and ankles to add height to the jump. | Land softly from the jump with bent knees, reset your balance, and step back onto the box for the next rep.

tHe: Sit or stand tall with a long spine, shoulders relaxed and pulled down away from your ears. | Let your right arm hang or rest at your side to anchor the shoulder you want to stretch. | Slowly drop your chin toward your chest, then rotate your head slightly so it angles down toward your left armpit (a diagonal forward tilt). | Place your left hand lightly on the back of your head and let its weight — not force — deepen the stretch. | Hold the position for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and keeping your shoulders down. | הרגיש משיכה עדינה לאורך הצד האחורי-ימני של הצוואר ואל הכתף העליונה. | Release by slowly lifting your head back to a neutral, upright position. | Repeat on the opposite side, angling your head down toward your right armpit.

t: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, chest up, and hands relaxed at your sides or clasped in front of your chest for balance. | Brace your core and step one foot out and forward on a diagonal, at roughly a 45° angle from straight ahead. | Plant the lead foot flat and bend both knees to lower your hips, keeping your front knee tracking over your toes. | Descend until your front thigh is about parallel to the floor and your back knee drops toward the ground, keeping your torso tall. | Drive through the heel and midfoot of your lead leg to push back up and return to the starting position. | Repeat for your target reps, then switch and step out on the diagonal with the other leg. | Finish standing tall with both feet together and your core still braced.
tRu: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, chest up, and hands relaxed at your sides or clasped in front of your chest for balance. | Напрягите пресс и шагните одной ногой вперёд по диагонали под углом примерно 45°. | Поставьте переднюю ногу на пол и согните оба колена, опуская бёдра, удерживая переднее колено над носками. | Опускайтесь, пока переднее бедро окажется примерно параллельно полу или настолько глубоко, насколько позволяет ваша подвижность, сохраняя бутылки по бокам. | Отталкивайтесь от пятки и средней части стопы ведущей ноги, чтобы вернуться в исходное положение. | Repeat for your target reps, then switch and step out on the diagonal with the other leg. | Завершите в стойке прямо со стопами вместе и напряжённым корпусом.
tHe: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, chest up, and hands relaxed at your sides or clasped in front of your chest for balance. | הדק את הליבה וצע צעד אחד החוצה וקדימה באלכסון, בזווית של כ-45° ישר קדימה. | Plant the lead foot flat and bend both knees to lower your hips, keeping your front knee tracking over your toes. | רד עד שהירך הקדמית מקבילה לרצפה והברך האחורית יורדת לכיוון הרצפה, שמור על גוף זקוף. | דחוף דרך העקב וכף הרגל המובילה כדי לחזור למצב ההתחלתי. | Repeat for your target reps, then switch and step out on the diagonal with the other leg. | סיים בעמידה זקופה עם רגליים צמודות והליבה עדיין מכווצת.

t: Stand in an athletic stance with your feet roughly shoulder-width apart, knees soft, and weight on the balls of your feet. | Raise both fists to guard height beside your chin, elbows tucked in and core braced. | Drive your right fist forward and across your body on an upward diagonal toward your opposite shoulder line, rotating through your hips and trunk. | Pivot your right foot and turn your hips into the punch so the power comes from rotation, not just the arm. | Snap the fist back to guard along the same path, keeping your chin protected. | Repeat with your left fist on the mirror-image diagonal, rotating to the opposite side. | Alternate sides in a steady rhythm, staying light on your feet and breathing out with each punch. | Continue for the set time or rep count, then return to a relaxed guard to finish.
tRu: Stand in an athletic stance with your feet roughly shoulder-width apart, knees soft, and weight on the balls of your feet. | Raise both fists to guard height beside your chin, elbows tucked in and core braced. | Резмо двигайте правый кулак вперёд и по диагонали вверх к противоположному плечу, вращаясь через бёдра и корпус. | Поверните правую ногу и направьте бедра в удар, чтобы сила исходила от вращения, а не только от руки. | Snap the fist back to guard along the same path, keeping your chin protected. | Repeat with your left fist on the mirror-image diagonal, rotating to the opposite side. | Чередуйте стороны в ровном ритме, оставаясь легко на ногах и выдыхая на каждый удар. | Продолжайте в течение заданного расстояния или времени, затем плавно опустите пятки на пол, чтобы завершить.
tHe: Stand in an athletic stance with your feet roughly shoulder-width apart, knees soft, and weight on the balls of your feet. | Raise both fists to guard height beside your chin, elbows tucked in and core braced. | הנע את אגודל ימיך כלפי מעלה ואל עבר הגוף באלכסון עליון כלפי קו הכתף הנגדית, מסובב דרך הירכיים והגו. | Pivot your right foot and turn your hips into the punch so the power comes from rotation, not just the arm. | Snap the fist back to guard along the same path, keeping your chin protected. | Repeat with your left fist on the mirror-image diagonal, rotating to the opposite side. | החלף צדדים בקצב יציב, תוך שמירה על קלות בכפות הרגליים ונשיפה בכל אגרוף. | המשך למשך הזמן או מספר החזרות המוגדר, ואז חזור למצב הגנה מרוגע כדי לסיים.

t: Sit tall toward the front of a stable chair with your feet flat on the floor about hip-width apart. | Brace your core gently and lengthen your spine, keeping your shoulders relaxed and down. | Raise one arm overhead, then reach that hand diagonally down and across your body toward the outside of the opposite foot. | Let your torso rotate and flex slightly toward the reach, exhaling as you move and keeping the motion slow and controlled. | Pause briefly at the bottom, feeling the stretch and tension along the side of your waist. | Reverse the movement under control, returning your arm overhead and your torso upright as you inhale. | Complete your reps on one side, then switch arms and repeat the reach on the other side. | Finish seated and tall, releasing your brace once both sides are done.
tRu: Sit tall toward the front of a stable chair with your feet flat on the floor about hip-width apart. | Слегка напрягите пресс и вытяните позвоночник, удерживая плечи расслабленными и опущенными. | Raise one arm overhead, then reach that hand diagonally down and across your body toward the outside of the opposite foot. | Позвольте вашему корпусу слегка повернуться, следуя гире, сохраняя позвоночник нейтральным и мышцы кора напряженными — избегайте изгиба в талии. | На мгновение задержитесь внизу, чувствуя растяжение и напряжение по бокам талии. | Reverse the movement under control, returning your arm overhead and your torso upright as you inhale. | Выполните все повторения на одну сторону, затем поменяйте руки и повторите движение с другой стороны. | Завершите сидя прямо, ослабив напряжение, когда обе стороны будут выполнены.
tHe: Sit tall toward the front of a stable chair with your feet flat on the floor about hip-width apart. | הדק בעדינות את הליבה והארך את עמוד השדרה, תוך שמירה על כתפיים רפויות ומטה. | Raise one arm overhead, then reach that hand diagonally down and across your body toward the outside of the opposite foot. | Let your torso rotate and flex slightly toward the reach, exhaling as you move and keeping the motion slow and controlled. | Pause briefly at the bottom, feeling the stretch and tension along the side of your waist. | Reverse the movement under control, returning your arm overhead and your torso upright as you inhale. | בצע את כל החזרות בצד אחד, ואז החלף ידיים וחזור על המתיחה לצד השני. | סיים בישיבה זקופה, ושחרר את ההידוק לאחר סיום שני הצדדים.

t: Start in a high plank with your hands flat on the floor under your chest and your feet about hip-width apart. | Slide your hands together so your index fingers and thumbs touch, forming a diamond or triangle shape beneath your sternum. | Brace your core and squeeze your erector spinae to lock your hips, spine, and head into one straight line from heels to crown. | Bend your elbows and lower your chest toward your hands under control, keeping your elbows tracking close to your sides rather than flaring wide. | Lower until your chest lightly touches or nearly touches the back of your hands, keeping your back flat throughout. | Press back up by extending your elbows, driving through your palms until your arms are fully straight. | Keep your hips level and your spine neutral at the top, then repeat for your target reps. | Finish your final rep, lower your knees to the floor, and rest.
tRu: Start in a high plank with your hands flat on the floor under your chest and your feet about hip-width apart. | Slide your hands together so your index fingers and thumbs touch, forming a diamond or triangle shape beneath your sternum. | Напрягите корпус и напрягите разгибатели спины, чтобы зафиксировать бёдра, позвоночник и голову в одну прямую линию от пяток до макушки. | Согните локти и подконтрольно опустите грудь к кистям, удерживая локти близко к бокам и не разводя их широко. | Опустите, пока ваша грудь не коснулась или почти не коснулась тыльной стороны ваших рук, сохраняя спину плоской на протяжении всего движения. | Press back up by extending your elbows, driving through your palms until your arms are fully straight. | Держите бёдра на одном уровне и позвоночник нейтральным в верхней точке, затем повторите для целевого количества повторений. | Завершите последнее повторение, опустите колени на пол и отдохните.
tHe: Start in a high plank with your hands flat on the floor under your chest and your feet about hip-width apart. | Slide your hands together so your index fingers and thumbs touch, forming a diamond or triangle shape beneath your sternum. | הדק את הליבה וכווץ את זוקפי הגב כדי לנעול את האגן, עמוד השדרה והראש בקו ישר אחד מהעקבים עד הקודקוד. | כופף את המרפקים והורד את החזה לכיוון הידיים בשליטה, תוך שמירה על מרפקים צמודים לצדי הגוף ולא פתוחים לרווחה. | Lower until your chest lightly touches or nearly touches the back of your hands, keeping your back flat throughout. | Press back up by extending your elbows, driving through your palms until your arms are fully straight. | Keep your hips level and your spine neutral at the top, then repeat for your target reps. | סיים את החזרה האחרונה, הורד את הברכיים לרצפה ונח.

t: Kneel on the floor and place your hands under your chest, bringing your thumbs and index fingers together so they form a diamond or triangle shape. | Walk your knees back until your body forms a straight line from your head through your hips to your knees, and brace your core and glutes. | Keep your knees on the floor as the pivot point and lift your feet so your shins are off the ground. | Lower your chest toward your hands under control, keeping your elbows tucked close to your sides rather than flaring them out. | Bring your chest down until it lightly touches or nearly touches the back of your hands. | Press back up by extending your elbows, driving through your hands until your arms are fully straight. | Keep your hips level and your body in one line throughout, then complete your reps.
tRu: Встаньте на колени на полу и поставьте руки под грудью, bringing большие пальцы и указательные пальцы вместе, чтобы они образовали ромб или треугольник. | Walk your knees back until your body forms a straight line from your head through your hips to your knees, and brace your core and glutes. | Держите колени на полу в качестве точки опоры и поднимите стопы, чтобы голи были оторваны от земли. | Под контролем опустите грудь к рукам, сохраняя локти близко к бокам, а не разведенными в стороны. | Опустите грудь, пока она слегка коснется или почти коснется тыльной стороны рук. | Press back up by extending your elbows, driving through your hands until your arms are fully straight. | Держите бёдра на одном уровне и тело в одной линии на протяжении всего движения, затем завершите ваши повторения.
tHe: Kneel on the floor and place your hands under your chest, bringing your thumbs and index fingers together so they form a diamond or triangle shape. | Walk your knees back until your body forms a straight line from your head through your hips to your knees, and brace your core and glutes. | Keep your knees on the floor as the pivot point and lift your feet so your shins are off the ground. | Lower your chest toward your hands under control, keeping your elbows tucked close to your sides rather than flaring them out. | הורד את החזה עד שהוא נוגע קלות או כמעט נוגע בגב כף היד. | Press back up by extending your elbows, driving through your hands until your arms are fully straight. | Keep your hips level and your body in one line throughout, then complete your reps.

t: Set up at parallel bars or a dip station with a grip roughly shoulder-width apart and your palms facing in toward each other. | Mount the bars by pressing up to a fully locked-out support position, arms straight, shoulders down and away from your ears. | Brace your core and squeeze your glutes, keeping your torso upright or with a slight forward lean over the bars. | Bend your elbows and lower under control to your chosen hold position, stopping when your upper arms are roughly parallel to the floor. | Hold the position statically, keeping your shoulders packed down, elbows tracking back, and your whole body tight. | Breathe in a steady, shallow rhythm and maintain tension through the chest, shoulders, and triceps for the planned time. | When the set is done, press back up to lockout or step down to the floor under control to dismount.
tRu: Set up at parallel bars or a dip station with a grip roughly shoulder-width apart and your palms facing in toward each other. | Займите положение на брусьях, оттолкнувшись в полностью выпрямленное поддерживающее положение, руки прямые, плечи опущены и отведены от ушей. | Напрягите корпус и сожмите ягодицы, удерживая корпус вертикально или с лёгким наклоном вперёд над перекладинами. | Согните локти и подконтрольно опуститесь до выбранного положения, останавливаясь, когда плечи станут примерно параллельны полу. | Держите положение статически, удерживая плечи опущенными, локтями отведёнными назад, и всем телом напряжённым. | Дышите в устойчивом, поверхностном ритме и поддерживайте напряжение в груди, плечах и трицепсах в течение запланированного времени. | When the set is done, press back up to lockout or step down to the floor under control to dismount.
tHe: Set up at parallel bars or a dip station with a grip roughly shoulder-width apart and your palms facing in toward each other. | Mount the bars by pressing up to a fully locked-out support position, arms straight, shoulders down and away from your ears. | הדק את הליבה וכווץ את הישבנים, תוך שמירה על גוף זקוף או עם הישענות קלה קדימה מעל המוטות. | כופף את המרפקים ורד בשליטה לתנוחת ההחזקה שבחרת, עצור כשהזרועות העליונות בערך מקבילות לרצפה. | Hold the position statically, keeping your shoulders packed down, elbows tracking back, and your whole body tight. | נשור בקצב יציב ורדוד, ושמור על מתח בחזה, כתפיים וזרועות למשך הזמן המתוכנן. | When the set is done, press back up to lockout or step down to the floor under control to dismount.

t: Sit on the front edge of a sturdy chair and place your hands on the edge beside your hips, fingers pointing forward toward your feet. | Slide your hips off the chair so your weight is supported on your hands, keeping your arms fully extended. | Walk your feet forward and rest your heels on the floor with your legs straight or knees slightly bent. | Keep your chest up, shoulders down away from your ears, and your hips close to the chair. | Bend your elbows to lower your body straight down until your upper arms are roughly parallel to the floor, keeping your elbows pointing back rather than flaring out. | Pause briefly when you feel a stretch across your chest and triceps, without letting your shoulders shrug up. | Press through your palms to push your body back up until your arms are fully extended again. | Complete your reps, then plant your feet and sit back onto the chair to finish.
tRu: Sit on the front edge of a sturdy chair and place your hands on the edge beside your hips, fingers pointing forward toward your feet. | Slide your hips off the chair so your weight is supported on your hands, keeping your arms fully extended. | Walk your feet forward and rest your heels on the floor with your legs straight or knees slightly bent. | Держите грудь поднятой, плечи опущены и远离 ушей, а бедра близко к стулу. | Согните локти, опуская тело строго вниз, пока плечи не станут примерно параллельны полу, направляя локти назад, а не в стороны. | Задержитесь на мгновение, когда чувствуете растяжение в груди и трицепсах, не поднимая плечи к ушам. | Press through your palms to push your body back up until your arms are fully extended again. | Выполните все повторения, затем поставьте ноги и сядьте на стул для завершения.
tHe: Sit on the front edge of a sturdy chair and place your hands on the edge beside your hips, fingers pointing forward toward your feet. | Slide your hips off the chair so your weight is supported on your hands, keeping your arms fully extended. | Walk your feet forward and rest your heels on the floor with your legs straight or knees slightly bent. | Keep your chest up, shoulders down away from your ears, and your hips close to the chair. | כופף את המרפקים כדי להוריד את הגוף ישר למטה עד שהזרועות העליונות בערך מקבילות לרצפה, תוך שמירה על מרפקים פונים לאחור ולא פתוחים החוצה. | Pause briefly when you feel a stretch across your chest and triceps, without letting your shoulders shrug up. | Press through your palms to push your body back up until your arms are fully extended again. | בצע את כל החזרות, ואז הנח את כפות הרגליים וישב לאחור על הכיסא כדי לסיים.

t: Place two sturdy chairs facing each other, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart, and check that both are stable and won't slide. | Grip the front edge of each chair seat with your hands and support your bodyweight on straight arms, keeping your shoulders down and away from your ears. | Extend your legs out in front of you with your heels on the floor, or rest your feet on a third chair to increase the difficulty. | Brace your core and lean your torso slightly forward to bias the chest, keeping your shoulder blades pulled down and back. | Bend your elbows and lower your body under control until your upper arms are roughly parallel to the floor or you feel a stretch across your chest. | Keep your elbows tracking back at about a 45° angle to your torso rather than flaring straight out. | Press through your palms to drive your body back up until your arms are fully extended. | Complete your reps, then lower your feet and step away from the chairs with control.
tRu: Поставьте две прочные скамьи лицом друг к другу, немного шире плеч, и убедитесь, что обе устойчивы и не будут скользить. | Возьмите передний край сиденья каждой椅子 руками и поддерживайте вес тела на выпрямленных руках, держа плечи опущенными и отведенными от ушей. | Вытяните ноги вперед с пятками на пол, или поставьте ноги на третий стул, чтобы увеличить нагрузку. | Напрягите корпус и слегка наклоните корпус вперёд с акцентом на грудь, удерживая лопатки сведёнными вниз и назад. | Согните локти и подконтрольно опустите тело, пока плечи не станут примерно параллельны полу или вы не почувствуете растяжение в груди. | Держите локти, двигаясь назад под углом примерно 45° к торсу, а не разведенными прямо. | Оттолкнитесь ладонями и поднимите тело вверх, пока руки полностью не выпрямятся. | Выполните все повторения, затем опустите ноги и сойдите со стульев с контролем.
tHe: Place two sturdy chairs facing each other, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart, and check that both are stable and won't slide. | אחוז בקצה הקדמי של כל כיסא בידיים ותמוך במשקל גופך על זרועות ישרות, תוך שמירה על הכתפיים מקובעות מטה והרחק מהאוזניים. | פשוט את רגליך לפניך מבלי לאפשר לכפות הרגליים לגעת ברצפה, ובו זמנים הורד את חלקו העליון של הגוף אחורה. | הדק את הליבה והטה את הגו קלות קדימה כדי להדגיש את החזה, תוך שמירה על השכמות משוכות למטה ולאחור. | כופף את המרפקים והורד את הגוף בשליטה עד שהזרועות העליונות בערך מקבילות לרצפה או עד שתרגיש מתיחה בחזה. | Keep your elbows tracking back at about a 45° angle to your torso rather than flaring straight out. | לחץ דרך כפות הידיים כדי לדחוף את הגוף חזרה למעלה עד שהידיים ישרות לגמרי. | בצע את החזרות שלך, ואז הורד את רגלייך וצא מהכיסאות בשליטה.

t: Lie flat on your back on the floor or a mat with your legs straight and your arms resting by your sides. | Press your lower back firmly into the floor and tilt your pelvis slightly so there is no gap beneath your spine. | Brace your abs and lift your shoulder blades a few inches off the floor, keeping your neck long and your chin slightly tucked. | At the same time, lift your straight legs off the floor so your body forms a shallow, curved dish shape from head to toe. | Keep your legs together, toes pointed, and arms extended either by your sides or overhead, whichever you can control. | Hold this position, breathing steadily, while keeping your lower back glued to the floor the whole time. | Hold for a set time, then lower your shoulders and legs to the floor under control to finish.
tRu: Лягте на спину на пол или на коврик с прямыми ногами и руками, лежащими вдоль тела. | Press your lower back firmly into the floor and tilt your pelvis slightly so there is no gap beneath your spine. | Напрягите пресс и приподнимите лопатки на несколько сантиметров от пола, сохраняя шею вытянутой, а подбородок слегка подтянутым. | Одновременно оторвите прямые ноги от пола, чтобы тело образовало неглубокую изогнутую лодочку от головы до носков. | Держите ноги вместе, носки направлены вперёд, и руки выпрямлены либо по бокам, либо над головой, в зависимости от того, что вы можете контролировать. | Удерживайте это положение, дыша ровно, и удерживайте поясницу прижатой к полу все время. | Удерживайте заданное время, затем плавно опустите плечи и ноги на пол для завершения.
tHe: Lie flat on your back on the floor or a mat with your legs straight and your arms resting by your sides. | Press your lower back firmly into the floor and tilt your pelvis slightly so there is no gap beneath your spine. | הדק את הבטן והרם את השכמות כמה אינץ׳ מהרצפה, תוך שמירה על צוואר ארוך וסנטר אסוף מעט. | בו זמנית הרם את הרגליים הישרות מהרצפה כך שהגוף יוצר צורת קערה רדודה ומעוגלת מהראש עד הבהונות. | Keep your legs together, toes pointed, and arms extended either by your sides or overhead, whichever you can control. | Hold this position, breathing steadily, while keeping your lower back glued to the floor the whole time. | Hold for a set time, then lower your shoulders and legs to the floor under control to finish.

t: Stand in an open doorway and place your forearm and palm flat against the frame, with your elbow bent to about 90 degrees and roughly at shoulder height. | Set the same-side foot slightly forward into the doorway to give yourself a stable base. | Keeping your chest tall and your core lightly braced, slowly rotate your torso away from the raised arm. | Step or lean gently forward until you feel a mild, comfortable stretch across the front of your chest and shoulder. | Hold the position and breathe steadily, relaxing into the stretch without bouncing or pushing into pain. | Hold for 20 to 30 seconds, then ease back out of the stretch under control. | Switch to the other arm and repeat, aiming for 2 to 3 holds per side.

t: Set up five dots in an X pattern — four corners of a roughly 2-foot by 2-foot rectangle plus one in the center — using tape, chalk, or a printed dot-drill mat. | Stand with one foot on the left-back dot and one foot on the right-back dot, knees softly bent and weight on the balls of your feet. | Jump both feet together into the center dot, landing light and quiet with your knees bent to absorb the impact. | Spring off the center dot and split your feet apart to land one on each front dot, staying low and balanced. | Hop both feet back to the center dot, then split again to the two back dots to complete one up-and-back cycle. | Keep your eyes up, arms relaxed and pumping for rhythm, and drive each jump from the ankles and knees rather than the hips. | Repeat the pattern continuously for your target reps or time, keeping the contacts as fast and quiet as you can. | Slow your last few jumps to a stop, step off the dots, and rest before your next round.

t: Hold the rope handles at hip height with your elbows tucked close to your sides and your forearms turned slightly outward. | Stand tall with your feet together, knees soft, and your weight balanced on the balls of your feet. | Begin a steady single-bounce rhythm to find your timing before attempting the double pass. | Jump a little higher than a normal skip, driving through the balls of your feet while keeping your torso upright. | Spin the rope faster using quick wrist rotations so it passes beneath your feet twice during that single jump. | Land softly on the balls of your feet with your knees slightly bent to absorb the impact. | Reset your rhythm and repeat for the planned reps or time, keeping the rope turning at a constant pace. | Slow the rope back to single bounces to finish, then stop and let your breathing settle.

t: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly out, and your weight balanced through your whole foot. | Brace your core, hinge slightly at the hips, and lower into a squat until your thighs are roughly parallel to the floor. | Drive explosively through your legs and jump straight up, swinging your arms upward for momentum. | Land softly on the balls of your feet, then your whole foot, bending your knees to absorb the impact and dropping straight back into a squat. | Immediately spring into a second jump from that squat, performing two consecutive explosive jumps before pausing. | Land softly again and reset to a stable squat or standing position to begin the next pair of jumps. | Continue for your target reps or time, keeping each landing controlled, then stop while your form is still clean.

t: Kneel down on a mat with both knees on the floor and your feet behind you, hip-width apart. | Point your toes straight back so the tops of your feet and your shins lie flat against the floor. | Keep your torso upright and place your hands on your thighs or the floor in front of you for balance. | Slowly sit back, lowering your hips toward your heels until you feel a gentle stretch along the front of your shins and ankles. | Stop the moment you feel a comfortable stretch — never push into sharp pain in the knees or ankles. | Hold the position and breathe steadily, keeping your shins pressed into the floor. | To increase the stretch slightly, lean your upper body back a little while supporting yourself with your hands. | Release by easing your hips forward off your heels, then come up onto all fours to finish.

t: Lie on your back with your knees pulled in toward your chest and your hands resting lightly on your shins. | Curl your head, neck, and shoulders off the mat, drawing your navel down toward your spine to flatten your lower back. | Inhale and reach your arms back past your ears while extending your legs out to a 45-degree angle, keeping your shoulders curled up. | Keep your lower back pressed into the mat throughout the reach so your abdominals stay engaged and your spine does not arch. | Exhale and sweep your arms out to the sides in a wide circle as you bend your knees back toward your chest. | Wrap your hands back around your shins and draw your knees in to return to the start position. | Repeat the reach-and-circle for the desired number of reps, then lower your head and legs to the mat under control.

t: Sit on the floor with your legs extended, then sit up tall on your sitting bones. If your hips are tight, sit on the front edge of a folded blanket. | Bend your right knee and lay the right shin on the floor in front of you, parallel to the front edge of your mat. | Bend your left knee and stack the left shin directly on top of the right, so your left ankle rests over your right knee and your left knee rests over your right ankle. | Flex both feet firmly to protect the knees, and aim to keep both shins parallel and roughly stacked rather than collapsed. | Sit tall and lengthen your spine, breathing into the outer hips as they open. | To deepen the stretch, hinge forward from the hips with a long back, walking your hands out in front of you only as far as feels comfortable. | Hold and breathe steadily, easing off if you feel any pinch or pain in the knees. | Slowly walk your hands back, unstack the legs, and extend both legs to release. | Repeat on the other side with the right shin stacked on top.

nE: Double Plank Jack to 4 Mountain Climber
nH: ג'ק פלאנק כפול ל-4 מטפסי הרים
t: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders, fingers spread, and your body in a straight line from head to heels. | Brace your core, squeeze your glutes, and set your feet together so your shoulders stay stacked over your wrists. | Jump both feet out wide for the first plank jack, then jump them back together, keeping your hips level the whole time. | Repeat the jump for a second plank jack, landing softly and resisting any bounce or sag in your hips. | Without resetting, drive one knee toward your chest for the first mountain climber, then switch legs quickly. | Continue alternating knees for four mountain climbers total, keeping your shoulders steady and your back flat. | Return your feet together in the plank and immediately begin the next round of two plank jacks. | Keep the rhythm steady for the prescribed time or rounds, then lower your knees to finish and rest.
tRu: Примите высокую планку с ладонями под плечами и разведёнными пальцами, тело в прямой линии от головы до пяток. | Напрягите корпус, сожмите ягодицы и поставьте стопы вместе, чтобы плечи оставались над запястьями. | Прыгните обеими ногами широко в первый раз, затем прыгните обратно вместе, держа бёдра на одном уровне всё время. | Repeat the jump for a second plank jack, landing softly and resisting any bounce or sag in your hips. | Without resetting, drive one knee toward your chest for the first mountain climber, then switch legs quickly. | Продолжайте поочерёдно сгибать колени всего четыре раза в стиле mountain climbers, удерживая плечи неподвижными и спину прямой. | Return your feet together in the plank and immediately begin the next round of two plank jacks. | Держите ритм ровное в течение указанного времени или кругов, затем опустите колени, чтобы закончить и отдохнуть.
tHe: התחל בפלאנק גבוה עם ידיים מתחת לכתפיים, אצבעות פרושות, והגוף בקו ישר מהראש ועד העקבים. | תכווץ את שרירי הליבה, תכווץ את השרירים הגלוטיאליים, וקבע את רגליך זו ליד זו כך שהכתפיים שלך יישארו מעל פרקי הידיים. | Jump both feet out wide for the first plank jack, then jump them back together, keeping your hips level the whole time. | Repeat the jump for a second plank jack, landing softly and resisting any bounce or sag in your hips. | Without resetting, drive one knee toward your chest for the first mountain climber, then switch legs quickly. | המשילו להחליף בין ברכיים לסך של ארבעה קלאימברים, ושמרו על כתפיים יציבות וגב שטוח. | Return your feet together in the plank and immediately begin the next round of two plank jacks. | Keep the rhythm steady for the prescribed time or rounds, then lower your knees to finish and rest.

t: Set the rope length so the handles reach roughly to your armpits when you stand on the middle of the rope. | Stand tall with your feet together, elbows close to your ribs, and the handles held low at hip height. | Begin with a few relaxed single-under jumps to find a steady rhythm and stay on the balls of your feet. | Jump slightly higher than a single under, keeping your body straight and your knees only softly bent. | Snap the rope around twice using a fast flick from your wrists and forearms, not big arm circles, while you are in the air. | Land softly on the balls of your feet with quiet, controlled contact, then absorb the impact through your ankles. | Reset your rhythm and repeat, chaining the double unders together for time or for a target number of reps.

nR: Отжимания из собаки мордой вниз у стены
nH: שכיבות סמיכה כלב מביט מטה מול קיר
t: Stand facing a wall, about an arm's length away, and place your hands flat on the floor shoulder-width apart. | Walk your feet up the wall and your hands back toward it, hips piking high so your body forms an inverted V (downward dog) with your head pointing toward the floor. | Set your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width and spread your fingers for a stable base. | Brace your core and keep your back flat, with your weight stacked over your hands and shoulders. | Bend your elbows and lower the crown of your head toward the floor under control, keeping your elbows tracking at roughly 45° to your torso. | Pause briefly just above the floor without letting your head touch down hard. | Press firmly through your hands to extend your arms and drive back to the starting inverted-V position. | Complete your reps, then walk your feet back down the wall and step away to finish.
tRu: Stand facing a wall, about an arm's length away, and place your hands flat on the floor shoulder-width apart. | Walk your feet up the wall and your hands back toward it, hips piking high so your body forms an inverted V (downward dog) with your head pointing toward the floor. | Set your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width and spread your fingers for a stable base. | Напрягите корпус и удерживайте спину прямой, располагая вес над кистями и плечами. | Согните локти и подконтрольно опустите макушку к полу, удерживая локти под углом примерно 45° к корпусу. | Задержитесь на мгновение прямо над полом, не позволяя голове сильно касаться пола. | Press firmly through your hands to extend your arms and drive back to the starting inverted-V position. | Выполните свои повторения, затем отойдите ногами вниз по стене и отойдите, чтобы закончить.

t: Start on your hands and knees with your wrists under your shoulders and your knees under your hips, fingers spread wide. | Press evenly through your palms and the bases of your fingers, then tuck your toes under so the balls of your feet contact the floor. | Exhale and lift your hips up and back, straightening your legs to draw your body into an inverted V shape. | Lengthen your spine by reaching your hips toward the ceiling and your chest gently back toward your thighs. | Rotate your shoulders outward to draw them away from your ears, keeping your upper arms active. | Let your heels sink toward the floor without forcing them, allowing the stretch to spread through your hamstrings and calves. | Hold the pose while breathing evenly through your nose, keeping your weight balanced between your hands and feet. | To release, exhale and lower your knees back to the floor, returning to hands and knees to rest.
tRu: Start on your hands and knees with your wrists under your shoulders and your knees under your hips, fingers spread wide. | Press evenly through your palms and the bases of your fingers, then tuck your toes under so the balls of your feet contact the floor. | Выдыхайте и поднимайте бёдра вверх и назад, выпрямляя ноги, чтобы принять форму перевернутой буквы V. | Вытягивайте позвоночник, двигая бёдра к потолку, а грудь — мягко назад к бёдрам. | Rotate your shoulders outward to draw them away from your ears, keeping your upper arms active. | Позвольте вашим пяткам опускаться к полу без усилий, позволяя растяжке распространиться на подколенные сухожилия и икры. | Задержите позу, дыша ровно через нос, сохраняя равновесие между весом на руках и ногах. | To release, exhale and lower your knees back to the floor, returning to hands and knees to rest.

nE: Downward Facing Dog Adho Mukha Svanasana
nH: כלב מביט מטה אדהו מוקה שוואנסאנה
t: Start on your hands and knees with your wrists under your shoulders and your knees under your hips. | Spread your fingers wide and press evenly through your whole palm and knuckles, keeping your hands shoulder-width apart. | Tuck your toes under and, on an exhale, lift your knees off the floor, sending your hips up and back toward the ceiling. | Straighten your arms and legs as much as is comfortable so your body forms an inverted V, lengthening through your spine. | Press the floor away through your hands and rotate your upper arms outward to draw your shoulders away from your ears. | Reach your heels toward the floor without forcing them down, and pedal your feet to ease into tight calves and hamstrings. | Let your head and neck hang relaxed between your arms, gaze toward your feet or navel, and breathe slowly through your nose. | Hold for several steady breaths, then lower your knees to the floor to release and rest in a brief child's pose.
tRu: Start on your hands and knees with your wrists under your shoulders and your knees under your hips. | Spread your fingers wide and press evenly through your whole palm and knuckles, keeping your hands shoulder-width apart. | Tuck your toes under and, on an exhale, lift your knees off the floor, sending your hips up and back toward the ceiling. | Straighten your arms and legs as much as is comfortable so your body forms an inverted V, lengthening through your spine. | Press the floor away through your hands and rotate your upper arms outward to draw your shoulders away from your ears. | Reach your heels toward the floor without forcing them down, and pedal your feet to ease into tight calves and hamstrings. | Позвольте вашей голове и шее расслабленно свисать между вашими руками, смотрите на ваши стопы или пупок и медленно дышите через нос. | Удерживайте несколько ровных дыханий, затем опустите колени на пол для расслабления и отдохните в короткой позе ребёнка.

nH: כלב מביט מטה לניידות עמוד שדרה
t: Start on all fours with your hands shoulder-width apart and your knees under your hips, fingers spread wide and pressing into the floor. | Tuck your toes under and lift your hips up and back, straightening your legs to form an inverted V shape with your body. | Press your chest gently toward your thighs and lengthen your spine, reaching your hips toward the ceiling. | Keep your head relaxed between your arms with your ears in line with your upper arms, neck long and free of tension. | Gently round and then lengthen your back through small, controlled movements to mobilize each segment of your spine. | Pedal your heels one at a time toward the floor to ease the stretch through your hamstrings and calves. | Breathe slowly and hold for several breaths, then bend your knees and lower back to all fours to finish.
tRu: Start on all fours with your hands shoulder-width apart and your knees under your hips, fingers spread wide and pressing into the floor. | Tuck your toes under and lift your hips up and back, straightening your legs to form an inverted V shape with your body. | Press your chest gently toward your thighs and lengthen your spine, reaching your hips toward the ceiling. | Держите голову расслабленной между руками, уши на одной линии с верхними частями рук, шея длинная и без напряжения. | Аккуратно округлите, а затем выпрямите спину с помощью небольших контролируемых движений, чтобы мобилизовать каждый сегмент позвоночника. | Плавно опускайте пятки поочерёдно к полу, чтобы облегчить растяжение в бицепсах бедра и икроножных мышцах. | Дышите медленно и удерживайте конечную позицию в течение 20–40 секунд, немного углубляя растяжку с каждым выдохом.
tHe: Start on all fours with your hands shoulder-width apart and your knees under your hips, fingers spread wide and pressing into the floor. | Tuck your toes under and lift your hips up and back, straightening your legs to form an inverted V shape with your body. | Press your chest gently toward your thighs and lengthen your spine, reaching your hips toward the ceiling. | Keep your head relaxed between your arms with your ears in line with your upper arms, neck long and free of tension. | עגל ואז הארך את הגב בתנועות קטנות ומבוקרות כדי להנייד כל חוליה בעמוד השדרה. | Pedal your heels one at a time toward the floor to ease the stretch through your hamstrings and calves. | נשיר לאט והחזיקו למשך כמה נשימות, ואז כפתו את הברכים והורידו את הגב חזרה לארבע כפות כדי לסיים.

nR: Собака мордой вниз с касанием носков
nH: כלב מביט מטה עם נגיעות אצבעות
t: Start on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and your knees under your hips. | Tuck your toes, press into your palms, and lift your hips up and back until your body forms an inverted V (downward facing dog). | Straighten your legs as much as is comfortable and let your heels reach toward the floor, lengthening through your spine and the backs of your thighs. | Hold this base position for a breath, keeping your back long and your head relaxed between your arms. | Reach your right hand across and down toward your left foot or ankle, letting your torso rotate gently through the hips. | Pause where you feel a comfortable stretch through the hamstring and side of your back, then return your right hand to the floor. | Reach your left hand toward your right foot the same way, then return to the centered downward dog position. | Continue alternating sides for your set, then lower your knees back to the floor to finish.
tRu: Start on all fours with your hands under your shoulders and your knees under your hips. | Tuck your toes, press into your palms, and lift your hips up and back until your body forms an inverted V (downward facing dog). | Straighten your legs as much as is comfortable and let your heels reach toward the floor, lengthening through your spine and the backs of your thighs. | Задержитесь в этом базовом положении на один вдох, сохраняя спину прямой и голову расслабленной между руками. | Reach your right hand across and down toward your left foot or ankle, letting your torso rotate gently through the hips. | Пауза в точке, где вы чувствуете комфортное растяжение в бицепсе бедра и боковой части спины, затем верните правую руку на пол. | Reach your left hand toward your right foot the same way, then return to the centered downward dog position. | Продолжайте поочередно выполнять движения на разные стороны в течение вашего подхода, затем опустите колени обратно на пол для завершения.

t: Warm up the hips, hamstrings, wrists, and spine first with gentle rotations and a few rounds of twisting and hip-opening stretches. | Begin in a low squat with your feet together and your hands flat on the floor in front of you, fingers spread wide. | Shift your weight onto one foot and thread the opposite leg across your body, hooking the back of that knee high over the same-side upper arm. | Rotate your torso toward the planted side, settling the outer thigh firmly onto the shelf created by your bent elbow. | Plant both hands shoulder-width apart and bend your elbows to roughly 90 degrees, keeping them stacked over your wrists like a low chaturanga base. | Lean your chest forward and slowly lift the planted foot off the floor, drawing your bodyweight onto your hands as you find balance. | Extend the top leg out to the side and the bottom leg back behind you, breathing steadily and keeping your gaze forward. | Hold for a few smooth breaths, then lower both feet to the floor with control and return to a squat to release. | Repeat on the opposite side to balance the stretch evenly.
tRu: Warm up the hips, hamstrings, wrists, and spine first with gentle rotations and a few rounds of twisting and hip-opening stretches. | Примите низкий присед: стопы вместе, ладони ровно на полу перед собой, пальцы широко разведены. | Shift your weight onto one foot and thread the opposite leg across your body, hooking the back of that knee high over the same-side upper arm. | Rotate your torso toward the planted side, settling the outer thigh firmly onto the shelf created by your bent elbow. | Поставьте обе руки на ширине плеч и согните локти примерно под 90 градусов, удерживая их над запястьями, как в низкой основе чатуранги. | Наклоните корпус вперед и медленно поднимите опорную ногу от пола, перенося вес тела на руки по мере поиска равновесия. | Вытяните верхнюю ногу вбок, а нижнюю назад, дыша ровно и глядя прямо перед собой. | Удерживайте несколько ровных дыханий, затем плавно опустите обе ноги на пол и вернитесь в приседание для расслабления. | Repeat on the opposite side to balance the stretch evenly.
tHe: Warm up the hips, hamstrings, wrists, and spine first with gentle rotations and a few rounds of twisting and hip-opening stretches. | התחל בסקוואט נמוך עם רגליים צמודות וכפות ידיים שטוחות על הרצפה מלפניך, אצבעות פרושות. | Shift your weight onto one foot and thread the opposite leg across your body, hooking the back of that knee high over the same-side upper arm. | Rotate your torso toward the planted side, settling the outer thigh firmly onto the shelf created by your bent elbow. | Plant both hands shoulder-width apart and bend your elbows to roughly 90 degrees, keeping them stacked over your wrists like a low chaturanga base. | Lean your chest forward and slowly lift the planted foot off the floor, drawing your bodyweight onto your hands as you find balance. | פשוט את הרגל העליונה לצד ואת הרגל התחתונה אחורה, נשור בקצב קבוע ושמור על מבטך קדימה. | Hold for a few smooth breaths, then lower both feet to the floor with control and return to a squat to release. | Repeat on the opposite side to balance the stretch evenly.

t: Set up two stable, level raised supports under your hands so there is a gap your chest can pass between when you lower. | Place your hands on the supports slightly wider than shoulder-width and grip firmly so your wrists stay neutral. | Step your feet back into a high plank with your body in a straight line from head to heels. | Brace your core and squeeze your glutes, keeping your hips level rather than sagging or piking. | Bend your elbows and lower your chest under control between the supports, dropping below hand level for a full stretch. | Keep your elbows tucked at roughly a 45° angle to your torso as you descend, lowering until you feel a deep stretch across the chest. | Press through your palms and drive your chest back up until your arms are fully extended. | Repeat for your target reps, then lower your knees to the floor to finish.
tRu: Set up two stable, level raised supports under your hands so there is a gap your chest can pass between when you lower. | Положите руки на упоры немного шире ширины плеч и крепко держите, чтобы запястья оставались нейтральными. | Step your feet back into a high plank with your body in a straight line from head to heels. | Напрягите корпус и сожмите ягодицы, удерживая бёдра на одном уровне, не давая им провисать или подниматься вверх. | Согните локти и подконтрольно опустите грудь между опорами ниже уровня кистей для полного растяжения. | Держите локти прижмыми близко к торсу — примерно под углом 30–45 градусов от боков — для защиты плеч и включения трехглавой мышцы плеча. | Press through your palms and drive your chest back up until your arms are fully extended. | Repeat for your target reps, then lower your knees to the floor to finish.
tHe: Set up two stable, level raised supports under your hands so there is a gap your chest can pass between when you lower. | Place your hands on the supports slightly wider than shoulder-width and grip firmly so your wrists stay neutral. | Step your feet back into a high plank with your body in a straight line from head to heels. | הדק את הליבה וכווץ את הישבנים, תוך שמירה על אגן מאוזן ולא שמיטה או התרוממות. | כופף את המרפקים והורד את החזה בשליטה בין התומכים, רד מתחת לגובה הידיים למתיחה מלאה. | Keep your elbows tucked at roughly a 45° angle to your torso as you descend, lowering until you feel a deep stretch across the chest. | Press through your palms and drive your chest back up until your arms are fully extended. | Repeat for your target reps, then lower your knees to the floor to finish.

t: Stand tall with your feet roughly shoulder-width apart and your hands clasped in front of your chest or resting on your hips for balance. | Bend your knees and sink into a deep squat, lowering your hips until your thighs are roughly parallel to the floor or below. | Keep your chest up, back flat, and core braced, staying down in the squat throughout the walk. | Step forward with one foot while staying low, driving through the heel and keeping the hips down. | Bring the trailing foot forward to match, maintaining the deep squat position without standing up between steps. | Continue stepping forward in a smooth, controlled rhythm, breathing steadily to manage the effort. | Walk for your target distance or time, then slowly stand up and rest before the next round.

t: Sit or stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, elbows in front of your body and palms facing your torso. | Brace your core, keep your chest up, and set your shoulder blades down to create a stable pressing base. | Press one dumbbell up while rotating that wrist outward, so the palm turns to face forward as the arm reaches overhead. | Finish with the arm fully extended overhead, palm facing forward, without locking the elbow harshly or shrugging the shoulder up. | Reverse the path under control: lower the dumbbell while rotating the wrist back so the palm faces you again at shoulder height. | Repeat the press and rotation with the other arm, keeping the resting dumbbell steady at shoulder height. | Continue alternating arms for your target reps, keeping the tempo controlled in both directions. | After your final rep, lower both dumbbells to your thighs or set them down with control.

t: Sit or stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, raised to shoulder height with your palms facing forward and your elbows under your wrists. | Brace your core and keep your ribs down so your lower back doesn't arch as you press. | Press one dumbbell straight overhead until your arm is fully extended, keeping the other dumbbell stationary at your shoulder. | Lower that dumbbell back to shoulder height under control, keeping tension on the front delt. | Press the opposite dumbbell overhead in the same way, finishing with the arm locked out. | Lower it back to shoulder height with control, completing one full alternating cycle. | Continue alternating arms for your target reps, then lower both dumbbells to your thighs to finish.

tRu: Sit on the floor with your legs extended straight in front of you and a dumbbell in each hand, racked at shoulder height with palms facing forward. | Sit tall and brace your core, squeezing your glutes and keeping your torso upright without leaning back against any support. | Press one dumbbell straight overhead until your arm is fully extended, keeping the other dumbbell racked at your shoulder. | Держите запястье над локтем и плечо опущено, избегая любого скручивания или наклона корпуса при жиме. | Опустите эту гантель под контролем обратно на высоту плеч, оставаясь высоким и напряжённым. | Press the opposite dumbbell overhead in the same way, alternating one rep per side. | Продолжайте чередовать, пока не закончите повторения, удерживая бёдра и ноги неподвижными на протяжении всего движения. | Опустите обе гантели под контролем и поставьте их в безопасное место, чтобы завершить.

t: Stand with your feet about shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand racked at shoulder height with palms facing each other and elbows pointing down. | Brace your core, keep your chest tall, and look straight ahead. | Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower into a squat until your thighs are roughly parallel to the floor, keeping both dumbbells racked at your shoulders. | Drive through your heels to stand up explosively, using the upward momentum from your legs to help press one dumbbell overhead until your arm is fully extended. | Lower that dumbbell back to your shoulder under control as you settle into a tall standing position. | Descend into your next squat, then stand and press the opposite arm overhead, alternating sides on each rep. | Continue alternating for your target reps, then lower both dumbbells under control to finish.

tRu: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and a dumbbell in each hand resting on your thighs. | Лягте на спину на пол и поднимите обе гантели к плечам, ладонями направлены к стопам. | Press both dumbbells up until your arms are extended over your chest, then lower one back to the start. | Держите эту гантель в зафиксированном положении, пока опускаете другую руку, пока ваша верхняя часть руки не легла легким касанием на пол. | Press the lowered dumbbell back up until the arm is extended, keeping the working elbow at about a 45-degree angle to your torso. | Опустите противоположную гантель на пол и поднимите её тем же способом, чередуя по одному повторению на каждой стороне. | Продолжайте поочерёдно работать руками, пока не закончите повторения, удерживая рабочую гантель вытянутой над головой. | Опустите обе гантели на плечи, затем сядьте под контролем и поставьте их.
tHe: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and a dumbbell in each hand resting on your thighs. | Lie back onto the floor and bring both dumbbells to your shoulders, palms facing toward your feet. | Press both dumbbells up until your arms are extended over your chest, then lower one back to the start. | Keep that dumbbell held at lockout while you lower the other arm until your upper arm rests lightly on the floor. | Press the lowered dumbbell back up until the arm is extended, keeping the working elbow at about a 45-degree angle to your torso. | Lower the opposite dumbbell to the floor and press it up the same way, alternating one rep per side. | המשיל להחליף בין הזרועות עד שתסיים את כל החזרות, שמור על הדאמבל הלא פעיל נעול מעל הראש. | Lower both dumbbells to your shoulders, then sit up under control and set them down.
