tHe: Stand tall with your feet roughly hip- to shoulder-width apart and your toes turned slightly out. | הדק את הליבה, שמור על חזה מורם והעבר את המשקל לאחור לאגן כאילו אתה מתיישב. | כופף באגן, בברכיים ובקרסוליים כדי לרדת לאט לסקוואט עמוק, תוך מתן לברכיים לנוע מעל קצות האצבעות. | Lower until your hips drop below your knees while keeping your heels flat and your spine neutral. | Hold the bottom position briefly, keeping tension through your glutes, quads, and inner thighs. | דחוף דרך כל כף הרגל ודחוף את הירכים קדימה כדי לקום חזרה בשליטה. | Squeeze your glutes at the top, then reset your stance and repeat for the desired reps.

t: Grip a pull-up bar slightly wider than shoulder-width with an overhand grip, wrapping your thumbs around the bar. | Pull yourself up into a flexed-arm hang so your chin is at or above the bar and your elbows are fully bent. | Brace your core and squeeze your back and shoulder blades to lock in a stable starting position. | Push your body down and away from the bar by extending your arms in a controlled motion until they are nearly straight. | Without swinging, reverse the movement and pull yourself explosively back up toward the bar. | Return to the flexed-arm hang with your chin level with the bar, keeping tension through your back and arms. | Repeat for your target reps, then lower under control to a dead hang and step down safely.
tRu: Возьмитесь за перекладину для подтягиваний немного шире плеч сверху, обхватив большой палец вокруг перекладины. | Pull yourself up into a flexed-arm hang so your chin is at or above the bar and your elbows are fully bent. | Напрягите корпус и напрягите спину, сведя лопатки, чтобы зафиксировать устойчивое исходное положение. | Push your body down and away from the bar by extending your arms in a controlled motion until they are nearly straight. | Without swinging, reverse the movement and pull yourself explosively back up toward the bar. | Return to the flexed-arm hang with your chin level with the bar, keeping tension through your back and arms. | Repeat for your target reps, then lower under control to a dead hang and step down safely.
tHe: אחוז במוט משיכה מעט רחב מרוחב הכתפיים באחיזה מלמעלה, תוך עטיפת האגודלים סביב המוט. | Pull yourself up into a flexed-arm hang so your chin is at or above the bar and your elbows are fully bent. | הדק את הליבה וכווץ את הגב והשכמות כדי לנעול תנוחת התחלה יציבה. | Push your body down and away from the bar by extending your arms in a controlled motion until they are nearly straight. | Without swinging, reverse the movement and pull yourself explosively back up toward the bar. | Return to the flexed-arm hang with your chin level with the bar, keeping tension through your back and arms. | Repeat for your target reps, then lower under control to a dead hang and step down safely.

t: Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart and your weight balanced over the balls of your feet. | Brace your core gently and keep your hips square and level to start from a stable base. | Rise up so your heels lift off the floor, keeping your ankles, knees, and hips aligned. | Lower your heels back down under control, feeling the movement through your hips and lower body. | Pause briefly at the bottom without letting your hips collapse or shift to one side. | Repeat for your target reps, keeping each drop smooth and controlled rather than dropping fast. | Finish by standing tall with your feet flat and your hips level.
tRu: Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart and your weight balanced over the balls of your feet. | Слегка напрягите пресс и удерживайте таз ровно и на одном уровне, начиная движение со стабильной базы. | Rise up so your heels lift off the floor, keeping your ankles, knees, and hips aligned. | Опустите пятки обратно вниз контролируемо, чувствуя движение через бёдра и нижнюю часть тела. | На мгновение задержитесь внизу, не давая бёдрам проваливаться или смещаться в сторону. | Repeat for your target reps, keeping each drop smooth and controlled rather than dropping fast. | Завершите упражнение, встаньте прямо, стопами полностью на полу и ровными бедрами.
tHe: Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart and your weight balanced over the balls of your feet. | הדק בעדינות את הליבה ושמור על אגן מרובע ומאוזן כדי להתחיל מבסיס יציב. | Rise up so your heels lift off the floor, keeping your ankles, knees, and hips aligned. | Lower your heels back down under control, feeling the movement through your hips and lower body. | Pause briefly at the bottom without letting your hips collapse or shift to one side. | Repeat for your target reps, keeping each drop smooth and controlled rather than dropping fast. | סיים בעמידה זקופה עם כפות הרגליים שטוחות והאגן ישר.

t: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, set about hip-width apart and close enough that your fingertips can graze your heels. | Lift your toes off the floor so your weight rests on your heels, and let your arms lie at your sides with palms down for balance. | Brace your core and tuck your pelvis slightly to flatten your lower back into the floor. | Drive through your heels and squeeze your glutes to lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from your shoulders to your knees. | Pause at the top for a moment and squeeze your glutes hard without overarching your lower back. | Lower your hips under control until they hover just above the floor, keeping tension on the glutes. | Repeat for your target reps, then set your hips down and relax.
tRu: Лягте на спину, согните колени и поставьте стопы на пол примерно на ширине бёдер, достаточно близко, чтобы кончики пальцев могли касаться пяток. | Поднимите пальцы ног с пола, чтобы вес приходился на пятки, и опустите руки вдоль тела ладонями вниз для равновесия. | Напрягите пресс и слегка подкрутите таз, прижав поясницу к полу. | Оттолкнитесь пятками и сожмите ягодицы, чтобы поднять бёдра, пока тело не образует прямую линию от плеч до коленей. | Сделайте паузу в верхней точке на мгновение и сильно сожмите ягодицы, не прогибая поясницу. | Подконтрольно опустите бёдра, пока они не окажутся чуть выше пола, сохраняя напряжение в ягодицах. | Повторите целевое количество повторений, затем опустите бёдра и расслабьтесь.
tHe: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, set about hip-width apart and close enough that your fingertips can graze your heels. | Lift your toes off the floor so your weight rests on your heels, and let your arms lie at your sides with palms down for balance. | הדק את הליבה ואסוף מעט את האגן כדי להשטיח את הגב התחתון לרצפה. | דחוף דרך העקבים וכווץ את הישבן כדי להרים את האגן עד שהגוף יוצר קו ישר מהכתפיים ועד הברכיים. | Pause at the top for a moment and squeeze your glutes hard without overarching your lower back. | הורד את האגן בשליטה עד שירחף ממש מעל הרצפה, תוך שמירה על מתח בישבן. | חזור על התרגיל לחזרות היעד, ואז הורד את האגן והירגע.

t: Stand facing a wall and place both hands on it at about chest height for support. | Step one foot back, keeping the back leg straight and the toes pointing forward toward the wall. | Press the back heel firmly down into the floor until you feel a stretch along the calf and ankle. | Keep your hips square and your back leg straight to direct the stretch into the upper calf (gastrocnemius). | Hold the position and breathe slowly and evenly, letting the calf relax into the stretch on each exhale. | Hold for 20 to 30 seconds without bouncing, easing deeper only as the tension releases. | Release gently, then switch legs and repeat on the other side.
tRu: Stand facing a wall and place both hands on it at about chest height for support. | Step one foot back, keeping the back leg straight and the toes pointing forward toward the wall. | Press the back heel firmly down into the floor until you feel a stretch along the calf and ankle. | Держите бёдра параллельными друг другу и заднюю ногу прямой, чтобы направить растяжение на верхнюю часть икроножной мышцы. | Задержите позицию и дышите медленно и ровно, позволяя икроножным мышцам расслабляться в растяжке с каждым выдохом. | Держитесь 20–30 секунд, затем плавно выйдите из растяжки. | Release gently, then switch legs and repeat on the other side.
tHe: Stand facing a wall and place both hands on it at about chest height for support. | Step one foot back, keeping the back leg straight and the toes pointing forward toward the wall. | Press the back heel firmly down into the floor until you feel a stretch along the calf and ankle. | Keep your hips square and your back leg straight to direct the stretch into the upper calf (gastrocnemius). | Hold the position and breathe slowly and evenly, letting the calf relax into the stretch on each exhale. | Hold for 20 to 30 seconds without bouncing, easing deeper only as the tension releases. | Release gently, then switch legs and repeat on the other side.

t: Start in a fighting stance with feet staggered, knees soft, hands up by your chin, and your weight slightly forward. | Shift your weight onto your standing leg and brace your core as you prepare to drive the rear (or lead) leg forward. | Pull the kicking knee up toward your chest, keeping the knee high and the foot cocked so the kick travels in a straight line. | Thrust your hips forward and extend the leg, pushing through the ball or heel of your foot into the target. | Keep your toes pulled back and your standing foot rooted, turning the supporting heel out slightly for power and reach. | Snap the kicking leg back to the chambered knee position immediately after contact rather than letting it drop. | Return the foot to the floor and reset into your stance with your guard up, ready to repeat or chain another strike. | Alternate legs or repeat for the prescribed reps or time, keeping a steady breathing rhythm throughout.
tRu: Start in a fighting stance with feet staggered, knees soft, hands up by your chin, and your weight slightly forward. | Shift your weight onto your standing leg and brace your core as you prepare to drive the rear (or lead) leg forward. | Pull the kicking knee up toward your chest, keeping the knee high and the foot cocked so the kick travels in a straight line. | Thrust your hips forward and extend the leg, pushing through the ball or heel of your foot into the target. | Держите пальцы ног pulled back и стоящую ногу прижатой к полу, поворачивая пятку опорной ноги наружу для силы и амплитуды. | Snap the kicking leg back to the chambered knee position immediately after contact rather than letting it drop. | Return the foot to the floor and reset into your stance with your guard up, ready to repeat or chain another strike. | Чередуйте ноги или повторяйте заданное число повторений или время, сохраняя ровный ритм дыхания.

nR: Скольжения в приседе на пятках у стены
t: Stand with your back flat against a wall and your feet about shoulder-width apart, a step or so out in front of you. | Raise your heels slightly so your weight sits toward the balls of your feet, keeping your toes pointed forward. | Brace your core and press your lower back, upper back, and shoulders into the wall. | Slide your back down the wall by bending your knees, keeping them tracking in line with your toes. | Lower under control until your thighs are roughly parallel to the floor, or as far as you can go with good form. | Pause briefly at the bottom while keeping your back in contact with the wall. | Drive through the balls of your feet and slide back up until your legs are nearly straight. | Complete your reps, then step away from the wall and lower your heels to finish.
tRu: Stand with your back flat against a wall and your feet about shoulder-width apart, a step or so out in front of you. | Raise your heels slightly so your weight sits toward the balls of your feet, keeping your toes pointed forward. | Напрягите корпус и прижмите поясницу, верхнюю часть спины и плечи к стене. | Slide your back down the wall by bending your knees, keeping them tracking in line with your toes. | Под контролем опуститесь, пока бедра не достигнут параллели полу или насколько глубоко ваша мобильность позволяет с нейтральным позвоночником. | Пауза на мгновение в нижней точке, сохраняя спину прижатой к стене. | Оттолкнитесь подушечками стоп и скользите обратно вверх, пока ноги не станут почти прямыми. | Выполните все повторения, затем отойдите от стены и опустите пятки, чтобы завершить.
tHe: Stand with your back flat against a wall and your feet about shoulder-width apart, a step or so out in front of you. | Raise your heels slightly so your weight sits toward the balls of your feet, keeping your toes pointed forward. | הדק את הליבה ולחץ את הגב התחתון, הגב העליון והכתפיים לקיר. | Slide your back down the wall by bending your knees, keeping them tracking in line with your toes. | Lower under control until your thighs are roughly parallel to the floor, or as far as you can go with good form. | Pause briefly at the bottom while keeping your back in contact with the wall. | דחוף דרך כפות כף הרגל וחזור למעלה עד שהרגליים כמעט ישרות. | בצע את כל החזרות, וצעד הרחק מהקיר והורד את עקביך כדי לסיים.

t: Find a straight line on the floor — a floor seam, a length of tape, or an imaginary line works well. | Stand tall at one end of the line with your feet together, eyes looking forward, and arms relaxed at your sides. | Step forward and place the heel of your front foot directly in front of the toes of your back foot, so they almost touch. | Shift your weight smoothly onto the front foot, keeping your torso upright and your core gently braced. | Bring the back foot through and place its heel just in front of the toes of the now-planted foot, staying on the line. | Continue walking heel-to-toe in a slow, controlled rhythm for the planned distance or number of steps. | Pause briefly on each step if needed to steady yourself, keeping your gaze fixed ahead rather than down at your feet. | Stop at the end of the line, return with control, and rest before repeating.
tRu: Найдите прямую линию на полу — стык плит, кусок ленты или воображаемая линия подойдут. | Stand tall at one end of the line with your feet together, eyes looking forward, and arms relaxed at your sides. | Step forward and place the heel of your front foot directly in front of the toes of your back foot, so they almost touch. | Shift your weight smoothly onto the front foot, keeping your torso upright and your core gently braced. | Перенесите заднюю ногу вперед и поставьте ее пятку чуть перед пальцами уже установленной ноги, оставаясь на линии. | Продолжайте идти пятка-на-носок в медленном, контролируемом ритме на заданное расстояние или количество шагов. | При необходимости задержитесь на мгновение на каждом шаге, чтобы удержать равновесие, сохраняя взгляд прямо перед собой, а не на ноги. | Stop at the end of the line, return with control, and rest before repeating.
tHe: מצא קו ישר על הרצפה — תפר ברצפה, רצועת דבק או קדקוד מדומה עובדים היטב. | Stand tall at one end of the line with your feet together, eyes looking forward, and arms relaxed at your sides. | Step forward and place the heel of your front foot directly in front of the toes of your back foot, so they almost touch. | Shift your weight smoothly onto the front foot, keeping your torso upright and your core gently braced. | הבא את הרגל האחורית קדימה ומקם את העקב קרוב לאצבעות של הרגל הנוכחית, נשאר על הקו. | המשך ללכת על עקבים לאצבעות בקצב איטי ומבוקר למרחק או מספר הצעדים המתוכנן. | Pause briefly on each step if needed to steady yourself, keeping your gaze fixed ahead rather than down at your feet. | Stop at the end of the line, return with control, and rest before repeating.

t: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, weight settled onto your heels, and arms relaxed at your sides for balance. | Pull your toes and the balls of both feet up off the floor so you are balancing on your heels only. | Keep your knees nearly straight, your chest up, and your core lightly braced. | Take a small, controlled step forward, landing on your heel with your toes still lifted. | Walk forward heel to heel, keeping your toes up the entire time and your stride short. | Continue for the prescribed distance or number of steps, feeling the work along the front of your shins. | Lower your toes back to the floor, rest briefly, then repeat for the next set.

t: Kneel on a mat with your knees together and your shins flat on the floor, feet pointing straight back behind you. | Spread your feet slightly wider than your hips so there is room for your hips to sink between them, keeping the tops of your feet pressing into the mat. | Sit back and lower your hips toward the floor in the gap between your heels, not on top of them. | If your hips do not reach the floor comfortably, slide a yoga block or cushion under them so you sit tall without straining your knees. | Lengthen your spine, stack your head over your hips, and let your shoulders relax down and back. | Rest your hands on your thighs with the palms facing down and soften your face and jaw. | Breathe slowly and hold for 30 seconds to a few minutes, feeling the stretch across the front of your thighs and ankles. | To release, press your hands into the floor, lift your hips, and extend your legs forward one at a time to ease out of the pose.

nR: Отжимания на наклонной на высокой перекладине
nH: שכיבות סמיכה בשיפוע על מוט גבוה
t: Set a fixed bar, railing, or rack pin at roughly chest-to-waist height and confirm it is stable and will not move. | Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width with your palms facing down and wrap your thumbs around it. | Walk your feet back until your body forms a straight line from head to heels, leaning into the bar at a steep angle. | Brace your core and squeeze your glutes so your hips neither sag nor pike up. | Lower your chest toward the bar under control, keeping your elbows tucked at roughly a 45° angle to your torso. | Stop when your chest nearly touches the bar, keeping your wrists stacked over the bar. | Press back up by driving through your hands until your arms are fully extended. | Complete your reps, then step your feet forward and stand up off the bar.
tRu: Set a fixed bar, railing, or rack pin at roughly chest-to-waist height and confirm it is stable and will not move. | Возьмитесь за штангу немного шире плеч, ладонями вниз, и обхватите её большими пальцами. | Walk your feet back until your body forms a straight line from head to heels, leaning into the bar at a steep angle. | Напрягите корпус и сожмите ягодицы, чтобы бёдра не провисали и не поднимались вверх. | Под контролем опустите грудь к перекладине, сохраняя локти прижтыми под углом примерно 45° к корпусу. | Stop when your chest nearly touches the bar, keeping your wrists stacked over the bar. | Press back up by driving through your hands until your arms are fully extended. | Выполните свои повторения, затем поставьте ноги вперед и встаньте со штанги.
tHe: Set a fixed bar, railing, or rack pin at roughly chest-to-waist height and confirm it is stable and will not move. | אחוז במוט מעט רחב מרוחב הכתפיים כשהכפות פונות מטה ועטוף את האגודלים סביבו. | Walk your feet back until your body forms a straight line from head to heels, leaning into the bar at a steep angle. | הדק את הליבה וכווץ את הישבן כך שהאגן לא ישקע ולא יתרומם. | Lower your chest toward the bar under control, keeping your elbows tucked at roughly a 45° angle to your torso. | Stop when your chest nearly touches the bar, keeping your wrists stacked over the bar. | Press back up by driving through your hands until your arms are fully extended. | בצע את כל החזרות, ואז הצע את רגליך קדימה וקום מהמוט.

t: Set a fixed bar at roughly hip-to-chest height in a squat rack or on a Smith machine, and check that it is locked and stable. | Lie on the floor beneath the bar so it sits directly over your upper chest. | Grip the bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width, arms fully extended. | Brace your core and squeeze your glutes so your body forms a straight line from heels to shoulders, with only your heels on the floor. | Pull your chest up toward the bar by driving your elbows down and back and squeezing your shoulder blades together. | Touch your chest to the bar, or get as close as your strength allows, while keeping your hips level. | Lower yourself under control until your arms are fully extended again, keeping tension in your back. | Complete your reps, then set your hips down and release the bar.
tRu: Set a fixed bar at roughly hip-to-chest height in a squat rack or on a Smith machine, and check that it is locked and stable. | Лягте на тренажёр спиной к подушке, коленями согнутыми и ступнями, закреплёнными под валиками для ног или на платформе для ног. | Возьмитесь за штангу хватом сверху немного шире плеч, руки полностью выпрямлены. | Напрягите корпус и сожмите ягодицы, чтобы тело образовало прямую линию от пяток до плеч, касаясь пола только пятками. | Pull your chest up toward the bar by driving your elbows down and back and squeezing your shoulder blades together. | Touch your chest to the bar, or get as close as your strength allows, while keeping your hips level. | Под контролем опуститесь до полного выпрямления рук, сохраняя напряжение в спине. | Выполните все повторения, затем опустите бёдра и отпустите штангу.
tHe: Set a fixed bar at roughly hip-to-chest height in a squat rack or on a Smith machine, and check that it is locked and stable. | Lie on the floor beneath the bar so it sits directly over your upper chest. | אחוז במוט באחיזה מלמעלה מעט רחבה מרוחב הכתפיים, זרועות פשוטות לגמרי. | הדק את הליבה וכווץ את הישבנים כך שהגוף יוצר קו ישר מהעקבים עד הכתפיים, כששרק העקבים על הרצפה. | Pull your chest up toward the bar by driving your elbows down and back and squeezing your shoulder blades together. | Touch your chest to the bar, or get as close as your strength allows, while keeping your hips level. | Lower yourself under control until your arms are fully extended again, keeping tension in your back. | בצע את החזרות שלך, ואז הורד את הירכיים ושחרר את המוט.

t: Stand facing a sturdy box or bench tall enough that your knee is at roughly hip height when your foot is planted on it. | Place one full foot flat on top of the box, keeping that shin close to vertical and your toes pointing forward. | Brace your core, keep your chest up, and shift your weight over the foot on the box. | Drive through the heel and midfoot of the top leg to push your body straight up, keeping the trailing leg relaxed. | Stand tall on top of the box with the working leg, bringing the trailing foot up to balance without slamming it down. | Pause briefly at the top under control, keeping your hips level and torso upright. | Lower the trailing leg back to the floor slowly, letting the working leg control the descent. | Reset your footing, complete your reps on that side, then switch to the other leg.

nE: High Hurdle Jump to Sprint and Cut
nR: Прыжки через высокий барьер со спринтом и сменой направления
nH: קפיצת משוכה גבוהה לספרינט ושינוי כיוון
t: Set a single high hurdle and clear the space in front of it for a 5–10 metre sprint lane plus room to cut left or right. | Stand a short stride behind the hurdle with feet shoulder-width apart, knees soft, and your weight balanced over the middle of your feet. | Dip into a quarter-squat, swing your arms back, then drive both arms up and extend powerfully through your hips, knees, and ankles to jump over the hurdle. | Tuck your knees to clear the bar and spot your landing zone on the far side. | Land on the balls of both feet with knees bent and hips back, absorbing the impact softly rather than landing stiff-legged. | The instant you land, transition forward and accelerate into a sprint, staying low for the first few steps and pumping your arms. | After a few hard strides, plant your outside foot, drop your hips, and cut sharply in the chosen direction by pushing off that planted foot. | Decelerate under control, reset to the start, and repeat for your prescribed reps, alternating the cut direction.
tRu: Set a single high hurdle and clear the space in front of it for a 5–10 metre sprint lane plus room to cut left or right. | Stand a short stride behind the hurdle with feet shoulder-width apart, knees soft, and your weight balanced over the middle of your feet. | Опуститесь в полуприсед, отведите руки назад, затем мощно выталкивайте ногами, разгибая бёдра, колени и лодыжки, чтобы перелезть через препятствие. | Tuck your knees to clear the bar and spot your landing zone on the far side. | Приземляйтесь на носки обеих ног с согнутыми коленями и отведёнными назад бёдрами, мягко амортизируя удар, а не приземляясь жёстко. | The instant you land, transition forward and accelerate into a sprint, staying low for the first few steps and pumping your arms. | После нескольких мощных шагов поставьте внешнюю стопу, опустите бёдра и резко смените направление в выбранную сторону, оттолкнувшись опорной ногой. | Замедляйтесь контролируемо, вернитесь в исходное положение и повторите для заданного количества повторений, чередая направление движения.

t: Hold one rope handle in each hand with the rope behind your heels, elbows tucked close to your sides and your forearms angled slightly out. | Stand tall with your chest up, core braced, and weight balanced over the balls of your feet. | Swing the rope overhead by turning your wrists, not your whole arms, to start the rotation. | As the rope reaches your feet, drive through the balls of your feet and jump higher than a normal skip, bringing your knees up toward your hips. | Pass the rope under your feet during the airborne phase, keeping your jumps tall and your landings soft. | Land lightly on the balls of your feet with knees slightly bent to absorb the impact, then immediately rebound into the next high jump. | Keep a steady rhythm for your target time or interval, then slow the rope down and step out to finish.
tRu: Держите по одной ручке каната в каждой руке с канатом за пятками, локти прижаты к бокам и предплечья слегка разведены в стороны. | Stand tall with your chest up, core braced, and weight balanced over the balls of your feet. | Swing the rope overhead by turning your wrists, not your whole arms, to start the rotation. | Когда скакалка окажется у стоп, оттолкнитесь подушечками стоп и прыгните выше обычного скипа, подтянув колени к бёдрам. | Перенесите канат под ногами в фазе прыжка, сохраняя прыжки высокими, а приземления мягкими. | Приземляйтесь мягко на подушечку стопы с слегка согнутыми коленями, чтобы поглотить удар, затем сразу оттолкнитесь в следующий высокий прыжок. | Поддерживайте стабильный ритм в течение заданного времени или интервала, затем замедлите вращение каната и выйдите из упражнения.
tHe: Hold one rope handle in each hand with the rope behind your heels, elbows tucked close to your sides and your forearms angled slightly out. | Stand tall with your chest up, core braced, and weight balanced over the balls of your feet. | Swing the rope overhead by turning your wrists, not your whole arms, to start the rotation. | כשהחבל מגיע לרגליים, דחוף דרך כריות כפות הרגליים וקפוץ גבוה מדילוג רגיל, עם הבאת הברכיים לעבר האגן. | Pass the rope under your feet during the airborne phase, keeping your jumps tall and your landings soft. | Land lightly on the balls of your feet with knees slightly bent to absorb the impact, then immediately rebound into the next high jump. | Keep a steady rhythm for your target time or interval, then slow the rope down and step out to finish.

nR: Прыжки на скакалке с высоким коленом
t: Hold one rope handle in each hand with the rope resting behind your heels, elbows close to your sides and wrists relaxed. | Stand tall with your core braced, eyes forward, and weight balanced on the balls of your feet. | Swing the rope overhead using small wrist circles rather than large arm movements. | As the rope passes under you, drive your right knee up toward hip height and land softly on the left foot. | On the next pass, switch and drive the left knee up high, alternating knees with each rope turn. | Keep the rhythm quick and light, staying on the balls of your feet and absorbing each landing through the ankles. | Maintain an upright torso and steady breathing as you continue alternating knees for the set duration. | Slow the rope to a stop, lower your knees, and step out of the rope to finish.
tRu: Держите по одной ручке каната в каждой руке с канатом, лежащим за пятками, локти близко к бокам и расслабленные запястья. | Stand tall with your core braced, eyes forward, and weight balanced on the balls of your feet. | Swing the rope overhead using small wrist circles rather than large arm movements. | Когда скакалка проходит под вами, поднимите правое колено до уровня бедра и мягко приземлитесь на левую ногу. | На следующем обороте поменяйте и поднимите высоко левое колено, чередуя колени с каждым оборотом каната. | Держите ритм быстрым и лёгким, оставаясь на носках и амортизируя каждое приземление за счёт голеностопных суставов. | Сохраняйте прямое положение корпуса и устойчивое дыхание, продолжая чередовать колени в течение времени подхода. | Slow the rope to a stop, lower your knees, and step out of the rope to finish.
tHe: Hold one rope handle in each hand with the rope resting behind your heels, elbows close to your sides and wrists relaxed. | Stand tall with your core braced, eyes forward, and weight balanced on the balls of your feet. | Swing the rope overhead using small wrist circles rather than large arm movements. | כשהחבל עובר מתחתיך, הרם את ברך ימין לגובה האגן ונחת ברכות על רגל שמאל. | On the next pass, switch and drive the left knee up high, alternating knees with each rope turn. | Keep the rhythm quick and light, staying on the balls of your feet and absorbing each landing through the ankles. | Maintain an upright torso and steady breathing as you continue alternating knees for the set duration. | Slow the rope to a stop, lower your knees, and step out of the rope to finish.

nE: High Knee Lunge on Bosu Ball
nR: Выпады с высоким коленом на босу
t: Place the Bosu ball dome-side up on a flat, non-slip surface and stand a stride-length in front of it with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced. | Step one foot back onto the center of the dome, finding your balance on the soft, unstable surface. | Lower into a lunge, bending both knees toward roughly 90° while keeping your front knee stacked over your ankle and your torso upright. | Drive hard through your front foot and push off the dome to stand up explosively. | As you rise, drive the rear knee up toward your chest into a high-knee position, swinging the opposite arm forward for momentum and balance. | Control your descent and step the same foot back onto the dome to begin the next rep, keeping your movements rhythmic. | Complete your reps on one side, then switch legs and repeat, or alternate legs each rep for a continuous aerobic pace. | Step off the dome with control to finish, and reset your balance before the next set.
tRu: Поставьте мяч Bosu выпуклой стороной вверх на плоскую, нескользящую поверхность и встаньте на шаг вперед от него, ноги на ширине тазобедренных суставов, корпус напряжен. | Step one foot back onto the center of the dome, finding your balance on the soft, unstable surface. | Опуститесь в выпад, сгибая оба колена примерно под углом 90°, сохраняя колено передней ноги над лодыжкой, а корпус вертикальным. | Сильно оттолкнитесь передней ногой и оттолкнитесь от купола, чтобы взрывно встать. | Поднимаясь, подтяните заднее колено к груди в высокое положение, выводя вперёд противоположную руку для импульса и равновесия. | Контролируйте опускание и ту же ногой шагайте обратно на платформу для начала следующего повторения, сохраняя ритмичность движений. | Выполните все повторения на одну сторону, затем поменяйте ноги и повторите, либо меняйте ноги при каждом повторении для непрерывного кардиотемп. | Step off the dome with control to finish, and reset your balance before the next set.
tHe: Place the Bosu ball dome-side up on a flat, non-slip surface and stand a stride-length in front of it with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced. | Step one foot back onto the center of the dome, finding your balance on the soft, unstable surface. | Lower into a lunge, bending both knees toward roughly 90° while keeping your front knee stacked over your ankle and your torso upright. | דחוף בכוח דרך כף הרגל הקדמית ודוחף מהכדור כדי לקום עמידה בכוח. | בעלייה, דחוף את ברך הגב למעלה לעבר החזה למנח היי־ני, תוך הנפת הזרוע הנגדית קדימה למומנטום ואיזון. | שלוט בירידה חזרה למצב הסקוואט וצעד באותו רגל חזרה על הכדור כדי להתחיל את החזרה הבאה, שומר על תנועות קצביות. | בצע את כל החזרות בצד אחד, ואז החלף רגליים וחזור על התרגיל, או החלף רגליים בכל חזרה לקצב אירובי רציף. | Step off the dome with control to finish, and reset your balance before the next set.

t: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, chest up, and arms bent to about 90 degrees at your sides. | Brace your core and rise onto the balls of your feet, keeping your shoulders relaxed and back. | Drive one knee up quickly until your thigh is roughly parallel to the floor, at hip height. | As that foot returns to the ground, immediately drive the opposite knee up to the same height. | Pump your arms in time with your legs, driving the opposite arm to each lifted knee. | Land softly on the balls of your feet with quick, light ground contacts and a tall posture. | Continue alternating knees at a fast cadence for the set time or distance, keeping your hips level. | Slow the cadence gradually to a stop, then walk for a few seconds to recover.

tHe: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, chest up, and arms bent to about 90 degrees at your sides. | הדק את הליבה ועלה על כריות כפות הרגליים, תוך שמירת הכתפיים משוחררות ולאחור. | הניע במהירות את ברך אחת עד שירך מקביל לרצפה בערך, בגובה הירך. | כשהרגל חוזרת לקרקע, הרם מיד את הברך הנגדית לאותו גובה. | Pump your arms in time with your legs, driving the opposite arm to each lifted knee. | Land softly on the balls of your feet with quick, light ground contacts and a tall posture. | המשילו להחליף בין ברכיים בקצב מהיר למשך זמן או מרחק המוגדרים, ושמרו על מותניים באותו גובה. | Slow the cadence gradually to a stop, then walk for a few seconds to recover.

t: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, chest up, and arms bent at about 90° by your sides. | Begin with high knees: drive one knee up toward hip height while pushing off the ball of the opposite foot. | Quickly switch legs, pumping your arms in opposition to your legs to keep a fast, light running-in-place rhythm. | After your set number of reps or seconds, transition to butt kicks without stopping. | For butt kicks, flick each heel back to lightly tap your glute, keeping your thighs roughly vertical and your torso upright. | Keep landing softly on the balls of your feet, staying quick and springy rather than heavy. | Alternate between the high-knees and butt-kick phases for your work interval, breathing steadily throughout. | Slow to a march and stop once the interval is complete, then recover before the next round.

t: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, chest up, and arms relaxed at your sides. | Drive one knee up explosively toward your chest, raising the same-side or opposite arm for balance. | As that leg comes down, step it straight back into a reverse lunge, lowering until both knees bend to roughly 90°. | Keep your front shin vertical and your torso upright, with your back knee hovering just above the floor. | Push hard through your front foot to drive back up and immediately fire the same knee up toward your chest again. | Move with a quick, controlled rhythm, exhaling on each knee drive and keeping your core braced. | Complete your reps on one leg, then switch sides, or alternate legs each rep for a continuous flow. | Slow the pace toward the end of the set and step your feet together to finish.

t: Stand tall with your feet about shoulder-width apart, chest up and arms relaxed at your sides. | Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower into a squat until your thighs are roughly parallel to the floor. | Drive through your feet and stand up explosively out of the squat. | As you rise, drive one knee up toward your chest while swinging the opposite arm forward. | Lower that foot back to the floor and immediately descend into your next squat. | Stand up explosively again, this time driving the opposite knee up toward your chest. | Keep alternating knees on each rep, staying light on the balls of your feet. | Continue at a steady, controlled pace for your set time or rep count, then come to a stop.

t: Stand facing a sturdy, knee-height box or step with your feet hip-width apart and your core braced. | Place your right foot fully onto the box, keeping the whole sole in contact and your knee tracking over your toes. | Drive through your right heel to stand tall on the box, straightening your hip and knee. | As you reach the top, explosively pull your left knee up high in front of you until your thigh is at least parallel to the ground. | Hold the balanced top position briefly, keeping your chest up and standing leg stable. | Step your left foot back down to the floor under control, then bring your right foot down to follow. | Reset your stance, then repeat leading with the same leg for your reps before switching sides. | Keep a steady, rhythmic pace to maintain an aerobic heart rate throughout the set.

t: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, chest up, and arms bent at about 90 degrees by your sides. | Begin by driving one knee up toward your chest while staying light on the ball of your standing foot. | Quickly switch legs, driving the opposite knee up so you settle into a marching or running rhythm on the spot. | After a set count or a few seconds of high knees, transition into butt kicks by snapping your heels back to lightly tap your glutes. | Pump your arms in time with your legs, keeping your core braced and your torso upright throughout. | Stay on the balls of your feet with quick, light ground contacts rather than heavy, flat-footed landings. | Alternate between phases of high knees and butt kicks for the prescribed time or reps. | Gradually slow your cadence to a walk to finish, then let your breathing and heart rate settle.
tRu: Встаньте прямо, поставив ноги на ширине бёдер, грудь вверх, руки согнуты под углом около 90 градусов вдоль тела. | Начните с подъёма одного колена к груди, оставаясь на подушечке опорной стопы. | Quickly switch legs, driving the opposite knee up so you settle into a marching or running rhythm on the spot. | После заданного количества или нескольких секунд бега с высоким подниманием бедра перейдите к захлёстам голени, касаясь пятками ягодиц. | Pump your arms in time with your legs, keeping your core braced and your torso upright throughout. | Stay on the balls of your feet with quick, light ground contacts rather than heavy, flat-footed landings. | Чередуйте фазы высокого поднимания коленей и захлёстов голени заданное время или число повторений. | Постепенно замедлите темп ходьбой, чтобы закончить, затем дайте вашему дыханию и сердечному ритму прийти в норму.
tHe: עמוד זקוף עם רגליים ברוחב האגן, חזה מורם, וידיים כפופות בערך ב-90 מעלות לצדי הגוף. | התחל בהנפת ברך אחת לכיוון החזה תוך שמירה על עמידה קלה על כרית כף הרגל העומדת. | Quickly switch legs, driving the opposite knee up so you settle into a marching or running rhythm on the spot. | אחרי מספר חזרות או כמה שניות של ברכיים גבוהות, עבור לבעיטות עקב לישבן על ידי הקפצת העקבים לאחור לנגיעה קלה בישבן. | Pump your arms in time with your legs, keeping your core braced and your torso upright throughout. | Stay on the balls of your feet with quick, light ground contacts rather than heavy, flat-footed landings. | החלף בין שלבי ברכיים גבוהות ובעיטות לישבן למשך הזמן או מספר החזרות שנקבע. | האט בהדרגה את הקצב להליכה כדי לסיים, ואז תן לנשימה ולדופק להתאזן.

t: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, chest up, and core braced. | Bend your elbows and hold your hands in front of your chest to give your torso something to rotate around. | Drive one knee up toward hip height while staying balanced on the standing leg. | As the knee rises, twist your torso so the opposite elbow rotates across toward that lifted knee. | Lower the leg and return your torso to center under control. | Repeat on the other side, driving the opposite knee up and twisting toward it. | Continue alternating sides at a steady, rhythmic pace for the desired time or rep count. | Keep landing softly through the balls of your feet and finish with a few easy marches to recover.
tRu: Встаньте прямо, поставив ноги на ширине бёдер, грудь вверх, напрягите корпус. | Согните локти и держите кисти перед грудью, чтобы корпусу было легче вращаться. | Поднимите одно колено до уровня бедра, сохраняя равновесие на опорной ноге. | Когда колено поднимается, скрутите корпус так, чтобы противоположный локоть потянулся к поднятому колену. | С контролем опустите ногу и верните корпус в центральное положение. | Repeat on the other side, driving the opposite knee up and twisting toward it. | Продолжайте попеременно менять стороны в устойчивом, ритмичном темпе в течение заданного времени или количества повторений. | Мягко приземляйтесь на носки и закончите несколькими лёгкими шагами на месте для восстановления.
tHe: עמוד זקוף עם רגליים ברוחב האגן, חזה מורם, וליבה מכווצת. | כופף את המרפקים והחזק את הידיים מול החזה כדי לתת לגוף ציר להסתובב סביבו. | הניע את ברך אחת לכיוון גובה הירך, תוך שאת שומר על איזון על הרגל העומדת. | כשהברך עולה, סובב את הגו כך שהמרפק הנגדי יסתובב לעבר הברך המורמת. | Lower the leg and return your torso to center under control. | Repeat on the other side, driving the opposite knee up and twisting toward it. | המשילו להחליף צדדים בקצב יציב וקצבי למספר החזרות או הזמן הרצוי. | Keep landing softly through the balls of your feet and finish with a few easy marches to recover.

t: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, chest up, shoulders back, and arms bent at about 90 degrees. | Brace your core lightly and shift your weight onto one foot. | Drive the opposite knee up in front of you until your thigh is roughly parallel to the floor. | Swing your opposite arm forward in time with the knee to keep your rhythm balanced. | Step that foot down softly under your hips and immediately drive the other knee up. | Continue marching forward, alternating knees in a smooth, controlled rhythm. | Keep your torso upright throughout, avoiding any backward lean. | Finish by slowing your pace to a normal walk and letting your breathing settle.
tRu: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, chest up, shoulders back, and arms bent at about 90 degrees. | Легко напрягите пресс и перенесите вес на одну ногу. | Оттолките противоположное колено вперёд до тех пор, пока бедро не окажется примерно параллельно полу. | Swing your opposite arm forward in time with the knee to keep your rhythm balanced. | Step that foot down softly under your hips and immediately drive the other knee up. | Продолжайте шагать вперед, попеременно сгибая колени в плавном и контролируемом ритме. | Держите корпус прямо на протяжении всего движения; избегайте отклонения назад, когда поднимающаяся нога поднимается. | Завершите упражнение, замедлив темп до обычной ходьбы и позволив дыханию восстановиться.
tHe: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, chest up, shoulders back, and arms bent at about 90 degrees. | הדק קלות את הליבה והעבר את המשקל לרגל אחת. | דחוף את הברך הנגדית כלפי מעלה מולך עד שהירך מקבילה לרצפה בערך. | Swing your opposite arm forward in time with the knee to keep your rhythm balanced. | Step that foot down softly under your hips and immediately drive the other knee up. | המשיכו לצעוד קדימה, עם החלפת הברכיים בקצב חלק ומבוקר. | Keep your torso upright throughout, avoiding any backward lean. | סיים בהאטת הקצב להליכה רגילה והרגעת הנשימה.

t: Start standing tall, then step one foot back into a long stride, keeping your feet about hip-width apart for balance. | Bend your front knee until it stacks directly over your ankle, with the shin close to vertical. | Keep your back leg straight and strong, pressing through the ball of the back foot with the heel lifted off the floor. | Square your hips toward the front of the mat and draw your tailbone gently down to lengthen the front of the back hip. | Lengthen your spine, lift your chest, and let your arms rest at your sides or reach them overhead. | Settle into the position and breathe slowly, sinking a little deeper into the hips with each exhale. | Hold for 20–40 seconds, feeling the stretch through the back-leg hip flexor and the front-leg hamstring. | Press through your front foot to step back to standing, then repeat on the other side.
tRu: Start standing tall, then step one foot back into a long stride, keeping your feet about hip-width apart for balance. | Согните переднее колено так, чтобы оно оказалось строго над лодыжкой, а голень была почти вертикальной. | Держите заднюю ногу прямой и напряжённой, активно отталкиваясь передней частью стопы, с пяткой, оторванной от пола. | Square your hips toward the front of the mat and draw your tailbone gently down to lengthen the front of the back hip. | Вытягивайте позвоночник, поднимайте грудь и опустите руки вдоль тела или поднимите их над головой. | Settle into the position and breathe slowly, sinking a little deeper into the hips with each exhale. | Удерживайте 20–40 секунд, ощущая растяжение в сгибателях бедра задней ноги и в задней поверхности бедра передней ноги. | Press through your front foot to step back to standing, then repeat on the other side.
tHe: Start standing tall, then step one foot back into a long stride, keeping your feet about hip-width apart for balance. | כופף את הברך הקדמית עד שהיא מוערמת ישירות מעל הקרסול, כשהשוק קרובה לאנכית. | Keep your back leg straight and strong, pressing through the ball of the back foot with the heel lifted off the floor. | Square your hips toward the front of the mat and draw your tailbone gently down to lengthen the front of the back hip. | Lengthen your spine, lift your chest, and let your arms rest at your sides or reach them overhead. | Settle into the position and breathe slowly, sinking a little deeper into the hips with each exhale. | Hold for 20–40 seconds, feeling the stretch through the back-leg hip flexor and the front-leg hamstring. | Press through your front foot to step back to standing, then repeat on the other side.

t: Stand tall beside a wall or sturdy support, feet hip-width apart, with one hand resting on the support for balance. | Brace your core and keep your standing leg slightly soft, hips level and squared forward. | Slowly lift the outside leg directly out to the side, leading with the knee and keeping the foot relaxed. | Articulate through the full pain-free range, feeling a gentle stretch along the inner thigh as the leg travels away from your midline. | Pause briefly at the top of your comfortable range without letting your torso tip or your hip hike up. | Lower the leg back to the start under control, resisting the movement the whole way down. | Complete your reps on one side, keeping the tempo slow and the motion smooth, then switch legs and repeat.
tRu: Stand tall beside a wall or sturdy support, feet hip-width apart, with one hand resting on the support for balance. | Напрягите корпус и держите опорную ногу слегка мягкой, а бёдра — на одном уровне и направленными вперёд. | Slowly lift the outside leg directly out to the side, leading with the knee and keeping the foot relaxed. | Двигайтесь в полной безболезненной амплитуде, чувствуя мягкое растяжение внутренней поверхности бедра при отведении ноги от средней линии. | На мгновение остановитесь в верхней точке вашего комфортного диапазона, не давая корпусу наклоняться или бедру подниматься. | С контролем опустите ногу в исходное положение, сопротивляясь движению на всем пути вниз. | Выполните все повторения на одну сторону, сохраняя медленный темп и плавное движение, затем поменяйте ноги и повторите.
tHe: Stand tall beside a wall or sturdy support, feet hip-width apart, with one hand resting on the support for balance. | הדק את הליבה ושמור על רגל העמידה רכה קלות, עם אגן מאוזן ומרובע קדימה. | Slowly lift the outside leg directly out to the side, leading with the knee and keeping the foot relaxed. | נוע דרך כל הטווח ללא כאב, תוך הרגשת מתיחה עדינה לאורך הירך הפנימית כשהרגל מתרחקת מקו האמצע. | Pause briefly at the top of your comfortable range without letting your torso tip or your hip hike up. | Lower the leg back to the start under control, resisting the movement the whole way down. | בצע את כל החזרות בצד אחד, שמור על קצב איטי ותנועה חלקה, ואז החלף רגליים וחזור על התרגיל.

nE: Hip Abduction With Flexion In Front Stretch
nR: Растяжка отведения бедра со сгибанием спереди
nH: מתיחת הרחקת ירך עם כפיפה מלפנים
t: Start seated upright on the floor with both legs extended in front of you and your spine tall. | Bend one knee and draw that foot toward you, then guide the bent leg out to the side so the knee opens away from your midline (abduction) while the thigh stays flexed in front of your body. | Rest the outer ankle or shin of the bent leg comfortably on the floor or across the opposite thigh, keeping the knee relaxed. | Sit tall and gently hinge forward from your hips over the bent leg until you feel a stretch through the outer hip and glute region. | Hold the position and breathe slowly, letting the hip ease open a little more with each exhale rather than forcing it. | Keep the hold for 20–30 seconds without bouncing, staying within a comfortable range of motion. | Slowly come back upright, extend the leg, and release the position with control. | Repeat on the other side so both hips are stretched evenly.
tRu: Start seated upright on the floor with both legs extended in front of you and your spine tall. | Согните одну ногу и подтяните стопу к себе, затем отведите согнутое колено в сторону от средней линии, удерживая бедро впереди корпуса. | Rest the outer ankle or shin of the bent leg comfortably on the floor or across the opposite thigh, keeping the knee relaxed. | Sit tall and gently hinge forward from your hips over the bent leg until you feel a stretch through the outer hip and glute region. | Задержите позицию и дышите медленно, позволяя тазобедренному суставу открываться всё больше с каждым выдохом, а не форсируя это движение. | Держите растяжку 20–30 секунд без пружинящих движений, оставаясь в комфортном диапазоне движения. | Slowly come back upright, extend the leg, and release the position with control. | Repeat on the other side so both hips are stretched evenly.
tHe: Start seated upright on the floor with both legs extended in front of you and your spine tall. | כופף ברך אחת ומשוך את כף הרגל אליך, ואז הובל את הרגל הכפופה הצידה כך שהברך נפתחת הרחק מקו האמצע (הרחקה) כשהירך נשארת כפופה מול הגוף. | Rest the outer ankle or shin of the bent leg comfortably on the floor or across the opposite thigh, keeping the knee relaxed. | Sit tall and gently hinge forward from your hips over the bent leg until you feel a stretch through the outer hip and glute region. | Hold the position and breathe slowly, letting the hip ease open a little more with each exhale rather than forcing it. | Keep the hold for 20–30 seconds without bouncing, staying within a comfortable range of motion. | Slowly come back upright, extend the leg, and release the position with control. | Repeat on the other side so both hips are stretched evenly.

t: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, core lightly braced, and hold a wall or rack with one hand for balance. | Shift your weight onto your supporting leg and let the working leg hang relaxed beside it. | Slowly draw the working leg across the front of your body, leading with the inner thigh until you feel a gentle stretch through the groin and adductors. | Pause briefly at the end of the range without forcing it, keeping your hips square and your torso upright. | Return the leg under control to the starting position, resisting the urge to let it swing. | Repeat the articulation for 8 to 12 smooth, controlled reps, increasing the range slightly as the adductors loosen. | Switch sides and repeat the same number of controlled reps with the other leg.
tRu: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, core lightly braced, and hold a wall or rack with one hand for balance. | Shift your weight onto your supporting leg and let the working leg hang relaxed beside it. | Slowly draw the working leg across the front of your body, leading with the inner thigh until you feel a gentle stretch through the groin and adductors. | На мгновение остановитесь в конце амплитуды, не форсируя, удерживая таз параллельным полу, а корпус вертикальным. | Return the leg under control to the starting position, resisting the urge to let it swing. | Repeat the articulation for 8 to 12 smooth, controlled reps, increasing the range slightly as the adductors loosen. | Switch sides and repeat the same number of controlled reps with the other leg.
