Your hands should not actually move. | Maintain this inward pressing force while simultaneously feeling your chest muscles contract hard across the sternum. | Hold the isometric contraction for the target duration (typically 3–10 seconds per rep), breathing steadily throughout. | Release the tension under control, then rest briefly before repeating for the desired number of holds.

t: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, dominant foot back, lead foot forward in a staggered boxing stance. | Raise your fists to chin height with elbows tucked close to your sides and chin slightly tucked. | Shift a small amount of weight onto your lead foot as you prepare to punch. | Extend your lead arm straight forward in a quick, snapping motion, rotating your fist so the palm faces down at full extension. | Keep your rear hand up by your cheek throughout the movement to protect your face. | Snap your lead arm back to the guard position immediately after extension — do not let it linger. | Exhale sharply on each punch to engage your core and maintain breathing rhythm. | Maintain a light bend in both knees and stay on the balls of your feet to keep the movement dynamic. | Repeat for the desired number of reps or time interval, maintaining consistent speed and form.
tRu: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, dominant foot back, lead foot forward in a staggered boxing stance. | Raise your fists to chin height with elbows tucked close to your sides and chin slightly tucked. | Shift a small amount of weight onto your lead foot as you prepare to punch. | Вытяните ведущую руку прямо вперед резким, отрывистым движением, поворачивая кулак так, чтобы ладонь была обращена вниз в полной амплитуде. | Держите заднюю руку у щеки на протяжении всего движения, чтобы защитить лицо. | Snap your lead arm back to the guard position immediately after extension — do not let it linger. | Резко выдыхайте при каждом ударе, чтобы вовлечь мышцы пресса и поддерживать ритм дыхания. | Сохраните лёгкий сгиб в обоих коленях и оставайтесь на носках ног, чтобы сохранить динамику движения. | Repeat for the desired number of reps or time interval, maintaining consistent speed and form.
tHe: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, dominant foot back, lead foot forward in a staggered boxing stance. | Raise your fists to chin height with elbows tucked close to your sides and chin slightly tucked. | Shift a small amount of weight onto your lead foot as you prepare to punch. | פתח את זרוע ההובלה ישר קדימה בתנועה מהירה וחדה, וסובב את אגודל כך שכף היד פונה למטה בהישענות מלאה. | Keep your rear hand up by your cheek throughout the movement to protect your face. | Snap your lead arm back to the guard position immediately after extension — do not let it linger. | זרום אויר בחדות בכל אגרוף כדי לאמץ את שרירי הליבה ולשמור על קצב נשימה. | Maintain a light bend in both knees and stay on the balls of your feet to keep the movement dynamic. | Repeat for the desired number of reps or time interval, maintaining consistent speed and form.

t: Stand tall with your feet together and arms at your sides. | Hinge at the hips, bend your knees, and place both hands on the floor shoulder-width apart just in front of your feet. | Jump or step both feet back simultaneously to a high-plank position, landing with your feet wider than hip-width apart in a jack position. | Lower your chest to the floor under control, keeping your elbows at roughly a 45° angle to your torso. | Press back up to a full plank, straightening your arms completely. | Jump your feet together and then forward toward your hands, returning to a low squat position. | Drive through your feet and swing your arms overhead to jump explosively off the ground. | Land softly with slightly bent knees, absorbing the impact, then immediately move into the next rep.
tRu: Stand tall with your feet together and arms at your sides. | Отведите бёра назад, возьмите ручку гири и отведите её назад между ногами, чтобы нагрузить заднюю цепь — как в начале свинга. | Прыгните или шагните обеими ногами одновременно в положение высокой планки, приземлившись ногами шире бёдер в положении "джека". | Подконтрольно опустите грудь к полу, удерживая локти под углом примерно 45° к корпусу. | Press back up to a full plank, straightening your arms completely. | Прыгните ногами вместе, затем вперед к рукам, вернувшись в положение низкого приседания. | Отталкивайтесь стопами и поднимите руки над головой, чтобы мощно оторваться от пола. | Приземлитесь мягко, слегка согнув колени, амортизируя удар, и сразу же переходите к следующему повторению.
tHe: Stand tall with your feet together and arms at your sides. | כופף בציר הירך, כופף את הברכיים והנח את שתי הידיים על הרצפה ברוחב הכתפיים ממש לפני כפות הרגליים. | Jump or step both feet back simultaneously to a high-plank position, landing with your feet wider than hip-width apart in a jack position. | הורד את החזה לרצפה בשליטה, תוך שמירה על מרפקים בזווית של כ-45° לגוף. | Press back up to a full plank, straightening your arms completely. | Jump your feet together and then forward toward your hands, returning to a low squat position. | דחוף באמצעות כפות הרגליים והניף את ידיך מעל הראש כדי לקפוץ פיצוצית מהקרקע. | Land softly with slightly bent knees, absorbing the impact, then immediately move into the next rep.

t: Stand tall with your feet together and your arms at your sides. | Engage your core and keep a soft bend in your knees to protect your joints. | Push through the balls of your feet and jump explosively off the ground. | As you leave the floor, simultaneously spread your feet out to roughly shoulder-width apart and raise both arms out and upward in a wide arc. | Land softly with your feet wide and arms raised, absorbing the impact through your ankles, knees, and hips — avoid locking your knees on landing. | Immediately jump again, bringing your feet back together and lowering your arms to your sides as you return to the starting position. | Continue alternating between the wide and narrow positions in a smooth, rhythmic cadence for the desired number of reps or duration.
tRu: Встаньте прямо, поставив стопы вместе, руки вдоль тела. | Напрягите мышцы кора и сохраняйте мягкий сгиб в коленях, чтобы защитить суставы. | Push through the balls of your feet and jump explosively off the ground. | Отрываясь от пола, одновременно расставьте ноги примерно на ширину плеч и поднимите обе руки в стороны и вверх по широкой дуге. | Приземлитесь мягко, ноги на ширине и руки подняты, амортизируя удар через лодыжки, колени и бёдра — не разгибайте колени до конца при приземлении. | Сразу же прыгните снова, вернув ноги вместе и опустив руки по бокам, когда вы возвращаетесь в исходное положение. | Продолжайте поочерёдно переходить от широкого к узкому положению в плавном, ритмичном темпе на заданное количество повторений или время.
tHe: עמוד זקוף עם רגליים צמודות וידיים לצדי הגוף. | הפעל את שרירי הליבה ושמור על כיפוף קל בברכים כדי להגן על המפרקים. | Push through the balls of your feet and jump explosively off the ground. | בעזיבת הרצפה, פשק בו־זמנית את הרגליים בערך לרוחב הכתפיים והרם את שתי הזרועות הצידה ומעלה בקשת רחבה. | Land softly with your feet wide and arms raised, absorbing the impact through your ankles, knees, and hips — avoid locking your knees on landing. | Immediately jump again, bringing your feet back together and lowering your arms to your sides as you return to the starting position. | המשיל להחליף בין העמדות הרחבות לצרות בקצב חלק וקצבי למספר החזרות או הזמן הרצוי.

t: Stand tall with your feet together or hip-width apart and your arms hanging at your sides. | Inhale to lengthen your spine, then hinge forward from your hips — not your waist — keeping your back as flat as possible. | Let your torso lower toward your legs as you reach both hands down toward your shins, ankles, or feet, depending on your flexibility. | Keep a slight, soft bend in your knees to avoid locking them out and to protect the knee joints. | Hold the bottom position for 20–40 seconds, breathing steadily and relaxing deeper into the stretch on each exhale. | To come out of the stretch, engage your core lightly, then slowly roll back up one vertebra at a time until you are standing upright. | Reset your posture, then repeat for the desired number of holds or sets.
tRu: Stand tall with your feet together or hip-width apart and your arms hanging at your sides. | Вдыхайте, чтобы вытянуть позвоночник, затем сгибайтесь в тазобедренных суставах — а не в талии — сохраняя спину как можно более прямой. | Позвольте вашему корпусу естественным образом поворачиваться с движением руки, пока задняя рука поднимается назад. | Сохраните мягкий сгиб в коленях, чтобы не выпрямлять их до конца и защищать суставы. | Держите нижнее положение в течение 20-40 секунд, дыша ровно и расслабляясь глубже в растяжку с каждым выдохом. | To come out of the stretch, engage your core lightly, then slowly roll back up one vertebra at a time until you are standing upright. | Reset your posture, then repeat for the desired number of holds or sets.
tHe: Stand tall with your feet together or hip-width apart and your arms hanging at your sides. | Inhale to lengthen your spine, then hinge forward from your hips — not your waist — keeping your back as flat as possible. | Let your torso lower toward your legs as you reach both hands down toward your shins, ankles, or feet, depending on your flexibility. | Keep a slight, soft bend in your knees to avoid locking them out and to protect the knee joints. | Hold the bottom position for 20–40 seconds, breathing steadily and relaxing deeper into the stretch on each exhale. | To come out of the stretch, engage your core lightly, then slowly roll back up one vertebra at a time until you are standing upright. | Reset your posture, then repeat for the desired number of holds or sets.

t: Lie flat on your back on the floor with your legs extended and your arms reaching overhead, close to your ears. | Keep your lower back in contact with the floor and brace your core before you begin. | In one controlled motion, lift your legs and your upper body simultaneously, reaching your hands toward your feet at the top. | Keep your knees as straight as possible and your arms close to your ears as both halves of your body rise. | Aim to bring your hands and feet close together above your hips at the peak of the movement, forming a V-shape with your body. | Hold the top position for a brief moment, feeling the contraction in your abs. | Lower your legs and upper body back to the starting position in a slow, controlled manner. | Allow your arms to return overhead and your back to return to the floor before initiating the next rep.
tRu: Лягте на спину на пол с выпрямленными ногами и руками, вытянутыми над головой, близко к ушам. | Держите поясницу в контакте с полом и напрягите корпус перед началом. | В одном контролируемом движении одновременно поднимите ноги и верхнюю часть тела, дотянувшись руками до ног в верхней точке. | Держите колени как можно более прямыми и руки близко к ушам, когда обе половины вашего тела поднимаются. | В верхней точке старайтесь сблизить руки и ноги над бёдрами, образуя телом форму галочки. | Удерживайте верхнюю точку в течение короткого времени, чувствуя сокращение в прессе. | Медленно опустите ноги и верхнюю часть тела обратно в исходное положение. | Верните руки за голову, а спину — на пол, прежде чем начинать следующее повторение.
tHe: Lie flat on your back on the floor with your legs extended and your arms reaching overhead, close to your ears. | Keep your lower back in contact with the floor and brace your core before you begin. | In one controlled motion, lift your legs and your upper body simultaneously, reaching your hands toward your feet at the top. | Keep your knees as straight as possible and your arms close to your ears as both halves of your body rise. | שאף לקרב את הידיים והרגליים זו לזו מעל האגן בשיא התנועה, ליצירת צורת וי עם הגוף. | Hold the top position for a brief moment, feeling the contraction in your abs. | Lower your legs and upper body back to the starting position in a slow, controlled manner. | תן לידיים לחזור מעל הראש ולגב לחזור לרצפה לפני תחילת החזרה הבאה.

t: Place a stability ball on the floor and kneel behind it. Roll forward over the ball until your shins rest on top of it and your hands are planted on the floor directly under your shoulders in a push-up position. | Brace your core and align your body in a straight line from head to heels, keeping your hips level and your back flat. | Exhale and pull your knees toward your chest by contracting your abs and hip flexors, allowing the ball to roll forward toward your hands. | Continue rolling until your knees are tucked as close to your chest as your range of motion comfortably allows, keeping your hips from rising too high. | Pause briefly at the top of the contraction, feeling the squeeze in your rectus abdominis. | Inhale and slowly extend your legs back to the starting position, controlling the ball as it rolls away from you. | Return to a straight-body plank position without letting your hips sag, and repeat for the desired number of reps.

tHe: Lie on your back with your knees bent at roughly 90 degrees and your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. | Place your hands behind your head with your fingers lightly supporting your skull — avoid interlacing them and pulling on your neck. | חדור את העקבים בכוח לרצפה וכווץ את שרירי האזור האחורי והגלוטיאל באופן פעיל כאילו אתה מנסה למשוך את העקבים לכיוון המותניים. שמור על הכיווץ הזה לאורך כל הסט. | Keeping your chin slightly tucked, curl your torso upward by drawing your ribcage toward your pelvis, leading with your chest rather than your elbows. | המשך לעלות רק עד שהבטן מכווצת במלואה — בערך כשכתפיים והגב האמצעי עזבו את הרצפה — ועצור לפני שהמותניים משתלטות. | עצור קצרות למעלה וכווץ את הבטן. | Lower yourself back down under control, maintaining the heel-pressing tension the entire way. | חזור על התרגיל למספר החזרות הרצוי.

t: Place a sturdy, low-to-medium-height box on a flat, non-slip surface and stand to one side of it with your feet hip-width apart. | Bend your knees slightly and load your hips back into an athletic quarter-squat stance, keeping your chest up and your core braced. | Swing your arms back, then drive them forward as you push explosively through both feet to jump laterally over the box. | Clear the box with both feet and land softly on the opposite side, absorbing impact by bending your knees and hinging slightly at the hips. | Stay on the balls of your feet and do not pause — immediately rebound and jump back over the box to the starting side. | Maintain a consistent, controlled rhythm throughout the set, keeping each landing quiet and controlled before the next take-off. | Complete the prescribed number of reps or time interval, then step away from the box and rest.
tRu: Положите sturdy, low-to-medium-height box на flat, non-slip surface и встаньте сбоку от нее с ногами на ширине таза. | Слегка согните ноги и отведите бёдра назад в спортивную стойку четверть-приседа, удерживая грудь поднятой, а пресс в напряжении. | Swing your arms back, then drive them forward as you push explosively through both feet to jump laterally over the box. | Перешагните через ящик обеими ногами и мягко приземлитесь с другой стороны, amortизируя удар, сгибая колени и немного отводя бёдра назад. | Stay on the balls of your feet and do not pause — immediately rebound and jump back over the box to the starting side. | Держите стабильный, контролируемый ритм в течение всего подхода, приземляясь тихо и контролируемо перед каждым следующим прыжком. | Выполните указанное количество повторений или время, затем отойдите от платформы и отдохните.
tHe: Place a sturdy, low-to-medium-height box on a flat, non-slip surface and stand to one side of it with your feet hip-width apart. | כופף קלות את הברכיים וטען את האגן לאחור לעמדת רבע סקוואט אתלטית, תוך שמירה על חזה מורם וליבה מהודקת. | Swing your arms back, then drive them forward as you push explosively through both feet to jump laterally over the box. | נקם את הקופסה עם שתי הרגליים ונחת בעדינות בצד השני, בקליטת הזעזוע על ידי כיפוף הברכיים והטייה קלה במותניים. | Stay on the balls of your feet and do not pause — immediately rebound and jump back over the box to the starting side. | Maintain a consistent, controlled rhythm throughout the set, keeping each landing quiet and controlled before the next take-off. | בצע את מספר החזרות או המשך הזמן המרוקן, ואז צעד הרחק מהקופסה ונח.

t: Sit on the edge of a sturdy bench, box, or chair with your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart and positioned directly beneath your knees. | Place your hands on your thighs or extend them forward for balance — do not use them to push off the surface. | Lean your torso slightly forward from the hips and shift your weight onto the balls of your feet. | Take a breath and brace your core firmly before initiating the movement. | Swing your arms forward and upward as you initiate the jump — the arm swing must lead the drive, not follow it. | Drive explosively through both feet at the same time, pressing the floor away as you extend your hips, knees, and ankles simultaneously to launch yourself upward. | Land softly with both feet at the same time, absorbing impact by bending at the ankles, knees, and hips into a partial squat. | Reset to the seated position with control and repeat for the desired number of reps.
tRu: Sit on the edge of a sturdy bench, box, or chair with your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart and positioned directly beneath your knees. | Положите руки на бёдра или вытяните их вперёд для баланса — не используйте их для отталкивания от поверхности. | Слегка наклоните корпус вперед от бедер и перенесите вес на подушечки стоп. | Take a breath and brace your core firmly before initiating the movement. | Swing your arms forward and upward as you initiate the jump — the arm swing must lead the drive, not follow it. | Взрывно оттолкнитесь обеими ногами одновременно, отталкиваясь от пола, одновременно разгибая тазобедренные, коленные и голеностопные суставы, чтобы оттолкнуть себя вверх. | Приземлитесь мягко на обе ноги одновременно, амортизируя удар сгибанием лодыжек, коленей и бёдер в неполный присед. | Reset to the seated position with control and repeat for the desired number of reps.
tHe: Sit on the edge of a sturdy bench, box, or chair with your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart and positioned directly beneath your knees. | Place your hands on your thighs or extend them forward for balance — do not use them to push off the surface. | Lean your torso slightly forward from the hips and shift your weight onto the balls of your feet. | Take a breath and brace your core firmly before initiating the movement. | Swing your arms forward and upward as you initiate the jump — the arm swing must lead the drive, not follow it. | דחוף בפיצוץ דרך שתי הרגליים בו זמנית, דוחף את הרצפה הרחק ממך בזמן שאתה מתישר דרך הירכיים, הברכים והקרסוליים כדי להטיל את עצמך למעלה. | Land softly with both feet at the same time, absorbing impact by bending at the ankles, knees, and hips into a partial squat. | Reset to the seated position with control and repeat for the desired number of reps.

t: Stand tall with your feet together, arms relaxed at your sides, and your core lightly braced. | Jump your feet out to shoulder width while simultaneously raising both arms overhead, as in a standard jumping jack. | Jump your feet back together, then immediately drive your right knee up toward your chest as high as you comfortably can while your arms swing down to meet it. | Lower your right foot and repeat the jumping jack: feet out, arms overhead. | Jump your feet back together and drive your left knee up toward your chest. | Continue alternating knees after each jumping jack, maintaining a steady, controlled rhythm. | Keep your chest tall and your gaze forward throughout — avoid rounding your back as you drive the knee up. | Land softly on the balls of your feet each time to absorb impact and protect your joints. | Complete the desired number of reps or duration, then step your feet together and rest.
tRu: Встаньте прямо, поставив стопы вместе, руки свободно вдоль тела, слегка напрягите корпус. | Прыгните ногами в стороны на ширину плеч, одновременно поднимая обе руки над головой, как в обычном прыжке на месте. | Прыгните ногами вместе, затем сразу же мощно подтяните правое колено к груди насколько комфортно, пока руки размахиваются вниз, чтобы встретить его. | Опустите правую ногу на пол и повторите прыжок «ножницы»: ноги в стороны, руки над головой. | Прыгните ногами вместе и подтяните левое колено к груди. | Продолжайте поочерёдно сгибать колени после каждого прыжка-звездочки, поддерживая устойчивый, контролируемый ритм. | Держите грудь приподнятой и взгляд вперёд на протяжении всего упражнения — избегайте округления спины, когда поднимаете колено. | Мягко приземляйтесь каждый раз на носки обеих стоп для амортизации удара и защиты суставов. | Выполните желаемое количество повторений или время, затем поставьте ноги вместе и отдохните.
tHe: עמוד זקוף עם רגליים צמודות, ידיים רפויות לצדי הגוף, והליבה קלות מכווצת. | Jump your feet out to shoulder width while simultaneously raising both arms overhead, as in a standard jumping jack. | Jump your feet back together, then immediately drive your right knee up toward your chest as high as you comfortably can while your arms swing down to meet it. | Lower your right foot and repeat the jumping jack: feet out, arms overhead. | Jump your feet back together and drive your left knee up toward your chest. | המשילו להחליף בין ברכיים לאחר כל קפיצת ג׳ק, ושמרו על קצב יציב ומבוקר. | Keep your chest tall and your gaze forward throughout — avoid rounding your back as you drive the knee up. | Land softly on the balls of your feet each time to absorb impact and protect your joints. | בצע את מספר החזרות או המשך הזמן הרצוי, ואצעד את רגליך יחד ונח.

t: Stand tall on one foot with your arms extended in front of you for counterbalance. Lift the free leg slightly off the ground and engage your core. | Begin the descent by pushing your hips back and bending the standing knee, keeping your chest upright and the free leg extended forward off the floor. | Continue lowering under control until your standing thigh is parallel to the floor or your hip is below knee height — whichever depth your mobility allows — while keeping the heel of your standing foot fully planted. | Pause briefly at the bottom to confirm balance and tension before initiating the ascent. | Drive powerfully through your standing heel to extend your hip and knee, accelerating upward out of the squat. | At the top of the movement, continue the drive and leave the ground in a single-leg jump, reaching full hip and knee extension in the air. | Land softly on the same foot with a bent knee to absorb impact, immediately re-establishing balance before the next rep. | Complete all reps on one leg, then switch to the other side.
tRu: Stand tall on one foot with your arms extended in front of you for counterbalance. Lift the free leg slightly off the ground and engage your core. | Начните опускание с отведения бёдер назад и сгибания опорной ноги, удерживая грудь вертикально, а свободную ногу — выпрямленной вперёд над полом. | Продолжайте опускаться с контролем, пока опорное бедро не станет параллельно полу или таз не окажется ниже уровня колена — в зависимости от глубины, позволяемой вашей гибкостью — при этом пятка опорной ноги полностью на полу. | Пауза на мгновение в нижней точке, чтобы подтвердить баланс и напряжение перед началом подъёма. | Сильно оттолкнитесь пяткой опорной ноги, разгибая тазобедренный и коленный сустав, ускоряясь вверх из приседа. | В верхней точке движения продолжите посыл и оторвитесь от пола в прыжок на одной ноге, полностью разогнув бедро и колено в воздухе. | Мягко приземлитесь на ту же ногу с согнутым коленом для амортизации удара, сразу восстанавливая равновесие перед следующим повторением. | Выполните все повторения на одну ногу, затем перейдите на другую сторону.
tHe: Stand tall on one foot with your arms extended in front of you for counterbalance. Lift the free leg slightly off the ground and engage your core. | התחל את הירידה בדחיפת האגן לאחור וכיפוף ברך העמידה, תוך שמירה על חזה זקוף והרגל החופשית פשוטה קדימה באוויר. | המשך לרדת בשליטה עד שהירך העומדת מקבילה לרצפה או הירך מתחת לגובה הברך - לעומק שהגמישות שלך מאפשרת - בעת שהעקב של הרגל העומדת מונח לחלוטין על הרצפה. | Pause briefly at the bottom to confirm balance and tension before initiating the ascent. | הנע בכוח דרך העקע העומדת כדי למתוח את הירך והברך, מאיץ מעלה מהסקוואט. | בשיא התנועה המשך את הדחיפה ועזוב את הקרקע בקפיצה על רגל אחת, תוך הגעה ליישור מלא של האגן והברך באוויר. | Land softly on the same foot with a bent knee to absorb impact, immediately re-establishing balance before the next rep. | בצע את כל החזרות ברגל אחת, ואז עבור לצד השני.

t: Stand directly under a pull-up bar with your feet shoulder-width apart. | Reach up and grip the bar with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width. | Bend your knees slightly, then drive through your legs and jump upward. | As you leave the ground, use the momentum from the jump to help pull your elbows down and back. | Continue pulling until your chin clears the top of the bar. | Pause briefly at the top with your chin above the bar. | Lower yourself in a controlled manner until your arms are fully extended. | Land softly on the balls of your feet, absorbing the impact through your knees. | Reset your stance and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tRu: Stand directly under a pull-up bar with your feet shoulder-width apart. | Reach up and grip the bar with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width. | Слегка согните ноги, затем оттолкнитесь ногами и прыгните вверх. | Отрываясь от пола, используйте импульс прыжка, чтобы помочь увести локти вниз и назад. | Продолжайте тянуть, пока ваш подбородок не окажется явно выше штанги. | Задержитесь на мгновение в верхней точке с подбородком над перекладиной. | Опуститесь под контролем, пока ваши руки не будут полностью выпрямлены. | Мягко приземляйтесь на носки обеих стоп, амортизируя удар через колени. | Восстановите стойку и повторите желаемое количество повторений.
tHe: Stand directly under a pull-up bar with your feet shoulder-width apart. | Reach up and grip the bar with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width. | כופף קלות את הברכיים, ואז דחוף דרך הרגליים וקפוץ למעלה. | בעזיבת הקרקע, השתמש במומנטום מהקפיצה כדי לעזור למשוך את המרפקים מטה ואחורה. | המשך למשוך עד שהסנטר שלך עובר מעל ראש המוט. | Pause briefly at the top with your chin above the bar. | Lower yourself in a controlled manner until your arms are fully extended. | Land softly on the balls of your feet, absorbing the impact through your knees. | אפס את עמדת המוצא וחזור על התרגיל למספר החזרות הרצוי.

nR: Выпады на одной ноге в прыжке
t: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and your core braced. | Step your right foot forward into a lunge position, lowering until your right thigh is roughly parallel to the floor and your left knee hovers just above the ground. | Shift your weight onto your right (front) foot. | Drive explosively through your right foot, extending the hip, knee, and ankle to propel yourself upward. | While airborne, tuck your left (rear) leg up slightly and keep your arms moving naturally for balance. | Land softly on your right foot only, absorbing the impact by bending the knee and sinking back into the lunge position. | Stabilize for a brief moment, then immediately drive into the next rep. | Complete all reps on one leg before switching sides, or alternate legs each rep as prescribed.
tRu: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and your core braced. | Step your right foot forward into a lunge position, lowering until your right thigh is roughly parallel to the floor and your left knee hovers just above the ground. | Shift your weight onto your right (front) foot. | Взрывно оттолкнитесь правой ногой, разгибая тазобедренный, коленный и голеностопный суставы, чтобы оттолкнуть себя вверх. | While airborne, tuck your left (rear) leg up slightly and keep your arms moving naturally for balance. | Приземлитесь на правую ногу мягко, амортизируя удар сгибанием колена и возвращаясь в положение выпада. | Stabilize for a brief moment, then immediately drive into the next rep. | Выполните все повторения на одной ноге, прежде чем перейти на другую сторону, или меняйте ноги с каждым повторением, как предписано.
tHe: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and your core braced. | Step your right foot forward into a lunge position, lowering until your right thigh is roughly parallel to the floor and your left knee hovers just above the ground. | Shift your weight onto your right (front) foot. | דחוף בכוח דרך כף הרגל הימנית, מאריך את האגן, הברך והקרסול כדי לדחוע את עצמך מעלה. | While airborne, tuck your left (rear) leg up slightly and keep your arms moving naturally for balance. | Land softly on your right foot only, absorbing the impact by bending the knee and sinking back into the lunge position. | Stabilize for a brief moment, then immediately drive into the next rep. | בצע את כל החזרות עם רגל אחת לפני המעבר לצד השני, או החלף בין הרגליים בכל חזרה כפי שנקבע בתוכנית.

t: Stand tall with your feet together, arms relaxed at your sides. | Step your right foot forward and lower into a lunge, bending both knees to roughly 90 degrees. | Drive through both feet and jump explosively upward, switching your legs in the air so your left foot lands forward and your right foot lands back. | Land softly in a lunge position with your left foot forward, absorbing the impact through your hips and knees. | From the lunge, jump both feet in to meet under your hips, then immediately jump them out wide to slightly beyond shoulder-width and back together — this is the feet jack portion. | From feet together, jump straight back into a lunge with your right foot forward to begin the next repetition. | Continue alternating the jump lunge and feet jack in a smooth, rhythmic sequence for the desired number of reps or time.
tRu: Stand tall with your feet together, arms relaxed at your sides. | Step your right foot forward and lower into a lunge, bending both knees to roughly 90 degrees. | Оттолкнитесь обеими стопами и взрывно прыгните вверх, меняя ноги в воздухе так, чтобы левая стопа приземлилась вперёд, а правая — назад. | Мягко приземлитесь в положение выпада левой ногой вперёд, амортизируя удар через бёдра и колени. | Из положения выпада прыгните обеими ногами под бёдра, затем сразу же разведите их широко, немного шире плеч, и снова сведь вместе — это часть упражнения «ножницы ногами». | Из положения ноги вместе, прыгните прямо назад в выпад с правой ногой вперёд, чтобы начать следующее повторение. | Продолжайте поочередно выполнять выпад с прыжком и прыжок-ноги в ногу в плавном, ритмичном порядке в течение назначенного количества повторений или времени.
tHe: Stand tall with your feet together, arms relaxed at your sides. | Step your right foot forward and lower into a lunge, bending both knees to roughly 90 degrees. | דחוף דרך שתי הרגליים וקפוץ בכוח למעלה, תוך החלפת הרגליים באוויר כך שרגל שמאל נוחתת קדימה ורגל ימין נוחתת אחורה. | Land softly in a lunge position with your left foot forward, absorbing the impact through your hips and knees. | מהלאנג׳, קפוץ עם שתי הרגליים פנימה למפגש מתחת לירכיים, ואז מיד קפוץ איתן החוצה לרוחב מעט מעבר לרוחב הכתפיים ובחזרה יחד — זהו מקטע הג׳אק ברגליים. | מרגליים יחד, קפוץ ישר לאחור ללאנג' עם רגל ימין קדימה כדי להתחיל את החזרה הבאה. | המשיל להחליף בין לאנג' קפיצה ופעימת רגליים ברצף חלק וקצבי למספר החזרות או הזמן הרצוי.

t: Stand facing the fit-box at a distance of roughly one shoe-length away, feet hip-width apart. | Hinge slightly at the hips and bend your knees into a quarter-squat, swinging your arms back to load the movement. | Swing your arms forward and up explosively as you drive through your feet to jump as high as possible. | Bring your knees up during the flight phase to clear the height of the box comfortably. | Land softly on top of the box with both feet simultaneously, absorbing the impact by bending your knees and hips into a quarter-squat position. | Stand tall on top of the box, fully extending your hips and knees to complete the rep. | Step down one foot at a time, or jump back down with a soft, controlled landing, bending the knees on contact to absorb force. | Reset your stance, take a breath, and repeat for the desired number of reps.
tRu: Stand facing the fit-box at a distance of roughly one shoe-length away, feet hip-width apart. | Слегка наклоняйтесь в бёдра и сгибайте колени в полуприсед, раскачивая руки назад для подготовки к движению. | Swing your arms forward and up explosively as you drive through your feet to jump as high as possible. | Поднимайте колени в фазе полета, чтобы комфортно перекрыть высоту скамьи. | Мягко приземлитесь на коробку обеими ногами одновременно, амортизируя удар за счёт сгибания коленей и бёдер в положение полуприседа. | Stand tall on top of the box, fully extending your hips and knees to complete the rep. | Step down one foot at a time, or jump back down with a soft, controlled landing, bending the knees on contact to absorb force. | Reset your stance, take a breath, and repeat for the desired number of reps.
tHe: Stand facing the fit-box at a distance of roughly one shoe-length away, feet hip-width apart. | כופף מעט בציר הירכיים וכופף את הברכיים לרבע סקוואט, תוך ניפוף הזרועות לאחור לטעינת התנועה. | Swing your arms forward and up explosively as you drive through your feet to jump as high as possible. | הרם את הברכיים במהלך שלב הטיסה כדי לעבור בנוחות את גובה הקופסה. | Land softly on top of the box with both feet simultaneously, absorbing the impact by bending your knees and hips into a quarter-squat position. | Stand tall on top of the box, fully extending your hips and knees to complete the rep. | Step down one foot at a time, or jump back down with a soft, controlled landing, bending the knees on contact to absorb force. | Reset your stance, take a breath, and repeat for the desired number of reps.

t: Stand facing the box on one foot, with the opposite leg extended forward off the ground and your arms ready at your sides. | Hinge at the hip and bend your standing knee to lower into a single-leg squat, keeping your extended leg elevated and your torso upright. | Descend until your hips are near or below parallel, controlling the movement and keeping your heel flat on the floor. | Drive explosively through your standing heel, extending your hip and knee to generate upward momentum. | Jump up onto the box, landing softly on the same single leg with your knee slightly bent to absorb impact. | Stabilize on top of the box for a brief moment before stepping or jumping back down with control. | Reset and complete all reps on one side before switching to the other leg.
tRu: Stand facing the box on one foot, with the opposite leg extended forward off the ground and your arms ready at your sides. | Отведите бёдра назад и согните колено опорной ноги, чтобы опуститься в приседание на одной ноге, удерживая выпрямленную ногу на весу и корпус прямо. | Опускайтесь, пока заднее колено приближается к полу, но не касается его, или пока переднее бедро окажется примерно параллельно полу. | Взрывно оттолкнитесь пяткой опорной ноги, разгибая тазобедренный и коленный суставы для создания импульса вверх. | Прыгните на скамью, мягко приземляясь на ту же самую ногу с слегка согнутым коленом для amortisation. | Stabilize on top of the box for a brief moment before stepping or jumping back down with control. | Reset and complete all reps on one side before switching to the other leg.
tHe: Stand facing the box on one foot, with the opposite leg extended forward off the ground and your arms ready at your sides. | כופף בציר הירך וכופף את ברך רגל העמידה לירידה לסקוואט חד-רגלי, תוך שמירה על הרגל הפשוטה מורמת והגו זקוף. | רד עד שהאגן שלך קרוב למקביל או מתחתיו, שלוט בתנועה ושמור על עקב שטוח על הרצפה. | דחוף בכוח מעלה דרך עקב הרגל העומדת, מאריך את האגן והברך כדי ליצור תנופה מעלה. | Jump up onto the box, landing softly on the same single leg with your knee slightly bent to absorb impact. | Stabilize on top of the box for a brief moment before stepping or jumping back down with control. | Reset and complete all reps on one side before switching to the other leg.

t: Stand with your feet hip- to shoulder-width apart, toes pointed slightly outward, and the barbell or a moderate load absent — this is a bodyweight movement. | Hinge at your hips and bend your knees slightly into an athletic quarter-squat position, keeping your chest up, back flat, and arms hanging in front of your thighs. | Load your hips by pushing them back slightly and creating tension through your glutes, hamstrings, and adductors — this is your starting position. | Drive explosively through your feet, extending your ankles, knees, and hips simultaneously to generate maximum upward force. | As your body reaches full triple extension and your heels leave the ground, shrug your shoulders powerfully straight up toward your ears. | Allow your arms to remain relatively straight throughout — the shrug should come from the upper trapezius, not a biceps curl. | Let your feet leave the floor at peak height, maintaining an upright torso. | Land softly by absorbing impact through your ankles, knees, and hips in sequence, returning to the athletic hinge position. | Reset your posture fully between reps before initiating the next explosive drive.
tRu: Stand with your feet hip- to shoulder-width apart, toes pointed slightly outward, and the barbell or a moderate load absent — this is a bodyweight movement. | Отведите бёра назад и слегка согните колени, опуская корпус до угла примерно 45°, сохраняя позвоночник нейтральным и грудь вверх. | Нагрузите бёдра, отводя их слегка назад и создавая напряжение в ягодицах, бицепсах бедер и приводящих мышцах — это ваше исходное положение. | Взрывно оттолкнитесь стопами, одновременно разгибая голеностопные, коленные и тазобедренные суставы для создания максимальной upward силы. | Когда тело выйдет в полное тройное разгибание и пятки оторвутся от пола, мощно пожмите плечами строго вверх к ушам. | Держите руки относительно прямыми на протяжении всего движения — шраги выполняйте верхней трапецией, а не сгибанием рук. | Пусть ваши стопы отрываются от пола на максимальной высоте, сохраняя прямой корпус. | Мягко приземляйтесь, амортизируя удар последовательно через голеностопы, колени и бёдра, возвращаясь в спортивное положение отведения бёдер. | Reset your posture fully between reps before initiating the next explosive drive.
tHe: Stand with your feet hip- to shoulder-width apart, toes pointed slightly outward, and the barbell or a moderate load absent — this is a bodyweight movement. | כופף בציר הירכיים וכופף את הברכיים מעט לעמדת רבע סקוואט אתלטית, תוך שמירה על חזה מורם, גב שטוח וזרועות תלויות לפני הירכיים. | Load your hips by pushing them back slightly and creating tension through your glutes, hamstrings, and adductors — this is your starting position. | דחוף בכוח דרך כפות הרגליים, מתיחת הקרסוליים, הברכיים והירכיים בו זמנית כדי ליצור כוח מרבי כלפי מעלה. | בהגעה ליישור משולש מלא והעקבים עוזבים את הקרקע, משוך בכתפיים בעוצמה ישר מעלה לעבר האוזניים. | שמור על ידיים ישרות יחסית לאורך כל התנועה — משיכת הכתפיים צריכה לבוא מהטרפז העליון, לא מכפיפת זרועות. | Let your feet leave the floor at peak height, maintaining an upright torso. | Land softly by absorbing impact through your ankles, knees, and hips in sequence, returning to the athletic hinge position. | Reset your posture fully between reps before initiating the next explosive drive.

t: Stand tall with the rope handles held loosely at your sides, one in each hand, with the rope looped behind your feet. | Hold the handles at roughly hip height and slightly out from your hips, keeping your elbows bent at around 90° and close to your torso. | Initiate the swing by rotating your wrists forward to send the rope up and over your head in a smooth arc. | As the rope swings down toward your feet, push off the balls of your feet and hop just high enough for the rope to pass underneath — roughly 1–2 inches of clearance. | Land softly on the balls of your feet with your knees slightly bent to absorb impact, staying light and springy. | Immediately prepare for the next rotation by letting your wrists flick forward again to keep the rope turning in a continuous arc. | Maintain an upright posture with your gaze forward and your core lightly braced throughout the set. | Continue for the target duration or rep count, then slow the rope to a controlled stop.
tRu: Stand tall with the rope handles held loosely at your sides, one in each hand, with the rope looped behind your feet. | Подержите рукояти примерно на уровне бедер и немного в стороны от них, сохраняя локти согнутыми под углом 90° и близко к корпусу. | Начните движение, отводя таз вперед и включая грудь и трицепсы, подтягивая мяч вперед и вниз по контролируемой дуге. | Когда скакалка опускается к стопам, оттолкнитесь подушечками стоп и подпрыгните ровно настолько, чтобы скакалка прошла под ногами, — примерно на 1–2 дюйма. | Мягко приземляйтесь на носки обеих стоп с слегка согнутыми коленями для амортизации удара, оставаясь лёгким и пружинящим. | Сразу же подготовьтесь к следующему вращению, позволив запястьям снова щёлкнуть вперёд, чтобы канат вращался по непрерывной дуге. | Сохраняйте прямое положение тела с взглядом вперёд и лёгким напряжением корпуса на протяжении всего подхода. | Продолжайте в течение заданного времени или количества повторений, затем постепенно замедлите раскачивание перед остановкой.
tHe: Stand tall with the rope handles held loosely at your sides, one in each hand, with the rope looped behind your feet. | Hold the handles at roughly hip height and slightly out from your hips, keeping your elbows bent at around 90° and close to your torso. | Initiate the swing by rotating your wrists forward to send the rope up and over your head in a smooth arc. | כשהחבל יורד לעבר הרגליים, נתק מכריות כפות הרגליים וקפוץ בדיוק מספיק כדי שהחבל יעבור מתחת — בערך 1–2 אינץ׳ מרווח. | Land softly on the balls of your feet with your knees slightly bent to absorb impact, staying light and springy. | Immediately prepare for the next rotation by letting your wrists flick forward again to keep the rope turning in a continuous arc. | Maintain an upright posture with your gaze forward and your core lightly braced throughout the set. | המשך למשך הזמן או מספר החזרות המטרה, ואז האט את הקפיצה בשליטה.

t: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and step your right foot forward into a split-squat stance, lowering your back knee until it hovers just above the floor. | Brace your core and keep your torso upright with your chest tall. | Drive through both feet and explode straight up as powerfully as possible, leaving the ground completely. | While airborne, switch the position of your legs so your left foot lands forward and your right foot lands behind you. | Land softly on the balls of your feet first, then lower your heel, absorbing the impact by bending both knees into the bottom of a split squat. | Without pausing, immediately drive back up into the next jump, switching legs again. | Continue alternating legs for the target number of reps or seconds, maintaining consistent depth and control throughout.
tRu: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and step your right foot forward into a split-squat stance, lowering your back knee until it hovers just above the floor. | Напрягите корпус и держите корпус вертикально с расправленной грудью. | Оттолкнитесь обеими стопами и взрывно выпрыгните вверх с максимальной силой, отрываясь от земли полностью. | While airborne, switch the position of your legs so your left foot lands forward and your right foot lands behind you. | Мягко приземлитесь сначала на носки обеих стоп, затем опустите пятки, амортизируя удар за счёт сгибания обоих колен в нижнее положение выпада. | Without pausing, immediately drive back up into the next jump, switching legs again. | Продолжайте поочерёдно менять ногами на целевое количество повторений или секунд, сохраняя одинаковую глубину и контроль на протяжении всего движения.
tHe: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and step your right foot forward into a split-squat stance, lowering your back knee until it hovers just above the floor. | הדק את הליבה ושמור על גו זקוף עם חזה זקוף. | דחוף דרך שתי הרגליים והתפרץ ישר למעלה בעוצמה מרבית, עד שעוזב לחלוטין את הקרקע. | While airborne, switch the position of your legs so your left foot lands forward and your right foot lands behind you. | Land softly on the balls of your feet first, then lower your heel, absorbing the impact by bending both knees into the bottom of a split squat. | Without pausing, immediately drive back up into the next jump, switching legs again. | המשילו להחליף בין רגליים למספר החזרות או הזמן המטרה, ושמרו על עומק ושליטה עקביים לכל אורך התרגיל.

nH: מפושק בקפיצה עם ידיים על האגן
t: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and place both hands firmly on your hips. | Step one foot forward and the other foot back into a split stance, lowering into a lunge so your front thigh approaches parallel to the floor. | From this lowered position, drive explosively through both feet to jump straight up off the ground. | While airborne, switch your legs so the front leg moves to the back and the back leg moves to the front. | Land softly with the opposite foot now forward, absorbing the impact by bending both knees simultaneously. | Sink immediately into the next lunge without pausing, then jump again to continue alternating legs. | Maintain an upright torso and keep your hands on your hips throughout every rep. | Complete the target number of reps or time, then stand up and rest.
tRu: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and place both hands firmly on your hips. | Step one foot forward and the other foot back into a split stance, lowering into a lunge so your front thigh approaches parallel to the floor. | Из этого опущенного положения, сильно оттолкнитесь обеими ногами, чтобы прыгнуть прямо вверх от земли. | While airborne, switch your legs so the front leg moves to the back and the back leg moves to the front. | Приземлитесь мягко, теперь передняя нога противоположная, амортизируя удар, одновременно сгибая обе колени. | Sink immediately into the next lunge without pausing, then jump again to continue alternating legs. | Сохраняйте прямое положение корпуса и держите руки на бёдрах на протяжении каждого повторения. | Выполните целевое количество повторений или время, затем встаньте и отдохните.
tHe: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and place both hands firmly on your hips. | Step one foot forward and the other foot back into a split stance, lowering into a lunge so your front thigh approaches parallel to the floor. | מעמדת ההורדה הזו, דחוף בעוצמה דרך שתי כפות הרגליים כדי לקפוץ ישר מעלה מהקרקע. | While airborne, switch your legs so the front leg moves to the back and the back leg moves to the front. | Land softly with the opposite foot now forward, absorbing the impact by bending both knees simultaneously. | Sink immediately into the next lunge without pausing, then jump again to continue alternating legs. | Maintain an upright torso and keep your hands on your hips throughout every rep. | בצע את מספר החזרות המטרה או את זמן המטרה, ואז קום לעמידה ונוח.

t: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outward, and your arms at your sides. | Brace your core and push your hips back as you bend your knees, lowering into a squat until your thighs are parallel to the floor. | Swing your arms back to load momentum as you reach the bottom position. | Drive explosively through your mid-foot, extending your hips and knees fully and finishing the push through the balls of your feet as you swing your arms forward and upward. | Leave the ground completely, reaching maximum height with your body fully extended. | Land softly on the balls of your feet first, then roll back through your heels, immediately bending your knees to absorb impact. | Sink directly back into the squat position to absorb the landing and load the next rep. | Continue for the prescribed number of reps, maintaining a smooth, controlled rhythm throughout.
tRu: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outward, and your arms at your sides. | Напрягите корпус и отведите бёдра назад, сгибая колени и опускаясь в присед, пока бёдра не станут параллельны полу. | Swing your arms back to load momentum as you reach the bottom position. | Взрывно оттолкнитесь серединой стопы, полностью разгибая тазобедренные и коленные суставы и завершая толчок через носки, когда вы размахиваете руками вперед и вверх. | Отрывайте полностью от пола, достигая максимальной высоты с полностью выпрямленным телом. | Мягко приземлитесь сначала на носки обеих стоп, затем перекатитесь на пятки, сразу сгибая колени для амортизации удара. | Sink directly back into the squat position to absorb the landing and load the next rep. | Продолжайте в течение заданного количества повторений, сохраняя плавный, контролируемый ритм.
tHe: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outward, and your arms at your sides. | הדק את הליבה ודחוף את האגן לאחור תוך כיפוף הברכיים, ורד לסקוואט עד שהירכיים מקבילות לרצפה. | Swing your arms back to load momentum as you reach the bottom position. | דחוף בכוח דרך כף הרגל האמצעית, מאריך את האגן והברכיים לחלוטין ומסיים את הדחיפה דרך כרית הרגל כשמניפים את הידיים קדימה ומעלה. | Leave the ground completely, reaching maximum height with your body fully extended. | Land softly on the balls of your feet first, then roll back through your heels, immediately bending your knees to absorb impact. | Sink directly back into the squat position to absorb the landing and load the next rep. | המשך למשך מספר החזרות המוגדר, שומר על קצב חלק ומבוקל לאורך כל התרגיל.

t: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, arms relaxed at your sides, and your core lightly braced. | Push through both feet and jump explosively upward, swinging your arms to generate momentum. | Land softly on the balls of your feet with your knees slightly bent to absorb impact. | Immediately take a quick step to the side or forward, shifting your weight onto that foot. | Load that stepping leg by bending the knee slightly to prepare for the next jump. | Push off the stepping leg and jump explosively upward again, repeating the same arm-swing pattern. | Land softly, absorbing the impact through your hips, knees, and ankles. | Continue the jump-step-jump sequence in a smooth, rhythmic pattern for the prescribed duration or rep count. | To finish, stick your last landing with control, standing tall and resetting your posture before stepping away.
tRu: Встаньте прямо, поставив ноги на ширине бёдер, руки свободно вдоль тела, слегка напрягите корпус. | Push through both feet and jump explosively upward, swinging your arms to generate momentum. | Мягко приземлитесь на носки со слегка согнутыми коленями, чтобы смягчить удар. | Сразу же сделайте быстрый шаг в сторону или вперед, перенося вес тела на эту ногу. | Нагрузите рабочую ногу, слегка согнув колено, чтобы подготовиться к следующему прыжку. | Push off the stepping leg and jump explosively upward again, repeating the same arm-swing pattern. | Приземлитесь мягко, амортизируя удар через бёдра, колени и лодыжки. | Продолжайте последовательность прыжка-шага-прыжка в плавном, ритмичном паттерне в течение заданного времени или количества повторений. | To finish, stick your last landing with control, standing tall and resetting your posture before stepping away.
tHe: עמוד זקוף עם רגליים ברוחב האגן, ידיים רפויות לצדי הגוף, והליבה קלות מכווצת. | Push through both feet and jump explosively upward, swinging your arms to generate momentum. | נחת ברכות על כריות כפות הרגליים עם ברכיים מעט כפופות כדי לבלום את הנחיתה. | Immediately take a quick step to the side or forward, shifting your weight onto that foot. | Load that stepping leg by bending the knee slightly to prepare for the next jump. | Push off the stepping leg and jump explosively upward again, repeating the same arm-swing pattern. | Land softly, absorbing the impact through your hips, knees, and ankles. | המשך את רצף הקפיצה-צעד-קפיצה בתבנית חלקה וקצבית למשך הזמן או מספר החזרות המומלץ. | To finish, stick your last landing with control, standing tall and resetting your posture before stepping away.

t: Stand facing a sturdy box, bench, or step that is roughly knee height. | Place your right foot firmly on top of the surface, keeping your heel fully on the platform. | Drive through your right foot to push your body upward. | At the top of the movement, extend forcefully through your right leg and leave the ground with a small jump. | While airborne, switch feet so your left foot lands on the box and your right foot steps back down to the floor. | Absorb the landing softly by bending the knee of the leg on the box. | Immediately drive through the left foot to perform the next rep on that side. | Continue alternating legs at a controlled, rhythmic pace for the desired duration or rep count. | Step down fully and reset your posture between sets if needed.
tRu: Stand facing a sturdy box, bench, or step that is roughly knee height. | Положите правую стопу плотно на поверхность, сохраняя пятку полностью на платформе. | Выталкивайтесь правой ногой, чтобы поднять тело вверх. | В верхней точке движения мощно разогните правую ногу и оторвитесь от пола в небольшой прыжок. | While airborne, switch feet so your left foot lands on the box and your right foot steps back down to the floor. | Мягко поглотите приземление, согнув колено ноги на тумбе. | Сразу же оттолкнитесь левой ногой, чтобы выполнить следующее повторение на этой стороне. | Продолжайте поочерёдно менять ногами в контролируемом, ритмичном темпе на заданное время или количество повторений. | Step down fully and reset your posture between sets if needed.
tHe: Stand facing a sturdy box, bench, or step that is roughly knee height. | Place your right foot firmly on top of the surface, keeping your heel fully on the platform. | דחוף עם הרגל הימנית כדי לדחות את הגוך מעלה. | בשיא התנועה התיישר בכוח דרך רגל ימין ועזוב את הקרקע בקפיצה קטנה. | While airborne, switch feet so your left foot lands on the box and your right foot steps back down to the floor. | ספוג את הנחיתה ברכות על ידי כיפוף הברך של הרגל שעל הארגז. | Immediately drive through the left foot to perform the next rep on that side. | המשילו להחליף בין רגליים בקצב מבוקר וקצבי למשך הזמן או מספר החזרות הרצוי. | Step down fully and reset your posture between sets if needed.

t: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and a kettlebell on the floor in front of each foot, handles parallel. | Hinge at the hips and bend your knees to grip both kettlebell handles, one in each hand. | Jump or step both feet back into a high plank position, keeping your hands on the kettlebell handles with wrists neutral and core braced. | Lower your chest toward the floor between the kettlebells to perform a push-up, keeping your elbows close to your sides. | Press back up to the plank position, locking out your arms. | Jump or step both feet forward toward the kettlebells, landing with knees bent and weight in your heels. | Drive through your legs, release the handles, and explode upward into a full jump, extending your hips and reaching your arms overhead. | Land softly with knees slightly bent and immediately set up for the next rep.

tHe: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and a kettlebell on the floor in front of each foot, handles parallel. | כופף בציר הירכיים וכופף את הברכיים כדי לאחוז בידיות שני הקטלבלים, אחד בכל יד. | Jump or step both feet back into a high plank position, keeping your hands on the kettlebell handles with wrists neutral and core braced. | Lower your chest toward the floor between the kettlebells to perform a push-up, keeping your elbows close to your sides. | Press back up to the plank position, locking out your arms. | Jump or step both feet forward toward the kettlebells, landing with knees bent and weight in your heels. | דחוף עם הרגליים, שחרר את הידיות, וקפוץ למעלה בקפיצה מלאה, מאציל את הירכיים ומושך את הידיים מעל הראש. | Land softly with knees slightly bent and immediately set up for the next rep.

nE: Kettlebell Calf Raise and Front Squat
nR: Подъёмы на носки и фронтальный присед с гирей
nH: עליות עקבים וסקוואט קדמי עם קטלבל
t: Stand with your feet roughly shoulder-width apart and your toes turned out slightly. Clean one or two kettlebells to the rack position — handles at shoulder height, elbows forward and up — or hold a single kettlebell in the goblet position close to your chest. | Brace your core, keep your chest tall, and look straight ahead throughout the movement. | Inhale and sit into the squat by bending your knees and pushing your hips back and down, keeping your knees tracking over your toes. | Descend until your thighs are at or just below parallel to the floor, allowing your elbows to travel forward so the kettlebells stay balanced over your mid-foot. | Drive through both feet to stand, exhaling as you press up through the floor. | As you reach the top of the squat and your legs straighten, continue the movement by rising onto the balls of your feet for a full calf raise, pausing for a moment at peak height. | Lower your heels back to the floor with control to complete one rep, then move directly into the next squat without resting between reps. | After completing your set, lower the kettlebells safely to the floor or return them to a rack.
tRu: Stand with your feet roughly shoulder-width apart and your toes turned out slightly. Clean one or two kettlebells to the rack position — handles at shoulder height, elbows forward and up — or hold a single kettlebell in the goblet position close to your chest. | Напрягите корпус, держите грудь расправленной и смотрите прямо вперёд в течение всего движения. | Вдохните и садитесь в присед, сгибая колени и отводя бёдра назад и вниз, сохраняя колени над носками. | Опуститесь до того уровня, пока ваши бедра не окажутся параллельны полу или немного ниже, позволяя локтям двигаться вперёд, чтобы гири оставались сбалансированы над серединой стопы. | Оттолкнитесь обеими стопами, чтобы встать, выдыхая, когда надавливаете на пол. | Выпрямившись в верхней точке приседа, продолжите движение подъёмом на подушечки стоп в полный подъём на икры, задержавшись на мгновение на пике. | Опустите пятки обратно вниз с контролем для завершения одного повторения, затем сразу переходите к следующему приседанию без отдыха между повторениями. | Выполнив подход, безопасно опустите гири на пол или верните их на стойку.
tHe: Stand with your feet roughly shoulder-width apart and your toes turned out slightly. Clean one or two kettlebells to the rack position — handles at shoulder height, elbows forward and up — or hold a single kettlebell in the goblet position close to your chest. | הדק את הליבה, שמור על חזה גבוה והבט ישר קדימה לאורך כל התנועה. | Inhale and sit into the squat by bending your knees and pushing your hips back and down, keeping your knees tracking over your toes. | רד עד שהירכיים מקבילות או מעט מתחת למקבילה לרצפה, מאפשר למרפקים לנוע קדימה כדי שהקטלבל יישאר מאוזן מעל אמצע כף הרגל. | דחוף דרך שתי הרגליים כדי לקום, תוך נשימה החוצה כשדוחף למעלה דרך הרצפה. | בהגעה לשיא הסקוואט עם התיישרות הרגליים, המשך בעלייה על כריות כפות הרגליים להרמת תאומים מלאה, ועצור לרגע בשיא הגובה. | Lower your heels back to the floor with control to complete one rep, then move directly into the next squat without resting between reps. | אחרי שסיימת את הסט, הורד את הקטלבלים בבטחה לרצפה או החזר אותם למתקן.

t: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and the kettlebell on the floor between your feet slightly in front of your shins. | Hinge at the hips, grip the handle with one hand, and hike the bell back between your legs to load the hips. | Drive your hips forward explosively, extending your hips and knees to generate upward momentum on the bell. | Guide the bell up close to your body, rotate your hand around the bell, and receive it in the rack position with your forearm vertical, the bell resting against the back of your forearm and upper arm, elbow tucked in at your chest. | Stabilize briefly in the rack position with your feet flat, core braced, and the bell controlled. | Perform a short, sharp dip by bending your knees a few inches, keeping your torso upright. | Explosively drive through your legs and hips to launch the bell upward, then quickly punch your arm up and drop slightly under the bell to lock your arm out overhead. | Stand tall to complete the lockout with your arm fully extended, bicep near your ear, and glutes squeezed. | Lower the bell back to the rack position, then hinge and swing it down to the starting position to complete the rep.
tRu: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and the kettlebell on the floor between your feet slightly in front of your shins. | Отведите бёра назад, возьмите ручки гири (боковые части рукоятки) обеими руками и поднимите её или поднимите со штанги до уровня груди, чтобы она находилась близко к груди, локтями направленными вниз. | Мощно выталкивайте бёдра вперёд, разгибая бёдра и колени, чтобы создать импульс для подъёма гири. | Пrowadź kulkę близко к телу, поверните руку вокруг гири и примите ее в положение на груди с вертикальным предплечьем, гиря опирается на заднюю часть предплечья и плеча, локоть прижат к груди. | Stabilize briefly in the rack position with your feet flat, core braced, and the bell controlled. | Выполните короткое, резкое приседание, согнув колени на несколько дюймов, сохраняя корпус прямо. | Взрывно оттолкнитесь ногами и бедрами, чтобы поднять гирю вверх, затем быстро поднимите руку вверх и немного опуститесь под гирю, чтобы зафиксировать руку над головой. | Stand tall to complete the lockout with your arm fully extended, bicep near your ear, and glutes squeezed. | Плавно опустите гирю в положение на груди, затем отведите бёдра назад и раскачайте её в исходное положение для завершения повторения.
tHe: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and the kettlebell on the floor between your feet slightly in front of your shins. | כופף בציר הירך, אחוז בידית ביד אחת ונופף את הקטלבל לאחור בין הרגליים כדי לטעון את הירכיים. | דחוף את האגן קדימה בכוח, מתיחה של האגן והברכיים כדי ליצור תנופה כלפי מעלה על הפעמון. | הנחה את הקטלבל מעלה צמוד לגוף, סובב את היד סביבו וקבל אותו בעמדת הראק עם האמה אנכית, הקטלבל נשען על חלקה האחורי של האמה והזרוע העליונה, מרפק צמוד לחזה. | Stabilize briefly in the rack position with your feet flat, core braced, and the bell controlled. | Perform a short, sharp dip by bending your knees a few inches, keeping your torso upright. | דחוף בכוח דרך הרגליים והירכיים כדי להעיף את הפעמון למעלה, לאחר מכן דחוף במהירות את היד למעלה וירד מעט מתחת לפעמון כדי לנעול את היד מעלה. | Stand tall to complete the lockout with your arm fully extended, bicep near your ear, and glutes squeezed. | Lower the bell back to the rack position, then hinge and swing it down to the starting position to complete the rep.

t: Stand with feet hip-width apart, kettlebell on the floor between your feet. Hinge at the hips, grip the handle with one hand, and set a neutral spine with shoulders packed down. | Hike the kettlebell back between your legs like a hike pass, loading the hips and hamstrings. | Drive your hips forward explosively, pulling the bell upward close to your body. As it rises to chest height, rotate your elbow under and around the bell so it lands softly on the outside of your forearm in the rack position — bell resting against your wrist and forearm, elbow tucked into your ribcage. | Pause briefly in the rack position with the bell at shoulder level, your elbow pointing down, and your wrist stacked directly over your elbow. | Take a breath, brace your core and glutes, then press the kettlebell straight overhead by driving your palm toward the ceiling until your arm is fully locked out and your bicep is beside your ear. | Lower the bell under control back to the rack position at your shoulder. | From the rack, let the bell swing back down and between your legs in one smooth arc, then immediately reload the hips to begin the next rep — or set the bell down with a controlled hinge if you are done.

Когда она поднимется до уровня груди, поверните локоть под и вокруг гири, чтобы она мягко легла на внешнюю часть предплечья в положении на грудь — гиря лежит на запястье и предплечье, локтя прижат к рёбрам. | Задержитесь на мгновение в положении на стойке со гирьёй на уровне плеч, локтем, направленным вниз, и запястьем, расположенным непосредственно над локтем. | Take a breath, brace your core and glutes, then press the kettlebell straight overhead by driving your palm toward the ceiling until your arm is fully locked out and your bicep is beside your ear. | Плавно опустите гирю в положение на груди на вашем плече. | Из стойки на груди позволь гире свободно опуститься назад и между ног по одной плавной дуге, затем сразу же отведите бёдры назад для начала следующего повторения — или плавно опустите гирю на пол с помощью отведения бёдер, если вы закончили.

t: Sit on a bench or sturdy surface with your feet flat on the floor, slightly wider than hip-width apart. | Hold a kettlebell in one hand with a neutral grip, letting your arm hang straight down between your legs. | Lean forward slightly and brace the back of your upper arm against the inside of your thigh on the same side. | Let your arm fully extend so the kettlebell hangs toward the floor — this is your starting position. | Keeping your upper arm locked against your thigh, exhale and curl the kettlebell upward in a smooth arc toward your shoulder. | Pause briefly at the top of the movement when the kettlebell is near shoulder height, squeezing the upper arm. | Inhale and slowly lower the kettlebell back to the fully extended starting position under control. | Complete all reps on one arm before switching to the other side.
tRu: Sit on a bench or sturdy surface with your feet flat on the floor, slightly wider than hip-width apart. | Держите гирю в одной руке нейтральным хватом, позволяя руке свободно свисать между ногами. | Слегка наклонитесь вперед и прижмите заднюю поверхность верхней руки к внутренней поверхности бедра на той же стороне. | Дайте вашей руке полностью выпрямиться, чтобы гиря висела к полу — это ваша исходная позиция. | Держа верхнюю часть руки зафиксированной у бедра, выдохните и поднимите гирю вверх плавной дугой к плечу. | Пауза в верхней точке движения, когда гиря находится на уровне плеч, сжимая плечо. | Вдохните и медленно опустите гирю обратно в полностью выпрямленное исходное положение под контролем. | Выполните все повторения одной рукой, затем перейдите на другую сторону.
tHe: Sit on a bench or sturdy surface with your feet flat on the floor, slightly wider than hip-width apart. | החזק קטלבל ביד אחת באחיזה ניטרלית, ותן לזרוע לתלות ישרה מטה בין הרגליים. | Lean forward slightly and brace the back of your upper arm against the inside of your thigh on the same side. | Let your arm fully extend so the kettlebell hangs toward the floor — this is your starting position. | Keeping your upper arm locked against your thigh, exhale and curl the kettlebell upward in a smooth arc toward your shoulder. | Pause briefly at the top of the movement when the kettlebell is near shoulder height, squeezing the upper arm. | Inhale and slowly lower the kettlebell back to the fully extended starting position under control. | בצע את כל החזרות ביד אחת לפני המעבר לצד השני.

t: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, holding a kettlebell in one hand by the handle at your side. | Position the kettlebell in the hand opposite to the leg you intend to step back with — for example, hold it in your right hand if your left leg will lunge back. | Brace your core and keep your chest upright as you step one foot straight back, landing on the ball of that foot. | Lower your rear knee toward the floor in a controlled descent, allowing both knees to bend to roughly 90°. | Keep your front knee tracking over your toes and your torso vertical — resist any urge to rotate toward the kettlebell side. | Drive through your front heel to press back up to the starting position, bringing your rear foot forward. | Complete all reps on one side, then switch the kettlebell to the other hand and repeat with the opposite leg stepping back.
tRu: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, holding a kettlebell in one hand by the handle at your side. | Position the kettlebell in the hand opposite to the leg you intend to step back with — for example, hold it in your right hand if your left leg will lunge back. | Напрягите корпус и держите грудь вертикально, делая одной ногой шаг строго назад с приземлением на подушечку стопы. | Опустите заднее колено к полу в контролируемом опускании, позволяя обоим коленям согнуться примерно под углом 90°. | Следите, чтобы колено передней ноги было направлено над носками, а корпус оставался вертикальным — сопротивляйтесь любому желанию повернуться в сторону гири. | Отталкивайтесь передней пяткой, чтобы встать в исходное положение, bringing your rear foot forward. | Выполните все повторения на одну сторону, затем поменяйте гирю на другую руку и повторите с противоположной ногой, делающей шаг назад.
tHe: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, holding a kettlebell in one hand by the handle at your side. | Position the kettlebell in the hand opposite to the leg you intend to step back with — for example, hold it in your right hand if your left leg will lunge back. | הדק את הליבה ושמור על חזה זקוף כשאתה צועד עם רגל אחת ישר לאחור, תוך נחיתה על כרית כף הרגל. | Lower your rear knee toward the floor in a controlled descent, allowing both knees to bend to roughly 90°. | Keep your front knee tracking over your toes and your torso vertical — resist any urge to rotate toward the kettlebell side. | דחוף עם עקב הרגל הקדמית כדי לחזור לתנוחת ההתחלה, מושך את כף הרגל האחורית קדימה. | בצע את כל החזרות בצד אחד, ואז העבר את הקטלבל ליד השנייה וחזור עם הרגל הנגדית צעד אחורה.

t: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart and your toes pointed slightly outward. Hold the kettlebell by the horns at chest height or let it hang in front of you as a counterbalance. | Shift your weight to your right foot and begin squatting down to the right side, pushing your hips back and keeping your chest tall. | Descend as low as your mobility allows, aiming to get your right thigh parallel to the floor or below, while keeping your right foot flat on the ground. | At the same time, let your left leg straighten fully, with your left foot remaining flat or pivoting onto the heel as your toes point up toward the ceiling. | Keep the kettlebell close to your body and your torso upright throughout the descent — use it to counterbalance if needed. | Press through your right foot to drive yourself back up to the starting position, squeezing your inner thigh and glute as you rise. | Complete all reps on the right side, then repeat on the left side.

t: Lie flat on your back on the floor with your knees bent to 90° and your shins parallel to the ground, so your hips and knees form right angles. | Press both arms straight up toward the ceiling, then grip one kettlebell with both hands directly above your chest. | Brace your core firmly, drawing your lower back into the floor so there is no gap between your spine and the ground. | Inhale, then slowly lower your right leg toward the floor while simultaneously extending it straight, keeping it a few inches off the ground at the lowest point. | At the same time, extend your left arm overhead toward the floor, lowering the kettlebell with it in a controlled arc. | Pause briefly at the bottom without letting your lower back arch off the floor. | Exhale and return your arm and leg back to the starting position under control. | Repeat on the opposite side — left leg and right arm — to complete one full rep. | Continue alternating sides for the prescribed number of repetitions, maintaining constant core tension throughout.

t: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and hold a kettlebell by the horns at chest height, elbows pointing down and the bell resting against your sternum. | Brace your core, pull your shoulders back, and keep your chest tall — maintain this posture throughout the movement. | Shift your weight onto your left foot, then step your right foot diagonally behind and across your body to the left side, as if taking a curtsey. | Bend both knees and lower your hips toward the floor in a controlled descent, aiming to bring your back knee to just above the ground. | Keep your front foot flat, your front knee tracking over your second toe, and your torso upright — resist the urge to lean forward. | At the bottom, pause briefly with tension in your left glute, then drive through your front heel to return to the starting position. | Bring your right foot back to the start, reset your balance, and repeat the crossover step on the same side for the target reps before switching legs.
tRu: Встаньте, поставив ноги на ширине бёдер, и удерживайте гирю за дужки на высоте груди, направив локти вниз и прижав гирю к грудине. | Напрягите корпус, отведите плечи назад, держите грудь расправленной — сохраняйте это положение в течение всего движения. | Shift your weight onto your left foot, then step your right foot diagonally behind and across your body to the left side, as if taking a curtsey. | Согните оба колена и опустите бёдра к полу контролируемым движением, стремясь подвести заднее колено чуть над полом. | Держите переднюю пятку firmly прижатой к полу и грудь открытой на протяжении всего опускания. | В нижней точке сделайте короткую паузу, держа в напряжении левую ягодицу, затем оттолкнитесь пяткой передней ноги и вернитесь в исходное положение. | Верните правую ногу в исходное положение, восстановите равновесие и повторите перекрестный шаг на той же стороне для заданного количества повторений, прежде чем поменять ноги.
tHe: עמוד עם רגליים ברוחב האגן ואחוז בקטלבל בקרניים בגובה החזה, המרפקים פונים מטה והמשקולת נשענת על עצם החזה. | הדק את הליבה, משוך את הכתפיים לאחור ושמור על חזה גבוה — שמור על תנוחה זו לאורך כל התנועה. | Shift your weight onto your left foot, then step your right foot diagonally behind and across your body to the left side, as if taking a curtsey. | כופף את שתי הברכיים והורד את האגן לכיוון הרצפה בירידה מבוקרת, תוך שאיפה להביא את הברך האחורית למעט מעל הקרקע. | Keep your front foot flat, your front knee tracking over your second toe, and your torso upright — resist the urge to lean forward. | בתחתית, עצור לרגע עם מתח בישבן שמאל, ואז דחוף דרך עקב קדמי בחזרה לעמדת המוצא. | הבא את רגל ימין חזרה להתחלה, אפס את שיווי המשקל, וחזור על צעד החצייה באותו הצד למספר החזרות המבוקש לפני החלפת הרגליים.

t: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and a kettlebell on the floor in front of you. | Hinge at the hips, grip the kettlebell by the horns (the sides of the handle) with both hands, and clean or deadlift it to chest height so it rests close to your sternum with your elbows pointing down. | Brace your core firmly — create full 360-degree tension around your trunk as if expecting a punch. | Pull your shoulder blades down and back to keep the bell tight against your chest and your chest tall. | Begin walking with deliberate, controlled steps at a moderate pace, keeping the kettlebell motionless relative to your torso. | Maintain an upright spine throughout — do not lean forward, round your upper back, or let the bell drift away from your chest. | Breathe steadily: inhale through the nose, brace, exhale slowly as you continue walking. | At the end of your set distance or time, stop, hinge at the hips, and lower the kettlebell back to the floor under control.

t: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outward. t: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and a slight bend in your knees. t: Place two kettlebells on the floor shoulder-width apart and stand behind them with your feet roughly hip-width apart. | Hinge at your hips and push them back until your torso is near parallel to the floor, then grip both kettlebell handles with a neutral grip. | Brace your core, keep your back flat, and let both kettlebells rest on the floor as your starting position. | Row one kettlebell toward your hip by driving your elbow straight back, keeping it close to your torso. | As the rowing arm reaches the top, let the kettlebell return to the floor under control. | Immediately row the opposite kettlebell in the same manner, allowing it to touch down before switching sides again. | Continue alternating for the target number of reps, maintaining a stable hip-hinge position throughout. | To finish, set both kettlebells down, then drive your hips forward to return to standing.

t: Kneel on the ground with your right knee down and left foot forward, forming a 90-degree angle at both knees. Your torso should be tall and your hips square. | Hold the kettlebell upside down by its horns (the sides of the handle) at chest height, keeping your elbows bent and close together. | Brace your core and squeeze your glutes to stabilize your pelvis and lower back throughout the movement. | Begin the halo by tilting the kettlebell to one side and guiding it around the back of your head in a smooth, controlled arc. | Keep the kettlebell close to your head as it passes behind your neck, moving it at a consistent, slow pace. | Continue the circle past your ear and back to the starting position at chest height in front of you. | Complete the desired number of circles in one direction, then reverse the motion and circle in the opposite direction for the same count. | Maintain an upright torso throughout — avoid leaning, tilting your head, or arching your lower back to compensate. | Switch your kneeling leg and repeat the set to train both sides equally.
tRu: Встаньте на колени на полу на правом колене, левая нога вперёд, образуя прямой угол в обоих коленях. t: Lie on a flat bench or the floor, holding a kettlebell by the horns or the handle with both hands, arms extended directly above your chest. | Plant your feet firmly on the floor and brace your core to keep your lower back stable throughout the movement. | With your upper arms fixed and vertical, slowly bend your elbows to lower the kettlebell toward your forehead, keeping your elbows pointing straight ahead. | Stop when the kettlebell is just above or level with your forehead — do not let it make contact with your head. | Pause briefly at the bottom, maintaining tension in the triceps. | Press the kettlebell back up by straightening your elbows until your arms are fully extended, returning to the starting position. | Keep your upper arms stationary throughout every rep — only your forearms should move. | Complete your reps, then carefully lower the kettlebell to your chest before sitting up.
