t: Set the gymnastic rings at a height that allows you to hang with your arms fully extended while your feet can still reach the floor — roughly waist to chest height works for most people. | Grip each ring with an overhand grip, hands roughly shoulder-width apart, and let your body hang at an angle with heels on the floor and legs extended in front of you. | Brace your core and squeeze your glutes to keep your body in a straight line from heels to shoulders throughout the movement. | Initiate the pull by depressing your shoulder blades and driving your elbows down and back toward your hips. | Press lightly through your heels to assist the pull — use only as much leg drive as needed to complete the rep with good form. | Continue pulling until your chest approaches the rings and your elbows are fully bent and close to your sides. | Pause briefly at the top, squeezing the back muscles. | Lower yourself in a controlled manner back to the fully extended start position, resisting the descent rather than dropping. | Reset your brace and repeat for the target number of repetitions.

t: Place a flat bench beside you and lie on your side on the floor, positioning your feet and lower legs on top of the bench with your hip still resting on the floor. | Stack your feet on top of each other and rest your lower elbow directly beneath your shoulder, forearm flat on the floor and perpendicular to your torso. | Place your top hand on your hip or extend it toward the ceiling for balance. | Brace your core and squeeze your obliques, then drive your hip off the floor until your body forms a rigid straight line from head to feet. | Hold your neck in a neutral position — do not crane it upward or let it drop toward the floor. | Keep your hips fully extended and avoid letting them sag or pike upward during the hold. | Breathe steadily throughout the hold; do not hold your breath. | Hold the bridge position for the target duration (e.g., 20–45 seconds), then lower your hip under control. | Complete all reps or time on one side before switching to the opposite side.
tRu: Поставьте плоскую скамью сбоку и лягте на пол на бок, поставив ноги и нижнюю часть ног на скамью, пока бедро все еще находится на полу. | Stack your feet on top of each other and rest your lower elbow directly beneath your shoulder, forearm flat on the floor and perpendicular to your torso. | Положите верхнюю руку на бедро или вытяните её к потолку для равновесия. | Напрягите пресс и косые мышцы, затем оторвите бедро от пола, пока тело не образует жёсткую прямую линию от головы до стоп. | Удерживайте шею в нейтральном положении — не запрокидывайте ее вверх и не давайте голове опускаться к полу. | Держите бёдра полностью выпрямленными и избегайте их провисания или подъёма вверх в верхней точке. | Дышите ровно в течение всего удержания, не задерживайте дыхание. | Держите положение моста в течение целевого времени (например, 20-45 секунд), затем опустите бедра под контролем. | Выполните все повторения или время удержания на одной стороне, прежде чем перейти на противоположную.

t: Lie flat on your back on the floor with your arms at your sides, palms facing down for support. | Place both heels on top of a stability ball, keeping your legs straight and your feet hip-width apart. | Press your heels into the ball and lift your hips off the floor until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to heels. | Brace your core and squeeze your glutes to maintain a rigid, elevated hip position throughout the set. | Curl the ball toward your glutes by bending both knees, rolling the ball in with your heels while keeping your hips high. | Pause briefly when your heels are directly under your knees and your shins are vertical, keeping your hips elevated. | Slowly extend your legs to roll the ball back out to the starting position, maintaining hip elevation throughout. | Complete all reps, then lower your hips to the floor in a controlled manner.
tRu: Лягте на спину на пол с руками вдоль тела, ладонями вниз для опоры. | Поставьте обе пятки на верхнюю часть мяча для равновесия, держа ноги прямыми и стопы на ширине бёдер. | Press your heels into the ball and lift your hips off the floor until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to heels. | Напрягите корпус и сожмите ягодицы, чтобы сохранять жёсткое положение с поднятыми бёдрами в течение всего подхода. | Подтяните мяч к ягодицам, сгибая оба колена, катая мяч внутрь пятками, сохраняя таз высоко. | Задержитесь на мгновение, когда ваши пятки находятся непосредственно под коленями, а голени вертикальны, сохраняя бёдра приподнятыми. | Slowly extend your legs to roll the ball back out to the starting position, maintaining hip elevation throughout. | Выполните все повторения, затем опустите таз на пол под контролем.

nH: פשיטות רגליים עם כפיפות בטן (על כדור פיזיו)
t: Sit upright on the stability ball with your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart, and the ball positioned beneath your mid-to-lower back when you recline. | Walk your feet forward and lean back until your lower back and mid-back rest on the ball, with your hips slightly lower than your knees and your head and shoulders unsupported. | Place your hands lightly behind your head or cross them over your chest, keeping your elbows wide. | Engage your core and press your lower back gently into the ball to establish a stable starting position. | Exhale and perform a crunch by lifting your head, neck, and shoulder blades off the ball while simultaneously extending one leg straight out at hip height, pointing your toes forward. | Hold the top position for one count, feeling the contraction in your rectus abdominis and the tension in the extended leg's quadriceps. | Inhale and slowly lower your upper body back onto the ball while bending the knee and returning your foot to the floor in a controlled manner. | Alternate legs with each repetition, or complete all reps on one side before switching, depending on the variation prescribed. | Maintain a neutral neck throughout — avoid pulling on your head — and keep the ball as still as possible to preserve core tension.

t: Start in a high or forearm plank position with your hands (or forearms) directly under your shoulders and your body forming a straight line from head to heels. | Place your feet hip-width apart and press through the balls of both feet to create a stable base. | Brace your core by drawing your navel gently toward your spine, squeeze your glutes, and ensure your hips are level — neither sagging nor piked. | Inhale to prepare, then on an exhale lift your right leg a few inches off the floor, keeping it straight and your foot flexed. | Hold the extended position for 2–3 seconds while maintaining a neutral spine and level hips. | Lower your right foot back to the floor with control, re-establish your brace, then repeat on the left side. | Continue alternating legs for the prescribed number of reps or time, breathing steadily throughout. | To finish, lower both feet to the floor and rest in a kneeling or child's pose position.

t: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, arms relaxed at your sides or held lightly in front for balance. | Shift your weight onto your left foot, keeping a slight bend in the standing knee. | Engage your core by bracing your abdominals as if preparing to absorb a punch. | Drive your right knee upward toward your chest, then extend the lower leg forward in a snapping kick. | Aim to bring the leg roughly parallel to the floor or as high as your flexibility comfortably allows. | Keep your torso upright and avoid leaning backward — the movement comes from the hip, not the spine. | Hold the extended position for a brief moment to challenge balance and waist stability. | Return the kicking leg in a controlled arc back to the starting position without letting it crash to the floor. | Complete all reps on one side before switching legs, or alternate legs each rep.

t: Find a firm, flat surface such as a treatment table or exercise mat and lie face-up with your legs fully extended. | Slide both heels together so your legs are parallel and touching, with your toes pointing toward the ceiling. | Relax your hips, legs, and lower back completely — avoid actively pulling or pushing either leg. | Flex your hips and knees to bring both knees up to your chest, hugging them briefly to reset any pelvic tilt. | Slowly lower both legs back to a fully extended position, letting them settle naturally without adjusting. | Look down at your ankles from above, or have a partner observe at foot level to compare the position of the medial malleoli (inner ankle bones). | Note any visible difference between the height or position of the two ankles — a discrepancy may suggest a functional or structural leg length difference. | Repeat the reset-and-lower sequence two to three times to confirm the finding is consistent.

nE: Leg Lift to Chest Front Plank
t: Place your hands directly under your shoulders on the floor and extend your legs behind you so your body forms a straight line from head to heels — this is the high-plank starting position. | Brace your core by drawing your navel gently toward your spine, and squeeze your glutes to keep your hips level. | Inhale to prepare, then exhale as you drive your right knee toward your chest, keeping your hips low and your back flat. | Pause briefly when your knee reaches chest height, ensuring your hips have not risen or rotated. | Return your right foot to the starting position under control, avoiding letting it drop or slam down. | Repeat the knee drive with your left leg, maintaining a stable plank throughout the transition. | Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions or duration, breathing steadily throughout. | To finish, step your feet forward and lower your knees to the floor rather than collapsing from the plank position.

nH: גשר עכוז עם רגל מעל ברך
t: Lie flat on your back on the floor with your knees bent and feet planted hip-width apart. | Cross your right ankle over your left knee, letting your right knee fall open to the side in a figure-4 position. | Press your right foot gently into your left thigh to keep the crossed leg stable throughout the movement. | Place your arms flat on the floor alongside your torso, palms facing down, for support. | Brace your core and press through the heel of your planted left foot to drive your hips upward. | Lift your hips until your torso forms a straight line from your left knee to your shoulders, squeezing your glutes at the top. | Hold the top position for one to two seconds, keeping your hips level and avoiding rotation. | Lower your hips slowly and with control back toward the floor without fully resting, then repeat for the desired reps. | Complete all reps on one side before switching legs.
tRu: Лягте ровно на спину на пол, согните колени и поставьте стопы на ширине бёдер. | Перекрестите правую лодыжку над левым коленом, позволяя правому колену открыться вбок в положении фигуры четыре. | Press your right foot gently into your left thigh to keep the crossed leg stable throughout the movement. | Положите ладони на пол вдоль корпуса, ладонями вниз, для поддержки. | Напрягите корпус и оттолкнитесь через пятку упёртой левой стопы, поднимая бёдра вверх. | Поднимите таз, пока корпус образует прямую линию от левого колена до плеч, сжимая ягодицы в верхней точке. | Задержитесь в верхней позиции на одну-две секунды, сохраняя бёдра на одном уровне и избегая вращения. | Опустите бёдра медленно и с контролем обратно к полу, не полностью отдыхая, затем повторите для нужного количества повторений. | Выполните все повторения на одну сторону, затем поменяйте ноги.
tHe: שכב שטוח על הגב על הרצפה עם ברכיים כפופות וכפות רגליים נטועות ברוחב האגן. | צול את קרסול ימין מעל ברך שמאל, ואז הורד את ברך ימין לצד החוצה בתנוחת 4. | Press your right foot gently into your left thigh to keep the crossed leg stable throughout the movement. | Place your arms flat on the floor alongside your torso, palms facing down, for support. | הדק את הליבה ודחוף דרך עקב רגל שמאל הנטועה כדי להרים את האגן למעלה. | Lift your hips until your torso forms a straight line from your left knee to your shoulders, squeezing your glutes at the top. | Hold the top position for one to two seconds, keeping your hips level and avoiding rotation. | Lower your hips slowly and with control back toward the floor without fully resting, then repeat for the desired reps. | בצע את כל החזרות בצד אחד לפני החלפת הרגליים.

t: Lie flat on your back on a comfortable surface with your legs extended and arms resting at your sides. | Engage your core lightly to press your lower back toward the floor. | Bend one knee and draw it toward your chest, wrapping both hands around your shin just below the knee. | Gently pull the knee closer to your chest until you feel a distinct stretch through the hip flexor and lower abdomen on the working side. | Keep the opposite leg fully extended and pressed down into the floor throughout the movement. | Hold the stretched position for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and deeply. | On each exhale, allow the knee to draw slightly closer to deepen the stretch without forcing the range. | Release the leg back to the starting position in a controlled manner. | Switch sides and repeat the same sequence with the opposite leg.
tRu: Лягте ровно на спину на удобную поверхность, выпрямив ноги и положив руки вдоль тела. | Напрягите корпус лёгким напряжением, чтобы прижимать поясницу к полу. | Согните одну ногу и подтяните колено к груди, обхватив обеими руками голень чуть ниже колена. | Аккуратно потяните колено ближе к груди, пока не почувствуете выраженное растяжение в сгибателе бедра и нижней части живота с рабочей стороны. | Держите противоположную ногу полностью выпрямленной и прижатой к полу на протяжении всего движения. | Держите растянутое положение 20–30 секунд, дыша медленно и глубоко. | На каждом выдохе позвольте колену немного приблизиться, чтобы углубить растяжку, не форсируя амплитуду. | Release the leg back to the starting position in a controlled manner. | Switch sides and repeat the same sequence with the opposite leg.
tHe: שכב שטוח על הגב על משטח נוח עם רגליים ישרות וידיים מונחות לצדי הגוף. | הפעל את שרירי הליבה בעדינות כדי ללחוץ על גבך התחתון לעבר הרצפה. | כופף ברך אחת ומשוך אותה לכיוון החזה, תוך כריכת שתי הידיים סביב השוק ממש מתחת לברך. | משוך בעדינות את הברך קרוב יותר לחזה עד שתרגיש מתיחה ברורה בכופף הירך ובתחתית הבטן בצד העובד. | Keep the opposite leg fully extended and pressed down into the floor throughout the movement. | Hold the stretched position for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and deeply. | On each exhale, allow the knee to draw slightly closer to deepen the stretch without forcing the range. | Release the leg back to the starting position in a controlled manner. | Switch sides and repeat the same sequence with the opposite leg.

t: Start in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders, arms fully extended, and your body forming a straight line from head to heels. | Engage your core and press the floor away with your hands to create a stable, supported base. | Keeping your hips level and square to the floor, lift one leg off the ground with a controlled motion. | Pull the lifted leg forward by driving the knee toward your chest, feeling a stretch through the hip and waist on that side. | Pause briefly at the point of maximum stretch, maintaining a neutral spine and avoiding any twisting through the hips. | Slowly return the leg back to the starting plank position under full control. | Repeat for the desired number of repetitions on that side, then switch to the other leg. | Throughout the movement, keep your shoulders packed down and away from your ears and avoid letting your lower back sag or arch excessively.
tRu: Примите упор лёжа с прямыми руками точно под плечами, тело образует прямую линию от головы до пяток. | Напрягите корпус и оттолкнитесь пол руками, создавая стабильную и надёжную опору. | Держа бёдра на уровне и параллельно полу, поднимите одну ногу над полом контролируемым движением. | Pull the lifted leg forward by driving the knee toward your chest, feeling a stretch through the hip and waist on that side. | На мгновение остановитесь в точке максимальной растяжки, сохраняя нейтральное положение позвоночника и избегая любых скручиваний в тазу. | Slowly return the leg back to the starting plank position under full control. | Repeat for the desired number of repetitions on that side, then switch to the other leg. | Throughout the movement, keep your shoulders packed down and away from your ears and avoid letting your lower back sag or arch excessively.
tHe: התחל בפלאנק גבוה עם ידיים בדיוק מתחת לכתפיים, ידיים ישרות לגמרי, והגוף יוצר קו ישר מהראש ועד העקבים. | הפעל את שרירי הליבה ודחוף את הרצפה עם כפות ידיך כדי ליצור בסיס יציב ותומך. | Keeping your hips level and square to the floor, lift one leg off the ground with a controlled motion. | Pull the lifted leg forward by driving the knee toward your chest, feeling a stretch through the hip and waist on that side. | Pause briefly at the point of maximum stretch, maintaining a neutral spine and avoiding any twisting through the hips. | Slowly return the leg back to the starting plank position under full control. | Repeat for the desired number of repetitions on that side, then switch to the other leg. | Throughout the movement, keep your shoulders packed down and away from your ears and avoid letting your lower back sag or arch excessively.

t: Sit on the edge of a flat bench and place your hands on the bench slightly behind your hips, fingers pointing forward, to create a stable base. | Extend both legs out in front of you, keeping them together and hovering a few inches above the floor. | Brace your core and sit tall, avoiding any rounding in the lower back. | Exhale as you draw both knees toward your chest in a controlled arc, tucking them as close as comfortable. | Hold the tucked position for one count, feeling the contraction in the rectus abdominis. | Inhale as you slowly extend your legs back out to the starting position without allowing your feet to touch the floor. | Maintain a stable upper body throughout — only your legs should move. | Complete the desired number of repetitions, then lower your feet to the floor to finish the set.
tRu: Sit on the edge of a flat bench and place your hands on the bench slightly behind your hips, fingers pointing forward, to create a stable base. | Вытяните обе ноги перед собой, держа их вместе и на несколько сантиметров над полом. | Напрягите корпус и сидите прямо, не допуская округления поясницы. | Выдыхайте, когда подтягиваете оба колена к груди по контролируемой дуге, поджимая их как можно ближе к себе. | Задержитесь в согнутой позиции на один счёт, ощущая сокращение в прямой мышце живота. | Вдыхайте, когда медленно выпрямляете ноги назад в исходное положение, не позволяя стопам касаться пола. | Сохраняйте стабильный верх тела на протяжении всего движения — должны двигаться только ваши ноги. | Выполните желаемое количество повторений, затем опустите ноги на пол, чтобы закончить подход.
tHe: Sit on the edge of a flat bench and place your hands on the bench slightly behind your hips, fingers pointing forward, to create a stable base. | פשוט את שתי הרגליים קדימה, שומר עליהן יחד ומרחק של כמה סנטימטרים מהרצפה. | הדק את הליבה ושב זקוף, תוך הימנעות מכל עיגול בגב התחתון. | לחץ אוויר בזמן שאתה מושך את שתי הברכים לחזה בקשת מבוקרת, מקפל אותן קרוב ככל שנוח. | Hold the tucked position for one count, feeling the contraction in the rectus abdominis. | Inhale as you slowly extend your legs back out to the starting position without allowing your feet to touch the floor. | Maintain a stable upper body throughout — only your legs should move. | בצע את מספר החזרות הרצוי, ואז הורד את רגליך לרצפה כדי לסיים את הסט.

t: Lie on your side on a mat with your body in a straight line, resting your head on your lower arm or hand for support. | Stack your hips directly on top of each other and keep your core lightly engaged to prevent your torso from rolling forward or backward. | Raise your top leg upward as high as comfortable, keeping it straight or with a slight bend at the knee. | Reach up with your top hand and grasp your ankle, shin, or foot — whichever allows you to maintain control without straining. | Gently pull the leg further toward your head and slightly across the midline of your body to increase the stretch through the inner thigh and hip adductors. | Hold the stretched position for 20–40 seconds, breathing slowly and relaxing into the tension with each exhale. | Release the grip and slowly lower the leg back to the starting position. | Roll to the other side and repeat the stretch on the opposite leg.
tRu: Лягте на бок на мате, тело вытянуто в прямую линию, голову положите на нижнюю руку или на руку для поддержки. | Stack your hips directly on top of each other and keep your core lightly engaged to prevent your torso from rolling forward or backward. | Raise your top leg upward as high as comfortable, keeping it straight or with a slight bend at the knee. | Reach up with your top hand and grasp your ankle, shin, or foot — whichever allows you to maintain control without straining. | Аккуратно потяните ногу дальше к голове и немного поперёк средней линии тела, чтобы усилить растяжку внутренней поверхности бедра и приводящих мышц тазобедренного сустава. | Держите растянутое положение 20–40 секунд, дыша медленно и расслабляясь в натяжении с каждым выдохом. | Release the grip and slowly lower the leg back to the starting position. | Перекатитесь на другую сторону и повторите растяжку на противоположной ноге.
tHe: Lie on your side on a mat with your body in a straight line, resting your head on your lower arm or hand for support. | Stack your hips directly on top of each other and keep your core lightly engaged to prevent your torso from rolling forward or backward. | Raise your top leg upward as high as comfortable, keeping it straight or with a slight bend at the knee. | Reach up with your top hand and grasp your ankle, shin, or foot — whichever allows you to maintain control without straining. | משוך בעדינות את הרגל עוד יותר לכיוון הראש ומעט מעבר לקו האמצע של הגוף כדי להגביר את המתיחה בירך הפנימית ובשרירי ההוספה. | Hold the stretched position for 20–40 seconds, breathing slowly and relaxing into the tension with each exhale. | Release the grip and slowly lower the leg back to the starting position. | התגלגל לצד השני וחזור על המתיחה ברגל הנגדית.

t: Lie flat on your back on a mat with your legs extended and arms resting at your sides, palms facing down. | Bend one knee and plant that foot flat on the floor for stability, keeping the other leg straight. | Bend the working leg to roughly 90 degrees so the knee points toward the ceiling. | Brace your core lightly and press your lower back gently toward the mat. | Slowly raise the bent knee toward your chest, pausing when your thigh is roughly perpendicular to the floor or you feel a comfortable stretch through the hip. | Hold the raised position for 1–2 seconds, focusing on the stretch sensation in the hip and thigh. | Lower the bent knee in a slow, controlled arc back to the starting position without letting the foot touch the floor if continuous tension is desired. | Complete all reps on one side, then switch legs and repeat.
tRu: Лягте на спину на коврик с вытянутыми ногами и руками вдоль тела, ладонями вниз. | Согните одну ногу и поставьте стопу на пол для устойчивости, удерживая другую ногу прямой. | Согните рабочую ногу примерно до 90 градусов так, чтобы колено смотрело в потолок. | Легко напрягите пресс и мягко прижмите поясницу к коврику. | Slowly raise the bent knee toward your chest, pausing when your thigh is roughly perpendicular to the floor or you feel a comfortable stretch through the hip. | Держите поднятую положение в течение 1-2 секунд, концентрируясь на ощущении растяжки в бёдре и бедре. | Плавно опустите согнутую ногу по медленной, контролируемой дуге в исходное положение, не давая стопе касаться пола, если необходимо постоянное напряжение. | Выполните все повторения на одну сторону, затем поменяйте ноги и повторите.
tHe: Lie flat on your back on a mat with your legs extended and arms resting at your sides, palms facing down. | כופף ברך אחת ונטע את כף הרגל שטוחה על הרצפה ליציבות, תוך שמירה על הרגל השנייה ישרה. | כופף את הרגל העובדת לערך ל-90 מעלות כך שהברך פונה לכיוון התקרה. | הדק קלות את הליבה ולחץ את הגב התחתון בעדינות לכיוון המזרן. | Slowly raise the bent knee toward your chest, pausing when your thigh is roughly perpendicular to the floor or you feel a comfortable stretch through the hip. | Hold the raised position for 1–2 seconds, focusing on the stretch sensation in the hip and thigh. | Lower the bent knee in a slow, controlled arc back to the starting position without letting the foot touch the floor if continuous tension is desired. | בצע את כל החזרות בצד אחד, ואז החלף רגליים וחזור על התרגיל.

t: Lie flat on a sturdy bench and reach both hands back to grip the bench firmly beside your head, thumbs wrapped around the edge for a secure hold. | Brace your core, squeeze your glutes, and press your upper back into the bench to create a stable shoulder anchor — this is your only contact point during the movement. | Raise your legs and hips off the bench in one controlled motion, lifting until your entire body forms a straight line from shoulders to feet, perpendicular to the bench. | Hold the top position briefly, maintaining a rigid plank — do not allow your hips to pike or your lower back to sag. | Lower your body slowly and under control toward the bench, keeping the straight-line position throughout the descent. | Stop just before your body touches the bench — hovering a few centimetres above it — to maintain tension in the core. | Raise back up to the top position in a controlled manner to complete one rep. | After your final rep, lower your body all the way to the bench and release the grip.
tRu: Лягте на спину на прочную скамью и обеими руками упритесь назад, крепко держась за скамью у головы, большие пальцы охватывают край для надежного хвата. | Напрягите корпус, сожмите ягодицы и прижмите верхнюю часть спины к скамье, чтобы создать стабильную точку опоры для плеч — это ваша точка контакта во время движения. | Raise your legs and hips off the bench in one controlled motion, lifting until your entire body forms a straight line from shoulders to feet, perpendicular to the bench. | Удерживайте верхнюю точку в течение короткого времени, сохраняя жёсткую планку — не позволяйте бёдрам подниматься или пояснице провисать. | Медленно и под контролем опустите тело к скамье, сохраняя прямую линию на всем протяжении опускания. | Stop just before your body touches the bench — hovering a few centimetres above it — to maintain tension in the core. | Raise back up to the top position in a controlled manner to complete one rep. | После финального повтора полностью опустите тело на скамью и отпустите хват.
tHe: Lie flat on a sturdy bench and reach both hands back to grip the bench firmly beside your head, thumbs wrapped around the edge for a secure hold. | תכווץ את שרירי הליבה, תכווץ את השרירים הגלוטיאליים, ולחץ את הגב העליון אל הספסל כדי ליצור עוגן יציב לכתף - זו הנקודה היחידה שבה באים במגע במהלך התנועה. | Raise your legs and hips off the bench in one controlled motion, lifting until your entire body forms a straight line from shoulders to feet, perpendicular to the bench. | Hold the top position briefly, maintaining a rigid plank — do not allow your hips to pike or your lower back to sag. | Lower your body slowly and under control toward the bench, keeping the straight-line position throughout the descent. | Stop just before your body touches the bench — hovering a few centimetres above it — to maintain tension in the core. | Raise back up to the top position in a controlled manner to complete one rep. | אחרי החזרה האחרונה, הורד את הגוף לגמרי לספסל ושחרר את האחיזה.

t: Lie flat on your back on a mat with your legs straight, arms at your sides with palms facing down. | Press your lower back gently into the mat by engaging your core before initiating any movement. | Keeping both legs straight and together, exhale and raise them until they are perpendicular to the floor at approximately 90 degrees. | At the top of the leg raise, contract your lower abdominals and curl your hips off the mat by tilting your pelvis posteriorly, lifting your tailbone 2–4 inches from the floor. | Hold the hip lift position for one count, ensuring the effort comes from your abs rather than momentum. | Slowly reverse the movement: lower your hips back to the mat first, then begin to descend your legs in a controlled manner. | Lower your legs until they are just above the floor without letting them touch, maintaining tension in the core throughout. | Inhale as you lower your legs and prepare for the next repetition.
tRu: Лягте на спину на коврик с прямыми ногами и руками вдоль тела, ладонями вниз. | Мягко прижмите поясницу к коврику, напрягая корпус, прежде чем начинать любое движение. | Держа обе ноги прямыми и вместе, на выдохе поднимите их, пока они не окажутся перпендикулярно полу примерно под углом 90 градусов. | В верхней точке подъёма ног напрягите нижнюю часть пресса и подкрутите бёдра от коврика, наклоняя таз назад и приподнимая копчик на 2–4 дюйма от пола. | Подержите положение поднятого таза в течение счета, убедившись, что усилие идет от пресса, а не за счет инерции. | Slowly reverse the movement: lower your hips back to the mat first, then begin to descend your legs in a controlled manner. | Опустите ноги до положения, когда они находятся прямо над полом, не давая им коснуться, сохраняя напряжение в корпусе на протяжении всего движения. | Выдохните, опуская ноги и готовясь к следующему повторению.

t: Lie on your side on a mat with your body in a straight line, legs stacked on top of each other and your bottom arm extended along the floor to support your head. | Place your top hand lightly behind your head or rest it on the floor in front of your chest for balance. | Brace your core and press your waist gently toward the mat to keep your spine neutral. | In one coordinated movement, raise your top leg upward and simultaneously crunch your torso laterally, bringing your elbow and hip toward each other. | Pause briefly at the top when you feel a contraction through the obliques and a stretch in the gluteus medius. | Slowly lower your leg and return your torso to the starting position with control, avoiding letting either the leg or torso drop passively. | Complete all reps on one side, then roll over and repeat on the opposite side.

t: Lie flat on your back on a mat with your legs extended, a slight (15–20 degree) bend in both knees, and your arms at your sides with palms facing down. | Press your lower back gently into the mat by engaging your core before initiating any movement. | Maintain the same slight knee bend throughout — this is the fixed position for the entire set, not a dynamic flex. | Exhale and raise both legs together in a controlled arc until your thighs are perpendicular to the floor, or as close to vertical as your flexibility allows. | Pause briefly at the top and squeeze your lower abdominals, ensuring your lower back remains in contact with the mat. | Inhale and slowly lower your legs back toward the floor in a controlled manner, resisting gravity the entire way down. | Stop the descent just before your feet touch the floor to keep continuous tension on the core. | Reset your breath and repeat for the target number of repetitions.

t: Place your mat perpendicular to a clear section of wall so that the short edge nearly touches the baseboard. | Sit sideways with one hip touching the wall, then swing your legs up the wall as you lower your torso onto the mat so you end up lying on your back with your legs extended vertically. | Scoot your hips as close to the wall as is comfortable, or allow a small gap if that feels better for your lower back. | Straighten your legs and let them rest passively against the wall, feet relaxed and hip-width apart. | Rest your arms on the floor beside you, palms facing up, and allow your shoulders and upper back to fully release into the mat. | Close your eyes, breathe slowly and evenly, and let your whole body become heavy against the floor. | Hold the position for 2–10 minutes, adjusting your distance from the wall if you feel any discomfort in the hamstrings or lower back. | To exit, bend your knees and bring them toward your chest, then roll gently onto one side and pause before pressing yourself up to seated.

t: Lie flat on your back on a mat with both legs extended and your arms resting at your sides, palms facing down. | Press your lower back gently into the mat to establish a stable, neutral spine. | Inhale to prepare, then on the exhale slowly slide your right leg out to the side along the floor, keeping your foot flexed and your toes pointing up toward the ceiling. | Move the leg only as far as you can while both hips remain in contact with the mat — do not allow the opposite hip to lift. | Hold the end position for 20 to 30 seconds, breathing steadily and relaxing into the stretch with each exhale. | To deepen the stretch, gently press your inner thigh toward the midline for about 5 seconds as if drawing the leg back to center, then release and let the leg settle a few degrees wider on the exhale. | After the hold, slowly slide the leg back to the center on an inhale, keeping the movement controlled. | Repeat on the left side, holding for the same duration. | Complete 2 to 3 rounds per side, allowing the range of motion to increase naturally over successive repetitions.

t: Lie flat on your back on a mat with both legs extended and your arms resting at your sides. | Bend your right knee and plant the foot on the floor, keeping your lower back in contact with the mat. | Raise your left leg off the floor and interlace your fingers behind the left thigh, just above the knee. | Slowly straighten the left knee as much as your flexibility allows, pressing the back of the leg toward the ceiling. | Gently pull the leg toward your torso until you feel a firm stretch along the back of the thigh — stop before pain or sharp tension. | Hold the stretched position for 20–30 seconds while breathing slowly and deeply, allowing the muscle to relax with each exhale. | Lower the leg under control, then repeat on the right leg.

t: Adjust the seat height so your hips are aligned with the pivot point of the machine's track — most Ab Coaster machines have a height pin or knob for this. | Kneel on the padded knee rest and grip the handles firmly with both hands, keeping your arms slightly bent and your shoulders relaxed. | Brace your core before moving — draw your navel gently inward and squeeze your abs to create tension. | Exhale and contract your abs to drive your knees upward along the curved track toward your chest in a smooth, controlled arc. | Continue until your knees reach the top of the arc and your abs are fully contracted — avoid jerking or using momentum to reach the peak. | Pause briefly at the top and squeeze your abdominals hard for one count. | Inhale and lower your knees back down the track slowly and under control, resisting gravity rather than letting the carriage drop. | Stop just short of the fully extended bottom position to keep tension on the abs, then begin the next rep. | Complete all reps, then carefully step off the knee rest.
tRu: Настройте высоту сиденья так, чтобы бёдра совпадали с осью направляющей тренажёра — на большинстве таких тренажёров для этого есть штифт или ручка регулировки высоты. | Встаньте на колено на подушке для коленей и крепко возьмитесь за рукоятки обеими руками, сохраняя руки слегка согнутыми, а плечи расслабленными. | Напрягите пресс перед движением — мягко втяните пупок и сожмите мышцы живота, создавая напряжение. | Выдохните и напрягите мышцы пресса, чтобы поднять колени вдоль изогнутой дорожки к груди по плавной, контролируемой дуге. | Продолжайте, пока ваши колени не достигнут вершины дуги, а пресс будет полностью сокращён — избегайте рывков или использования инерции для достижения верхней точки. | Пауза в верхней точке и сильное сжатие мышц живота на счёт один. | Выдохните и медленно опустите колени обратно по направлению под контролем, сопротивляясь гравитации, а не давая платформе падать. | Stop just short of the fully extended bottom position to keep tension on the abs, then begin the next rep. | Выполните все повторения, затем осторожно сойдите с упора для коленей.

t: Set the lever arm or cable attachment on the abduction machine to a height that aligns with your ankle or lower shin. | Stand next to the machine with the working leg closest to the attachment point, and secure the cuff around your ankle. | Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, holding the machine frame lightly for balance — do not lean into it. | Brace your core by drawing your navel gently inward, keeping your torso upright throughout the movement. | Exhale and raise the working leg out to the side and slightly forward in a controlled arc, combining abduction with a moderate hip flexion angle. | Lift until you feel a firm contraction in the outer hip (gluteus medius) and the hip flexor — typically 45 to 60 degrees — without tilting your pelvis. | Pause briefly at the top of the range, then inhale and lower the leg back to the starting position under control over two to three seconds. | Complete all reps on one side before switching legs, keeping the motion smooth and avoiding momentum. | Adjust the machine weight so you can maintain full control throughout — avoid using a load that forces you to hitch your hip or lean sideways.

tHe: Set the lever arm or cable attachment on the abduction machine to a height that aligns with your ankle or lower shin. | Stand next to the machine with the working leg closest to the attachment point, and secure the cuff around your ankle. | Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, holding the machine frame lightly for balance — do not lean into it. | הדק את הליבה במשיכת הטבור בעדינות פנימה, תוך שמירה על גו זקוף לאורך כל התנועה. | נשום החוצה והרים את הרגל הפועלת לצד וקלות קדימה בקשת מבוקרת, משלב הפרדה עם זווית בינונית של כיפוף הירך. | Lift until you feel a firm contraction in the outer hip (gluteus medius) and the hip flexor — typically 45 to 60 degrees — without tilting your pelvis. | Pause briefly at the top of the range, then inhale and lower the leg back to the starting position under control over two to three seconds. | בצע את כל החזרות בצד אחד לפני החלפת הרגליים, תוך שמירה על חלקלקות התנועה והימנעות מתנועה קינטית. | כוון את משקל המכשיר כך שתשמור על שליטה מלאה לאורך כל התנועה — הימנע ממשקל שמאלץ אותך להקפיץ את האגן או להישען הצידה.

t: Adjust the leverage machine seat height and pad positions so the pads sit comfortably against the outer thighs just above the knees. | Sit on the machine with your back flat against the support pad and your feet positioned on the footrests at roughly shoulder width. | Grip the side handles firmly to stabilize your torso throughout the movement. | Begin with the legs together or at the machine's starting position, then press outward through both legs simultaneously, abducting the hips. | As you press outward, allow a slight squat motion by bending at the hips and knees in coordination with the abduction movement. | Move to the end of the machine's range of motion in a controlled manner without locking out or jerking. | Pause briefly at the widest point, then return the legs back to the starting position with control, resisting the machine's weight on the way in. | Complete all reps for the set, then disengage the weight stack before stepping off the machine.
tRu: Настройте высоту сиденья рычажного тренажёра так, чтобы подушки удобно лежали на внешней поверхности бёдер чуть выше коленей. | Sit on the machine with your back flat against the support pad and your feet positioned on the footrests at roughly shoulder width. | Надежно возьмитесь за боковые ручки для стабилизации корпуса на протяжении всего движения. | Начните со сведённых ног или из стартового положения тренажёра, затем одновременно разведите обе ноги наружу, разводя бёдра. | Выжимая наружу, допустите лёгкое подседание, сгибая бёдра и колени согласованно с отведением. | Двигайтесь до конца амплитуды тренажёма контролируемо, не разгибая полностью и не рывками. | Задержитесь на мгновение в самой широкой точке, затем верните ноги в исходное положение, сопротивляясь весу тренажера. | Выполните все повторения в подходе, затем отключите весовую рамку, прежде чем сойти с тренажера.
tHe: כוון את גובה המושב ומיקום המשענות במכשיר המנוף כך שהמשענות יישבו בנוחות על הירכיים החיצוניות ממש מעל הברכיים. | Sit on the machine with your back flat against the support pad and your feet positioned on the footrests at roughly shoulder width. | אחוז בידיות הצד בחוזקה כדי לייצב את הגו לאורך כל התנועה. | התחל עם רגליים צמודות או במנח המוצא של המכשיר, ואז לחץ החוצה עם שתי הרגליים יחד תוך הרחקת האגן. | בדחיפה החוצה, אפשר כיפוף קל על ידי כיפוף באגן ובברכיים בתיאום עם תנועת ההרחקה. | Move to the end of the machine's range of motion in a controlled manner without locking out or jerking. | Pause briefly at the widest point, then return the legs back to the starting position with control, resisting the machine's weight on the way in. | בצע את כל החזרות לסט, ואף שחרר את הידיות וצעד בבטחה מהמזח.

t: Adjust the seat and lever arm of the machine so the pad or handles align with your upper body when seated upright. | Sit facing the machine and grip the handles or place your forearms on the pads, keeping your chest up and your back against the support. | Brace your core and set your feet flat on the footrests or floor to anchor your lower body. | Exhale and pull the lever downward and forward by contracting your abdominals, allowing your torso to round slightly as the resistance allows. | Continue the motion in a controlled arc until you reach the end of your comfortable range of motion without rounding your lower back excessively. | Pause briefly at the bottom of the swing to maximize abdominal contraction. | Inhale and return the lever to the starting position under control, resisting the weight on the way back rather than letting it snap up. | Complete the desired number of reps, then carefully release the weight stack and step away from the machine.
tRu: Настройте сиденье и рычаг тренажёра так, чтобы подушка или рукоятки находились на уровне верхней части тела в положении сидя прямо. | Sit facing the machine and grip the handles or place your forearms on the pads, keeping your chest up and your back against the support. | Напрягите корпус и плотно поставьте стопы на подставки или пол, чтобы зафиксировать нижнюю часть тела. | Выдыхайте и тяните рычаг вниз и вперёд, сокращая пресс, позволяя корпусу слегка округляться в меру сопротивления. | Продолжайте движение по контролируемой дуге, пока не достигнете предела своей комфортной амплитуды, не излишне округляя поясницу. | Пауза на мгновение в нижней точке маха для максимального сокращения мышц пресса. | Вдохните и плавно верните рычаг в исходное положение, сопротивляясь весу на пути назад, а не позволяя ему резко подняться. | Выполните желаемое количество повторений, затем осторожно снимите вес и отойдите от тренажера.
tHe: כוון את המושב וזרוע המנוף של המכשיר כך שהמשענת או הידיות יהיו בקו הגוף העליון בישיבה זקופה. | Sit facing the machine and grip the handles or place your forearms on the pads, keeping your chest up and your back against the support. | הדק את הליבה ומקם את כפות הרגליים שטוחות על התושבות או הרצפה כדי לעגן את פלג הגוף התחתון. | נשום החוצה ומשך את המנוף למטה ולפנים על ידי כיווץ שרירי הבטן, מאפשר לגוף להקפל קלות ככל שההתנגדות מאפשרת. | המשך את התנועה במסלול מבוקר עד שאתה מגיע לקצה טווח התנועה הנוח שלך מבלי לכפוף את הגב התחתון יתר על המידה. | Pause briefly at the bottom of the swing to maximize abdominal contraction. | Inhale and return the lever to the starting position under control, resisting the weight on the way back rather than letting it snap up. | בצע את מספר החזרות הרצוי, ואז שחרר בזהירות את ערימת המשקולות וצעד מהמכונה.

t: Select an appropriate weight on the leverage machine and adjust the seat height so your hips are level with or slightly above the machine's pivot point. | Sit upright with your back pressed firmly against the pad and your feet flat on the footrests or floor for stability. | Position your legs on the resistance pads so the pads rest against the inner surface of your thighs, just above the knees. | Set the machine's range-of-motion stop so that your starting position has your legs comfortably abducted — typically at a 30–45° angle from center. | Grip the handles lightly for balance, brace your core, and keep your chest up throughout the movement. | Exhale and drive your thighs inward in a controlled arc, squeezing your inner thighs together as your legs approach the midline. | At the point of peak adduction, pause for one second and contract the adductors and glutes deliberately. | Inhale and slowly allow your legs to return to the starting position, resisting the weight on the way out — do not let the stack crash. | Complete all reps for the set, maintaining an upright torso and controlled tempo throughout.

t: Adjust the seat height so that your upper arms rest flat along the arm pad with your elbows aligned with the machine's pivot point. | Grip the handles with an underhand (supinated) grip, one handle in each hand, and let both arms hang at full extension as your starting position. | Brace your core and keep your back against the seat — avoid leaning or rotating your torso. | Exhale and curl one arm upward in a smooth arc, squeezing the biceps as your forearm approaches your shoulder. | Hold the contracted position for a brief pause at the top, keeping the working upper arm pressed into the pad. | Inhale and lower the weight back to full extension in a controlled manner — do not let the weight drop. | Once the first arm is fully extended, immediately begin curling the opposite arm in the same fashion. | Continue alternating arms for the target number of repetitions per side. | After completing your set, lower both handles to the resting position before releasing your grip.
tRu: Настройте высоту сиденья так, чтобы плечи ровно лежали вдоль подушки для рук, а локти совпадали с осью вращения тренажёра. | Возьмитесь за ручки supinated (хватом снизу) хватом, одна ручка в каждой руке, и позвольте обеим рукам свободно висеть в полном выпрямлении в качестве исходного положения. | Напрягите корпус и прижимайте спину к спинке — избегайте наклона или вращения корпуса. | Выдохните и поднимите одну руку вверх по плавной дуге, сжимая бицепс, когда предплечье приближается к плечу. | Зафиксируйте сокращенное положение на короткую паузу в верхней точке, удерживая рабочую верхнюю руку прижатой к подушке. | Выдохните и опустите вес обратно в полное разгибание в контролируемом режиме — не давайте весу падать. | Как только одна рука будет полностью выпрямлена, немедленно начните сгибать противоположную руку в том же стиле. | Продолжайте поочерёдно работать руками на целевое количество повторений на каждую сторону. | Выполнив подход, опустите обе рукоятки в положение покоя, прежде чем отпустить хват.
tHe: כוון את גובה המושב כך שהזרועות העליונות יונחו שטוח לאורך משענת היד עם מרפקים בקו ציר הסיבוב של המכשיר. | אחוז בידיות באחיזה מלמטה (סופינציה), ידית בכל יד, ותן לשתי הזרועות לתלות בפשיטה מלאה כעמדת ההתחלה. | הדק את הליבה ושמור את הגב על המושב — הימנע מהישענות או סיבוב הגוף. | נשוף וכופף את יד אחת למעלה בקשת חלקה, כופף את הזרוע הקדמית כשהיא מתקרבת לכתף. | Hold the contracted position for a brief pause at the top, keeping the working upper arm pressed into the pad. | Inhale and lower the weight back to full extension in a controlled manner — do not let the weight drop. | Once the first arm is fully extended, immediately begin curling the opposite arm in the same fashion. | המשיל להחליף בין הזרועות למספר החזרות המיועד לכל צד. | אחרי שסיימת את הסט, הורד את שתי הידיות לעמדת המנוחה לפני שחרור האחיזה.

t: Load the appropriate weight plates onto the machine and adjust the seat so your knees align with the machine's pivot point. | Sit upright with your back flat against the pad and grip the handles on either side of the seat for stability. | Place both feet behind the roller pads with your feet hip-width apart and toes pointing forward. | Brace your core and, keeping your non-working leg relaxed behind its pad, exhale and extend your working leg smoothly until it is nearly straight — avoid locking the knee. | Hold the fully extended position briefly to maintain tension in the quadriceps. | Inhale and lower the working leg in a controlled manner back to the starting position. | Without pausing, repeat the extension with the opposite leg, alternating in this fashion for the target number of repetitions per side. | After completing the set, ensure the weight is secured before stepping off the machine.
tRu: Загрузите соответствующие весовые диски на тренажёр и отрегулируйте сиденье так, чтобы колени совпадали с шарнирной точкой тренажёра. | Sit upright with your back flat against the pad and grip the handles on either side of the seat for stability. | Поставьте обе ноги за валиками так, чтобы ноги были на ширине бёдер и пальцы направлены вперёд. | Напрягите пресс и, удерживая нерабочую ногу расслабленной за валиком, на выдохе плавно разогните рабочую ногу почти до конца — не выпрямляйте колено полностью. | Задержите полностью выпрямленное положение на короткое время, чтобы сохранить напряжение в квадрицепсах. | Выдохните и опустите рабочую ногу в контролируемом режиме обратно в исходное положение. | Without pausing, repeat the extension with the opposite leg, alternating in this fashion for the target number of repetitions per side. | Выполнив подход, убедитесь, что вес закреплён, прежде чем сойти с тренажёра.

t: Load the desired weight plates onto the machine's horns and secure them with collars. | Sit in the seat and place both feet on the platform at roughly hip-width apart, with toes pointed slightly outward. | Disengage the safety handles and hold the machine's side handles firmly to stabilize your torso. | Press the platform out fully with both legs to establish your starting position, then allow one foot to remain on the platform while lifting the opposite foot a few inches away. | Lower the platform by bending the working knee in a controlled manner until your knee reaches approximately 90 degrees, keeping your lower back flat against the pad. | Press the platform back to full extension through your hip and thigh without locking the knee aggressively at the top. | Complete all reps on the first leg, then switch so the other foot is the working leg and repeat. | Once all reps are done, engage the safety handles before removing your feet from the platform. | Lower the platform gently back to the rest position and re-rack safely.

t: Load the plate-loaded leverage machine and adjust the chest pad (if present) or seat height so that the handles are at approximately mid-chest level when you sit upright. | Sit facing the machine and plant your feet firmly on the footrests or floor. t: Adjust the seat so that when you place one foot on the platform, your knee bends to roughly 90° and your lower back stays flat against the pad. | Sit down and place one foot in the center of the platform, roughly shoulder-width from the midline, with your toes pointed slightly outward. | Keep your non-working foot flat on the floor or resting lightly on the frame — do not use it to assist the press. | Release the safety handles and lower the platform by bending your working knee slowly toward your chest, stopping when your knee reaches about 90° or your lower back begins to round. | Drive through your heel and mid-foot to press the platform away, extending your knee without locking it out at the top. | Control the descent for the full set of reps, then lock the safety handles before switching legs. | Perform the same number of reps on the other leg, starting with your weaker side if there is a noticeable imbalance.

t: Adjust the seat back position so that when seated, your knees form approximately a 90-degree angle with your feet flat on the footplate. | Sit firmly in the seat with your back flush against the pad and your head resting naturally against the headrest. | Place your feet shoulder-width apart on the footplate, toes pointing slightly outward (about 15–30 degrees). | Grip the handles on either side of the seat to stabilize your upper body throughout the movement. | Press through your heels and the balls of your feet to extend your legs, pushing the footplate away until your legs are nearly straight — do not lock out your knees at the top. | Pause briefly at the top of the movement, keeping a slight bend in the knees. | Slowly lower the footplate back toward you in a controlled manner until your knees return to approximately 90 degrees, or until you feel a comfortable stretch in the hips and thighs. | Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, maintaining steady breathing — exhale on the press, inhale on the lowering phase. | To finish, press to the top position and engage any safety latches or pegs before releasing your feet from the footplate.

t: Adjust the lever machine so the pad sits across your lower thighs, just above the knees, and your hips are free to hinge over the edge of the platform. | Step onto the footrests and hook your feet securely under the anchor, keeping them hip-width apart. | Fold at the hips and lower your torso toward the floor until your body forms roughly a 90° angle — or as far as your flexibility allows without rounding your lower back. | Cross your arms over your chest or place your hands lightly behind your head; avoid pulling on your neck. | Brace your core and squeeze your glutes, then drive your hips forward and raise your torso by extending through your lower back and hips. | Continue rising until your body forms a straight line from head to heels — do not hyperextend past neutral. | Pause briefly at the top to feel peak contraction in your erector spinae and glutes. | Lower your torso back down slowly and under control to the starting position. | Complete all reps, then step off the machine safely.

nR: Растяжка икр на рычажном (со свободным весом, изометрия)
t: Load the machine with an appropriate amount of weight — start light, as even modest loads create significant stretch tension on the calves. | Sit or stand in the machine according to its design, and position the balls of your feet on the edge of the footplate with your heels hanging freely off the bottom. | Extend your legs so the machine is supporting the load, then allow your ankles to dorsiflex fully — heels dropping as far down as your range of motion allows. | Keep your knees straight (to emphasize the gastrocnemius) or slightly bent (to emphasize the soleus), depending on which part of the calf you want to target. | Maintain a neutral spine and a relaxed upper body throughout the hold — do not grip or brace aggressively. | Hold the stretched position for the desired duration, typically 20–60 seconds, breathing steadily and allowing the muscles to relax into the stretch. | When the hold is complete, plantarflex slightly to release the tension before unloading the machine and stepping off safely.

t: Adjust the seat so the handles align roughly with the middle of your chest when you sit upright. | Sit back firmly against the pad, plant both feet flat on the floor, and pull your shoulder blades down and together against the backrest. | Grip the handles at a comfortable width — slightly wider than shoulder-width is typical — with your thumbs wrapped fully around them. | Inhale, then exhale as you press the handles forward in a smooth arc until your arms are fully extended but not locked out aggressively. | Pause briefly at the end of the press without letting your shoulders round forward. | Inhale as you control the handles back toward the start position, feeling a stretch across the chest at the end of the return. | Stop just before the weight settles onto the stops to keep tension on the muscles throughout the set. | Complete your reps, then guide the handles back to the rest position under control before standing.

tHe: כוון את המושב כך שהידיות יהיו בערך בקו מרכז החזה בישיבה זקופה. | Sit back firmly against the pad, plant both feet flat on the floor, and pull your shoulder blades down and together against the backrest. | אחוז בידיות ברוחב נוח — מעט רחב מרוחב הכתפיים הוא המקובל — תוך עטיפת האגודלים לגמרי סביבן. | Inhale, then exhale as you press the handles forward in a smooth arc until your arms are fully extended but not locked out aggressively. | Pause briefly at the end of the press without letting your shoulders round forward. | Inhale as you control the handles back toward the start position, feeling a stretch across the chest at the end of the return. | Stop just before the weight settles onto the stops to keep tension on the muscles throughout the set. | בצע את כל החזרות, ואז הובל את הידיות בחזרה למצב המנוחה בשליטה לפני שתעמוד.

t: Set the seat height so the handles align with the middle of your chest when you sit upright. | Sit with your back flat against the pad, feet planted firmly on the floor. | Grip the handles with a neutral or pronated grip at chest level, wrapping your thumbs fully around the handles. | Retract and depress your shoulder blades — pull them down and together against the back pad — and hold this position throughout the set. | Take a breath, brace your core, and press the handles forward in a smooth arc until your arms are fully extended but not locked out aggressively. | Pause briefly at the extended position without letting your shoulders roll forward. | Return the handles under control to the starting position, feeling a light stretch across your chest at the end of the negative. | Complete your reps, then engage the safety stop or re-rack the handles before standing.

t: Adjust the seat height so your thighs are secured under the pad and your feet are flat on the floor. | Grasp the handles with a palms-facing-in grip, reaching across your body so each hand takes the opposite handle (right hand to left handle, left hand to right handle). | Sit tall with your chest up and a slight natural arch in your lower back — avoid rounding the spine. | Take a deep breath in, then exhale as you pull both handles down and toward your lower chest by driving your elbows down and back. | Keep your elbows flared out to the sides rather than tucking them forward, to maximize lat engagement. | Squeeze your lats hard at the bottom of the movement when the handles reach mid-chest level. | Inhale as you slowly return the handles to the starting position, allowing your shoulder blades to spread and your lats to fully stretch at the top. | Repeat for the target number of repetitions without losing control of the weight on the return.
tRu: Настройте высоту сиденья так, чтобы бёдра были зафиксированы под подушкой, а стопы ровно стояли на полу. | Возьмитесь за рукоятки хватом ладонями внутрь, перекрывая тело, чтобы каждая рука брала противоположную рукоятку (правая рука к левой рукоятке, левая рука к правой рукоятке). | Sit tall with your chest up and a slight natural arch in your lower back — avoid rounding the spine. | Take a deep breath in, then exhale as you pull both handles down and toward your lower chest by driving your elbows down and back. | Держите локти разведенными в стороны, а не прижмыными вперед, чтобы максимально задействовать широчайшие мышцы. | Squeeze your lats hard at the bottom of the movement when the handles reach mid-chest level. | Вдыхайте, когда плавно возвращаете рукоятки в исходное положение, позволяя лопаткам расходиться, а широчайшим мышцам полностью растягиваться в верхней точке. | Repeat for the target number of repetitions without losing control of the weight on the return.

t: Adjust the seat height so the handles are at roughly chest level when you sit upright with your back against the pad. | Sit with your back firmly against the pad, chest up, and feet flat on the floor. Grip the handles with a neutral or slightly supinated grip. | Start with your arms extended outward to your sides, elbows slightly bent — do not lock them straight. This is your starting position. | Exhale and sweep your arms forward and inward in a wide arc, leading with your elbows and forearms, not your hands alone. | Continue the arc until your hands cross at the midline of your body, actively squeezing your chest (pectoralis major, sternal head) at this point of maximum contraction. | Hold the squeeze for one count, then inhale and reverse the arc under control, allowing your arms to open back to the start position without letting the weight stack touch down between reps. | Keep your torso still throughout — do not lean forward or shrug your shoulders to assist the movement. | Complete your target reps, then let the handles return to the resting position before releasing your grip.

t: Load the desired weight plates onto both lever arms and secure any collars. | Step onto the platform and position yourself between the machine's rails so the handles are at roughly mid-shin height when you stand tall. | Place your feet hip-width apart with toes pointed slightly outward, directly under your hips. | Hinge at the hips and push them back — do not squat straight down — until your torso is angled forward and you can reach the handles comfortably. | Grip the handles firmly with both hands and brace your core, drawing your shoulder blades down and back to create a flat, neutral spine. | Take a deep breath, brace your abdomen, and drive through your heels to extend your hips and knees simultaneously as you rise. | Stand fully upright at the top, squeezing your glutes — avoid hyperextending your lower back. | Lower the weight under control by hinging at the hips first, then bending the knees, maintaining a flat back throughout the descent. | Return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of reps before re-racking the weight.

t: Adjust the seat height so the handles align with your lower chest when seated. | Sit down and recline into the decline pad, securing your feet under the foot brace to anchor your lower body. | Grasp both handles with a full overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width. | Plant your back firmly against the pad, keep your chest up, and retract your shoulder blades. | Take a deep breath in, then press the handles forward and slightly downward along the machine's arc until your elbows are nearly fully extended — do not lock out. | Pause briefly at the top with tension still on the chest. | Slowly lower the handles back toward your lower chest under control, letting your elbows travel back to roughly 90 degrees or the comfortable end of the machine's range. | Exhale as you press and inhale as you lower. Repeat for the target number of reps.

Повторите для целевого количества повторений.

t: Set the decline bench to your desired angle — a shallower angle (around 30°) suits beginners, while a steeper angle increases difficulty. | Sit on the bench and hook your feet securely under the padded rollers so your ankles are fully locked in. | Lower yourself back until your torso is in line with the decline, with your arms crossed over your chest or hands lightly touching your temples. | Brace your core and exhale as you curl your torso upward, leading with your chest and bringing your ribcage toward your hips. | Continue rising until your torso is roughly perpendicular to the floor or your lower back just lifts off the pad. | Pause briefly at the top with your abs contracted. | Inhale as you lower your torso back down under control, resisting the pull of gravity rather than dropping freely. | Keep the descent slow and controlled until your upper back contacts the pad, then begin the next rep.

t: Load the leverage machine with the appropriate weight and position yourself under the shoulder pads, standing with feet hip- to shoulder-width apart and toes angled out 15–30 degrees. | Stand tall to take the load on the shoulder pads, then rotate the handles to unrack the weight. | Brace your core, take a deep breath in, and keep your chest tall and gaze forward. | Initiate the descent by simultaneously pushing your knees out in line with your toes and sitting your hips back and down. | Lower yourself until your thighs are at or below parallel to the floor — achieving full depth with hips below knees. | Keep your heels flat on the platform throughout the descent; do not allow them to rise. | At the bottom, pause briefly, then drive through your entire foot to push the floor away and return to standing. | Exhale as you push through the concentric phase; fully extend your hips and knees at the top without locking out aggressively. | Complete all reps, stand fully upright, then rotate the handles to re-rack the weight before stepping out from under the pads.
tRu: Нагрузите рычажный тренажер подходящим весом и займите положение под плечевыми упорами, стоя с ногами на ширине таза до ширины плеч и носками, развёрнутыми на 15–30 градусов. | Stand tall to take the load on the shoulder pads, then rotate the handles to unrack the weight. | Напрягите корпус, сделайте глубокий вдох и держите грудь высоко, смотрите прямо перед собой. | Начните опускание, одновременно отводя колени в сторону носков и опуская бёдра назад и вниз. | Опуститесь до положения, когда бёдра находятся на уровне ниже параллели полу — достигнув полной глубины с бёдрами ниже колен. | Держите пятки прижатыми к платформе в течение всего опускания, не позволяйте им отрываться. | Внизу сделайте короткую паузу, затем оттолкнитесь всей стопой от пола и вернитесь в стойку. | Выдыхайте, когда выталкиваетесь в концентрической фазе; полностью выпрямите бедра и колени в верхней точке, но не агрессивно блокируйте их. | Выполните все повторения, встаньте прямо, затем поверните рукоятки, чтобы вернуть вес на место, прежде чем выкатываться из-под упоров.
tHe: Load the leverage machine with the appropriate weight and position yourself under the shoulder pads, standing with feet hip- to shoulder-width apart and toes angled out 15–30 degrees. | Stand tall to take the load on the shoulder pads, then rotate the handles to unrack the weight. | כווץ את שרירי הליבה, קח נשימה עמוקה, ושמור על חזה גבוה ומבט קדימה. | Initiate the descent by simultaneously pushing your knees out in line with your toes and sitting your hips back and down. | Lower yourself until your thighs are at or below parallel to the floor — achieving full depth with hips below knees. | שמור על עקבים שטוחים על המשטח לאורך כל הירידה; אל תיתן להם להתרומם. | בתחתית עצור לרגע, ואז דחוף דרך כל כף הרגל את הרצפה וחזור לעמידה. | לחץ אוויר בזמן שאתה דוחף דרך שלב הכיווץ; הארך את המותניים והברכיים במלואן בשיא התנועה מבלי לנעול בחוזקה. | בצע את כל החזרות, עמוד ישר לחלוטין, ואז סובב את הידיות כדי להניח מחדש את המשקל לפני היציאה מתחת לפדים.

t: Adjust the machine so the pad rests against the back of your thigh just above the knee, or your heel depending on the machine design. Set the footplate or starting position so your hip begins in a flexed, neutral position. | Stand or kneel on the machine's support platform with your chest and hips braced against the pad. Grip the handles firmly to stabilize your upper body. | Engage your core and keep your lower back in a neutral position — avoid letting it arch excessively before the movement begins. | Drive the lever backward by extending your hip, pressing through the pad with a slow, controlled push. Think of pushing your leg straight back and up. | Continue the extension until your leg is fully extended behind you and you feel a strong contraction in your glute at the top. | Pause for a full second at peak extension, squeezing your glute deliberately before returning. | Lower the lever back to the starting position under control, letting your hip return to a flexed position without relaxing the muscles entirely. | Complete all reps on one side before switching legs, or follow the machine's dual-leg protocol if available.

t: Load the machine with the appropriate weight and step into the platform, positioning your feet hip- to shoulder-width apart with toes angled slightly outward. | Place your back flat against the padded backrest and your shoulders firmly under the shoulder pads. | Disengage the safety handles and hold them at your sides. | Take a deep breath, brace your core, and begin lowering by bending at the knees, keeping them tracking in line with your toes. | Descend in a controlled manner until your thighs are parallel to the platform — or as low as your mobility allows without your lower back rounding. | Pause briefly at the bottom without locking your knees together or collapsing inward. | Drive through your entire foot to press the platform away, extending your knees and hips simultaneously until your legs are nearly straight. | Do not lock out your knees at the top — keep a slight bend to maintain tension on the quadriceps. | Complete your reps, then re-engage the safety handles before stepping off the machine.
tRu: Нагрузите тренажер подходящим весом и ступите на платформу, расположив ноги на ширине таза до ширины плеч с носками, слегка развёрнутыми наружу. | Прижмите спину к мягкой спинке и плотно прижмите плечи к подушечкам под плечи. | Отключите предохранительные рукоятки и держите их по бокам. | Take a deep breath, brace your core, and begin lowering by bending at the knees, keeping them tracking in line with your toes. | Опускайтесь контролируемо, пока бедра не станут параллельны платформе — или насколько позволяет ваша подвижность, не округляя поясницу. | На мгновение задержитесь внизу, не разгибая колени до упора и не сводя их внутрь. | Отталкивайтесь всей стопой, чтобы оттолкнуть платформу, разгибая колено и тазобедренный сустав одновременно, пока ноги не станут почти прямыми. | Не выпрямляйте колени в верхней точке — сохраните небольшое сгибание, чтобы поддерживать напряжение в квадрицепсах. | Выполните повторения, затем снова зафиксируйте страховочные рукояти, прежде чем сходить с тренажёра.
tHe: Load the machine with the appropriate weight and step into the platform, positioning your feet hip- to shoulder-width apart with toes angled slightly outward. | Place your back flat against the padded backrest and your shoulders firmly under the shoulder pads. | שחרר את מנגנוני הבטיחות ואחז בהם בצדדיך. | Take a deep breath, brace your core, and begin lowering by bending at the knees, keeping them tracking in line with your toes. | רד בצורה מבוקרת עד שהירכים שלך מקבילות למשטח — או ככל שהניידות שלך מאפשרת מבלי לגרום לגב התחתון להתעקם. | Pause briefly at the bottom without locking your knees together or collapsing inward. | דחוף דרך כף הרגל כולה כדי ללחוץ את הפלטפורמה רחוק, מרחיב את הברכים והאגן בו זמנית עד שהרגליים כמעט ישרות. | אל תנעוץ את הברכים בראש התנועה — שמור על כיפוף קל כדי לשמור על מתח בשרירי הירך. | סיים את החזרות, ואז נעל מחדש את ידיות הבטיחות לפני הירידה מהמכשיר.

nR: Нижняя тяга на рычажном (со свободным весом)
t: Load the appropriate weight plates onto the leverage machine and adjust the seat height so the handles are roughly at lower-chest height when you are seated upright. | Sit down, place your feet flat on the footrests or floor, and brace your core with a slight forward lean from the hips — not the lower back. | Grasp the handles with a neutral or pronated grip, arms extended in front of you, feeling a light stretch through your lats and mid-back. | Take a breath in, then initiate the pull by drawing your shoulder blades down and together before your elbows begin to bend. | Row the handles toward your lower abdomen, keeping your elbows close to your sides and driving them straight back rather than flaring them out. | Squeeze your mid-back and lats hard at the end of the pull, holding for one count without rocking your torso. | Exhale and extend your arms back to the starting position under control, allowing your shoulder blades to protract fully to stretch the target muscles. | Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, maintaining an upright, stable torso throughout.
tRu: Загрузите соответствующие весовые диски на рычажную машину и отрегулируйте высоту сиденья так, чтобы ручки были примерно на уровне нижней груди, когда вы сидите прямо. | Sit down, place your feet flat on the footrests or floor, and brace your core with a slight forward lean from the hips — not the lower back. | Возьмитесь за рукоятки нейтральным или пронированным хватом, руки полностью выпрямлены перед вами, чувствуя легкую растяжку в широчайших мышцах и средней части спины. | Take a breath in, then initiate the pull by drawing your shoulder blades down and together before your elbows begin to bend. | Row the handles toward your lower abdomen, keeping your elbows close to your sides and driving them straight back rather than flaring them out. | Squeeze your mid-back and lats hard at the end of the pull, holding for one count without rocking your torso. | Выдохните и верните руки в исходное положение под контролем, позволяя лопаткам полностью выдвигаться вперед, чтобы растян целевые мышцы. | Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, maintaining an upright, stable torso throughout.
