t: Start in a push-up position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your hips raised so your body forms an inverted V, similar to a downward-dog. | Keep your arms and legs straight and your heels pressing toward the floor at the top of the arc. | Begin the movement by bending your elbows and lowering your chin toward the floor, initiating the forward sweep. | Scoop your chest forward and down in a smooth arc, keeping your hips lower than at the start as your body sweeps through the bottom position. | Press through your hands and extend your elbows as you continue the arc, pushing your chest upward and forward into an upward-dog position with hips near the floor. | At the top of the press, your arms should be straight, your chest open, and your gaze forward or slightly upward — feel the stretch across the pectoralis major and through the front of the torso. | Reverse the arc by pushing your hips back and upward, returning to the inverted-V starting position. | Control the return so you feel the rectus abdominis engage as the hips rise. | Repeat for the prescribed number of reps, maintaining a smooth, continuous motion throughout each cycle.
tRu: Start in a push-up position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your hips raised so your body forms an inverted V, similar to a downward-dog. | Держите руки вдоль тела, расслабленно лежа на бёдрах или вытянутыми вперёд — не отталкивайтесь от бёдер. | Начните движение со сгибания локтей и опускания подбородка к полу, инициируя проход вперёд. | Scoop your chest forward and down in a smooth arc, keeping your hips lower than at the start as your body sweeps through the bottom position. | Press through your hands and extend your elbows as you continue the arc, pushing your chest upward and forward into an upward-dog position with hips near the floor. | В верхней точке жима руки прямые, грудь раскрыта, взгляд вперёд или чуть вверх — почувствуйте растяжение большой грудной мышцы и передней поверхности корпуса. | Reverse the arc by pushing your hips back and upward, returning to the inverted-V starting position. | Контролируйте возврат, чтобы почувствовать напряжение прямой мышцы живота, когда бёдра поднимаются. | Repeat for the prescribed number of reps, maintaining a smooth, continuous motion throughout each cycle.
tHe: Start in a push-up position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your hips raised so your body forms an inverted V, similar to a downward-dog. | Keep your arms and legs straight and your heels pressing toward the floor at the top of the arc. | התחל את התנועה בכיפוף המרפקים והורדת הסנטר לכיוון הרצפה, תוך פתיחת הגריפה קדימה. | Scoop your chest forward and down in a smooth arc, keeping your hips lower than at the start as your body sweeps through the bottom position. | Press through your hands and extend your elbows as you continue the arc, pushing your chest upward and forward into an upward-dog position with hips near the floor. | בשיא הלחיצה הידיים צריכות להיות ישרות, החזה פתוח, והמבט קדימה או מעט למעלה — הרגש את המתיחה לאורך החזה וקדמת פלג הגוף. | Reverse the arc by pushing your hips back and upward, returning to the inverted-V starting position. | שלוט בחזרה כך שתרגיש את שריר הבטן הישר מתכווץ כשהירכיים עולות. | Repeat for the prescribed number of reps, maintaining a smooth, continuous motion throughout each cycle.

t: Start in a standard push-up position with your hands directly under your shoulders, arms straight, body in a straight line from head to heels. | Brace your core, squeeze your glutes, and keep your hips level so your spine stays neutral throughout the movement. | Lower your right forearm to the floor, placing it where your right hand was, then lower your left forearm so both forearms are flat on the ground. | Hold the forearm plank position for a moment, keeping your hips from rising or sagging. | Press your right hand back to the floor, followed by your left hand, returning to the push-up position. | Alternate the leading arm each rep to balance the workload evenly on both sides. | Complete the target number of transitions, then lower your knees to the floor to rest.
tRu: Start in a standard push-up position with your hands directly under your shoulders, arms straight, body in a straight line from head to heels. | Напрягите корпус, сожмите ягодицы и держите бёдра на одном уровне, чтобы позвоночник оставался нейтральным на протяжении всего движения. | Опустите правое предплечье на пол, поставив его туда, где была правая ладонь, затем опустите левое предплечье, чтобы оба предплечья лежали на земле. | Задержите планку на предплечьях на мгновение, не давая тазу подниматься или опускаться. | Press your right hand back to the floor, followed by your left hand, returning to the push-up position. | Чередуйте ведущую руку каждое повторение, чтобы равномерно распределить нагрузку на обе стороны. | Выполните целевое количество переходов, затем опустите колени на пол, чтобы отдохнуть.
tHe: Start in a standard push-up position with your hands directly under your shoulders, arms straight, body in a straight line from head to heels. | תכווץ את שרירי הליבה, כווץ את השרירים הגלוטיאליים, ושמור על ירכיים בגובה אחיד כך שהחוטם יישאר נייטרלי לאורך כל התנועה. | Lower your right forearm to the floor, placing it where your right hand was, then lower your left forearm so both forearms are flat on the ground. | Hold the forearm plank position for a moment, keeping your hips from rising or sagging. | Press your right hand back to the floor, followed by your left hand, returning to the push-up position. | החלף את היד המובילה בכל חזרה לאיזון שווה של העומס בשני הצדדים. | בצע את מספר המעברים המטרה, ואם ירד את הברכיים לרצפה כדי לנוח.

t: Stand with feet hip-width apart and place your hands on your hips or extend them forward for balance. | Adopt a quarter-squat position by pushing your hips back slightly and bending your knees, keeping your chest tall and core braced. | Shift your weight onto your right foot and step your left foot diagonally forward and to the left, landing softly on the ball of your foot. | Follow with your right foot, stepping only far enough to return to a hip-width stance without letting your feet touch, and keep the squat depth as you step. | Continue stepping in the same diagonal direction for the prescribed number of steps or distance. | Reverse the pattern by stepping diagonally backward and to the right, leading with the right foot, to travel back to your starting position. | Finish the set by bringing your feet back to hip-width and standing tall out of the quarter-squat.
tRu: Stand with feet hip-width apart and place your hands on your hips or extend them forward for balance. | Примите положение четверть-приседа, слегка отведя бёдра назад и согнув колени, удерживая грудь высоко, а корпус напряжённым. | Shift your weight onto your right foot and step your left foot diagonally forward and to the left, landing softly on the ball of your foot. | Следуйте правой ногой, делая шаг только настолько, чтобы вернуться в положение на ширине таза, не позволяя ногам соприкасаться, и сохраняйте глубину приседа во время шага. | Продолжайте шагать в том же диагональном направлении для назначенного количества шагов или расстояния. | Reverse the pattern by stepping diagonally backward and to the right, leading with the right foot, to travel back to your starting position. | Завершите подход, вернув ноги на ширину бедер и встаньте прямо из полуприседа.
tHe: Stand with feet hip-width apart and place your hands on your hips or extend them forward for balance. | אמץ עמדת רבע סקוואט על ידי דחיפת האגן מעט לאחור וכיפוף הברכיים, תוך שמירה על חזה זקוף וליבה מהודקת. | Shift your weight onto your right foot and step your left foot diagonally forward and to the left, landing softly on the ball of your foot. | המשך עם רגל ימין, וצעד רק עד כדי חזרה לרוחב האגן מבלי לתת לכפות הרגליים לגעת, ושמור על עומק הסקוואט בזמן הצעד. | המשך ללכת באלכסון באותו כיוון למספר הצעדים או המרחק המוגדר. | Reverse the pattern by stepping diagonally backward and to the right, leading with the right foot, to travel back to your starting position. | סיים את הסט בהחזרת הרגליים לרוחב האגן ועמידה זקופה מתוך הסקוואט החלקי.

t: Begin in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders, arms straight, and your body forming a straight line from head to heels. | Brace your core and keep your hips level — they should not pike up or sag toward the floor. | Drive your right knee diagonally toward your left elbow, rotating your hip slightly to complete the cross-body movement. | Without pausing, kick your right leg out to the right side, extending it roughly parallel to the floor. | Return your right foot to the starting position under control. | Immediately repeat the sequence on the opposite side — drive the left knee toward the right elbow, then kick the left leg out to the left. | Continue alternating sides at a brisk, controlled pace, maintaining plank alignment throughout. | Complete the prescribed number of repetitions or time interval, then lower your knees to the floor to rest.
tRu: Примите упор лёжа на прямых руках: ладони точно под плечами, руки прямые, тело образует прямую линию от головы до пяток. | Напрягите корпус и удерживайте бёдра на одном уровне — не поднимайте их вверх и не провисайте к полу. | С силовым движением подтяните правое колено по диагонали к левому локтю, слегка поворачивая таз для завершения скрестного движения. | Without pausing, kick your right leg out to the right side, extending it roughly parallel to the floor. | Return your right foot to the starting position under control. | Сразу же повторите последовательность на противоположной стороне — оттолкните левое колено к правому локтю, затем ударьте левой ногой влево. | Продолжайте попеременно менять стороны в быстром, контролируемом темпе, сохраняя положение планки. | Выполните указанное количество повторений или время, затем опустите колени на пол, чтобы отдохнуть.
tHe: התחל בפלאנק גבוה עם כפות ידיים בדיוק מתחת לכתפיים, זרועות ישרות, והגוף בקו ישר מהראש לעקבים. | הדק את הליבה ושמור על אגן מאוזן — אל תרים אותו למעלה ואל תשמיט אותו לכיוון הרצפה. | הנע את ברך ימיך באלכסון כלפי מרפק שמאל, מסובב מעט את הירך כדי להשלים את תנועת החצייה לגוף. | Without pausing, kick your right leg out to the right side, extending it roughly parallel to the floor. | Return your right foot to the starting position under control. | Immediately repeat the sequence on the opposite side — drive the left knee toward the right elbow, then kick the left leg out to the left. | המשיל לחילופין בין צד לצד בקצב מהיר ומבוקר, שומר על יישור פלאנק לאורך כל התרגיל. | בצע את מספר החזרות או המשך הזמן המרוקן, ואז הנמיך את הברכים לרצפה למנוחה.

t: Start in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders, arms fully extended, and your body forming a straight line from head to heels. | Engage your core and keep your hips level — do not let them rise or sag. | Drive your right knee toward your chest as explosively as possible. | Before that foot returns to the ground, simultaneously drive your left knee forward in a switching motion. | As both feet leave the ground during the switch, add a small explosive hop so both feet are briefly airborne at the same time. | Land softly with one knee drawn in and the opposite leg extended, absorbing impact through the balls of your feet. | Continue alternating legs in a rapid, rhythmic cadence for the target duration or repetitions. | To finish, bring both feet back to the starting plank position and hold briefly to stabilise.
tRu: Примите упор лёжа с прямыми руками точно под плечами, тело образует прямую линию от головы до пяток. | Напрягите корпус и держите бёдра на одном уровне — не позволяйте им подниматься или опускаться. | С силовым движением подтяните правое колено к груди как можно сильнее. | Прежде чем эта стопа вернётся на пол, одновременно выведите левое колено вперёд сменным движением. | Когда обе стопы отрываются от пола при смене, добавьте небольшой взрывной прыжок, чтобы обе ноги ненадолго оказались в воздухе одновременно. | Приземлитесь мягко, подтянув одно колено к себе и выпрямив противоположную ногу, амортизируя удар через носки стопы. | Продолжайте попеременно менять ногами в быстром, ритмичном темпе в течение целевой продолжительности или повторений. | To finish, bring both feet back to the starting plank position and hold briefly to stabilise.
tHe: התחל בפלאנק גבוה עם ידיים בדיוק מתחת לכתפיים, ידיים ישרות לגמרי, והגוף יוצר קו ישר מהראש ועד העקבים. | הפעל את שרירי הליבה ושמור על האגן במפלס — אל תתן לו לעלות או לרדת. | הנע את ברך ימיך כלפי החזה בכוח הרב ביותר האפשרי. | לפני שכף הרגל חוזרת לקרקע, הנף בו זמנית את ברך שמאל קדימה בתנועת החלפה. | כששתי הרגליים עוזבות את הקרקע בהחלפה, הוסף קפיצה קטנה ומתפרצת כך ששתי הרגליים באוויר לרגע בו-זמנית. | Land softly with one knee drawn in and the opposite leg extended, absorbing impact through the balls of your feet. | המשילו להחליף בין רגליים בקצב מהיר וקצבי למשך הזמן או מספר החזרות המטרה. | To finish, bring both feet back to the starting plank position and hold briefly to stabilise.

t: Start in a high plank with your hands flat on the floor directly under your shoulders, arms straight, and body in a straight line from head to heels. | Brace your core, squeeze your glutes, and ensure your hips are level — neither piked up nor sagging toward the floor. | Drive your right knee forward and bring your right foot all the way up beside your right hand, landing in a low lunge position with your heel flat or close to flat on the floor. | Pause briefly in the lunge to feel the stretch at the front of your left hip, keeping both hands planted and your right knee tracking in line with your right foot. | Step your right foot back to the starting plank position with control, re-establishing a neutral spine before the next rep. | Drive your left knee forward in the same way, bringing your left foot up beside your left hand into the low lunge position. | Pause, then return the left foot to the plank. | Continue alternating sides for the prescribed number of reps or time, maintaining steady breathing throughout.
tRu: Start in a high plank with your hands flat on the floor directly under your shoulders, arms straight, and body in a straight line from head to heels. | Напрягите корпус, сожмите ягодицы и убедитесь, что бёдра на одном уровне — ни приподняты, ни провисают. | С силовым движением подтяните правое колено вперёд и полностью поднимите правую стопу рядом с правой рукой, приземлившись в низкий выпад с пяткой на полу или близко к ней. | Задержитесь на мгновение в выпаде, чтобы почувствовать растяжение в передней части левого тазобедренного сустава, сохраняя обе руки на полу и отслеживая правое колено по линии правой стопы. | Step your right foot back to the starting plank position with control, re-establishing a neutral spine before the next rep. | С силовым движением подтяните левое колено вперёд так же, чтобы левая стопа оказалась рядом с левой рукой в положении выпада. | Пауза, затем верните левую ногу в планку. | Продолжайте поочередно выполнять движения на разные стороны в течение назначенного количества повторений или времени, сохраняя ровное дыхание на протяжении всего упражнения.
tHe: Start in a high plank with your hands flat on the floor directly under your shoulders, arms straight, and body in a straight line from head to heels. | תכווץ את שרירי הליבה, כווץ את הישבנים, ווודא שהמותניים באותגרך — לא מורמות ולא שקועות לעבר הרצפה. | הנע את ברך ימיך קדימה והבא את כף רגל ימיך עד לצד יד ימיך, נוח בתנוחת לאנג' נמוכה עם העקב שטוח או קרוב לשטוח על הרצפה. | Pause briefly in the lunge to feel the stretch at the front of your left hip, keeping both hands planted and your right knee tracking in line with your right foot. | Step your right foot back to the starting plank position with control, re-establishing a neutral spine before the next rep. | דחוף את הברך השמאלית קדימה באותו אופן, מביא את הכף השמאלית לצד היד השמאלית למצב לאנג' נמוך. | Pause, then return the left foot to the plank. | המשיל להחליף צדדים למספר החזרות או הזמן המומלצים, נשוף בקצב יציב לאורך כל התרגיל.

t: Place a folded towel on a smooth, hard floor — hardwood, tile, or laminate works best. | Get into a high-plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders, arms straight, and both feet resting on the towel. | Brace your core, squeeze your glutes, and set a neutral spine — your body should form a straight line from head to heels. | Slide your right foot forward along the floor, drawing your right knee toward your chest without raising your hips. | Slide the right foot back to the starting position, fully extending the hip before the next rep. | Immediately slide your left foot forward in the same controlled manner, keeping your hips level throughout. | Continue alternating legs at a steady pace, maintaining shoulder position directly over your wrists for the duration of the set. | To finish, press back through your shoulders, step off the towel, and release the plank position.
tRu: Положите сложенное полотенце на гладкий, твердый пол — лучше всего подходит паркет, плитка или ламинат. | Примите положение высокой планки с руками прямо под плечами, выпрямленными руками и обеими стопами на полотенце. | Напрягите корпус, сожмите ягодицы и установите нейтральное положение позвоночника — ваше тело должно образовать прямую линию от головы до пяток. | Slide your right foot forward along the floor, drawing your right knee toward your chest without raising your hips. | Slide the right foot back to the starting position, fully extending the hip before the next rep. | Сразу же скользите левой ногой вперед таким же контролируемым образом, сохраняя бедра на одном уровне. | Продолжайте поочерёдно менять ногами в устойчивом темпе, сохраняя положение плеч непосредственно над запястьями на протяжении всего подхода. | To finish, press back through your shoulders, step off the towel, and release the plank position.
tHe: Place a folded towel on a smooth, hard floor — hardwood, tile, or laminate works best. | היכנס לעמדת פלאנק גבוה כשהידיים ישירות מתחת לכתפיים, הזרועות ישרות ושתי כפות הרגליים מונחות על המגבת. | תכווץ את שרירי הליבה, תכווץ את השרירים הגלוטיאליים, וקבע עמוד שדרה נייטרלי - גופך צריך ליצור קו ישר מהראש עד לעקבים. | Slide your right foot forward along the floor, drawing your right knee toward your chest without raising your hips. | Slide the right foot back to the starting position, fully extending the hip before the next rep. | Immediately slide your left foot forward in the same controlled manner, keeping your hips level throughout. | המשילו להחליף בין רגליים בקצב יציב, ושמרו על מיקום הכתפיים מעל פרקי הידיים לכל אורך הסט. | To finish, press back through your shoulders, step off the towel, and release the plank position.

t: Place your hands flat on the floor, slightly wider than shoulder-width, and extend both legs behind you into a high-plank position with your body forming a straight line from head to heels. | Engage your core by bracing your abs and squeezing your glutes so your hips stay level with your shoulders throughout the set. | Lift your right foot and drive your right knee diagonally across your body toward your left elbow, rotating your hip slightly to allow full range of motion. | Pause for a brief moment at the top of the drive, feeling the contraction in your obliques and hip flexors. | Return your right foot to the starting position with control, keeping your hips from rising or dropping as the leg extends back. | Immediately drive your left knee diagonally toward your right elbow, mirroring the movement on the opposite side. | Continue alternating legs in a smooth, rhythmic pattern for the target number of repetitions or duration. | Keep your breathing steady throughout — exhale as each knee drives across, inhale as the foot returns.
tRu: Положите ладони плашмя на пол немного шире ширины плеч и вытяните обе ноги назад, заняв положение высокой планки, чтобы ваше тело образовывало прямую линию от головы до пят. | Напрягите корпус, напрягая пресс и сжимая ягодицы, чтобы бёдра оставались на уровне с плечами на протяжении подхода. | Поднимите правую ногу и отведите правое колено по диагонали через тело к левому локтю, слегка поворачивая бедро для полного диапазона движения. | Задержитесь на мгновение в верхней точке толчка, чувствуя сокращение в косых мышцах и сгибателях бёдер. | Return your right foot to the starting position with control, keeping your hips from rising or dropping as the leg extends back. | Сразу же оттолкните левое колено по диагонали к правому локтю, повторяя движение на противоположной стороне. | Продолжайте попеременно менять ногами в плавном, ритмичном движении в течение целевого количества повторений или продолжительности. | Держите дыхание ровным на протяжении всего движения — выдыхайте, когда каждое колено проходит мимо, вдохните, когда нога возвращается.
tHe: Place your hands flat on the floor, slightly wider than shoulder-width, and extend both legs behind you into a high-plank position with your body forming a straight line from head to heels. | הפעל את שרירי הליבה על ידי כריכת הבטן וכיווץ הישבנים כך שהירכיים נשארות באותו הגובה עם הכתפיים לכל אורך הסט. | Lift your right foot and drive your right knee diagonally across your body toward your left elbow, rotating your hip slightly to allow full range of motion. | Pause for a brief moment at the top of the drive, feeling the contraction in your obliques and hip flexors. | Return your right foot to the starting position with control, keeping your hips from rising or dropping as the leg extends back. | Immediately drive your left knee diagonally toward your right elbow, mirroring the movement on the opposite side. | המשיל לחילופין בין הרגליים בתבנית חלקה וקצבית למספר החזרות או הזמן המיועד. | Keep your breathing steady throughout — exhale as each knee drives across, inhale as the foot returns.

t: Stand with your feet together or hip-width apart, toes pointing straight forward and the outer edges of your feet parallel. | Press all four corners of each foot — the ball of the big toe, the ball of the little toe, and both sides of the heel — evenly into the floor. | Engage your thighs lightly so the kneecaps lift, but do not lock your knees; keep a very slight, natural bend. | Tuck your tailbone just enough to neutralize the lower back — avoid an exaggerated arch or a full posterior tuck. | Lengthen through the entire spine, drawing the crown of your head upward as if a thread were pulling it toward the ceiling. | Roll your shoulders up, back, and down so your shoulder blades settle onto your upper back and your chest opens without your ribcage flaring forward. | Let your arms hang at your sides with palms facing your thighs or slightly forward; keep your fingers long and relaxed. | Soften your jaw and face, breathe steadily through your nose, and hold the pose for five to ten slow breaths. | Release by taking one deep breath, then step your feet together if they were apart and allow your body to relax.
tRu: Stand with your feet together or hip-width apart, toes pointing straight forward and the outer edges of your feet parallel. | Press all four corners of each foot — the ball of the big toe, the ball of the little toe, and both sides of the heel — evenly into the floor. | Напрягите бедра легким напряжением, чтобы поднять колени, но не разгибайте их до конца; сохраняйте очень легкий, естественный сгиб. | Tuck your tailbone just enough to neutralize the lower back — avoid an exaggerated arch or a full posterior tuck. | Вытягивайтесь по всему позвоночнику, тянув макушку вверх, будто её тянит к потолку нитка. | Roll your shoulders up, back, and down so your shoulder blades settle onto your upper back and your chest opens without your ribcage flaring forward. | Пусть ваши руки свободно свисают по боками с ладонями, обращенными к бедрам или слегка вперед; держите пальцы длинными и расслабленными. | Soften your jaw and face, breathe steadily through your nose, and hold the pose for five to ten slow breaths. | Release by taking one deep breath, then step your feet together if they were apart and allow your body to relax.

t: Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width with an overhand grip, arms fully extended and body hanging straight. | Engage your core and retract your scapulae to create tension through your lats and upper back. | Initiate an explosive pull by driving your elbows down and back, pulling the bar toward your lower chest rather than your chin. | As the bar reaches chest height, lean forward aggressively and begin rotating your wrists so your hands transition from below to above the bar. | Use the momentum of the pull to drive your torso up and over the bar, keeping the bar close to your body throughout the transition. | Once your hips are level with the bar and your chest is above it, press your hands down into the bar to straighten your arms into the dip lockout position. | Pause briefly at the top with arms fully extended and body supported above the bar. | Lower yourself in a controlled manner back through the transition and into a full hang to complete the repetition.
tRu: Возьмитесь за штангу немного шире плеч хватом сверху, руки полностью выпрямлены, тело висит прямо. | Напрягите корпус и retract лопатки, создавая напряжение в широчайших мышцах спины и верхней части спины. | Инициируйте взрывную тягу, двигая локти вниз и назад, чтобы приподнять грудь к штанге как можно выше и быстрее. | Когда гриф достигает высоты груди, агрессивно наклонитесь вперёд и начните проворачивать запястья, переводя кисти из-под грифа наверх. | Use the momentum of the pull to drive your torso up and over the bar, keeping the bar close to your body throughout the transition. | Как только таз окажется на уровне штанги, а грудь над ней, надавите руками на штангу, выпрямив руки в конечной позиции отжимания. | На мгновение остановитесь в верхней точке с полностью выпрямленными руками и корпусом, поддерживаемым над перекладиной. | Опуститесь под контролем обратно через переходное положение и в полный вис, чтобы завершить повторение.
tHe: אחוז במוט מעט רחב מרוחב הכתפיים באחיזה מלמעלה, זרועות פשוטות לגמרי והגוף תלוי ישר. | הפעל את שרירי הליבה ומשוך את השכמות קדימה כדי ליצור מתח דרך הגב התחתון והחלק העליון של הגב. | Initiate an explosive pull by driving your elbows down and back, pulling the bar toward your lower chest rather than your chin. | כשהמוט מגיע לגובה החזה, הישען קדימה באגרסיביות והתחל לסובב את שורשי כף היד כך שהידיים יעברו מתחת למוט למעליו. | Use the momentum of the pull to drive your torso up and over the bar, keeping the bar close to your body throughout the transition. | Once your hips are level with the bar and your chest is above it, press your hands down into the bar to straighten your arms into the dip lockout position. | Pause briefly at the top with arms fully extended and body supported above the bar. | Lower yourself in a controlled manner back through the transition and into a full hang to complete the repetition.

t: Place a Bosu ball dome-side up on the floor and sit on the center of the dome. | Walk your feet forward and lower your lower back onto the top of the dome so it sits roughly at the level of your lumbar spine. | Let your torso arch back over the dome until your abs feel a full stretch, with your head, upper back, and arms hanging below the level of your hips. | Place your fingertips lightly at the sides of your head or cross your arms over your chest — do not pull on your neck. | Brace your core and exhale as you curl your torso upward, lifting your shoulders and upper back off the dome. | Continue curling until your abs are fully contracted and your torso has reached roughly a 30–45° angle above horizontal. | Hold the contracted position for one count, then inhale and slowly lower your torso back over the dome to the starting stretched position. | Control the descent fully — let the dome support your arch without bouncing off it. | Complete your reps, then carefully sit upright before stepping off the Bosu ball.
tRu: Поставьте Босу-бол вверх куполом на пол и сядьте в центр купола. | Walk your feet forward and lower your lower back onto the top of the dome so it sits roughly at the level of your lumbar spine. | Позвольте вашему корпусу наклониться вниз к полу под контролем, пока вы не почувствуете растяжку в ваших ягодицах, сохраняя округлое положение верхней части спины. | Положите пальцы по бокам головы или скрестите руки на груди — не тяните за шею. | Напрягите корпус и на выдохе поднимите корпус вверх, отрывая плечи и верх спины от полусферы. | Продолжайте сгибать, пока мышцы живота полностью не сократятся, а корпус не достигнет угла примерно 30–45° выше горизонтального. | Зафиксируйте сокращенное положение на один счет, затем вдохните и плавно опустите корпус обратно над куполом в исходное растянутое положение. | Полностью контролируйте опускание — позвольте куполу поддерживать свод стопы без отскока. | Выполните все повторения, затем осторожно сядьте прямо, прежде чем сойти с Bosu-мяча.

t: Stand with your feet slightly wider than hip-width apart and your toes angled out at roughly 45 degrees. | Lower your hips down into a deep squat, keeping your heels flat on the floor if possible; if your heels rise, place a folded mat or small wedge under them. | Allow your thighs to open wider than your torso so your knees track over your toes. | Bring your palms together at the center of your chest in a prayer position, thumbs lightly touching your sternum. | Press your elbows firmly against the inner surfaces of your knees, using this contact to encourage the knees to widen and the hips to open further. | Lengthen your spine upward, lifting the crown of your head toward the ceiling and drawing your shoulder blades slightly together to avoid rounding the upper back. | Breathe steadily, holding the position for five to ten slow breaths or as directed by your practice. | To exit, press through your feet, engage your legs, and rise back to standing in a controlled manner.
tRu: Stand with your feet slightly wider than hip-width apart and your toes angled out at roughly 45 degrees. | Опустите бёдра вниз в глубокое приседание, сохраняя пятки прижатыми к полу, если возможно; если пятки отрываются, подложите сложенный коврик или небольшой клин под них. | Разведите бёдра шире корпуса, чтобы колени шли над носками. | Сведите ладони в центре груди в положении молитвы, большие пальцы легко касаются грудины. | Press your elbows firmly against the inner surfaces of your knees, using this contact to encourage the knees to widen and the hips to open further. | Вытягивайте позвоночник вверх, поднимая макушку к потолку и слегка сводя лопатки вместе, чтобы избежать округления спины. | Дышите ровно, удерживая положение пять-десять медленных дыханий или как предписано вашей практикой. | To exit, press through your feet, engage your legs, and rise back to standing in a controlled manner.

nR: Мостик у скамьи с узкими ногами
t: Place a flat bench behind you and sit on the floor in front of it, facing away. | Lean back and position both heels on top of the bench with your feet together or no more than a few inches apart — this narrow stance is the key challenge of the movement. | Plant your hands flat on the floor beside your hips for initial stability. | Brace your core, press through your heels, and lift your hips off the floor until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to heels. | Lift your hands off the floor and extend your arms alongside your torso or hold them slightly out to the sides for balance, engaging the deltoid anterior and serratus anterior. | Hold the top position with your glutes lightly squeezed, but focus on drawing your lower ribs toward your hips to keep the rectus abdominis under tension. | Keep your hips level — resist any rotation caused by the narrow foot placement. | Lower your hips back to the floor under control to complete one repetition, or hold the top position for the prescribed time if performing an isometric variation.
tRu: Поставьте плоскую скамью за собой и сядьте на пол перед ней, спиной вперед. | Отклонитесь назад и поставьте обе пятки на скамью, ноги вместе или не более чем на несколько дюймов apart — узкая постановка ног — это ключевая сложность упражнения. | Положите руки на пол рядом с бёдрами для начальной устойчивости. | Напрягите корпус, оттолкнитесь пятками и поднимите бёдра от пола, пока тело не образует прямую линию от плеч до пяток. | Поднимите руки с пола и вытяните их вдоль корпуса или держите их немного в стороны для равновесия, вовлекая передние дельты и передние зубцы. | Задержитесь в верхней позиции, слегка сжимая ягодичные мышцы, но фокусируясь на том, чтобы тянуть нижние рёбра к бёдрам, чтобы держать прямую мышцу живота в напряжении. | Держите бёдра на одном уровне — сопротивляйтесь любому вращению, вызванному узкой постановкой ног. | Опустите бёдра обратно на пол под контролем для завершения одного повторения, или удерживайте верхнее положение в течение назначенного времени, если выполняется изометрический вариант.
tHe: Place a flat bench behind you and sit on the floor in front of it, facing away. | Lean back and position both heels on top of the bench with your feet together or no more than a few inches apart — this narrow stance is the key challenge of the movement. | Plant your hands flat on the floor beside your hips for initial stability. | הדק את הליבה, דחוף דרך העקבים והרם את האגן מהרצפה עד שהגוף יוצר קו ישר מהכתפיים לעקבים. | Lift your hands off the floor and extend your arms alongside your torso or hold them slightly out to the sides for balance, engaging the deltoid anterior and serratus anterior. | Hold the top position with your glutes lightly squeezed, but focus on drawing your lower ribs toward your hips to keep the rectus abdominis under tension. | Keep your hips level — resist any rotation caused by the narrow foot placement. | Lower your hips back to the floor under control to complete one repetition, or hold the top position for the prescribed time if performing an isometric variation.

t: Sit or stand beneath a chin-up bar and take a close, shoulder-width or narrower supinated (palms-facing-you) grip on the bar. | Hang at full arm extension, cross your feet if needed, and pull your shoulder blades down and back to activate the lats before you begin pulling. | Brace your core and depress your shoulders away from your ears to create a stable base. | Pull yourself upward by driving your elbows straight down toward your hips, keeping them close to your sides throughout the movement. | Continue pulling until your chin clears the bar or your upper chest approaches it, squeezing the lats and mid-back at the top. | Lower yourself in a controlled, slow manner back to full arm extension, resisting gravity on the way down. | Repeat for the desired number of reps, maintaining tension in the back and avoiding swinging.
tRu: Sit or stand beneath a chin-up bar and take a close, shoulder-width or narrower supinated (palms-facing-you) grip on the bar. | Повисните с полностью выпрямленными руками, при необходимости скрестите ноги, и опустите лопатки вниз и назад, чтобы активировать широчайшие мышцы, прежде чем начать тянуть. | Напрягите корпус и опустите плечи вниз от ушей, чтобы создать устойчивую базу. | Pull yourself upward by driving your elbows straight down toward your hips, keeping them close to your sides throughout the movement. | Продолжайте тянуть, пока ваш подбородок не окажется выше штанги или ваша верхняя часть груди не приблизилась к ней, сжимая широчайшие мышцы спины и середину спины в верхней точке. | Опуститесь под контролем, медленно, обратно в полное выпрямление рук, сопротивляясь силе тяжести на пути вниз. | Repeat for the desired number of reps, maintaining tension in the back and avoiding swinging.
tHe: Sit or stand beneath a chin-up bar and take a close, shoulder-width or narrower supinated (palms-facing-you) grip on the bar. | תלה בפשיטת זרועות מלאה, הצלב את הרגליים במידת הצורך, ומשוך את השכמות מטה ולאחור כדי להפעיל את הגב הרחב לפני תחילת המשיכה. | הדק את הליבה והורד את הכתפיים הרחק מהאוזניים כדי ליצור בסיס יציב. | Pull yourself upward by driving your elbows straight down toward your hips, keeping them close to your sides throughout the movement. | המשך למשוך עד שהסנטר שלך מעל המוט או החזה העליון מתקרב אליו, וכווץ את השרירים האחוריים של הגב הרחב והאמצעי בשיא התנועה. | Lower yourself in a controlled, slow manner back to full arm extension, resisting gravity on the way down. | Repeat for the desired number of reps, maintaining tension in the back and avoiding swinging.

t: Place a stable raised surface — weight plates, a low step, or a sturdy block — on the floor and stand on top of it with your feet hip-width apart or closer, toes pointing slightly outward. | Stand tall with your chest up, shoulders back, and arms extended in front of you or crossed at your chest for counterbalance. | Brace your core and shift your weight evenly through both feet, making sure your heels are fully supported by the platform. | Begin the descent by simultaneously pushing your hips back and bending your knees, allowing them to track over your toes. | Lower yourself as deep as your mobility allows — ideally until your thighs go below parallel — letting your heels drop toward the floor below the platform level to exploit the full deficit range. | Pause briefly at the bottom without collapsing your torso or rounding your lower back. | Drive through your entire foot to press the floor away, extending your hips and knees together as you return to standing. | Lock out at the top by squeezing your glutes and fully extending your legs before beginning the next rep.
tRu: Положите stable raised surface — weight plates, a low step, or a sturdy block — на пол и встаньте на нее с ногами на ширине таза или уже, пальцы ног слегка направлены наружу. | Stand tall with your chest up, shoulders back, and arms extended in front of you or crossed at your chest for counterbalance. | Напрягите корпус и равномерно распределите вес на обе стопы, убедившись, что пятки полностью стоят на платформе. | Начните опускание с одновременного отведения бёдер назад и сгибания коленей, позволяя им идти над носками. | Опуститесь как можно глубже, позволяет ваша подвижность — в идеале до тех пор, пока бедра не окажутся ниже параллельного пола — позволяя пяткам опуститься ниже уровня платформы, чтобы использовать полный диапазон движения с дефицитом. | На мгновение задержитесь внизу, не прогибаясь и не округляя поясницу. | Отталкивайтесь всей стопой, чтобы оттолкнуть пол, разгибая тазобедренный сустав и колено вместе, чтобы встать. | Зафиксируйте положение в верхней точке, сжимая ягодицы и полностью выпрямляя ноги перед началом следующего повторения.
tHe: Place a stable raised surface — weight plates, a low step, or a sturdy block — on the floor and stand on top of it with your feet hip-width apart or closer, toes pointing slightly outward. | Stand tall with your chest up, shoulders back, and arms extended in front of you or crossed at your chest for counterbalance. | הדק את הליבה והעבר את המשקל באופן שווה דרך שתי הרגליים, תוך וידוא שהעקבים נתמכים לגמרי על ידי המשטח. | התחל את הירידה בדחיפת האגן לאחור וכיפוף הברכיים בו זמנית, תוך מתן לברכיים לנוע מעל קצות האצבעות. | Lower yourself as deep as your mobility allows — ideally until your thighs go below parallel — letting your heels drop toward the floor below the platform level to exploit the full deficit range. | Pause briefly at the bottom without collapsing your torso or rounding your lower back. | דחוף דרך כף הרגל כולה כדי ללחוץ את הרצפה רחוק, מרחיב את האגן והברך יחד כשחוזרים לעמידה. | Lock out at the top by squeezing your glutes and fully extending your legs before beginning the next rep.

t: Grip a pull-up bar with your hands placed 4–6 inches apart, palms facing away from you. Your thumbs should wrap fully around the bar. | Jump or step up so your chin is above the bar and your arms are bent, starting in the top position of a pull-up. | Brace your core, depress your shoulder blades, and avoid letting your body swing. | Lower yourself in a controlled manner until your elbows reach roughly 90 degrees — this is the halfway point. | Pause briefly at the bottom of this range, keeping tension in your back. | Pull yourself back up until your chin clears the bar and your elbows are fully bent. | Repeat for the desired number of reps, then lower yourself fully to a dead hang to dismount safely.
tRu: Возьмитесь за перекладину руками на расстоянии 4-6 дюймов друг от друга, ладонями от себя. Ваши большие пальцы должны полностью обхватывать перекладину. | Прыгните или заберитесь так, чтобы подбородок был над перекладиной, а руки согнуты, начав в верхнем положении подтягивания. | Напрягите пресс, опустите лопатки и не допускайте раскачивания корпуса. | Опуститесь под контролем, пока ваши локти не согнутся примерно под углом 90 градусов — это середина амплитуды. | Пауза на мгновение в нижней точке этого диапазона, сохраняя напряжение в спине. | Pull yourself back up until your chin clears the bar and your elbows are fully bent. | Repeat for the desired number of reps, then lower yourself fully to a dead hang to dismount safely.
tHe: אחוז במוט משיכה בידיים במרחק של 10–15 סנטימטרים זו מזו, כפות פונות הרחק ממך. האגודלים צריכים לעטוף את המוט לגמרי. | Jump or step up so your chin is above the bar and your arms are bent, starting in the top position of a pull-up. | הדק את הליבה, הורד את שכמות הכתפיים והימנע מנדנוד הגוף. | Lower yourself in a controlled manner until your elbows reach roughly 90 degrees — this is the halfway point. | Pause briefly at the bottom of this range, keeping tension in your back. | Pull yourself back up until your chin clears the bar and your elbows are fully bent. | Repeat for the desired number of reps, then lower yourself fully to a dead hang to dismount safely.

nR: Мостик на шее лёжа на животе
t: Lie face-down on an exercise mat with your legs extended and the balls of your feet on the floor, hip-width apart. | Place your hands flat on the floor beside your chest, fingers pointing forward, to support yourself during setup. | Tuck your chin slightly and place your forehead, just below the hairline, flat on the mat — do not roll back onto the crown of your head. | Brace your neck muscles and press through your forehead and the balls of your feet to lift your torso and thighs off the mat. | At the top, your body should form a gentle arc from feet to head with your hips at roughly the same height as your shoulders — avoid letting the hips rise much higher than the head. | Keep your hands lightly hovering near the floor or cross them over your lower back once you feel stable, but keep them within reach for safety. | Hold the position for the prescribed duration, breathing steadily through your nose — do not hold your breath. | To finish a repetition, lower your torso back to the mat under control, leading with your chest, and remove your head last.
tRu: Лягте на живот на спортивный коврик с вытянутыми ногами и подушечками стоп на полу, на ширине таза. | Положите ладони плашмя на пол у груди, пальцами вперёд, чтобы поддерживать себя в начальном положении. | Tuck your chin slightly and place your forehead, just below the hairline, flat on the mat — do not roll back onto the crown of your head. | Напрягите мышцы шеи и выжмите через лоб и переднюю часть стоп, чтобы приподнять туловище и бёдра от мат. | Вверху тело должно образовать мягкую дугу от стоп до головы, бёдра — примерно на высоте плеч, не поднимайте таз намного выше головы. | Держите руки слегка поднятыми над полом или скрестите их на нижней части спины, как только почувствуете устойчивость, но держите их в зоне досягаемости для безопасности. | Держите положение в течение назначенной продолжительности, дыша ровно через нос — не задерживайте дыхание. | To finish a repetition, lower your torso back to the mat under control, leading with your chest, and remove your head last.
tHe: Lie face-down on an exercise mat with your legs extended and the balls of your feet on the floor, hip-width apart. | Place your hands flat on the floor beside your chest, fingers pointing forward, to support yourself during setup. | Tuck your chin slightly and place your forehead, just below the hairline, flat on the mat — do not roll back onto the crown of your head. | הקשיש את שרירי הצוואר ודחוף דרך המצח וכפות הרגליים כדי להרים את הגוף והירכיים מהמשטח. | בשיא הגוף צריך ליצור קשת עדינה מהרגליים עד הראש כשהאגן בערך בגובה הכתפיים — הימנע מהרמת האגן הרבה מעל הראש. | Keep your hands lightly hovering near the floor or cross them over your lower back once you feel stable, but keep them within reach for safety. | Hold the position for the prescribed duration, breathing steadily through your nose — do not hold your breath. | To finish a repetition, lower your torso back to the mat under control, leading with your chest, and remove your head last.

t: Stand or sit tall with your spine neutral, shoulders relaxed, and feet hip-width apart. | Gently drop your chin toward your chest, feeling a mild stretch along the back of your neck. | Slowly roll your head to the right, bringing your right ear toward your right shoulder without lifting the shoulder. | Continue the arc by tilting your head back slightly — only as far as is comfortable with no sharp pain. | Keep rolling to the left, bringing your left ear toward your left shoulder in a smooth, continuous motion. | Return to the chin-down position to complete one full circle. | Perform the desired number of slow circles in this direction, then reverse and repeat the same number of circles in the opposite direction.
tRu: Stand or sit tall with your spine neutral, shoulders relaxed, and feet hip-width apart. | Плавно опустите подбородок к груди, чувствуя легкую растяжку по задней поверхности шеи. | Slowly roll your head to the right, bringing your right ear toward your right shoulder without lifting the shoulder. | Продолжайте дугу, слегка запрокидывая голову назад — только настолько, насколько комфортно, без резкой боли. | Продолжайте поворачиваться влево, bringing левое ухо к левому плечу в плавном, непрерывном движении. | Return to the chin-down position to complete one full circle. | Выполните желаемое количество медленных кругов в этом направлении, затем измените и повторите то же количество кругов в противоположном направлении.
tHe: Stand or sit tall with your spine neutral, shoulders relaxed, and feet hip-width apart. | הצניח בעדינות את הסנטר לכיוון החזה, ותחוש מתיחה קלה לאורך החלק האחורי של הצוואר. | Slowly roll your head to the right, bringing your right ear toward your right shoulder without lifting the shoulder. | המשך הקשת על ידי הטיית הראש אחורה במקצת — רק כפי שנוח ללא כאב חד. | Keep rolling to the left, bringing your left ear toward your left shoulder in a smooth, continuous motion. | Return to the chin-down position to complete one full circle. | Perform the desired number of slow circles in this direction, then reverse and repeat the same number of circles in the opposite direction.

t: Sit or stand tall with your spine neutral, shoulders relaxed, and feet hip-width apart on the floor. | Relax your jaw and let your mouth close gently so your neck muscles are not braced. | Place your hands loosely in your lap or at your sides — do not use your hands to push or pull your head. | Slowly lift your chin up and away from your chest and begin to tilt your head backward, leading with the top of your skull moving toward the back wall. | Continue the movement until you feel a gentle stretch across the front of your throat and along both sides of your neck — stop well before any point of discomfort or dizziness. | Hold this position for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and evenly, allowing the anterior neck muscles to gradually release. | To release, gently bring your head back to neutral by lifting your chin and returning your gaze forward — do not let your head drop forward quickly. | Rest for a breath or two, then repeat for 2–3 rounds as needed.
tRu: Sit or stand tall with your spine neutral, shoulders relaxed, and feet hip-width apart on the floor. | Relax your jaw and let your mouth close gently so your neck muscles are not braced. | Положите руки расслабленно на коленях или по бокам — не используйте руки, чтобы толкать или тянуть голову. | Slowly lift your chin up and away from your chest and begin to tilt your head backward, leading with the top of your skull moving toward the back wall. | Продолжайте движение, пока не почувствуете легкую растяжение передней части горла и по обеим сторонам шеи — остановитесь задолго до появления дискомфорта или головокружения. | Удерживайте это положение в течение 20-30 секунд, дыша медленно и ровно, позволяя мышцам передней поверхности шеи постепенно расслабиться. | To release, gently bring your head back to neutral by lifting your chin and returning your gaze forward — do not let your head drop forward quickly. | Rest for a breath or two, then repeat for 2–3 rounds as needed.
tHe: Sit or stand tall with your spine neutral, shoulders relaxed, and feet hip-width apart on the floor. | Relax your jaw and let your mouth close gently so your neck muscles are not braced. | Place your hands loosely in your lap or at your sides — do not use your hands to push or pull your head. | Slowly lift your chin up and away from your chest and begin to tilt your head backward, leading with the top of your skull moving toward the back wall. | המשך את התנועה עד שאתה מרגיש מתיחה עדינה בחלק הקדמי של הגרון ולאורך שני צידי הצוואר — עצור הרבה לפני כל נקודת אי-נעימות או סחרחורת. | Hold this position for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and evenly, allowing the anterior neck muscles to gradually release. | To release, gently bring your head back to neutral by lifting your chin and returning your gaze forward — do not let your head drop forward quickly. | Rest for a breath or two, then repeat for 2–3 rounds as needed.

t: Sit or stand tall with your spine neutral, shoulders relaxed, and chin level with the floor. | Slowly drop your chin toward your chest, letting the weight of your head gently stretch the back of your neck. | From that flexed position, begin to rotate your head slowly to the right, bringing your chin toward your right collarbone. | Pause for 2–3 seconds when you feel a comfortable stretch along the left side and back of your neck. | Slowly rotate back through center — chin still lowered — and continue rotating to the left, bringing your chin toward your left collarbone. | Pause again for 2–3 seconds to feel the stretch along the right side and back of your neck. | Return to center and gently lift your head back to the neutral starting position. | Repeat for the desired number of repetitions or hold each end position for a longer duration as needed.
tRu: Sit or stand tall with your spine neutral, shoulders relaxed, and chin level with the floor. | Slowly drop your chin toward your chest, letting the weight of your head gently stretch the back of your neck. | Из этого согнутого положения, начните медленно поворачивать голову вправо, bringing подбородок к правому ключице. | Задержитесь на 2–3 секунды, когда чувствуете комфортную растяжку по левой стороне и спине шеи. | Slowly rotate back through center — chin still lowered — and continue rotating to the left, bringing your chin toward your left collarbone. | Снова сделайте паузу на 2–3 секунды, чтобы почувствовать растяжение по правой стороне шеи и сзади. | Return to center and gently lift your head back to the neutral starting position. | Repeat for the desired number of repetitions or hold each end position for a longer duration as needed.
tHe: Sit or stand tall with your spine neutral, shoulders relaxed, and chin level with the floor. | Slowly drop your chin toward your chest, letting the weight of your head gently stretch the back of your neck. | מעמדת הכיפוף הזו, התחל לסובב את הראש לאט ימינה, והבא את הסנטר לכיוון עצם הבריח הימנית. | Pause for 2–3 seconds when you feel a comfortable stretch along the left side and back of your neck. | Slowly rotate back through center — chin still lowered — and continue rotating to the left, bringing your chin toward your left collarbone. | Pause again for 2–3 seconds to feel the stretch along the right side and back of your neck. | Return to center and gently lift your head back to the neutral starting position. | Repeat for the desired number of repetitions or hold each end position for a longer duration as needed.

t: Sit or stand tall with your spine long and your shoulders relaxed away from your ears. | Look straight ahead to establish a neutral starting position. | Slowly lower your chin toward your chest, allowing the weight of your head to guide the movement without forcing it. | Place both hands lightly on the back of your head and allow the gentle weight of your arms — not active pressure — to deepen the stretch. | Hold this position and breathe steadily, exhaling to relax further into the stretch. | Hold for 20–30 seconds, feeling the stretch along the back of your neck and upper back. | To release, remove your hands first, then slowly raise your head back to neutral. | Repeat 2–3 times per session, resting a few seconds between each hold.
tRu: Sit or stand tall with your spine long and your shoulders relaxed away from your ears. | Смотрите прямо вперед, чтобы занять нейтральное исходное положение. | Slowly lower your chin toward your chest, allowing the weight of your head to guide the movement without forcing it. | Поставьте обе руки легко на затылок и позвольте лёгкому весу рук — не активному давлению — углубить растяжку. | Удерживайте это положение и дышите ровно, выдыхая, чтобы еще сильнее расслабиться в растяжке. | Держитесь 20–30 секунд, ощущая, как растяжение углубляется в правой ягодичной мышце и задней поверхности бедра. | To release, remove your hands first, then slowly raise your head back to neutral. | Repeat 2–3 times per session, resting a few seconds between each hold.

t: Sit or stand tall with your spine neutral, shoulders relaxed, and feet flat on the floor. | Lower your chin slowly toward your chest until you feel a mild stretch along the back of your neck — hold for two to three seconds. | Return your head to the neutral position. | Gently rotate your chin toward your right shoulder as far as comfortable without straining, feeling the stretch along the left side of your neck. | Hold the rotated position for two to three seconds, breathing steadily. | Return your head to center, then repeat the rotation toward your left shoulder. | Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions, keeping all movements slow and controlled throughout.
tRu: Сядьте или встаньте прямо с нейтральным позвоночником, расслабленными плечами и стопами на полу. | Медленно опустите подбородок к груди, пока не почувствуете легкое растяжение в задней части шеи — удерживайте 2–3 секунды. | Return your head to the neutral position. | Аккуратно поверните подбородок к правому плечу насколько комфортно, не напрягая, чувствуя растяжение по левой стороне шеи. | Держите повернутое положение в течение двух-трёх секунд, дыша ровно. | Return your head to center, then repeat the rotation toward your left shoulder. | Продолжайте попеременно менять стороны в течение заданного количества повторений, сохраняя все движения медленными и контролируемыми.
tHe: שב או עמוד זקוף עם עמוד שדרה ניטרלי, כתפיים רפויות, וכפות רגליים שטוחות על הרצפה. | Lower your chin slowly toward your chest until you feel a mild stretch along the back of your neck — hold for two to three seconds. | Return your head to the neutral position. | סובב בעדינות את הסנטר לכיוון כתף ימין עד כמה שנוח מבלי להימתח, ותחוש את המתיחה לאורך צידו השמאלי של הצוואר. | Hold the rotated position for two to three seconds, breathing steadily. | Return your head to center, then repeat the rotation toward your left shoulder. | המשילו להחליף צדדים למספר החזרות הרצוי, שמרו על כל התנועות איטיות ומבוקלות לאורך כל התרגיל.

t: Sit or stand tall with your spine in a neutral position, shoulders relaxed and pulled slightly back and down. | Begin with a chin tuck: gently draw your chin straight back, as if making a slight double chin, to align your head over your spine. | From the tucked position, slowly tilt your head back by lifting your chin toward the ceiling, allowing your neck to extend gently. | Stop as soon as you feel a mild stretch along the front and sides of your neck — do not force further range of motion. | Keep your mouth closed and your jaw relaxed throughout; avoid letting your mouth drop open as you extend. | Hold the stretched position for 20 to 30 seconds, breathing slowly and allowing the anterior neck muscles to release. | To exit, bring your chin back to neutral slowly and with control — do not let your head drop forward. | Repeat 2 to 3 times per session, resting briefly between holds.
tRu: Sit or stand tall with your spine in a neutral position, shoulders relaxed and pulled slightly back and down. | Начните с подбора подбородка: мягко отведите подбородок строго назад, словно делая лёгкий второй подбородок, чтобы выровнять голову над позвоночником. | Из положения с согнутыми коленями, медленно запрокиньте голову назад, поднимая подбородок к потолку, позволяя шее плавно вытягиваться. | Stop as soon as you feel a mild stretch along the front and sides of your neck — do not force further range of motion. | Держите рот закрытым и челюсть расслабленной на протяжении всего движения; не позволяйте рту открываться при выпрямлении. | Держите растянутое положение 20–30 секунд, дыша медленно и позволяя мышцам передней поверхности шеи расслабляться. | To exit, bring your chin back to neutral slowly and with control — do not let your head drop forward. | Repeat 2 to 3 times per session, resting briefly between holds.
tHe: Sit or stand tall with your spine in a neutral position, shoulders relaxed and pulled slightly back and down. | התחל בהצמדת סנטר: משוך בעדינות את הסנטר ישר לאחור, כאילו אתה יוצר סנטר כפול קל, כדי ליישר את הראש מעל עמוד השדרה. | מעמדת הקיפוף, הטה לאט את הראש לאחור על ידי הרמת הסנטר לכיוון התקרה, ואפשר לצוואר להיפתח בעדינות. | Stop as soon as you feel a mild stretch along the front and sides of your neck — do not force further range of motion. | Keep your mouth closed and your jaw relaxed throughout; avoid letting your mouth drop open as you extend. | Hold the stretched position for 20 to 30 seconds, breathing slowly and allowing the anterior neck muscles to release. | To exit, bring your chin back to neutral slowly and with control — do not let your head drop forward. | Repeat 2 to 3 times per session, resting briefly between holds.

t: Sit upright in a chair or stand with your feet hip-width apart, keeping your spine long and your shoulders relaxed. | Look straight ahead so your ears are roughly stacked over your shoulders as your starting position. | Slowly slide your head forward — as if pushing your chin toward an imaginary wall in front of you — without tilting your chin up or down. Your head should translate forward, not tilt. | Hold the protracted position for 2–3 seconds and notice the gentle stretch along the back of your neck. | Reverse the movement by drawing your head straight back and tucking your chin slightly until your ears are again stacked over your shoulders — you should feel the stretch shift up to the base of your skull. This is the retraction phase. | Hold the retracted position for 2–3 seconds, then return to neutral. | Repeat the forward-and-back cycle for the prescribed number of repetitions, moving slowly and deliberately throughout.

t: Sit or stand tall with your spine neutral, shoulders relaxed and away from your ears. | Let your arms hang at your sides or rest your hands gently in your lap. | Slowly tilt your right ear toward your right shoulder until you feel a stretch along the left side of your neck — aim for roughly 30–45 degrees of lateral tilt. | Keep both shoulders level, especially the left one — letting it creep up slackens the muscle you are stretching. | Breathe in through the nose, then exhale slowly to deepen the stretch slightly. | Hold the position for 20–30 seconds, breathing steadily throughout. | To increase intensity, place your right hand lightly on the left side of your head and allow the weight of the hand — not active pressure — to deepen the tilt. | Slowly return your head to the upright, neutral position. | Repeat on the opposite side, tilting your left ear toward your left shoulder.

t: Sit upright on a chair or stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, shoulders relaxed and down away from your ears. | Slowly tilt your head to the right, bringing your right ear toward your right shoulder without rotating or jutting your chin forward. | Raise your right hand and place it lightly on the left side of your head, just above the ear — use only the weight of your hand, not a pulling force. | Allow the gentle weight of your hand to guide your head a little deeper into the stretch, feeling a mild pull along the left side of your neck and upper trapezius. | Hold the stretch for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and letting the muscles release further with each exhale. | Lift your hand away from your head and slowly return your head to the upright, neutral position. | Repeat the stretch on the opposite side: tilt your head to the left, place your left hand on the right side of your head, and hold for 20–30 seconds. | Complete 2–3 rounds on each side, resting briefly between repetitions.

nR: Негативные концентрированные сгибания ног на бицепс
t: Sit on a bench or sturdy surface with your feet flat on the floor and knees apart at roughly 90 degrees. | Lean forward slightly and brace the back of your right upper arm firmly against the inside of your right thigh, just above the knee. | Let your right forearm hang down toward the floor with your palm facing up. | Use your left hand or press your right knee inward against your forearm to assist curling your right forearm up toward your shoulder — this is the assisted concentric phase. | Once your forearm is fully curled and your biceps are contracted, remove the assistance completely. | Slowly lower your forearm back to the starting position over 3 to 5 seconds, resisting gravity with your biceps alone — this controlled descent is the negative phase. | At the bottom, pause briefly, then use your hand or leg to assist the next curl up. | Complete all reps on one arm before switching to the other side.

t: Lie on a flat bench and grip a fixed overhead support — a rack upright, bench uprights, or a sturdy post — with both hands at roughly ear level, thumbs wrapped around for a secure hold. | Brace your entire core, squeeze your glutes, and press your upper back firmly into the bench so your shoulder blades are the only point of contact below the hands. | Lift your legs and hips until your body is nearly vertical, forming a straight line from shoulders to feet with only a slight outward arch acceptable. | Initiate the lowering phase by controlling your hips downward — resist the pull of gravity with your iliopsoas and rectus abdominis rather than letting gravity drop you. | Keep your body rigid as a single unit: do not pike at the hips or allow your lower back to sag away from the straight line. | Lower at a slow, deliberate tempo — aim for 3 to 5 seconds per rep — until your body is just above parallel to the bench or as low as you can hold without losing spinal alignment. | Stop the descent before your hips touch the bench or your lower back breaks into a hyperextended arch. | Return to the starting vertical position by bending your knees to step or swing up carefully, or have a partner assist the concentric — do not attempt the raise under fatigue. | Reset your brace and grip fully before beginning the next rep.

t: Set up in a high plank position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width, arms fully extended, and your body forming a straight line from head to heels. | Engage your core, squeeze your glutes, and tuck your chin slightly so your neck stays neutral throughout the movement. | Begin lowering your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows at roughly a 45° angle to your torso — avoid letting them flare straight out. | Lower yourself as slowly as possible, aiming for a 3–5 second descent, maintaining full-body tension the entire way down. | Continue until your chest lightly touches or nearly touches the floor, keeping your hips level — do not let them sag or pike upward. | From the bottom position, push the floor away and press yourself back up to the starting plank with as much control as possible, or drop your knees if needed to reset safely. | Reset your body to the full plank position and repeat for the desired number of reps, keeping the slow lowering tempo on every repetition.

t: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart and your core lightly braced. | Hold the wrist roller device with both hands in a neutral grip — thumbs pointing up, knuckles facing outward — with your hands about shoulder-width apart on the handle. | Extend your arms straight out in front of you at shoulder height, keeping a slight bend in the elbows to avoid joint strain. | Begin winding the roller upward by alternately flexing each wrist forward, curling one hand over the top while the other follows in sequence. | Continue the alternating wrist-rolling motion in a slow, controlled rhythm until you have wound the roller as far as the range of motion allows. | Pause briefly at the top of the wind, maintaining your arm position and neutral wrist alignment. | Reverse the motion by unwinding the roller slowly, resisting the downward movement with the same controlled wrist action. | Complete the full unwind to return to the starting position. That is one full repetition. | Perform the prescribed number of repetitions or time, then lower your arms and rest.

t: Kneel on a padded surface and have a partner hold your ankles firmly down, or anchor them under a sturdy bar, pad, or piece of equipment at floor level. | Sit upright on your heels with your hips fully extended and your body forming a straight line from knees to head. | Cross your arms over your chest or hold them ready to catch yourself, and engage your core and glutes. | Begin lowering your torso toward the floor as slowly as you can, resisting the descent entirely with your hamstrings. | Keep your hips extended and your body rigid throughout the descent — do not let your hips break or your lower back round. | When your hamstrings can no longer control the fall, place your hands on the floor to catch yourself and absorb the remaining descent with a controlled push-up. | Push off the floor lightly with your hands to help initiate the return, then contract your hamstrings to pull your torso back up to the starting position. | Reset to upright and repeat for the target number of reps.

nE: Oblique Crunches with Bent Knee Leg Lift
nR: Скручивания на косые с подъёмом согнутой ноги
nH: כפיפות אלכסונים עם הרמת רגל בברך כפופה
t: Lie on your side on a mat with your legs stacked, knees bent to roughly 90°, and your bottom arm extended along the floor for support. | Place your top hand lightly behind your head, keeping your elbow pointing toward the ceiling. | Engage your core and press your bottom side into the floor to establish a stable base. | Simultaneously crunch your torso laterally upward while lifting your top knee toward your elbow, contracting your obliques and adductors. | Pause briefly at the top, squeezing your obliques and hip muscles. | Lower your torso and knee back to the starting position with control, avoiding letting either touch down completely before the next rep. | Complete all reps on one side, then roll to the opposite side and repeat.

nE: Oblique Crunches with Straight Leg Lift
nR: Скручивания на косые с подъёмом прямой ноги
nH: כפיפות אלכסונים עם הרמת רגל ישרה
t: Lie on your back on the floor with your legs extended and your hands placed lightly behind your head, elbows wide. | Engage your core and press your lower back gently toward the floor. | Lift your right leg straight off the floor to roughly 45 degrees, keeping it fully extended and your toes pointed or flexed. | Simultaneously crunch your upper body diagonally, bringing your left elbow toward your right knee without pulling on your neck. | Hold the top position for a brief pause, feeling the contraction in your obliques and inner thigh. | Lower your leg and torso back to the starting position in a controlled manner. | Complete all reps on this side, then switch — lift the left leg and crunch the right elbow toward it. | Keep the movement slow and deliberate throughout; avoid momentum or swinging.
tRu: Лягте на спину на пол, выпрямите ноги и положите руки за голову, слегка касаясь пальцами, локти широко. | Напрягите корпус и мягко прижмите поясницу к полу. | Поднимите правую ногу прямо с пола примерно под углом 45 градусов, сохраняя ее полностью выпрямленной, а пальцы стопы вытянутыми или согнутыми. | Simultaneously crunch your upper body diagonally, bringing your left elbow toward your right knee without pulling on your neck. | Удерживайте верхнюю точку в течение короткой паузы, чувствуя сокращение в косых мышцах и внутренней части бедра. | Медленно опустите ногу и корпус обратно в исходное положение. | Выполните все повторения на этой стороне, затем поменяйте положение — поднимите левую ногу и подтяните правый локоть к ней. | Держите движение медленным и осознанным на протяжении всего подхода; избегайте инерции раскачки.
tHe: Lie on your back on the floor with your legs extended and your hands placed lightly behind your head, elbows wide. | הפעל את שרירי הליבה ודחוף את הגב התחתון בעדינות לכיוון הרצפה. | Lift your right leg straight off the floor to roughly 45 degrees, keeping it fully extended and your toes pointed or flexed. | Simultaneously crunch your upper body diagonally, bringing your left elbow toward your right knee without pulling on your neck. | Hold the top position for a brief pause, feeling the contraction in your obliques and inner thigh. | Lower your leg and torso back to the starting position in a controlled manner. | בצע את כל החזרות בצד זה, ואז החלף — הרם את הרגל השמאלית וכופף את המרפק הימני אליה. | Keep the movement slow and deliberate throughout; avoid momentum or swinging.

t: Lie on your side on a mat with your legs stacked or slightly staggered, knees bent at roughly 45 degrees. | Place your bottom arm across your torso or rest it on the floor in front of you for light support. | Bring your top hand to the side of your head, fingertips touching your temple without pulling on your neck. | Brace your core to stabilize your spine and press your hips into the mat. | Exhale and laterally crunch upward, shortening the distance between your top hip and your top shoulder. | Lift your upper body as high as the obliques allow — typically 20 to 30 degrees — without rotating your torso. | Pause briefly at the top and squeeze the obliques before lowering. | Inhale and lower your torso under control back to the starting position without fully relaxing. | Complete all reps on one side, then switch to the other side.
tRu: Лягте на бок на мате, ноги лежат одна на другой или с небольшим смещением, колени согнуты под углом примерно 45 градусов. | Положите нижнюю руку через корпус или опустите ее на пол перед собой для легкой поддержки. | Положите верхнюю руку на сторону головы, пальцами касаясь виска, не тяните шею. | Напрягите пресс, стабилизируя позвоночник и прижимая бёдра к коврику. | Выдыхайте и выполняйте боковой скручивание вверх, уменьшая расстояние между верхним бедром и верхним плечом. | Поднимите верхнюю часть тела настолько высок, как позволяют косые мышцы — обычно на 20-30 градусов — не поворачивая корпус. | Пауза в верхней точке и сжатие косых мышц живота перед опусканием. | Выдохните и опустите корпус под контролем обратно в исходное положение без полного расслабления. | Выполните все повторения на одну сторону, затем перейдите на другую сторону.
tHe: Lie on your side on a mat with your legs stacked or slightly staggered, knees bent at roughly 45 degrees. | Place your bottom arm across your torso or rest it on the floor in front of you for light support. | הבא את היד העליונה לצד הראש, אצבעות מגעות במקום המפגש בין הראש לצוואר מבלי למשוך את הצוואר. | הדק את הליבה כדי לייצב את עמוד השדרה וללחוץ את האגן למזרן. | נשוף וכופף לצד במעלה, מקצר את המרחק בין הירך העליונה לכתף העליונה. | Lift your upper body as high as the obliques allow — typically 20 to 30 degrees — without rotating your torso. | Pause briefly at the top and squeeze the obliques before lowering. | Inhale and lower your torso under control back to the starting position without fully relaxing. | בצע את כל החזרות בצד אחד, ואז עבור לצד השני.

t: Lie on your right side on the floor with your body in a straight line, legs stacked and extended, and your right arm extended overhead along the floor for alignment. | Place your left hand lightly behind your head or rest it along your left side for balance. | Brace your core and, in one controlled movement, raise both legs and your upper torso off the floor simultaneously, crunching toward each other. | Continue lifting until your body forms a V-shape, with your obliques fully contracted at the top. | Pause briefly at the peak contraction, keeping your legs straight and your torso lifted. | Slowly lower both your legs and torso back to the starting position under control, avoiding letting them drop. | Complete all reps on the right side, then switch to your left side and repeat.

t: Set a flat bench lengthwise and load a barbell on the floor at the foot end. Lie face-down on the bench so your hips are near the end and your torso is fully supported. | Reach down and grasp the barbell with a double-overhand grip, hands roughly shoulder-width apart. Allow your arms to hang straight toward the floor, elbows extended. | Brace your core and press your hips and torso firmly into the bench to create a stable base. | Initiate the movement by driving your elbows back and up, pulling the barbell in an arc from in front of and below the bench toward your hips. | Continue the arc, extending your elbows so the barbell travels behind you and your arms approach parallel with the floor — or as high as your mobility allows without shrugging your shoulders or arching your lower back excessively. | Pause briefly at the top with your lats and triceps contracted. | Lower the barbell back along the same arc under control until your arms are fully extended toward the floor. | Complete all reps before carefully setting the bar down. Step off the bench before adding or removing weight.

t: Stand facing a wall at arm's length and raise one arm to roughly shoulder height, pressing your palm flat against the wall. | Step your feet back slightly so your body is on a gentle angle and your extended arm bears some of your bodyweight through the wall. | Engage your core and keep a neutral spine throughout the movement. | Without bending your elbow, pull your shoulder blade down and back — think of driving your elbow toward your hip — to create tension through your lat and teres major. | Hold the retracted and depressed position for one to two seconds, feeling the muscles on the side of your back engage. | Slowly release the tension and allow your shoulder blade to protract back to the starting position. | Complete all reps on one side, then switch arms and repeat.

t: Stand beneath a pull-up bar and take an underhand (supinated) grip with one hand, positioning it so you hang directly beneath the working hand. Allow your body to settle into a dead hang with the arm fully extended. | Let your free arm hang at your side or rest it across your torso. Do not place it on your thigh or use it to assist the working arm in any way. | Depress and retract the shoulder of your working arm, pulling it away from your ear, before initiating the movement. | Brace your core and squeeze your glutes to keep the body rigid and prevent swinging. | Drive your elbow toward your hip, pulling your chest toward the bar by contracting the latissimus dorsi and biceps. | Continue pulling until your chin clears the bar and your working elbow is at or below shoulder height. | Hold the top position for a brief moment, maintaining full tension in the back and shoulder. | Lower yourself under control back to a dead hang, taking 3–5 seconds for the descent. | Complete your target reps, then step down or carefully release the bar.

t: Set up in a standard forearm plank position with both forearms on the floor, elbows directly under your shoulders, and your body forming a straight line from head to heels. | Brace your core hard — draw your navel gently in, squeeze your glutes, and press your forearm into the floor to create full-body tension before you lift anything. | Shift your weight slightly onto one forearm, distributing it evenly across that arm to keep your shoulder stable. | Slowly lift the opposite arm off the floor and extend it straight in front of you, keeping it in line with your body rather than reaching wide. | Hold your hips level — your pelvis should not rotate, hike, or sag as the arm comes up. | Keep your gaze down and slightly forward to maintain a neutral neck, and breathe steadily throughout the hold. | Hold the position for the prescribed duration, then lower the raised arm back to the floor with control. | Rest briefly, then repeat on the other side.

t: Stand facing a sturdy vertical support such as a rack upright, door frame, or pole. | Extend your right arm and grip the support at roughly shoulder height or slightly above. | Step your feet back so your arm is fully extended and your torso leans forward at a slight angle. | Shift your hips to the left, away from the gripping arm, to increase the stretch along your right side. | Let your chest drop toward the floor while keeping your elbow straight and your grip firm. | Hold the stretched position for 20 to 30 seconds, breathing slowly and allowing the lat to relax. | Release the grip, return to standing, and repeat on the left arm. | Perform 2 to 3 holds per side.

t: Stand with the barbell on the floor in front of you, feet about hip-width apart. Hinge at the hips and bend the knees to reach down and grip the bar with one hand, using a neutral or pronated grip directly beneath your shoulder. | Brace your core, keep your back flat, and set your shoulder down and away from your ear before you begin the pull. | Drive forcefully through your legs and extend your hips to accelerate the bar upward, keeping it close to your body. | As the bar passes your hips, rotate your torso slightly toward the lifting side — this is the twist — and pull your elbow high to guide the bar up. | Drop under the bar by bending the knees slightly and rotating your elbow around and underneath the bar to catch it in the rack position at your shoulder, with the bar resting on the heel of your palm and your elbow pointing forward. | Stand up fully from the catch position, hips and knees locked out, before initiating the press. | Press the bar directly overhead by extending your elbow until your arm is fully locked out, keeping your core tight and your ribs down to avoid excessive lumbar extension. | Lower the bar back to the rack position under control, then return it to the floor with a controlled hinge before the next rep.
