t: Stand facing a wall at roughly arm's length away, feet hip-width apart and flat on the floor. | Place both hands on the wall at shoulder height and slightly wider than shoulder-width, fingers pointing upward and palms flat against the surface. | Step your feet back slightly so your body forms a diagonal line from head to heels, and brace your core to keep your spine neutral. | Inhale, then bend your elbows at roughly a 45-degree angle from your torso, lowering your chest toward the wall in a controlled manner. | Continue lowering until your nose or chin is close to the wall without letting your hips sag or pike. | Exhale and press through your palms to push your body back to the starting position until your arms are extended. | Pause briefly at the top without locking your elbows out hard, then begin the next rep.
tRu: Stand facing a wall at roughly arm's length away, feet hip-width apart and flat on the floor. | Поставьте обе руки на стену на уровне плеч и немного шире плеч, пальцами направленными вверх и ладонями плоско прижатыми к поверхности. | Step your feet back slightly so your body forms a diagonal line from head to heels, and brace your core to keep your spine neutral. | Сделайте вдох, затем согните локти под углом примерно 45 градусов относительно корпуса, опуская грудь к стене контролируемо. | Продолжайте опускаться, пока ваш нос или подбородок не окажутся близко к стене, не давая бедрам провисать или подниматься. | Выдыхайте и надавливайте ладонями, чтобы поднять тело обратно в исходное положение, пока руки не будут выпрямлены. | Задержитесь на мгновение в верхней точке, не выпрямляя локти агрессивно, затем начните следующее повторение.
tHe: Stand facing a wall at roughly arm's length away, feet hip-width apart and flat on the floor. | Place both hands on the wall at shoulder height and slightly wider than shoulder-width, fingers pointing upward and palms flat against the surface. | Step your feet back slightly so your body forms a diagonal line from head to heels, and brace your core to keep your spine neutral. | Inhale, then bend your elbows at roughly a 45-degree angle from your torso, lowering your chest toward the wall in a controlled manner. | המשילו עד שהאף או הסנטר שלך קרובים לקיר, מבלי לאפשר לירכים שלך לשקוע או להתכופף. | נשום החוצה ודחוף דרך כפות הידיים כדי לדחוף את הגוף חזרה למצב ההתחלתי עד שהזרועות מושטות. | Pause briefly at the top without locking your elbows out hard, then begin the next rep.

t: Start in a high plank position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width, wrists stacked under your shoulders, and your body forming a straight line from head to heels. | Brace your core, squeeze your glutes, and keep your hips level before you begin. | Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows at roughly a 45° angle to your torso, keeping your body rigid throughout. | Press back up explosively until your arms are fully extended. | At the top of the push-up, shift your weight slightly onto one hand and drive one knee toward your chest (or toward the opposite elbow for a cross-body variation). | Hold the knee drive for a brief pause, feeling your abs and hip flexors contract. | Return the foot to the starting plank position with control. | Perform the next push-up and repeat the knee drive on the opposite side, or alternate sides each rep as desired. | Continue for the target number of reps, maintaining a neutral spine and level hips throughout.
tRu: Примите высокую планку с ладонями чуть шире плеч и запястьями строго под плечами, тело образует прямую линию от головы до пяток. | Напрягите корпус, сожмите ягодицы и удерживайте бёдра на одном уровне перед началом. | Под контролем опустите грудь к полу, сгибая локти под углом примерно 45° к корпусу, сохраняя тело прямым. | Мощно выжмитесь вверх, пока руки полностью не выпрямятся. | В верхней точке отжимания слегка перенесите вес на одну руку и подтяните колено к груди или к противоположному локтю для варианта крест-накрест. | Подержите положение согнутого колена в короткой паузе, чувствуя сокращение пресса и сгибателей бедра. | Return the foot to the starting plank position with control. | Выполните следующее отжимание и повторите подтягивание колена на противоположной стороне, или чередуйте стороны при каждом повторении по желанию. | Продолжайте в течение заданного количества повторений, затем опустите поднятую ногу на пол и поменяйте ноги, повторив ту же последовательность с другой стороны.
tHe: התחל בפלאנק גבוה עם ידיים מעט רחבות מרוחב הכתפיים, שורשי כף היד מתחת לכתפיים, והגוף יוצר קו ישר מהראש ועד העקבים. | הדק את הליבה, כווץ את הישבן, ושמור על אגן מאוזן לפני תחילת התרגיל. | Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows at roughly a 45° angle to your torso, keeping your body rigid throughout. | לחץ חזרה למעלה בצורה מתפרצת עד שהידיים ישרות לגמרי. | בשיא שכיבת הסמיכה העבר מעט את המשקל ליד אחת ומשוך ברך אחת לכיוון החזה או לכיוון המרפק הנגדי בווריאציית האלכסון. | Hold the knee drive for a brief pause, feeling your abs and hip flexors contract. | Return the foot to the starting plank position with control. | Perform the next push-up and repeat the knee drive on the opposite side, or alternate sides each rep as desired. | המשך למשך מספר החזרות המטרה, שומר על עמוד שדרה נייטרלי וירכיים באותו גובה לאורך כל התרגיל.

t: Place the push-up handles shoulder-width apart on a firm, non-slip surface with the grips parallel or angled slightly outward. | Grip the handles firmly and step into a high plank position: arms fully extended, hands under your shoulders, body forming a straight line from head to heels. | Squeeze your glutes, brace your core, and tuck your hips slightly to prevent your lower back from sagging. | Inhale and lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows at roughly a 45° angle to your torso — not flared straight out to the sides. | Continue lowering until your chest passes the level of the handles, taking advantage of the increased range of motion the bars provide. | Pause briefly at the bottom without resting your chest on the floor, keeping tension in your chest and shoulders. | Exhale and press through the handles, driving the floor away until your arms are fully extended at the top. | Repeat for the desired number of reps, maintaining a rigid plank position throughout every rep.
tRu: Поставьте рукоятки отжиманий на ширине плеч на прочную, нескользящую поверхность, рукоятки параллельны или слегка развернуты наружу. | Возьмите рукоятки плотно и займите положение высокой планки: руки полностью выпрямлены, кисти под плечами, тело образует прямую линию от головы до пят. | Squeeze your glutes, brace your core, and tuck your hips slightly to prevent your lower back from sagging. | Выдохните и опустите грудь к полу, сгибая локти под углом примерно 45° к корпусу — не разводите их прямо в стороны. | Продолжайте опускаться, пока ваша грудь не прошла уровень рукояток, используя увеличенный диапазон движения, который дают перекладины. | На мгновение задержитесь внизу, не опираясь грудью на пол, сохраняя напряжение в груди и плечах. | Выдыхайте и надавливайте через рукоятки, отталкивая пол от себя, пока руки не будут полностью выпрямлены в верхней точке. | Repeat for the desired number of reps, maintaining a rigid plank position throughout every rep.
tHe: Place the push-up handles shoulder-width apart on a firm, non-slip surface with the grips parallel or angled slightly outward. | אחוז בידיות בחוזקה והיכנס לפלאנק גבוה: זרועות פשוטות לגמרי, ידיים מתחת לכתפיים, הגוף בקו ישר מהראש ועד העקבים. | Squeeze your glutes, brace your core, and tuck your hips slightly to prevent your lower back from sagging. | Inhale and lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows at roughly a 45° angle to your torso — not flared straight out to the sides. | המשך לרדת עד שהחזה שלך עובר את גובה הידיות, נצל את טווח התנועה המוגבר שהמוטות מספקים. | Pause briefly at the bottom without resting your chest on the floor, keeping tension in your chest and shoulders. | נשום החוצה ודחוף דרך הידיות, דוחף את הרצפה עד שהזרועות שלך מושטות לחלוטין בראש. | Repeat for the desired number of reps, maintaining a rigid plank position throughout every rep.

t: Place a sturdy, non-rolling chair on a flat surface and position yourself in front of it. | Place both hands on the front edge of the chair seat, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart, with fingers pointing forward. | Walk your feet back until your body forms a straight line from head to heels, with arms fully extended and core braced. | Squeeze your glutes and tighten your core to keep your hips level and your spine neutral throughout the movement. | Bend your elbows and lower your chest toward the chair seat in a controlled manner, keeping your elbows at roughly a 45-degree angle to your torso. | Lower until your chest nearly touches the edge of the chair, then pause briefly at the bottom. | Press through your palms to push your body back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms without locking your elbows. | Complete the desired number of repetitions while maintaining a rigid, plank-like body position throughout.
tRu: Положите sturdy, non-rolling chair на flat surface и position yourself in front of it. | Поставьте обе руки на передний край сиденья стула, немного шире плеч, пальцами направленными вперёд. | Walk your feet back until your body forms a straight line from head to heels, with arms fully extended and core braced. | Squeeze your glutes and tighten your core to keep your hips level and your spine neutral throughout the movement. | Согните локти и подконтрольно опустите грудь к сиденью стула, удерживая локти под углом примерно 45 градусов к корпусу. | Опустите, пока ваша грудь не почти не коснулась края стула, затем сделайте короткую паузу в нижней точке. | Press through your palms to push your body back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms without locking your elbows. | Выполните желаемое количество повторений, сохраняя напряженное, планочное положение тела.
tHe: Place a sturdy, non-rolling chair on a flat surface and position yourself in front of it. | Place both hands on the front edge of the chair seat, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart, with fingers pointing forward. | Walk your feet back until your body forms a straight line from head to heels, with arms fully extended and core braced. | Squeeze your glutes and tighten your core to keep your hips level and your spine neutral throughout the movement. | כופף את המרפקים והורד את החזה לכיוון מושב הכיסא בצורה מבוקרת, תוך שמירה על מרפקים בזווית של כ-45 מעלות לגוף. | Lower until your chest nearly touches the edge of the chair, then pause briefly at the bottom. | Press through your palms to push your body back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms without locking your elbows. | בצע את המספר הרצוי של החזרות, תוך שמירה על תנוחת גוף נוקשה דמוית פלאנק לכל אורך התרגיל.

t: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a PVC pipe horizontally behind your back with both hands, palms facing away from your body. | Position your arms so the pipe rests across the back of your hips, with your elbows slightly bent and your grip about shoulder-width or slightly wider. | Brace your core lightly and keep your chest up and your shoulder blades gently retracted throughout the movement. | Slowly pull the pipe upward and away from your body by externally rotating both shoulders simultaneously, keeping your elbows close to your sides. | Continue lifting the pipe as high as your mobility allows without forcing the movement or shrugging your shoulders toward your ears. | Hold the top position for one to two seconds, feeling the contraction in your rotator cuff muscles. | Lower the pipe back down to the starting position in a controlled manner. | Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, moving smoothly through your full pain-free range of motion.
tRu: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a PVC pipe horizontally behind your back with both hands, palms facing away from your body. | Position your arms so the pipe rests across the back of your hips, with your elbows slightly bent and your grip about shoulder-width or slightly wider. | Легко напрягите пресс и держите грудь поднятой, мягко сведя лопатки в течение всего движения. | Slowly pull the pipe upward and away from your body by externally rotating both shoulders simultaneously, keeping your elbows close to your sides. | Продолжайте поднимать штангу на максимально возможную для вас высоту, не форсируя движение и не поднимая плечи к ушам. | Задержитесь в верхней позиции на одну-две секунды, ощущая сокращение в мышцах ротаторной манжеты. | Опустите штангу обратно вниз в исходное положение контролируемым движением. | Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, moving smoothly through your full pain-free range of motion.
tHe: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a PVC pipe horizontally behind your back with both hands, palms facing away from your body. | Position your arms so the pipe rests across the back of your hips, with your elbows slightly bent and your grip about shoulder-width or slightly wider. | הדק קלות את הליבה ושמור על חזה מורם ועל שכמות הכתפיים אסופות בעדינות לאורך כל התנועה. | Slowly pull the pipe upward and away from your body by externally rotating both shoulders simultaneously, keeping your elbows close to your sides. | המשך להרים את הצינור כמה שיותר גבוה לפי יכולת התנועה שלך מבלי לאלץ את התנועה או להרים את הכתפיים לעבר האוזנים. | Hold the top position for one to two seconds, feeling the contraction in your rotator cuff muscles. | Lower the pipe back down to the starting position in a controlled manner. | Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, moving smoothly through your full pain-free range of motion.

t: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hold a PVC pipe with a grip slightly wider than shoulder-width. | Bring the pipe to the front rack position: elbows raised to shoulder height, pipe resting across the front of your shoulders and upper chest. | Push your elbows up as high as possible while keeping the pipe in contact with your shoulders — do not let it drift forward. | With elbows raised, gently pull the ends of the pipe apart as if trying to widen it, creating outward tension. | Begin to squat or hinge slightly at the hips to load the stretch, keeping your chest up and your upper back engaged. | Hold the end position for 20–30 seconds, breathing steadily and allowing the shoulder and thoracic tissues to relax into the stretch. | Lower your elbows slowly to release tension, then return to the starting position. | Repeat for 2–3 sets, focusing on progressively raising the elbows higher with each hold.
tRu: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hold a PVC pipe with a grip slightly wider than shoulder-width. | Поднимите штангу в переднюю стойку на груди: локти подняты до уровня плеч, штанга лежит на передней части плеч и верхней груди. | Push your elbows up as high as possible while keeping the pipe in contact with your shoulders — do not let it drift forward. | With elbows raised, gently pull the ends of the pipe apart as if trying to widen it, creating outward tension. | Начните слегка приседать или наклоняться в бёдрах, чтобы усилить растяжение, удерживая грудь поднятой, а верх спины — включённым. | Задержите конечное положение на 20–30 секунд, дышите ровно и позволяйте тканям плеч и грудного отдела расслабиться в растяжке. | Медленно опустите локти, чтобы снять напряжение, затем вернитесь в исходное положение. | Repeat for 2–3 sets, focusing on progressively raising the elbows higher with each hold.
tHe: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hold a PVC pipe with a grip slightly wider than shoulder-width. | הבא את הצינור למצב ראק קדמי: מרימים את המרפקים לגובה הכתפיים, הצינור נח על פני הכתפיים והחזה העליון. | Push your elbows up as high as possible while keeping the pipe in contact with your shoulders — do not let it drift forward. | With elbows raised, gently pull the ends of the pipe apart as if trying to widen it, creating outward tension. | התחל בסקוואט או בציר קל מהאגן כדי להעמיס את המתיחה, תוך שמירה על חזה זקוף וגב עליון מופעל. | Hold the end position for 20–30 seconds, breathing steadily and allowing the shoulder and thoracic tissues to relax into the stretch. | Lower your elbows slowly to release tension, then return to the starting position. | Repeat for 2–3 sets, focusing on progressively raising the elbows higher with each hold.

t: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, toes pointing forward or slightly out, and place the stick across your upper traps — not your neck. | Grip the stick with both hands at a comfortable width outside your shoulders to keep it stable throughout the movement. | Brace your core lightly, maintain a neutral spine, and unlock your knees with a soft bend of about 15–20°. | Initiate the movement by pushing your hips straight back, not by bending your knees or rounding your lower back. | Hinge forward until your torso is roughly parallel to the floor, or until you feel a strong stretch in your hamstrings — whichever comes first. | Pause for a moment at the bottom, keeping your back flat and the stick level across your shoulders. | Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes to return to the upright starting position. | Reset your brace and repeat for the target number of reps.
tRu: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, toes pointing forward or slightly out, and place the stick across your upper traps — not your neck. | Возьмитесь за палочку обеими руками на комфортной ширине за плечами, чтобы она оставалась стабильной на протяжении всего движения. | Легко напрягите пресс, сохраняйте позвоночник нейтральным и слегка согните колени примерно на 15–20°. | Начните движение, отводя таз прямо назад, а не сгибая колени или округляя поясницу. | Наклоняйтесь вперёд, пока корпус не будет примерно параллелен полу, или пока не почувствуете сильное растяжение в подколенных сухожилиях — в зависимости от того, что наступит раньше. | Задержитесь на мгновение в нижней точке, сохраняя спину прямой и палку на уровне плеч. | Выведите бёдра вперёд и сожмите ягодицы, чтобы вернуться в вертикальное исходное положение. | Восстановите напряжение корпуса и повторите целевое количество повторений.
tHe: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, toes pointing forward or slightly out, and place the stick across your upper traps — not your neck. | אחוז במקל בשתי הידיים ברוחב נוח מחוץ לכתפיים כדי לשמור עליו יציב לאורך כל התנועה. | הדק קלות את הליבה, שמור על עמוד שדרה ניטרלי ושחרר את הברכיים עם כיפוף רך של כ-15–20°. | Initiate the movement by pushing your hips straight back, not by bending your knees or rounding your lower back. | כופף קדימה עד שהגו בקירוב מקביל לרצפה, או עד שתרגיש מתיחה חזקה בירך האחורית — לפי מה שיגיע קודם. | Pause for a moment at the bottom, keeping your back flat and the stick level across your shoulders. | דחוף את האגן קדימה וכווץ את הישבן כדי לחזור לעמדת המוצא הזקופה. | אפס את המתח בליבה וחזור על התרגיל למספר חזרות היעד.

t: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and toes pointing straight ahead or slightly out. | Hold a PVC stick (or dowel) vertically behind your back, gripping it with one hand at your lower back and the other behind your head. | Position the stick so it maintains three points of contact: the back of your head, between your shoulder blades, and your tailbone (sacrum). | Brace your core lightly, set your shoulders back and down, and keep your chest up before you move. | Initiate the movement by pushing your hips back — not by bending your knees — while keeping both feet flat on the floor. | Continue hinging until your torso approaches parallel to the floor, or until your hamstrings pull tight, whichever comes first. | Throughout the descent, verify that all three contact points remain on the stick and that your shins stay close to vertical. | Pause briefly at the bottom, then drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes to return to a tall standing position. | Reset the stick contact points between reps before beginning the next repetition.
tRu: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and toes pointing straight ahead or slightly out. | Держите ПВХ-трубу (или деревянный брусок) вертикально за спиной, удерживая одной рукой в нижней части спины, а другой — за головой. | Position the stick so it maintains three points of contact: the back of your head, between your shoulder blades, and your tailbone (sacrum). | Легко напрягите пресс, отведите плечи назад и вниз и держите грудь поднятой перед движением. | Начните движение, отводя таз назад — а не сгибая колени — сохраняя обе стопы на полу. | Продолжайте отводить бёдра назад, пока ваш корпус не станет примерно параллелен полу, или пока подколенные сухожилия не натянутся — в зависимости от того, что наступит раньше. | Throughout the descent, verify that all three contact points remain on the stick and that your shins stay close to vertical. | На мгновение остановитесь в нижней точке, затем толкните таз вперед и сожмите ягодицы, чтобы вернуться в положение стоя. | Reset the stick contact points between reps before beginning the next repetition.
tHe: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and toes pointing straight ahead or slightly out. | החזק מקל PVC (או מקל) אנכית מאחורי הגב, תוך אחיזתו ביד אחת בגב התחתון וביד השנייה מאחורי הראש. | Position the stick so it maintains three points of contact: the back of your head, between your shoulder blades, and your tailbone (sacrum). | הדק קלות את הליבה, קבע כתפיים לאחור ולמטה ושמור על חזה מורם לפני התנועה. | Initiate the movement by pushing your hips back — not by bending your knees — while keeping both feet flat on the floor. | המשך להתכופף עד שהגוף שלך מגיע לזווית של כ-90 מעלות לרצפה, או עד ששרירי הירך האחוריים מתמתחים, תלוי מה קורה קודם. | Throughout the descent, verify that all three contact points remain on the stick and that your shins stay close to vertical. | Pause briefly at the bottom, then drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes to return to a tall standing position. | Reset the stick contact points between reps before beginning the next repetition.

t: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart or slightly wider, toes turned out 15–30 degrees. | Hold the PVC pipe with a wide snatch-width grip — hands well outside shoulder-width — and press it overhead until your arms are fully extended. | Rotate your shoulders outward to engage your upper back and pull the pipe apart slightly to create tension, keeping it directly above or just behind the crown of your head. | Brace your core, take a breath, and keep your chest tall before beginning the descent. | Push your knees out in line with your toes and sit your hips back and down simultaneously, descending into a full squat until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor. | Keep the pipe locked out overhead throughout the descent — do not let your arms drift forward or your elbows bend. | At the bottom, pause briefly to confirm your heels are flat, your chest is upright, and the pipe remains stacked above your feet. | Drive through your full foot to stand, keeping your knees tracking over your toes and the pipe locked out until you reach full hip and knee extension. | Reset your breath and brace before each rep.
tRu: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart or slightly wider, toes turned out 15–30 degrees. | Держите ПВХ-трубку широким хватом для рывка — руки значительно шире плеч — и поднимите её над головой до полного выпрямления рук. | Rotate your shoulders outward to engage your upper back and pull the pipe apart slightly to create tension, keeping it directly above or just behind the crown of your head. | Напрягите корпус, сделайте вдох и держите грудь прямо перед началом опускания. | Push your knees out in line with your toes and sit your hips back and down simultaneously, descending into a full squat until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor. | Держите гриф зафиксированным над головой на протяжении всего опускания — не позволяйте рукам уходить вперёд или сгибать локти. | В нижней точке сделайте короткую паузу и проверьте: пятки плотно на полу, грудь вертикально, а бодибар остаётся над стопами. | Отталкивайтесь всей стопой, чтобы встать, сохраняя колени над пальцами ног и штангу зафиксированной до полного разгибания тазобедренного сустава и колена. | Reset your breath and brace before each rep.
tHe: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart or slightly wider, toes turned out 15–30 degrees. | Hold the PVC pipe with a wide snatch-width grip — hands well outside shoulder-width — and press it overhead until your arms are fully extended. | Rotate your shoulders outward to engage your upper back and pull the pipe apart slightly to create tension, keeping it directly above or just behind the crown of your head. | כווץ את שרירי הליבה, קח נשימה, ושמור על חזה גבוה לפני התחלת הירידה. | Push your knees out in line with your toes and sit your hips back and down simultaneously, descending into a full squat until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor. | Keep the pipe locked out overhead throughout the descent — do not let your arms drift forward or your elbows bend. | בתחתית, עצור לרגע כדי לוודא שהעקבים שטוחים, החזה זקוף, והצינור נשאר מונח מעל כפות הרגליים. | דחוף דרך כל כף הרגל כדי לקום, שומר שהברכים ממוקמות מעל אצבעות הרגליים והצינור נעול עד שאתה מגיע למתיחה מלאה של הירך והברך. | Reset your breath and brace before each rep.

t: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and hold a PVC pipe in front of your thighs using a wide overhand grip — hands spaced well outside shoulder width. | Brace your core lightly and keep your elbows soft but not deeply bent throughout the movement. | Begin the forward pass by raising the pipe upward in a smooth arc, keeping your arms as straight as comfortably possible. | Continue the arc overhead, allowing your shoulders to rotate naturally as the pipe passes above your head. | Lower the pipe behind your back until it rests against your glutes or upper hamstrings, maintaining control throughout. | Pause briefly at the bottom of the behind-back position, then reverse the arc to bring the pipe back overhead and down to the starting position in front of your thighs. | That is one repetition. Perform 8–15 controlled reps, adjusting grip width as needed to complete the full range of motion.
tRu: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and hold a PVC pipe in front of your thighs using a wide overhand grip — hands spaced well outside shoulder width. | Легко напрягите пресс и удерживайте локти мягкими, но не согнутыми сильно в течение всего движения. | Начните проход вперёд с подъёма палки вверх по плавной дуге, удерживая руки максимально прямыми, насколько комфортно. | Продолжайте дугу над головой, позволяя плечам вращаться естественным образом, когда палка проходит над вашей головой. | Опустите штангу за спину, пока она не окажется у ягодиц или верхних бедер, сохраняя контроль на протяжении всего движения. | Пауза на мгновение в нижней точке положения за спиной, затем разверните дугу, чтобы вернуть штангу над головой и вниз в исходное положение перед бёдрами. | That is one repetition. Perform 8–15 controlled reps, adjusting grip width as needed to complete the full range of motion.
tHe: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and hold a PVC pipe in front of your thighs using a wide overhand grip — hands spaced well outside shoulder width. | הדק קלות את הליבה ושמור על מרפקים רכים אך לא כפופים עמוק לאורך כל התנועה. | התחל את המעבר קדימה בהרמת המוט מעלה בקשת חלקה, תוך שמירה על זרועות ישרות ככל שנוח. | המשך הקשת מעל הראש, מאפשר לכתפיים להסתובב באופן טבעי כשהצינור עובר מעל הראש. | Lower the pipe behind your back until it rests against your glutes or upper hamstrings, maintaining control throughout. | Pause briefly at the bottom of the behind-back position, then reverse the arc to bring the pipe back overhead and down to the starting position in front of your thighs. | That is one repetition. Perform 8–15 controlled reps, adjusting grip width as needed to complete the full range of motion.

t: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, then step your right foot forward about 3–4 feet and your left foot back, keeping both feet flat on the floor. | Angle your back (left) foot out to roughly 45° to give your hips a stable base, and square your hips as much as possible toward the front of the mat. | Place your hands on your hips and draw your shoulder blades down and back to lengthen your spine. | On an inhale, grow tall through the crown of your head, creating as much length in the torso as possible. | On an exhale, hinge at the hips — not the waist — and fold your torso forward over your front (right) leg, keeping your back flat. | Lower as far as your hamstring flexibility allows: rest your hands on your shin, ankle, the floor beside your foot, or on blocks for support. | Hold the position for 5–10 slow, steady breaths, relaxing deeper into the stretch with each exhale. | To come out, engage your core, press through both feet, and rise back up on an inhale with a flat back. | Step your feet together, then repeat on the opposite side with the left foot forward.
tRu: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, then step your right foot forward about 3–4 feet and your left foot back, keeping both feet flat on the floor. | Разверните заднюю левую стопу наружу примерно на 45°, обеспечив бёдрам стабильную опору, и максимально разверните бёдра к передней части коврика. | Положите руки на бёдра и отведите лопатки вниз и назад, вытягивая позвоночник. | На вдохе вытянитесь макушкой вверх, создавая максимальную длину в туловище. | На выдохе отведите бёдра назад — не в пояснице — и наклоните корпус вперёд над передней (правой) ногой, сохраняя спину прямой. | Опустите насколько позволяет гибкость бицепсов бедер: положите руки на голень, лодыжку, пол рядом со стопой или на опорные блоки. | Держите положение в течение 5-10 медленных, ровных дыханий, расслабляясь глубже в растяжку с каждым выдохом. | To come out, engage your core, press through both feet, and rise back up on an inhale with a flat back. | Step your feet together, then repeat on the opposite side with the left foot forward.
tHe: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, then step your right foot forward about 3–4 feet and your left foot back, keeping both feet flat on the floor. | הטה את כף הרגל האחורית (שמאל) החוצה לזווית של כ-45° כדי לתת לאגן בסיס יציב, ויישר את האגן ככל האפשר לקדמת המזרן. | Place your hands on your hips and draw your shoulder blades down and back to lengthen your spine. | On an inhale, grow tall through the crown of your head, creating as much length in the torso as possible. | On an exhale, hinge at the hips — not the waist — and fold your torso forward over your front (right) leg, keeping your back flat. | Lower as far as your hamstring flexibility allows: rest your hands on your shin, ankle, the floor beside your foot, or on blocks for support. | Hold the position for 5–10 slow, steady breaths, relaxing deeper into the stretch with each exhale. | To come out, engage your core, press through both feet, and rise back up on an inhale with a flat back. | Step your feet together, then repeat on the opposite side with the left foot forward.

t: Lie face-down on a flat surface with your legs extended and your forehead resting on your free hand or a folded towel. | Keep your hips pressed evenly into the floor and your core lightly engaged so your lower back stays neutral. | Bend your right knee, bringing your right heel toward your right glute. | Reach back with your right hand and grasp the top of your right foot or your ankle. | Gently pull your heel closer to your glute until you feel a firm stretch along the front of your right thigh — do not force the movement. | Hold the position for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and allowing the muscle to relax into the stretch. | Release your foot, straighten your right leg, and return to the starting position. | Repeat on the left side: bend the left knee, grasp the left foot or ankle with the left hand, and hold for 20–30 seconds. | Complete 2–3 rounds per side, resting briefly between rounds.
tRu: Лягте на живот на горизонтальную поверхность с вытянутыми ногами и лбом, лежащим на свободной руке или сложенном полотенце. | Держите бёдра равномерно прижатыми к полу и корпус слегка напряжённым, чтобы поясница оставалась нейтральной. | Согните правое колено, подтягивая правую пятку к правой ягодице. | Reach back with your right hand and grasp the top of your right foot or your ankle. | Аккуратно потяните пятку ближе к ягодице, пока не почувствуете устойчивое растяжение по передней поверхности правого бедра — не форсируйте движение. | Задержите положение на 20-30 секунд, дыша медленно и позволяя мышце расслабляться в растяжке. | Release your foot, straighten your right leg, and return to the starting position. | Repeat on the left side: bend the left knee, grasp the left foot or ankle with the left hand, and hold for 20–30 seconds. | Выполните 2–3 круга на каждую сторону, делая короткие паузы между кругами.
tHe: Lie face-down on a flat surface with your legs extended and your forehead resting on your free hand or a folded towel. | Keep your hips pressed evenly into the floor and your core lightly engaged so your lower back stays neutral. | כופף את ברך ימין והבא את עקב ימין לכיוון העכוז הימני. | Reach back with your right hand and grasp the top of your right foot or your ankle. | משוך בעדינות את העקב קרוב יותר לישבן עד שתרגיש מתיחה החלטית לאורך קדמת הירך הימנית — אל תכפה את התנועה. | Hold the position for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and allowing the muscle to relax into the stretch. | Release your foot, straighten your right leg, and return to the starting position. | Repeat on the left side: bend the left knee, grasp the left foot or ankle with the left hand, and hold for 20–30 seconds. | בצע 2–3 סבבים לכל צד, עם מנוחה קצרה בין הסבבים.

t: Stand tall with your feet together and your gaze fixed on a point ahead of you to help maintain balance. | Shift your weight onto your left foot and bend your right knee, bringing your right heel up toward your right glute. | Reach back with your right hand and grasp the top of your right foot or ankle. | Draw your right heel as close to your glute as comfortably possible while keeping your knees close together and your right knee pointing straight down. | Squeeze your glutes and keep your hips level — avoid letting the right hip hike up or rotate outward. | Stand tall through your spine; do not lean forward at the waist or arch your lower back excessively. | Breathe slowly and deeply, allowing the quadriceps to relax further with each exhale. Hold the stretch for 20–30 seconds. | Release your foot gently, return to the starting position, then repeat on the opposite side.
tRu: Stand tall with your feet together and your gaze fixed on a point ahead of you to help maintain balance. | Shift your weight onto your left foot and bend your right knee, bringing your right heel up toward your right glute. | Отведите правую руку назад и захватите верхнюю часть правой стопы или лодыжку. | Приведите правую пятку как можно ближе к ягодице, сохраняя колени близко друг к другу и направив правое колено прямо вниз. | Squeeze your glutes and keep your hips level — avoid letting the right hip hike up or rotate outward. | Stand tall through your spine; do not lean forward at the waist or arch your lower back excessively. | Дышите медленно и глубоко, плавно углубляясь в растяжку с каждым выдохом, не форсируя ее. | Release your foot gently, return to the starting position, then repeat on the opposite side.
tHe: Stand tall with your feet together and your gaze fixed on a point ahead of you to help maintain balance. | Shift your weight onto your left foot and bend your right knee, bringing your right heel up toward your right glute. | הושט לאחור עם יד ימין ואחוז בחלק העליון של כף רגל ימין או בקרסול. | משוך את עקב ימין ככל האפשר בנוחות לעבר הישבן, שומר על ברכים קרובות ועל ברך ימין פונה ישר למטה. | Squeeze your glutes and keep your hips level — avoid letting the right hip hike up or rotate outward. | Stand tall through your spine; do not lean forward at the waist or arch your lower back excessively. | נשיר לאט ועמוק, מאפשר לשרירי הירך הקדמיים להרפות עוד יותר עם כל נשימה. החזיקו את המתיחה למשך 20–30 שניות. | Release your foot gently, return to the starting position, then repeat on the opposite side.

t: Place a sturdy box or bench behind you at roughly knee height and stand about one step in front of it. | Shift your weight onto your left foot, reach back, and place the top of your right foot on the box so the laces face down. | Lower your right knee toward the floor, keeping your torso upright, until you feel a stretch along the front of your right thigh. | Position your left knee directly over your left ankle so your front shin stays vertical. | Place your hands on your left thigh or a stable surface for balance if needed. | Breathe out and gently deepen the stretch by pressing your hips slightly forward and down without arching your lower back. | Hold the stretch for 20 to 45 seconds, breathing steadily throughout. | Carefully step your right foot off the box, return to standing, and repeat on the opposite side.
tRu: Положите sturdy box or bench behind you at roughly knee height and stand about one step in front of it. | Shift your weight onto your left foot, reach back, and place the top of your right foot on the box so the laces face down. | Опустите правое колено к полу, сохраняя корпус прямо, пока не почувствуете растяжение передней поверхности правого бедра. | Position your left knee directly over your left ankle so your front shin stays vertical. | Положите руки на левое бедро или на устойчивую поверхность для баланса, если необходимо. | Выдыхайте, когда позволяете колену занять положение, позволяя суставу расслабиться в этой позиции, не форсируя ее. | Держите растяжку в течение 20-45 секунд, дыша ровно на протяжении всего времени. | Осторожно сойдите с ящика правой ногой, встаньте прямо и повторите с противоположной стороны.
tHe: Place a sturdy box or bench behind you at roughly knee height and stand about one step in front of it. | Shift your weight onto your left foot, reach back, and place the top of your right foot on the box so the laces face down. | Lower your right knee toward the floor, keeping your torso upright, until you feel a stretch along the front of your right thigh. | Position your left knee directly over your left ankle so your front shin stays vertical. | Place your hands on your left thigh or a stable surface for balance if needed. | נשור והעמק בעדינות את המתיחה על ידי לחיצת הירכיים קדימה ולמטה בלי לקמט את גבך התחתון. | Hold the stretch for 20 to 45 seconds, breathing steadily throughout. | צעד בזהירות עם הרגל הימנית מהקופסה, חזור לעמידה זקופה, וחזור על התרגיל בצד השני.

t: Position yourself on all fours with your hands directly under your shoulders and your knees under your hips, hip-width apart. | Brace your core and set your spine to neutral — your back should be flat, neither rounded nor overarched. | Lift your right knee off the floor and raise your thigh until it is roughly parallel with the floor, with the knee bent at approximately 90°. | From that position, actively curl your right heel toward your glutes by contracting your hamstring, flexing the knee as far as you can while keeping your thigh still. | Pause briefly at the top of the curl, squeezing the back of your thigh. | Lower your foot under control until your knee returns to the 90° starting position, keeping your thigh parallel to the floor throughout. | Complete all reps on the right leg, then switch to the left side and repeat for the same number of reps.
tRu: Position yourself on all fours with your hands directly under your shoulders and your knees under your hips, hip-width apart. | Напрягите корпус и займите нейтральное положение позвоночника: спина ровная, без округления и чрезмерного прогиба. | Поднимите правое колено с пола и поднимите бедро до примерно параллели с полом, с согнутым под углом 90° коленом. | Из этого положения, активно подведите правую пятку к ягодицам, сокращая бицепс бедра, сгибая колено до максимума, сохраняя бедро неподвижным. | Пауза в верхней точке сгибания, сжимая заднюю поверхность бедра. | Опустите ногу под контролем, пока ваше колено не вернётся в исходное положение с углом 90°, сохраняя бедро параллельным полу на протяжении всего движения. | Выполните все повторения на правой ноге, затем поменяйте на левую сторону и повторите для того же количества повторений.
tHe: Position yourself on all fours with your hands directly under your shoulders and your knees under your hips, hip-width apart. | הדק את הליבה וקבע את עמוד השדרה לניטרלי — הגב צריך להיות שטוח, לא מעוגל ולא קשור יתר על המידה. | Lift your right knee off the floor and raise your thigh until it is roughly parallel with the floor, with the knee bent at approximately 90°. | מעמדה זו, כופף באופן אקטיבי את עקב ימין לכיוון הישבן בכיווץ הירך האחורית, וכופף את הברך עד הקצה תוך שמירה על הירך נייחת. | Pause briefly at the top of the curl, squeezing the back of your thigh. | Lower your foot under control until your knee returns to the 90° starting position, keeping your thigh parallel to the floor throughout. | בצע את כל החזרות עם הרגל הימינה, ואז החלף לצד השמאל וחזור על אותו מספר חזרות.

t: Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent, and your weight balanced on the balls of your feet. | Begin running forward at a controlled pace, keeping your torso tall and your core lightly braced. | Bring your feet in toward the center with two quick, choppy steps, staying light on the balls of your feet. | Immediately step both feet back out to a stance just past shoulder-width with two more quick steps. | Continue alternating the in-out pattern — in, in, out, out — while inching forward and keeping your steps rapid and light. | Pump your arms in rhythm with your feet, keeping your elbows bent at roughly 90° and your hands relaxed. | Stay on the balls of your feet throughout; avoid letting your heels drop heavily with each contact. | Complete the drill for the prescribed distance or time, then decelerate gradually to a walk.
tRu: Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent, and your weight balanced on the balls of your feet. | Начните бег вперёд в контролируемом темпе, удерживая корпус высоким, а мышцы кора слегка напряжёнными. | Сведите ноги к центру двумя быстрыми резкими шагами, оставаясь на носках. | Сразу же сделайте обеими ногами шаг назад в положение, немного шире плеч, еще двумя быстрыми шагами. | Продолжайте поочередно выполнять паттерн «внутрь-внутрь-наружу-наружу», продвигаясь вперед, и делайте шаги быстрыми и легкими. | Pump your arms in rhythm with your feet, keeping your elbows bent at roughly 90° and your hands relaxed. | Stay on the balls of your feet throughout; avoid letting your heels drop heavily with each contact. | Выполните упражнение на заданную дистанцию или время, затем постепенно замедлитесь до ходьбы.
tHe: Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent, and your weight balanced on the balls of your feet. | התחל לרוץ קדימה בקצב מבוקר, תוך שמירה על גו זקוף וליבה מעט מהודקת. | הביא את הרגליים למרכז בשני צעדים מהירים וקצרים, נשאר קל עכשיו על כפות הרגליים. | Immediately step both feet back out to a stance just past shoulder-width with two more quick steps. | המשיל להחליף בין התבנית פנים-חוץ — פנים, פנים, חוץ, חוץ — בעת התקדמות קדימה ושמירה על צעדים מהירים וקלים. | Pump your arms in rhythm with your feet, keeping your elbows bent at roughly 90° and your hands relaxed. | Stay on the balls of your feet throughout; avoid letting your heels drop heavily with each contact. | בצע את התרגיל למרחק או לזמן המוגדר, ואפחות בהדרגה להליכה.

t: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent, and your weight balanced over the balls of your feet. | Hinge forward slightly at the hips — enough to keep your center of mass over the front of your feet without rounding your back. | Raise your arms to roughly a 90° bend at the elbows, the same position you would hold while jogging. | Begin alternating your feet in very short, rapid steps, lifting each foot just a few centimeters off the ground. | Drive your arms in a controlled back-and-forth swing in time with your feet to build rhythm and maintain balance. | Keep your steps as fast as possible while staying light on your feet — contact time with the ground should be minimal. | Breathe in a steady, rhythmic pattern throughout; do not hold your breath. | Maintain the drill for your target duration or rep count, then slow your feet gradually to a stop rather than stopping abruptly.

t: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent, and your weight balanced on the balls of your feet. | Engage your core and keep your torso upright with a slight forward lean at the hips. | Raise your arms to roughly waist height and bend your elbows at 90 degrees to help drive rhythm. | Begin alternating your feet as fast as possible, lifting each foot only 1–2 inches off the floor. | Keep your steps short and controlled — feet should land directly beneath your hips, not out in front. | Maintain continuous, rapid contact with the floor, avoiding any single large jump or bound. | Drive with your hip flexors and thighs to sustain the quick tempo throughout the set. | Continue for the prescribed duration (typically 10–30 seconds), then lower both feet flat to the floor and stand tall to recover.

tHe: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent, and your weight balanced on the balls of your feet. | הפעל את שרירי הליבה ושמור על גוף הפלטה זקוף עם קימור קדמי קל במפרקי הירך. | Raise your arms to roughly waist height and bend your elbows at 90 degrees to help drive rhythm. | התחל להחליף רגליים מהר ככל האפשר, והרם כל כף רגל רק 1–2 אינץ׳ מהרצפה. | Keep your steps short and controlled — feet should land directly beneath your hips, not out in front. | Maintain continuous, rapid contact with the floor, avoiding any single large jump or bound. | דחוף עם שרירי הירך הקדמיים והירכיים כדי לשמור על הקצב המהיר לאורך כל הסט. | המשך למשך הזמן המומלץ (בדרך כלל 10–30 שניות), ואן הורד את שתי הרגליים על הרצפה ועמוד זקוף כדי להתאושש.

t: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, knees soft, and your spine tall. | Let your arms hang relaxed at your sides with your hands loosely open. | Brace your core lightly to keep your torso stable throughout the drill. | Begin swinging both arms forward and back simultaneously in a controlled but brisk pendulum motion. | On the forward swing, raise each arm to roughly shoulder height while keeping your elbow slightly soft. | On the backward swing, drive your arms behind your hips as far as comfortable range of motion allows. | Increase tempo progressively until you are moving at a quick, rhythmic pace without losing posture. | Keep your shoulders level and your head neutral — avoid hunching or shrugging as speed builds. | Continue for the target duration or rep count, then slow the swing gradually before stopping.

t: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, arms bent at roughly 90 degrees at your sides. | Engage your core and keep your torso upright with a slight forward lean from the ankles. | Lift your right knee toward hip height while simultaneously driving your left arm forward. | Quickly lower your right foot and immediately lift your left knee, swinging your right arm forward. | Alternate legs in a continuous, brisk rhythm — aim for a jogging cadence faster than a casual jog. | Land softly on the balls of your feet each time, avoiding heavy heel strikes. | Keep your shoulders relaxed and away from your ears; let the arms swing naturally from the shoulders. | Maintain steady breathing — inhale for two steps, exhale for two steps — to sustain the pace. | Continue for the prescribed duration or rep count, then slow to a walk to recover.

nH: מתיחת שוק עם כף רגל מורמת
t: Stand facing a low step, box, or raised surface roughly 15 to 30 centimetres high. | Shift your weight onto your left foot and place the top of your right foot on the raised surface so the toes point away from you and the laces face down. | Stand tall with your hips square and your hands on your hips or lightly resting on a wall for balance. | Slowly bend your left knee and lower your body slightly to allow the right ankle to plantarflex, which brings the shin closer to the surface. | Gently press your right shin forward and down until you feel a stretch along the front of the lower leg, just below the knee and along the shin bone. | Keep the top of your right foot and toes pressed into the raised surface throughout so the ankle stays plantarflexed. | Hold the stretched position for 20 to 45 seconds, breathing steadily. | Slowly straighten your left leg and lift your right foot off the surface to release the stretch. | Repeat on the opposite side.
tRu: Stand facing a low step, box, or raised surface roughly 15 to 30 centimetres high. | Shift your weight onto your left foot and place the top of your right foot on the raised surface so the toes point away from you and the laces face down. | Stand tall with your hips square and your hands on your hips or lightly resting on a wall for balance. | Slowly bend your left knee and lower your body slightly to allow the right ankle to plantarflex, which brings the shin closer to the surface. | Аккуратно надавьте правой голенью вперёд и вниз, пока не почувствуете растяжение по передней части нижней ноги, чуть ниже колена и вдоль большеберцовой кости. | Держите верхнюю часть правой стопы и пальцы прижатыми к возвышенной поверхности на протяжении всего движения, чтобы голеностопный сустав оставался в положении подошвенного сгибания. | Держите растянутое положение 20–45 секунд, дыша ровно. | Slowly straighten your left leg and lift your right foot off the surface to release the stretch. | Повторите на противоположной стороне.

t: Stand facing a bench, step, or sturdy elevated surface roughly hip to waist height. | Lift one leg and place your heel on the surface with the leg extended straight, toes pointing upward. | Stand tall with your supporting leg slightly soft at the knee and your hands resting on your hips or on the surface for balance. | Keeping your back flat, hinge forward from your hips — not your waist — until you feel a strong but comfortable stretch along the back of the raised thigh. | Hold the stretched position for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and allowing the hamstrings to relax with each exhale. | Return to an upright position by engaging your core and lifting your torso back to neutral. | Lower the raised leg and repeat on the opposite side, completing 2–3 holds per leg.
tRu: Stand facing a bench, step, or sturdy elevated surface roughly hip to waist height. | Приподнимите одну ногу и поставьте пятку на поверхность, держа ногу прямой, носки направлены вверх. | Stand tall with your supporting leg slightly soft at the knee and your hands resting on your hips or on the surface for balance. | Держа спину прямой, отведите таз назад — не в поясницу — пока не почувствуете сильную, но комфортную растяжку в задней части поднятого бедра. | Держите растянутое положение 20–30 секунд, дыша медленно и позволяя задней поверхности бедра расслабляться с каждым выдохом. | Return to an upright position by engaging your core and lifting your torso back to neutral. | Опустите поднятую ногу и повторите на противоположной стороне, выполняя 2–3 задержки на каждую ногу.
