t: Anchor a resistance band to a sturdy post or door frame at approximately shoulder height. | Grasp the band with both hands, palms facing down, and step back until the band has light tension with your arms extended straight in front of you. | Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly soft, and hinge forward from the hips until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor. | Brace your core and keep your spine neutral throughout the movement. | Pull both handles out and back in a wide arc, leading with your elbows, until your hands reach ear height and your upper arms are roughly parallel to the floor. | Pause briefly at the end of the pull and squeeze your rear deltoids. | Slowly extend your arms back to the start position under control, maintaining tension in the band throughout.

tHe: עגן גומייה לעמוד יציב או למשקוף בערך בגובה הכתפיים. | אחוז בגומייה בשתי הידיים, כפות מטה, וצעד לאחור עד שהגומייה תחת מתח קל והזרועות פשוטות ישר לפניך. | Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly soft, and hinge forward from the hips until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor. | הדק את הליבה ושמור על עמוד שדרה ניטרלי לאורך כל התנועה. | Pull both handles out and back in a wide arc, leading with your elbows, until your hands reach ear height and your upper arms are roughly parallel to the floor. | Pause briefly at the end of the pull and squeeze your rear deltoids. | Slowly extend your arms back to the start position under control, maintaining tension in the band throughout.

t: Anchor a resistance band under both hands at shoulder width, or loop it so each hand holds one end with light-to-moderate tension. | Start in a high-plank position with hands directly under shoulders, feet hip-width apart, and the band running beneath your chest. | Brace your core, squeeze your glutes, and create a rigid, neutral spine from head to heels before lifting either hand. | Keeping your hips level and parallel to the floor, drive your right elbow straight back and pull the band toward your right hip. | Pause briefly at the top with your elbow close to your ribcage and your shoulder blade fully retracted. | Slowly lower your right hand back to the floor with control, re-establishing full plank tension. | Without rotating your hips, repeat the row on your left side to complete one full rep. | Continue alternating sides for the target number of reps, maintaining a locked-in plank throughout the set.

t: Anchor the resistance band to a sturdy object at floor level behind your head, such as the base of a rack or a heavy piece of furniture. | Lie on your back with your head near the anchor point. t: Secure a resistance band to a stable anchor point directly above you — a pull-up bar or a sturdy rack works well. t: Anchor one end of a resistance band to a sturdy post or the base of a rack at ground level, then loop the other end securely around both ankles. | Lie face-down on a flat bench so your hips sit at the edge — your upper body rests on the bench and your legs hang freely off the end toward the floor. | Grip the sides of the bench firmly with both hands to stabilize your upper body throughout the movement. | Brace your core and press your hips gently into the bench to protect your lower back. | Squeeze your glutes and lift both legs together in a smooth arc, extending your hips until your legs are roughly parallel to the floor or slightly above — do not hyperextend the lumbar spine. | Hold the top position for one count, maintaining a strong glute contraction. | Lower your legs back toward the floor with control, resisting the pull of the band on the way down. | Allow the legs to descend until they are just short of the starting position, then immediately initiate the next rep without losing tension in the band. | Complete the desired number of reps, then carefully step off the bench and unhook the band.

t: Sit upright on a bench or firm chair with your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart, and your knees bent at approximately 90 degrees. | Place a resistance band loop around both thighs, just above the knees, so the band sits snug but not cutting into the skin. | Position your feet so there is light tension already present in the band before you begin — adjust your foot stance wider or narrower as needed. | Sit tall with your spine neutral, hands resting on your thighs or gripping the edges of the seat for stability. | Exhale and press both knees outward against the band resistance as far as your hip range of motion comfortably allows, without letting your hips rotate or your torso lean. | Hold the end position for one to two seconds, feeling tension through the outer hips. | Inhale and return your knees back to the starting position in a slow, controlled manner — do not let the band snap them inward. | Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, maintaining a consistent tempo throughout.

t: Sit on the floor with your legs extended straight in front of you and your back tall. | Loop a resistance band around the ball of one foot, holding one end of the band in each hand. | Pull the band taut so there is light tension without yet pulling your foot back. | Sit up tall through your spine — avoid rounding your lower back, as this limits how far the stretch travels down the calf. | Gently pull the band toward you, drawing your toes back toward your shin until you feel a moderate stretch along the back of your calf. | Hold the stretch for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and deeply, and allow the calf to relax further with each exhale. | Release the tension gradually — do not let the band snap back. | Repeat on the other leg, then perform 2–3 rounds per side as needed.

nH: סיבוב כף רגל החוצה בישיבה עם גומייה
t: Sit upright in a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor, knees bent at roughly 90 degrees. | Anchor one end of the resistance band to a fixed object at floor level to your inside (for the right foot, anchor to the left). nR: Тяга к лицу сидя с лентой
t: Set a resistance band at approximately face height by looping it around a sturdy post, rack upright, or secure door anchor. | Sit facing the anchor point with your hips centered, back tall, and feet flat on the floor. Grip one end of the band in each hand with an overhand grip, palms facing down, arms fully extended in front of you. | Brace your core and depress your shoulder blades — pull them down and back — before starting the pull. | Pull the band toward your face by driving your elbows wide and slightly upward, leading with the elbows rather than the hands. | As the band approaches your face, externally rotate your shoulders so your forearms angle upward and your hands sit beside your temples, palms facing forward. | Pause for one count at the peak, squeezing your rear deltoids and upper traps. | Slowly extend your arms back to the starting position over 2–3 seconds, maintaining tension on the band throughout. | Repeat for the prescribed reps, then release the band with control.

t: Sit upright on a flat bench or sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. | Loop a resistance band around both ankles or just above the ankles, with light to moderate tension when your legs are hip-width apart. | Plant your feet firmly and sit tall with a neutral spine, hands resting on your thighs or gripping the sides of the bench for stability. | Brace your core lightly and keep your torso upright throughout the movement — avoid leaning to either side. | Press both knees outward simultaneously, driving against the band's resistance until your legs are as wide as comfortable without your hips tilting. | Pause for one second at the widest point and squeeze your glutes and outer hips. | Slowly return your knees inward toward the starting position, controlling the band's pull rather than letting it snap your legs back. | Complete your reps for the set, keeping the movement smooth and tension in the band at all times.

nH: סיבוב כף רגל פנימה בישיבה עם גומייה
t: Sit upright in a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor and your knees bent at roughly 90 degrees. | Place the resistance band around the inside (medial) edge of your foot, anchoring the opposite end to a fixed point at floor height on the same side — such as a chair leg or a door anchor. | Position your foot so the sole faces forward and slightly outward, which is your starting position and sets the band under light tension. | Keeping your heel on the floor, slowly rotate the sole of your foot inward and upward toward your midline, working against the band's resistance. | Pause briefly at the end of your comfortable range of motion — typically 20–30 degrees of inversion — without forcing the ankle. | Slowly return your foot to the starting position under control, resisting the band as it pulls back. | Complete all reps on one foot, then reposition the band and repeat on the other side.

tHe: שב זקוף בכיסא יציב עם כפות רגליים שטוחות על הרצפה וברכיים כפופות בערך ב-90 מעלות. | Place the resistance band around the inside (medial) edge of your foot, anchoring the opposite end to a fixed point at floor height on the same side — such as a chair leg or a door anchor. | Position your foot so the sole faces forward and slightly outward, which is your starting position and sets the band under light tension. | Keeping your heel on the floor, slowly rotate the sole of your foot inward and upward toward your midline, working against the band's resistance. | Pause briefly at the end of your comfortable range of motion — typically 20–30 degrees of inversion — without forcing the ankle. | Slowly return your foot to the starting position under control, resisting the band as it pulls back. | בצע את כל החזרות עם רגל אחת, ולאחר מכן הזז מחדש את הגומייה וחזור על התרגיל בצד השני.

t: Sit upright on the edge of a sturdy bench or chair with your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. | Loop the resistance band around both ankles, or just above both knees for a shorter lever and lighter resistance. | Sit tall, brace your core, and grip the sides of the bench lightly for balance — keep your chest up and your back straight. | Exhale and drive one knee upward toward your chest as high as you can comfortably control, leading with the thigh. | Pause briefly at the top and feel the contraction in your hip flexor. | Inhale and lower your foot back to the floor slowly, resisting the band's pull throughout the descent. | Complete all reps on one side before switching, or alternate legs each rep for the prescribed total.
tRu: Sit upright on the edge of a sturdy bench or chair with your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. | Оберните эспандер вокруг обеих лодыжек или чуть выше обеих колен для более короткого рычага и меньшего сопротивления. | Sit tall, brace your core, and grip the sides of the bench lightly for balance — keep your chest up and your back straight. | Выдохните и поднимите одно колено к груди как можно выше, насколько комфортно контролировать, начиная движение бедром. | На мгновение остановитесь в верхней точке и ощущайте сокращение в сгибателе бедра. | Выдохните и медленно опустите ногу обратно на пол, сопротивляясь натяжению эспандера на протяжении всего опускания. | Выполните все повторения на одной стороне перед тем, как сменить сторону, или чередуйте ноги с каждым повторением для назначенного общего количества.

t: Anchor a resistance band to a sturdy low point in front of you — a heavy bench leg, rack upright, or door anchor set at floor level. | Sit on the edge of a chair or bench with your feet flat on the floor, and loop the free end of the band around both ankles or lower shins. | Slide forward so there is tension in the band with your legs nearly fully extended, feet a few inches off or lightly resting on the floor. | Brace your core, sit tall with a neutral spine, and grip the sides of the bench for stability. | Drive your heels toward the underside of the seat by bending both knees, pulling against the band's resistance. | Curl until your knees are bent to roughly 90° or as far as the band allows while maintaining tension. | Pause briefly at peak contraction, squeezing your hamstrings. | Slowly extend your legs back to the starting position under control, resisting the band on the way out. | Complete all reps, then carefully remove the band from your ankles.
tRu: Закрепите эспандер к прочной низкой точке перед собой — ножке тяжёлой скамьи, стойке рамы или дверному креплению на уровне пола. | Sit on the edge of a chair or bench with your feet flat on the floor, and loop the free end of the band around both ankles or lower shins. | Slide forward so there is tension in the band with your legs nearly fully extended, feet a few inches off or lightly resting on the floor. | Напрягите корпус, сядьте прямо с нейтральным положением позвоночника и возьмитесь за края скамьи для устойчивости. | Упритесь пятками в нижнюю часть сиденья, сгибая оба колена, преодолевая сопротивление эспандера. | Поднимайте, пока колени не согнутся примерно под углом 90° или настолько, как позволяет эспандер, сохраняя напряжение. | Пауза на мгновение в пиковой точке сокращения, сжимая бицепсы бедра. | Slowly extend your legs back to the starting position under control, resisting the band on the way out. | Выполните все повторения, затем осторожно снимите эспандер с лодыжек.
tHe: עגן גומייה לנקודה נמוכה ויציבה מלפניך – רגל של ספסל כבד, עמוד מתקן או עוגן דלת בגובה הרצפה. | Sit on the edge of a chair or bench with your feet flat on the floor, and loop the free end of the band around both ankles or lower shins. | Slide forward so there is tension in the band with your legs nearly fully extended, feet a few inches off or lightly resting on the floor. | תכווץ את שרירי הליבה, ישב זקוף עם עמוד שדרה נייטרלי, ותפוס את צדדי הספסל ליציבות. | דחף את העקבים לכיוון התחתון של הכיסא על ידי כיפוף שתי הברכיים, מושך כנגד התנגדות הגומייה. | כופף עד שהברכיים כפופות בזוויה של כ-90° או כפי שהגומיה מאפשרת, תוך שמירה על מתח. | Pause briefly at peak contraction, squeezing your hamstrings. | Slowly extend your legs back to the starting position under control, resisting the band on the way out. | בצע את כל החזרות, ואז הסר בזהירות את הגומייה מהקרסוליים.

nE: Resistance Band Seated Single Leg Curl
nR: Сгибания одной ноги сидя с лентой
nH: כפיפות רגל אחת בישיבה עם גומייה

t: Loop a resistance band around both thighs just above the knees (or around your ankles for greater challenge) and lie on your side on an exercise mat. | Stack your feet on top of each other and prop yourself up on your bottom forearm, with your elbow directly beneath your shoulder. | Brace your core, squeeze your glutes, and lift your hips off the mat until your body forms a straight line from head to heel. | Press your bottom hip upward and outward slightly to engage the gluteus medius, keeping your top hip stacked directly over your bottom hip. | Without rotating your torso, press your top thigh outward against the band to create tension — this activates the gluteus medius and tensor fasciae latae. | Keep your neck neutral, your gaze forward, and breathe steadily throughout the hold. | Hold the position for the target duration (20–45 seconds for beginners, up to 60 seconds as you progress), then lower your hips with control. | Repeat on the opposite side for equal time.

nE: Resistance Band Side Plank Glute Raise
nR: Боковая планка с подъёмом таза с лентой
nH: פלאנק צדדי עם הרמת אגן עם גומייה
t: Place a resistance band around both legs, just above the knees or around the ankles depending on the band length and desired difficulty. | Lie on your side on the floor or a mat with your legs stacked, your bottom forearm on the ground, and your elbow directly under your shoulder. | Press through your forearm and the side of your bottom foot to lift your hips off the floor, forming a straight line from your head to your feet. | Brace your core and keep your hips stacked so neither hip sags forward or backward. | While holding the side plank, slowly raise your top leg upward as high as you can while keeping it straight and your hips level. | Pause at the top for a moment, feeling the contraction in your outer glute. | Lower your top leg back down under control until it rests on the bottom leg, maintaining tension against the band throughout. | Complete all reps on one side, then switch to the other side and repeat.

nE: Resistance Band Side Step with Horizontal Pallof Hold
nR: Шаги вбок с удержанием Паллофа с лентой
nH: צעדים צידה עם החזקת פאלוף עם גומייה
t: Anchor a resistance band at chest height to a stable post or rack. Stand sideways to the anchor, feet hip-width apart, with your inside hand closest to it. | Grasp the band with both hands and step laterally until the band has firm tension. This is your starting position. | Press both arms straight out in front of your chest, elbows fully extended and hands stacked together at sternum height — this is the Pallof hold position. | Brace your core firmly, drawing your ribs down and your waist tight to resist the band's rotational pull toward the anchor. | Take a controlled lateral step away from the anchor with your outside foot, then bring your inside foot to meet it, restoring your hip-width stance. Keep your arms extended and your torso square throughout. | Continue stepping laterally for the target number of steps or distance, maintaining the arm position and a neutral spine on every step. | Do not allow your shoulders to rotate toward or away from the anchor — the goal is to keep your chest facing straight ahead the entire time. | Once you have completed all steps in one direction, return to the start or switch sides so the anchor is on your opposite side and repeat.

nE: Resistance Band Single Arm Overhead Shoulder Press
nR: Жим одной рукой над головой с лентой
nH: לחיצת כתפיים מעל הראש ביד אחת עם גומייה

nE: Resistance Band Split Jump with Single Arm Row
nR: Прыжки вразножку + тяга одной рукой с лентой
nH: קפיצה מפוצלת עם חתירה ביד אחת עם גומייה
t: Anchor a resistance band at hip-to-chest height to a stable post or rack. Stand facing the anchor, feet together, and grasp the band in one hand with your arm fully extended and light tension already in the band. | Set your distance from the anchor so the band is taut but not pulling you forward. This is your starting position. | Explosively jump upward, scissoring your legs in the air, and land in a split stance — one foot forward, one back — with both knees soft and bent to absorb impact. | At the moment your feet contact the ground, drive your elbow straight back and row the band toward your lower chest, squeezing your back at the end of the pull. | Hold the row for one count at the bottom of the split, keeping your torso upright and chest tall. | Push off both feet explosively to jump again, simultaneously straightening your rowing arm back to full extension as you leave the ground. | While airborne, switch your legs so the opposite foot lands forward. Continue alternating legs and rowing for the prescribed time or rep count, keeping a steady rhythm throughout.

t: Anchor a resistance band at a low point in front of you — such as the base of a rack, a door anchor at floor level, or a heavy object. | Stand facing the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding one end of the band in one hand with your arm extended toward the anchor. | Keep your free arm relaxed at your side or place your hand on your hip for balance. | Brace your core and hinge at the hips to begin the squat, lowering your body until your thighs are parallel to the floor or as low as your mobility allows. | Pause briefly at the bottom of the squat, keeping your chest up and knees tracking over your toes. | As you drive through your heels to rise from the squat, simultaneously pull the band toward your hip or waist, driving your elbow back behind you. | Squeeze your back muscles at the top of the row while fully extending your legs and standing tall. | Slowly return your arm to the extended starting position as you prepare for the next rep. | Complete all reps on one side, then switch the band to the opposite hand and repeat.
tRu: Закрепите эспандер в низкой точке перед собой — например, за основание стойки, дверной фиксатор у пола или тяжёлый предмет. | Stand facing the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding one end of the band in one hand with your arm extended toward the anchor. | Держите свободную руку на бедре или скамье для устойчивости и не наклоняйтесь к работающей стороне. | Напрягите корпус и наклонитесь в бёдрах, начиная присед, опускаясь, пока бёдра не станут параллельны полу или настолько низко, насколько позволяет подвижность. | Пауза на мгновение в нижней точке приседа, сохраняя грудь поднятой, а колени над пальцами ног. | Отталкиваясь пятками и вставая из приседа, одновременно потяните эспандер к бедру или талии, уводя локоть назад за спину. | Squeeze your back muscles at the top of the row while fully extending your legs and standing tall. | Slowly return your arm to the extended starting position as you prepare for the next rep. | Выполните все повторения на одну сторону, затем переставьте эспандер в противоположную руку и повторите.
tHe: עגן גומייה בנקודה נמוכה לפניך — כמו בסיס מתקן, עוגן דלת בגובה הרצפה או חפץ כבד. | Stand facing the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding one end of the band in one hand with your arm extended toward the anchor. | Keep your free arm relaxed at your side or place your hand on your hip for balance. | הדק את הליבה וכופף את האגן כדי להתחיל את הסקוואט, והורד את הגוף עד שהירכיים מקבילות לרצפה או נמוך ככל שהגמישות מאפשרת. | Pause briefly at the bottom of the squat, keeping your chest up and knees tracking over your toes. | בדחיפה דרך העקבים לעלייה מהסקוואט, משוך בו־זמנית את הגומייה לעבר האגן או המותניים, תוך דחיפת המרפק אחורה מאחוריך. | Squeeze your back muscles at the top of the row while fully extending your legs and standing tall. | Slowly return your arm to the extended starting position as you prepare for the next rep. | בצע את כל החזרות בצד אחד, ואז העבר את הגומייה ליד הנגדית וחזור על התרגיל.

nE: Resistance Band Standing 90 degrees Shoulder Extrernal Rotation
nR: Наружная ротация плеча на 90° стоя с лентой
nH: רוטציה חיצונית של הכתף ב-90 מעלות בעמידה עם גומייה
t: Anchor a resistance band at elbow height to a stable post or door frame and stand sideways to the anchor point. | Grasp the band with your working hand and step far enough away to create light tension at the start position. | Raise your upper arm out to the side until it is parallel to the floor (abducted 90 degrees), then bend your elbow to 90 degrees so your forearm points straight down toward the floor. | Brace your core, stand tall, and keep your upper arm fixed and parallel to the floor throughout the movement — this is your setup position. | Rotate your forearm upward in an arc, keeping the elbow at shoulder height, until your forearm is parallel to the floor and pointing straight ahead or slightly above horizontal. | Pause briefly at the top of the rotation, feeling a squeeze in the back of the shoulder. | Slowly lower your forearm back down to the start position over 2–3 seconds, resisting the band the entire way. | Complete all reps on one side before switching to the other arm.
tRu: Закрепите эспандер на высоте локтя за устойчивую стойку или дверную раму и встаньте боком к точке крепления. | Возьмитесь за эспандер рабочей рукой и отойдите достаточно далеко, чтобы создать легкое напряжение в исходном положении. | Raise your upper arm out to the side until it is parallel to the floor (abducted 90 degrees), then bend your elbow to 90 degrees so your forearm points straight down toward the floor. | Напрягите корпус, встаньте прямо и держите верхнюю часть руки зафиксированной и параллельно полу на протяжении всего движения — это ваша исходная позиция. | Rotate your forearm upward in an arc, keeping the elbow at shoulder height, until your forearm is parallel to the floor and pointing straight ahead or slightly above horizontal. | На мгновение остановитесь в верхней точке вращения, ощущая сжатие в задней части плеча. | Slowly lower your forearm back down to the start position over 2–3 seconds, resisting the band the entire way. | Выполните все повторения на одну сторону, затем перейдите на другую руку.
tHe: עגן גומייה בגובה המרפק לעמוד יציב או למשקוף, ועמוד עם הצד לעוגן. | אחוז בגומייה ביד העובדת וצעד מספיק הרחק כדי ליצור מתח קל בעמדת ההתחלה. | Raise your upper arm out to the side until it is parallel to the floor (abducted 90 degrees), then bend your elbow to 90 degrees so your forearm points straight down toward the floor. | תכווץ את שרירי הליבה, עמוד ישר, ושמור על הזרוע העליונה קבועה ומקבילה לרצפה לאורך כל התנועה - זו התנוחה ההכנה שלך. | Rotate your forearm upward in an arc, keeping the elbow at shoulder height, until your forearm is parallel to the floor and pointing straight ahead or slightly above horizontal. | Pause briefly at the top of the rotation, feeling a squeeze in the back of the shoulder. | Slowly lower your forearm back down to the start position over 2–3 seconds, resisting the band the entire way. | בצע את כל החזרות בצד אחד לפני המעבר ליד השנייה.

t: Attach a resistance band to a sturdy anchor point above your head — a pull-up bar, door anchor, or cable machine works well. | Stand facing the anchor, feet shoulder-width apart, and grasp one end of the band in each hand. | Bring your hands up and hold them at the sides of your head or clasp them behind your neck, keeping your elbows wide. | Step back slightly so the band is taut and there is tension even in your upright starting position. | Brace your core firmly, keep your hips still, and maintain a slight bend in your knees. | Exhale and flex your spine, crunching your elbows down toward your thighs while contracting your abs — lead with your abs, not your arms. | Squeeze your rectus abdominis hard at the bottom of the crunch for a brief pause. | Inhale and slowly return to the upright position under control, resisting the band's pull throughout the eccentric phase. | Repeat for the desired number of reps without letting the band jerk you back to the start.
tRu: Закрепите эспандер за надёжную опору над головой — подойдёт турник, дверной фиксатор или блочный тренажёр. | Stand facing the anchor, feet shoulder-width apart, and grasp one end of the band in each hand. | Поднимите руки и держите их по бокам головы или скрестите за шеей, сохраняя локти широко. | Step back slightly so the band is taut and there is tension even in your upright starting position. | Сильно напрягите пресс, удерживайте таз неподвижно и сохраняйте лёгкий сгиб в коленях. | Выдыхайте и сгибайте позвоночник, подтягивая локти к бёдрам и сокращая пресс — ведите прессом, а не руками. | Squeeze your rectus abdominis hard at the bottom of the crunch for a brief pause. | Выдохните и медленно вернитесь в вертикальное исходное положение под контролем, сопротивляясь натяжению эспандера на протяжении эксцентрической фазы. | Repeat for the desired number of reps without letting the band jerk you back to the start.
tHe: חבר גומייה לנקודת עיגון יציבה מעל הראש — מתח, עוגן דלת או מכשיר כבלים יתאימו. | Stand facing the anchor, feet shoulder-width apart, and grasp one end of the band in each hand. | הרם את ידיך והחזק אותן בצדדי הראש או תפוס מאחורי הצוואר, שומר על מרפיים פתוחות. | Step back slightly so the band is taut and there is tension even in your upright starting position. | הדק היטב את הליבה, שמור על אגן יציב ושמור על כיפוף קל בברכיים. | נשוף וכופף את הגב, מושך את המרפקים למטה לעבר הירכיים בזמן שכופפים את הבטן — הובילו עם הבטן, לא עם הזרועות. | Squeeze your rectus abdominis hard at the bottom of the crunch for a brief pause. | Inhale and slowly return to the upright position under control, resisting the band's pull throughout the eccentric phase. | Repeat for the desired number of reps without letting the band jerk you back to the start.

nE: Resistance Band Standing Back Achilles Stretch
nR: Растяжка ахилла стоя спиной с лентой
nH: מתיחת אכילס בעמידה מאחור עם גומייה
t: Stand upright on one leg with a slight bend in the knee, placing your opposite foot slightly behind you with the heel lifted. | Loop a resistance band around the ball and toes of the back foot, holding both ends of the band in your hands. | Keep your back straight and your core lightly engaged for balance. | Gently pull the band upward and toward your shin to draw your toes into dorsiflexion, feeling the stretch through your calf and Achilles tendon. | Hold the stretched position for 20–30 seconds while breathing steadily. | Ease the tension slowly and lower your foot back to the starting position. | Repeat on the opposite leg, completing 2–3 holds per side.
tRu: Stand upright on one leg with a slight bend in the knee, placing your opposite foot slightly behind you with the heel lifted. | Оберните эспандер вокруг стопы и пальцев задней ноги, держа оба конца эспандера в руках. | Держите спину прямой и корпус слегка напряжённым для равновесия. | Аккуратно потяните эспандер вверх и к голени, чтобы отвести пальцы в тыльное направление, чувствуя растяжение в икроножной мышце и ахилловом сухожилии. | Удерживайте растянутое положение 20–30 секунд, дыша ровно. | Постепенно ослабьте напряжение и верните ногу в исходное положение. | Repeat on the opposite leg, completing 2–3 holds per side.
tHe: Stand upright on one leg with a slight bend in the knee, placing your opposite foot slightly behind you with the heel lifted. | Loop a resistance band around the ball and toes of the back foot, holding both ends of the band in your hands. | Keep your back straight and your core lightly engaged for balance. | משוך בעדינות את הגומייה מעלה ולכיוון השוק כדי להביא את האצבעות לכיפוף, ותחוש את המתיחה לאורך השוק וגיד אכילס. | החזק את תנוחת המתיחה 20–30 שניות תוך נשימה סדירה. | רפה באיטיות את המתיחה והורד את רגלך חזרה למצב ההתחלתי. | Repeat on the opposite leg, completing 2–3 holds per side.

t: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hold the resistance band in front of you with both hands slightly wider than shoulder-width, arms extended at hip height. | Engage your core and stand tall with a neutral spine and soft knees. | Slowly raise the band overhead in a wide arc, keeping your arms straight and your grip wide enough that the band stays taut throughout the movement. | Continue the arc until the band passes overhead and comes to rest behind your hips, gently pulling your shoulders back and opening your chest. | Pause in the back position for 1–2 seconds, feeling the stretch across your chest and the front of your hips. | Reverse the movement by bringing the band back overhead and returning to the starting position in front of your hips at the same controlled tempo. | Repeat for the prescribed number of repetitions, moving rhythmically and breathing out as the band passes overhead and in as it returns to the front.
tRu: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hold the resistance band in front of you with both hands slightly wider than shoulder-width, arms extended at hip height. | Напрягите корпус и встаньте прямо с нейтральным позвоночником и мягкими коленями. | Slowly raise the band overhead in a wide arc, keeping your arms straight and your grip wide enough that the band stays taut throughout the movement. | Продолжайте дугу, пока эспандер не пройдет над головой и не окажется за вашими бедрами, мягко отводя плечи назад и открывая грудь. | Пауза в обратной позе на 1–2 секунды, почувствуйте растяжение в груди и передней поверхности бёдер. | Reverse the movement by bringing the band back overhead and returning to the starting position in front of your hips at the same controlled tempo. | Repeat for the prescribed number of repetitions, moving rhythmically and breathing out as the band passes overhead and in as it returns to the front.
tHe: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hold the resistance band in front of you with both hands slightly wider than shoulder-width, arms extended at hip height. | הפעל את שרירי הליבה ועמוד ישר עם עמוד שדרה נייטרלי וברכיים רכות. | Slowly raise the band overhead in a wide arc, keeping your arms straight and your grip wide enough that the band stays taut throughout the movement. | המשך הקשת עד שהגומייה עוברת מעל הראש ונחה מאחורי המותניים, מושך את הכתפיים אחורה ופותח את החזה בעדינות. | Pause in the back position for 1–2 seconds, feeling the stretch across your chest and the front of your hips. | Reverse the movement by bringing the band back overhead and returning to the starting position in front of your hips at the same controlled tempo. | Repeat for the prescribed number of repetitions, moving rhythmically and breathing out as the band passes overhead and in as it returns to the front.

nE: Resistance Band Standing Balance Bent Leg Hip Abduction
nR: Отведения бедра с согнутой ногой в балансе стоя с лентой
nH: הרחקת ירך ברגל כפופה בשיווי משקל בעמידה עם גומייה
t: Loop a resistance band around both ankles or just above both knees, then stand tall with your feet hip-width apart. | Shift your weight onto your left foot, softening the knee slightly so it is not locked out. This is your standing leg for the set. | Lift your right foot just off the floor and find your balance. Brace your core and keep your hips level. | Bend your right knee to roughly 45–90° and hold it there throughout the movement — do not let the leg straighten as you lift. | Drive your right leg out to the side against the band's resistance, leading with your knee and keeping your foot flexed. Stop when your thigh reaches roughly 30–45° from the midline or before your pelvis tilts. | Pause briefly at the top with your hips still level and your torso upright. | Slowly return your right leg back to the starting position under control, resisting the band on the way down. | Complete all reps on the right side, then switch legs and repeat.
tRu: Оберните эспандер вокруг обеих лодыжек или чуть выше обеих колен, затем встаньте прямо, ноги на ширине бедер. | Перенесите вес на левую ногу, слегка смягчив колено, чтобы оно не было выпрямлено полностью. Это опорная нога на весь подход. | Слегка приподнимите правую стопу над полом и поймайте равновесие. Напрягите корпус и удерживайте бёдра на одном уровне. | Согните правое колено примерно до 45–90° и удерживайте его так в течение всего движения — не позволяйте ноге выпрямляться при подъёме. | С силовым движением отведите правую ногу в сторону, сопротивляясь эспандеру, ведя коленом, удерживая стопу согнутой. Остановитесь, когда бедро окажется под углом примерно 30–45° к средней линии или до наклона таза. | Кратко задержитесь вверху, удерживая бёдра на одном уровне, а корпус вертикально. | Slowly return your right leg back to the starting position under control, resisting the band on the way down. | Выполните все повторения на правую сторону, затем поменяйте ноги и повторите.
tHe: Loop a resistance band around both ankles or just above both knees, then stand tall with your feet hip-width apart. | העבר את המשקל לרגל שמאל, רכך מעט את הברך כך שלא תינעל. זו רגל העמידה שלך לסט. | הרם את רגל ימין מעט מעל הרצפה ומצא את שיווי המשקל. הדק את הליבה ושמור על אגן מאוזן. | כופף את ברך ימין לערך ל-45–90° והחזק אותה שם לאורך כל התנועה — אל תתן לרגל להתיישר בהרמה. | הנע את שוק וכף רגל ימיך אל הצד וקדימה בקשת אופקית, חותך דרך אזור המטרה עם השוק או גב כף הרגל. | עצור קצרות למעלה כשהאגן עדיין מאוזן והגוף זקוף. | Slowly return your right leg back to the starting position under control, resisting the band on the way down. | בצע את כל החזרות בצד ימין, ואז החלף רגליים וחזור על התרגיל.

nE: Resistance Band Standing Balance Glute Kickback
nR: Ягодичный кикбэк в балансе стоя с лентой
nH: בעיטת עכוז לאחור בשיווי משקל בעמידה עם גומייה
t: Anchor the resistance band to a low, fixed point at ankle height in front of you and loop or attach the free end around the ankle of your working leg. | Step back until there is light tension in the band, then shift your weight onto your standing leg with a soft bend in the knee. | Hinge forward slightly at the hips and place your hands on a wall or sturdy surface for light balance support if needed. | Brace your core and keep your hips level — do not rotate or tilt them to one side. | Drive your working leg straight back in a controlled arc, squeezing the glute at the top of the movement. | Pause for one count at full extension with your heel raised and your glute fully contracted, keeping your back flat and your hips square. | Slowly return your foot back toward the starting position under control, resisting the pull of the band on the way in. | Complete all reps on one side, then switch legs and repeat.
tRu: Закрепите эспандер в низкой фиксированной точке на высоте лодыжек перед собой и накиньте или прикрепите свободный конец вокруг лодыжки рабочей ноги. | Step back until there is light tension in the band, then shift your weight onto your standing leg with a soft bend in the knee. | Слегка наклоняйтесь вперёд, отводя бёдра назад, и поставьте руки на стену или прочную поверхность для лёгкой поддержки равновесия, если необходимо. | Напрягите корпус и удерживайте бёдра на одном уровне — не разворачивайте и не наклоняйте их в сторону. | С силовым движением отведите рабочую ногу прямо назад по контролируемой дуге, сжимая ягодицы в верхней точке. | Задержитесь на один счёт в полном разгибании с поднятым пяткой и полностью сокращённой ягодицей, сохраняя спину прямой и бёдрами параллельно. | Slowly return your foot back toward the starting position under control, resisting the pull of the band on the way in. | Выполните все повторения на одну сторону, затем поменяйте ноги и повторите.
tHe: עגן את הגומייה לנקודה נמוכה וקבועה בגובה הקרסול מלפניך ולפף או חבר את הקצה החופשי סביב קרסול הרגל העובדת. | Step back until there is light tension in the band, then shift your weight onto your standing leg with a soft bend in the knee. | כופף קדימה מעט בציר הירכיים והנח את הידיים על קיר או משטח יציב לתמיכת איזון קלה במידת הצורך. | הדק את הליבה ושמור על אגן מאוזן — אל תסובב או תטה אותו לצד. | הושב את הרגל הפעילה ישר אחורה בקשת מבוקרת, מכווץ את השריר הגלוטאי בשיא התנועה. | Pause for one count at full extension with your heel raised and your glute fully contracted, keeping your back flat and your hips square. | Slowly return your foot back toward the starting position under control, resisting the pull of the band on the way in. | בצע את כל החזרות בצד אחד, ואז החלף רגליים וחזור על התרגיל.

nE: Resistance Band Standing Balance Glute Kickback (VERSION 2)
nR: Ягодичный кикбэк в балансе стоя с лентой (вариант 2)
nH: בעיטת עכוז לאחור בשיווי משקל בעמידה עם גומייה (גרסה 2)
t: Anchor the resistance band low to a sturdy fixed point at ankle height and loop or clip the other end around your right ankle. | Step far enough away from the anchor point to create light tension in the band when you stand upright. | Shift your weight onto your left foot and find your balance, softening the knee of your standing leg slightly. | Place your hands on a wall or sturdy surface for support if needed, keeping your torso upright and your core braced. | Hinge very slightly at the hips to keep your back flat, then drive your right leg straight back and behind you by squeezing the glute. | Continue the kickback until your right leg forms roughly a 30–45 degree angle behind your body, without arching your lower back. | Pause for one count at the top, feeling the contraction in your right glute. | Return your right leg slowly and under control to the starting position. | Complete all reps on the right side before switching the band to the left ankle and repeating.

t: Anchor a resistance band to a sturdy low point behind you at roughly ankle height — a rack upright, a closed doorframe, or a heavy table leg. | Loop the free end around the ankle of your working leg, then step forward until the band is taut with no slack. | Stand tall on the opposite leg with your feet under your hips, brace your core, and keep a soft bend in the standing knee. | Hold a wall, doorframe, or sturdy chair with one hand for balance so the quadriceps, not your stability, limit the set. | Lift the working thigh until it sits roughly 45° in front of you and let the knee hang bent near 90°, feeling the band pull your heel back. | Exhale and extend the knee smoothly until the leg is almost straight, stopping just short of lockout and keeping the thigh in the same position throughout. | Squeeze the quadriceps for a beat at the top, then lower over 2–3 seconds while resisting the band's pull back to the start. | Complete all reps on that side, then unhook the band, switch legs, and repeat.
tRu: Закрепите эспандер к прочной низкой точке позади вас примерно на высоте лодыжек — стойке рамы, закрытому дверному проёму или ножке тяжёлого стола. | Оберните свободный конец вокруг лодыжки рабочей ноги, затем сделайте шаг вперед, пока эспандер не станет натянутым без провисания. | Stand tall on the opposite leg with your feet under your hips, brace your core, and keep a soft bend in the standing knee. | Держитесь за стену, перила или дверной косяк одной или обеими руками, чтобы сохранять равновесие на протяжении всего растяжения. | Поднимите рабочее бедро, пока оно не окажется примерно под углом 45° перед вами, и согните колено под углом около 90°, чувствуя, как эспандер тянет вашу пятку назад. | Выдохните и плавно разогните колено, пока нога почти не выпрямится, останавливаясь чуть раньше полного разгибания, сохраняя бедро в том же положении на протяжении всего движения. | Squeeze the quadriceps for a beat at the top, then lower over 2–3 seconds while resisting the band's pull back to the start. | Выполните все повторения на этой стороне, затем отсоедините эспандер, поменяйте ноги и повторите.
tHe: עגן גומייה לנקודה נמוכה ויציבה מאחוריך בערך בגובה הקרסול – עמוד מתקן, משקוף של דלת סגורה או רגל של שולחן כבד. | Loop the free end around the ankle of your working leg, then step forward until the band is taut with no slack. | Stand tall on the opposite leg with your feet under your hips, brace your core, and keep a soft bend in the standing knee. | החזק קיר, מסגרת דלת או כיסא יציב ביד אחת לאיזון כך שארבעה ראשי הפשיטה, ולא היציבות שלך, יגבילו את הסט. | Lift the working thigh until it sits roughly 45° in front of you and let the knee hang bent near 90°, feeling the band pull your heel back. | נשוף והארך את הברך בצורה חלקה עד שהרגל כמעט ישרה, עוצר רק לפני נעילה ושומר על הירך באותו מקום לאורך כל התנועה. | Squeeze the quadriceps for a beat at the top, then lower over 2–3 seconds while resisting the band's pull back to the start. | בצע את כל החזרות בצד אחד, ואז שחרר את הגומייה, החלף רגליים וחזור על התרגיל.

t: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart and toes pointing out at roughly 45 degrees, with the resistance band looped under both feet. | Hold the other end of the band with both hands at chest height, or grip it at your sides — whichever keeps the band taut at the start position. | Brace your core, keep your chest tall, and pull your shoulders back and down. | Push your hips back and bend your knees, lowering your body until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor, keeping your knees tracking in line with your toes. | Ensure your heels stay flat on the floor and your chest remains upright throughout the descent. | Pause briefly at the bottom, then drive through your heels and squeeze your glutes to push the floor away and return to standing. | Fully extend your hips at the top and briefly contract your glutes before beginning the next rep.
tRu: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart and toes pointing out at roughly 45 degrees, with the resistance band looped under both feet. | Задержите другой конец эспандера обеими руками на уровне груди или возьмитесь за него с боков — whichever keeps the band taut at the start position. | Напрягите корпус, держите грудь расправленной, отведите плечи назад и опустите вниз. | Push your hips back and bend your knees, lowering your body until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor, keeping your knees tracking in line with your toes. | Убедитесь, что пятки остаются прижатыми к полу, а грудь остается прямой на протяжении всего опускания. | На мгновение остановитесь в нижней точке, затем упритесь пяткой и сожмите ягодицы, чтобы оттолкнуть пол и вернуться в положение стоя. | В верхней точке полностью выпрямите таз и кратко сожмите ягодицы перед началом следующего повторения.

t: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. t: Anchor the resistance band to a low, fixed point at or near floor level. | Stand facing the anchor point with feet hip-width apart and hold the free end of the band with both hands or loop it around your foot on the working leg. | Shift your weight onto the standing leg and maintain a soft bend in that knee. | Hinge slightly at the hips to keep your torso stable and your lower back neutral. | Drive the working leg back and down, reaching your toes toward the floor behind you while squeezing the glutes. | Control the movement — do not swing or let momentum do the work. | Pause briefly at the end range, then return the leg to the starting position in a slow, controlled manner. | Complete all reps on one side before switching to the other leg.

t: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and loop a resistance band around both feet, just below the ankles, so there is light tension when your feet are parallel. | Rise onto the balls of both feet, lifting your heels as high as possible and keeping your core braced and your posture tall. | Take a small step forward with your right foot, landing on the ball of the foot and keeping your heel elevated. | Follow immediately with your left foot, matching the same toe-raised position, so both heels remain off the floor throughout. | Continue walking forward in steady, controlled steps, maintaining full heel elevation and resisting the band's pull to keep your feet from splaying outward. | Walk for the prescribed distance or number of steps, then carefully lower your heels to the floor and turn around to repeat if needed. | At the end of the set, lower both heels to the floor with control before removing the band.

t: Anchor the resistance band at a fixed point above your head, such as over a door, pull-up bar, or power rack. | Stand facing the anchor point and grasp both ends of the band (or the handles) with an overhand grip, hands roughly shoulder-width apart. | Step back slightly to create tension in the band and position your feet hip-width apart for a stable base. | Tuck your elbows firmly against your sides at roughly a 90° bend in your elbows — keep them there throughout the set. | Brace your core and maintain a slight forward lean at the hips so your torso stays neutral. | Exhale and press both hands straight down toward your thighs until your arms are fully extended, squeezing your triceps at the bottom. | Pause for one count at full extension to maximize triceps contraction. | Inhale and slowly allow the band to pull your hands back up to the starting position, resisting the return under control. | Repeat for the target number of reps.

nE: Resistance Band Upper Body Dead Bug
nR: Мёртвый жук на верх тела с лентой
nH: דד באג פלג עליון עם גומייה
t: Anchor a resistance band to a sturdy low point in front of you, or hold the center of the band with both hands and loop it around a fixed object behind your head. | Lie on your back with the band held taut at chest height, arms extended toward the ceiling and perpendicular to the floor. | Bend your hips and knees to 90°, shins parallel to the floor, so you are in the tabletop position. | Brace your core firmly, pressing your lower back flat against the floor and exhaling to set your ribcage down. | Keeping your arms fully extended and maintaining tension on the band, slowly lower both arms overhead toward the floor while simultaneously extending one leg out straight, hovering it a few inches above the ground. | Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, keeping your lower back in contact with the floor throughout. | Reverse the movement under control, returning your arms to the starting position and your leg back to the tabletop position as you inhale. | Repeat on the opposite leg, alternating sides for the desired number of reps.
tRu: Закрепите эспандер к прочной низкой точке перед собой или удерживайте середину эспандера обеими руками, накинув его вокруг фиксированного объекта позади головы. | Лягте на спину, удерживая эспандер напряжённо на уровне груди, вытяните руки к потолку перпендикулярно полу. | Согните бёдра и колени до 90°, удерживая голени параллельно полу, принимая положение «столешницы». | Сильно напрягите пресс, прижав поясницу плотно к полу и выдохнув, чтобы опустить грудную клетку. | Держа руки полностью выпрямленными и поддерживая напряжение в эспандере, медленно опустите обе руки над головой к полу, одновременно выпрямляя одну ногу вперед, поднимая ее на несколько сантиметров над землей. | Задержитесь на мгновение в нижней точке движения, сохраняя поясницу прижатой к полу на протяжении всего времени. | Reverse the movement under control, returning your arms to the starting position and your leg back to the tabletop position as you inhale. | Repeat on the opposite leg, alternating sides for the desired number of reps.
tHe: עגן גומייה לנקודה נמוכה ויציבה מלפניך, או אחוז במרכז הגומייה בשתי הידיים ולפף אותה סביב חפץ קבוע מאחורי הראש. | Lie on your back with the band held taut at chest height, arms extended toward the ceiling and perpendicular to the floor. | כופף את האגן והברכיים ל-90°, שוקיים מקבילות לרצפה, כך שתהיה בתנוחת השולחן. | הדק היטב את הליבה, תוך לחיצת הגב התחתון שטוח לרצפה ונשיפה כדי להוריד את בית החזה. | Keeping your arms fully extended and maintaining tension on the band, slowly lower both arms overhead toward the floor while simultaneously extending one leg out straight, hovering it a few inches above the ground. | Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, keeping your lower back in contact with the floor throughout. | Reverse the movement under control, returning your arms to the starting position and your leg back to the tabletop position as you inhale. | Repeat on the opposite leg, alternating sides for the desired number of reps.

nE: Resistance Band Upper Body Lying Air Bike

nE: Resistance Band Weighted Standing Pronation Twist Curl (Arm Wrestler)
nR: Сгибания с пронацией стоя с отягощением с лентой (армрестлер)
nH: כפיפות פרונציה בפיתול בעמידה עם משקל עם גומייה (הורדת ידיים)
t: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and secure the resistance band under your foot or to a low anchor point, holding the free end together with a weight (dumbbell or plate) in one hand. | Begin with your arm extended downward, palm facing inward (neutral grip) with the band and weight in hand. | Brace your core, pin your elbow to your side, and keep your upper arm stationary throughout the movement. | Curl the weight upward toward your shoulder while simultaneously rotating your forearm so your palm faces down (pronation) at the top of the curl. | Pause briefly at the top, feeling the contraction in your forearm and brachioradialis. | Slowly lower the weight back down, reversing the rotation so your palm returns to the neutral starting position. | Complete all reps on one side before switching to the other arm.

nE: Resistance Band Wide Stance Anti Rotation Chop
nR: Рубка против ротации в широкой стойке с лентой
nH: קיצוץ נגד רוטציה בעמידה רחבה עם גומייה
t: Anchor the resistance band to a fixed point at head height or above on your right side, and stand far enough away that the band is taut at the start position. | Take a wide stance — roughly 1.5 to 2 times shoulder-width — with your feet flat, toes pointing forward or slightly out, and your body turned so the anchor point is to one side. | Grip the band with both hands together, arms extended toward the anchor, and position your hands near your top shoulder. | Brace your core firmly, set your hips level, and keep your chest tall and your spine neutral — this is your starting position. | In one controlled motion, pull the band diagonally downward and across your body, moving from high on the anchor side to low on the opposite side, finishing with your hands near your opposite hip. | Keep your feet planted and your hips square throughout — resist any urge to twist or rotate the trunk, letting the shoulders and arms do the work while the core stabilizes. | Pause briefly at the end of the chop to reinforce the stable position, then return the band slowly back to the start under full control. | Complete all reps on one side before switching the anchor to the opposite side and repeating.
tRu: Закрепите эспандер в фиксированной точке на высоте головы или выше справа от вас и встаньте достаточно далеко, чтобы в стартовом положении было натяжение. | Take a wide stance — roughly 1.5 to 2 times shoulder-width — with your feet flat, toes pointing forward or slightly out, and your body turned so the anchor point is to one side. | Возьмите эспандер обеими руками вместе, руки направлены к точке крепления, и расположите руки у верхнего плеча. | Сильно напрягите пресс, выровняйте таз, держите грудь поднятой, а позвоночник нейтральным — это исходное положение. | В одном контролируемом движении потяните эспандер по диагонали вниз и через тело, перемещаясь с высокой точки крепления к низкой точке на противоположной стороне, завершая движение руками у противоположного бедра. | Держите ноги на месте и колени примерно на ширине таза как исходное положение. | На мгновение остановитесь в конце движения, чтобы зафиксировать устойчивое положение, затем медленно верните эспандер в исходное положение под полным контролем. | Выполните все повторения на одной стороне перед тем, как перенести якорь на противоположную сторону и повторить.

nR: Обратные скручивания с переходом в мёртвого жука

t: Lie on your back with your hips and knees bent to roughly 90 degrees, shins parallel to the floor, and arms resting flat at your sides. | Press your lower back firmly into the floor and brace your core before every rep. | Exhale and curl your pelvis toward your ribcage, lifting your hips one to three inches off the floor — this is the reverse crunch phase. | Hold the top position for one count, keeping the movement controlled and driven by your abs rather than a leg swing. | Inhale and lower your hips back to the floor, returning to the 90/90 starting position without letting your lower back arch away. | Without resting, extend your right arm overhead toward the floor and simultaneously straighten your left leg, lowering it toward the floor — this is the dead bug phase. | Stop both limbs a few inches above the floor, keeping your lower back pressed down and your core fully braced. | Exhale as you draw the arm and leg back to the 90/90 position. | Repeat the full sequence — reverse crunch, then dead bug with the opposite arm and leg — alternating sides each rep.
tRu: Лягте на спину с бёдрами и коленями, согнутыми под углом примерно 90 градусов, голенями параллельными полу, и руками, лежащими вдоль тела. | Press your lower back firmly into the floor and brace your core before every rep. | Выдохните и поднимите таз к ребрам, поднимая таз на один-три дюйма от пола — это фаза обратного скручивания. | Задержитесь в верхней позиции на один счёт, сохраняя движение под контролем и за счёт мышц живота, а не раскачивания ногами. | Выдохните и опустите таз обратно на пол, возвращаясь в исходное положение 90/90, не давая пояснице прогибаться. | Without resting, extend your right arm overhead toward the floor and simultaneously straighten your left leg, lowering it toward the floor — this is the dead bug phase. | Stop both limbs a few inches above the floor, keeping your lower back pressed down and your core fully braced. | Выдыхайте, когда возвращаете руку и ногу в положение 90/90. | Repeat the full sequence — reverse crunch, then dead bug with the opposite arm and leg — alternating sides each rep.

t: Lie on your back on the floor or a mat with your arms flat at your sides, palms pressing down for stability. | Extend both legs straight and hold them at roughly a 45-degree angle to the floor, or parallel to the floor if you have sufficient core strength. | Brace your core by drawing your navel toward your spine and pressing your lower back firmly into the mat. | Keeping your legs extended, contract your abs and hip flexors to begin curling your pelvis upward off the mat. | Continue the curl, allowing your knees to draw toward your chest as your hips peel off the floor — drive the movement from your abs rather than from momentum. | Pause briefly at the top when your hips are fully curled and your knees are close to your face. | Lower your hips back to the mat slowly and under control, resisting the pull of gravity throughout the descent. | Return your legs to the starting angle without letting them drop to the floor, and move directly into the next rep.
