t: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, arms relaxed at your sides or hands on your hips for balance. | Brace your core, keep your chest up, and shift your weight onto your left foot. | Step your right foot directly back, lowering your body until your right knee hovers just above the floor and your left thigh is roughly parallel to the ground — this is the bottom of the lunge. | Pause briefly at the bottom to ensure your front knee tracks over your second toe and does not cave inward. | Drive through your left heel to stand back up, swinging your right leg forward as you rise. | As your right leg swings forward, extend it into a controlled front kick at hip height, straightening the knee with your quadriceps at the top of the kick. | Hold the kick position for one count, then lower your right foot back to the starting position with control. | Complete all reps on the right leg, then switch sides, or alternate legs each rep depending on your goal.
tRu: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, arms relaxed at your sides or hands on your hips for balance. | Напрягите корпус, держите грудь вверх и перенесите вес на левую ногу. | Step your right foot directly back, lowering your body until your right knee hovers just above the floor and your left thigh is roughly parallel to the ground — this is the bottom of the lunge. | Пауза на мгновение в нижней точке, чтобы убедиться, что ваше переднее колено отслеживается над вторым пальцем стопы и не заваливается внутрь. | Отталкивайтесь левой пяткой, чтобы вернуться в исходное положение, поднимая правую ногу вперед при подъеме. | Когда правая нога идёт вперёд, выпрямите её в контролируемый передний удар до высоты бедра, разогнув колено квадрицепсом в верхней точке. | Подержите положение вытянутой ноги в течение счета, затем плавно опустите правую ногу в исходное положение. | Выполните все повторения на правой ноге, затем поменяйте стороны, либо поочерёдно меняйте ноги с каждым повторением в зависимости от вашей цели.
tHe: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, arms relaxed at your sides or hands on your hips for balance. | הדק את הליבה, שמור על חזה מורם והעבר את המשקל לרגל שמאל. | Step your right foot directly back, lowering your body until your right knee hovers just above the floor and your left thigh is roughly parallel to the ground — this is the bottom of the lunge. | Pause briefly at the bottom to ensure your front knee tracks over your second toe and does not cave inward. | דחוף דרך עקב שמאל כדי לעמוד בחזרה, מניע את הרגל הימנית קדימה בזמן שקמת. | בהנפת רגל ימין קדימה, יישר אותה לבעיטת חזית מבוקרת בגובה האגן, תוך יישור הברך עם הארבע־ראשי בשיא הבעיטה. | Hold the kick position for one count, then lower your right foot back to the starting position with control. | בצע את כל החזרות עם הרגל הימינה, ואז החלף צדדים, או החלף בין הרגליים בכל חזרה לפי המטרה שלך.

t: Sit on the floor with your legs extended straight in front of you and your feet together. | Place your hands on the floor behind your hips, roughly shoulder-width apart, with fingers pointing toward your feet or angled slightly outward. | Press through your palms and engage your core, then drive your heels into the floor to lift your hips up off the ground. | Continue pressing until your body forms a straight line from your heels to your shoulders — squeeze your glutes to hold the position. | Keep your head in a neutral position, looking slightly upward, without letting it drop back excessively. | Hold the position for the desired duration while breathing steadily, maintaining a flat body line throughout. | To finish, lower your hips back to the floor with control.
tRu: Сядьте на пол, выпрямив ноги перед собой и соединив стопы. | Положите руки на пол за бёдрами, примерно на ширине плеч, пальцами к стопам или под небольшим углом наружу. | Press through your palms and engage your core, then drive your heels into the floor to lift your hips up off the ground. | Продолжайте жим, пока ваше тело не образует прямую линию от пяток до плеч — сожмите ягодицы, чтобы удержать положение. | Держите голову в нейтральном положении, взгляд направлен немного вверх, без чрезмерного запрокидывания назад. | Держите положение в течение желаемой продолжительности, дыша ровно и сохраняя ровную линию тела. | Чтобы завершить, подконтрольно опустите бёдра обратно на пол.
tHe: שב על הרצפה עם רגליים ישרות לפנים וכפות הרגליים צמודות. | Place your hands on the floor behind your hips, roughly shoulder-width apart, with fingers pointing toward your feet or angled slightly outward. | Press through your palms and engage your core, then drive your heels into the floor to lift your hips up off the ground. | המשיכו ללחוץ עד שהגוף יוצר קו ישר מהעקבים לכתפיים — לחצו בשרירי הירך הגדולים כדי להחזיק בתנוחה. | Keep your head in a neutral position, looking slightly upward, without letting it drop back excessively. | Hold the position for the desired duration while breathing steadily, maintaining a flat body line throughout. | לסיום, הורד את האגן חזרה לרצפה בשליטה.

t: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you and place your elbows directly beneath your shoulders, forearms flat on the ground. | Point your toes toward the ceiling and press your heels firmly into the floor. | Brace your core and squeeze your glutes, then drive your hips upward until your body forms a straight diagonal line from head to heel. | Keep your chin slightly tucked so your head is neutral — neither drooping toward your chest nor tilting back. | Hold the raised position, maintaining even pressure through both elbows and both heels. | Breathe steadily throughout the hold; avoid holding your breath. | To finish, lower your hips back to the floor in a controlled manner and rest before repeating.
tRu: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you and place your elbows directly beneath your shoulders, forearms flat on the ground. | Point your toes toward the ceiling and press your heels firmly into the floor. | Напрягите корпус и сожмите ягодицы, затем поднимите бёдра вверх, пока тело не образует прямую диагональную линию от головы до пятки. | Держите подбородок слегка прижатым, чтобы голова была нейтральной — ни не запрокидывалась назад. | Держите поднятую положение, сохраняя равномерное давление через оба локтя и обе пятки. | Дышите ровно на протяжении всего удержания; избегайте задержки дыхания. | To finish, lower your hips back to the floor in a controlled manner and rest before repeating.
tHe: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you and place your elbows directly beneath your shoulders, forearms flat on the ground. | Point your toes toward the ceiling and press your heels firmly into the floor. | הדק את הליבה וכווץ את הישבנים, ואז דחוף את האגן למעלה עד שהגוף יוצר קו אלכסוני ישר מהראש עד העקב. | Keep your chin slightly tucked so your head is neutral — neither drooping toward your chest nor tilting back. | Hold the raised position, maintaining even pressure through both elbows and both heels. | נשום בצורה יציבה לכל אורך ההחזקה; מנע מלחזוק את הנשימה. | To finish, lower your hips back to the floor in a controlled manner and rest before repeating.

t: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you and your heels pressed into the ground. | Place your hands flat on the floor just behind your hips, fingers pointing forward or slightly outward. | Press through your palms and heels to lift your hips off the floor, squeezing your glutes and driving your hips upward. | Continue raising your hips until your body forms a straight line from heels to shoulders — avoid letting your hips pike up too high or sag toward the floor. | Pull your shoulder blades together and down to keep your chest open and your shoulders stable. | Hold your head in a neutral position — either looking straight up toward the ceiling or keeping your chin slightly tucked. | Breathe steadily throughout the hold, keeping your glutes, hamstrings, and core actively engaged. | To finish, lower your hips gently back to the floor in a controlled manner.
tRu: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you and your heels pressed into the ground. | Положите ладони плашмя на пол немного за бёдрами, пальцами вперёд или немного наружу. | Press through your palms and heels to lift your hips off the floor, squeezing your glutes and driving your hips upward. | Продолжайте поднимать бёдра, пока ваше тело не образует прямую линию от пяток до плеч — не позволяйте бёдрам подниматься слишком высоко или провисать к полу. | Pull your shoulder blades together and down to keep your chest open and your shoulders stable. | Удерживайте голову в нейтральном положении — либо смотрите прямо на потолок, либо слегка прижмите подбородок. | Дышите ровно на протяжении всего удержания, сохраняя активное вовлечение ягодиц, подколенных сухожилий и кора. | To finish, lower your hips gently back to the floor in a controlled manner.
tHe: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you and your heels pressed into the ground. | Place your hands flat on the floor just behind your hips, fingers pointing forward or slightly outward. | Press through your palms and heels to lift your hips off the floor, squeezing your glutes and driving your hips upward. | המשך להרים את הירכיים עד שהגוך יוצר קו ישר מהעקבים לכתפיים — מנע מהירכיים לעלות גבוה מדי או ליפול לכיוון הרצפה. | Pull your shoulder blades together and down to keep your chest open and your shoulders stable. | Hold your head in a neutral position — either looking straight up toward the ceiling or keeping your chin slightly tucked. | נשום בצורה יציבה לכל אורך ההחזקה, שמור על השרירים הגלוטאליים, הירך האחורית ושרירי הליבה פעילים. | To finish, lower your hips gently back to the floor in a controlled manner.

t: Start in a standard push-up position with your hands flat on the floor, shoulder-width apart and directly under your shoulders. | Rotate both hands so your fingers point toward your feet and your palms remain in full contact with the floor — this is the reverse hand position that defines the exercise. | Brace your core, squeeze your glutes, and keep your body in a straight line from your head to your heels. | Inhale and bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the floor, keeping your elbows tracking close to your sides rather than flaring out. | Lower under control until your chest is a few centimeters from the floor or until you reach the end of your comfortable range of motion. | Exhale and press firmly through your palms to extend your elbows and return to the starting position. | Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, maintaining a rigid torso throughout every rep.
tRu: Start in a standard push-up position with your hands flat on the floor, shoulder-width apart and directly under your shoulders. | Rotate both hands so your fingers point toward your feet and your palms remain in full contact with the floor — this is the reverse hand position that defines the exercise. | Напрягите корпус, сожмите ягодицы и держите тело в прямой линии от головы до пяток. | Вдохните и согните локти, опуская грудь к полу, сохраняя локти близко к бокам, а не разведенными в стороны. | Под контролем опуститесь, пока ваша грудь не окажется в нескольких сантиметрах от пола или пока вы не достигнете предела комфортной амплитуды движения. | Выдыхайте и сильно надавливайте ладонями, чтобы разогнуть локти и вернуться в исходное положение. | Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, maintaining a rigid torso throughout every rep.
tHe: Start in a standard push-up position with your hands flat on the floor, shoulder-width apart and directly under your shoulders. | Rotate both hands so your fingers point toward your feet and your palms remain in full contact with the floor — this is the reverse hand position that defines the exercise. | הקשישו את שרירי הליבה, כווצו את הישבן, ושמרו על גופכם בקו ישר מראשכם לעקביכם. | Inhale and bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the floor, keeping your elbows tracking close to your sides rather than flaring out. | Lower under control until your chest is a few centimeters from the floor or until you reach the end of your comfortable range of motion. | שחרר אוויר ולחוץ בחוזקה דרך כף היד כדי להאריך את המרפקים ולחזור למיקום ההתחלתי. | Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, maintaining a rigid torso throughout every rep.

t: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, chest lifted, and chin slightly tucked. | Bring both arms behind your back and interlace your fingers, or clasp one wrist with the opposite hand if interlacing is uncomfortable. | Straighten your arms as fully as possible and squeeze your shoulder blades together, opening your chest forward. | Without hunching your upper back, slowly lift your clasped hands upward and away from your glutes until you feel a stretch across the front of your shoulders and chest. | Keep your elbows as straight as you can and your palms pressed together or facing inward throughout the hold. | Hold the end position for 20–30 seconds, breathing steadily and deepening the stretch slightly on each exhale. | Lower your arms, release your hands, and gently roll your shoulders forward to decompress before repeating.
tRu: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, chest lifted, and chin slightly tucked. | Разведите обе руки за спиной и переплетите пальцы, или сожмите запястье противоположной рукой, если переплетение неудобно. | Straighten your arms as fully as possible and squeeze your shoulder blades together, opening your chest forward. | Without hunching your upper back, slowly lift your clasped hands upward and away from your glutes until you feel a stretch across the front of your shoulders and chest. | Держите локоть максимально выпрямленным и ладони прижатыми друг к другу или направлены внутрь на протяжении всего удержания. | Задержите конечное положение на 20–30 секунд, дышите ровно и немного углубляйте растяжку с каждым выдохом. | Опустите руки, разожмите кисти и аккуратно вращайте плечами вперёд, чтобы снять напряжение перед повторением.
tHe: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, chest lifted, and chin slightly tucked. | הבא את שתי הידיים מאחורי הגב וקשור אצבעותים, או תפס פרק יד אחד עם היד הנגדית אם קישור האצבעות לא נוח. | Straighten your arms as fully as possible and squeeze your shoulder blades together, opening your chest forward. | Without hunching your upper back, slowly lift your clasped hands upward and away from your glutes until you feel a stretch across the front of your shoulders and chest. | Keep your elbows as straight as you can and your palms pressed together or facing inward throughout the hold. | Hold the end position for 20–30 seconds, breathing steadily and deepening the stretch slightly on each exhale. | Lower your arms, release your hands, and gently roll your shoulders forward to decompress before repeating.

nE: Reverse Sliding Leg Curl on Floor with Towel
nR: Обратные сгибания ног со скольжением на полу с полотенцем
nH: כפיפות רגליים הפוכות בהחלקה על הרצפה עם מגבת
t: Place a folded towel on a smooth, low-friction floor surface and lie flat on your back with your arms at your sides for stability. | Bend your knees to roughly 90 degrees and position both heels on the center of the towel, hip-width apart. | Press through your heels and brace your core to lift your hips off the floor, forming a straight line from shoulders to knees. | Keeping your hips elevated, slowly slide both heels outward along the floor, allowing your legs to extend and your hips to lower in a controlled descent. | Stop the slide when your legs are nearly fully extended and your hips are just above or lightly touching the floor. | Dig your heels into the towel and contract your hamstrings to curl both heels back toward your glutes, simultaneously driving your hips back up. | Return to the starting bridge position with hips fully elevated and knees at 90 degrees. | Pause briefly at the top, squeeze your glutes and hamstrings, then begin the next repetition. | Complete all reps in a controlled manner, maintaining tension throughout the movement rather than using momentum.
tRu: Положите сложенное полотенце на гладкую, низкотренированную поверхность пола и лягте ровно на спину с руками вдоль тела для устойчивости. | Согните ноги примерно до 90 градусов и поставьте обе пятки в центр полотенца на ширине бёдер. | Press through your heels and brace your core to lift your hips off the floor, forming a straight line from shoulders to knees. | Держа бёдра приподнятыми, медленно отводите обе пятки в стороны по полу, позволяя ногам выпрямиться, а бёдрам опуститься в контролируемом движении. | Stop the slide when your legs are nearly fully extended and your hips are just above or lightly touching the floor. | Упритесь пятками в полотенце и напрягите бицепсы бедер, чтобы подтянуть обе пятки к ягодицам, одновременно поднимая бёдра вверх. | Return to the starting bridge position with hips fully elevated and knees at 90 degrees. | Задержитесь на мгновение в верхней точке, сожмите ягодицы и бицепс бедра, затем начните следующее повторение. | Выполните все повторения в контролируемом темпе, сохраняя напряжение на протяжении всего движения, а не используя инерцию.
tHe: Place a folded towel on a smooth, low-friction floor surface and lie flat on your back with your arms at your sides for stability. | כופף את הברכיים לערך ל-90 מעלות ומקם את שני העקבים במרכז המגבת, ברוחב האגן. | Press through your heels and brace your core to lift your hips off the floor, forming a straight line from shoulders to knees. | Keeping your hips elevated, slowly slide both heels outward along the floor, allowing your legs to extend and your hips to lower in a controlled descent. | Stop the slide when your legs are nearly fully extended and your hips are just above or lightly touching the floor. | חדור את העקבים למגבת וכווץ את שרירי האזור האחורי כדי לגלגל את שני העקבים בחזרה לכיוון הגלוטיאל, בו זמנית דוחף את הירכיים חזרה למעלה. | Return to the starting bridge position with hips fully elevated and knees at 90 degrees. | Pause briefly at the top, squeeze your glutes and hamstrings, then begin the next repetition. | בצע את כל החזרות בצורה מבוקרת, שומר על מתח לאורך כל התנועה במקום להשתמש בתנופה.

t: Stand with your feet wide apart, roughly 3–4 feet, turning your right foot out 90 degrees and your left foot in about 15 degrees. | Bend your right knee until your thigh is approximately parallel to the floor, stacking the knee directly over the ankle. | Extend both arms out to the sides at shoulder height, parallel to the floor. | Inhale and flip your right palm to face upward, then sweep your right arm up and overhead toward the back of the room. | Lower your left hand to rest lightly on the back of your left leg — shin or thigh — without pushing into it for support. | Gently lean your torso back and to the left, creating a long arc through the right side of your body from hip to fingertips. | Keep your right knee bent and pointing toward your right pinky toe throughout the pose. | Hold for 3–5 breaths, feeling the stretch along the right side body and hip flexors. | Inhale to rise back to center, then repeat on the opposite side.
tRu: Stand with your feet wide apart, roughly 3–4 feet, turning your right foot out 90 degrees and your left foot in about 15 degrees. | Согните правое колено, пока бедро не станет примерно параллельно полу, удерживая колено строго над лодыжкой. | Вытяните обе руки в стороны на уровне плеч, параллельно полу. | Вдохните и поверните правую ладонь вверх, затем поднимите правую руку над головой к задней части зала. | Опустите левую руку так, чтобы она лёгкой касалась задней поверхности вашей левой ноги — икры или бедра — не опираясь на неё для поддержки. | Плавно наклоните корпус назад и влево, создавая длинную дугу по правой стороне тела от бедра до кончиков пальцев. | Держите правое колено согнутым и направленным к правому мизинцу на протяжении всей позы. | Удерживайте 3–5 дыханий, ощущая растяжку по правому боку тела и в сгибателях бедра. | Сделайте вдох, чтобы вернуться в центр, затем повторите на противоположной стороне.
tHe: Stand with your feet wide apart, roughly 3–4 feet, turning your right foot out 90 degrees and your left foot in about 15 degrees. | כופף את ברך ימין עד שהירך כמעט מקבילה לרצפה, כשהברך בדיוק מעל הקרסול. | הושט את שתי הידיים לצדדים בגובה כתפיים, מקבילות לרצפה. | Inhale and flip your right palm to face upward, then sweep your right arm up and overhead toward the back of the room. | Lower your left hand to rest lightly on the back of your left leg — shin or thigh — without pushing into it for support. | נטה בעדינות את הגו לאחור ושמאלה, ויצור קשת ארוכה לאורך צידו הימני של הגוף מהאגן ועד קצות האצבעות. | Keep your right knee bent and pointing toward your right pinky toe throughout the pose. | Hold for 3–5 breaths, feeling the stretch along the right side body and hip flexors. | Inhale to rise back to center, then repeat on the opposite side.

t: Stand with your feet together and arms at your sides. | Bend your knees and lower your hips as if sitting back into a chair, keeping your weight in your heels and your torso upright — this is Chair Pose (Utkatasana). | Bring your palms together at your chest in a prayer position. | On an exhale, rotate your torso to the right, hooking your left elbow outside your right knee. | Press your elbow firmly against your knee to deepen the twist and keep your knees aligned. | Extend through the crown of your head to lengthen your spine, and gently open your chest toward the ceiling. | Hold the position for 5–10 breaths, keeping your hips level and your core engaged. | On an inhale, unwind back to center and return to Chair Pose. | Repeat the twist on the opposite side, rotating to the left with your right elbow outside your left knee.
tRu: Встаньте, поставив стопы вместе, руки вдоль тела. | Согните ноги и опустите бёдра, как будто садитесь на стул, удерживая вес в пятках и корпус вертикально — это поза стула (Уткатасана). | Сведите ладони на уровне груди в положении молитвы. | На выдохе поверните корпус вправо, заводя левый локоть снаружи правого колена. | Press your elbow firmly against your knee to deepen the twist and keep your knees aligned. | Вытяните макушкой вверх, удлиняя позвоночник, и мягко откройте грудь к потолку. | Держите положение в течение 5-10 дыханий, удерживая бёдровы кости на одном уровне и напрягая корпус. | На вдохе развернитесь обратно в центр и вернитесь в Положение стула. | Repeat the twist on the opposite side, rotating to the left with your right elbow outside your left knee.
tHe: עמוד עם רגליים צמודות וידיים לצדי הגוף. | כופף את הברכיים והורד את האגן כאילו התיישבת לאחור על כיסא, תוך שמירה על המשקל בעקבים והגוף זקוף — זוהי תנוחת הכיסא (אוטקאטאסאנה). | הבא את כפות ידיך יחד בחזה. | On an exhale, rotate your torso to the right, hooking your left elbow outside your right knee. | Press your elbow firmly against your knee to deepen the twist and keep your knees aligned. | פשוט דרך פסגת הראש כדי לאריך את העמוד השדרתי, ופתח בעדינות את החזה כלפי התקרה. | Hold the position for 5–10 breaths, keeping your hips level and your core engaged. | On an inhale, unwind back to center and return to Chair Pose. | Repeat the twist on the opposite side, rotating to the left with your right elbow outside your left knee.

t: Sit on the floor with both legs extended in front of you. Bend your right knee and draw the sole of your right foot against the inside of your left thigh, letting your right knee fall out to the side. | Flex your left foot so the toes point toward the ceiling, keeping the left leg straight and the back of your knee in contact with the floor. | Inhale and grow tall through your spine, sitting evenly on both sit bones. | Exhale and rotate your torso slightly toward the left leg, then begin to hinge and side-bend to the left, reaching your left hand toward your left foot. | Extend your right arm up and over your head, reaching toward the left foot so both hands can hold the foot, ankle, or shin — whichever is reachable without rounding your lower back. | Turn your chest gently upward toward the ceiling to deepen the spinal rotation, keeping your shoulders relaxed away from your ears. | Hold the position for 5–10 slow breaths, using each exhale to ease a little deeper into the stretch. | Inhale to rise back to an upright seat, then repeat on the opposite side.
tRu: Sit on the floor with both legs extended in front of you. Bend your right knee and draw the sole of your right foot against the inside of your left thigh, letting your right knee fall out to the side. | Согните левую стопу так, чтобы пальцы ног были направлены к потолку, сохраняя левую ногой прямой и задней частью колена в контакте с полом. | Вдохните и вытяните позвоночник вверх, садясь равномерно на обе седалищные кости. | Выдыхайте и поверните корпус немного влево к ноге, затем начните наклоняться и наклоняться влево, направляя левую руку к левой стопе. | Выпрямите правую руку вверх и над головой, тянитесь к левой ноге, чтобы обеими руками можно было удерживать стопу, голень или подъём — whichever is reachable without rounding your lower back. | Turn your chest gently upward toward the ceiling to deepen the spinal rotation, keeping your shoulders relaxed away from your ears. | Держите положение в течение 5-10 медленных дыханий, используя каждый выдох для того, чтобы немного глубже войти в растяжку. | Сделайте вдох, чтобы вернуться в вертикальное сидячее положение, затем повторите на противоположной стороне.
tHe: Sit on the floor with both legs extended in front of you. Bend your right knee and draw the sole of your right foot against the inside of your left thigh, letting your right knee fall out to the side. | כופף את כף רגל שמאל כך שהאצבעות יפנו אל התקרה, שמור על רגל שמאל ישרה ועל חלקה האחורי של הברך צמוד לרצפה. | Inhale and grow tall through your spine, sitting evenly on both sit bones. | נשוף וסובבו את הגוף מעט לכיוון הרגל השמאלית, אז התחילו להישען ולהתכופף לצד שמאל, הגיעו עם יד שמאל לכיוון כף רגל שמאל. | פשוט את ידיך ימינה מעלה ומעבר לראש, משיך לכיוון כף הרגל השמאלית כך ששתי הידות יכולות לאחוז בכף הרגל, הקרסול או השוק — זה שהוא נגיש בלי לעקם את הגב התחתון. | Turn your chest gently upward toward the ceiling to deepen the spinal rotation, keeping your shoulders relaxed away from your ears. | Hold the position for 5–10 slow breaths, using each exhale to ease a little deeper into the stretch. | Inhale to rise back to an upright seat, then repeat on the opposite side.

t: Stand at the top of your mat with your feet together, then step your left foot back about 3–4 feet into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the floor if needed to find stability. | Align your right knee directly over your right ankle, keeping your front shin vertical and your back leg extended or knee resting gently on the mat. | Place your hands together at your chest in a prayer position (Anjali Mudra) and take a tall breath in to lengthen your spine. | On an exhale, rotate your torso to the right, hooking your left elbow outside your right knee. Use this contact as leverage to deepen the twist without collapsing your chest. | Press your palms firmly together and use the resistance between your elbow and knee to open your chest upward, rotating your top shoulder back and your bottom shoulder forward. | Keep your hips as square to the front of the mat as possible — resist letting the back hip swing open as you twist. | Gaze upward toward the ceiling or keep your eyes level if that is more comfortable for your neck. | Hold the pose for 20–30 seconds, breathing steadily and deepening the rotation a little more with each exhale. | To release, unwind the twist on an inhale, return your hands to the mat, and step your back foot forward. Repeat on the opposite side, stepping the right foot back.

Repeat on the opposite side, stepping the right foot back.

nE: Revolved Side Angle Pose Parivrtta Parsvakonasana
nH: תנוחת זווית צדדית מסובבת פריווריטה פרשוואקונאסאנה
t: Begin in a high lunge with your right foot forward, knee stacked over the ankle, and your left leg extended straight behind you with the ball of the left foot on the mat. | Square your hips toward the front of the mat and press back through the left heel to straighten the back leg and stabilize the stance. | On an inhale, lengthen through the crown of the head and lift your torso upright, engaging the core. | On an exhale, rotate your torso to the right, bringing your left elbow to the outside of your right knee. Press elbow and knee against each other to deepen the twist. | If the twist allows, lower your left hand to the mat or a block on the outside of the right foot, pressing the palm flat to create a stable foundation. | Extend your right arm overhead and in line with your right ear, reaching the fingertips forward to create a long diagonal line from the back heel through the top hand. | Turn your gaze upward toward the ceiling or, if that strains the neck, look straight ahead. Hold for 5 steady breaths, lengthening the spine on each inhale and deepening the rotation on each exhale. | To release, unwind the twist on an inhale, return both hands to the mat, and step back to Downward-Facing Dog before repeating on the left side.
tRu: Примите высокий выпад с правой ногой впереди, колено точно над голеностопом, а левая нога выпрямлена назад с опорой на подушечку левой стопы. | Square your hips toward the front of the mat and press back through the left heel to straighten the back leg and stabilize the stance. | На вдохе вытяните позвоночник через макушку и поднимите корпус в вертикальное положение, напрягая корпус. | На выдохе поверните корпус вправо, принося левый локоть к внешней стороне правого колена. Прижмите локоть и колено друг к другу, чтобы углубить скручивание. | Если позволяет скручивание, опустите левую руку на коврик или блок с внешней стороны правой стопы, прижав ладонь для создания устойчивой опоры. | Выпрямите правую руку над головой и на одной линии с правым ухом, вытягивайте пальцы вперёд, чтобы создать длинную диагональную линию от пятки сзади до верхней руки. | Turn your gaze upward toward the ceiling or, if that strains the neck, look straight ahead. t: Stand with your feet together, then step your left foot back about 3–4 feet, keeping both feet pointing forward and your legs straight. | Square your hips as much as possible toward the front of your mat, pressing the outer edge of your back foot firmly into the floor. | Inhale and extend your arms out to the sides at shoulder height, creating a T shape with your torso. | Exhale and hinge forward from your hips, keeping your spine long, and bring your torso over your front (right) leg. | Place your left hand on the floor outside your right foot, or on a block positioned beside your right shin if you cannot reach the floor. | Inhale to lengthen your spine, then exhale and rotate your torso to the right, stacking your right shoulder above the left. | Extend your right arm straight up toward the ceiling, opening your chest and gazing up at your raised hand if your neck allows. | Hold for 5–10 slow breaths, maintaining an elongated spine rather than collapsing into the forward fold. | To exit, lower your top arm, inhale to lift your torso back to upright, and step your feet together before repeating on the opposite side.
tRu: Stand with your feet together, then step your left foot back about 3–4 feet, keeping both feet pointing forward and your legs straight. | Square your hips as much as possible toward the front of your mat, pressing the outer edge of your back foot firmly into the floor. | Вдохните и разведите руки в стороны на уровне плеч, образуя Т-образное положение корпуса. | Выдыхайте и наклоняйтесь вперёд от бёдер, сохраняя позвоночник прямым, и наклоняйте корпус переднюю (правую) ногу. | Положите левую руку снаружи правого колена или на блок, расположенный рядом с правой голенью, если вы не можете дотянуться до пола. | Вдыхайте, чтобы вытянуть позвоночник, затем выдыхайте и поворачивайте корпус вправо, ставя правое плечо над левым. | Выпрямите правую руку прямо вверх к потолку, раскрывая грудь и глядя на поднятую руку, если это позволяет ваша шея. | Удерживайте 5–10 медленных дыханий, сохраняя вытяжённый позвоночник, а не проваливаясь в наклон. | To exit, lower your top arm, inhale to lift your torso back to upright, and step your feet together before repeating on the opposite side.
tHe: Stand with your feet together, then step your left foot back about 3–4 feet, keeping both feet pointing forward and your legs straight. | Square your hips as much as possible toward the front of your mat, pressing the outer edge of your back foot firmly into the floor. | Inhale and extend your arms out to the sides at shoulder height, creating a T shape with your torso. | נשוף והטה קדימה מהמותניים, שומר על עמוד שדרה ארוך, והביא את הגוף שלך מעל הרגל הקדמית (ימין). | Place your left hand on the floor outside your right foot, or on a block positioned beside your right shin if you cannot reach the floor. | Inhale to lengthen your spine, then exhale and rotate your torso to the right, stacking your right shoulder above the left. | פשוט את ידיך ימינה ישר מעלה לעבר התקרה, פותח את החזה ומביט ביד המורמת אם הצוואר מאפשר. | Hold for 5–10 slow breaths, maintaining an elongated spine rather than collapsing into the forward fold. | To exit, lower your top arm, inhale to lift your torso back to upright, and step your feet together before repeating on the opposite side.

t: Adjust the saddle height so your knee has a slight bend (about 25–35°) at the bottom of the pedal stroke, with your foot flat on the pedal. | Set the handlebar height so you can reach it comfortably without rounding your lower back or locking out your elbows. | Before setting off, do 5 minutes of easy spinning at low resistance to warm up your legs and elevate your heart rate gradually. | Clip in or place the ball of your foot over the center of the pedal, then push off and begin pedaling in smooth, circular strokes. | Sit tall with a neutral spine, a slight forward lean from the hips, and relaxed shoulders — avoid hunching or gripping the bars too tightly. | Maintain a cadence of 70–90 RPM for general fitness; shift to an easier gear to keep your cadence in range rather than grinding a heavy gear. | Ride at a conversational pace for the bulk of your session if you are building base fitness, or follow a structured interval plan for higher-intensity work. | In the final 5 minutes, reduce intensity and spin in an easy gear to cool down and bring your heart rate back toward resting. | Dismount carefully, check your bike is secured, and stretch your quads, hamstrings, and hip flexors after the ride.
tRu: Отрегулируйте высоту седла так, чтобы колено слегка сгибалось (примерно на 25–35°) в нижней точке хода педали при ровной стопе на педали. | Set the handlebar height so you can reach it comfortably without rounding your lower back or locking out your elbows. | Перед стартом покрутите педали 5 минут в лёгком темпе на низком сопротивлении, чтобы разогреть ноги и постепенно повысить пульс. | Зацепитесь или поставьте переднюю часть стопы в центр педали, затем оттолкнитесь и начните крутить педали плавными круговыми движениями. | Sit tall with a neutral spine, a slight forward lean from the hips, and relaxed shoulders — avoid hunching or gripping the bars too tightly. | Держите темп 70–90 оборотов в минуту для общей физической подготовки; переключитесь на более лёгкую передачу, чтобы держать темп в заданном диапазоне, а не «топтаться» на тяжёлой. | Ride at a conversational pace for the bulk of your session if you are building base fitness, or follow a structured interval plan for higher-intensity work. | В последние 5 минут снизьте интенсивность и крутите педали в легком режиме для заминки и возвращения пульса к исходному состоянию. | Сойдите с тренажёра осторожно, убедитесь, что велосипед надёжно закреплён, и растяните квадрицепсы, бицепсы бедер и сгибатели бёдер после тренировки.
tHe: כוון את גובה האוכף כך שהברך תהיה בכיפוף קל (בערך 25–35°) בתחתית סיבוב הדוושה, עם כף רגל שטוחה על הדוושה. | Set the handlebar height so you can reach it comfortably without rounding your lower back or locking out your elbows. | לפני היציאה לדרך, בצע 5 דקות של דיווש קל בהתנגדות נמוכה כדי לחמם את הרגליים ולהעלות את הדופק בהדרגה. | חבר את הרצועה לכבל, ואז עלה על ארבע בכיוון המכונה עם הידיים מתחת לכתפיים והברכיים מתחת לאגן. | Sit tall with a neutral spine, a slight forward lean from the hips, and relaxed shoulders — avoid hunching or gripping the bars too tightly. | Maintain a cadence of 70–90 RPM for general fitness; shift to an easier gear to keep your cadence in range rather than grinding a heavy gear. | Ride at a conversational pace for the bulk of your session if you are building base fitness, or follow a structured interval plan for higher-intensity work. | In the final 5 minutes, reduce intensity and spin in an easy gear to cool down and bring your heart rate back toward resting. | ירד מהמכונה בזהירות, בדוק שהאופניים שלך מאובטחים, ומתח את שרירי הרגליים הקדמיים, האחוריים והמפרקים אחר הרכיבה.

t: Stand with your left foot forward and right foot back, feet roughly shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent. | Raise your hands into guard position — left fist near your chin, right fist beside your right cheek, elbows tucked in. | Pivot your right foot, turning the heel outward so your right hip rotates forward. | Drive the rotation through your core and torso, letting your right shoulder follow the hip forward. | Extend your right arm in a straight line toward the target, rotating your fist so the palm faces down at full extension. | Make contact with the first two knuckles of your right hand, keeping your wrist straight and aligned with your forearm. | Exhale sharply as you extend, engaging your core throughout the punch. | Pull your arm back along the same path immediately after contact, returning your fist to guard position. | Reset your stance and weight distribution before throwing another punch or combination.

t: Stand in an orthodox boxing stance: feet shoulder-width apart, left foot forward, knees slightly bent, and weight evenly distributed between both feet. | Raise your hands to guard position — left fist near your left cheekbone, right fist protecting your right cheekbone, elbows angled down toward your ribs. | Shift a small amount of weight onto your right (rear) foot by bending the right knee, loading the hip for rotation. | Initiate the punch by driving your right hip explosively forward and pivoting on the ball of your right foot, letting your heel rise naturally. | As your hips rotate, allow your right shoulder to follow through and bring your right elbow up to roughly shoulder height, forming approximately a 90° bend at the elbow. | Deliver the hook in a tight horizontal arc toward the target, keeping your right fist level with your shoulder at the moment of contact. | Keep your left hand pressed firmly against your left cheekbone throughout the entire movement to maintain your guard. | At the moment of impact, exhale sharply and tighten your core to transfer force through the punch. | Snap your right hand back to guard position by reversing the hip rotation, then reset your balanced stance and prepare for the next combination.

t: Adjust the rings so they hang just a few inches above the floor, enough clearance to kneel beneath them comfortably. | Kneel on a mat and grip one ring in each hand with a neutral or pronated grip, hands roughly shoulder-width apart. | Brace your core, posteriorly tilt your pelvis, and slowly walk your knees back while extending your arms forward and overhead until your body forms a straight, hollow-body line — hips in line with your torso, arms fully extended. | Hold that extended position: arms straight and pressed down against the rings, ribcage depressed, glutes and abs fully contracted, and hips just above floor level. | Keep your gaze toward the floor and your neck neutral so your spine stays in alignment throughout the hold. | Breathe in controlled nasal inhales and exhale slowly without releasing the abdominal brace — do not hold your breath for the entire set. | Maintain the hollow-body position for the target duration, typically 10–30 seconds, resisting any temptation to let the hips drop or the lower back arch. | To finish, bend your elbows and pull the rings back toward your hips while walking your knees forward, returning to the kneeling start position under control.

tRu: Set the rings wider than shoulder-width — roughly 1.5 times shoulder-width is a useful starting point — and adjust them to the same height. | Повисните на кольцах с нейтральным или слегка пронационным хватом, руки полностью выпрямлены, и позвольте лопаткам естественным образом подняться в нижней точке. | Напрягите корпус и сожмите ягодицы, чтобы тело образовало прямую линию от плеч до пят. | Опустите и сведите лопатки — потяните их вниз и назад — перед началом тяги. | Отведите локти в стороны и вниз к бедрам, подтягивая грудь к кольцам. | Продолжайте тянуть, пока ваша грудь не достигнет уровня колец или ваш подбородок не окажется выше них, сохраняя корпус вертикальным, а не давая ему раскачиваться. | Задержитесь на мгновение в верхней точке, затем плавно опуститесь в полную вис. | Выполните все повторения без использования рывков или раскачивания, при необходимости восстанавливая положение плеч между повторениями.

t: Sit on the floor with your legs spread wide in a straddle position, as far apart as is comfortable without forcing range. | Sit up tall, place both hands on the floor in front of you for support, and let your feet flex or relax naturally. | Inhale to lengthen your spine, then exhale and slowly rock your weight forward, walking your hands out ahead of you. | Pause at the limit of your comfortable range for one or two breaths, feeling a stretch along the inner thighs and groin. | Slowly rock back to the starting position, keeping your back relatively upright rather than collapsing into a slump. | Continue rocking forward and back in a smooth, controlled rhythm for the desired number of repetitions or time. | To add a lateral component, shift your weight toward one leg, pause briefly, then rock back through center and toward the other leg. | When finished, bring your legs together slowly before standing up.
tRu: Sit on the floor with your legs spread wide in a straddle position, as far apart as is comfortable without forcing range. | Sit up tall, place both hands on the floor in front of you for support, and let your feet flex or relax naturally. | Вдыхайте, чтобы вытянуть позвоночник, затем выдыхайте, когда плавно переносите вес вперед, переступая руками. | Сделайте паузу на пределе вашей комфортной амплитуды на один или два вдоха, ощущая растяжку по внутренней поверхности бедер и паху. | Slowly rock back to the starting position, keeping your back relatively upright rather than collapsing into a slump. | Продолжайте качаться вперёд и назад в плавном, контролируемом ритме в течение заданного количества повторений или времени. | To add a lateral component, shift your weight toward one leg, pause briefly, then rock back through center and toward the other leg. | When finished, bring your legs together slowly before standing up.

t: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outward and arms hanging at your sides. | Hinge at the hips and bend your knees to lower into a squat until your thighs are roughly parallel to the floor, keeping your chest up and your weight through your heels. | As you reach the bottom of the squat, swing your arms back behind your hips to load the movement. | Explode upward by driving through your legs and swinging your arms forcefully overhead, leaving the ground as high as possible. | At the peak of the jump your body should be fully extended — legs straight, arms reaching straight up above your head. | Begin pulling your arms back down as you descend so they help absorb the landing. | Land softly by bending your knees to cushion the impact, allowing your hips to drop back into the bottom of the squat position. | Use the momentum from the landing to flow directly into the next repetition without pausing at the bottom. | Continue for the prescribed number of repetitions or duration, maintaining consistent jump height and soft landings throughout.
tRu: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outward and arms hanging at your sides. | Отводите бёдра назад и сгибайте колени, чтобы опуститься в присед до положения, когда бёдра будут примерно параллельны полу, сохраняя грудь поднятой и вес на пятках. | Дойдя до нижней точки приседа, отведите руки назад за бёдра, чтобы зарядить движение. | Взрывно двигайтесь вверх, отталкиваясь ногами и сильно раскачивая руки над головой, отрываясь от земли как можно выше. | В верхней точке прыжка тело должно быть полностью выпрямлено — ноги прямые, руки тянутся строго вверх над головой. | Начните опускать руки вниз по ходу спуска, чтобы они помогли смягчить приземление. | Мягко приземляйтесь, сгибая колени для смягчения удара, позволяя бёдрам опуститься в нижнее положение приседа. | Use the momentum from the landing to flow directly into the next repetition without pausing at the bottom. | Продолжайте в течение заданного количества повторений или времени, сохраняя одинаковую высоту прыжков и мягкие приземления.
tHe: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outward and arms hanging at your sides. | כופף בציר הירכיים וכופף את הברכיים לירידה לסקוואט עד שהירכיים בקירוב מקבילות לרצפה, תוך שמירה על חזה מורם והמשקל על העקבים. | בהגעה לתחתית הסקוואט, הנף את הזרועות לאחור מאחורי האגן כדי לטעון את התנועה. | התפרץ למעלה על ידי דחיפה דרך הרגליים ונעירת הידיים בכוח למעלה, עוזב את הקרקע בגובה המרבי האפשרי. | בשיא הקפיצה הגוף צריך להיות ישר לגמרי — רגליים ישרות, ידיים מושטות ישר למעלה מעל הראש. | התחל למשוך את הזרועות בחזרה למטה בזמן הירידה כדי שיעזרו לבלום את הנחיתה. | Land softly by bending your knees to cushion the impact, allowing your hips to drop back into the bottom of the squat position. | Use the momentum from the landing to flow directly into the next repetition without pausing at the bottom. | המשך למשך מספר החזרות או הזמן המוגדר, שומר על גובה קפיצה עקבי ונחיתות רכות לאורך כל התרגיל.

t: Kneel on all fours with your hands directly under your shoulders and your knees under your hips, hip-width apart. Keep your spine neutral and your head in line with your back. | Take a slow breath in to prepare, bracing your core lightly without holding your breath. | Exhale as you push your hips back toward your heels, lowering your torso toward the floor in a controlled slide. Allow your arms to extend naturally in front of you as your hips descend. | Pause briefly in the lowered position — your hips should be close to or resting on your heels and your chest near your thighs, resembling child's pose. | Inhale and shift your weight forward, pressing through your hands to return to the starting quadruped position. Keep the movement smooth and continuous rather than jerky. | Continue rocking back and forth at a steady, unhurried pace for the prescribed number of repetitions or time. | To finish, hold the lowered position for two to three breaths before returning to neutral and resting.
tRu: Встаньте на колени на четвереньках, руки прямо под плечами, колени под тазом, на ширине бедер. Держите позвоночник нейтральным, голову в линии со спиной. | Take a slow breath in to prepare, bracing your core lightly without holding your breath. | Выдыхайте, когда отводите бедра назад к пяткам, опуская туловище к полу в контролируемом скольжении. Позвольте вашим рукам естественно вытягиваться перед собой, когда бедра опускаются. | Задержитесь на мгновение в опущенном положении — ваши бёдра должны быть близко к пяткам или опираться на них, а грудь — близко к бёдрам, напоминая позу ребёнка. | Вдохните и перенесите вес тела вперёд, выжимаясь руками для возврата в исходное положение на четвереньках. Движение должно быть плавным и непрерывным, а не рывковым. | Продолжайте раскачиваться взад и вперёд в устойчивом, размеренном темпе в течение заданного количества повторений или времени. | To finish, hold the lowered position for two to three breaths before returning to neutral and resting.
tHe: Kneel on all fours with your hands directly under your shoulders and your knees under your hips, hip-width apart. Keep your spine neutral and your head in line with your back. | Take a slow breath in to prepare, bracing your core lightly without holding your breath. | לחץ אוויר בזמן שאתה דוחף את המותניים חזרה לעקביך, מוריד את הגוף בהחלקה מבוקרת. אפשר לידיים להתארך באופן טבעי לפניך כשהמותניים יורדות. | Pause briefly in the lowered position — your hips should be close to or resting on your heels and your chest near your thighs, resembling child's pose. | Inhale and shift your weight forward, pressing through your hands to return to the starting quadruped position. Keep the movement smooth and continuous rather than jerky. | המשך לנעול קדימה ואחורה בקצב יציב ולא ממהר למספר החזרות או הזמן המומלץ. | To finish, hold the lowered position for two to three breaths before returning to neutral and resting.

t: Kneel on the floor with one foot flat on the ground in front of you, knee bent at roughly 90°, and the other knee resting on the floor behind you for support. | Place your hands on your front knee or the floor for balance. | Keeping your front heel firmly on the floor, slowly rock your body weight forward so your front knee travels over your toes — this is the dorsiflexion (toes-up) end of the movement. | Rock back to the starting position, allowing your ankle to return to neutral. | Continue rocking forward and back in a smooth, controlled rhythm, going a little further into dorsiflexion each time as the joint loosens. | Perform the desired number of reps, then switch legs and repeat on the other side. | To increase intensity, you can perform the exercise standing with one hand on a wall for support, rocking the working knee forward over the toes.
tRu: Встаньте на колени на полу, одна нога полностью на полу перед вами, колено согнуто примерно под углом 90°, а другое колено опирается на пол сзади для опоры. | Положите руки на переднее колено или на пол для равновесия. | Держа пятку передней ноги плотно на полу, медленно перенесите вес тела вперёд, чтобы переднее колено прошло над пальцами ног — это конец движения в положении подошвенного сгибания (пальцы вверх). | Rock back to the starting position, allowing your ankle to return to neutral. | Продолжайте качаться вперёд и назад в плавном, контролируемом ритме, заходя немного дальше в тыльное сгибание стопы каждый раз по мере того, как сустав разрабатывается. | Выполните желаемое количество повторений, затем смените ноги и повторите на другой стороне. | To increase intensity, you can perform the exercise standing with one hand on a wall for support, rocking the working knee forward over the toes.
tHe: Kneel on the floor with one foot flat on the ground in front of you, knee bent at roughly 90°, and the other knee resting on the floor behind you for support. | Place your hands on your front knee or the floor for balance. | Keeping your front heel firmly on the floor, slowly rock your body weight forward so your front knee travels over your toes — this is the dorsiflexion (toes-up) end of the movement. | Rock back to the starting position, allowing your ankle to return to neutral. | המשך לנעול קדימה ואחורה בקצב חלק ומבוקר, חוזר קצת יותר לכיוון כף הרגל הפנימית כל פעם שהמפרק מתרכך. | Perform the desired number of reps, then switch legs and repeat on the other side. | To increase intensity, you can perform the exercise standing with one hand on a wall for support, rocking the working knee forward over the toes.

t: Place a foam roller on the floor and kneel behind it, then lower the front of your left shin onto the roller just above the ankle. | Support your upper body with both hands flat on the floor in front of you, arms straight, so you can control how much bodyweight presses into the roller. | Keep your right knee on the floor or extend the right leg out to the side to adjust the load on the working leg. | Brace your core slightly and keep your spine neutral — avoid letting your lower back sag. | Using your arms, slowly push your body forward so the roller travels up the front of the shin toward the knee, moving at roughly one inch per second. | When you reach a tender spot, pause and hold steady pressure on that point for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and letting the tissue relax. | Continue rolling from ankle to just below the knee, covering the full length of the anterior lower leg — never roll directly over the knee joint. | Complete 2–3 slow passes up and down the shin, then switch legs and repeat the same sequence on the other side.
tRu: Положите валик для пены на пол и встаньте на колени за ним, затем положите переднюю часть левой голени на валик чуть выше лодыжки. | Support your upper body with both hands flat on the floor in front of you, arms straight, so you can control how much bodyweight presses into the roller. | Держите правое колено на полу или выпрямите правую ногу в сторону, чтобы регулировать нагрузку на рабочую ногу. | Слегка напрягите пресс и удерживайте позвоночник нейтрально — не давайте пояснице провисать. | Using your arms, slowly push your body forward so the roller travels up the front of the shin toward the knee, moving at roughly one inch per second. | When you reach a tender spot, pause and hold steady pressure on that point for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and letting the tissue relax. | Продолжайте кататься от лодыжки до области чуть ниже колена, прорабатывая всю длисть передней поверхности нижней ноги — никогда не катайтесь непосредственно по коленному суставу. | Выполните 2–3 медленных прохода вверх-вниз по голени, затем поменяйте ноги и повторите ту же последовательность на другой стороне.
tHe: Place a foam roller on the floor and kneel behind it, then lower the front of your left shin onto the roller just above the ankle. | Support your upper body with both hands flat on the floor in front of you, arms straight, so you can control how much bodyweight presses into the roller. | Keep your right knee on the floor or extend the right leg out to the side to adjust the load on the working leg. | הדק מעט את הליבה ושמור על עמוד שדרה ניטרלי — הימנע משקיעת הגב התחתון. | Using your arms, slowly push your body forward so the roller travels up the front of the shin toward the knee, moving at roughly one inch per second. | When you reach a tender spot, pause and hold steady pressure on that point for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and letting the tissue relax. | המשילו להתגלגל מהקרסול עד מעט מתחת לברך, מכסים את כל אורך השוק הקדמי — אל תתגלגלו ישירות מעל מפרק הברך. | בצע 2–3 מעברים איטיים למעלה ולמטה לאורך השוק, ואז החלף רגליים וחזור על אותה סדרה בצד השני.

nE: Roll Around the World Lying on Floor
nR: Круги лёжа на полу с роллом
nH: עיגולים בשכיבה על הרצפה עם רולר
t: Place the foam roller on the floor perpendicular to your spine. Sit in front of it, then lean back so the roller contacts your mid-back at roughly the level of your shoulder blades. | Lower yourself until your upper back rests on the roller with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. | Support your head lightly with your hands or let your arms rest at your sides to start. Engage your core to keep your hips low and your lower back relaxed. | Slowly extend both arms out to your sides, then sweep them up overhead in a wide arc, as if making a snow angel — this is the "around the world" motion. | Continue the sweep, bringing your arms around and back down to your sides, completing a full circle. Move at a slow, controlled pace and breathe steadily throughout. | Pause at any point in the arc where you feel tightness in the upper back, holding for two to three seconds to allow the tissue to release. | Reverse the direction of the arm sweep for the next repetition to work the muscles from both angles. | After completing your reps, shift the roller slightly up or down your spine to address different segments of the thoracic region before repeating.
tRu: Положите массажный валик на пол перпендикулярно позвоночнику. Сядьте перед ним, затем запрокиньте голову, чтобы валик касался средней части спины, примерно на уровне лопаток. | Опуститесь до положения, когда верхняя часть спины лежит на валике с согнутыми коленями и стопами на полу на ширине таза. | Support your head lightly with your hands or let your arms rest at your sides to start. Engage your core to keep your hips low and your lower back relaxed. | Slowly extend both arms out to your sides, then sweep them up overhead in a wide arc, as if making a snow angel — this is the "around the world" motion. | Продолжайте движение, вынося руки вокруг и обратно вниз к бокам, выполняя полный круг. Двигайтесь в медленном, контролируемом темпе и дышите ровно. | Сделайте паузу в любой точке дуги, где вы чувствуете напряжение в верхней части спины, удерживая в течение двух-трех секунд, чтобы ткани могли расслабиться. | Reverse the direction of the arm sweep for the next repetition to work the muscles from both angles. | Выполнив повторы, слегка сместите валик вверх или вниз вдоль позвоночника, чтобы проработать разные сегменты грудного отдела, прежде чем повторить.

Sit in front of it, then lean back so the roller contacts your mid-back at roughly the level of your shoulder blades. | Lower yourself until your upper back rests on the roller with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. | Support your head lightly with your hands or let your arms rest at your sides to start. Engage your core to keep your hips low and your lower back relaxed. | Slowly extend both arms out to your sides, then sweep them up overhead in a wide arc, as if making a snow angel — this is the "around the world" motion. | המשך את הטווח, מושט את הידיים סביב וחזרה למטה לצדדיך, משלים מעגה מלאה. זוז בקצב איטי ומבוקר ונשם בצורה יציבה לאורך כל התרגיל. | Pause at any point in the arc where you feel tightness in the upper back, holding for two to three seconds to allow the tissue to release. | Reverse the direction of the arm sweep for the next repetition to work the muscles from both angles. | אחרי שסיימת את החזרות, הזז את הגליל מעט למעלה או למטה לאורך עמוד השדרה כדי לטפל במקטעים שונים באזור החזה לפני החזרה.

t: Place a foam roller or cylindrical roll on the floor perpendicular to your body. | Sit on the floor in front of the roller, then lean back so the roller contacts the middle of your upper back, just below the shoulder blades. | Cross your arms over your chest or support the back of your head with both hands to keep your neck neutral. | Plant your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart, and engage your glutes to lift your hips slightly so your body forms a gentle arc over the roller. | Allow gravity to extend your thoracic spine over the roller, breathing out as you relax into the stretch. | Hold the stretched position for one to two seconds, then use your feet and glutes to drive your hips up and roll the foam roller a few centimetres toward your upper back. | Pause again at each new segment, letting the spine extend over the roller before rolling further. | Continue rolling upward until you reach the base of the neck, then reverse direction and work back down toward the lower thoracic area. | Complete the desired number of passes, then roll to one side and press up to a seated position.
tRu: Положите валик для пены или цилиндрический валик на пол перпендикулярно вашему телу. | Sit on the floor in front of the roller, then lean back so the roller contacts the middle of your upper back, just below the shoulder blades. | Перекрестите руки на груди или поддерживайте затылок обеими руками, чтобы сохранить шею нейтральной. | Поставьте ноги на пол на ширине бёдер, приподнимите бёдра, чтобы тело образовало плавную дугу над валиком. | Позвольте гравитации прогнуть грудной отдел на ролле, выдыхая и расслабляясь в растяжке. | Держите растянутое положение 2–3 секунды, затем используйте стопы и ягодицы, чтобы поднять бедра и перекатить валик для пиллинга на несколько сантиметров к верхней части спины. | Снова остановитесь на каждом новом участке, позволяя позвоночнику выпрямиться над роликом перед тем, как катиться дальше. | Продолжайте перекатываться вверх до основания шеи, затем измените направление и работайте обратно вниз к области нижней грудной клетки. | Выполните желаемое количество передач, затем перекатитесь на одну сторону и поднимитесь в сидячее положение.
tHe: Place a foam roller or cylindrical roll on the floor perpendicular to your body. | Sit on the floor in front of the roller, then lean back so the roller contacts the middle of your upper back, just below the shoulder blades. | חצה את הידיים לפני החזה או תמך בחלק האחורי של הראש עם שתי הידיים כדי לשמור על נייטרליות הצוואר. | Plant your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart, and engage your glutes to lift your hips slightly so your body forms a gentle arc over the roller. | תן לכוח הכבידה ליישר את עמוד השדרה החזי מעל הרולר, תוך נשיפה בזמן ההרפיה לתוך המתיחה. | Hold the stretched position for one to two seconds, then use your feet and glutes to drive your hips up and roll the foam roller a few centimetres toward your upper back. | Pause again at each new segment, letting the spine extend over the roller before rolling further. | המשיך להתגלגל למעלה עד שמגיעים לבסיס הצוואר, ואז הפך כיוון ועבור חזרה למטה לאזור החזה התחתון. | בצע את המספר הרצוי של המעברים, ואז גלגל לצד אחד והקף למצב ישיבה.

t: Place the rollball on the floor and get down onto your forearms, positioning yourself face-down or slightly to one side so you can reach your inner thigh. | Lift one leg out to the side at roughly a 45-degree angle from your body, and position the rollball against the inner thigh just above the knee. | Shift enough bodyweight onto that leg to create firm, tolerable pressure through the ball — support the rest of your weight on your forearms and opposite leg. | Breathe in slowly, then as you exhale, allow your muscles to soften into the pressure rather than tensing against it. | Begin rolling the ball slowly up toward the groin in small increments, pausing for 2–3 seconds on any area that feels noticeably tender or restricted. | When you find a tender spot, hold the ball still there and maintain steady pressure for 20–30 seconds until the discomfort begins to ease. | Continue working the ball along the full length of the inner thigh from just above the knee up to the groin, then reverse direction back down. | Complete 1–2 minutes on one leg, then switch to the other side and repeat the process. | Finish by performing a gentle static stretch of the inner thigh to reinforce the mobility gained from the release.
tRu: Положите массажный мяч на пол и лягте на предплечья, расположившись лицом вниз или немного на боку, чтобы дотянуться до внутренней поверхности бедра. | Приподнимите одну ногу в сторону под углом примерно 45 градусов к телу, и расположите ролик против внутренней поверхности бедра чуть выше колена. | Shift enough bodyweight onto that leg to create firm, tolerable pressure through the ball — support the rest of your weight on your forearms and opposite leg. | Дышите медленно, затем, выдыхая, позвольте мышцам расслабиться под давлением, а не напрягаться против него. | Начните медленно катить мяч вверх к паху мелкими шагами, останавливаясь на 2–3 секунды в любой заметно болезненной или зажатой точке. | When you find a tender spot, hold the ball still there and maintain steady pressure for 20–30 seconds until the discomfort begins to ease. | Продолжайте водить мячом по всей внутренней поверхности бедра от области чуть выше колена до паха, затем измените направление и двигайтесь обратно вниз. | Выполните 1–2 минуты на одной ноге, затем перейдите на другую сторону и повторите процесс. | Завершите, выполнив лёгкое статическое растяжение внутренней поверхности бедра для закрепления подвижности, полученной от расслабления.
tHe: Place the rollball on the floor and get down onto your forearms, positioning yourself face-down or slightly to one side so you can reach your inner thigh. | Lift one leg out to the side at roughly a 45-degree angle from your body, and position the rollball against the inner thigh just above the knee. | Shift enough bodyweight onto that leg to create firm, tolerable pressure through the ball — support the rest of your weight on your forearms and opposite leg. | נשור לאט, ואז כאשר אתה נושר, אפשר לשרירים שלך להרכן ללחץ במקום להתכווץ נגדו. | התחל לגלגל את הכדור לאט מעלה לכיוון המפשעה בצעדים קטנים, ועצור ל-2–3 שניות על כל אזור רגיש או מוגבל. | When you find a tender spot, hold the ball still there and maintain steady pressure for 20–30 seconds until the discomfort begins to ease. | המשיך לעבוד עם הכדור לאורך הירך הפנימית ממש מעל הברך עד לאזור המפשע, ואז הפוך כיוון חזרה למטה. | בצע 1–2 חציים בכל רגל, ואז החלף צדדים. | סיים במתיחה סטטית עדינה של הירך הפנימית לחיזוק הטווח שהושג מהשחרור.

t: Place a lacrosse ball or massage ball on the floor in front of you. | Lie face down and position the ball under the front of one upper arm, roughly at the midpoint of the bicep brachii — between the elbow crease and the front of the shoulder. | Extend that arm forward at roughly a 45° angle from your torso with your palm facing down or slightly to the side. | Use your free arm and legs to brace against the floor, controlling how much of your bodyweight presses onto the ball. | Slowly roll your arm so the ball travels along the front of the upper arm, from just above the elbow crease toward the front of the shoulder. | When you find a tender or tight spot, pause and hold light, steady pressure on it for 20–30 seconds while breathing slowly. | Continue rolling for 30–60 seconds total on that arm, then switch to the other side.
tRu: Положите лакроссовый мяч или массажный мяч на пол перед собой. | Лягте на живот и расположите мяч передней частью одной верхней руки примерно в середине бицепса — между локтевым сгибом и передней частью плеча. | Вытяните эту руку вперёд примерно под углом 45° к корпусу, ладонью вниз или немного вбок. | Use your free arm and legs to brace against the floor, controlling how much of your bodyweight presses onto the ball. | Slowly roll your arm so the ball travels along the front of the upper arm, from just above the elbow crease toward the front of the shoulder. | When you find a tender or tight spot, pause and hold light, steady pressure on it for 20–30 seconds while breathing slowly. | Продолжайте кататься в течение 30–60 секунд всего на той руке, затем перейдите на другую сторону.
tHe: Place a lacrosse ball or massage ball on the floor in front of you. | Lie face down and position the ball under the front of one upper arm, roughly at the midpoint of the bicep brachii — between the elbow crease and the front of the shoulder. | פשוט את הזרוע הזו קדימה בזווית של כ-45° מהגוף עם כף היד פונה למטה או קלות לצד. | Use your free arm and legs to brace against the floor, controlling how much of your bodyweight presses onto the ball. | Slowly roll your arm so the ball travels along the front of the upper arm, from just above the elbow crease toward the front of the shoulder. | When you find a tender or tight spot, pause and hold light, steady pressure on it for 20–30 seconds while breathing slowly. | המשילו להתגלגל בסך הכל למשך 30–60 שניות על זרוע זו, ואז עברו לצד השני.

t: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you. Place the rollball under your right calf, roughly at the mid-point between the ankle and the back of the knee. | Lift your hips off the floor slightly and prop yourself up on your hands behind you, so your body weight presses the calf down onto the ball. | Slowly roll your calf forward over the ball, moving from just above the ankle toward the base of the knee. Keep the movement controlled — about one inch per second. | When you find a tender or tight spot, pause and hold light pressure on that point for 20–30 seconds, breathing steadily, until the tension decreases. | Continue rolling back down toward the ankle, covering the full length of the gastrocnemius (upper calf belly). | Rotate your leg slightly inward and repeat the rolling motion to reach the soleus, which runs deeper and along the inner edge of the lower calf. | Adjust the load by crossing your left ankle over your right leg to add more pressure, or keep both legs down to reduce it. | Spend 60–90 seconds total on each calf, then switch legs and repeat. | Finish with 2–3 slow ankle circles to encourage blood flow through the tissue.
tRu: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you. Place the rollball under your right calf, roughly at the mid-point between the ankle and the back of the knee. | Поднимите таз немного с пола и упритесь руками сзади, чтобы вес тела давил на икру, прижимая ее к мячу. | Slowly roll your calf forward over the ball, moving from just above the ankle toward the base of the knee. Keep the movement controlled — about one inch per second. | When you find a tender or tight spot, pause and hold light pressure on that point for 20–30 seconds, breathing steadily, until the tension decreases. | Продолжайте кататься вниз к лодыжке, прорабатывая всю длину икроножной мышцы (верхней части икры). | Rotate your leg slightly inward and repeat the rolling motion to reach the soleus, which runs deeper and along the inner edge of the lower calf. | Отрегулируйте нагрузку, скрестив левую лодыжку поверх правой ноги для большего давления либо держа обе ноги внизу для меньшего. | Spend 60–90 seconds total on each calf, then switch legs and repeat. | Завершите 2–3 медленными круговыми движениями в голеностопе, чтобы улучшить кровоток в тканях.

Keep the movement controlled — about one inch per second. | When you find a tender or tight spot, pause and hold light pressure on that point for 20–30 seconds, breathing steadily, until the tension decreases. | המשילו להתגלגל חזרה לכיוון הקרסול, מכסים את כל אורך שריר השוק הקדמי (הבטן העליונה של השוק). | Rotate your leg slightly inward and repeat the rolling motion to reach the soleus, which runs deeper and along the inner edge of the lower calf. | ווסת את העומס על ידי הצלבת קרסול שמאל מעל רגל ימין להגברת הלחץ, או השאר את שתי הרגליים למטה להפחתתו. | Spend 60–90 seconds total on each calf, then switch legs and repeat. | סיים בשתיים-שלוש הקפות קרסול איטיות לעידוד זרימת הדם ברקמה.

t: Place a rollball against a wall at approximately shoulder height, then position your rear shoulder directly against the ball. | Lean your body weight gently into the ball so it presses into the posterior deltoid — the fleshy area at the back of your shoulder. | Stand with a slight bend in your knees and feet shoulder-width apart to maintain a stable, balanced stance. | Slowly roll the ball upward toward the top of the rear shoulder, pausing on any tender or tight spot you find. | Hold pressure on each tender point for 20–30 seconds, breathing deeply and allowing the muscle to relax into the ball. | Continue rolling the ball downward and outward, exploring the full area of the posterior deltoid. | Rotate your arm slowly inward and outward while maintaining ball pressure to increase the release effect on the muscle fibers. | Work each tight area for 1–2 minutes, then lower your arm and step away from the wall to assess your shoulder mobility.
tRu: Поставьте роликовый мяч в стену на уровне плеч, затем поместите ваше заднее плечо прямо к мячу. | Плавно перенесите вес тела на мяч, чтобы он давил на задний дельтовидный — мясистую область на задней поверхности плеча. | Stand with a slight bend in your knees and feet shoulder-width apart to maintain a stable, balanced stance. | Slowly roll the ball upward toward the top of the rear shoulder, pausing on any tender or tight spot you find. | Держите давление на каждой болезненной точке в течение 20–30 секунд, глубоко дыша и позволяя мышце расслабиться в шарик. | Продолжайте катать мяч вниз и наружу, исследуя всю область задней дельты. | Rotate your arm slowly inward and outward while maintaining ball pressure to increase the release effect on the muscle fibers. | Work each tight area for 1–2 minutes, then lower your arm and step away from the wall to assess your shoulder mobility.

t: Lie face down on the floor. Place the rollball just below the lower edge of your ribs, slightly to one side of your midline, positioning it against the soft tissue of the upper abdominal and diaphragm region. | Rest your forearms on the floor in front of you and gently lower your torso so that your bodyweight settles onto the ball. Start with minimal pressure — your forearms should bear most of your weight. | Take a slow, deep inhale through the nose, allowing your belly to expand downward into the ball. You should feel the ball press back against the tissue as your diaphragm descends. | Exhale fully and slowly through pursed lips, letting your torso relax further into the ball as you breathe out. The tissue under the ball should soften slightly with each exhale. | Hold this position for 20–30 seconds, breathing steadily, until you notice a reduction in tension or discomfort at that spot. | Slowly shift your torso a short distance — about one inch — in any direction to move the ball to an adjacent area, then repeat the breathing cycle. | Work across the lower ribcage on that side, covering the area from just left of the sternum to the outer edge of the ribcage, spending 20–30 seconds at each point. | Carefully push yourself up off the ball, reposition it to the opposite side of the midline, and repeat the entire sequence. | Finish by rolling onto your back and taking three to five slow, full diaphragmatic breaths to allow the tissue to settle.
tRu: Лягте на живот на пол. Положите ролик чуть ниже нижнего края ребер, немного сбоку от средней линии, расположив его против мягких тканей верхней части живота и диафрагмальной области. | Rest your forearms on the floor in front of you and gently lower your torso so that your bodyweight settles onto the ball. Start with minimal pressure — your forearms should bear most of your weight. | Take a slow, deep inhale through the nose, allowing your belly to expand downward into the ball. You should feel the ball press back against the tissue as your diaphragm descends. | Полностью и медленно выдыхайте через сжатые губы, позволяя вашему туловищу расслабиться еще глубже на мяче во время выдоха. Ткань под мячом должна немного смягчаться с каждым выдохом. | Удерживайте это положение в течение 20-30 секунд, дыша ровно, пока не заметите снижение напряжения или дискомфорта в этом месте. | Slowly shift your torso a short distance — about one inch — in any direction to move the ball to an adjacent area, then repeat the breathing cycle. | Work across the lower ribcage on that side, covering the area from just left of the sternum to the outer edge of the ribcage, spending 20–30 seconds at each point. | Осторожно оттолкнитесь от мяча, переместите его на противоположную сторону от средней линии и повторите всю последовательность. | Завершите упражнение, перевернувшись на спину и сделав три-пять медленных, диафрагмальных вдохов, чтобы ткани пришли в норму.
