tHe: Lie face-down on the floor with your legs straight and the tops of your feet flat against the ground, hip-width apart. | Place your hands flat on the floor directly under your shoulders, fingers pointing forward. | Press your hips and the tops of your feet firmly into the floor to anchor your lower body. | On an exhale, straighten your arms and press your torso up, lifting your chest and abdomen off the floor while keeping your hips grounded. | תן לגב התחתון להתיישר באופן טבעי — אל תכפה את הטווח; התקדם רק עד היכן שמרגיש בנוח בלי כאב. | משוך את הכתפיים אחורה ולמטה, הרחק מהאוזניים, כדי לשמור על חזה פתוח. | Hold the top position for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and letting the abdominals and hip flexors relax into the stretch. | To release, bend your elbows and lower your torso back to the floor under control. | Rest briefly, then repeat for the target number of sets.

t: Lie face-down on the floor with your legs straight and the tops of your feet flat against the ground. | Place your hands flat on the floor directly beneath your shoulders, fingers pointing forward. | Press your hips, thighs, and the tops of your feet firmly into the floor — they should stay in contact with the ground throughout the movement. | Inhale, then press through your palms to straighten your arms and lift your chest and torso off the floor. | Allow your back to arch naturally, letting the stretch travel through your lumbar spine and abdomen. | Keep your shoulders down and away from your ears, and your elbows soft rather than fully locked. | Hold the extended position for 20–30 seconds while breathing slowly and evenly. | Exhale and slowly lower your torso back to the floor with control to complete one repetition.
tRu: Лягте на живот на пол с прямыми ногами и верхними сторонами стоп, лежащими на полу. | Положите ладони плашмя на пол прямо под плечами, пальцами вперёд. | Press your hips, thighs, and the tops of your feet firmly into the floor — they should stay in contact with the ground throughout the movement. | Сделайте вдох, затем надавите поднятой пяткой на мяч, как будто пытаясь оттолкнуть его обратно к опорной ноге, изометрически сокращая бицепсы бедра в течение 6–10 секунд. | Позвольте спине естественно прогнуться, направляя растяжку через поясницу и живот. | Держите плечи опущенными и вдали от ушей, и локти слегка согнутыми, а не полностью выпрямленными. | Задержите конечное положение на 20–30 секунд, дышите медленно и ровно. | Выдыхайте и медленно опустите корпус обратно на пол под контролем, чтобы завершить одно повторение.
tHe: Lie face-down on the floor with your legs straight and the tops of your feet flat against the ground. | Place your hands flat on the floor directly beneath your shoulders, fingers pointing forward. | Press your hips, thighs, and the tops of your feet firmly into the floor — they should stay in contact with the ground throughout the movement. | Inhale, then press through your palms to straighten your arms and lift your chest and torso off the floor. | תן לגב להתקשת באופן טבעי, תוך מתן למתיחה לעבור דרך עמוד השדרה המותני והבטן. | Keep your shoulders down and away from your ears, and your elbows soft rather than fully locked. | Hold the extended position for 20–30 seconds while breathing slowly and evenly. | נשף והורד באיטיות את הגוף חזרה אל הרצפה בשליטה כדי לסיים חזרה אחת.

t: Sit on the floor with your hands placed lightly behind you for support, fingers pointing forward. Lift your chest and lengthen your spine. | Raise both legs off the floor and extend them out in front of you at roughly a 45-degree angle, keeping your core braced. | Open your legs wide apart in a controlled V-shape, feeling a stretch through your inner thighs. | Sweep both legs inward and cross them over each other, alternating which leg crosses on top to trace a figure-8 pattern. | Continue the pattern — open wide, then cross — without letting your feet touch the floor. | Keep your lower back from rounding by actively engaging your abdominals and obliques throughout the movement. | Breathe steadily: exhale as you close and cross the legs, inhale as you open them wide. | After completing the desired number of repetitions, gently lower both legs back to the floor to finish.

Lift your chest and lengthen your spine. | Raise both legs off the floor and extend them out in front of you at roughly a 45-degree angle, keeping your core braced. | Расставьте ноги широко в контролируемое V-образное положение, чувствуя растяжку внутренней поверхности бедер. | Sweep both legs inward and cross them over each other, alternating which leg crosses on top to trace a figure-8 pattern. | Продолжайте паттерн — широко раскрыть, затем скрестить — не позволяя ногам касаться пола. | Держите поясницу от округления, активно напрягая мышцы живота и косые мышцы на протяжении всего движения. | Дышите ровно: выдыхайте, когда вы сводите и скрещиваете ноги, и вдыхайте, когда разводите их в стороны. | Выполнив нужное количество повторений, мягко опустите обе ноги обратно на пол для завершения.

t: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat. Lean back slightly until your torso is at roughly a 45-degree angle and your core is engaged. | Place your hands lightly behind your head with your elbows wide, or cross your arms over your chest — whichever feels more comfortable. | Brace your abdominals and press your lower back toward a neutral position to avoid excessive lumbar rounding. | Lift your right knee toward your chest while simultaneously rotating your left elbow to meet it, crunching through the waist. | Pause briefly at the top, feeling the contraction in your rectus abdominis and hip flexors. | Return your right foot toward the floor and your torso toward the starting angle in a controlled manner — do not fully lower between reps. | Immediately drive your left knee up and rotate your right elbow to meet it, completing one full repetition. | Continue alternating sides for the desired number of reps, keeping your feet from touching the floor if you want to increase the difficulty.

tHe: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat. Lean back slightly until your torso is at roughly a 45-degree angle and your core is engaged. | הנח את הידיים קלות מאחורי הראש עם מרפקים פתוחים, או שלב את הידיים על החזה — מה שנוח לך יותר. | הדק את שרירי הבטן ולחץ את הגב התחתון למצב ניטרלי כדי להימנע מעיגול מוגזם של הגב התחתון. | Lift your right knee toward your chest while simultaneously rotating your left elbow to meet it, crunching through the waist. | Pause briefly at the top, feeling the contraction in your rectus abdominis and hip flexors. | Return your right foot toward the floor and your torso toward the starting angle in a controlled manner — do not fully lower between reps. | Immediately drive your left knee up and rotate your right elbow to meet it, completing one full repetition. | המשילו להחליף צדדים למספר החזרות הרצוי, שמרו על כפות הרגלים מרוחות מהרצפה אם ברצונכם להגביר את הקושי.

nE: Seated Alternate Dynamic Chest Stretch on a Chair
nR: Попеременная динамическая растяжка груди сидя на стуле
nH: מתיחת חזה דינמית לסירוגין בישיבה על כיסא
t: Sit upright near the front edge of a chair with your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart, and your spine tall. | Raise both arms out to your sides at shoulder height, palms facing forward, elbows soft. | Sweep your right arm back as far as comfortably possible, rotating slightly through the upper back to feel a stretch across the right side of your chest. | Return the right arm to the starting position as you simultaneously sweep the left arm back in the same controlled arc. | Continue alternating arms in a smooth, rhythmic motion — right back, return, left back, return — for the desired number of repetitions or duration. | Maintain tall posture throughout: avoid letting your shoulders round forward or your lower back slump between reps. | To finish, lower both arms and relax your shoulders.
tRu: Sit upright near the front edge of a chair with your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart, and your spine tall. | Raise both arms out to your sides at shoulder height, palms facing forward, elbows soft. | Sweep your right arm back as far as comfortably possible, rotating slightly through the upper back to feel a stretch across the right side of your chest. | Return the right arm to the starting position as you simultaneously sweep the left arm back in the same controlled arc. | Продолжайте поочерёдно работать руками в плавном, ритмичном движении — назад правой, возврат, назад левой, возврат — на заданное количество повторений или время. | Сохраняйте прямую осанку на протяжении всего движения: избегайте округления плеч вперёд или сутулости поясницы между повторениями. | To finish, lower both arms and relax your shoulders.

t: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you, or sit upright on a chair or bench with your feet flat on the ground. | If sitting on the floor, shift your weight slightly to one side and bring the foot of the leg you want to stretch back toward your body, placing the top of that foot flat on the floor behind you. | Alternatively, if seated on a chair, slide one foot back and rest the top of the foot on the floor with the toes pointing away from you. | Sit tall with an upright posture and gently shift your weight or press down through your shin to increase the downward point of the foot. | You should feel a stretch along the front of the shin and top of the foot — this is the tibialis anterior being lengthened. | Hold the stretch for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and allowing the muscle to relax into the position. | Release the tension gently, return the foot to a neutral position, and repeat on the other side. | Perform 2–3 holds per side.
tRu: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you, or sit upright on a chair or bench with your feet flat on the ground. | Если вы сидите на полу, сместите вес немного на одну сторону и подтяните стопу ноги, которую вы хотите растянуть, к корпусу, положив верхнюю часть стопы плоско на пол за собой. | Как вариант, сидя на стуле, отведите одну стопу назад и положите подъём стопы на пол пальцами от себя. | Sit tall with an upright posture and gently shift your weight or press down through your shin to increase the downward point of the foot. | You should feel a stretch along the front of the shin and top of the foot — this is the tibialis anterior being lengthened. | Держите растяжку в течение 20-30 секунд, дыша медленно и позволяя мышце расслабиться в этом положении. | Release the tension gently, return the foot to a neutral position, and repeat on the other side. | Выполните 2–3 удержания на каждую сторону.
tHe: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you, or sit upright on a chair or bench with your feet flat on the ground. | If sitting on the floor, shift your weight slightly to one side and bring the foot of the leg you want to stretch back toward your body, placing the top of that foot flat on the floor behind you. | לחלופין, בישיבה על כיסא, החלק כף רגל אחת לאחור והנח את גב כף הרגל על הרצפה כשהבהונות פונות ממך. | Sit tall with an upright posture and gently shift your weight or press down through your shin to increase the downward point of the foot. | You should feel a stretch along the front of the shin and top of the foot — this is the tibialis anterior being lengthened. | Hold the stretch for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and allowing the muscle to relax into the position. | Release the tension gently, return the foot to a neutral position, and repeat on the other side. | בצע 2–3 החזקות לכל צד.

nE: Seated Arm Crossover on a Chair
t: Sit upright on the edge of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart, and your spine tall. | Extend both arms out to your sides at shoulder height, palms facing forward, so your body forms a T-shape. | Take a breath in and brace your core lightly to stabilize your torso. | Exhale and sweep both arms forward and across your body in a wide arc, as if hugging a large barrel. | Continue crossing until one forearm overlaps the other in front of your chest, squeezing the chest muscles at the point of maximum crossover. | Hold the crossed position for one to two seconds, focusing on the contraction in your chest. | Slowly reverse the arc, returning both arms to the starting T-position under control. | Alternate which arm crosses on top with each repetition, then repeat for the target number of reps.
tRu: Sit upright on the edge of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart, and your spine tall. | Вытяните обе руки в стороны на уровне плеч, ладонями вперёд, чтобы ваше тело образовывало букву «Т». | Take a breath in and brace your core lightly to stabilize your torso. | Выдыхайте и ведите обе руки вперед и через тело по широкой дуге, как будто обнимая большой бочонок. | Продолжайте перекрещивать, пока одна предплечья не пересечёт другое перед грудью, сжимая грудные мышцы в точке максимального пересечения. | Зафиксируйте перекрестное положение на одну-две секунды, концентрируясь на сокращении в вашей груди. | Slowly reverse the arc, returning both arms to the starting T-position under control. | Чередуйте руку, которая оказывается сверху, каждое повторение, затем повторите целевое число повторений.
tHe: Sit upright on the edge of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart, and your spine tall. | פשוט את שתי הידיים לצידים בגובה הכתפיים, כפות הידיים פונות קדימה, כך שהגוף יצור צורת T. | Take a breath in and brace your core lightly to stabilize your torso. | לחץ אוויר והזז את שתי הידיים קדימה ולאורך גופך בקשת רחבה, כאילו מחבק חבית גדולה. | המשך לחצות עד שזרוע אחת חוצה את השנייה מלפני החזה, מכווץ את שרירי החזה בנקודת החצייה המרבית. | Hold the crossed position for one to two seconds, focusing on the contraction in your chest. | Slowly reverse the arc, returning both arms to the starting T-position under control. | החלף בכל חזרה איזו יד חוצה מלמעלה, ואז חזור על התרגיל למספר החזרות שנקבע.

t: Sit upright on a flat bench or sturdy surface with your feet flat on the floor. | Hold an EZ barbell horizontally with both hands using an overhand grip, palms facing down, arms extended in front of you at roughly chest height. | Brace your core and sit tall, avoiding any lean forward or backward. | Without shrugging your shoulders, initiate the movement by squeezing your shoulder blades together. | Continue retracting the scapulae as far as your range of motion allows, bringing your elbows back and to the sides. | Hold the fully contracted position for one to two seconds, focusing on feeling the tension between your shoulder blades. | Slowly reverse the movement, allowing your shoulder blades to protract and your arms to return to the start position. | Reset your posture if needed, then repeat for the desired number of reps.
tRu: Sit upright on a flat bench or sturdy surface with your feet flat on the floor. | Держите прямую ось — грудь вверх, корпус слегка напряжён — и позвольте гравитации углубить растяжение в нижней части икроножной мышцы и ахилловом сухожилии. | Напрягите корпус и сидите прямо, не наклоняясь ни вперёд, ни назад. | Without shrugging your shoulders, initiate the movement by squeezing your shoulder blades together. | Продолжайте отводить лопатки настолько, насколько позволяет ваша амплитуда движения, отводя локти назад и в стороны. | Задержите полностью сокращённое положение на одну-две секунды, концентрируясь на ощущении напряжения между лопатками. | Slowly reverse the movement, allowing your shoulder blades to protract and your arms to return to the start position. | Reset your posture if needed, then repeat for the desired number of reps.
tHe: Sit upright on a flat bench or sturdy surface with your feet flat on the floor. | החזק מוט EZ אופקית בשתי הידיים באחיזה מלמעלה, כפות מטה, זרועות פשוטות לפניך בגובה החזה בקירוב. | הדק את הליבה ושב זקוף, תוך הימנעות מכל הישענות קדימה או לאחור. | Without shrugging your shoulders, initiate the movement by squeezing your shoulder blades together. | המשך למשוך את השקעים ככל שטווח התנועה שלך מאפשר, מושך את המרפקים אחורה ואל הצדדים. | Hold the fully contracted position for one to two seconds, focusing on feeling the tension between your shoulder blades. | Slowly reverse the movement, allowing your shoulder blades to protract and your arms to return to the start position. | Reset your posture if needed, then repeat for the desired number of reps.

t: Sit upright on a bench, chair, or the floor with your feet flat and your knees bent at roughly 90°. Keep your hips square and facing forward throughout the movement. | Cross your arms over your chest, or extend them straight out in front of you at shoulder height — whichever feels more stable. | Sit tall, lengthen your spine, and brace your core lightly so your lower back stays neutral rather than rounded. | Exhale and rotate your torso to the right as far as you can without letting your hips shift or your lower back collapse. Lead with your chest, not your shoulders. | Pause briefly at the end of your range of motion, feeling the stretch in your left side and the contraction in your right oblique. | Inhale and rotate smoothly back through the center. | Continue to the left side in the same controlled manner, pausing at the end range before returning to center. | Alternate sides for the target number of repetitions, keeping the movement deliberate and the pace steady throughout.
tRu: Sit upright on a bench, chair, or the floor with your feet flat and your knees bent at roughly 90°. Keep your hips square and facing forward throughout the movement. | Перекрестите руки на груди или выпрямите их прямо перед собой на уровне плеч — whichever feels more stable. | Sit tall, lengthen your spine, and brace your core lightly so your lower back stays neutral rather than rounded. | Выдыхайте и поверните корпус вправо настолько, насколько можете, не позволяя тазу смещаться или пояснице прогибаться. Ведите грудью, а не плечами. | На мгновение остановитесь в конечной точке амплитуды, ощущая растяжение по левой стороне и сокращение по правой косой мышце живота. | Вдохните и плавно вернитесь через центр. | Продолжайте движение влево в том же контролируемом manner, задерживаясь в конечной точке перед возвратом в центр. | Чередуйте стороны целевое число повторений, выполняя движение осознанно и держа ровный темп.
tHe: Sit upright on a bench, chair, or the floor with your feet flat and your knees bent at roughly 90°. Keep your hips square and facing forward throughout the movement. | חצה את הידיים לפני החזה, או פרוש אותן ישר לפניך בגובה כתפיים — לפי מה שמרגיש יותר יציב. | Sit tall, lengthen your spine, and brace your core lightly so your lower back stays neutral rather than rounded. | נשוף וסובבו את הגוף לצד ימין כמה שאתם יכולים מבלי להזיז את האגן או להתמוטטות בגב התחתון. הובילו עם החזה, לא עם הכתפיים. | Pause briefly at the end of your range of motion, feeling the stretch in your left side and the contraction in your right oblique. | Inhale and rotate smoothly back through the center. | המשך לצד השמאל באותה דרך מבוקרת, עוצר לרגע בקצה הטווח לפני החזרה למרכז. | החלף צדדים למספר החזרות שנקבע, תוך שמירה על תנועה מכוונת וקצב יציב לאורך כל התנועה.

t: Place a stability ball on a flat, non-slip surface and sit centered on top of it with your feet flat on the floor, roughly hip-width apart. | Sit tall, stacking your hips beneath your shoulders and lifting the crown of your head toward the ceiling; avoid rounding the lower back or leaning to either side. | Brace your core lightly — imagine drawing your navel gently inward — to stabilize your pelvis on the ball. | Let your arms hang naturally at your sides with a slight bend in the elbows and your palms facing your body. | Inhale to prepare, then exhale as you slowly raise both arms out to the sides in a wide arc, like a ballerina opening her arms, until they reach approximately shoulder height. | Hold the raised position for one to two seconds, keeping your shoulders pulled down away from your ears and your wrists relaxed. | Inhale as you lower your arms with control back to the starting position, resisting gravity rather than letting them drop. | Repeat for the desired number of reps, maintaining a steady upright posture and stable ball throughout every repetition.
tRu: Поставьте мяч для стабилизации на flat, non-slip surface and sit centered on top of it with your feet flat on the floor, roughly hip-width apart. | Sit tall, stacking your hips beneath your shoulders and lifting the crown of your head toward the ceiling; avoid rounding the lower back or leaning to either side. | Легко напрягите пресс — представьте, что мягко втягиваете пупок, — чтобы стабилизировать таз на мяче. | Пусть ваши руки естественно свисают по боками с небольшим сгибанием в локтях и ладонями, обращенными к телу. | Вдыхайте, чтобы подготовиться, затем выдыхайте, когда медленно поворачиваете корпус вправо насколько это комфортно. | Держите поднятую положение в течение одного-двух секунд, удерживая плечи опущенными, а запястья расслабленными. | Выдохните, опуская руки с контролем обратно в исходное положение, сопротивляясь силе тяжести, а не позволяя им резко опускаться. | Repeat for the desired number of reps, maintaining a steady upright posture and stable ball throughout every repetition.

t: Sit upright on the floor or the edge of a bench with your legs straight out in front of you or feet flat on the floor, depending on your setup. | Place your hands at your sides with your palms facing inward toward your hips. | Brace your core gently and lengthen your spine, sitting tall with your chest lifted and your chin level. | Draw your shoulder blades back and together to set your upper back before the movement begins. | Keeping your arms straight, raise both arms behind your body as high as your range of motion allows without rounding your spine or lifting your shoulders toward your ears. | Hold the top position for one to two seconds, squeezing the muscles between and around your shoulder blades. | Lower your arms slowly and under control back to the starting position. | Reset your posture between repetitions if needed, then repeat for the target number of reps.
tRu: Sit upright on the floor or the edge of a bench with your legs straight out in front of you or feet flat on the floor, depending on your setup. | Положите руки по бокам, ладонями обращенными внутрь к бедрам. | Слегка напрягите пресс и вытяните позвоночник, сидя прямо с поднятой грудью и подбородком параллельно полу. | Отведите лопатки назад и вместе, чтобы зафиксировать верхнюю часть спины перед началом движения. | Держа руки прямыми, поднимите обе руки за тело как позволяет ваша амплитуда движения, не округляя спину и не поднимая плечи к ушам. | Задержитесь в верхней позиции на одну-две секунды, сжимая мышцы между и вокруг лопаток. | Медленно опустите руки обратно в исходное положение. | Reset your posture between repetitions if needed, then repeat for the target number of reps.

nE: Seated Bent Knee To Chest Buttock Stretch
nR: Растяжка ягодиц с коленом к груди сидя
t: Sit upright on the edge of a sturdy chair or bench with your feet flat on the floor and your spine tall. | Lift your right foot off the floor and interlace your fingers just below your right knee. | Keeping your back straight, gently draw your right knee up toward your chest as far as your flexibility allows. | Hold the position, breathing steadily and avoiding any rounding of your lower back. | Hold for 20–30 seconds, feeling the stretch deepen across your right glute and the back of your hip. | Slowly lower your right foot back to the floor with control. | Repeat the stretch on the left side, drawing the left knee toward your chest in the same manner. | Complete the desired number of holds on each side.
tRu: Sit upright on the edge of a sturdy chair or bench with your feet flat on the floor and your spine tall. | Поднимите правую ногу с пола и переплетите пальцы чуть ниже правого колена. | Держа спину прямо, плавно поднимите правое колено к груди насколько позволяет ваша гибкость. | Держите положение, дыша ровно и избегая любого округления нижней части спины. | Держитесь 20–30 секунд или столько, сколько комфортно, не задерживая дыхание. | Медленно и подконтрольно верните правую стопу на пол. | Repeat the stretch on the left side, drawing the left knee toward your chest in the same manner. | Выполните желаемое количество удержаний на каждую сторону.

t: Sit on the floor or a chair with one or both legs extended in front of you, knees straight and heels resting on the surface. | Sit tall with a neutral spine — avoid rounding your lower back, as this reduces the stretch in the lower leg. | Loop a towel, resistance band, or your hands around the ball of your foot and the toes. | Gently pull the foot back toward your shin (dorsiflexion) until you feel a clear stretch along the back of the calf and lower leg. | Hold the end position for 20–30 seconds, breathing steadily and letting the muscle relax into the stretch. | Release the pull slowly, then repeat on the other leg. | Complete 2–3 holds per side, progressively pulling the foot a little further back as the tissue releases.
tRu: Sit on the floor or a chair with one or both legs extended in front of you, knees straight and heels resting on the surface. | Sit tall with a neutral spine — avoid rounding your lower back, as this reduces the stretch in the lower leg. | Оберните полотенце, эспандер или руками вокруг стопы и пальцев ноги. | Аккуратно потяните стопу к голени (тыльное сгибание), пока не почувствуете явное растяжение по задней поверхности икры и нижней ноги. | Задержите конечное положение на 20–30 секунд, дышите ровно и позволяйте мышце расслабиться в растяжке. | Release the pull slowly, then repeat on the other leg. | Выполните 2–3 удержания на каждую сторону, постепенно отводя ногу чуть дальше назад по мере расслабления тканей.
tHe: Sit on the floor or a chair with one or both legs extended in front of you, knees straight and heels resting on the surface. | Sit tall with a neutral spine — avoid rounding your lower back, as this reduces the stretch in the lower leg. | Loop a towel, resistance band, or your hands around the ball of your foot and the toes. | משוך בעדינות את כף הרגל לאחור לכיוון השוק (כיפוף) עד שתרגיש מתיחה ברורה לאורך חלקו האחורי של השוק והרגל התחתונה. | Hold the end position for 20–30 seconds, breathing steadily and letting the muscle relax into the stretch. | Release the pull slowly, then repeat on the other leg. | בצע 2–3 החזקות לכל צד, מושך את הרגל בהדרגה קצת יותר אחורה ככל שהרקמה משתחררת.

t: Sit on the floor with your legs extended straight out in front of you and your spine tall. | Loop a towel, resistance band, or stretching strap around the ball of one foot, holding one end in each hand. | Keep the target leg straight and the knee pressed gently toward the floor to ensure the gastrocnemius is fully engaged in the stretch. | Gently pull both ends of the strap toward you, drawing the foot into dorsiflexion — toes pointing back toward your shin — until you feel a firm stretch through the calf. | Hold the stretched position for 20–30 seconds, breathing steadily and avoiding any bouncing or jerking. | Slowly release tension on the strap and allow the foot to return to a neutral position. | Repeat on the opposite leg, performing 2–3 holds per side.
tRu: Сядьте на пол, выпрямив ноги перед собой и вытянув позвоночник вверх. | Оберните полотенце, эспандер или растягивающий ремень вокруг стопы одной ноги, держа один конец в каждой руке. | Держите целевую ногу прямой и колено мягко прижатым к полу, чтобы икроножная мышца была полностью вовлечена в растяжку. | Аккуратно потяните обе ends of the strap к себе, отводя стопу в тыльное направление — пальцы направлены к голени — пока не почувствуете устойчивое растяжение икроножных мышц. | Держите растянутое положение 20–30 секунд, дыша ровно и избегая любых рывков или толчков. | Slowly release tension on the strap and allow the foot to return to a neutral position. | Повторите на противоположной ноге, выполнив 2–3 удержания на каждую сторону.
tHe: שב על הרצפה עם רגליים ישרות לפנים ועמוד שדרה זקוף. | Loop a towel, resistance band, or stretching strap around the ball of one foot, holding one end in each hand. | Keep the target leg straight and the knee pressed gently toward the floor to ensure the gastrocnemius is fully engaged in the stretch. | משוך בעדינות את שני קצות הרצועה לכיוונך, והביא את כף הרגל לכיפוף — האצבעות נשכות לאחור לכיוון השוק — עד שתרגיש מתיחה החלטית בשוק. | Hold the stretched position for 20–30 seconds, breathing steadily and avoiding any bouncing or jerking. | Slowly release tension on the strap and allow the foot to return to a neutral position. | חזור על התרגיל ברגל הנגדית, בצע 2–3 החזקות לכל צד.

t: Sit upright on a chair or bench with your feet flat on the floor and your spine in a neutral position. | Raise both arms to chest height and bend your elbows to roughly 90 degrees so your forearms point forward and your palms face each other. | Press your forearms and the backs of your hands together at the midline, creating tension across your chest. | Maintaining that tension, slowly open your arms outward like a clamshell opening, stopping when your elbows are in line with or slightly behind your shoulders. | Pause briefly at the open position, feeling a stretch across the chest and front shoulders. | Drive your arms back together at the midline under control, squeezing your pectorals as your forearms meet. | Keep your shoulders down and away from your ears throughout the entire movement. | Complete the desired number of repetitions, maintaining consistent tension and a tall seated posture throughout.
tRu: Sit upright on a chair or bench with your feet flat on the floor and your spine in a neutral position. | Raise both arms to chest height and bend your elbows to roughly 90 degrees so your forearms point forward and your palms face each other. | Press your forearms and the backs of your hands together at the midline, creating tension across your chest. | Сохраняя это напряжение, медленно откройте руки наружу, как открываются створки ракушки, остановившись, когда локти окажутся на уровне или немного позади плеч. | На мгновение остановитесь в открытом положении, ощущая растяжку по груди и передней части плеч. | Отводите руки назад под контролем к средней линии, сжимая грудные мышцы, когда предплечья сходятся. | Держите плечи опущенными и вдали от ушей на протяжении всего движения. | Выполните желаемое количество повторений, сохраняя постоянное напряжение и прямое положение сидя.

nE: Seated Chest Press on a Chair
t: Sit tall on the edge of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. | Bring both hands together in front of your chest, palms flat against each other and fingers pointing upward. | Position your elbows at roughly shoulder height, arms parallel to the floor. | Press your palms firmly into each other, creating maximum resistance between both hands. | Hold the contraction and feel the squeeze across the center of your chest. | Breathe steadily — exhale as you increase pressure, inhale as you ease off. | Maintain the press for the desired duration (typically 5–10 seconds per rep). | Release the pressure slowly and rest briefly between repetitions. | Complete 3–4 sets of 8–12 contractions, resting 30–60 seconds between sets.
tRu: Sit tall on the edge of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. | Соедините обе руки перед грудью, ладонями прижатыми друг к другу и пальцами, направленными вверх. | Position your elbows at roughly shoulder height, arms parallel to the floor. | Press your palms firmly into each other, creating maximum resistance between both hands. | Зафиксируйте сокращение и почувствуйте сжатие по центру вашей груди. | Дышите ровно — выдыхайте при увеличении нагрузки, вдыхайте при ослаблении. | Сохраняйте напряжение в течение желаемого времени (обычно 5-10 секунд на повторение). | Release the pressure slowly and rest briefly between repetitions. | Выполните 3–4 подхода по 8–12 сокращений, отдыхая 30–60 секунд между подходами.

t: Sit upright in a chair with your feet flat on the floor, your spine tall, and your shoulders relaxed and level. | Look straight ahead so your gaze is parallel to the floor and your ears are directly above your shoulders. | Without tilting your head up or down, gently draw your chin straight back as if sliding it along a horizontal rail. | Hold the retracted position for 2–3 seconds, feeling a mild stretch at the base of your skull and light tension in the front of your neck. | Slowly return your head to the neutral starting position — do not let it drift forward past neutral. | Repeat for the prescribed number of reps, keeping each repetition smooth and deliberate.

t: Position a low bar (such as a smith machine bar or sturdy horizontal bar) at roughly hip height when seated, then sit on the floor directly beneath it with your legs extended straight in front of you. | Reach up and grip the bar with a supinated (underhand/palms-facing-you) grip, hands shoulder-width apart. | Extend your arms fully so your body hangs at an angle with only your heels on the floor — this is your starting position. | Brace your core, squeeze your glutes, and keep your body in a straight line from heels to shoulders throughout the movement. | Pull your chest up toward the bar by driving your elbows down and back, initiating the movement from your lats and upper back rather than your arms. | Continue pulling until your chest touches or comes close to the bar, and briefly squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top. | Lower yourself in a slow, controlled manner back to the starting position with arms fully extended, resisting gravity on the way down. | Reset your body position if needed and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tRu: Position a low bar (such as a smith machine bar or sturdy horizontal bar) at roughly hip height when seated, then sit on the floor directly beneath it with your legs extended straight in front of you. | Reach up and grip the bar with a supinated (underhand/palms-facing-you) grip, hands shoulder-width apart. | Полностью вытяните руки так, чтобы тело висело под углом, а на полу оставались только пятки — это ваше исходное положение. | Напрягите корпус, сожмите ягодицы и держите тело в прямой линии от пяток до плеч на протяжении всего движения. | Pull your chest up toward the bar by driving your elbows down and back, initiating the movement from your lats and upper back rather than your arms. | Продолжайте тянуть, пока ваша грудь не коснется или почти не коснется штанги, и на мгновение сожмите лопатки вместе в верхней точке. | Опуститесь медленно и под контролем обратно в исходное положение с полностью выпрямленными руками, сопротивляясь силе тяжести на пути вниз. | Reset your body position if needed and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

t: Set a bar at roughly waist to hip height in a squat rack, Smith machine, or on sturdy parallettes. Sit on the floor directly underneath it. | Extend your legs in front of you with your heels on the floor. Reach up and grip the bar with a supinated (underhand, palms facing you) grip, hands approximately shoulder-width apart. | Straighten your arms fully so your body lifts off the floor at an angle, forming a rigid line from heels to head. Only your heels remain in contact with the ground. | Brace your core and squeeze your glutes to prevent your hips from sagging toward the floor. Maintain this body tension throughout every rep. | Initiate the pull by driving your elbows down and back rather than thinking about curling your hands. Lead with your chest moving toward the bar. | Continue pulling until your chest touches or nearly touches the bar, pausing briefly to feel your shoulder blades fully retracted. | Lower yourself under control back to the starting position, allowing your arms to extend fully before beginning the next rep. | Complete the desired number of reps, then carefully lower your hips to the floor to exit the movement.

Достаньте вверх и возьмитесь за штангу обратным (ладонями к себе) хватом, руки на расстоянии примерно ширины плеч. | Straighten your arms fully so your body lifts off the floor at an angle, forming a rigid line from heels to head. Only your heels remain in contact with the ground. | Напрягите корпус и сожмите ягодицы, чтобы бёдра не провисали к полу. Сохраняйте это напряжение в каждом повторении. | Начните тягу, отводя локти вниз и назад, а не думая о сгибании кистей. Ведите грудью к штанге. | Продолжайте тянуть, пока ваша грудь не коснется или почти не коснется штанги, задерживаясь на мгновение, чтобы почувствовать полное сведение лопаток. | Под контролем вернитесь в исходное положение, позволяя рукам полностью выпрямиться перед началом следующего повторения. | Выполните желаемое количество повторений, затем осторожно опустите таз на пол, чтобы завершить движение.

nE: Seated Knee Up Extended Rotation Stretch

t: Sit on the floor with your legs loosely extended in front of you and your spine tall. | Bend your right knee and draw your right foot in toward your body so the sole rests flat on the floor, with your right thigh angled upward. | Place your left hand on the outside of your right knee for light support without pushing the knee down. | Sit upright and take a slow breath in to lengthen your spine before you rotate. | On the exhale, rotate your torso to the right, leading with your right shoulder moving back and your chest turning toward the right side. | Use your left hand against the outside of your right knee as a gentle anchor to deepen the rotation without forcing it. | Hold the rotated position for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and allowing the hip and outer glute to release with each exhale. | Slowly unwind the rotation and return to the upright starting position. | Repeat on the opposite side, bending your left knee and rotating your torso to the left.

nE: Seated Lean Back on a Chair
t: Sit upright near the front edge of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. | Place your hands on your thighs or cross them over your chest to remove arm support from the movement. | Brace your core lightly and maintain a neutral spine — avoid rounding the lower back. | Begin to slowly lean your torso backward, allowing your back to move away from vertical while keeping your spine long. | Lower only as far as you can control without losing the neutral lumbar curve — typically 30–45 degrees from vertical. | Pause briefly at the bottom of the lean, keeping tension in your back extensors. | Engage your erector spinae to pull your torso back upright to the starting position. | Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, moving in a slow and controlled manner throughout.

nE: Seated Lower Trunk Extensor Lateral Flexor Stretch

t: Sit upright on the floor or a firm surface with both legs extended straight in front of you and your spine tall. | Cross your right ankle over your left so your legs remain roughly parallel and relaxed, or simply keep both legs extended side by side — choose whichever position lets you sit most stably. | Place your left hand on the floor beside your left hip for light support. | Raise your right arm overhead, elongating the right side of your body. | On an exhale, hinge forward from the hips while simultaneously leaning your raised arm and torso diagonally toward the left — combining a forward fold with a side bend so you feel the stretch across your lower back and right flank. | Lower your right arm gently toward the floor to your left as you deepen the combined lean, letting the right side of your lower trunk lengthen. | Hold the end position for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and allowing the erector spinae, quadratus lumborum, and obliques on the right side to release with each exhale. | Slowly return to the upright starting position on an inhale. | Switch sides — raise your left arm overhead and lean diagonally to the right — and hold for the same duration.

nE: Seated Neck Flexion to Extension on Chair
nR: Наклоны шеи вперёд-назад сидя на стуле
nH: כפיפות צוואר קדימה-אחורה בישיבה על כיסא
t: Sit upright at the front edge of a chair with both feet flat on the floor, your spine tall, and your shoulders relaxed away from your ears. | Place your hands loosely on your thighs so your arms are not supporting or pulling on your head at any point during the movement. | Take a slow breath in to lengthen the spine. | As you exhale, slowly lower your chin toward your chest, letting the neck extensors pay out the descent under control — stop when you feel a firm but comfortable stretch at the back of the neck. | Hold the flexed position for one to two seconds, then breathe in. | As you exhale again, slowly lift your head back through neutral and continue into a gentle extension, tilting the chin upward until you feel a mild stretch along the front of the neck — do not force the head back past a comfortable range. | Hold the extended position for one to two seconds. | Return the head to the neutral, upright position to complete one repetition. | Repeat for 8–12 controlled repetitions, moving smoothly through the full arc each time.

t: Sit upright in a chair or on a mat with your spine tall, shoulders relaxed away from your ears, and feet flat on the floor. | Rest your right hand on top of your head, placing it lightly near the left temple — do not pull yet. | Breathe in to lengthen your spine, then as you exhale, slowly tilt your right ear toward your right shoulder until you feel a gentle stretch along the left side of your neck. | Once you reach a comfortable end range, apply very light downward pressure with your right hand to deepen the stretch slightly. | Hold the position for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and allowing the left side of the neck to soften with each exhale. | Slowly lift your head back to center, release your hand, and pause for a breath before switching sides. | Place your left hand on top of your head near the right temple and repeat the lateral tilt toward your left shoulder, holding for the same duration. | For an optional forward stretch, interlace both hands behind your head and gently guide your chin toward your chest, holding for 20–30 seconds before returning upright.

nR: Махи с раскрытием сидя на стуле

t: Sit upright on the edge of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart, and your core lightly braced. | Raise both arms straight overhead, then clasp your hands together with your palms facing up toward the ceiling. | Keep your upper arms close to your ears and your elbows pointing directly forward — this is your starting position. | Inhale, then slowly bend at the elbows to lower your clasped hands down behind your head until your forearms are roughly parallel to the floor or until you feel a deep stretch in the back of the upper arms. | Pause briefly at the bottom without letting your elbows flare wide or your lower back arch. | Exhale and press your hands back up toward the ceiling by fully extending the elbows, squeezing the triceps at the top. | Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, keeping the motion slow and controlled throughout.

t: Sit tall on a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart, and your back straight away from the backrest. | Raise both arms out to your sides and bend your elbows to 90°, bringing your upper arms parallel to the floor in a goalpost position. | Keep your wrists roughly in line with your elbows and your shoulders pulled slightly back and down — avoid shrugging. | Take a deep breath in, brace your core, and squeeze your chest muscles to drive your elbows toward each other in front of your body. | Continue pressing your elbows together until they meet or nearly meet at chest height, pausing at the peak contraction for one to two seconds. | Slowly reverse the movement, resisting as you open your arms back to the goalpost starting position, maintaining tension through the chest. | Repeat for the desired number of reps, keeping your torso upright and still throughout the set.

t: Sit upright in a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor and your knees bent at roughly 90 degrees. | Lift the toes of one foot slightly so the heel stays lightly in contact with the floor, or raise the whole foot a few centimetres so it hangs free. | Slowly roll the foot inward so the inner edge of the sole lowers toward the floor — this is pronation. | Pause briefly at the end of the inward range, feeling a gentle stretch along the inner lower leg and arch. | Reverse the motion and roll the foot outward so the outer edge lowers toward the floor — this is supination. | Pause briefly at the end of the outward range, feeling a gentle stretch along the outer lower leg. | Return the foot to the neutral starting position to complete one repetition. | Complete all reps on one foot, then switch to the other foot.

t: Sit upright on a stable chair with your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart, and your hands raised in a loose guard position beside your face. | Engage your core and sit tall, keeping your lower back in a neutral position and your chest lifted throughout the exercise. | Initiate the roll by rotating your torso to the right while simultaneously dropping your right shoulder slightly downward and forward, as if slipping under an imaginary punch coming from the right. | Continue the arc by rolling your torso to the left — rising through the center and then rotating left, dipping your left shoulder downward and forward to complete one full rolling cycle. | Reverse the direction smoothly, rolling from left to right to complete the next repetition, keeping the movement fluid and continuous. | Breathe rhythmically throughout: exhale as you dip down through the bottom of each roll, inhale as you rise through the center. | Maintain your guard position with your hands, keeping your elbows close to your body and your chin tucked slightly throughout. | Perform the desired number of rolls at a controlled pace, then return to an upright seated position and lower your hands to rest.
tRu: Sit upright on a stable chair with your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart, and your hands raised in a loose guard position beside your face. | Напрягите корпус и сидите прямо, сохраняя поясницу в нейтральном положении и грудь приподнятой на протяжении всего упражнения. | Начните движение, поворачивая рабочую руку наружу — перемещая тыльную сторону кисти от позвоночника — в то время как полотенце направляет и ограничивает амплитуду движения. | Продолжайте дугу, перекатывая корпус влево — поднимаясь через центр, затем поворачиваясь влево, опуская левое плечо вниз и вперед для завершения одного полного цикла перекатывания. | Reverse the direction smoothly, rolling from left to right to complete the next repetition, keeping the movement fluid and continuous. | Дышите медленно и позвольте лестничным мышцам расслабиться под продолжительным контактом в течение 20–30 секунд. | Сохраняйте защитную позицию руками, держа локти близко к телу и слегка подтянув подбородок. | Выполните желаемое количество перекатываний в контролируемом темпе, затем вернитесь в положение сидя и опустите руки для отдыха.
tHe: Sit upright on a stable chair with your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart, and your hands raised in a loose guard position beside your face. | הפעל את שרירי הליבה וישב ישר, שומר על הגב התחתון בתנוחה נייטרלית ועל החזה מורם לכל אורך התרגיל. | Initiate the roll by rotating your torso to the right while simultaneously dropping your right shoulder slightly downward and forward, as if slipping under an imaginary punch coming from the right. | המשך הקשת על ידי גלגול הגוף כלפי שמאל — עלייה דרך המרכז ואז סיבוב שמאלה, הנמכת הכתף השמאלית כלפי מטה וקדימה כדי להשלים מחזור גלילה מלא. | Reverse the direction smoothly, rolling from left to right to complete the next repetition, keeping the movement fluid and continuous. | נשיר בקצב קבוע לאורך כל התרגיל: נשיר בעת הירידה לתחתית כל גלגול, נשאב בעת העלייה דרך המרכז. | Maintain your guard position with your hands, keeping your elbows close to your body and your chin tucked slightly throughout. | Perform the desired number of rolls at a controlled pace, then return to an upright seated position and lower your hands to rest.

t: Sit upright on a chair or bench with both feet flat on the floor and your hips at roughly 90 degrees. | Place your spine in a neutral, tall position — imagine the crown of your head being gently pulled toward the ceiling. | Cross your arms over your chest or place your hands lightly on your shoulders to remove the arms from the movement. | Inhale to prepare, then exhale slowly as you rotate your torso to the right, initiating the movement from your mid-back rather than your hips or lower back. | Rotate as far as comfortable without forcing — your gaze follows the rotation and your hips stay squared forward. | Hold the end position for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and allowing the stretch to deepen on each exhale. | Gently return to center with control, then repeat the rotation to the left side. | Complete 2–3 holds per side per session, resting briefly between sides.
tRu: Sit upright on a chair or bench with both feet flat on the floor and your hips at roughly 90 degrees. | Согните позвоночник в нейтральное положение, выпрямившись — представьте, что макушку головы мягко тянут к потолку. | Перекрестите руки на груди или поставьте руки на плечи, чтобы исключить руки из движения. | Сделайте вдох, чтобы подготовиться, затем на выдохе медленно поворачивайте корпус вправо, инициируя движение от средней части спины, а не от бёдер или нижней части спины. | Rotate as far as comfortable without forcing — your gaze follows the rotation and your hips stay squared forward. | Зафиксируйте конечное положение на 20-30 секунд, дыша медленно и позволяя растяжке углубляться с каждым выдохом. | Аккуратно вернитесь в центр, контролируя движение, затем повторите поворот влево. | Выполните 2–3 удержания на каждую сторону за тренировку, отдыхая коротко между сторонами.
tHe: Sit upright on a chair or bench with both feet flat on the floor and your hips at roughly 90 degrees. | Place your spine in a neutral, tall position — imagine the crown of your head being gently pulled toward the ceiling. | חצה את הידיים לפני החזה כדי להחזיק את הגומייה במקום, או פרוש את הידיים כדי לכוונן את מתח הגומייה לפי רמת הכוח שלך. | Inhale to prepare, then exhale slowly as you rotate your torso to the right, initiating the movement from your mid-back rather than your hips or lower back. | Rotate as far as comfortable without forcing — your gaze follows the rotation and your hips stay squared forward. | Hold the end position for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and allowing the stretch to deepen on each exhale. | חזור בעדינות למרכז בשליטה, ואז חזור על הסיבוב לצד שמאל. | בצע 2–3 החזקות לכל צד בכל אימון, עם מנוחה קצרה בין הצדדים.

t: Loop a sturdy towel around a fixed anchor — a door handle, a heavy table leg, or a pole — and hold one end in each hand. | Sit on the floor facing the anchor with your knees bent at roughly 90 degrees and your feet flat on the floor, pressing against the base of the anchor or a wall for support. | Extend your arms fully toward the anchor and lean back slightly until the towel is taut and you feel tension in your back. | Brace your core, retract your shoulder blades, and keep your chest tall throughout the movement. | Drive your elbows back and down, rowing your chest toward the anchor while keeping your elbows close to your sides. | Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top of the row, holding the contraction for one second. | Extend your arms slowly under control — taking roughly two seconds — to return to the start position. | Complete all reps, inhaling on the way out and exhaling as you pull.
tRu: Оберните прочное полотенце вокруг фиксированной опоры — ручки двери, ножки массивного стола или опоры — и держите один конец в каждой руке. | Sit on the floor facing the anchor with your knees bent at roughly 90 degrees and your feet flat on the floor, pressing against the base of the anchor or a wall for support. | Полностью вытяните руки к точке крепления и слегка отклонитесь назад, пока полотенце не натянется, и вы почувствуете напряжение в спине. | Напрягите корпус, сведите лопатки и держите грудь расправленной в течение всего движения. | Отведите локти назад и к бокам, ведя движение за счет сжатия лопаток. | Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top of the row, holding the contraction for one second. | Медленно и под контролем выпрямите руки — примерно за две секунды — чтобы вернуться в исходное положение. | Выполните все повторения, вдыхая на отводе и выдыхая при тяге.

nE: Seated Shoulder Flexor Depresor Retractor Stretch
nH: מתיחת כופפי כתף ומקרבי שכמות בישיבה
t: Sit tall on a chair or bench with your feet flat on the floor, hips at roughly 90 degrees, and spine upright. | Reach both arms behind your back and either interlace your fingers or grip the back edge of the chair seat. | Straighten your elbows as much as your flexibility allows, keeping the grip firm. | Inhale to prepare, then on the exhale draw your shoulder blades down away from your ears (depression) and squeeze them together toward your spine (retraction). | Gently lift and extend your clasped hands a few centimetres away from your lower back, increasing the stretch across the front of the shoulders and chest. | Keep your chin level — avoid jutting the head forward or tilting it back. | Breathe slowly and hold the end position for 20–40 seconds, deepening the stretch slightly with each exhale. | To release, soften the shoulder blades, lower your hands, and bring your arms back to your sides.
tRu: Sit tall on a chair or bench with your feet flat on the floor, hips at roughly 90 degrees, and spine upright. | Reach both arms behind your back and either interlace your fingers or grip the back edge of the chair seat. | Straighten your elbows as much as your flexibility allows, keeping the grip firm. | Сделайте вдох, чтобы подготовиться, затем на выдохе опустите лопатки вниз,远离 ушей (депрессия), и сожмите их вместе к позвоночнику (ретракция). | Плавно поднимите и вытяните сцепленные руки на несколько сантиметров от поясницы, увеличивая растяжку в передней части плеч и груди. | Держите подбородок на уровне — не выдвигайте голову вперед и не запрокидывайте ее назад. | Дышите медленно и удерживайте конечную позицию, выдыхая, чтобы плавно углубиться в доступную амплитуду, не форсируя ее. | To release, soften the shoulder blades, lower your hands, and bring your arms back to your sides.

nE: Seated Shoulder Flexor Depresor Retractor Stretch Bent Knee
nR: Растяжка сгибателей/депрессоров/ретракторов плеча сидя с согнутыми коленями
nH: מתיחת כופפי כתף ומקרבי שכמות בישיבה בברכיים כפופות
t: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat, hip-width apart. | Place both hands flat on the floor behind your hips, fingers pointing away from your body or slightly to the sides. | Straighten your arms and shift a small amount of weight into your palms to create a stable base. | Draw your shoulder blades down away from your ears (depression) and squeeze them together toward your spine (retraction). | Gently press your chest forward and upward without arching your lower back excessively. | Keep your chin level and your gaze forward or slightly upward — do not let your head drop back. | Hold the stretched position for 20–40 seconds, breathing steadily throughout. | To release, relax the shoulder blade squeeze, shift your weight forward, and return to a neutral seated posture.
tRu: Сядьте на пол, согнув колени и поставив стопы на ширине бёдер. | Поставьте обе руки на пол за бёдрами, пальцами, направленными от тела или слегка в стороны. | Straighten your arms and shift a small amount of weight into your palms to create a stable base. | Отведите лопатки вниз от ушей (депрессия) и сожмите их вместе к позвоночнику (ретракция). | Аккуратно надавите грудью вперёд и вверх, не выгибая поясницу. | Держите подбородок на уровне и взгляд направлен вперед или немного вверх — не позволяйте голове запрокидываться назад. | Держите растянутое положение 20–40 секунд, дыша ровно на протяжении всего времени. | To release, relax the shoulder blade squeeze, shift your weight forward, and return to a neutral seated posture.
tHe: שב על הרצפה עם ברכיים כפופות וכפות רגליים שטוחות, ברוחב האגן. | Place both hands flat on the floor behind your hips, fingers pointing away from your body or slightly to the sides. | Straighten your arms and shift a small amount of weight into your palms to create a stable base. | משוך את שכמותיך למטה מהאוזנים (דיכוי) ודחיס אותן יחד לעבר עמוד השדרה (משיכה). | לחץ בעדינות עם החזה קדימה ומעלה מבלי לקשת יתר על המידה את הגב התחתון. | Keep your chin level and your gaze forward or slightly upward — do not let your head drop back. | Hold the stretched position for 20–40 seconds, breathing steadily throughout. | To release, relax the shoulder blade squeeze, shift your weight forward, and return to a neutral seated posture.

nE: Seated Shoulder Press on a Chair
t: Sit on the front edge of a sturdy, non-rolling chair with your feet flat on the floor and hip-width apart. | Place your hands on the front corners of the chair seat just outside your hips, fingers pointing forward, wrists stacked directly below your shoulders. | Sit tall, brace your core lightly, and depress your shoulder blades down and back — this is your start position. | Inhale to prepare, then exhale and press firmly through both palms, driving your shoulders down and away from your ears to lift your hips one to two inches off the seat. | Hold the elevated position for two counts, keeping the shoulders packed and the elbows slightly bent rather than fully locked. | Slowly lower your hips back onto the chair seat with control, absorbing the descent through the shoulders and triceps. | Reset your posture — spine tall, shoulders depressed — before initiating the next repetition. | Repeat for the desired number of reps, maintaining a slow, controlled tempo on both the press and the descent.
tRu: Sit on the front edge of a sturdy, non-rolling chair with your feet flat on the floor and hip-width apart. | Положите руки на передние углы сиденья стула снаружи от бёдер, пальцами вперёд, запястьями прямо под плечами. | Sit tall, brace your core lightly, and depress your shoulder blades down and back — this is your start position. | Вдыхайте, чтобы подготовиться, затем выдыхайте и сильно нажимайте на ладони, опуская плечи вниз и от ушей, чтобы приподнять бедра на один-два дюйма над сиденьем. | Зафиксируйте приподнятое положение на два счета, удерживая плечи опущенными, а локти слегка согнутыми, а не полностью выпрямленными. | Slowly lower your hips back onto the chair seat with control, absorbing the descent through the shoulders and triceps. | Reset your posture — spine tall, shoulders depressed — before initiating the next repetition. | Repeat for the desired number of reps, maintaining a slow, controlled tempo on both the press and the descent.

nE: Seated Shoulder Tap on a Chair
t: Sit at the very edge of a sturdy chair and place both hands on the front corners of the seat, fingers pointing forward, directly below your shoulders. | Press through your palms to lift your hips slightly off the seat so your arms are supporting most of your body weight. | Brace your core and keep your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart, to stabilize your lower body. | Keeping your hips level and your supporting arm fully extended, lift your right hand off the seat and tap your left shoulder. | Return your right hand to the seat under control before it touches down. | Immediately lift your left hand and tap your right shoulder, maintaining hip position throughout. | Continue alternating sides for the target number of taps per side, moving at a slow, controlled pace. | When the set is complete, lower your hips fully back onto the seat.
tRu: Sit at the very edge of a sturdy chair and place both hands on the front corners of the seat, fingers pointing forward, directly below your shoulders. | Press through your palms to lift your hips slightly off the seat so your arms are supporting most of your body weight. | Напрягите корпус и держите стопы прижатыми к полу на ширине бёдер, чтобы стабилизировать нижнюю часть тела. | Держа бёдра на уровне и опорную руку полностью выпрямленной, поднимите правую руку с сиденья и коснитесь левым плечом. | Return your right hand to the seat under control before it touches down. | Сразу же поднимите левую руку и коснитесь правого плеча, сохраняя положение бёдер на протяжении всего движения. | Продолжайте поочередно выполнять движения на разные стороны в течение целевого количества касаний на каждую сторону, двигаясь в медленном и контролируемом темпе. | When the set is complete, lower your hips fully back onto the seat.

nE: Seated Side Bend on a Chair
nR: Наклоны в сторону сидя на стуле
t: Sit upright on a chair with both feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart, and your spine tall. | Place your left hand on your left thigh or grip the side of the seat for light support. | Raise your right arm straight overhead with your palm facing inward. | Inhale to prepare, then exhale as you slowly bend your torso to the left, reaching your right arm up and over toward the left side. | Keep both sit bones pressing evenly into the seat — do not let your right hip lift off the chair. | Lower only as far as you can control without collapsing the torso or rotating the chest. | Pause briefly at the end range, then inhale and use your right-side lateral muscles to pull your torso back to upright. | Complete all reps on one side before switching arms and repeating on the other side. | Perform 10–15 controlled reps per side for 2–3 sets.
tRu: Sit upright on a chair with both feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart, and your spine tall. | Положите левую руку на левое бедро или возьмитесь за сторону сиденья для лёгкой поддержки. | Raise your right arm straight overhead with your palm facing inward. | Вдыхайте, чтобы подготовиться, затем выдыхайте, когда медленно поднимаете руку с поверхности, поднимая ее как можно выше, не поворачивая корпус и не поднимая плечо к уху. | Держите обе седалищные кости равномерно прижатыми к сиденью — не позволяйте вашему правому бедру отрываться от стула. | Опуститесь только настолько, насколько можете контролировать, не допуская обвисания корпуса или вращения груди. | На мгновение остановитесь в конечной точке амплитуды, затем вдохните и используйте мышцы правой стороны туловища, чтобы вернуть корпус в вертикальное положение. | Выполните все повторения на одной стороне перед тем, как сменить руки и повторить на другой стороне. | Выполняйте 10–15 контролируемых повторений на каждую сторону в 2–3 подхода.

nE: Seated Side-to-Side Leg Raise Crunch on Floor
nR: Боковые подъёмы ног со скручиванием сидя на полу
nH: הרמות רגליים מצד לצד עם כפיפות בישיבה על הרצפה
t: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat. Place your hands lightly behind your head or cross them over your chest. | Lean your torso back slightly until your core engages, keeping your spine neutral rather than rounded. | Lift both feet a few inches off the floor to establish the starting position, maintaining the slight trunk lean. | Crunch your torso toward the right while simultaneously drawing your right knee toward your chest. | Return your torso to center and lower your right foot back to the hover position without letting it touch the floor. | Crunch your torso toward the left while simultaneously drawing your left knee toward your chest. | Return to center and lower your left foot to complete one full repetition. | Continue alternating sides for the desired number of reps, keeping your lower back from touching the floor between reps.
tRu: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat.
