t: Sit upright near the front edge of a sturdy chair so your thighs are not fully supported and your feet rest flat on the floor. | Fold a standard hand towel lengthwise and loop it around the ankle or lower shin of one leg, holding one end in each hand. | Lift the foot of the working leg a few centimeters off the floor so the leg is unsupported and the towel is taut around your lower leg. | Keeping your torso upright and your core lightly braced, drive your heel toward the back of the chair by bending the knee — aim for a 90-degree angle or as far as your flexibility allows. | As your knee bends, pull gently on both ends of the towel to resist the motion, adding manual load and creating tension through the hamstrings. | Pause briefly at the end of the range of motion, feeling the hamstrings contract. | Slowly straighten the leg back to the starting position while maintaining towel tension, controlling the movement on the way down. | Complete all reps on one side before switching the towel to the other leg and repeating.
tRu: Sit upright near the front edge of a sturdy chair so your thighs are not fully supported and your feet rest flat on the floor. | Сложите стандартное полотенце вдоль и оберните его вокруг лодыжки или нижней части голени одной ноги, держа один конец в каждой руке. | Приподнимите стопу рабочей ноги на несколько сантиметров от пола, чтобы нога была неподдерживаема, и полотенце было натянуто вокруг голени. | Держа туловище прямо и колено на одной высоте, медленно поверните правое бедро внутрь, чтобы стопа качнулась к срединной линии тела. | Сгибая колено, мягко тяните за оба конца полотенца, сопротивляясь движению и создавая напряжение в бицепсах бедра. | На мгновение остановитесь в конце амплитуды, чувствуя сокращение бицепсов бедра. | Slowly straighten the leg back to the starting position while maintaining towel tension, controlling the movement on the way down. | Выполните все повторения на одной стороне перед тем, как перенести полотенце на другую ногу и повторить.
tHe: Sit upright near the front edge of a sturdy chair so your thighs are not fully supported and your feet rest flat on the floor. | קפל מגבת יד רגילה לאורך והשחל אותה סביב הקרסול או השוק התחתון של רגל אחת, כשקצה אחד בכל יד. | Lift the foot of the working leg a few centimeters off the floor so the leg is unsupported and the towel is taut around your lower leg. | Keeping your torso upright and your core lightly braced, drive your heel toward the back of the chair by bending the knee — aim for a 90-degree angle or as far as your flexibility allows. | בכיפוף הברך, משוך בעדינות בשני קצות המגבת כדי להתנגד לתנועה, תוך הוספת עומס ידני ויצירת מתח דרך ההמסטרינג. | Pause briefly at the end of the range of motion, feeling the hamstrings contract. | Slowly straighten the leg back to the starting position while maintaining towel tension, controlling the movement on the way down. | בצע את כל החזרות בצד אחד לפני העברת המגבת לרגל השנייה וחזרה על התרגיל.

t: Sit upright on a sturdy chair or bench with your feet flat on the floor and your back away from the backrest. | Place your hands on the sides of the seat or your thighs for light support. | Lift one foot a few centimetres off the floor so the working leg is free to move. | Slowly extend that knee until the leg is as straight as you can comfortably hold it, parallel to the floor. | Pause for one to two seconds at the top, squeezing the quadriceps. | Lower the foot back toward the floor in a controlled manner until it nearly touches, then stop before setting it down. | Complete all reps on one leg, then switch sides.
tRu: Сядьте прямо на устойчивый стул или скамью, поставив стопы на пол и оторвав спину от спинки. | Положите руки на стороны сиденья или на бёдра для лёгкой поддержки. | Приподнимите одну стопу на несколько сантиметров от пола, чтобы рабочая нога могла свободно двигаться. | Slowly extend that knee until the leg is as straight as you can comfortably hold it, parallel to the floor. | Пауза на одну-две секунды в верхней точке, сжимая квадрицепсы. | Плавно опустите ногу к полу, остановившись, прежде чем поставить её. | Выполните все повторения на одну ногу, затем поменяйте стороны.
tHe: שב זקוף על כיסא יציב או ספסל עם כפות רגליים שטוחות על הרצפה והגב מנותק מהמשענת. | Place your hands on the sides of the seat or your thighs for light support. | Lift one foot a few centimetres off the floor so the working leg is free to move. | Slowly extend that knee until the leg is as straight as you can comfortably hold it, parallel to the floor. | Pause for one to two seconds at the top, squeezing the quadriceps. | Lower the foot back toward the floor in a controlled manner until it nearly touches, then stop before setting it down. | בצע את כל החזרות ברגל אחת, ואז החלף צדדים.

t: Sit upright on a sturdy chair or bench with your feet flat on the floor and your back away from the backrest. | Place your hands on the sides of the seat or on your thighs for light support. | Lift one foot slightly off the floor so the working leg hangs freely. | Brace your core and sit tall with a neutral spine throughout the movement. | Slowly straighten the working leg by extending the knee until the leg is nearly parallel to the floor. | Pause briefly at the top, squeezing the quadriceps. | Lower the foot back toward the floor in a controlled manner, stopping just before it touches. | Complete all reps on one side before switching to the other leg.
tRu: Сядьте прямо на устойчивый стул или скамью, поставив стопы на пол и оторвав спину от спинки. | Положите руки на стороны сиденья или на бёдра для лёгкой поддержки. | Приподнимите одну стопу немного от пола, чтобы рабочая нога свободно свисала. | Напрягите корпус и сидите прямо, сохраняя нейтральное положение позвоночника в течение всего движения. | Slowly straighten the working leg by extending the knee until the leg is nearly parallel to the floor. | Задержитесь на мгновение в верхней точке, сжимая квадрицепс. | Плавно опустите ногу к полу, остановившись, прежде чем она коснётся пола. | Выполните все повторения на одну сторону, затем перейдите на другую ногу.
tHe: שב זקוף על כיסא יציב או ספסל עם כפות רגליים שטוחות על הרצפה והגב מנותק מהמשענת. | Place your hands on the sides of the seat or on your thighs for light support. | Lift one foot slightly off the floor so the working leg hangs freely. | הדק את הליבה ושב זקוף עם עמוד שדרה ניטרלי לאורך כל התנועה. | Slowly straighten the working leg by extending the knee until the leg is nearly parallel to the floor. | Pause briefly at the top, squeezing the quadriceps. | Lower the foot back toward the floor in a controlled manner, stopping just before it touches. | בצע את כל החזרות בצד אחד לפני המעבר לרגל השנייה.

t: Sit upright near the edge of a sturdy chair or bench so your hips are at roughly a 90-degree angle and both feet rest flat on the floor. | Extend one leg out in front of you until it is nearly straight, hovering just above the floor. | Engage your core lightly to keep your torso stable and avoid leaning back. | Slowly curl the extended leg back by bending at the knee, drawing your heel toward the underside of the chair. | Continue the movement until your knee is bent to the fullest comfortable range of motion. | Hold the contracted position for one to two seconds, squeezing the hamstring at the back of your thigh. | Slowly reverse the motion, extending the leg back out to the starting position under control. | Complete all reps on one leg, then switch to the other side and repeat.
tRu: Sit upright near the edge of a sturdy chair or bench so your hips are at roughly a 90-degree angle and both feet rest flat on the floor. | Вытяните одну ногу перед собой до почти прямого положения, удерживая её чуть над полом. | Напрягите корпус лёгким напряжением, чтобы держать туловище стабильным и избегать запрокидывания назад. | Slowly curl the extended leg back by bending at the knee, drawing your heel toward the underside of the chair. | Продолжайте движение, пока колено не согнется до максимально комфортной амплитуды. | Зафиксируйте сокращенное положение на одну-две секунды, сжимая заднюю поверхность бедра. | Slowly reverse the motion, extending the leg back out to the starting position under control. | Выполните все повторения на одной ноге, затем перейдите на другую сторону и повторите.
tHe: Sit upright near the edge of a sturdy chair or bench so your hips are at roughly a 90-degree angle and both feet rest flat on the floor. | פשוט רגל אחת קדימה עד שהיא כמעט ישרה, תלויה מעט מעל הרצפה. | הפעל את שרירי הליבה בעדינות כדי לשמור על יציבות הגו ולמנוע הטיה אחורה. | Slowly curl the extended leg back by bending at the knee, drawing your heel toward the underside of the chair. | המשך את התנועה עד שהברך שלך מכופפת לטווח הנעים המרבי. | Hold the contracted position for one to two seconds, squeezing the hamstring at the back of your thigh. | Slowly reverse the motion, extending the leg back out to the starting position under control. | בצע את כל החזרות בצד אחד, ואז עבור לצד השני וחזור על התרגיל.

t: Sit upright near the front edge of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor and your hands resting on the sides of the seat or in your lap. | Straighten your right leg so the knee is fully extended and the foot hovers just above the floor. | Brace your core and sit tall, avoiding any lean backward in your torso. | Exhale and raise your straight right leg until the thigh is roughly parallel to the floor, or as high as your range of motion allows without rounding your lower back. | Hold the top position for one to two seconds, keeping the knee locked out and the foot flexed. | Inhale and lower the leg in a controlled manner back to the starting position just above the floor. | Complete all reps on the right leg, then switch to the left leg and repeat for the same number of reps.
tRu: Sit upright near the front edge of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor and your hands resting on the sides of the seat or in your lap. | Straighten your right leg so the knee is fully extended and the foot hovers just above the floor. | Напрягите корпус и сидите прямо, не отклоняясь назад. | Выдыхайте и поднимите прямую правую ногу, пока бедро не окажется примерно параллельно полу, или насколько позволяет ваша амплитуда движения, не округляя поясницу. | Задержитесь в верхней позиции на одну-две секунды, сохраняя колено полностью выпрямленным и стопу согнутой. | Вдохните и плавно опустите ногу в исходное положение чуть выше пола. | Выполните все повторения на правой ноге, затем поменяйте на левую ногу и повторите для того же количества повторений.
tHe: Sit upright near the front edge of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor and your hands resting on the sides of the seat or in your lap. | Straighten your right leg so the knee is fully extended and the foot hovers just above the floor. | הדק את הליבה ושב זקוף, תוך הימנעות מכל הישענות לאחור בגוף. | נשוף והרימו את הרגל הימני הישרה עד שהירך מקבילה בערך לרצפה, או כמה שטווח התנועה שלכם מאפשר מבלי לעקם את הגב התחתון. | Hold the top position for one to two seconds, keeping the knee locked out and the foot flexed. | Inhale and lower the leg in a controlled manner back to the starting position just above the floor. | בצע את כל החזרות עם הרגל הימינה, ואז החלף לרגל השמאלית וחזור על אותו מספר חזרות.

t: Sit upright on a bench or sturdy chair with both feet flat on the floor and your back tall. | Place the EZ barbell across the toes of one foot, centering it just behind the toe joints so it rests evenly on all five toes. | Keep the heel flat on the floor and the working ankle relaxed throughout the set. | Curl your toes downward and inward, squeezing them under the bar against its weight. | Hold the fully curled position for one to two seconds, feeling the tension through the toe flexors and intrinsic foot muscles. | Slowly uncurl your toes and return them to the flat starting position under control. | Complete all reps on one foot, then move the barbell to the other foot and repeat.
tRu: Sit upright on a bench or sturdy chair with both feet flat on the floor and your back tall. | Положите EZ-штангу на пальцы одной ноги, центрируя ее сразу за суставами пальцев, чтобы она равномерно лежала на всех пяти пальцах. | Держите пятку прижатой к полу, а рабочий лодыжку расслабленной на протяжении всего подхода. | Подогните пальцы ног вниз и внутрь, сжимая их под штангой под ее весом. | Задержите полностью согнутое положение на одну-две секунды, чувствуя напряжение в сгибателях пальцев стоп и мышцах стопы. | Slowly uncurl your toes and return them to the flat starting position under control. | Выполните все повторения на одной ноге, затем перенесите штангу на другую ногу и повторите.
tHe: Sit upright on a bench or sturdy chair with both feet flat on the floor and your back tall. | Place the EZ barbell across the toes of one foot, centering it just behind the toe joints so it rests evenly on all five toes. | Keep the heel flat on the floor and the working ankle relaxed throughout the set. | קפוץ אצבעותיך למטה ופנימה, לחץ אותן מתחת למוט כנגד משקלו. | Hold the fully curled position for one to two seconds, feeling the tension through the toe flexors and intrinsic foot muscles. | Slowly uncurl your toes and return them to the flat starting position under control. | בצע את כל החזרות עם רגל אחת, ולאחר מכן העבר את המוט לרגל השנייה וחזור על התרגיל.

t: Sit upright on a sturdy chair or bench with your feet flat on the floor and your spine tall. | Place an EZ barbell on the floor in front of you so that the knurled shaft rests horizontally within reach of your toes. | Extend one leg slightly and position your foot over the bar so that the pads of your toes rest on top of the EZ barbell shaft. | Press your heel gently into the floor or keep it raised, whichever allows you to isolate the toe flexors. | Curl your toes down and around the bar, squeezing firmly against the knurling to create resistance. | Hold the squeeze for a count of two to three seconds, focusing on full contraction of the toe flexors and the arch of the foot. | Release the grip slowly and allow your toes to extend back to a neutral position. | Complete all reps on one foot, then reposition the bar and repeat with the opposite foot. | Keep your upper body still throughout; only the toes and foot muscles should be working.
tRu: Sit upright on a sturdy chair or bench with your feet flat on the floor and your spine tall. | Поставьте EZ-штангу на пол перед собой так, чтобы рифлёный гриф располагался горизонтально в пределах досягаемости ваших пальцев ног. | Слегка вытяните одну ногу и поставьте стопу на штангу так, чтобы подушечки пальцев опирались на гриф EZ-штанги. | Press your heel gently into the floor or keep it raised, whichever allows you to isolate the toe flexors. | Подогните пальцы ног вниз и вокруг штанги, сжимая ее поверхность для создания сопротивления. | Держите сжатие в течение двух-трёх секунд, концентрируясь на полном сокращении сгибателей пальцев и свода стопы. | Release the grip slowly and allow your toes to extend back to a neutral position. | Выполните все повторения на одной ноге, затем перенесите штангу и повторите с противоположной ногой. | Держите верхнюю часть тела неподвижной; работают только пальцы ног и мышцы стопы.
tHe: Sit upright on a sturdy chair or bench with your feet flat on the floor and your spine tall. | Place an EZ barbell on the floor in front of you so that the knurled shaft rests horizontally within reach of your toes. | פשוט רגל אחת מעט קדימה כך שהרגל מעל המוט כך שכריות אצבעות הרגל נחות על גבול המוט המיוחד. | Press your heel gently into the floor or keep it raised, whichever allows you to isolate the toe flexors. | קפוץ את אצבעותיך למטה ומסביב למוט, לחץ בחוזקה כנגד החריטה כדי ליצור התנגדות. | Hold the squeeze for a count of two to three seconds, focusing on full contraction of the toe flexors and the arch of the foot. | Release the grip slowly and allow your toes to extend back to a neutral position. | בצע את כל החזרות עם רגל אחת, ולאחר מכן הזז מחדש את המוט וחזור עם הרגל הנגדית. | Keep your upper body still throughout; only the toes and foot muscles should be working.

t: Sit upright on a sturdy chair or bench with your feet flat on the floor and your back supported or straight. | Extend one leg slightly forward so that only your heel rests on the floor, with your toes and forefoot elevated off the ground. | Place your hands on your thighs or the sides of the chair for balance — do not use them to assist the leg movement. | Starting with your toes pointing downward (plantarflexed), slowly pull your toes and forefoot up toward your shin as far as your range of motion allows — this is dorsiflexion. | Pause briefly at the top of the movement when your foot is fully dorsiflexed, feeling the contraction in your tibialis anterior. | Slowly lower your foot back to the starting plantarflexed position under control, taking 2–3 seconds on the way down. | Complete all reps on one leg before switching to the other leg.
tRu: Sit upright on a sturdy chair or bench with your feet flat on the floor and your back supported or straight. | Слегка вытяните одну ногу вперед так, чтобы на полу оставался только пятка, а пальцы стопы и передняя часть стопы были подняты. | Положите руки на бёдра или на стороны сиденья для баланса — не используйте их для помощи движению ног. | Starting with your toes pointing downward (plantarflexed), slowly pull your toes and forefoot up toward your shin as far as your range of motion allows — this is dorsiflexion. | Пауза в верхней точке движения, когда стопа полностью согнута в голеностопном суставе, ощущая сокращение передней большеберцовой мышцы. | Slowly lower your foot back to the starting plantarflexed position under control, taking 2–3 seconds on the way down. | Выполните все повторения на одну ногу, затем перейдите на другую ногу.
tHe: Sit upright on a sturdy chair or bench with your feet flat on the floor and your back supported or straight. | פשוט רגל אחת מעט קדימה כך שרק העקב נח על הרצפה, עם אצבעות וכף הרגל מורמות מהקרקע. | Place your hands on your thighs or the sides of the chair for balance — do not use them to assist the leg movement. | Starting with your toes pointing downward (plantarflexed), slowly pull your toes and forefoot up toward your shin as far as your range of motion allows — this is dorsiflexion. | Pause briefly at the top of the movement when your foot is fully dorsiflexed, feeling the contraction in your tibialis anterior. | Slowly lower your foot back to the starting plantarflexed position under control, taking 2–3 seconds on the way down. | בצע את כל החזרות ברגל אחת לפני המעבר לרגל השנייה.

t: Sit upright near the edge of a chair or bench with your feet flat on the floor and your hands resting on your thighs or the sides of the seat for light support. | Extend one leg forward so that only your heel rests on the floor, with your foot hovering just above the ground in a neutral position. | Brace your core lightly and keep your back tall — do not slouch or lean back. | Slowly pull your toes and forefoot upward toward your shin as far as you comfortably can, fully dorsiflexing the ankle. | Pause for one to two seconds at the top of the movement, squeezing the tibialis anterior on the front of your lower leg. | Lower your foot back down in a controlled manner until it nearly returns to the starting position — do not let it drop passively. | Complete all reps on one leg before switching to the other side. | Aim for 2–4 sets of 15–25 repetitions per leg, resting 60–90 seconds between sets.
tRu: Sit upright near the edge of a chair or bench with your feet flat on the floor and your hands resting on your thighs or the sides of the seat for light support. | Вытяните одну ногу вперёд так, чтобы только ваша пятка касалась пола, стопа парила над землёй в нейтральном положении. | Легко напрягите пресс и держите спину ровно — не сутультесь и не отклоняйтесь назад. | Slowly pull your toes and forefoot upward toward your shin as far as you comfortably can, fully dorsiflexing the ankle. | Пауза на одну-две секунды в верхней точке движения, сжимая большеберцовую мышцу на передней поверхности голени. | Опустите ногу обратно вниз под контролем, пока она почти не вернётся в исходное положение — не позволяйте ей пассивно упасть. | Выполните все повторения на одну ногу, затем перейдите на другую сторону. | Выполняйте 2–4 подхода по 15–25 повторений на каждую ногу, отдыхая 60–90 секунд между подходами.
tHe: Sit upright near the edge of a chair or bench with your feet flat on the floor and your hands resting on your thighs or the sides of the seat for light support. | פשוט רגל אחת קדימה כך שרק העקב נח על הרצפה, עם הרגל תלויה מעט מעל הקרקע בתנוחה נייטרלית. | הדק קלות את הליבה ושמור על גב זקוף — אל תתכופף ואל תישען לאחור. | Slowly pull your toes and forefoot upward toward your shin as far as you comfortably can, fully dorsiflexing the ankle. | Pause for one to two seconds at the top of the movement, squeezing the tibialis anterior on the front of your lower leg. | Lower your foot back down in a controlled manner until it nearly returns to the starting position — do not let it drop passively. | בצע את כל החזרות ברגל אחת לפני המעבר לצד השני. | שאף ל-2–4 סטים של 15–25 חזרות לכל רגל, עם מנוחה של 60–90 שניות בין הסטים.

t: Sit upright on a chair or bench with your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. | Extend one foot slightly forward so only the heel rests on the floor, with the toes and forefoot lifted off the ground. | Brace your core lightly and keep your back straight throughout the movement. | Press your toes and forefoot firmly downward toward the floor, curling the toes as if gripping the ground, and hold for one to two seconds. | Slowly release and return the toes to the starting lifted position under control. | Complete all reps on one foot before switching to the other foot.
tRu: Sit upright on a chair or bench with your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. | Вытяните одну ногу немного вперёд, так чтобы только пятка касалась пола, а носки и передняя часть стопы были подняты. | Легко напрягите пресс и держите спину прямой в течение всего движения. | Press your toes and forefoot firmly downward toward the floor, curling the toes as if gripping the ground, and hold for one to two seconds. | Slowly release and return the toes to the starting lifted position under control. | Выполните все повторения на одной ноге, прежде чем перейти на другую.

t: Sit upright on a chair or on the floor with your feet flat and your spine tall. | Place both hands behind your head, fingers interlaced, elbows wide. | Inhale to prepare, then rotate your torso to the right, leading with your right elbow. | As you reach the end of your rotation, extend your thoracic spine and tilt your head back to look upward toward the ceiling. | Hold the top position for one to two seconds, feeling the stretch across your chest and the front of your shoulder. | Exhale as you return your torso to the starting position in a controlled manner. | Repeat for the prescribed number of repetitions on the right side, then perform the same sequence rotating to the left.
tRu: Сядьте прямо на стул или на пол, поставив стопы ровно и вытянув позвоночник вверх. | Поставьте обе руки за голову, пальцы переплетены, локти в стороны. | Сделайте вдох, чтобы подготовиться, затем поверните корпус вправо, ведя правым локтем. | В конце поворота разогните грудной отдел и слегка запрокиньте голову, направив взгляд вверх в потолок. | Задержитесь в верхней позиции на одну-две секунды, ощущая растяжение в груди и передней части плеча. | Выдыхайте, когда возвращаете туловище в исходное положение контролируемым образом. | Repeat for the prescribed number of repetitions on the right side, then perform the same sequence rotating to the left.
tHe: שב זקוף על כיסא או על הרצפה עם כפות רגליים שטוחות ועמוד שדרה זקוף. | Place both hands behind your head, fingers interlaced, elbows wide. | Inhale to prepare, then rotate your torso to the right, leading with your right elbow. | בהגעה לסוף הסיבוב, פשוט את עמוד השדרה החזי והטה את הראש לאחור למבט מעלה לעבר התקרה. | Hold the top position for one to two seconds, feeling the stretch across your chest and the front of your shoulder. | לחץ אוויר בזמן שאתה מחזיר את הגוף למצב ההתחלתי באופן מבוקר. | Repeat for the prescribed number of repetitions on the right side, then perform the same sequence rotating to the left.

t: Sit upright on a bench or sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. | Place an EZ barbell on the floor directly in front of your feet so that the knurled section rests beneath the balls of your feet and toes. | Position your feet so the toes are draped over the top of the bar, with the pads of your toes making contact with the bar. | Brace your core lightly and keep your spine tall and your hands resting on your thighs for stability. | Inhale, then as you exhale, curl and squeeze your toes downward and around the bar as firmly as you can, as if you are trying to grip and lift it with your toes. | Hold the peak contraction for 1–2 seconds, feeling the muscles along the sole of your foot engage. | Slowly release the squeeze and allow your toes to return to a relaxed, flat position. | Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, maintaining controlled pressure throughout each squeeze.

t: Sit on the floor with your legs extended straight in front of you and your back tall. You can sit against a wall for support if needed. | Keep both knees fully locked out and your toes pointing toward the ceiling in a neutral position. | Reach forward and hook your hands around the ball of one foot (or both feet if stretching both at once); if you cannot reach without rounding your back, loop a towel or belt around the foot instead. | Gently pull the top of the foot back toward your shin, flexing at the ankle until you feel a clear stretch through the back of your lower leg. | Hold your spine upright — avoid rounding your lower back to reach further, as this reduces tension on the calf and loads the hamstrings unnecessarily. | Hold the stretched position for 20–45 seconds, breathing steadily and allowing the muscle to relax into the stretch. | Release slowly and repeat on the other side, or repeat the same side for the prescribed number of sets.

t: Sit upright on a sturdy chair or bench with your feet flat on the floor and your hands resting comfortably on your thighs. | Lift your right foot slightly off the floor so it is free to move without restriction. | Point your toes downward toward the floor, as if you are trying to lengthen the top of your foot away from your shin. | While keeping the toes pointed, slowly rotate the sole of your foot inward so it faces toward the midline of your body — this is foot inversion. | Hold this combined position — toes pointed down, sole turned inward — for 20 to 30 seconds, breathing steadily throughout. | Gently release the foot back to a neutral, flat-footed position and rest for a few seconds. | Repeat on the same foot for the desired number of holds, then switch to the left foot and perform the same sequence.

t: Sit upright on a chair, bench, or the floor with your spine tall and your feet flat on the ground. | Cross your right ankle over your left knee so the right foot rests comfortably on the left thigh. | Place your left hand on the right shin just above the ankle to keep the leg stable. | With your right hand, grasp the top of the right foot across the toe joints. | Gently curl the toes downward and pull the top of the foot toward the floor, creating a stretch across the toe extensors on the top of the foot. | At the same time, turn the sole of the foot inward (toward the midline of the body) to engage the foot inverter stretch. | Hold the combined stretch for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and allowing the tissues to relax. | Release gradually, return the foot to a neutral position, and repeat on the opposite side.
tRu: Sit upright on a chair, bench, or the floor with your spine tall and your feet flat on the ground. | Перекрестите правую лодыжку над левым коленом так, чтобы правая стопа удобно лежала на левом бедре. | Положите левую руку на правую голень чуть выше лодыжки, чтобы держать ногу устойчивой. | With your right hand, grasp the top of the right foot across the toe joints. | Плавно согните пальцы стопы и потяните верхнюю часть стопы к полу, создавая растяжку сгибателей пальцев на верхней части стопы. | Одновременно разверните подошву внутрь, к средней линии тела, чтобы включить растяжку инверторов стопы. | Держите комбинированную растяжку в течение 20-30 секунд, дыша медленно и позволяя тканям расслабиться. | Release gradually, return the foot to a neutral position, and repeat on the opposite side.
tHe: Sit upright on a chair, bench, or the floor with your spine tall and your feet flat on the ground. | חצה את קרסול ימין מעל ברך שמאל כך שכף הרגל הימנית נחה בנוחות על הירך השמאלית. | Place your left hand on the right shin just above the ankle to keep the leg stable. | With your right hand, grasp the top of the right foot across the toe joints. | כופף בעדינות את האצבעות מטה ומשוך את גב כף הרגל לכיוון הרצפה, ויצור מתיחה לאורך פושטי האצבעות בגב כף הרגל. | בו זמנית סובב את כף הרגל פנימה לכיוון קו האמצע של הגוף כדי להפעיל את מתיחת שרירי ההיפוך. | Hold the combined stretch for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and allowing the tissues to relax. | Release gradually, return the foot to a neutral position, and repeat on the opposite side.

t: Sit on a sturdy chair or bench with your feet flat on the floor, hips at roughly a 90-degree angle. | Shift your weight slightly to one side and slide the foot of the working leg back so the toes are tucked under and resting on the floor, with the top of the foot facing down. | Keep your heel raised slightly off the floor so the stretch loads the extensor muscles and tendons across the top of the foot. | Gently press down through your toes into the floor, allowing the top of the foot to flatten toward the ground. | Hold the stretched position for 20–30 seconds, breathing steadily and letting the tension across the top of the foot release gradually. | Ease off the stretch, return your foot to a flat position, and rest for a few seconds. | Repeat on the same foot for the desired number of holds, then switch to the other foot.

t: Sit upright on a bench or sturdy chair with both feet flat on the floor and your hands resting on your thighs. | Cross your right ankle over your left knee so the sole of your right foot faces outward and you have clear access to your toes. | Wrap the fingers of your right hand around your right toes and the ball of the foot. | With your left hand, hold your right ankle steady to keep the lower leg from rotating. | Gently pull your toes upward toward your shin — dorsiflexing them — while simultaneously turning the sole of your foot outward, away from the midline of your body (eversion). | Hold this combined position for 20–30 seconds, breathing steadily and allowing the stretch to deepen on each exhale. | Slowly release your toes back to a neutral position without letting them snap back. | Repeat on the left foot by crossing your left ankle over your right knee and performing the same movement. | Complete 2–3 holds per foot per session.

tHe: Sit upright on a bench or sturdy chair with both feet flat on the floor and your hands resting on your thighs. | חצה את קרסול ימין מעל ברך שמאל כך כף הרגל הימניפ פונה החוצה ויש לך גישה ברורה לאצבעות רגלייך. | Wrap the fingers of your right hand around your right toes and the ball of the foot. | With your left hand, hold your right ankle steady to keep the lower leg from rotating. | משוך בעדינות את האצבעות מעלה לכיוון השוק — כיפוף הקרסול — תוך סיבוב בו זמני של כרית כף הרגל החוצה, הרחק מקו האמצע של הגוף (אוורסיה). | Hold this combined position for 20–30 seconds, breathing steadily and allowing the stretch to deepen on each exhale. | Slowly release your toes back to a neutral position without letting them snap back. | Repeat on the left foot by crossing your left ankle over your right knee and performing the same movement. | בצע 2–3 החזקות לכל רגל בכל אימון.

t: Sit upright on a bench or sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor and your spine tall. | Cross one ankle over the opposite knee so the bottom of your foot faces upward and is accessible with your hands. | Wrap your fingers around the top of your toes on the raised foot. | Gently pull all of your toes back toward your shin, creating a stretch along the sole of your foot and the underside of your toes. | Hold the stretch for 20–30 seconds, breathing steadily and allowing the toe flexors to release gradually. | Release the toes slowly back to their natural position. | Repeat on the same foot for the desired number of holds, then switch feet and perform the same stretch on the other side.
tRu: Sit upright on a bench or sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor and your spine tall. | Перекрестите лодыжку одной ноги над коленом противоположной так, чтобы подошва стопы была направлена вверх и доступна для рук. | Wrap your fingers around the top of your toes on the raised foot. | Аккуратно потяните все пальцы ног к голени, создавая растяжение по подошве и нижней стороне пальцев. | Держите растяжку 20–30 секунд, дыша ровно и позволяя сгибателям пальцев постепенно расслабляться. | Release the toes slowly back to their natural position. | Repeat on the same foot for the desired number of holds, then switch feet and perform the same stretch on the other side.
tHe: Sit upright on a bench or sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor and your spine tall. | חצה את קרסול אחד מעל הברך הנגדית כך שתחתית הכף פונה מעלה ונגישה לידיים. | Wrap your fingers around the top of your toes on the raised foot. | משוך בעדינות את כל האצבעות לאחור לכיוון השוק, ויצור מתיחה לאורך כרית כף הרגל ותחתית האצבעות. | Hold the stretch for 20–30 seconds, breathing steadily and allowing the toe flexors to release gradually. | Release the toes slowly back to their natural position. | Repeat on the same foot for the desired number of holds, then switch feet and perform the same stretch on the other side.

t: Sit tall on a stability ball with your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart, and your knees bent at roughly 90 degrees. | Extend your arms straight out in front of you at chest height, hands clasped together or holding a light weight. | Brace your core and sit upright so your spine is neutral, not rounded or overextended. | Slowly rotate your torso to the right, leading with your shoulders and keeping your hips facing forward and still. | Pause briefly at the end of the rotation, feeling the obliques on both sides working to hold the twist. | Return under control to the center, then rotate to the left side in the same controlled manner. | Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions, maintaining a tall spine throughout.

t: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat, hip-width apart. Sit tall so your spine is neutral and your torso is upright. | Extend both arms straight out in front of you at shoulder height, palms facing each other or facing down. Keep your arms parallel to the floor throughout the set. | Lean your torso back slightly — roughly 45° from the floor — until you feel tension in your core. Maintain this angle for the entire set. | Brace your core, then rotate your torso to the right as far as you can without letting your hips shift or your arms drop. | Hold the end position for one count, feeling the contraction in your right oblique. | Return to center in a controlled manner, then rotate to the left side with the same deliberate pace. | Continue alternating sides for the desired number of reps, keeping your arms straight and your lower body still throughout.
tRu: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat, hip-width apart. nE: Seated Underhand Arm Circle on a Chair
nR: Круги руками нижним хватом сидя на стуле
nH: עיגולי ידיים באחיזה תחתית בישיבה על כיסא
t: Sit upright in a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart, and your hands resting on your thighs. | Sit tall, lengthen your spine, and pull your shoulder blades gently down and back to establish a neutral posture. | Raise both arms out to your sides at shoulder height, rotating your forearms so your palms face upward — this is the underhand (supinated) position you will maintain throughout the movement. | Begin tracing slow, controlled circles with both arms simultaneously, starting by moving the arms forward and upward. | Continue the circular path overhead, then back and downward, completing one full rotation while keeping the palms continuously facing upward. | Keep the circles smooth and even, maintaining tension in the shoulders and avoiding any shrugging of the traps toward your ears. | Complete the prescribed number of circles in the forward direction, then pause and reverse the direction, tracing the circles backward for an equal number of repetitions. | Lower your arms and rest briefly between sets, keeping your posture upright throughout.

t: Sit upright on a chair or on the floor with your feet flat and hip-width apart, or cross-legged if on the floor. | Sit tall, lengthening the spine from the base to the crown of your head, and avoid leaning backward. | Bring your arms across your chest or extend them out to the sides at shoulder height, whichever feels comfortable. | Brace your core lightly and keep your hips and lower body still and facing forward throughout the movement. | Inhale to prepare, then as you exhale, rotate your upper body smoothly to the right as far as your range of motion comfortably allows. | Pause briefly at the end of the rotation, feeling the stretch and contraction through the waist. | Inhale as you return your torso to the center. | Exhale and rotate to the left side with the same controlled motion, pausing at the end range. | Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions, maintaining an upright spine and steady breathing throughout.
tRu: Sit upright on a chair or on the floor with your feet flat and hip-width apart, or cross-legged if on the floor. | Sit tall, lengthening the spine from the base to the crown of your head, and avoid leaning backward. | Переместите руки через грудь или вытяните их в стороны на уровне плеч, whichever feels comfortable. | Легко напрягите пресс и удерживайте бёдра и нижнюю часть тела неподвижно, направленными вперёд в течение всего движения. | Вдыхайте, чтобы подготовиться, затем, когда выдыхаете, плавно поворачивайте верхнюю часть тела вправо настолько, насколько позволяет ваш комфортный диапазон движения. | На мгновение остановитесь в конце поворота, чувствуя растяжение и сокращение в области талии. | Вдыхайте, когда возвращаете торс в центральное положение. | Выдыхайте и поверните влево тем же контролируемым движением, сделав паузу в конце амплитуды. | Продолжайте попеременно менять стороны в течение заданного количества повторений, сохраняя прямой позвоночник и ровное дыхание.

nE: Seated Upright Twists on a Chair
t: Sit near the front edge of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart, and your spine tall — do not lean against the backrest. | Cross your arms over your chest, or extend them straight out in front of you at shoulder height, whichever feels more natural. | Brace your core lightly so your lower back stays neutral throughout the movement. | Inhale to prepare, then as you exhale, rotate your upper body to the right as far as you can without letting your hips shift or your lower back round. | Pause briefly at the end of the range, feeling the muscles along the side of your waist engage. | Slowly rotate back to center under control — do not let the torso snap back passively. | Repeat the rotation to the left side, again pausing at the end of range before returning to center. | Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions, keeping your hips and lower body still throughout.

nE: Seated Wrist Ulnar Deviator And Flexor Stretch
t: Sit upright on a chair or bench with your feet flat on the floor and your back away from the backrest. | Extend your right arm in front of you at roughly chest height, elbow straight or very slightly soft. | Rotate your palm to face the floor so your wrist is in a neutral, pronated position. | Curl your fingers and wrist downward into flexion, pointing your fingertips toward the floor. | Simultaneously shift your wrist toward the pinky side, adding ulnar deviation to the flexion. | Reach across with your left hand and wrap your fingers gently over the back of your right hand. | Use your left hand to apply light overpressure, deepening both the flexion and the ulnar deviation until you feel a stretch along the thumb side and top of your right forearm. | Hold the stretch for 20–30 seconds, breathing steadily, then release slowly. | Repeat on the opposite side.

t: Place a foam roller on the floor and kneel behind it with your hands in front of you in a tabletop or push-up position. | Lower the front of your lower leg onto the foam roller so that it sits just below the knee, contacting the tibialis anterior along the outer shin — not the bony shin bone itself. | Support your body weight through your hands and keep your core lightly braced. | Slowly shift your weight forward to roll the foam roller down toward your ankle, moving a few centimeters at a time. | When you reach a tender or tight spot, pause and hold for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and allowing the pressure to soften the tissue. | Continue rolling from just below the knee down to just above the ankle, spending extra time on any areas that feel particularly tense. | Roll back up toward the knee using the same slow, controlled pace. | Complete 1–2 passes on each leg, then switch sides.

t: Kneel on a padded surface with your knees hip-width apart and your feet anchored firmly under a heavy barbell, the base of a sofa, or held down by a partner. | Extend your hips fully so your torso is upright and your body forms a straight line from knees to head. | Hold your arms close to your chest with your palms facing outward, ready to extend and catch yourself near the bottom of the rep. | Take a breath in, brace your core hard, and squeeze your glutes to lock your hips in place. | Slowly lower your torso toward the floor by extending your knees, using your hamstrings to resist gravity. Aim for a controlled four- to six-second descent. | When you can no longer control the descent with your hamstrings, extend your arms and place your palms on the floor close to your body rather than far in front of you. | Press firmly into the floor with both hands to assist your hamstrings in driving your torso back up to the starting position — use only as much push as necessary. | As your torso rises, actively pull with your hamstrings and shift the effort away from your arms as quickly as possible. | Return fully upright, reset your brace, and repeat for the target number of repetitions.
tRu: Встаньте на колени на мягкой поверхности, колени на ширине бедер, стопы firmly anchored под тяжелой штангой, основанием дивана или held down партнером. | Полностью разогните таз, чтобы корпус был прямо, и тело образовывало прямую линию от колен до головы. | Удерживайте руки близко к груди, ладонями наружу, готовясь выпрямить их и поймать себя в нижней точке повторения. | Take a breath in, brace your core hard, and squeeze your glutes to lock your hips in place. | Slowly lower your torso toward the floor by extending your knees, using your hamstrings to resist gravity. Aim for a controlled four- to six-second descent. | When you can no longer control the descent with your hamstrings, extend your arms and place your palms on the floor close to your body rather than far in front of you. | Press firmly into the floor with both hands to assist your hamstrings in driving your torso back up to the starting position — use only as much push as necessary. | Поднимая корпус, активно тяните бицепсами бедра и как можно скорее перенесите усилие с рук. | Return fully upright, reset your brace, and repeat for the target number of repetitions.
tHe: Kneel on a padded surface with your knees hip-width apart and your feet anchored firmly under a heavy barbell, the base of a sofa, or held down by a partner. | הרחק את מפרקי הירכיים לחלוטין כך שהגוף שלך זקוף והגוף שלך יוצר קו ישר מהברכים ועד הראש. | Hold your arms close to your chest with your palms facing outward, ready to extend and catch yourself near the bottom of the rep. | Take a breath in, brace your core hard, and squeeze your glutes to lock your hips in place. | Slowly lower your torso toward the floor by extending your knees, using your hamstrings to resist gravity. Aim for a controlled four- to six-second descent. | When you can no longer control the descent with your hamstrings, extend your arms and place your palms on the floor close to your body rather than far in front of you. | Press firmly into the floor with both hands to assist your hamstrings in driving your torso back up to the starting position — use only as much push as necessary. | בעליית הגו, משוך באופן פעיל עם ההמסטרינג והעבר את המאמץ מהזרועות מהר ככל האפשר. | Return fully upright, reset your brace, and repeat for the target number of repetitions.

t: Position yourself beneath a fixed horizontal bar set at hip to waist height — a Smith machine bar, a low pull-up bar, or a sturdy table edge works well. | Lie on your back with your head just inside the bar and your arms extended overhead so both hands can reach it. | Grip the bar with both hands, palms facing up (supinated grip), arms fully extended above your chest. | Release your non-working hand and place it on your working wrist or forearm to provide light, controlled assistance. | Keeping your core braced and your body straight, pull the bar down toward your hips in a wide arc, leading with straight or slightly soft elbows. | Continue the arc until your hands reach your thighs and your lats are fully contracted, allowing your assisting hand to contribute only as much force as necessary. | Slowly reverse the arc, guiding the bar back overhead under control until your arms are fully extended and you feel a stretch across the lats. | Complete all reps on one side, then switch so the other hand takes the primary role.
tRu: Position yourself beneath a fixed horizontal bar set at hip to waist height — a Smith machine bar, a low pull-up bar, or a sturdy table edge works well. | Лягте на спину с головой, расположенной чуть внутри штанги, и руками, вытянутыми над головой, чтобы обе руки могли до неё дотянуться. | Возьмитесь за штангу обеими руками, ладонями вверх (супинированный хват), руки полностью выпрямлены над грудью. | Release your non-working hand and place it on your working wrist or forearm to provide light, controlled assistance. | Держа корпус напряжённым и тело прямым, опустите штангу к бёдрам по широкой дуге, ведя прямыми или слегка согнутыми локтями. | Продолжайте дугу вверх и над головой, чтобы тарелка прошла прямо над вашей головой с полностью выпрямленными руками. | Slowly reverse the arc, guiding the bar back overhead under control until your arms are fully extended and you feel a stretch across the lats. | Выполните все повторения на одной стороне, затем поменяйтесь, чтобы другая рука выполняла основную роль.
tHe: Position yourself beneath a fixed horizontal bar set at hip to waist height — a Smith machine bar, a low pull-up bar, or a sturdy table edge works well. | Lie on your back with your head just inside the bar and your arms extended overhead so both hands can reach it. | אחוז במוט בשתי הידיים, כפות מעלה (אחיזת סופינציה), זרועות פשוטות לגמרי מעל החזה. | Release your non-working hand and place it on your working wrist or forearm to provide light, controlled assistance. | Keeping your core braced and your body straight, pull the bar down toward your hips in a wide arc, leading with straight or slightly soft elbows. | המשך הקשת עד שהידיים מגיעות לירכיים והשרירים הרחבים מותכצים לחלוטין, מאפשר ליד העוזרת לתרום כוח רק במידה הנחוצה. | Slowly reverse the arc, guiding the bar back overhead under control until your arms are fully extended and you feel a stretch across the lats. | בצע את כל החזרות בצד אחד, ואז החלף כך שהיד האחרת לוקחת את התפקיד הראשי.

t: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your toes pointing slightly outward. | Hinge at the hips and bend your knees to lower into a partial squat, stopping when your thighs are at roughly a 45-degree angle to the floor rather than parallel. | Keep your chest tall, your core braced, and your weight evenly distributed across both feet. | From the semi-squat position, drive explosively through your heels and the balls of your feet to jump straight up. | Extend your hips, knees, and ankles fully at the top of the jump. | Land softly with your knees slightly bent to absorb the impact, returning directly to the semi-squat position. | Maintain a controlled, rhythmic pace, keeping your core engaged throughout each repetition.
tRu: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your toes pointing slightly outward. | Отводите бёдра назад и сгибайте колени, чтобы опуститься в полуприсед, останавливаясь, когда бёдра будут под углом примерно 45 градусов к полу, а не параллельно. | Держите грудь поднятой, корпус напряженным, а вес равномерно распределенным на обеих ногах. | Из положения полуприседа мощно оттолкнитесь пятками и передней частью стопы, чтобы выпрыгнуть вверх. | Полностью разогните таз, колени и лодыжки в верхней точке прыжка. | Приземлитесь мягко, слегка согнув колени для амортизации удара, и сразу вернитесь в положение полуприседа. | Держите быстрый, ритмичный темп, сохраняя напряжение корпуса на протяжении каждого повторения.
tHe: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your toes pointing slightly outward. | כופף בציר הירכיים וכופף את הברכיים לירידה לסקוואט חלקי, ועצור כשהירכיים בזווית של כ-45 מעלות לרצפה ולא מקבילות. | Keep your chest tall, your core braced, and your weight evenly distributed across both feet. | מעמדת חצי הסקוואט, דחוף בעוצמה דרך העקבים וכריות כפות הרגליים כדי לקפוץ ישר מעלה. | פתח את הירכיים, הברכיים והקרסולים במלואם בשיא הקפיצה. | Land softly with your knees slightly bent to absorb the impact, returning directly to the semi-squat position. | Maintain a controlled, rhythmic pace, keeping your core engaged throughout each repetition.

t: Sit upright in a chair or on the floor with your feet flat and accessible. | Lift one foot and rest it across the opposite thigh so you can comfortably reach your toes. | Interlace the fingers of one hand between all five toes, weaving each finger into the gaps as far as is comfortable. | Gently squeeze your hand to spread your toes apart, creating separation between each toe. | Hold the spread position for 20–30 seconds, breathing steadily and allowing the tissues to release. | While holding, you can slowly circle the ankle in both directions to combine toe separation with ankle mobility. | Release the hand grip and let the toes return to their natural position. | Repeat on the other foot.
tRu: Sit upright in a chair or on the floor with your feet flat and accessible. | Приподнимите одну стопу и положите её на противоположное бедро, чтобы можно было удобно дотянуться до носков. | Переплетите пальцы одной руки между всеми пятью пальцами ног, вплетая каждый палец в промежутки насколько это удобно. | Аккуратно сожмите руку, чтобы растопырить пальцы ног, создавая пространство между каждым пальцем. | Держите разведённое положение в течение 20-30 секунд, дыша ровно и позволяя тканям расслабиться. | While holding, you can slowly circle the ankle in both directions to combine toe separation with ankle mobility. | Release the hand grip and let the toes return to their natural position. | Repeat on the other foot.

t: Sit or stand in a comfortable, upright position with your shoulders relaxed. | Extend one arm in front of you with your palm facing down and your elbow slightly soft. | Spread all five fingers apart as wide as you can, creating as much space between each finger as possible. | Hold the fully spread position for 5–10 seconds, feeling the stretch across the top of your hand and into your forearm. | Relax your fingers back to a neutral position, then repeat the spread 3–5 times on the same hand. | To deepen the stretch, use your opposite hand to gently press each finger outward one at a time. | Switch to the other hand and repeat the same sequence. | Perform 2–3 sets per hand, breathing steadily throughout.
tRu: Sit or stand in a comfortable, upright position with your shoulders relaxed. | Вытяните одну руку перед собой, ладонью вниз и с мягким локтем. | Spread all five fingers apart as wide as you can, creating as much space between each finger as possible. | Подержите конечное разведенное положение в течение 5–10 секунд, чувствуя растяжение по тыльной стороне руки и предплечья. | Relax your fingers back to a neutral position, then repeat the spread 3–5 times on the same hand. | To deepen the stretch, use your opposite hand to gently press each finger outward one at a time. | Switch to the other hand and repeat the same sequence. | Выполняйте 2–3 подхода на каждую руку, дыша ровно на протяжении всего движения.
tHe: Sit or stand in a comfortable, upright position with your shoulders relaxed. | פשוט יד אחת קדימה עם כף היד מופנת למטה והמרפק מעט רך. | Spread all five fingers apart as wide as you can, creating as much space between each finger as possible. | Hold the fully spread position for 5–10 seconds, feeling the stretch across the top of your hand and into your forearm. | Relax your fingers back to a neutral position, then repeat the spread 3–5 times on the same hand. | To deepen the stretch, use your opposite hand to gently press each finger outward one at a time. | Switch to the other hand and repeat the same sequence. | Perform 2–3 sets per hand, breathing steadily throughout.

t: Stand facing a smooth wall with your feet hip-width apart and about 15–20 cm away from the wall. | Place both forearms flat against the wall at roughly shoulder height, elbows bent to 90°, with your forearms vertical and hands pointing toward the ceiling. | Gently brace your core and tuck your chin slightly so your neck is long and neutral. | Reach your arms upward by sliding your forearms along the wall, actively pushing your chest away from the wall as you raise your arms. | Continue sliding until your arms are nearly fully extended overhead, keeping both forearms in contact with the wall throughout. | At the top, consciously protract and elevate your shoulder blades — think of pushing the wall away and reaching tall through your fingertips. | Slowly slide your forearms back down to the starting 90° position under control, resisting the urge to let your lower back arch. | Repeat for the desired number of reps, maintaining steady contact between your forearms and the wall on every repetition.
tRu: Stand facing a smooth wall with your feet hip-width apart and about 15–20 cm away from the wall. | Поставьте обе предплечья плоско на стену на уровне примерно плеч, с согнутыми под углом 90° локтями, предплечья вертикально и ладонями, направленными вверх. | Напрягите корпус и слегка подберите подбородок, чтобы шея была длинной и нейтральной. | Reach your arms upward by sliding your forearms along the wall, actively pushing your chest away from the wall as you raise your arms. | Продолжайте скользить, пока ваши руки не окажутся почти полностью вытянуты над головой, сохраняя оба предплечья в контакте со стеной на протяжении всего движения. | Вверху осознанно разведите и поднимите лопатки — представьте, что отталкиваете стену и вытягиваетесь вверх через кончики пальцев. | Slowly slide your forearms back down to the starting 90° position under control, resisting the urge to let your lower back arch. | Repeat for the desired number of reps, maintaining steady contact between your forearms and the wall on every repetition.
tHe: Stand facing a smooth wall with your feet hip-width apart and about 15–20 cm away from the wall. | Place both forearms flat against the wall at roughly shoulder height, elbows bent to 90°, with your forearms vertical and hands pointing toward the ceiling. | הדק בעדינות את הליבה וקפף מעט את הסנטר כך שהצוואר ארוך וניטרלי. | Reach your arms upward by sliding your forearms along the wall, actively pushing your chest away from the wall as you raise your arms. | המשך להחליק עד שהזרועות כמען מושטות למעלה באופן מלא ככל שאפשר, שומר על שתי האמה במגע עם הקיר לכל אורך התרגיל. | בשיא בלוט והרם במכוון את שכמות הכתפיים — דמיין שאתה דוחף את הקיר ומתארך דרך קצות האצבעות. | Slowly slide your forearms back down to the starting 90° position under control, resisting the urge to let your lower back arch. | Repeat for the desired number of reps, maintaining steady contact between your forearms and the wall on every repetition.

t: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and your feet roughly hip-width apart. Rotate both knees to the left so your left shin is in front of you and your right shin is behind you, each forming a 90-degree angle — this is the 90-90 position. | Place your hands lightly on the floor behind you for initial support, keeping your torso upright. | Press the outer edge of your front shin and the inner edge of your rear shin gently into the floor to feel the hip stretch on both sides. | To switch, lift both knees off the floor simultaneously, rotating your hips so your knees pass through center and drop to the opposite side. | Land with your right shin now in front and your left shin behind, re-establishing the 90-90 position on the other side. | Sit tall, minimize leaning on your hands as your mobility improves, and feel the stretch settle into your hips. | Continue alternating sides in a slow, controlled rhythm for the desired number of repetitions.
tRu: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and your feet roughly hip-width apart. Rotate both knees to the left so your left shin is in front of you and your right shin is behind you, each forming a 90-degree angle — this is the 90-90 position. | Положите руки легко на пол за собой для начальной поддержки, сохраняя корпус вертикальным. | Press the outer edge of your front shin and the inner edge of your rear shin gently into the floor to feel the hip stretch on both sides. | To switch, lift both knees off the floor simultaneously, rotating your hips so your knees pass through center and drop to the opposite side. | Приземлитесь мягко, теперь правая голень впереди, левая сзади, устанавливая положение 90-90 с другой стороны. | Sit tall, minimize leaning on your hands as your mobility improves, and feel the stretch settle into your hips. | Продолжайте поочередно выполнять движения на разные стороны в медленном, контролируемом ритме в течение назначенного количества повторений.

Rotate both knees to the left so your left shin is in front of you and your right shin is behind you, each forming a 90-degree angle — this is the 90-90 position. | Place your hands lightly on the floor behind you for initial support, keeping your torso upright. | Press the outer edge of your front shin and the inner edge of your rear shin gently into the floor to feel the hip stretch on both sides. | To switch, lift both knees off the floor simultaneously, rotating your hips so your knees pass through center and drop to the opposite side. | Land with your right shin now in front and your left shin behind, re-establishing the 90-90 position on the other side. | Sit tall, minimize leaning on your hands as your mobility improves, and feel the stretch settle into your hips. | המשיל להחליף צדדים בקצב איטי ומבוקר למספר החזרות הרצוי.

t: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart, spine neutral, and core lightly braced. | Let both arms hang relaxed at your sides with palms facing your thighs. | Keeping the elbow soft (very slightly bent), begin raising one arm out to the side in the frontal plane. | Rotate the arm so the thumb leads the movement as the arm rises past waist height, allowing the shoulder to open naturally. | Continue lifting the arm in a smooth, controlled arc until it reaches full overhead position or the end of your comfortable range. | Pause briefly at the top to feel the stretch across the anterior deltoid, lateral deltoid, and clavicular pec head. | Slowly lower the arm back down along the same arc, maintaining control throughout the descent. | Complete all reps on one side, then repeat on the opposite arm. | Perform 8–12 slow, deliberate repetitions per side for 2–3 sets.
tRu: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart, spine neutral, and core lightly braced. | Позвольте обеим рукам расслабленно свисать вдоль тела ладонями к бёдрам. | Держа локоть мягким (слегка согнутым), начните поднимать одну руку в сторону в фронтальной плоскости. | Rotate the arm so the thumb leads the movement as the arm rises past waist height, allowing the shoulder to open naturally. | Продолжайте поднимать руку в плавном, контролируемом дуге, пока она не окажется в полном положении над головой или в конце вашего комфортного диапазона. | На мгновение остановитесь в верхней точке, чтобы почувствовать растяжение в переднем пучке дельтовидной мышцы, боковом пучке дельтовидной мышцы и ключичной части большой грудной мышцы. | Slowly lower the arm back down along the same arc, maintaining control throughout the descent. | Выполните все повторения на одну сторону, затем повторите с противоположной рукой. | Выполните 8–12 медленных, осознанных повторений на каждую сторону в 2–3 подхода.
tHe: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart, spine neutral, and core lightly braced. | Let both arms hang relaxed at your sides with palms facing your thighs. | Keeping the elbow soft (very slightly bent), begin raising one arm out to the side in the frontal plane. | Rotate the arm so the thumb leads the movement as the arm rises past waist height, allowing the shoulder to open naturally. | המשך להרים את הזרוע בקשת חלקה ומבוקרת עד שהיא מגיעה למצב עמידה מלא מעל הראש או לקצה טווח התנועה הנוח שלך. | Pause briefly at the top to feel the stretch across the anterior deltoid, lateral deltoid, and clavicular pec head. | Slowly lower the arm back down along the same arc, maintaining control throughout the descent. | בצע את כל החזרות בצד אחד, ואז חזור על הזרוע הנגדית. | Perform 8–12 slow, deliberate repetitions per side for 2–3 sets.

t: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, core lightly braced, and chest open. Let both arms hang relaxed at your sides. | Raise one arm straight out to the side to roughly shoulder height (90° of abduction) with your palm facing down. | Begin the articulation by slowly sweeping that arm downward and across the front of your body in a smooth arc, leading with the back of your hand. | Continue the arc until your arm crosses the midline of your body as far as your range of motion comfortably allows, feeling a stretch through the lat, pec, teres major, and triceps. | Pause briefly at end range to allow the tissues to lengthen, without forcing the joint. | Reverse the movement under control, sweeping the arm back out to the starting position along the same arc. | Repeat for the prescribed number of repetitions, then switch to the opposite arm. | Keep your torso still throughout — resist the urge to rotate the trunk to compensate for limited shoulder range.
tRu: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, core lightly braced, and chest open. Let both arms hang relaxed at your sides. | Raise one arm straight out to the side to roughly shoulder height (90° of abduction) with your palm facing down. | Начните движение с медленного ведения этой руки вниз и через переднюю часть тела по плавной дуге, ведя тыльной стороной кисти. | Продолжайте дугу, пока ваша рука не пересечет среднюю линию тела настолько, насколько позволяет ваш комфортный диапазон движения, чувствуя растяжение в широчайшей мышце, большой грудной, большой круглой и трехглавой мышце. | Сделайте короткую паузу в конце амплитуды, чтобы ткани могли растянуться, не форсируя сустав. | Reverse the movement under control, sweeping the arm back out to the starting position along the same arc. | Repeat for the prescribed number of repetitions, then switch to the opposite arm. | Держите корпус неподвижным на протяжении всего движения — сопротивлятесь желанию повернуть туловище, чтобы компенсировать ограниченный диапазон движения в плечах.
