Let both arms hang relaxed at your sides. | Raise one arm straight out to the side to roughly shoulder height (90° of abduction) with your palm facing down. | התחל את התנועה בגריפה איטית של הזרוע מטה ולרוחב קדמת הגוף בקשת חלקה, בהובלת גב כף היד. | המשך הקשת עד שהזרועחוצה את קו האמצע של הגוף כפי שהטווח הנוח של התנועה מאפשר, מרגיש מתיחה בשריר הגב הרחב, החזה, השריר הגדול של הגב והזרוע. | Pause briefly at end range to allow the tissues to lengthen, without forcing the joint. | Reverse the movement under control, sweeping the arm back out to the starting position along the same arc. | Repeat for the prescribed number of repetitions, then switch to the opposite arm. | Keep your torso still throughout — resist the urge to rotate the trunk to compensate for limited shoulder range.

nE: Shoulder Adductor Elevator And Protractor Stretch
t: Stand or sit tall with your spine neutral and your feet hip-width apart if standing. | Raise one arm and reach it across your body at shoulder height, drawing it toward the opposite shoulder. | Use your opposite hand to grasp just above the elbow of the reaching arm and gently pull it closer to your chest. | As you apply the pull, allow your shoulder blade to round forward slightly so the serratus anterior and pectoralis minor are also engaged in the stretch. | Simultaneously let your shoulder shrug upward slightly to load the levator scapulae and upper trapezius portion of the stretch. | Hold the combined position for 20 to 30 seconds, breathing steadily and allowing the muscles to release with each exhale. | Release slowly, lower the arm, and repeat on the opposite side. | Perform 2 to 3 repetitions per side.
tRu: Встаньте или сядьте прямо с нейтральным позвоночником, а если стоите — поставьте ноги на ширине бёдер. | Raise one arm and reach it across your body at shoulder height, drawing it toward the opposite shoulder. | Use your opposite hand to grasp just above the elbow of the reaching arm and gently pull it closer to your chest. | Выполняя тягу, позвольте лопатке слегка скруглиться вперёд, чтобы передняя зубчатая и малая грудная мышцы тоже включились в растяжку. | Simultaneously let your shoulder shrug upward slightly to load the levator scapulae and upper trapezius portion of the stretch. | Держите комбинированное положение в течение 20-30 секунд, дыша ровно и позволяя мышцам расслабляться с каждым выдохом. | Release slowly, lower the arm, and repeat on the opposite side. | Выполните 2–3 повторения на каждую сторону.
tHe: עמוד או שב זקוף עם עמוד שדרה ניטרלי ורגליים ברוחב האגן בעמידה. | Raise one arm and reach it across your body at shoulder height, drawing it toward the opposite shoulder. | Use your opposite hand to grasp just above the elbow of the reaching arm and gently pull it closer to your chest. | בזמן המשיכה, תן לשכמה להתעגל מעט קדימה כדי שגם המסור הקדמי והחזה הקטן ישתתפו במתיחה. | Simultaneously let your shoulder shrug upward slightly to load the levator scapulae and upper trapezius portion of the stretch. | Hold the combined position for 20 to 30 seconds, breathing steadily and allowing the muscles to release with each exhale. | Release slowly, lower the arm, and repeat on the opposite side. | בצע 2 עד 3 חזרות לכל צד.

nE: Shoulder Adductor Protractor And Elevator Stretch
t: Stand or sit tall with your spine neutral and feet shoulder-width apart. | Raise one arm to approximately shoulder height and draw it horizontally across your chest toward the opposite shoulder (adduction). | Use your opposite forearm or hand to gently press the stretching arm closer to your chest, deepening the adduction. | While holding that position, allow the shoulder of the stretching arm to round forward slightly (protraction) — do not rotate your torso to achieve this. | With the arm still held across your chest, gently shrug that shoulder upward toward your ear (elevation) to add the third component of the stretch. | Hold the combined position — arm across chest, shoulder protracted and elevated — for 20 to 30 seconds. | Breathe steadily throughout; exhale to relax deeper into the stretch on each breath. | Release slowly and lower the arm back to your side. | Repeat on the other side for equal time.
tRu: Stand or sit tall with your spine neutral and feet shoulder-width apart. | Raise one arm to approximately shoulder height and draw it horizontally across your chest toward the opposite shoulder (adduction). | Use your opposite forearm or hand to gently press the stretching arm closer to your chest, deepening the adduction. | While holding that position, allow the shoulder of the stretching arm to round forward slightly (protraction) — do not rotate your torso to achieve this. | With the arm still held across your chest, gently shrug that shoulder upward toward your ear (elevation) to add the third component of the stretch. | Держите комбинированное положение — рука через грудь, плечи выдвинуты и подняты — в течение 20-30 секунд. | Дышите ровно на протяжении всего выдоха; выдыхайте, чтобы глубже расслабиться в растяжке на каждом вдохе. | Release slowly and lower the arm back to your side. | Repeat on the other side for equal time.
tHe: Stand or sit tall with your spine neutral and feet shoulder-width apart. | Raise one arm to approximately shoulder height and draw it horizontally across your chest toward the opposite shoulder (adduction). | Use your opposite forearm or hand to gently press the stretching arm closer to your chest, deepening the adduction. | While holding that position, allow the shoulder of the stretching arm to round forward slightly (protraction) — do not rotate your torso to achieve this. | With the arm still held across your chest, gently shrug that shoulder upward toward your ear (elevation) to add the third component of the stretch. | Hold the combined position — arm across chest, shoulder protracted and elevated — for 20 to 30 seconds. | נשום באופן יציב לאורך כל התרגיל; נשף כדי להיכנס עמוק יותר למתיחה בכל נשימה. | Release slowly and lower the arm back to your side. | Repeat on the other side for equal time.

t: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your arms relaxed at your sides. | Reach both arms behind your back and interlace your fingers, palms facing each other, as low on your back as is comfortable. | Straighten your elbows fully and rotate your palms so they face downward or slightly away from your body. | Inhale to lengthen your spine, then gently squeeze your shoulder blades together and draw them downward away from your ears. | On an exhale, slowly lift your clasped hands away from your lower back, extending your arms backward and upward as far as your shoulder mobility allows without pain. | At the same time, lift your chest forward and upward into a gentle backbend, keeping your chin level and your neck long. | Hold this stretched position for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and deeply to allow the muscles to relax further into the stretch. | On an exhale, slowly lower your hands back toward your lower back, release the clasp, and let your arms return to your sides. | Repeat for 2–3 sets, resting briefly between holds.
tRu: Встаньте прямо, поставив ноги на ширине бёдер, руки свободно опущены вдоль тела. | Reach both arms behind your back and interlace your fingers, palms facing each other, as low on your back as is comfortable. | Straighten your elbows fully and rotate your palms so they face downward or slightly away from your body. | Вдыхайте, чтобы вытянуть позвоночник, затем плавно сожмите лопатки вместе и отведите их вниз от ушей. | На выдохе медленно отведите сцепленные руки от поясницы, вытягивая руки назад и вверх настолько, позволяет подвижность плеч без боли. | Одновременно поднимите грудь вперёд и вверх в мягкий прогиб, удерживая подбородок ровно, а шею длинной. | Удерживайте это растянутое положение в течение 20-30 секунд, дыша медленно и глубоко, чтобы мышцы еще сильнее расслабились в растяжке. | На выдохе медленно опустите руки назад к пояснице, разожмите ладони и опустите руки вдоль тела. | Repeat for 2–3 sets, resting briefly between holds.
tHe: עמוד זקוף עם רגליים ברוחב האגן וידיים רפויות לצדי הגוף. | Reach both arms behind your back and interlace your fingers, palms facing each other, as low on your back as is comfortable. | Straighten your elbows fully and rotate your palms so they face downward or slightly away from your body. | Inhale to lengthen your spine, then gently squeeze your shoulder blades together and draw them downward away from your ears. | On an exhale, slowly lift your clasped hands away from your lower back, extending your arms backward and upward as far as your shoulder mobility allows without pain. | בו זמנית הרם את החזה קדימה ומעלה לקשת גב עדינה, תוך שמירה על סנטר בגובה אחיד וצוואר ארוך. | Hold this stretched position for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and deeply to allow the muscles to relax further into the stretch. | On an exhale, slowly lower your hands back toward your lower back, release the clasp, and let your arms return to your sides. | Repeat for 2–3 sets, resting briefly between holds.

t: Lie flat on your back on a mat with your knees bent and feet placed hip-width apart, flat on the floor. | Position your arms alongside your body with palms facing down. | Press your feet firmly into the floor and engage the muscles around your hips and waist. | Exhale and slowly lift your hips off the mat, rolling up through the spine one vertebra at a time. | Continue raising your hips until your body forms a straight diagonal line from your shoulders to your knees. | Hold the top position for the desired duration, keeping your thighs parallel and your chin slightly away from your chest. | Inhale and slowly lower your hips back to the mat, reversing the movement vertebra by vertebra. | Return your hips fully to the starting position and relax before repeating.
tRu: Лягте на спину на коврик, согните колени и поставьте ступни на пол на ширине бёдер. | Position your arms alongside your body with palms facing down. | Press your feet firmly into the floor and engage the muscles around your hips and waist. | Выдыхайте и медленно поднимите таз от матраса, поднимаясь по позвоночнику позвонок за позвонком. | Продолжайте поднимать бёдра, пока ваше тело не образует прямую диагональную линию от плеч до колен. | Задержитесь в верхней позиции на заданное время, сохраняя бёдра параллельно полу и подбородок немного от груди. | Вдохните и медленно опустите бёдра обратно на коврик, выполняя обратное движение позвонок за позвонком. | Return your hips fully to the starting position and relax before repeating.
tHe: Lie flat on your back on a mat with your knees bent and feet placed hip-width apart, flat on the floor. | Position your arms alongside your body with palms facing down. | Press your feet firmly into the floor and engage the muscles around your hips and waist. | נשף והרם באיטיות את הירכיים מהמזרן, מגלגל על השדרה חוליה אחר חוליה. | המשך להרים את הירכיים עד שהגוך יוצר קו אלכסון ישר מהכתפיים לברכיים. | Hold the top position for the desired duration, keeping your thighs parallel and your chin slightly away from your chest. | Inhale and slowly lower your hips back to the mat, reversing the movement vertebra by vertebra. | Return your hips fully to the starting position and relax before repeating.

t: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms relaxed at your sides. | Raise both shoulders upward toward your ears, initiating the circular motion. | Roll your shoulders back, squeezing your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement. | Continue the circle by dropping your shoulders down and back, feeling a stretch across the front of your chest. | Roll your shoulders forward and upward to complete one full circle, keeping the motion smooth and controlled. | Perform the desired number of repetitions in this direction, then reverse the motion to roll your shoulders in the opposite direction. | Finish the set with your shoulders relaxed and your posture upright.
tRu: Встаньте прямо, поставив ноги на ширине плеч, руки свободно вдоль тела. | Raise both shoulders upward toward your ears, initiating the circular motion. | Roll your shoulders back, squeezing your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement. | Продолжайте движение по кругу, опуская плечи вниз и назад, чувствуя растяжение передней поверхности груди. | Roll your shoulders forward and upward to complete one full circle, keeping the motion smooth and controlled. | Выполните желаемое количество повторений в этом направлении, затем измените движение, чтобы вращать плечами в противоположном направлении. | Завершите подход с расслабленными плечами и прямой осанкой.
tHe: עמוד זקוף עם רגליים ברוחב הכתפיים וידיים רפויות לצדי הגוף. | Raise both shoulders upward toward your ears, initiating the circular motion. | Roll your shoulders back, squeezing your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement. | המשך את המעגל על ידי הורדת הכתפיים למטה ואחורה, כשאתה מרגיש מתיחה בחלק הקדמי של החזה. | Roll your shoulders forward and upward to complete one full circle, keeping the motion smooth and controlled. | Perform the desired number of repetitions in this direction, then reverse the motion to roll your shoulders in the opposite direction. | סיים את הסט עם כתפיים רפויות ויציבה זקופה.

t: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your arms hanging at your sides. | Relax your shoulders down and back so there is no tension in your neck or upper traps. | Keeping your elbow straight, slowly begin to move one arm backward behind your body, leading with the back of your hand. | Continue moving the arm backward through its comfortable range, feeling a stretch in the lats, chest, and the back of the upper arm. | At the end of your comfortable range, pause for one to two seconds without forcing the joint further. | Slowly return the arm forward to the starting position in a controlled arc. | Repeat for the prescribed number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm. | Keep your torso upright throughout and avoid rotating the trunk to compensate for limited shoulder range.
tRu: Встаньте прямо, поставив ноги на ширине бёдер, руки свободно висят вдоль тела. | Relax your shoulders down and back so there is no tension in your neck or upper traps. | Держа локоть прямым, медленно начните двигать одну руку назад за тело, ведя тыльной стороной кисти. | Продолжайте двигать руку назад в пределах комфортного диапазона, чувствуя растяжение в широчайших мышцах спины, груди и задней поверхности плеча. | В конце комфортной амплитуды сделайте паузу на одну-две секунды, не дожимая сустав силой. | Slowly return the arm forward to the starting position in a controlled arc. | Repeat for the prescribed number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm. | Держите корпус прямо на протяжении всего движения, избегая любого отклонения назад.
tHe: עמוד זקוף עם רגליים ברוחב האגן וידיים תלויות לצדי הגוף. | Relax your shoulders down and back so there is no tension in your neck or upper traps. | Keeping your elbow straight, slowly begin to move one arm backward behind your body, leading with the back of your hand. | המשיכו להוציא את הזרוע אחורה בטווח הנוח, תוך הרגשת מתיחה בשריר הגב הרחב, בחזה ובחלק האחורי של הזרוע העליונה. | בסוף הטווח הנוח עצור לשנייה-שתיים בלי לאלץ את המפרק מעבר לכך. | Slowly return the arm forward to the starting position in a controlled arc. | Repeat for the prescribed number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm. | Keep your torso upright throughout and avoid rotating the trunk to compensate for limited shoulder range.

nE: Shoulder Extensor Adductor And Retractor Stretch
t: Stand tall or sit upright with your feet shoulder-width apart and your spine neutral. | Extend your right arm straight out in front of you at shoulder height, palm facing down. | Bring the right arm horizontally across your chest toward the left shoulder. | Hook your left forearm or hand under the right elbow to support and gently draw the arm closer to your chest. | Keep your right shoulder down and away from your ear — do not let it shrug up. | Hold the stretch for 20–30 seconds, breathing steadily and relaxing deeper into the position with each exhale. | Release slowly and return the arm to the starting position. | Repeat on the left side, holding for the same duration. | Perform 2–3 rounds per side as part of your warm-up or cooldown routine.
tRu: Stand tall or sit upright with your feet shoulder-width apart and your spine neutral. | Выпрямите правую руку прямо перед собой на уровне плеч, ладонь обращена вниз. | Переместите правую руку горизонтально через грудь к левому плечу. | Зацепите левое предплечье или руку под правый локоть, чтобы поддержать и аккуратно притянуть руку ближе к груди. | Держите правое плечо опущенным и вдали от уха — не позволяйте ему подниматься вверх. | Удерживайте растяжку 20–30 секунд, дыша ровно и расслабляясь глубже в положении на каждом выдохе. | Release slowly and return the arm to the starting position. | Повторите на левой стороне, удерживая столько же по времени. | Выполняйте 2–3 подхода на каждую сторону как часть вашей разминки или заминки.
tHe: Stand tall or sit upright with your feet shoulder-width apart and your spine neutral. | פשוט את ידיך ימינה ישר לפניך בגובה הכתף, כף היד פונה מטה. | הבא את היד הימנה אופקית על חזך לכיוון הכתף השמאלית. | Hook your left forearm or hand under the right elbow to support and gently draw the arm closer to your chest. | Keep your right shoulder down and away from your ear — do not let it shrug up. | החזק את המתיחה 20–30 שניות, תוך נשימה סדירה והרפיה עמוקה יותר לתוך התנוחה עם כל נשיפה. | Release slowly and return the arm to the starting position. | חזור על התרגיל בצד שמאל, תוך החזקה לאותו משך זמן. | Perform 2–3 rounds per side as part of your warm-up or cooldown routine.

t: Stand tall or sit upright on a bench with your spine neutral and your feet flat on the floor. | Raise your right arm to the side so your upper arm is parallel to the floor and your elbow is bent to 90°, forearm pointing straight up. | Keep your upper arm fixed and stationary throughout the test — it should not drift forward, backward, or drop. | Slowly rotate your forearm backward and downward, as if trying to lay the back of your hand on a surface behind you. | Stop rotating when you feel resistance, tension, or discomfort — do not force past that point. | Note the angle your forearm makes relative to vertical. A neutral starting position is 0°; full external rotation for most healthy shoulders reaches 90° (forearm horizontal, parallel to the floor). | Return your forearm to vertical and repeat on the left arm. | Compare the range of motion between both sides and record any asymmetry or limitation.
tRu: Stand tall or sit upright on a bench with your spine neutral and your feet flat on the floor. | Raise your right arm to the side so your upper arm is parallel to the floor and your elbow is bent to 90°, forearm pointing straight up. | Держите верхнюю часть руки зафиксированной и локтем направленным вниз, затем поднимайте рукоять к плечу, сгибая только локоть. | Slowly rotate your forearm backward and downward, as if trying to lay the back of your hand on a surface behind you. | Stop rotating when you feel resistance, tension, or discomfort — do not force past that point. | Отметьте угол, который предплечье образует относительно вертикали. Нейтральное исходное положение — 0°; полная внешняя ротация для большинства здоровых плеч достигает 90° (предплечье горизонтально, параллельно полу). | Return your forearm to vertical and repeat on the left arm. | Сравните амплитуду движения на обеих сторонах и зафиксируйте любую асимметрию или ограничение.
tHe: Stand tall or sit upright on a bench with your spine neutral and your feet flat on the floor. | Raise your right arm to the side so your upper arm is parallel to the floor and your elbow is bent to 90°, forearm pointing straight up. | Keep your upper arm fixed and stationary throughout the test — it should not drift forward, backward, or drop. | Slowly rotate your forearm backward and downward, as if trying to lay the back of your hand on a surface behind you. | Stop rotating when you feel resistance, tension, or discomfort — do not force past that point. | Note the angle your forearm makes relative to vertical. A neutral starting position is 0°; full external rotation for most healthy shoulders reaches 90° (forearm horizontal, parallel to the floor). | Return your forearm to vertical and repeat on the left arm. | השווה בין שני הצדדים: המטרה היא טווח דומה שמאל וימין, וקשת קטנה באופן ניכר באחד מהמפרקים מסמנת את הצד עליו יש לעבוד.

t: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, arms resting at your sides, and your core lightly braced. | Relax the shoulder you are about to move — let it sit in its natural, neutral position before you begin. | Keeping your elbow straight but not locked, begin raising your arm forward with the palm facing down or inward. | Move the arm slowly and smoothly, tracing a straight path upward in front of your body. | Continue lifting until you reach the end of your comfortable range — ideally overhead with the arm alongside your ear. | Pause briefly at the top, allowing the anterior deltoid and upper chest to feel a gentle lengthening. | Lower the arm back down at the same controlled pace, resisting gravity the entire way. | Complete all repetitions on one side before switching, or alternate arms for the prescribed number of reps. | Aim for fluid, continuous motion — treat each repetition as an exploration of your range rather than a race.
tRu: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, arms resting at your sides, and your core lightly braced. | Relax the shoulder you are about to move — let it sit in its natural, neutral position before you begin. | Держа локоть прямым, но не зафиксированным, начните поднимать руку вперёд, ладонью вниз или внутрь. | Двигайте рукой медленно и плавно, описывая прямой путь вверх перед телом. | Продолжайте поднимать, пока не достигнете конца вашего комфортного диапазона — в идеале над головой с рукой вдоль уха. | Задержитесь на мгновение в верхней точке, позволяя передней дельте и верху груди почувствовать лёгкое растяжение. | Опустите руку обратно с той же контролируемой скоростью, сопротивляясь гравитации на всём пути. | Выполните все повторения на одной стороне, прежде чем перейти на другую, или меняйте руки на указанное количество повторений. | Двигайтесь плавно и непрерывно — воспринимайте каждое повторение как освоение амплитуды, а не гонку.
tHe: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, arms resting at your sides, and your core lightly braced. | Relax the shoulder you are about to move — let it sit in its natural, neutral position before you begin. | Keeping your elbow straight but not locked, begin raising your arm forward with the palm facing down or inward. | Move the arm slowly and smoothly, tracing a straight path upward in front of your body. | המשך להרים עד שתגיע לקצה טווח התנועה הנוח שלך — באופן אידיאלי מעל הראש עם הזרוע ליד האוזן. | Pause briefly at the top, allowing the anterior deltoid and upper chest to feel a gentle lengthening. | Lower the arm back down at the same controlled pace, resisting gravity the entire way. | בצע את כל החזרות בצד אחד, ואז שנה מיקום כדי לעבוד על הצד השני. | שאף לתנועה זורמת ורציפה — התייחס לכל חזרה כאל חקירת הטווח ולא כמרוץ.

t: Stand with your back, head, and hips pressed firmly against a wall, feet roughly 15 to 30 centimetres away from the base. | Begin with your arms at your sides, palms facing forward, elbows straight. | Press the entire length of your spine and the back of your head into the wall and maintain that contact throughout the movement. | Slowly raise both arms forward and upward, keeping the elbows straight and palms facing the ceiling as your arms travel overhead. | Continue lifting until your arms are fully overhead, reaching as high as possible while your back and head remain in contact with the wall. | Hold the end position for one to two seconds, feeling the stretch across the posterior shoulder area and the engagement through the upper back. | Lower your arms back to the starting position in a slow, controlled manner. | Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, maintaining wall contact on every rep.
tRu: Stand with your back, head, and hips pressed firmly against a wall, feet roughly 15 to 30 centimetres away from the base. | Начните с руками вдоль тела, ладони обращены вперёд, локти прямые. | Press the entire length of your spine and the back of your head into the wall and maintain that contact throughout the movement. | Slowly raise both arms forward and upward, keeping the elbows straight and palms facing the ceiling as your arms travel overhead. | Продолжайте поднимать, пока ваши руки не окажутся полностью над головой, максимально высоко, при этом спина и голова остаются прижатыми к стене. | Задержите конечное положение на одну-две секунды, чувствуя растяжку по области заднего плеча и напряжение в верхней части спины. | Медленно опустите руки обратно в исходное положение. | Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, maintaining wall contact on every rep.
tHe: Stand with your back, head, and hips pressed firmly against a wall, feet roughly 15 to 30 centimetres away from the base. | התחל עם זרועות לצדדים, כפות ידיים פונות קדימה, מרפקים ישרים. | Press the entire length of your spine and the back of your head into the wall and maintain that contact throughout the movement. | Slowly raise both arms forward and upward, keeping the elbows straight and palms facing the ceiling as your arms travel overhead. | המשך להרים עד שהזרועות מלאות מעל הראש, מגיעים כמה שיותר גבוה תוך שהגב והראש נותרים במגע עם הקיר. | Hold the end position for one to two seconds, feeling the stretch across the posterior shoulder area and the engagement through the upper back. | Lower your arms back to the starting position in a slow, controlled manner. | Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, maintaining wall contact on every rep.

t: Lie on your back on a firm, flat surface with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. | Raise your right arm out to the side until it is level with your shoulder — 90° of abduction — and bend your elbow to 90° so your forearm points straight up toward the ceiling. | Allow your upper arm to rest fully on the floor; your elbow should stay in contact with the surface throughout the test. | Keeping your elbow fixed and your upper arm pinned to the floor, slowly rotate your forearm forward and downward toward the floor — this is internal rotation. | Stop when you feel resistance or when your elbow begins to lift off the surface, noting the angle your forearm makes with the floor. | Hold the end-range position for 2–3 seconds to confirm this is your true limit, not muscular guarding. | Return your forearm to the starting vertical position under control. | Repeat the assessment on the left side and compare the range of motion between arms. | Record any asymmetry greater than 10–15° or any reproduction of familiar pain as a positive finding warranting follow-up.
tRu: Лягте на спину на твёрдую, плоскую поверхность, согните колени и поставьте стопы на пол. | Raise your right arm out to the side until it is level with your shoulder — 90° of abduction — and bend your elbow to 90° so your forearm points straight up toward the ceiling. | Полностью положите плечо на пол; локоть должен оставаться в контакте с поверхностью на протяжении всего теста. | Держа локоть неподвижным и верхнюю руку прижатой к полу, медленно поворачивайте предплечье вперёд и вниз к полу — это внутренняя ротация. | Stop when you feel resistance or when your elbow begins to lift off the surface, noting the angle your forearm makes with the floor. | Задержите конечное положение на 2–3 секунды, чтобы убедиться, что это ваш истинный предел, а не мышечное напряжение. | Return your forearm to the starting vertical position under control. | Repeat the assessment on the left side and compare the range of motion between arms. | Record any asymmetry greater than 10–15° or any reproduction of familiar pain as a positive finding warranting follow-up.
tHe: Lie on your back on a firm, flat surface with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. | Raise your right arm out to the side until it is level with your shoulder — 90° of abduction — and bend your elbow to 90° so your forearm points straight up toward the ceiling. | תן לזרוע העליונה לנוח לגמרי על הרצפה; המרפק צריך להישאר במגע עם המשטח לאורך כל הבדיקה. | Keeping your elbow fixed and your upper arm pinned to the floor, slowly rotate your forearm forward and downward toward the floor — this is internal rotation. | Stop when you feel resistance or when your elbow begins to lift off the surface, noting the angle your forearm makes with the floor. | Hold the end-range position for 2–3 seconds to confirm this is your true limit, not muscular guarding. | Return your forearm to the starting vertical position under control. | Repeat the assessment on the left side and compare the range of motion between arms. | Record any asymmetry greater than 10–15° or any reproduction of familiar pain as a positive finding warranting follow-up.

t: Stand or sit tall with your spine neutral and your feet hip-width apart if standing. | Bring your right arm out to the side at shoulder height, elbow bent to 90 degrees so your forearm points straight up toward the ceiling. | Keep your upper arm parallel to the floor and your elbow fixed at shoulder height throughout the movement. | Slowly rotate your forearm downward and backward — externally rotating the upper arm — until your forearm is parallel to the floor or until you reach a comfortable end range. | Pause briefly at the end range, feeling a gentle stretch across the posterior shoulder and rotator cuff. | Slowly reverse the motion, rotating the forearm back up to the starting vertical position in a controlled, deliberate arc. | Perform 8–12 slow, controlled rotations on one side, pausing at the end range of each rep. | Switch to the opposite arm and repeat for the same number of repetitions. | Complete 2–3 sets per side, focusing on smooth movement and increasing range of motion with each repetition.
tRu: Встаньте или сядьте прямо с нейтральным позвоночником, а если стоите — поставьте ноги на ширине бёдер. | Отведите правую руку в сторону на уровне плеч, согнув локоть под углом 90 градусов, чтобы предплечье было направлено прямо вверх к потолку. | Держите верхнюю часть руки параллельно полу и локоть прижат к уровню плеч на протяжении всего движения. | Slowly rotate your forearm downward and backward — externally rotating the upper arm — until your forearm is parallel to the floor or until you reach a comfortable end range. | На мгновение остановитесь в конечной точке амплитуды, ощущая мягкую растяжку в задней части плеча и вращательной манжете. | Slowly reverse the motion, rotating the forearm back up to the starting vertical position in a controlled, deliberate arc. | Выполняйте 8–12 медленных, контролируемых вращений на одну сторону, делая паузу в конечной точке каждого повторения. | Switch to the opposite arm and repeat for the same number of repetitions. | Выполните 2–3 подхода на каждую сторону, концентрируясь на плавности движения и увеличивая амплитуду с каждым повторением.
tHe: עמוד או שב זקוף עם עמוד שדרה ניטרלי ורגליים ברוחב האגן בעמידה. | הבא את זרוע ימין לצד בגובה הכתף, מרפק מקופל ב-90 מעלות כך שהזרוע הקדמית מצביעה ישר למעלה לתקרה. | Keep your upper arm parallel to the floor and your elbow fixed at shoulder height throughout the movement. | Slowly rotate your forearm downward and backward — externally rotating the upper arm — until your forearm is parallel to the floor or until you reach a comfortable end range. | Pause briefly at the end range, feeling a gentle stretch across the posterior shoulder and rotator cuff. | Slowly reverse the motion, rotating the forearm back up to the starting vertical position in a controlled, deliberate arc. | Perform 8–12 slow, controlled rotations on one side, pausing at the end range of each rep. | Switch to the opposite arm and repeat for the same number of repetitions. | בצע 2–3 סטים לכל צד, מתמקד בתנועה חלקה ומגביר את טווח התנועה עם כל חזרה.

t: Stand upright in a relaxed, natural posture with your feet hip-width apart and your arms hanging loosely at your sides. | Look straight ahead at a fixed point on the wall or in a mirror at eye level to avoid tilting your head. | Relax your shoulders completely — do not shrug, pull them back, or force them into any particular position. | Have an observer stand directly in front of you, or position yourself in front of a full-length mirror so both shoulders are visible simultaneously. | Observe the height of the bony tip of each shoulder (the acromion) and note whether one side sits higher, lower, or level with the other. | Take a deep breath, relax, and repeat the observation two or three times to confirm the finding is consistent rather than a momentary postural shift. | Record which shoulder appears elevated or depressed, and note whether the difference is subtle or pronounced, to guide any follow-up assessment or corrective work.

t: Stand tall or sit upright with your spine neutral and your feet hip-width apart. | Raise one arm to shoulder height with the elbow bent to 90°, so your forearm points straight up toward the ceiling. | Keeping the upper arm parallel to the floor and the elbow fixed in position, slowly rotate your forearm downward in front of you until it points toward the floor. | Pause at the end range, feeling a gentle stretch across the front of the shoulder and chest. | Slowly return the forearm back to the starting upright position under full control. | Complete all reps on one side before switching to the opposite arm. | Breathe steadily throughout — exhale as you rotate inward, inhale as you return.

t: Stand with both feet hip-width apart and centered on the middle of the band, or loop the band under one foot for a narrower stance. | Grasp one end of the band in each hand and bring your hands up to shoulder height with your palms facing forward and elbows pointed out to the sides. | Brace your core, squeeze your glutes, and maintain a neutral spine — avoid arching your lower back. | Press both hands directly overhead in a straight vertical path until your arms are fully extended without locking the elbows forcefully. | Pause briefly at the top, ensuring the band does not pull you forward or to one side. | Lower your hands in a controlled manner back to shoulder height, resisting the pull of the band on the way down. | Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, keeping tension in the band throughout the entire set.
tRu: Stand with both feet hip-width apart and centered on the middle of the band, or loop the band under one foot for a narrower stance. | Возьмите один конец эспандера в каждую руку и поднимите руки до уровня плеч, ладонями вперед, а локтями, направленными в стороны. | Напрягите корпус, сожмите ягодицы и поддерживайте нейтральное положение позвоночника — избегайте выгибания поясницы. | Press both hands directly overhead in a straight vertical path until your arms are fully extended without locking the elbows forcefully. | Задержитесь на мгновение в верхней точке, убедившись, что эспандер не тянет вас вперёд или вбок. | Опустите руки под контролем обратно на уровень плеч, сопротивляясь натяжению эспандера на пути вниз. | Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, keeping tension in the band throughout the entire set.
tHe: Stand with both feet hip-width apart and centered on the middle of the band, or loop the band under one foot for a narrower stance. | אחוז בקצה הגומייה בכל יד והרם את הידיים לגובה הכתפיים כשהכפות פונות קדימה והמרפקים מצביעים הצידה. | תכווץ את שרירי הליבה, כווץ את השרירים הגלוטיאליים, ושמור על חוטם נייטרלי - תמנע מעקום את גב התחתון. | Press both hands directly overhead in a straight vertical path until your arms are fully extended without locking the elbows forcefully. | Pause briefly at the top, ensuring the band does not pull you forward or to one side. | Lower your hands in a controlled manner back to shoulder height, resisting the pull of the band on the way down. | Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, keeping tension in the band throughout the entire set.

t: Lie flat on your back on a mat with your arms alongside your body, palms facing down and legs fully extended. | Press your palms and arms firmly into the mat, then engage your core and swing your legs up overhead, bringing your hips off the floor. | Bend your elbows and place your hands on your lower back, fingers pointing upward, to form a supportive shelf for your spine. | Walk your hands higher up your back toward the shoulder blades to straighten your torso as vertical as possible. | Extend your legs straight up toward the ceiling, squeezing your thighs and pointing your toes so your body forms a single vertical line from shoulders to feet. | Keep your weight distributed evenly across both shoulders and your upper back — not your neck — and gaze softly at your toes or the ceiling. | Hold the position for the desired duration while breathing steadily through your nose. | To exit, lower your legs slowly back overhead, release your hands to the mat, and unroll your spine back down to the floor one vertebra at a time.
tRu: Лягте на спину на коврик с руками вдоль тела, ладонями вниз и полностью вытянутыми ногами. | Press your palms and arms firmly into the mat, then engage your core and swing your legs up overhead, bringing your hips off the floor. | Согните локти и положите кисти на поясницу пальцами вверх, образуя поддерживающую опору для позвоночника. | Walk your hands higher up your back toward the shoulder blades to straighten your torso as vertical as possible. | Вытяните ноги прямо к потолку, сжимая бедра и вытягивая носки, чтобы тело образовывало одну вертикальную линию от плеч до стоп. | Держите вес распределённым равномерно между обеими плечами и верхней частью спины — а не шеей — и мягко смотрите на пальцы ног или потолок. | Держите положение в течение желаемой продолжительности, дыша ровно через нос. | To exit, lower your legs slowly back overhead, release your hands to the mat, and unroll your spine back down to the floor one vertebra at a time.
tHe: Lie flat on your back on a mat with your arms alongside your body, palms facing down and legs fully extended. | Press your palms and arms firmly into the mat, then engage your core and swing your legs up overhead, bringing your hips off the floor. | כופף את המרפקים והנח את הידיים על הגב התחתון, אצבעות פונות למעלה, ליצירת מדף תומך לעמוד השדרה. | Walk your hands higher up your back toward the shoulder blades to straighten your torso as vertical as possible. | פשוט את רגליך ישר עם עקבים על הרצפה לגרסה הקשה יותר, או כפוף ברכים והנח את כפות הרגליים שטות אם אתה צריך להפחית את העומס. | Keep your weight distributed evenly across both shoulders and your upper back — not your neck — and gaze softly at your toes or the ceiling. | Hold the position for the desired duration while breathing steadily through your nose. | To exit, lower your legs slowly back overhead, release your hands to the mat, and unroll your spine back down to the floor one vertebra at a time.

t: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your spine in a neutral position. | Reach both arms behind your back and clasp your hands together, interlacing your fingers. | Straighten your arms as much as your shoulder mobility allows, keeping your elbows as extended as possible. | Gently squeeze your shoulder blades together and then press your clasped hands away from your body and slightly downward. | Hold your chest up and avoid rounding your upper back or pushing your head forward. | Breathe deeply and hold the stretch for 20–30 seconds, feeling the pull across the back of your shoulders and upper back. | Release slowly, bring your arms back to your sides, and repeat for the desired number of sets.

nE: Shoulder Stretch Behind the Back with Towel
nR: Растяжка плеч за спиной с полотенцем
nH: מתיחת כתפיים מאחורי הגב עם מגבת
t: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and hold one end of a towel in your right hand. | Raise your right arm overhead, bend the elbow so your right hand drops behind your head, and let the towel hang down your back. | Reach your left arm behind your lower back and bend the elbow upward so your left hand can grasp the lower end of the towel. | Gently walk your hands closer together along the towel until you feel a moderate stretch in both shoulders — stop before any pain. | Hold the position for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and letting the shoulders relax deeper into the stretch with each exhale. | Release the towel, lower both arms, and shake them out briefly. | Switch sides: raise your left arm overhead and reach your right arm up from below, then repeat the same hold.

t: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold one end of a towel in your right hand. | Raise your right arm overhead and bend the elbow so your right hand hangs down behind your head, holding the towel. | Reach your left arm behind your lower back and bend the elbow so your left hand reaches upward to grasp the other end of the towel. | Adjust your grip so both hands hold the towel with a comfortable gap between them. | Gently pull downward with your left hand to increase the stretch on your right shoulder, holding for two to three seconds. | Then gently pull upward with your right hand to increase the stretch on your left shoulder, holding for two to three seconds. | Continue alternating the direction of the pull for the desired number of repetitions, or hold the stretch for 20 to 30 seconds per side. | Switch which arm is overhead and which is at the lower back, then repeat the sequence on the opposite side.
tRu: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold one end of a towel in your right hand. | Raise your right arm overhead and bend the elbow so your right hand hangs down behind your head, holding the towel. | Reach your left arm behind your lower back and bend the elbow so your left hand reaches upward to grasp the other end of the towel. | Отрегулируйте хват так, чтобы обе руки держали полотенце с удобным расстоянием между ними. | Аккуратно потяните вниз левой рукой, чтобы усилить растяжку правого плеча, удерживая в течение двух-трёх секунд. | Then gently pull upward with your right hand to increase the stretch on your left shoulder, holding for two to three seconds. | Продолжайте поочередно менять направление тяги в течение назначенного количества повторений, или удерживайте растяжку в течение 20-30 секунд на каждую сторону. | Switch which arm is overhead and which is at the lower back, then repeat the sequence on the opposite side.

t: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart and your core lightly braced. | Bring your right arm across your body at shoulder height, so the hand reaches toward your left shoulder — this is the starting position. | Keep a slight bend in the elbow throughout the movement to reduce joint stress. | Slowly sweep the arm horizontally outward (transverse abduction) until it points directly to your right side or slightly behind it. | Feel the stretch deepen in the rear deltoid and the rotator cuff muscles (infraspinatus and teres minor) as the arm moves away from the body. | Pause briefly at the end range, then return the arm back across the body to the starting position in a controlled arc. | Complete the desired number of repetitions on the right side, then switch arms and repeat. | Breathe steadily throughout — exhale as the arm sweeps outward, inhale as it returns across the body.
tRu: Встаньте прямо, поставив ноги на ширине плеч, слегка напрягите корпус. | Поднимите правую руку через тело на уровне плеч, чтобы рука была направлена к левому плечу — это исходное положение. | Держите лёгкий сгиб в локте на протяжении всего движения для снижения нагрузки на сустав. | Slowly sweep the arm horizontally outward (transverse abduction) until it points directly to your right side or slightly behind it. | Почувствуйте, как растяжка углубляется в задней дельтовидной мышце и мышцах вращательной манжеты (подостной и малая круглая) по мере того, как рука удаляется от тела. | На мгновение остановитесь в конечной точке амплитуды, затем верните руку обратно через тело в исходное положение по контролируемой дуге. | Выполните желаемое количество повторений с правой стороны, затем поменяйте руки и повторите. | Дышите ровно на протяжении всего выдоха — выдыхайте, когда рука движется наружу, и вдыхайте, когда она возвращается через тело.
tHe: עמוד זקוף עם רגליים ברוחב הכתפיים והליבה קלות מכווצת. | הבא את זרוע ימין דרך גופך בגובה הכתף, כך שהיד מגיעה לכיוון כתף שמאל — זו תנוחת ההתחלה. | Keep a slight bend in the elbow throughout the movement to reduce joint stress. | Slowly sweep the arm horizontally outward (transverse abduction) until it points directly to your right side or slightly behind it. | הרגיש את העומק הגובר של המתיחה בשריר הדלתא האחורית ובשרירי הכתף הסובבים (שריר העל-סוככת ושריר הקטן המשולש) כשהזרוע זזה מהגוף. | Pause briefly at the end range, then return the arm back across the body to the starting position in a controlled arc. | בצע את המספר הרצוי של החזרות בצד ימין, ואז החלף ידיים וחזור על התרגיל. | נשום בצורה יציבה לכל אורך — נשום החוצה כשהזרוע נעה החוצה, שאב אוויר כשהיא חוזרת על פני הגוף.

t: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart, core lightly braced, and your spine in a neutral position. | Extend your working arm out to your side at shoulder height, palm facing forward or down, so it is roughly parallel to the floor. | Begin the movement by driving your arm forward and across your body in a smooth horizontal arc, keeping it at shoulder height throughout. | Continue sweeping the arm past the midline of your chest until it reaches the opposite side of your body — as far as your shoulder mobility comfortably allows. | Pause briefly at the end range to let the pectoralis major fully shorten. | Reverse the arc in a controlled manner, returning the arm back out to the starting position at your side. | Allow a small, natural rotation of the torso if your mobility requires it, but keep the movement led by the shoulder rather than the trunk. | Complete all reps on one side, then repeat with the opposite arm. | Perform 10–15 smooth repetitions per side, treating each swing as an active articulation rather than a ballistic throw.
tRu: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart, core lightly braced, and your spine in a neutral position. | Выпрямите рабочую руку в сторону на уровне плеч, ладонь обращена вперёд или вниз, чтобы рука была примерно параллельна полу. | Начните движение с ведения руки вперёд и через корпус по плавной горизонтальной дуге, удерживая её на высоте плеч всё время. | Продолжайте вести руку за средней линией груди, пока она не достигнет противоположной стороны тела — настолько, насколько позволяет подвижность вашего плеч. | На мгновение остановитесь в конечной точке амплитуды, чтобы большая грудная мышца полностью сократилась. | Reverse the arc in a controlled manner, returning the arm back out to the starting position at your side. | Допустим небольшой естественный разворот корпуса, если требует подвижность, но ведите движение плечом, а не туловищем. | Выполните все повторения на одну сторону, затем повторите противоположной рукой. | Выполняйте 10–15 плавных повторений на каждую сторону, воспринимая каждый мах как активное движение, а не как баллистичный бросок.
tHe: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart, core lightly braced, and your spine in a neutral position. | זרוע העבודה שלך הצידה לגובה הכתף, כף יד קדימה או למטה, כך שהיא בערך מקבילה לרצפה. | התחל את התנועה בדחיפת הזרוע קדימה ולרוחב הגוף בקשת אופקית חלקה, תוך שמירה על גובה הכתף לאורך כל התנועה. | המשך להעביר את הזרוע מעבר לקו האמצע של החזה עד שהיא מגיעה לצד השני של הגוף — ככל שגמישות הכתף מאפשר. | Pause briefly at the end range to let the pectoralis major fully shorten. | Reverse the arc in a controlled manner, returning the arm back out to the starting position at your side. | אפשר סיבוב קטן וטבעי של הגו אם הגמישות דורשת זאת, אך שמור על תנועה המובלת מהכתף ולא מהגו. | בצע את כל החזרות בצד אחד, ואז חזור על התרגיל עם הזרוע הנגדית. | Perform 10–15 smooth repetitions per side, treating each swing as an active articulation rather than a ballistic throw.

t: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, or sit upright on a bench with a neutral spine. | Extend one arm straight out in front of you at shoulder height, parallel to the floor, with the palm facing inward or downward. | Keeping the arm level and the elbow long, begin sweeping it slowly outward and backward in a wide horizontal arc. | Continue the arc until the arm is as far behind your torso as your comfortable range of motion allows. | Pause briefly at end range and notice the stretch across the posterior shoulder, outer back, and upper arm. | Slowly reverse the motion, sweeping the arm back through the same arc to the starting position in front of you. | Maintain a steady, rhythmic pace — neither rushing the swing nor holding the stretch for an extended count — to keep the movement articular. | Complete all reps on one side, then switch arms and repeat.
tRu: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, or sit upright on a bench with a neutral spine. | Вытяните одну руку прямо перед собой на уровне плеч, параллельно полу, ладонью внутрь или вниз. | Сохраняя руку на уровне и локоть прямым, начните плавно вести её наружу и назад по широкой горизонтальной дуге. | Продолжайте дугу, пока рука не окажется как можно дальше за вашим корпусом в пределах вашего комфортного диапазона движения. | Сделайте короткую паузу в конце амплитуды и почувствуйте растяжку по задней поверхности плеч, внешней стороне спины и верхней части руки. | Slowly reverse the motion, sweeping the arm back through the same arc to the starting position in front of you. | Сохраняйте устойчивый, ритмичный темп — ни в коем случае не торопите взмах и не задерживайте растяжку на слишком долгое время — чтобы движение оставалось суставным. | Выполните все повторения на одну сторону, затем поменяйте руки и повторите.
tHe: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, or sit upright on a bench with a neutral spine. | פשוט יד אחת ישר קדימה בגובה הכתף, מקבילה לרצפה, עם כף היד מופנת פנימה או למטה. | Keeping the arm level and the elbow long, begin sweeping it slowly outward and backward in a wide horizontal arc. | המשך הקשת עד שהזרוע כל כך מאחורי הגוף כפי שהטווח הנוח של התנועה מאפשר. | Pause briefly at end range and notice the stretch across the posterior shoulder, outer back, and upper arm. | Slowly reverse the motion, sweeping the arm back through the same arc to the starting position in front of you. | Maintain a steady, rhythmic pace — neither rushing the swing nor holding the stretch for an extended count — to keep the movement articular. | בצע את כל החזרות בצד אחד, ואז החלף ידיים וחזור על התרגיל.

t: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, core lightly braced, and both arms hanging relaxed at your sides. | Raise one or both arms to shoulder height in front of you so they are parallel to the floor. | Slowly sweep your arms outward to the sides in a wide horizontal arc, opening your chest as you go. | Pause briefly at the end of the arc when you feel a gentle stretch across your chest and the front of your shoulders. | Reverse the motion and sweep your arms back across the midline of your body, allowing them to cross slightly in front of your chest. | Pause again to feel a mild stretch at the back of the shoulder and along the outer chest. | Continue the outward and inward sweeping motion in a smooth, controlled rhythm for the desired number of repetitions. | Lower your arms to your sides between sets and reset your posture before performing additional sets.
tRu: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, core lightly braced, and both arms hanging relaxed at your sides. | Raise one or both arms to shoulder height in front of you so they are parallel to the floor. | Slowly sweep your arms outward to the sides in a wide horizontal arc, opening your chest as you go. | На мгновение остановитесь в конце дуги, когда вы чувствуете легкое растяжение в груди и передней части плеч. | Reverse the motion and sweep your arms back across the midline of your body, allowing them to cross slightly in front of your chest. | Снова сделайте паузу, чтобы почувствовать легкую растяжение в задней части плеча и по внешней стороне груди. | Продолжайте движение наружу и внутрь в плавном, контролируемом ритме для заданного количества повторений. | Опустите руки в стороны между подходами и выровняйте осанку перед выполнением следующих подходов.
tHe: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, core lightly braced, and both arms hanging relaxed at your sides. | Raise one or both arms to shoulder height in front of you so they are parallel to the floor. | Slowly sweep your arms outward to the sides in a wide horizontal arc, opening your chest as you go. | Pause briefly at the end of the arc when you feel a gentle stretch across your chest and the front of your shoulders. | Reverse the motion and sweep your arms back across the midline of your body, allowing them to cross slightly in front of your chest. | Pause again to feel a mild stretch at the back of the shoulder and along the outer chest. | המשך את תנועת הטווח החוצה פנימה בקצב חלק ומבוקר למספר החזרות הרצוי. | Lower your arms to your sides between sets and reset your posture before performing additional sets.

t: Stand beneath a parallel-grip pull-up bar or suspension handles set to shoulder width. Reach up and grasp each handle with a neutral grip — palms facing each other — directly above your shoulders. | Hang at full arm extension, allowing your shoulders to rise slightly so the lats stretch at the bottom. Cross your ankles behind you or keep your legs straight to reduce swinging. | Brace your core, depress your shoulder blades (pull them down and away from your ears), and squeeze your glutes lightly to keep your body stable. | Initiate the pull by driving your elbows down and back toward your hips rather than simply bending your arms. Think about pulling the bar to your chest, not your chest to the bar. | Continue pulling until your chin clears the bar or your chest approaches the handles, keeping your torso upright and your elbows tracking close to your sides. | Pause briefly at the top, then lower yourself under control with a 2–3 second descent, resisting the urge to drop quickly. | Return to a full hang with arms extended before beginning the next repetition.
tRu: Stand beneath a parallel-grip pull-up bar or suspension handles set to shoulder width. Reach up and grasp each handle with a neutral grip — palms facing each other — directly above your shoulders. | Повисните с полностью выпрямленными руками, позволяя плечам слегка подняться, чтобы широчайшие мышцы растянулись в нижней точке. Перехватите лодыжки за спиной или держите ноги прямыми, чтобы уменьшить раскачивание. | Напрягите пресс, опустите лопатки вниз, подальше от ушей, и слегка сожмите ягодицы для стабильности тела. | Начните тягу, отводя локти вниз и назад к бедрам, а не просто сгибая руки. Думайте о том, чтобы подтянуть штангу к груди, а не о том, чтобы грудь пошла к штанге. | Продолжайте тянуть, пока ваш подбородок не окажется выше штанги или ваша грудь не приблизилась к рукоятям, сохраняя корпус вертикальным, а локти близко к бокам. | Задержитесь на мгновение в верхней точке, затем плавно опуститесь за 2-3 секунды, сопротивляясь желанию быстро опуститься. | Return to a full hang with arms extended before beginning the next repetition.
tHe: Stand beneath a parallel-grip pull-up bar or suspension handles set to shoulder width. Reach up and grasp each handle with a neutral grip — palms facing each other — directly above your shoulders. | תלה בפשיטת זרועות מלאה, ואפשר לכתפיים להתרומם מעט כך שהגב הרחב נמתח בתחתית. הצלב את הקרסוליים מאחוריך או שמור על הרגליים ישרות לצמצום הניפוף. | הדק את הליבה, הורד את שכמות הכתפיים (משוך אותן למטה והרחק מהאוזניים), וכווץ קלות את הישבן כדי לשמור על גוף יציב. | Initiate the pull by driving your elbows down and back toward your hips rather than simply bending your arms. Think about pulling the bar to your chest, not your chest to the bar. | המשך למשוך עד שהסנטר שלך מעל המוט או החזה העליון מתקרב אל הידיים, שומר על גוף זקוף והמרפקים קרובים לצדדים. | Pause briefly at the top, then lower yourself under control with a 2–3 second descent, resisting the urge to drop quickly. | Return to a full hang with arms extended before beginning the next repetition.

t: Stand upright with your feet together, then shift your weight onto your left foot. | Reach back with your right hand and grasp your right ankle, bending that knee so your foot is held close to your glute. | Extend your free left arm forward at shoulder height for counterbalance. | Brace your core and fix your gaze on a point directly ahead to stabilise your balance. | Hinge slightly at the hip and begin to bend your standing knee, lowering your body in a controlled manner. | Continue descending until your rear knee lightly touches or hovers just above the floor, keeping your torso as upright as you can manage. | Pause briefly at the bottom, then drive through the heel and midfoot of your standing leg to press yourself back to full standing. | Complete all reps on one side before switching legs.
tRu: Stand upright with your feet together, then shift your weight onto your left foot. | Reach back with your right hand and grasp your right ankle, bending that knee so your foot is held close to your glute. | Вытяните свободную левую руку вперед на уровне плеч для уравновешивания. | Напрягите корпус и зафиксируйте взгляд на точке строго впереди, чтобы стабилизировать равновесие. | Слегка наклоняйтесь в бёдра и начинайте сгибать опорную ногу, опуская тело контролируемо. | Продолжайте опускаться, пока заднее колено не коснётся пола или не будет зависать прямо над ним, удерживая корпус максимально прямо. | На мгновение задержитесь внизу, затем выжмите через пятку и среднюю часть стопы рабочей ноги, чтобы вернуться в положение стоя. | Выполните все повторения на одну сторону, затем поменяйте ноги.
tHe: Stand upright with your feet together, then shift your weight onto your left foot. | Reach back with your right hand and grasp your right ankle, bending that knee so your foot is held close to your glute. | הרחק את יד שמאל החופשית שלך קדימה בגובה כתף למען איזון נגדי. | הדק את הליבה וקבע את המבט בנקודה ישר לפניך כדי לייצב את שיווי המשקל. | כופף מעט בציר הירך והתחל לכופף את ברך רגל העמידה, והורד את הגוף בצורה מבוקרת. | המשילו לרדת עד שהברך האחורית שלכם נוגעת בעדינות או ריחפת מעט מעל הרצפה, תוך שמירה על גופך זקוף ככל שאפשר. | Pause briefly at the bottom, then drive through the heel and midfoot of your standing leg to press yourself back to full standing. | בצע את כל החזרות בצד אחד לפני החלפת הרגליים.

t: Stand between a set of parallel bars and grip each bar with a neutral (palms facing inward) grip, hands roughly hip-width apart. | Press yourself up to the top of a dip: arms fully extended, elbows locked out, body upright, and feet lifted off the floor. | Allow your shoulders to sink down passively toward your ears as far as comfortable — this is your starting (depressed) position. | Without bending your elbows, actively shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears as high as possible. | Hold the top position for a brief pause, fully elevating the shoulder girdle. | Slowly lower your shoulders back down to the fully depressed starting position under control. | Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, keeping your arms straight and core braced throughout. | When finished, lower yourself back to the ground with control.
tRu: Stand between a set of parallel bars and grip each bar with a neutral (palms facing inward) grip, hands roughly hip-width apart. | Press yourself up to the top of a dip: arms fully extended, elbows locked out, body upright, and feet lifted off the floor. | Позвольте плечам пассивно опуститься вниз насколько комфортно — это стартовое опущенное положение. | Without bending your elbows, actively shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears as high as possible. | Удерживайте верхнюю точку в течение короткой паузы, полностью поднимая плечевой пояс. | Slowly lower your shoulders back down to the fully depressed starting position under control. | Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, keeping your arms straight and core braced throughout. | When finished, lower yourself back to the ground with control.

t: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and hips hinged so your chest is up and your weight is over the balls of your feet — this is your athletic base position. | Lower into a quarter-squat, keeping your core braced and your eyes looking forward. | Push off your right foot and step your left foot out laterally two to three feet, then immediately bring your right foot in so your feet return to shoulder width. tHe: Stand beside a sturdy step or box with your feet hip-width apart and the platform to one side of you. | כופף קלות את הברכיים והתכופף באגן לטעינת הרגליים, תוך שמירה על חזה מורם וליבה מהודקת. | Push off both feet explosively and jump laterally, clearing the edge of the platform. | Land on top of the platform with both feet, absorbing the impact by bending your knees and hips into a soft, controlled landing. | Stand tall for a moment on the platform, then step back down to the starting position on the opposite side. | Reset your stance, then jump back laterally onto the platform from the new side. | המשיל להחליף צדדים למספר החזרות או הזמן המטרה, שומר על נחיתה מבוקת ועקבית בכל חזרה.

t: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent, and arms relaxed at your sides. | Load your legs by sinking into a quarter-squat, engaging your core and keeping your chest up. | Drive through both feet to jump to the right, pushing off with enough force to clear comfortable ground distance. | While airborne, rotate your torso and hips to the left so your shoulders turn opposite to your direction of travel. | Land softly on both feet, absorbing the impact through your hips, knees, and ankles — never with locked knees. | Immediately reset your stance in the quarter-squat position to absorb the landing fully before initiating the next rep. | Jump back to the left and rotate your torso to the right, mirroring the previous movement. | Continue alternating sides for the prescribed number of reps or duration, keeping the rhythm consistent and controlled.
tRu: Встаньте, поставив ноги на ширине бёдер, колени слегка согнуты, руки свободно вдоль тела. | Нагрузите ноги, садясь в четверть-присед, напрягая корпус и держа грудь вверх. | Оттолкнитесь обеими стопами, чтобы прыгнуть вправо, отталкиваясь с достаточной силой, чтобы преодолеть комфортное расстояние. | While airborne, rotate your torso and hips to the left so your shoulders turn opposite to your direction of travel. | Мягко приземлитесь на обе ноги, амортизируя удар через бёдра, колени и голеностопы — никогда не с прямыми коленями. | Сразу же вернитесь в положение полуприседа, чтобы полностью поглотить приземление перед началом следующего повторения. | Прыгните влево и поверните корпус вправо, повторив предыдущее движение в зеркальном отражении. | Продолжайте поочередно выполнять движения на разные стороны в течение назначенного количества повторений или времени, сохраняя ритмичный и контролируемый темп.
tHe: עמוד עם רגליים ברוחב האגן, ברכיים מעט כפופות, וידיים רפויות לצדי הגוף. | Load your legs by sinking into a quarter-squat, engaging your core and keeping your chest up. | דחוף דרך שתי הרגליים כדי לקפוץ ימינה, בדחיפה מספיקה כדי לעבור מרחק נוח מהקרקע. | While airborne, rotate your torso and hips to the left so your shoulders turn opposite to your direction of travel. | Land softly on both feet, absorbing the impact through your hips, knees, and ankles — never with locked knees. | Immediately reset your stance in the quarter-squat position to absorb the landing fully before initiating the next rep. | Jump back to the left and rotate your torso to the right, mirroring the previous movement. | המשיל להחליף צדדים למספר החזרות או הזמן המומלצים, שומר על קצב עקבי ומבוקר.

t: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, core braced, and hands placed on your hips or out to your sides for balance. | Shift your weight onto your left foot, keeping a soft bend in the left knee. | Lift your right knee up toward your hip to chamber the leg, keeping the foot flexed. | Drive your right foot directly out to the side, extending the leg as straight as your flexibility allows. | Hold the extended position for one to two seconds, feeling the stretch through the inner thigh and hip. | Return the leg back to the chambered knee position in a controlled manner — do not let it drop. | Lower your right foot to the floor and repeat for the target number of reps, then switch sides.
tRu: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, core braced, and hands placed on your hips or out to your sides for balance. | Перенесите вес на левую ногу, сохраняя небольшой сгиб в левом колене. | Поднимите правое колено вверх к бедру, чтобы подвести ногу, сохраняя стопу согнутой. | Резмо двигайте правую ногу прямо в сторону, максимально выпрямляя ногу в пределах гибкости. | Задержите конечное положение на одну-две секунды, чувствуя растяжку во внутренней части бедра и тазобедренного сустава. | Return the leg back to the chambered knee position in a controlled manner — do not let it drop. | Опустите правую ногу на пол и выполните целевое количество повторений, затем поменяйте стороны.
tHe: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, core braced, and hands placed on your hips or out to your sides for balance. | העבר את המשקל לרגל שמאל, תוך שמירה על כיפוף קל בברך שמאל. | Lift your right knee up toward your hip to chamber the leg, keeping the foot flexed. | הנע את כף ימיך ישר אל הצד, מאריך את הרגל כמה שהגמישות מאפשרת. | Hold the extended position for one to two seconds, feeling the stretch through the inner thigh and hip. | Return the leg back to the chambered knee position in a controlled manner — do not let it drop. | Lower your right foot to the floor and repeat for the target number of reps, then switch sides.

t: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms at your sides. | Hinge at the hips and bend your knees to place both hands flat on the floor directly below your shoulders. | Jump or step both feet back simultaneously to land in a high plank position with your body forming a straight line from head to heels. | Lower your chest to the floor by bending your elbows, performing a push-up, then press back up to the high plank (optional for added intensity). | Jump or step both feet back toward your hands and rise up explosively. | As you reach the top of the movement, shift your weight onto your left foot and drive your right knee up. | Extend your right leg outward in a controlled side kick, pushing through the heel at hip height. | Return your right foot to the floor and immediately begin the next rep, alternating the kicking leg each round.
tRu: Встаньте прямо, поставив ноги на ширине плеч, руки вдоль тела. | Отводите бёдра назад и сгибайте колени, чтобы поставить обе руки на пол прямо под плечами. | Прыгните или шагните обеими ногами одновременно, приземлившись в положение высокой планки, тело образует прямую линию от головы до пят. | Опустите грудь к полу, сгибая локти, выполнив отжимание, затем вернитесь вверх в планку (опционально для повышения интенсивности). | Прыгните или шагните обеими ногами назад к рукам и мощно поднимитесь. | В верхней точке перенесите вес на левую ногу и поднимите правое колено вверх. | Выпрямите правую ногу в сторону контролируемого удара, толкаяся через пятку на уровне бедра. | Return your right foot to the floor and immediately begin the next rep, alternating the kicking leg each round.
tHe: עמוד זקוף עם רגליים ברוחב הכתפיים וידיים לצדי הגוף. | כופף בציר הירכיים וכופף את הברכיים כדי להניח את שתי כפות הידיים שטוחות על הרצפה ישירות מתחת לכתפיים. | Jump or step both feet back simultaneously to land in a high plank position with your body forming a straight line from head to heels. | Lower your chest to the floor by bending your elbows, performing a push-up, then press back up to the high plank (optional for added intensity). | Jump or step both feet back toward your hands and rise up explosively. | בהגעה לשיא התנועה, העבר משקל לרגל שמאל והרם את ברך ימין. | פשוט את רגל ימין החוצה בבעיטת צד מבוקרת, דוחף דרך העקב בגובה הירך. | Return your right foot to the floor and immediately begin the next rep, alternating the kicking leg each round.

t: Stand in a fighting stance with your non-dominant foot forward, feet roughly shoulder-width apart, hands raised in guard position near your chin. | Shift your weight onto your front (supporting) foot and pivot it 45–90 degrees outward so your heel points toward the target. | Chamber the kicking knee by lifting it up and across your torso until your thigh is roughly parallel to the floor and your heel is tucked close to your glute. | Drive your heel outward in a straight horizontal line, extending your leg fully and pushing through the heel. Your foot should be flexed with toes pointing down or forward. | Pause briefly at full extension without locking the knee — keep a very slight bend to protect the joint. | Retract the leg by bending the knee and pulling it back to the chambered position before lowering your foot to the floor. | Return to your fighting stance and reset your guard before the next repetition.
tRu: Stand in a fighting stance with your non-dominant foot forward, feet roughly shoulder-width apart, hands raised in guard position near your chin. | Shift your weight onto your front (supporting) foot and pivot it 45–90 degrees outward so your heel points toward the target. | Поднимите колено для удвига, сильно поднимая колено к груди, сохраняя стопу расслабленной. | Уводите пятку в сторону по прямой горизонтальной линии, полностью выпрямляя ногу и отталкиваясь от пятки. Стопа должна быть выгнута, пальцы направлены вниз или вперёд. | Пауза на мгновение в полной амплитуде, не блокируя колено — сохраняйте очень лёгкий сгиб для защиты сустава. | Retract the leg by bending the knee and pulling it back to the chambered position before lowering your foot to the floor. | Return to your fighting stance and reset your guard before the next repetition.
tHe: Stand in a fighting stance with your non-dominant foot forward, feet roughly shoulder-width apart, hands raised in guard position near your chin. | Shift your weight onto your front (supporting) foot and pivot it 45–90 degrees outward so your heel points toward the target. | קרב את הברך הבועטת על ידי הרמתה והזזתה על גופך עד שהירך מקבילה לרצפה והעקב קרוב לגב. | דחף את עקב הרגל החוצה בקו אופקי ישר, מרחיב את הרגל לחלוטין ודוחף דרך העקב. כף הרגל צריכה להיות מושטת עם אצבעות מכוונות למטה או קדימה. | Pause briefly at full extension without locking the knee — keep a very slight bend to protect the joint. | Retract the leg by bending the knee and pulling it back to the chambered position before lowering your foot to the floor. | Return to your fighting stance and reset your guard before the next repetition.

t: Kneel on a mat with both knees together and your torso upright, hands resting on your hips or lightly on the floor for balance. | Shift your weight onto your left knee and plant it firmly into the mat so your base is stable. | Extend your right leg straight out to the side, placing the foot flat on the floor with toes pointing forward or slightly outward. | Press through your left knee and right foot to create a stable foundation, keeping your hips square and level. | Lengthen your torso upward, then lean gently to the left, allowing your right hip and inner thigh to stretch. | For a deeper waist stretch, raise your right arm overhead and reach toward the left to create a long arc through your right side. | Hold the stretch for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and letting the hips and waist relax with each exhale. | Return to the starting kneeling position and repeat on the opposite side.
tRu: Встаньте на колени на коврике, оба колена вместе, корпус прямой, руки на бедрах или lightly на полу для баланса. | Shift your weight onto your left knee and plant it firmly into the mat so your base is stable. | Выпрямите правую ногу в сторону, поставив стопу на пол пальцами вперёд или немного наружу. | Press through your left knee and right foot to create a stable foundation, keeping your hips square and level. | Вытягивайте корпус вверх, затем наклоняйтесь мягко влево, позволяя правому бедру и внутренней поверхности бедра растягиваться. | Для более глубокого растяжения боковых мышц живота, поднимите правую руку вверх над головой и потянитесь влево, создавая длинную дугу по правой стороне тела. | Держите растяжку в течение 20-30 секунд, дыша медленно и позволяя мышцам расслабляться ещё больше с каждым выдохом. | Return to the starting kneeling position and repeat on the opposite side.
tHe: Kneel on a mat with both knees together and your torso upright, hands resting on your hips or lightly on the floor for balance. | Shift your weight onto your left knee and plant it firmly into the mat so your base is stable. | פשוט את רגל ימינה ישר החוצה לצד, מניח את הכף שטח על הרצפה עם כפות הרגלים פונות קדימה או מעט החוצה. | Press through your left knee and right foot to create a stable foundation, keeping your hips square and level. | Lengthen your torso upward, then lean gently to the left, allowing your right hip and inner thigh to stretch. | למתיחת מותניים עמוקה יותר, הרם את זרוע ימין מעל הראש והושט אותה שמאלה ליצירת קשת ארוכה לאורך צידו הימני של הגוף. | Hold the stretch for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and letting the hips and waist relax with each exhale. | Return to the starting kneeling position and repeat on the opposite side.

t: Start on all fours with your hands directly under your shoulders, knees under your hips, and toes tucked. Lift your knees one to two inches off the floor so your weight is on your hands and the balls of your feet. | Shift your weight onto your left hand and left foot, rotating your hips slightly to the right to create space. | Sweep your right leg forward and across your body, kicking it through the gap between your left hand and left foot toward the left side. | As the right leg drives through, rotate your torso to follow — your left hip will rise and your body will face partially upward at the end of the kick. | Keep your hips elevated throughout; do not let them sink to the floor during or after the kick. | Extend the kicking leg as fully as the stretch allows, then pause briefly in the end position. | Reverse the movement under control: pull the right leg back through and return to the bear-crawl starting position. | Complete all reps on one side, then switch — shift weight to the right hand and foot and kick the left leg through.

Lift your knees one to two inches off the floor so your weight is on your hands and the balls of your feet. | Shift your weight onto your left hand and left foot, rotating your hips slightly to the right to create space. | Sweep your right leg forward and across your body, kicking it through the gap between your left hand and left foot toward the left side. | Когда правая нога выполняет маховое движение, поворачивайте корпус вслед — левое бедро поднимется, а тело в конце удара развернётся частично вверх. | Держите бёдра поднятыми на протяжении всего движения; не позволяйте им опускаться на пол во время или после удара ногой. | Полностью выпрямите маховую ногу, насколько позволяет растяжка, затем на мгновение остановитесь в конечном положении. | Reverse the movement under control: pull the right leg back through and return to the bear-crawl starting position. | Выполните все повторения на одну сторону, затем поменяйтесь — перенесите вес на правую руку и ногу и проведите левую ногу сквозь.
