tRu: Sit on the floor with your back straight and extend both legs out wide in a V-shape, aiming for roughly 45° from the centerline on each side — a range that feels firm but not painful. | Point your toes toward the ceiling and gently press the backs of your knees toward the floor to keep the legs fully extended. | Sit tall, engage your core lightly, and place your hands on the floor between your legs for balance. | Отводите бёдра вперёд — не в талии — сохраняя позвоночник длинным и грудь lifted, начиная наклоняться. | Walk your hands forward along the floor until you feel a firm stretch along the inner thighs and groin. | Зафиксируйте максимально комфортное положение на 20–30 секунд, дыша ровно и позволяя себе расслабляться еще глубже с каждым выдохом. | На вдохе упритесь руками в пол и медленно вернитесь в сидячее положение, затем расслабьтесь.
tHe: Sit on the floor with your back straight and extend both legs out wide in a V-shape, aiming for roughly 45° from the centerline on each side — a range that feels firm but not painful. | Point your toes toward the ceiling and gently press the backs of your knees toward the floor to keep the legs fully extended. | Sit tall, engage your core lightly, and place your hands on the floor between your legs for balance. | כופף קדימה בציר הירכיים — לא במותניים — תוך שמירה על עמוד שדרה ארוך וחזה מורם בתחילת הנטייה. | Walk your hands forward along the floor until you feel a firm stretch along the inner thighs and groin. | Hold the deepest comfortable position for 20–30 seconds, breathing steadily and allowing yourself to relax slightly deeper on each exhale. | On an inhale, press your hands into the floor and return slowly to an upright seated position before releasing.

t: Sit upright near the edge of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart, and your knees bent at roughly 90 degrees. | Clasp your hands together in front of your chest with your arms slightly bent. | Brace your core and sit tall so your spine is neutral — avoid rounding your lower back. | Rotate your torso to the right while sweeping your clasped hands diagonally downward toward your right hip, as if chopping toward the floor. | Reverse the motion by rotating your torso up and across to the left, sweeping your hands diagonally upward toward your left shoulder. | Continue this diagonal chopping pattern for the prescribed number of reps, then switch sides so you chop from left hip to right shoulder. | Throughout the movement, keep your hips and thighs facing forward — the rotation should come from your waist and not from your pelvis shifting.
tRu: Sit upright near the edge of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart, and your knees bent at roughly 90 degrees. | Соедините ладони вместе перед грудью, слегка согнув руки. | Напрягите корпус и сядьте прямо, чтобы позвоночник был в нейтральном положении, не округляйте поясницу. | Rotate your torso to the right while sweeping your clasped hands diagonally downward toward your right hip, as if chopping toward the floor. | Reverse the motion by rotating your torso up and across to the left, sweeping your hands diagonally upward toward your left shoulder. | Продолжайте этот диагональный рубящий паттерн для заданного количества повторений, затем смените сторону, чтобы рубить от левого бедра к правому плечу. | Throughout the movement, keep your hips and thighs facing forward — the rotation should come from your waist and not from your pelvis shifting.
tHe: Sit upright near the edge of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart, and your knees bent at roughly 90 degrees. | חבר את ידיך לפני החזה עם הזרועות מעט מכופפות. | הדק את הליבה ושב זקוף כך שעמוד השדרה ניטרלי — הימנע מעיגול הגב התחתון. | Rotate your torso to the right while sweeping your clasped hands diagonally downward toward your right hip, as if chopping toward the floor. | Reverse the motion by rotating your torso up and across to the left, sweeping your hands diagonally upward toward your left shoulder. | המשך את תבנית החיתוך האלכסוני הזו למספר החזרות המומלץ, ואז החלף צדדים כך שחותכים מהירך השמאלית לכתף הימנית. | Throughout the movement, keep your hips and thighs facing forward — the rotation should come from your waist and not from your pelvis shifting.

nH: קיצוץ עצים בישיבה על כדור פיזיו
t: Sit tall on a stability ball with your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart, and your knees bent at roughly 90 degrees. | Interlace your fingers or clasp your hands together in front of your chest. | Rotate your torso to the right and raise your clasped hands up toward your right shoulder, keeping your arms relatively straight. | In one controlled motion, sweep your hands diagonally downward across your body toward your left hip, rotating your torso to the left as you go. | Allow your right heel to lift slightly and your torso to follow the rotation naturally — do not force the movement from your arms alone. | Pause briefly at the bottom of the chop, feeling the stretch through your right oblique. | Reverse the motion, sweeping your hands back up to the starting position on the right side under control. | Complete all reps on one side before switching, or alternate sides each rep according to your preference. | Throughout the set, keep your hips level and your core braced to prevent the ball from rolling out from under you.
tRu: Сядьте ровно на фитбол, поставив стопы на пол на ширине бёдер и согнув колени под углом примерно 90 градусов. | Переплетите пальцы или сожмите руки вместе перед грудью. | Rotate your torso to the right and raise your clasped hands up toward your right shoulder, keeping your arms relatively straight. | В одном контролируемом движении проведите руки по диагонали вниз через тело к левому бедру, вращая корпус влеву. | Позвольте правой пятке слегка подняться, а корпусу — естественно следовать за поворотом, не выполняйте движение только руками. | Пауза на мгновение в нижней точке рубки, ощущая растяжение в правой косой мышце живота. | Reverse the motion, sweeping your hands back up to the starting position on the right side under control. | Выполните все повторения на одной стороне перед тем, как сменить сторону, или чередуйте стороны с каждым повторением по вашему желанию. | Throughout the set, keep your hips level and your core braced to prevent the ball from rolling out from under you.
tHe: שב זקוף על כדור פיזיו עם כפות רגליים שטוחות על הרצפה, ברוחב האגן, וברכיים כפופות בערך ב-90 מעלות. | Interlace your fingers or clasp your hands together in front of your chest. | Rotate your torso to the right and raise your clasped hands up toward your right shoulder, keeping your arms relatively straight. | In one controlled motion, sweep your hands diagonally downward across your body toward your left hip, rotating your torso to the left as you go. | תן לעקב ימין להתרומם קלות ולגו לעקוב אחר הסיבוב באופן טבעי — אל תכפה את התנועה מהידיים בלבד. | Pause briefly at the bottom of the chop, feeling the stretch through your right oblique. | Reverse the motion, sweeping your hands back up to the starting position on the right side under control. | בצע את כל החזרות בצד אחד לפני החלפה, או החלף צדדים בכל חזרה לפי העדפתך. | Throughout the set, keep your hips level and your core braced to prevent the ball from rolling out from under you.

t: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you. | Bend your left knee and draw the left heel in toward your perineum, resting the outer edge of the left foot on the floor. | Bend your right knee and place the right foot on top of the left ankle, positioning the right heel directly above the left heel. | Tuck the toes of your right foot between the calf and thigh of your left leg. | Rest your hands on your knees with palms facing up or down, or adopt a mudra of your choice. | Lengthen your spine upward, draw your shoulder blades gently back, and lift the crown of your head toward the ceiling. | Close your eyes, soften your face, and breathe slowly and evenly through your nose. | Hold the posture for as long as comfortable, then release and switch the crossing of the legs.
tRu: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you. | Согните левое колено и подтяните левую пятку к промежности, опираясь внешним краем левой стопы на пол. | Согните правое колено и положите правую стопу поверх левой лодыжки так, чтобы правая пятка оказалась прямо над левой. | Tuck the toes of your right foot between the calf and thigh of your left leg. | Rest your hands on your knees with palms facing up or down, or adopt a mudra of your choice. | Вытягивайте позвоночник вверх, мягко отводите лопатки назад и поднимайте макушку к потолку. | Закройте глаза, расслабьте лицо и дышите медленно и ровно через нос. | Держите позу в течение комфортного времени, затем расслабьтесь и поменяйте скрещивание ног.
tHe: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you. | כופף את ברך שמאל ומשוך את עקב שמאל פנימה לכיוון אזור החיץ, תוך הנחת הקצה החיצוני של כף רגל שמאל על הרצפה. | כופף את ברך ימין והנח את כף רגל ימין על גבי קרסול שמאל, תוך מיקום עקב ימין ישירות מעל עקב שמאל. | Tuck the toes of your right foot between the calf and thigh of your left leg. | Rest your hands on your knees with palms facing up or down, or adopt a mudra of your choice. | Lengthen your spine upward, draw your shoulder blades gently back, and lift the crown of your head toward the ceiling. | סגור את הפה ונשוף לאט דרך האף לספירת ארבע, מכוון את הנשירה לבטן והצלעות התחתונות ולא להרמת החזה. | Hold the posture for as long as comfortable, then release and switch the crossing of the legs.

t: Lie on your back with your knees bent to roughly 90 degrees and your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. | Cross your arms over your chest, placing each hand on the opposite shoulder. | Press your lower back lightly into the floor and brace your core before you begin. | Exhale and curl your torso upward by first lifting your shoulder blades off the floor, then continuing to rise until your torso is fully upright and your chest is close to your thighs. | Hold the top position briefly without rounding your upper back excessively. | Inhale and lower your torso back to the floor under control, uncurling vertebra by vertebra until your shoulder blades touch the floor. | Reset your brace and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tRu: Лягте на спину, колени согните под углом примерно 90 градусов, ступни поставьте на пол на ширине таза. | Перекрестите руки на груди, положив каждую руку на противоположное плечо. | Press your lower back lightly into the floor and brace your core before you begin. | Выдохните и поднимите туловище вверх, сначала оторвав лопатки от пола, а затем продолжая подниматься до полного выпрямления туловища, когда грудь окажется близко к бедрам. | Удерживайте верхнюю точку в течение короткого времени, не изгибая верхнюю часть спины чрезмерно. | Выдохните и опустите корпус обратно на пол под контролем, распрямляя позвонок за позвонком, пока лопатки не коснутся пола. | Восстановите напряжение корпуса и повторите желаемое количество повторений.
tHe: Lie on your back with your knees bent to roughly 90 degrees and your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. | חצה את הידיים לפני החזה, שים כל יד על הכתף הנגדית. | Press your lower back lightly into the floor and brace your core before you begin. | נשוף וכף את גופך למעלה על ידי הרמת להבות הכתפיים מהרצפה קודם, ואז המשך לעלות עד שגופך יהיה מאונך לחלוטין והחזה שלך יהיה קרוב לירכיים. | Hold the top position briefly without rounding your upper back excessively. | Inhale and lower your torso back to the floor under control, uncurling vertebra by vertebra until your shoulder blades touch the floor. | אפס את המתח בליבה וחזור על התרגיל למספר החזרות הרצוי.

t: Place a sturdy chair on a non-slip surface and sit on the floor in front of it, facing away from the seat. | Slide your feet under the front legs or the bottom rung of the chair so your ankles are securely anchored. | Lie back on the floor with your knees bent at roughly 90 degrees and your feet flat. | Cross your arms over your chest or place your fingertips lightly at your temples — do not pull on your neck. | Exhale and contract your rectus abdominis to curl your torso upward, leading with your chest rather than your head. | Continue rising until your torso is upright and your forearms are near your thighs. | Pause briefly at the top, keeping tension in your core. | Inhale and lower your torso back to the floor under control, vertebra by vertebra, until your shoulder blades touch the floor. | Complete the desired number of repetitions before removing your feet from under the chair.
tRu: Положите sturdy chair на non-slip surface and sit on the floor in front of it, facing away from the seat. | Slide your feet under the front legs or the bottom rung of the chair so your ankles are securely anchored. | Лягте на спину на пол, колени согнуты под углом примерно 90 градусов, ступни flat. | Перекрестите руки на груди или поставьте пальцы лёгкими касаниями у висков — не тяните за шею. | Выдохните и напрягите прямые мышцы живота, чтобы поднять корпус вверх, ведя грудью, а не головой. | Продолжайте подниматься, пока ваш торс не станет вертикальным, а ваши предплечья не окажутся рядом с бёдрами. | На вершине движения сделайте короткую паузу, сохраняя напряжение в корпусе. | На вдохе подконтрольно опустите корпус на пол, позвонок за позвонком, пока лопатки не коснутся пола. | Выполните желаемое количество повторений, прежде чем убрать ноги из-под стула.
tHe: Place a sturdy chair on a non-slip surface and sit on the floor in front of it, facing away from the seat. | Slide your feet under the front legs or the bottom rung of the chair so your ankles are securely anchored. | Lie back on the floor with your knees bent at roughly 90 degrees and your feet flat. | חצה את ידיך מעל החזה שלך או הנח את אצבעות ידיך בצדדי המצח בקלות — אל תמשוך בצוואר. | נשוף וכווץ את השריר הישר של הבטן כדי לכופף את גופך למעלה, מוביל עם החזה ולא עם הראש. | המשך לעלות עד שהגוף שלך זקוף והזרועות הקדמיים קרובות לירכיים. | Pause briefly at the top, keeping tension in your core. | שאף והורד את הגו חזרה לרצפה בשליטה, חוליה אחר חוליה, עד ששכמות הכתפיים נוגעות ברצפה. | בצע את המספר הרצוי של החזרות לפני שמוצא את רגליך מתחת לכיסא.

t: Stand with your back against a smooth wall, feet hip-width apart and roughly 45–50 cm away from the wall — about the length of your thigh. | Slide your back down the wall until your hips and knees are both at approximately 90 degrees and your thighs are parallel to the floor. | Press your entire back — lower, mid, and upper — firmly into the wall throughout the hold. | Position your feet so your shins are vertical and your knees track directly over your second toes. | Keep your arms at your sides, resting lightly on your thighs or extended forward — do not push off your thighs. | Hold the position for the target duration, breathing steadily and keeping your core braced. | To finish, press through your feet and slide back up the wall to a standing position.
tRu: Stand with your back against a smooth wall, feet hip-width apart and roughly 45–50 cm away from the wall — about the length of your thigh. | Slide your back down the wall until your hips and knees are both at approximately 90 degrees and your thighs are parallel to the floor. | Press your entire back — lower, mid, and upper — firmly into the wall throughout the hold. | Position your feet so your shins are vertical and your knees track directly over your second toes. | Держите руки согнуты под углом примерно 90° и двигайте их в противоположность ногам, чтобы помочь ритму и равновесию. | Удерживайте положение в течение целевого времени, дыша ровно и напрягая корпус. | To finish, press through your feet and slide back up the wall to a standing position.
tHe: Stand with your back against a smooth wall, feet hip-width apart and roughly 45–50 cm away from the wall — about the length of your thigh. | Slide your back down the wall until your hips and knees are both at approximately 90 degrees and your thighs are parallel to the floor. | Press your entire back — lower, mid, and upper — firmly into the wall throughout the hold. | Position your feet so your shins are vertical and your knees track directly over your second toes. | Keep your arms at your sides, resting lightly on your thighs or extended forward — do not push off your thighs. | החזק את התנוחה למשך הזמן היעד, תוך נשימה סדירה ושמירה על ליבה מכווצת. | To finish, press through your feet and slide back up the wall to a standing position.

t: Stand with your feet together and your knees slightly bent in an athletic stance, keeping your chest up and your weight centered. | Push off your right foot and leap laterally to the left, driving your left arm across your body for momentum. | Land on your left foot with your knee bent and your hips pushed back, absorbing the impact softly as you settle into a single-leg squat position. | Bring your right foot behind and to the inside of your left leg without letting it touch the floor. | Swing your right arm across your body and push off your left foot to leap back to the right. | Land on your right foot in the same controlled single-leg position, keeping your knee tracking over your toes. | Continue alternating sides at a steady rhythm, maintaining control on each landing before driving into the next jump. | After completing your reps or time interval, step to the center and stand upright to finish.
tRu: Stand with your feet together and your knees slightly bent in an athletic stance, keeping your chest up and your weight centered. | Push off your right foot and leap laterally to the left, driving your left arm across your body for momentum. | Приземляйтесь на левую ногу с согнутым коленом и отведёнными назад бёдрами, мягко амортизируя удар, переходя в положение приседа на одной ноге. | Заведите правую ногу за и внутрь левой ноги, не касаясь пола. | Swing your right arm across your body and push off your left foot to leap back to the right. | Приземляйтесь на правую ногу в том же контролируемом положении на одной ноге, сохраняя движение колена над пальцами ног. | Продолжайте попеременно менять стороны в устойчивом ритме, сохраняя контроль при каждом приземлении перед следующим прыжком. | Выполнив повторы или временной интервал, шагните в центр и встаньте прямо для завершения.
tHe: Stand with your feet together and your knees slightly bent in an athletic stance, keeping your chest up and your weight centered. | Push off your right foot and leap laterally to the left, driving your left arm across your body for momentum. | Land on your left foot with your knee bent and your hips pushed back, absorbing the impact softly as you settle into a single-leg squat position. | הבא את רגל ימין מאחורה ולפנים של רגל שמאל מבלי לאפשר לה לגעת ברצפה. | Swing your right arm across your body and push off your left foot to leap back to the right. | Land on your right foot in the same controlled single-leg position, keeping your knee tracking over your toes. | המשיל לחילופין בין צד לצד בקצב קבוע, שומר על שליטה בכל נחיתה לפני הדחיפה לקפיצה הבאה. | אחרי שסיימת את החזרות או פרק הזמן, צעד למרכז ועמוד זקוף לסיום.

t: Stand tall and shift your weight entirely onto one foot. Lift the non-working leg off the floor and let it bend behind you so the lower leg hangs freely. | Extend both arms forward at shoulder height to serve as a counterbalance throughout the movement. | Engage your core and fix your gaze on a point at eye level to help maintain balance. | Initiate the descent by pushing your hips back and bending the standing knee, keeping your torso relatively upright with a controlled forward lean from the hips. | Lower in a controlled manner, allowing the trailing knee to travel toward the floor behind you — do not let it drop or crash down. | Descend until the trailing knee gently grazes or hovers just above the floor, or until you reach the deepest range you can control without losing alignment. | Keep the heel of the standing foot flat on the floor throughout, and track the knee in line with your second and third toes — do not let it cave inward. | Drive through your heel and midfoot to press the floor away and return under control to the starting position. | Complete all reps on one side before switching legs.
tRu: Stand tall and shift your weight entirely onto one foot. Lift the non-working leg off the floor and let it bend behind you so the lower leg hangs freely. | Вытяните обе руки вперёд на уровне плеч, чтобы служить противовесом на протяжении всего движения. | Напрягите мышцы кора и зафиксируйте взгляд на точке на уровне глаз, чтобы помочь сохранить равновесие. | Начните опускание, отводя бёдра назад и разводя колни в стороны, в линию с носками, опускаясь контролируемо к стулу. | Опуститесь под контролем, позволяя заднему колену двигаться к полу за вами — не давайте ему упасть или резко опуститься. | Опускайтесь, пока заднее колено едва касается или находится чуть над полом, или пока вы достигнете максимальной амплитуды, которую можете контролировать без потери правильного положения. | Держите пятку опорной ноги прижатой к полу на протяжении всего движения, и следите, чтобы колено было на одной линии со вторым и третьим пальцами ног — не позволяйте ему заваливаться внутрь. | Отталкивайтесь пяткой и серединой стопы, чтобы оттолкнуть пол и вернуться под контролем в исходное положение. | Выполните все повторения на одну сторону, затем поменяйте ноги.
tHe: Stand tall and shift your weight entirely onto one foot. t: Sit in the 45-degree sled machine and press your lower back, hips, and head firmly against the pad. | Place your right foot flat in the center of the platform at roughly hip width, with your toes angled slightly outward; rest your left foot on the frame or floor. | Grip the handles at your sides to anchor your upper body and brace your core. | Disengage the safety stops and hold the sled with your working leg extended, stopping just short of full knee lockout. | Inhale and lower the sled under control by bending your working knee slowly — take three to four seconds to descend — keeping your heel flat on the platform and your knee tracking in line with your toes. | Continue the descent until your thigh reaches roughly parallel to the platform or your lower back just begins to lift off the pad, whichever comes first. | Exhale and drive evenly through your full foot to press the sled back up, extending your knee and hip simultaneously, and stop just short of full lockout. | Engage the safety stops, switch feet so your left foot is on the platform, release the stops, and repeat the slow eccentric descent followed by a controlled press. | Continue alternating legs for the target number of reps per side, then engage the safety stops securely before exiting the machine.
tRu: Sit in the 45-degree sled machine and press your lower back, hips, and head firmly against the pad. | Положите правую стопу плоско в центре платформы примерно на ширине таза, носками слегка наружу; левую стопу поставьте на раму или пол. | Возьмитесь за боковые рукояти, чтобы зафиксировать верх тела, и напрягите корпус. | Снимите страховочные упоры и удерживайте платформу с выпрямленной рабочей ногой, не доводя колено до полного выпрямления. | Выдохните и опустите платформу под контролем, медленно сгибая рабочее колено — на опускание потратьте три-четыре секунды — удерживая пятку на платформе и отслеживая колено в линее с носками. | Продолжайте опускание, пока ваше бедро не окажется примерно параллельно платформе или нижняя часть спины только начнет отрываться от подушки, в зависимости от того, что произойдет первым. | На выдохе равномерно отожмите платформу всей стопой, одновременно выпрямляя колено и бедро, и не доводите до полного выпрямления. | Активируйте страховочные упоры, поменяйте ноги так, чтобы левая нога была на платформе, снимите упоры и повторите медленный эксцентрический спуск с последующим контролируемым жимом. | Продолжайте попеременно менять ноги в течение целевого количества повторений на каждую сторону, затем надёжно зафиксируйте блокировку безопасности, прежде чем покинуть тренажёр.
tHe: Sit in the 45-degree sled machine and press your lower back, hips, and head firmly against the pad. | Place your right foot flat in the center of the platform at roughly hip width, with your toes angled slightly outward; rest your left foot on the frame or floor. | אחוז בידיות לצדי הגוף כדי לעגן את פלג הגוף העליון והדק את הליבה. | שחרר את מעצורי הבטיחות והחזק את המזחלת עם הרגל העובדת ישרה, תוך עצירה מעט לפני נעילת ברך מלאה. | Inhale and lower the sled under control by bending your working knee slowly — take three to four seconds to descend — keeping your heel flat on the platform and your knee tracking in line with your toes. | המשך את הירידה עד שהירך מגיעה לזווית של כ-45 מעלות למפתן או עד שהגב התחתון מתחיל להרים מהריפוד, זה שקורה קודם. | נשוף ודחוף באופן שווה דרך כל כף הרגל כדי להרים את המזחלת חזרה, תוך יישור הברך והאגן יחד, ועצור מעט לפני נעילה מלאה. | הפעל את נעילות הבטיחות, החלף רגליים כך שהרגל השמאלית על הבמה, שחרר את הנעילות, וחזור על הירידה האיטית האקצנטרית ולאחריה הדחיפה המבוקרת. | המשילו להחליף בין רגליים למספר החזרות המטרה לכל צד, ואז הפעילו את בלמי הבטיחות בביטחה לפני יציאה מהמכונה.

t: Sit in the 45-degree sled machine and press your lower back and glutes firmly into the seat pad, with your head resting against the backrest. | Place both feet high on the footplate — near the upper edge — with a hip-width to shoulder-width stance and toes pointed slightly outward. | Ensure your entire foot, including your heels, is in contact with the footplate before unracking. | Grip the handles on either side of the seat to stabilize your upper body, then release the safety stoppers to take control of the sled. | Slowly lower the sled by bending your knees and allowing your hips to flex, keeping your lower back pressed into the pad throughout the descent. | Lower until your knees approach your chest or your thighs reach roughly parallel, stopping before your lower back peels away from the seat pad. | Drive through your heels to press the sled back up along the track, focusing on extending the hips and squeezing the glutes at the top. | Stop just short of fully locking out your knees at the top of each rep to keep tension on the muscles. | After completing your reps, rotate the safety stoppers fully into the locked position and confirm they are engaged before exiting the machine.

t: Load the sled and step into the machine, positioning your back flat against the padded backrest and your feet shoulder-width apart in the middle of the platform, toes angled out 15 to 30 degrees. | Release the safety handles and stand tall with your legs extended and your spine neutral against the pad. | Brace your core, then bend your knees and hips to lower the sled in a slow, controlled manner. | Keep your heels pressed firmly into the platform and your knees tracking over your toes throughout the descent. | Continue lowering until your thighs reach at least parallel to the platform, without letting your lower back peel away from the pad. | Pause briefly at the bottom, then drive through your entire foot to press the sled back up to the start position. | Stop just short of fully locking out your knees at the top to maintain tension on the thighs. | At the end of your set, re-engage the safety handles before stepping out of the machine.
tRu: Нагрузите sledge и ступите в тренажер, расположив спину ровно к padded спинке и ноги на ширине плеч в центре платформы, носками, развёрнутыми на 15-30 градусов. | Release the safety handles and stand tall with your legs extended and your spine neutral against the pad. | Напрягите корпус, затем сгибайте колени и бёдра, чтобы медленно и контролируемо опустить платформу. | Держите таз и стопы направленными прямо вперед — двигаются только руки и плечи; сопротивляйтесь желанию вращать корпус вместе с весом. | Продолжайте опускаться, пока ваши бедра не достигнут хотя бы параллели платформе, не давая пояснице отрываться от валика. | На мгновение остановитесь в нижней точке, затем упритесь всей стопой, чтобы вернуть эспандер в исходное положение. | Stop just short of fully locking out your knees at the top to maintain tension on the thighs. | В конце подхода снова зафиксируйте страховочные рукояти, прежде чем выходить из тренажёра.
tHe: Load the sled and step into the machine, positioning your back flat against the padded backrest and your feet shoulder-width apart in the middle of the platform, toes angled out 15 to 30 degrees. | Release the safety handles and stand tall with your legs extended and your spine neutral against the pad. | כווץ את שרירי הליבה, ואז דחוף דרך עקב וכף הרגל העליונה כדי לעלות על הקופסה. | Keep your heels pressed firmly into the platform and your knees tracking over your toes throughout the descent. | המשילו עד שהירכים מגיעות למקבילות לפחות למשטח, מבלי לאפשר לגב התחתון להיפרד מהכרית. | Pause briefly at the bottom, then drive through your entire foot to press the sled back up to the start position. | Stop just short of fully locking out your knees at the top to maintain tension on the thighs. | בסוף הסט נעל שוב את ידיות הבטיחות לפני היציאה מהמכשיר.

t: Set the sled to a manageable weight and lie back on the carriage with your back flat against the pad. | Place one foot on the footplate at roughly hip width, keeping the heel fully in contact with the plate. | Let the non-working leg hang free and clear of the footplate for the entire set. | Disengage the safety handles and lower the carriage under control by bending the working knee. | Descend until your knee reaches roughly a 90-degree angle or as deep as your mobility allows without your lower back lifting off the pad. | Press through the heel of the working foot to extend the knee and drive the sled back to the starting position. | Stop just short of full knee lockout at the top of each rep. | Complete all reps on one leg, re-engage the safety handles, switch feet, and repeat on the other side.

t: Step into the hack squat machine and position your back and shoulders firmly against the pad, with the shoulder stops resting comfortably on your traps. | Place one foot flat near the center of the platform at roughly hip width, with your toes angled slightly outward; lift and tuck your other foot off the platform entirely. | Grip the handles at your sides to stabilize your upper body and brace your core. | Disengage the safety handles and hold the sled with your working leg extended, stopping just short of full knee lockout. | Inhale and lower the sled under control by bending your working knee, keeping your heel flat and your knee tracking over your toes. | Continue the descent until your thigh reaches roughly parallel to the platform or your lower back begins to peel away from the pad — whichever comes first. | Exhale and drive through your full foot to press the sled back up, extending your knee and hip simultaneously, and stop just short of full lockout. | Complete all reps on that leg, then re-engage the safety handles fully before repositioning and switching to the other leg. | When the set is finished, lock the safety handles securely before stepping off the platform.

t: Load the sled machine to the appropriate weight, then step onto the platform facing the pad with your chest pressed against it. | Place your feet shoulder-width apart on the footplate, toes angled out 10–15°, positioned slightly lower than you would for a standard hack squat to allow a fuller range of hip flexion. | Rest your shoulders under the shoulder pads and grip the handles firmly with both hands. | Release the safety handles and stand fully upright so your legs support the weight. | Brace your core, then begin the descent by simultaneously bending your knees and pushing your hips back, maintaining contact between your chest and the pad. | Lower until your thighs reach parallel with the footplate or just below, keeping your heels firmly in contact with the platform throughout. | Drive through your heels and mid-foot to press back to the starting position, fully extending your hips and knees without snapping them into hyperextension. | Complete all target reps, then re-engage the safety handles before stepping off the machine.

t: Position yourself sideways against the sled pad so that one hip and the side of your torso rest against the carriage, with the pressing leg closest to the platform. | Place your foot flat on the sled platform at a comfortable height, roughly level with your hip, with your knee bent and your toes pointing slightly outward. | Brace your core and stabilize your upper body against the pad with your hand or forearm for support. | Press the platform away by extending your hip and knee in a controlled, smooth motion, driving through your heel. | Continue pressing until your leg is nearly fully extended, avoiding a hard lockout at the knee. | Slowly return the platform toward your starting position, letting your hip and knee bend under control, until you reach the starting depth. | Complete all reps on one side, then reposition and repeat on the other leg.

t: Load the sled with the desired weight plates and set the safety stops just above your starting position. | Lie flat on the padded carriage with your back and hips fully in contact with the pad. | Place your feet on the sled platform roughly shoulder-width apart, toes angled slightly outward. | Disengage the safety stops so the sled rests against your feet under full load. | Brace your core and press your lower back firmly into the pad. | Push the sled upward by extending your knees and hips smoothly until your legs are nearly straight, stopping just short of full lockout. | Lower the sled in a controlled manner until your knees reach roughly 90 degrees or you feel a full stretch in the thighs — stop before the lower back lifts off the pad. | Complete your reps, then re-engage the safety stops fully before releasing foot pressure or stepping out of the machine.

t: Step onto the hack squat machine and position your back and shoulders against the padded backrest, with your feet placed wide on the footplate — roughly 1.5 to 2 times shoulder-width apart. | Turn your toes outward at roughly 30 to 45 degrees, keeping your entire foot flat against the footplate. | Rest your shoulders under the shoulder pads and grip the handles to stabilize your upper body. | Disengage the safety handles and take control of the sled weight before beginning your descent. | Brace your core and begin lowering by bending at the hips and knees simultaneously, allowing your knees to track in line with your toes. | Descend until your thighs reach parallel with the footplate or slightly below, stopping before your lower back rounds away from the backrest. | Drive through your full foot — keeping your heels flat — to press the sled back up along the track, stopping just short of fully locking out your knees at the top. | Complete your reps under control, then re-engage the safety handles and confirm they are locked before stepping off the machine.

t: Lie on your back on a smooth floor. Place both heels on a folded towel so they can slide freely, with your legs almost fully extended and your arms resting at your sides. | Brace your core by drawing your navel gently toward your spine, and press your lower back lightly into the floor to establish a stable starting position. | Drive through your heels to lift your hips off the floor until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to heels, fully extending your hips at the top. | Keeping your hips raised and your glutes squeezed, slowly slide the towel toward your glutes by bending your knees — curling your heels in without letting your hips drop. | Continue curling until your knees reach roughly a 90-degree bend, or as far as you can maintain a level hip position without sagging. | Pause briefly at the top of the curl, squeezing your hamstrings and glutes while keeping your core engaged. | Slowly slide the towel back out by extending your knees, keeping your hips elevated throughout the entire return. | Once your legs are nearly straight again, lower your hips under control back to the floor to complete one rep.

t: Lie face down on a smooth, low-friction floor with your body fully extended. Place a folded towel under each hand, or grip the ends of a single towel laid across the floor in front of you. | Extend your arms straight overhead, shoulder-width apart, with your palms pressing down into the towels. Keep your forehead lightly resting on the floor. | Engage your core and glutes so your lower back stays neutral and your hips do not hike upward. | Initiate the movement by driving your elbows down and back toward your hips, allowing the towels to slide toward your sides. Focus on pulling with your lats rather than pushing with your hands. | Continue sliding your arms until your elbows are bent roughly 90° and your hands are beside your ribcage. Squeeze your lats and mid-back at this point. | Pause for one second at the bottom of the pull, maintaining tension through the back. | Slowly extend your arms back overhead along the floor, letting the towels slide forward, until you return to the starting position. | Repeat for the desired number of reps without losing tension in your core or letting your lower back arch excessively.

t: Stand facing a wall, pole, or sturdy surface at roughly arm's length, feet shoulder-width apart. | Raise one arm and place your hand on the surface slightly above shoulder height, fingers pointing upward. | Shift your hips away from the surface so your body forms a diagonal line — you are leaning toward the surface with your arm extended, creating a slope with your torso. | Allow your shoulder to drop and your lat to lengthen by pressing your hip away from the wall while keeping your arm straight. | Turn your torso very slightly away from the anchored arm to increase the stretch along the side of your back. | Breathe in deeply to expand the rib cage, then exhale slowly to deepen the stretch without forcing it. | Hold the position for 20–30 seconds, keeping steady breathing throughout. | Gently return to standing, then repeat on the other side for the same duration. | Complete 2–3 rounds per side, moving deeper into the stretch only as your muscles relax.

t: Set the Smith machine bar to approximately hip height. t: Start in a high-plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders, arms fully extended, and your body forming a straight line from head to heels. | Engage your core, squeeze your glutes, and ensure your hips are neither sagging toward the floor nor piked up toward the ceiling. | Take a breath in, then drive your right knee out to the side toward your right elbow, keeping your foot close to the floor and rotating at the hip. | Bring your right foot back to the starting position in a controlled but quick motion. | Immediately drive your left knee out to the side toward your left elbow in the same lateral arc. | Return your left foot to the starting position to complete one full repetition. | Continue alternating legs at a brisk, rhythmic pace for the desired number of reps or duration. | Maintain a neutral spine and level hips throughout — do not let your lower back collapse or your hips rotate excessively to the side as you move each leg.

t: Place a stability ball on a flat, non-slip surface and kneel or stand just behind it. | Sit on the floor or on your heels in front of the ball, then lean back and drape your mid-back over the top of the ball so your spine curves around its surface. | Walk your feet slightly forward until the ball rests comfortably under your mid-to-lower back and your hips drop toward the floor. | Allow your arms to fall open to the sides or extend them overhead to deepen the stretch along the obliques and rectus abdominis. | Let gravity gently pull your head, shoulders, and hips downward, elongating the spine over the curve of the ball. | Breathe deeply and slowly, releasing tension with each exhale and allowing the stretch to deepen gradually. | Hold the position for 20–60 seconds, or as long as comfortable, then carefully roll to one side to dismount the ball.
tRu: Поставьте мяч для стабилизации на flat, non-slip surface and kneel or stand just behind it. | Sit on the floor or on your heels in front of the ball, then lean back and drape your mid-back over the top of the ball so your spine curves around its surface. | Walk your feet slightly forward until the ball rests comfortably under your mid-to-lower back and your hips drop toward the floor. | Позвольте рукам раскрыться в стороны или вытяните их над головой, чтобы углубить растяжку косых мышц и прямой мышцы живота. | Позвольте тяжести мягко тянуть вашу голову, плечи и бёдра вниз, вытягивая позвоночник по изгибу мяча. | Дышите глубоко и медленно, расслабляя напряжение с каждым выдохом и позволяя растяжке постепенно углубляться. | Задержите положение на 20-60 секунд или столько, сколько комфортно, затем аккуратно перекатитесь на бок, чтобы сойти с мяча.
tHe: Place a stability ball on a flat, non-slip surface and kneel or stand just behind it. | Sit on the floor or on your heels in front of the ball, then lean back and drape your mid-back over the top of the ball so your spine curves around its surface. | Walk your feet slightly forward until the ball rests comfortably under your mid-to-lower back and your hips drop toward the floor. | תן לידיים להיפתח לצדדים או הושט אותן מעל הראש כדי להעמיק את המתיחה לאורך האלכסונים והבטן הישרה. | Let gravity gently pull your head, shoulders, and hips downward, elongating the spine over the curve of the ball. | נשור עמוקה ולאט, משחרר מתח עם כל נשימה ומאפשר למתיחה להעמיק בהדרגה. | Hold the position for 20–60 seconds, or as long as comfortable, then carefully roll to one side to dismount the ball.

t: Stand in your fighting stance with feet shoulder-width apart, dominant foot slightly back, hands raised to guard position. | Shift your weight onto your front foot and begin rotating your hips and shoulders toward the rear, pivoting on the ball of your front foot. | As your back comes toward the target, tuck your rear knee toward your chest to chamber the kicking leg. | Spot the target over your rear shoulder so you can track it through the rotation and time the extension accurately. | Drive your heel directly backward into the target by extending the hip and knee in one explosive thrust, foot flexed and toes pulled back. | Keep your core braced and your arms close to your body throughout the spin to maintain rotational speed and balance. | After contact, retract the leg quickly back to the chambered position rather than letting it drop. | Complete the rotation to return to your fighting stance and reset your guard.
tRu: Stand in your fighting stance with feet shoulder-width apart, dominant foot slightly back, hands raised to guard position. | Shift your weight onto your front foot and begin rotating your hips and shoulders toward the rear, pivoting on the ball of your front foot. | Когда спина разворачивается к цели, подтяните заднее колено к груди, заряжая бьющую ногу. | Spot the target over your rear shoulder so you can track it through the rotation and time the extension accurately. | Мощным рывком вытолкните пятку назад в целевую зону, разгибая тазобедренный сустав и колено одновременно, стопа выгнута, пальцы ног оттянуты. | Держите корпус напряжен и руки близко к телу на протяжении всего вращения для поддержания rotational скорости и баланса. | После касания быстро верните ногу обратно в согнутое положение, а не давайте ей падать. | Выполните вращение, чтобы вернуться в боевую стойку и восстановить защиту.
tHe: Stand in your fighting stance with feet shoulder-width apart, dominant foot slightly back, hands raised to guard position. | Shift your weight onto your front foot and begin rotating your hips and shoulders toward the rear, pivoting on the ball of your front foot. | כשהגב פונה לעבר המטרה, קרב את ברך הגב לעבר החזה להכנת הרגל הבועטת. | Spot the target over your rear shoulder so you can track it through the rotation and time the extension accurately. | דחף את עקב הרגל ישר אחורה לעבר המטרה על ידי הרחבת אגן הירך והברך בדחיפה פיצוצית אחת, עם כף הרג� מושטת ואצבעות מושכות לאחור. | Keep your core braced and your arms close to your body throughout the spin to maintain rotational speed and balance. | אחרי המגע, משוך את הרגל במהירות חזרה לעמדת ההכנה במקום לתת לה ליפול. | בצע את הסיבוב כדי לחזור למצב הקרב שלך ואפס את ההגנה.

t: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and place both hands on your lower back, fingers pointing downward with thumbs wrapped around your sides for support. | Engage your core lightly and lengthen through the crown of your head to create space between your vertebrae before moving. | Inhale and begin pressing your hips forward while simultaneously leaning your upper body backward, initiating the movement from your mid-back rather than your lower back. | Continue arching smoothly, allowing your chest to open toward the ceiling and your gaze to follow the arc upward and slightly behind you. | Hold the end position for 20–30 seconds, breathing steadily and allowing your erector spinae to lengthen with each exhale. | Exhale and slowly return to an upright position by engaging your core and stacking your vertebrae back to neutral one at a time. | Repeat for the desired number of holds, releasing further into the stretch with each repetition.
tRu: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and place both hands on your lower back, fingers pointing downward with thumbs wrapped around your sides for support. | Напрягите корпус лёгким напряжением и вытяните макушкой вверх, создавая пространство между позвонками перед движением. | Вдохните и начните надавливать тазом вперед, одновременно наклоняя верхнюю часть тела назад, инициируя движение от средней части спины, а не от нижней. | Продолжайте плавно прогибаться, позволяя груди раскрыться к потолку, а взгляду следовать по дуге вверх и немного за собой. | Задержите конечное положение на 20–30 секунд, дышите ровно и позволяйте вашей поясничной мышце удлиняться с каждым выдохом. | Выдыхайте и медленно вернитесь в вертикальное положение, напрягая мышцы кора и поочередно возвращая позвонки в нейтральное положение. | Repeat for the desired number of holds, releasing further into the stretch with each repetition.
tHe: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and place both hands on your lower back, fingers pointing downward with thumbs wrapped around your sides for support. | הפעל את שרירי הליבה בעדינות ומתן לראש כדי ליצור מרחב בין חוליות השדרה לפני התנועה. | Inhale and begin pressing your hips forward while simultaneously leaning your upper body backward, initiating the movement from your mid-back rather than your lower back. | המשיל להתכופף בצורה חלקה, מאפשר לחזה שלך להיפתח לעבר התקרה והמבט שלך לעקוב אחר הקשת למעלה וקלות מאחוריך. | Hold the end position for 20–30 seconds, breathing steadily and allowing your erector spinae to lengthen with each exhale. | נשף וחזור באיטיות לתנוחה זקופה על ידי הפעלת שרירי הליבה וערימת חוליות השדרה חזרה לנייטרליות אחת אחרת. | Repeat for the desired number of holds, releasing further into the stretch with each repetition.

t: Start on all fours with your hands directly under your shoulders and your knees under your hips. Keep your spine in a neutral position. | Take a slow breath in to prepare. On the exhale, begin the movement at the tailbone by gently tilting your pelvis into anterior tilt, allowing the lumbar curve to deepen. | Progressively extend the movement upward through each lumbar vertebra in sequence — think of stacking each segment into extension one at a time from the base of the spine toward the mid-back. | Continue until you reach a comfortable end range of lumbar extension, keeping your neck long and gaze forward rather than cranking your head back. | Pause briefly at the top of the extension arc, feeling a gentle lengthening through the front of the lumbar spine. | Reverse the motion by slowly returning each segment back to neutral, again moving sequentially from the lower lumbar upward. | Repeat for the prescribed number of repetitions, maintaining smooth, controlled articulation throughout each cycle.

t: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, arms relaxed at your sides or crossed over your chest, and your gaze forward. | Take a slow breath in, then exhale as you begin to tuck your chin gently toward your chest. | Continue the exhale while rounding your upper back, then your mid-back, and finally your lower back, curling the spine forward one segment at a time from top to bottom. | Allow your torso to fold until you reach a comfortable end range — your hands can hang toward the floor or rest on your thighs if needed. | Pause briefly at the bottom, feeling a gentle stretch through the lumbar region and along the sides of the torso. | On your next exhale, slowly begin to rebuild the spine from the bottom up — stack the lumbar vertebrae first, then the mid-back, then the upper back, and finally lift your head to return to a tall, upright position. | Reset your breath and repeat for the prescribed number of articulations, keeping each repetition slow and deliberate.
tRu: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, arms relaxed at your sides or crossed over your chest, and your gaze forward. | Take a slow breath in, then exhale as you begin to tuck your chin gently toward your chest. | Продолжайте выдыхать, округляя верхнюю часть спины, затем среднюю, и наконец нижнюю, сгибая позвоночник вперед по одному сегменту сверху вниз. | Наклоняйте корпус до комфортной конечной точки — руки могут свисать к полу или опираться на бёдра, если нужно. | На мгновение задержитесь внизу, чувствуя лёгкое растяжение в поясничной области и по бокам корпуса. | На вашем следующем выдохе медленно начните восстанавливать позвоночник снизу вверх — сначала поставьте поясничные позвонки, затем среднюю спину, затем верхнюю спину и, наконец, поднимите голову, чтобы вернуться в высокое вертикальное положение. | Reset your breath and repeat for the prescribed number of articulations, keeping each repetition slow and deliberate.
tHe: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, arms relaxed at your sides or crossed over your chest, and your gaze forward. | Take a slow breath in, then exhale as you begin to tuck your chin gently toward your chest. | המשך את היציאה מהאוויר בעת עיגול הגב העליון, אחר כך האמצעי, ולבסוף התחתון, כשכל חוליה בחוליית הגב מתקפלת קדימה אחת אחרת מלמעלה למטה. | תן לגו להתקפל עד לטווח סופי נוח — הידיים יכולות להיתלות לעבר הרצפה או לנוח על הירכיים אם צריך. | Pause briefly at the bottom, feeling a gentle stretch through the lumbar region and along the sides of the torso. | On your next exhale, slowly begin to rebuild the spine from the bottom up — stack the lumbar vertebrae first, then the mid-back, then the upper back, and finally lift your head to return to a tall, upright position. | Reset your breath and repeat for the prescribed number of articulations, keeping each repetition slow and deliberate.

t: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, arms relaxed at your sides or hands resting lightly on your hips. | Engage your core gently and ensure your pelvis is level and neutral — avoid letting one hip hike before you begin. | Inhale to prepare, then on the exhale slowly side-bend your torso to the right, letting your right hand slide down the outside of your right thigh. | Move vertebra by vertebra, articulating through the lumbar spine rather than collapsing at a single segment. | Stop when you feel a lengthening stretch through the left side of your waist and hip — do not rotate or lean forward. | Hold the end position for one breath, actively reaching through the top of your head to maintain length. | Slowly return to upright on an inhale, stacking each vertebra back into neutral. | Repeat on the left side, then continue alternating for the prescribed number of repetitions.
tRu: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, arms relaxed at your sides or hands resting lightly on your hips. | Напрягите корпус мягко и убедитесь, что таз находится в нейтральном и ровном положении — не позволяйте одному из бёдер подниматься перед началом. | Сделайте вдох, чтобы подготовиться, затем на выдохе медленно наклоните корпус вправо, позволяя правой руке скользить по внешней стороне правого бедра. | Двигайтесь позвонок за позвонком, сгибая поясничный отдел позвоночника, а не сгибаясь в одном сегменте. | Stop when you feel a lengthening stretch through the left side of your waist and hip — do not rotate or lean forward. | Задержите конечное положение на один вдох, активно вытягиваясь макушкой вверх для сохранения длины. | Slowly return to upright on an inhale, stacking each vertebra back into neutral. | Repeat on the left side, then continue alternating for the prescribed number of repetitions.

t: Lie face-up on a firm, flat surface with your legs extended and your arms out to your sides at roughly shoulder height, palms facing down. | Bend your knees to roughly 90° and plant your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. | Brace your core lightly so your lower back maintains a neutral contact with the floor before you begin moving. | On an exhale, let both knees drop slowly toward the floor on your right side. Move only as far as your hips and pelvis will allow without your left shoulder lifting off the surface. | Pause at the end of your comfortable range for 2–3 seconds, breathing steadily and allowing the obliques and iliopsoas to release. | On an inhale, engage your core and draw both knees back to the center starting position. | On the next exhale, let both knees drop slowly toward the floor on your left side, again keeping your opposite shoulder flat on the surface. | Pause for 2–3 seconds, then return to center on an inhale. | Continue alternating sides for the prescribed number of repetitions, moving at a deliberate, controlled pace throughout.
tRu: Лягте на спину на твердую, ровную поверхность, ноги выпрямлены, руки в стороны на уровне плеч, ладони смотрят вниз. | Согните ноги примерно до 90° и поставьте стопы на пол на ширине бёдер. | Легко напрягите пресс, чтобы поясница сохраняла нейтральный контакт с полом перед началом движения. | На выдохе медленно опустите оба колена вправо. Двигайтесь только до тех пор, пока ваши бёдра и таз позволяют, не отрывая левое плечо от поверхности. | Сделайте паузу в конце вашей комфортной амплитуды в течение 2–3 секунд, спокойно дыша и позволяя косым мышцам живота и подвздошно-поясничной мышце расслабиться. | На вдохе напрягите корпус и верните обе колени в центральное исходное положение. | На следующем выдохе медленно опустите оба колена влево, снова удерживая противоположное плечо прижатым к поверхности. | Задержитесь на 2–3 секунды, затем вернитесь в центр на вдохе. | Продолжайте попеременно менять стороны в течение заданного количества повторений, двигаясь в осознанном, контролируемом темпе.
tHe: Lie face-up on a firm, flat surface with your legs extended and your arms out to your sides at roughly shoulder height, palms facing down. | כופף את הברכיים לערך ל-90° ונטע את כפות הרגליים שטוחות על הרצפה, ברוחב האגן. | הדק קלות את הליבה כך שהגב התחתון שומר על מגע ניטרלי עם הרצפה לפני תחילת התנועה. | On an exhale, let both knees drop slowly toward the floor on your right side. Move only as far as your hips and pelvis will allow without your left shoulder lifting off the surface. | Pause at the end of your comfortable range for 2–3 seconds, breathing steadily and allowing the obliques and iliopsoas to release. | On an inhale, engage your core and draw both knees back to the center starting position. | On the next exhale, let both knees drop slowly toward the floor on your left side, again keeping your opposite shoulder flat on the surface. | Pause for 2–3 seconds, then return to center on an inhale. | המשיל להחליף צדדים למספר החזרות המומלצות, זז בקצב מכוון ומבוקר לאורך כל התרגיל.

t: Sit upright on the floor with your legs extended straight in front of you, feet flexed and hip-width apart. | Raise both arms to shoulder height, reaching forward with palms facing down. | Inhale to prepare, sitting as tall as possible and lengthening through the crown of your head. | Exhale and begin to curl forward, starting from the crown of your head, then rounding through your upper back and lower back one vertebra at a time. | Reach your fingertips forward past your feet, hollowing the abdominals inward and upward as you deepen the stretch. | Hold the stretched position briefly, feeling the lengthening through your spine, hamstrings, and calves. | Inhale and slowly stack your vertebrae back to the upright starting position, rebuilding the spine from the base to the top. | Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, maintaining smooth, controlled breathing throughout.
tRu: Sit upright on the floor with your legs extended straight in front of you, feet flexed and hip-width apart. | Raise both arms to shoulder height, reaching forward with palms facing down. | Вдыхайте, чтобы подготовиться, сидя как можно прямо и вытягиваясь через макушку. | Выдохните и начните наклоняться вперед, начиная от макушки, затем округляя верхнюю и нижнюю часть спины позвонок за позвонком. | Reach your fingertips forward past your feet, hollowing the abdominals inward and upward as you deepen the stretch. | Держите растянутое положение в течение короткого времени, ощущая удлинение по всей длине позвоночника, задней поверхности бедра и икр. | Выдохните и медленно верните позвонки в вертикальное исходное положение, восстанавливая позвоночник снизу вверх. | Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, maintaining smooth, controlled breathing throughout.
tHe: Sit upright on the floor with your legs extended straight in front of you, feet flexed and hip-width apart. | Raise both arms to shoulder height, reaching forward with palms facing down. | Inhale to prepare, sitting as tall as possible and lengthening through the crown of your head. | נשור והתחל להתכופף קדימה, מתחיל מקודקוד הראש, ואז מעגל דרך הגב העליון והתחתון חוליה אחר חוליה. | Reach your fingertips forward past your feet, hollowing the abdominals inward and upward as you deepen the stretch. | Hold the stretched position briefly, feeling the lengthening through your spine, hamstrings, and calves. | Inhale and slowly stack your vertebrae back to the upright starting position, rebuilding the spine from the base to the top. | Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, maintaining smooth, controlled breathing throughout.

t: Sit tall on the floor with your legs extended straight in front of you, feet flexed and hip-width apart. | Place your hands lightly behind your head or extend your arms out to the sides at shoulder height, whichever feels more comfortable. | Inhale to lengthen your spine, sitting as tall as possible and engaging your core. | Exhale and slowly rotate your upper body to the right, leading with your chest and keeping your hips and legs completely still. | Pause at the end of your comfortable range of motion for 1–2 seconds, feeling the stretch through your waist and obliques. | Inhale and return your torso back to the center with control. | Exhale and rotate to the left in the same controlled manner, again keeping the hips anchored to the floor. | Return to center, then repeat the sequence for the desired number of repetitions on each side.
tRu: Sit tall on the floor with your legs extended straight in front of you, feet flexed and hip-width apart. | Положите руки легко за голову или вытяните их в стороны на уровне плеч, whichever feels more comfortable. | Вдыхайте, чтобы вытянуть позвоночник, сидя как можно прямо и напрягая мышцы кора. | Выдыхайте и медленно поверните верхнюю часть тела вправо, ведя грудью и сохраняя таз и ноги абсолютно неподвижными. | Сделайте паузу в конце вашей комфортной амплитуды движения в течение 1–2 секунд, ощущая растяжку в талии и косых мышцах живота. | Вдохните и плавно верните торс в центр с контролем. | Выдыхайте и поверните влево тем же контролируемым образом, снова удерживая таз прижатым к полу. | Return to center, then repeat the sequence for the desired number of repetitions on each side.
tHe: Sit tall on the floor with your legs extended straight in front of you, feet flexed and hip-width apart. | Place your hands lightly behind your head or extend your arms out to the sides at shoulder height, whichever feels more comfortable. | Inhale to lengthen your spine, sitting as tall as possible and engaging your core. | לחץ אוויר וסובב את גופך העליון לימין לאט, מוביל עם החזה ושומר על מותניים ורגליים סטטיות לחלוטין. | Pause at the end of your comfortable range of motion for 1–2 seconds, feeling the stretch through your waist and obliques. | Inhale and return your torso back to the center with control. | נשוף וסובבו לצד שמאל באותה דרך מבוקרת, שוב שמרו על האגן צמוד לרצפה. | Return to center, then repeat the sequence for the desired number of repetitions on each side.

t: Stand in your fighting stance with feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and hands raised to guard position. | Shift your weight onto your rear foot and begin rotating your hips and shoulders away from your target, initiating the spin. | Pivot on the ball of your rear foot, allowing your body to rotate 180 degrees so your back momentarily faces the target. | As your body continues rotating toward the target, lift the knee of your kicking leg to chamber height — roughly hip to mid-chest level. | Drive your hips through by extending the kicking leg outward in a sweeping hook motion, making contact with the heel or sole of the foot at the target. | Keep your standing knee slightly bent throughout to absorb force and maintain stability. | Pull the kicking leg back sharply after contact, reversing the hook motion to chamber the knee again. | Land in a controlled stance with your weight centered and your guard back up, ready to follow with the next technique.
tRu: Stand in your fighting stance with feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and hands raised to guard position. | Shift your weight onto your rear foot and begin rotating your hips and shoulders away from your target, initiating the spin. | Опирайтесь на носок задней ноги, позволяя телу повернуться на 180 градусов, чтобы ваша спина на мгновение была обращена к цели. | Продолжая разворот тела к цели, поднимите колено бьющей ноги до заряженной высоты — примерно от бедра до середины груди. | С силовым движением выталкивайте бёдра вперёд, разгибая ногу для удара в выноске, совершая движение по дуге, и наносите удар пяткой или подошвой. | Держите стоящее колено слегка согнутым на протяжении для поглощения силы и сохранения стабильности. | Pull the kicking leg back sharply after contact, reversing the hook motion to chamber the knee again. | Приземлитесь в контролируемое положение с весом тела в центре и guard-позицией, готовым выполнить следующий приём.
tHe: Stand in your fighting stance with feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and hands raised to guard position. | Shift your weight onto your rear foot and begin rotating your hips and shoulders away from your target, initiating the spin. | Pivot on the ball of your rear foot, allowing your body to rotate 180 degrees so your back momentarily faces the target. | כשהגוף ממשיך להסתובב לעבר המטרה, הרם את ברך הרגל הבועטת לגובה הכנה — בערך מגובה האגן עד אמצע החזה. | דחוף את האגן דרך הרחבת הרגל הבועטת החוצה בתנועת סלילה, מבצע מגע עם העקב או כף הרגל במטרה. | Keep your standing knee slightly bent throughout to absorb force and maintain stability. | Pull the kicking leg back sharply after contact, reversing the hook motion to chamber the knee again. | Land in a controlled stance with your weight centered and your guard back up, ready to follow with the next technique.

t: Stand tall with your feet together and your arms at your sides. | Jump and simultaneously split your legs so your right foot lands forward and your left foot lands behind you, landing in a staggered stance roughly shoulder-width apart. | At the same time, swing your arms in opposition — right arm forward and left arm back — to mirror your leg movement. | Keep your torso upright, core braced, and land with soft knees to absorb the impact. | Jump again and switch legs and arms in a single fluid motion, so your left foot moves forward and your right foot moves back. | Continue alternating the split position at a controlled, rhythmic pace. | To finish, bring your feet together on a jump and return your arms to your sides.

tHe: עמוד זקוף עם רגליים צמודות וידיים לצדי הגוף. | Jump and simultaneously split your legs so your right foot lands forward and your left foot lands behind you, landing in a staggered stance roughly shoulder-width apart. | בו זמנית הנף את הידיים בניגוד — יד ימין קדימה ויד שמאל אחורה — בהתאם לתנועת הרגליים. | Keep your torso upright, core braced, and land with soft knees to absorb the impact. | Jump again and switch legs and arms in a single fluid motion, so your left foot moves forward and your right foot moves back. | המשיל להחליף בין התנוחת פיצול בקצב מבוקר וקצבי. | To finish, bring your feet together on a jump and return your arms to your sides.

t: Stand facing a sturdy box (6–18 inches tall) and step one foot forward into a split stance, with your front foot roughly two feet from the base of the box. | Sink into a lunge position — front knee bent to approximately 90 degrees, rear knee hovering just above the floor — with your torso upright and core braced. | Load your hips by driving them slightly back and keeping your front heel planted. | Swing your arms back to generate momentum, then explosively drive both arms upward as you push off both feet simultaneously. | Leave the ground with maximum power, extending fully through your hips, knees, and ankles at the peak of the jump. | While airborne, bring both feet together and position them to land simultaneously on top of the box with feet roughly hip-width apart. | Land softly with knees slightly bent, hips back, and weight distributed evenly across both feet to absorb impact. | Step back down to the floor one foot at a time, reset into the split stance, and repeat for the target number of repetitions before switching your lead leg.

t: Stand with your feet roughly two to three shoulder-widths apart and your toes turned out slightly, hands clasped in front of your chest or extended forward for balance. | Shift your weight to the right, pushing your hips back and bending your right knee as you descend into a lateral squat on that side. | Lower until your right thigh is roughly parallel to the floor (or as deep as your mobility allows), keeping your left leg straight and your left foot fully planted. | At the bottom of the squat, roll onto the outer edge of your left foot, allowing the sole to tilt slightly as your hips sink deeper and your torso leans forward with a neutral spine. | Pause briefly, feeling the stretch across your left inner thigh and groin. | Roll your left foot back to flat, then drive through your right heel to push yourself back up to the starting position. | Repeat for the desired reps on the right side before switching to the left.

t: Stand with feet hip-width apart, then step one foot forward roughly two to three feet, placing the ball of your back foot on the floor with your heel raised. | Align your front foot so the knee tracks directly over the second toe, and keep your back leg nearly straight with a soft bend at the knee. | Lift your torso to a tall, upright position — chest up, shoulders back, core braced — avoiding any forward lean. | Rest your hands on your hips or extend them alongside your body for balance. | Inhale, then lower your hips straight down by bending the front knee until your front thigh is roughly parallel to the floor or as low as control allows. | Keep your back knee hovering just above the floor without touching it, and maintain an upright torso throughout the descent. | Exhale and drive through your front heel to press the floor away, extending the front hip and knee to return to the starting high position. | Complete all repetitions on one side before switching legs, or alternate sides each rep depending on your training goal.
tRu: Stand with feet hip-width apart, then step one foot forward roughly two to three feet, placing the ball of your back foot on the floor with your heel raised. | Поставьте переднюю стопу так, чтобы колено шло строго над вторым пальцем, а заднюю ногу держите почти прямой с мягким сгибом в колене. | Поднимите корпус в высокое, вертикальное положение — грудь вверх, плечи назад, пресс напряжен — избегая любого наклона вперед. | Rest your hands on your hips or extend them alongside your body for balance. | Сделайте вдох, затем на выдохе наклонитесь вперёд от бёдер — не от нижней части спины — наклоняя грудь к поднятой ноге. | Держите заднее колено чуть над полом, не касаясь его, и сохраняйте вертикальное положение корпуса на протяжении опускания. | Выдохните и оттолкнитесь пяткой передней ноги, чтобы оттолкнуть пол, разгибая тазобедренный сустав и колено передней ноги, чтобы вернуться в исходное положение. | Выполните все повторения на одной стороне, прежде чем перейти на другую ногу, или меняйте стороны с каждым повторением в зависимости от вашей тренировочной цели.
tHe: Stand with feet hip-width apart, then step one foot forward roughly two to three feet, placing the ball of your back foot on the floor with your heel raised. | מקם את כף הרגל הקדמית כך שהברך נעה בדיוק מעל הבוהן השנייה, ושמור את הרגל האחורית כמעט ישרה עם כיפוף קל בברך. | Lift your torso to a tall, upright position — chest up, shoulders back, core braced — avoiding any forward lean. | Rest your hands on your hips or extend them alongside your body for balance. | Inhale, then lower your hips straight down by bending the front knee until your front thigh is roughly parallel to the floor or as low as control allows. | Keep your back knee hovering just above the floor without touching it, and maintain an upright torso throughout the descent. | נשוף ודחוף דרך העקב הקדמי כדי לדחוף את הרצפה רחוק, מתיחת המותן והברך הקדמית כדי לחזור למצב ההתחלתי הגבוה. | בצע את כל החזרות בצד אחד לפני החלפת הרגליים, או החלף צדדים בכל חזרה בהתאם ליעד האימון שלך.

t: Start standing with your feet together and your hands relaxed at your sides. | Step your right foot forward roughly two to three feet and plant it flat on the floor, toes pointing straight ahead. | Lower your left knee toward the floor, keeping the left toes tucked under so you are in a low lunge position with the back knee close to — or resting lightly on — the ground. | Sink your hips down and forward until your right thigh is roughly parallel to the floor and your right shin is vertical. This is the low lunge base position. | Drive your right knee forward slightly over the toes to deepen the stretch in the left hip flexor while simultaneously pressing your right foot into the floor to engage the glutes and quadriceps. | To add the sprinter element, lean your torso slightly forward over the front thigh and drive both arms into a sprint-arm position — right arm back, left arm bent forward at roughly 90° — mimicking the upper-body mechanics of a running stride. | Hold the position for the prescribed duration or pulse gently through a small range of motion to increase hip-flexor release and glute activation. | Press through the right heel to stand back up, step your feet together, and repeat on the left side.

t: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, then step one foot roughly two to three feet back, resting on the ball of your rear foot. t: Kneel on a mat and place your forearms on top of a stability ball, hands clasped or flat, with your hips stacked over your knees. | Deliberately round your lower back and tuck your pelvis under — this is the key difference from a standard rollout and is intentional throughout the movement. | Brace your core and begin rolling the ball forward by extending your arms, allowing your hips to travel forward and down toward the floor. | Maintain the rounded spine as you roll out as far as you can control, feeling a deep stretch through your rectus abdominis and hip flexors. | Pause briefly at the end range, keeping tension through your core and avoiding a full collapse into the lower back. | Engage your abs and hip flexors to pull the ball back toward your knees, returning to the starting position in a controlled manner. | Complete your reps without losing the rounded spinal position throughout the set.

t: Lie on your back with both knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. | Stagger your feet by sliding one foot 6–8 inches forward so the heel of that foot is roughly level with the toes of the other foot. | Place your arms at your sides with your palms flat on the floor to provide stability. | Tuck your chin slightly to maintain a neutral neck position and brace your core. | Press through both heels to lift your hips off the floor, initiating the movement by driving the rear heel into the ground. | Continue raising your hips until your body forms a straight line from your shoulders to your knees, squeezing your glutes firmly at the top. | Hold the top position for one full second, then lower your hips in a controlled manner back toward the floor without fully resting them. | Complete all reps on that side, then switch foot positions and repeat with the other foot staggered forward.

t: Lie on your side on a firm surface with your legs fully extended. Stack your hips and shoulders vertically so your body forms a straight line from head to feet. | Place your bottom elbow directly beneath your shoulder with your forearm flat on the floor and pointing away from your body. | Stagger your feet by sliding the top foot approximately one foot-length in front of the bottom foot so they are offset rather than stacked. | Rest your top hand on your hip or extend it toward the ceiling to assist with balance. | Press your bottom forearm and the outer edge of your bottom foot into the floor, then lift your hips until your body forms a straight diagonal line from head to feet. | Hold the position by contracting the muscles along the side of your torso and keeping your hips level — do not let them sag toward the floor or rotate forward or backward. | Breathe steadily throughout the hold, keeping your neck neutral and your gaze directed forward. | Lower your hips back to the floor in a controlled manner to end the set, then switch sides.

t: Stand at the base of a staircase or in front of a single step, feet hip-width apart and arms relaxed at your sides. | Hinge slightly at the hips and bend your knees into a quarter-squat to load your legs. | Swing your arms back, then drive them forward and upward as you push explosively through your feet to jump up onto the step. | Land softly on both feet simultaneously, absorbing the impact by bending your knees and hips — land on the balls of your feet first, then lower your heels. | Stand tall on the step for a brief moment to confirm balance before descending. | Step back down one foot at a time (or jump back down with control if your fitness level allows), returning to the starting position. | Reset your stance and repeat for the target number of reps or duration.
