t: Set the Fingal's Finger implement upright in its pivot base on the ground and stand at the base end, feet shoulder-width apart. | Hinge at the hips and grip the shaft low with both hands, one hand above the other, as if setting up a deadlift. | Brace your core, take a deep breath, and drive through your legs to pull the implement off the ground into a deadlift position. | Continue driving upward, shifting your hands higher up the shaft as the implement rises to leverage it vertically. | Once the implement passes vertical, press and push it forward and over, driving with your chest and shoulders to complete the tip. | Step to the other side of the fallen implement, reposition your grip at the base end, and repeat the movement in the opposite direction. | Maintain an upright torso and tight core throughout each repetition to protect the lower back under maximal load. | Continue tipping the implement back and forth for the required number of reps or until the time limit expires.

t: Set the barbell in a squat rack at approximately upper-chest height, then step up and position the bar across your front deltoids and upper chest — the bar should sit in the groove between your shoulders and throat. | Cross your arms over the bar (each hand gripping the opposite shoulder) or cup your hands beneath the bar with elbows raised high, whichever allows you to keep the bar stable; elbows should be parallel to the floor or slightly above. | Unrack the bar by standing tall, take two small steps back, and set your feet shoulder- to hip-width apart with toes turned out 15–30 degrees. | Take a deep breath into your belly, brace your core hard as if bracing for a punch, and keep your chest tall and elbows up throughout the entire movement. | Begin the descent by pushing your knees out in line with your toes while hinging slightly at the hips, lowering under control until your thighs are parallel to the floor or deeper if mobility allows. | At the bottom, maintain an upright torso — do not let the elbows drop or the upper back round, as this will cause the bar to roll off the chest. | Drive through the full foot, push your knees out, and stand back up with a controlled, powerful extension of the hips and knees simultaneously. | Exhale at the top of the rep, reset your brace, then perform the next repetition. | After completing your set, step forward to re-rack the bar safely — never drop the elbows to attempt a forward dump.

t: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and a slight bend in your knees, facing the weighted implement. | Grip the implement firmly on both sides — thumbs wrapped, wrists neutral — and lift it off the ground or rack to chest height. | Press the implement forward until your arms are straight or nearly straight, holding it at approximately shoulder height. | Brace your core hard: draw your ribs down, tighten your abdomen, and squeeze your glutes to prevent your lower back from arching. | Keep your chest up and your shoulders pulled back and down — do not let the weight drag your shoulders forward into a rounded position. | Fix your gaze straight ahead and breathe steadily: inhale through your nose, exhale through pursed lips without releasing the brace. | Hold the position for the prescribed time or walk the designated distance, maintaining arm height and body alignment throughout. | To finish, bend your elbows to bring the implement back to your chest, then lower it under control to the ground or rack.

t: Stand with your feet roughly hip-width apart, toes pointing slightly outward, with the stone resting between your feet on the hood platform. | Hinge at the hips and bend your knees to descend, wrapping both arms around the stone and interlacing or overlapping your fingers beneath it. | Pull the stone into your body, drawing it against your thighs and lower abdomen to keep the load close to your centre of gravity. | Drive through your heels and extend your hips to deadlift the stone off the platform, keeping your chest up and your lower back braced throughout. | As the stone rises to lap height, re-position your arms beneath it so it rests on your thighs and stomach — this is the lap position. | Dip your hips slightly, then explosively extend your hips, knees, and ankles to pop the stone upward while simultaneously redirecting your arms to roll it up your torso. | Lean back and guide the stone onto the target platform, keeping your core rigid and your lower back in a neutral position at the point of release. | Step back and lower your arms in a controlled manner once the stone is secured on the platform. | Reset your stance and breathing before attempting the next stone or the next height.

t: Set up two weighted sleds or implements at equal distances from a centre point, arranged so they form a cross (plus-sign) pattern with the starting position at the intersection. | Step into the pulling harness and adjust the straps so they sit firmly across your hips and chest with the attachment point centred on your back, then take up the slack in the cables or chains. | Adopt a strong pulling stance: feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent, hips pushed back, chest tall, and core braced as if preparing to absorb a heavy load. | Drive through your thighs and glutes to initiate forward movement, leaning into the harness at roughly a 45-degree angle to keep tension on the implement throughout each step. | Take short, powerful strides — pushing aggressively through the full length of each step — until you reach the first marker. | Come to a controlled stop at the marker, pivot to face the next arm of the cross, and re-establish your pulling stance before driving again. | Repeat the loaded pull in each direction of the cross, completing all required arms in sequence as fast and powerfully as possible. | Maintain an upright torso and active core on every arm of the cross — avoid excessive forward lean from the waist, which shifts stress from the thighs to the lower back. | After completing all arms, walk back to the centre point and remove the harness safely once the implement comes to a full stop.

t: Stand the iron block upright on a platform or the floor at approximately hip-to-waist height. Position your feet shoulder-width apart, toes turned out slightly. | Hinge at the hips and grip the sides of the block firmly with both hands, keeping your chest up and your lower back neutral. | Drive through your legs to deadlift the block upward, then transition it to your chest and shoulder level — bending your elbows and bringing the block close to your body as you stand tall. | Set the block against your chest and front delts with your elbows angled slightly forward. This is your starting position for the press. | Brace your core hard, squeeze your glutes, and plant your feet firmly into the ground to create a stable base before the press. | Drive the block overhead in a straight vertical path by extending your elbows and pressing your shoulders up and into the lift. | Lock out your elbows at the top with the block directly over your head and your biceps close to your ears. t: Stand facing the bar with the keg on the ground between your feet, feet set slightly wider than hip-width and toes turned out slightly. | Hinge at the hips and bend your knees to grip the keg firmly on both sides near its base, keeping your chest up and your back flat. | Brace your core hard and take a deep breath. t: Stand directly behind the implement with your feet roughly hip-width apart, toes turned slightly out. Visualize your path to the platform before you begin. | Hip-hinge and squat down to grip the implement, keeping your chest up and your back flat. Wrap your arms around or under the object as grip mechanics allow. | Brace your core hard — take a deep breath into your belly, create intra-abdominal pressure, and lock your lats tight before breaking the implement off the ground. | Drive through your legs to pull the implement clear of the ground, keeping it as close to your body as possible to reduce moment arm and protect your lower back. | Transition the implement to a lap-load position by resting it on your thighs at mid-height, re-positioning your grip higher if needed and taking a brief additional breath. | Explode through your hips, driving them forward and extending your whole body to elevate the implement to platform height. Use the momentum generated by your hips — not your lower back — to get the object moving upward. | Guide the implement onto the platform with your hands and chest, pushing or tipping it over the edge until it is fully loaded and secure. | Step back and stand tall before resetting for your next rep or rotating to the next implement.

tRu: Stand over the log with your feet hip-width apart and the log centered between your shins, parallel to your body. | Отводите бёдра назад и возьмите ручки брёвна (или само бревно) нейтральным хватом, сохраняя грудь поднятой и спину прямую. | Отталкивайтесь ногами, чтобы перенести бревно на бедра, затем присядьте на четверть, держа бревно на бедрах. | Взрывно выпрямите бедра и ноги, одновременно подтягивая бревно вверх руками; используйте импульс, чтобы повернуть бревно вверх и вывести локти вперед и под него, чтобы оно упало на грудь и плечи. | Напрягите корпус и поставьте стопы в стойку для жима: от ширины бёдер до ширины плеч, носки слегка разведены. | Слегка согните колени, затем мощно выталкивайте вверх и выжимайте лог над головой, пока руки не выпрямятся полностью, а бицепсы не окажутся сбоку или сзади от ушей. | Подержите зафиксированное положение с контролем, жердь над головой в равновесии и корпус вертикальный. | С контролем опустите бревно в положение на грудь и плечи, если выполняете дополнительные повторения, или безопасно верните его на пол, выполняя движение рывка в обратном направлении.

t: Sit on the board facing your opponent with your feet firmly planted against the footboards, knees bent and positioned outside your arms. | Grip the wooden stick with both hands using a full overhand grip, hands approximately shoulder-width apart, placed between your opponent's grip points. | Brace your core, set your back into a rigid, slightly forward-leaning position, and press your feet hard into the footboards before the pull begins. | At the start signal, drive through your legs into the footboards and pull the stick toward your hips, engaging your back, arms, and entire posterior chain simultaneously. | Keep your elbows close to your torso and use your bodyweight as leverage by leaning back into the pull while maintaining a flat, braced spine. | If your opponent surges, resist by reinforcing your grip, pushing harder through your feet, and maintaining your position on the board without lifting your hips. | Continue pulling and countering your opponent's force until you extract the stick from their hands or pull them off the board, then release in a controlled manner. | When training solo, sit on the floor with your feet braced against a wall or anchor point, grip a resistance band or rope at the same height, and practice both explosive burst pulls and sustained isometric holds. | Rest fully between sets to allow grip and full-body recovery before repeating.

t: Stand the sandbag upright on the floor in front of you, centered between your feet, which are set roughly hip-width apart. | Hinge at the hips and bend your knees to reach around the bag, wrapping both arms as low around its girth as possible — aim to clasp your hands or forearms together behind it. | Brace your core hard, take a deep breath, and drive through your legs to stand up, pulling the bag tight to your chest and upper abdomen in a bear-hug position. | Once upright, squeeze the bag firmly against your torso, keep your elbows tucked, and pull your shoulder blades back and down to prevent the weight from rounding your upper back. | Maintain a neutral spine — chest tall, slight arch in the lower back — and avoid letting the bag's shifting load pull you forward. | Begin walking with controlled, deliberate steps, keeping your gaze forward and your breathing rhythmic; exhale on each step rather than holding your breath. | Walk the prescribed distance or time without setting the bag down, fighting any tendency to lean backward excessively to counterbalance the load. | To set the bag down, reverse the pick-up: hinge at the hips and bend the knees, lower the bag under control until it rests on the floor, then release.

t: Approach the log and stand at its center, feet roughly hip-width apart and toes pointing forward. | Hinge at the hips and bend the knees to lower yourself to the log, keeping your chest up and back flat. | Wrap both hands firmly around the log with a full grip, knuckles facing out and wrists neutral. | Drive through your heels to stand tall, extending the hips and knees simultaneously to lift the log off the ground. | Hug the log tightly into your body at hip or low-stomach height, keeping your elbows in and bracing your core hard. | Lift your chest, pull your shoulder blades back and down, and adopt an upright torso before taking your first step. | Walk at a controlled, powerful pace toward the finish line, taking short, deliberate steps and keeping the log pressed against your body. | Maintain steady breathing throughout — exhale on each step if needed, never fully releasing core tension. | At the finish line, hinge at the hips and bend the knees to lower the log back to the ground under control, keeping your back flat until it is set down.
tRu: Подойдите к логу и встаньте по его центру, стопы примерно на ширине бёдер, носки вперёд. | Отводите бёдра назад и сгибайте колени, опускаясь к брёвну, сохраняя грудь поднятой и спину прямой. | Wrap both hands firmly around the log with a full grip, knuckles facing out and wrists neutral. | Отталкивайтесь пятками, чтобы выпрямиться, одновременно разгибая таз и колени, чтобы поднуть бревно с пола. | Обхватите бревно плотно телом на уровне бёдер или нижней части живота, удерживая локти близко к корпусу и сильно напрягая пресс. | Поднимите грудь, отведите плечи назад и вниз и примите вертикальное положение корпуса перед первым шагом. | Walk at a controlled, powerful pace toward the finish line, taking short, deliberate steps and keeping the log pressed against your body. | Сохраняйте устойчивое дыхание на протяжении всего движения — выдыхайте на каждом шаге, если необходимо, никогда не полностью расслабляя напряжение в корпусе. | На финише наклонитесь в бёдрах и согните колени, чтобы контролируемо опустить лог на землю, удерживая спину прямой до полной постановки.
tHe: גש אל הלוג ועמוד במרכזו, עם רגליים בערך ברוחב האגן והבהונות פונות קדימה. | כופף בציר הירכיים וכופף את הברכיים כדי לרדת אל הבול עץ, תוך שמירה על חזה מורם וגב שטוח. | Wrap both hands firmly around the log with a full grip, knuckles facing out and wrists neutral. | דחוף דרך עקביך כדי לעמוד זקוף, מאחורי הירכיים והברכיים בו-זמנית כדי להרים את הגזע מהרצפה. | Hug the log tightly into your body at hip or low-stomach height, keeping your elbows in and bracing your core hard. | Lift your chest, pull your shoulder blades back and down, and adopt an upright torso before taking your first step. | Walk at a controlled, powerful pace toward the finish line, taking short, deliberate steps and keeping the log pressed against your body. | Maintain steady breathing throughout — exhale on each step if needed, never fully releasing core tension. | בקו הסיום בצע ציר אגן וכופף את הברכיים כדי להוריד את הבול לקרקע בשליטה, תוך שמירה על גב שטוח עד להנחה.

t: Stand facing the tire with your feet hip-width apart and toes just beneath its edge. | Hinge at the hips and lower into a deep squat, keeping a neutral spine. Slide your fingers under the tire, palms facing up, with your chest pressed against the tire's surface. | Take a deep breath, brace your core and lats, and begin the lift by driving hard through your legs — not your lower back — to break the tire off the ground. | As the tire rises past knee height, shift your hips forward explosively and lean into the tire to keep momentum building. | When the tire reaches roughly waist or chest height, quickly transition your grip: pull your hands out and place your palms flat against the face of the tire. | Drive forward and push the tire forcefully with your arms and body weight until it tips over and lands flat on the ground. | Step back, approach the tire again, and reset your stance for the next rep.

t: Put on a pulling harness and adjust it so it sits securely across your chest and shoulders without restricting your breathing. | Attach the harness to the tow rope or chain connected to the vehicle and take up all slack. | Stand with feet hip-width apart, facing away from the vehicle, and hinge forward at the hips into a strong athletic lean — your body should form roughly a 45° angle to the ground. | Drive your lead foot into the ground with a powerful push, extending through the hip and knee, and take your first step forward. | Continue driving alternating steps, staying low and keeping your torso leaned forward so the force vector stays productive throughout each stride. | Pump your arms aggressively to help generate momentum and maintain rhythm between your steps. | Keep your core braced and spine neutral on every step — avoid rounding the lower back under the load. | Accelerate smoothly through the required distance, finishing with a controlled deceleration once the course is complete. | After completing the pull, step out of the harness with help from a partner or judge and allow the vehicle to come to a full stop before approaching it.

tHe: Put on a pulling harness and adjust it so it sits securely across your chest and shoulders without restricting your breathing. | חבר את הרתמה לחבל הגרירה או לשרשרת המחוברת לרכב ומתח את כל הרפיון. | Stand with feet hip-width apart, facing away from the vehicle, and hinge forward at the hips into a strong athletic lean — your body should form roughly a 45° angle to the ground. | דחוף את הרגל הקדמית אל הקרקע בדחיפה חזקה, מתרחב דרך האגן והברך, ובצע את הצעד הראשון קדימה. | המשילו לדחוף בצעדים чередующимися, נשארים נמוכים ושומרים על הגוף מוטה קדימה כדי שכוח הדחיפה יישאר יעיל לאורך כל צעד. | Pump your arms aggressively to help generate momentum and maintain rhythm between your steps. | Keep your core braced and spine neutral on every step — avoid rounding the lower back under the load. | האץ בצורה חלקה לאורך המרחק הנדרש, וסיים בהאטה מבוקרת בסוף המסלול. | אחרי שסיימת את המשיכה, צא מהרתמה בעזרת שותף או שופט ואפשר לרכב לעצור לגמרי לפני שתתקרב אליו.

t: Stand facing the Viking Press apparatus with your feet roughly shoulder-width apart and a slight bend in your knees, positioning yourself so the handles are at approximately chin height at the start of each rep. | Grip the parallel handles firmly with a neutral (palms-facing) grip, keeping your wrists stacked directly over your forearms. | Brace your core, pull your shoulder blades down and together, and set your chest up tall before each press. | Dip slightly at the knees and hips to load the legs — keep your torso upright and avoid excessive forward lean. | Drive explosively through your legs, transferring that force into your upper body as you press the handles overhead. | Lock your elbows fully at the top, squeezing the deltoids and triceps, with your biceps finishing close to your ears. | Lower the handles back to chin height under control, absorbing the load through your shoulders and arms rather than letting it crash down. | Reset your stance and brace, then immediately initiate the next rep with another leg-drive dip. | Complete your target reps or max-rep set, then step back and release the apparatus safely.
tRu: Stand facing the Viking Press apparatus with your feet roughly shoulder-width apart and a slight bend in your knees, positioning yourself so the handles are at approximately chin height at the start of each rep. | Надежно возьмитесь за параллельные рукояти нейтральным хватом (ладонями к себе), сохраняя запястья, расположенные прямо над предплечьями. | Напрягите корпус, сведите лопатки вниз и вместе и поднимите грудь высоко перед каждым жимом. | Слегка согните колени и отведите бёдра назад, чтобы подготовить ноги — сохраняйте корпус прямо и избегайте excessive наклона вперёд. | Взрывно оттолкнитесь ногами, передавая эту силу в верхнюю часть тела, когда вы выжимаете рукоятки над головой. | Полностью выпрямите локти в верхней точке, сжимая дельты и трицепсы, при этом ваши бицепсы должны закончить движение близко к ушам. | Опустите рукояти обратно на уровень подбородка под контролем, поглощая нагрузку через плечи и руки, а не позволяя ей резко опуститься. | Reset your stance and brace, then immediately initiate the next rep with another leg-drive dip. | Выполните целевое количество повторений или подход на максимум, затем отойдите и безопасно снимите снаряд.
tHe: Stand facing the Viking Press apparatus with your feet roughly shoulder-width apart and a slight bend in your knees, positioning yourself so the handles are at approximately chin height at the start of each rep. | אחוז בידיות המקבילות בחוזקה באחיזה ניטרלית (כפות פונות), תוך שמירה על פרקי הידיים בקו ישיר מעל האמות. | הדק את הליבה, משוך את השכמות למטה ויחד וקבע חזה גבוה זקוף לפני כל לחיצה. | שקע מעט בברכים ובירכיים כדי לטען את הרגליים — שמור על גוף זקוף והימנע מהטייה קדימה מרובה. | דחוף בכוח דרך הרגליים, מעביר את הכוח לגוף העליון כשלוחצים את הידיות מעלה. | Lock your elbows fully at the top, squeezing the deltoids and triceps, with your biceps finishing close to your ears. | Lower the handles back to chin height under control, absorbing the load through your shoulders and arms rather than letting it crash down. | Reset your stance and brace, then immediately initiate the next rep with another leg-drive dip. | בצע את מספר החזרות המטרה או את הסט מקסימלי, ואז צעד אחורה ושחרר את הציוד בבטחה.

t: Set up directly in front of the crossbar with the implement on the ground between your feet or slightly in front of you. Stand with feet roughly hip-width apart, toes turned out slightly. | Hinge at the hips and bend your knees to reach down and grip the implement with both hands, keeping your chest up and your back flat. | Take a breath into your belly and brace your core firmly before initiating the movement. | Drive through the floor by extending your hips and knees explosively, pulling the implement up close to your body — the hip extension is the primary power source. | As the implement rises to hip height, begin the second pull: pop your hips forward aggressively and stand tall, redirecting the momentum upward. | As the implement continues upward, guide it with your hands and arms to steer it over the bar — release it at the peak of its arc so it clears the crossbar. | Step back from the landing zone immediately after releasing the implement. | Reset your stance and breathing fully before each attempt, especially when training multiple reps or increasing bar height.

t: Load the wheelbarrow with the target weight, ensuring the load is evenly distributed and secured. | Stand behind the wheelbarrow and grip the handles firmly with both hands at roughly hip height, knuckles facing up. | Hinge at the hips and bend your knees to lift the handles, tipping the wheelbarrow onto its wheel — keep your chest up and your back flat. | Brace your core hard and drive through the balls of your feet to begin moving forward. | Lean slightly into the wheelbarrow and push it at maximum controllable speed, taking quick, powerful steps. | Keep your arms straight or only slightly bent as you push — use leg drive, not arm strength, to accelerate the load. | Steer with small wrist adjustments to stay on course; look a few meters ahead rather than straight down. | Maintain your brace and pace all the way to the finish line — do not relax before you clear the distance marker. | Lower the handles in a controlled hinge to set the wheelbarrow down safely at the end of the run.

tHe: Load the wheelbarrow with the target weight, ensuring the load is evenly distributed and secured. | Stand behind the wheelbarrow and grip the handles firmly with both hands at roughly hip height, knuckles facing up. | כופף בציר הירכיים וכופף את הברכיים כדי להרים את הידיות, והרם את המריצה על גלגלה — שמור על חזה מורם וגב שטוח. | הדק בחוזקה את הליבה ודחוף דרך כריות כפות הרגליים כדי להתחיל לנוע קדימה. | Lean slightly into the wheelbarrow and push it at maximum controllable speed, taking quick, powerful steps. | Keep your arms straight or only slightly bent as you push — use leg drive, not arm strength, to accelerate the load. | Steer with small wrist adjustments to stay on course; look a few meters ahead rather than straight down. | Maintain your brace and pace all the way to the finish line — do not relax before you clear the distance marker. | Lower the handles in a controlled hinge to set the wheelbarrow down safely at the end of the run.

t: Set the yoke uprights so the crossbar sits at approximately upper-trap height — you should be able to walk under it with a slight bend, not duck fully under. | Step under the yoke and centre the crossbar across your upper traps and rear deltoids, exactly as you would position a low-bar squat. | Take a tight grip on the uprights to help lock the yoke against your back, then brace your core hard and take a big breath into your belly (Valsalva). | Drive through your legs to stand the yoke up, keeping your chest tall and eyes fixed on a point at the far end of the course. | Begin walking with short, quick, controlled strides — keep your feet close to directly under your hips to minimise lateral sway of the yoke. | Maintain constant abdominal and glute tension throughout the walk; do not allow your lower back to hyperextend or your torso to lean excessively forward. | At the turnaround, plant both feet, pivot in place, and re-establish your brace before continuing — do not rush the turn. | At the finish, walk the yoke over the designated set-down point, hinge at the hips under control, and lower it to the ground — never drop it uncontrolled unless safety demands it.
tRu: Set the yoke uprights so the crossbar sits at approximately upper-trap height — you should be able to walk under it with a slight bend, not duck fully under. | Step under the yoke and centre the crossbar across your upper traps and rear deltoids, exactly as you would position a low-bar squat. | Take a tight grip on the uprights to help lock the yoke against your back, then brace your core hard and take a big breath into your belly (Valsalva). | Выталкивайтесь ногами, чтобы поставить раму вертикально, держа грудь высоко и глядя на точку в дальнем конце дорожки. | Начните идти короткими быстрыми подконтрольными шагами — держите стопы почти строго под бёдрами, чтобы минимизировать боковое качание коромысла. | Сохраняйте постоянное напряжение мышц живота и ягодиц на протяжении ходьбы; не позволяйте пояснице чрезмерно прогибаться или корпусу наклоняться чрезмерно вперёд. | На развороте жёстко поставьте обе стопы, повернитесь на месте и восстановите напряжение корпуса перед продолжением — не торопитесь. | На финише занесите коромысло над отметкой, контролируемо наклонитесь в бёдрах и опустите его на землю — не бросайте бесконтрольно, если этого не требует безопасность.
tHe: Set the yoke uprights so the crossbar sits at approximately upper-trap height — you should be able to walk under it with a slight bend, not duck fully under. | Step under the yoke and centre the crossbar across your upper traps and rear deltoids, exactly as you would position a low-bar squat. | Take a tight grip on the uprights to help lock the yoke against your back, then brace your core hard and take a big breath into your belly (Valsalva). | דחוף דרך הרגליים כדי להקים את העגלה, שומר על החזה זקוף והעיניים נעוצות בנקודה בקצה המסלול. | התחל ללכת בצעדים קצרים, מהירים ומבוקרים – שמור על כפות הרגליים קרוב מתחת לאגן כדי למזער נדנוד צידי של המתקן. | Maintain constant abdominal and glute tension throughout the walk; do not allow your lower back to hyperextend or your torso to lean excessively forward. | בנקודת הסיבוב נטע את שתי הרגליים, הסתובב במקום, ובסס מחדש את ההידוק לפני ההמשך — אל תמהר את הסיבוב. | בסיום הובל את היוק בהליכה מעל נקודת ההנחה, בצע ציר אגן בשליטה, והורד אותו לקרקע — לעולם אל תפיל אותו בלי שליטה אלא אם הבטיחות מחייבת זאת.

t: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart and turn your toes out 30–45°, keeping your hands on your hips or clasped in front of your chest. | Brace your core, keep your chest tall, and pull your shoulder blades down and back. | Push your knees out in line with your toes as you begin to lower your hips straight down. | Descend until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor, or as low as your mobility comfortably allows, keeping your torso as upright as possible. | Pause briefly at the bottom, ensuring your knees are still tracking over your toes and your heels remain flat on the floor. | Drive through your full foot to press the floor away and return to standing, squeezing your glutes at the top. | Reset your stance and brace before beginning the next rep.
tRu: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart and turn your toes out 30–45°, keeping your hands on your hips or clasped in front of your chest. | Напрягите корпус, держите грудь расправленной и опустите лопатки вниз и назад. | Push your knees out in line with your toes as you begin to lower your hips straight down. | Опуститесь до того уровня, пока ваши бедра не окажутся хотя бы параллельны полу, или как глубоко позволит ваша подвижность, сохраняя корпус максимально прямым. | На мгновение задержитесь внизу, убедившись, что колени по-прежнему находятся над носками, а пятки прижаты к полу. | Отталкивайтесь всей стопой, чтобы оттолкнуть пол и встать, сжимая ягодицы в верхней точке. | Reset your stance and brace before beginning the next rep.
tHe: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart and turn your toes out 30–45°, keeping your hands on your hips or clasped in front of your chest. | הדק את הליבה, שמור על חזה זקוף, ומשוך את שכמות הכתפיים למטה ולאחור. | Push your knees out in line with your toes as you begin to lower your hips straight down. | רד עד שהירכיים לפחות מקבילות לרצפה, או לעומק שגמישות מאפשרת בנוחות, שומר על הגוף זקוף ככל האפשר. | Pause briefly at the bottom, ensuring your knees are still tracking over your toes and your heels remain flat on the floor. | דחוף דרך כל כף הרגל כדי לדחוף הרחק מהרצפה ולחזור לעמידה, לחוץ בשרירי הירך העליונים בשיא התנועה. | Reset your stance and brace before beginning the next rep.

t: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart and angle your toes outward at roughly 45 degrees. | Brace your core, keep your chest tall, and distribute your weight evenly across both feet. | Inhale and begin lowering your hips by bending your knees, actively pushing them outward in line with your toes. | Continue descending until your thighs are parallel to the floor or slightly below, keeping your torso upright. | Pause briefly at the bottom, ensuring your knees remain tracking over your toes and your heels stay flat on the floor. | Exhale and drive through both heels to press the floor away, extending your hips and knees simultaneously. | Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement as you return to the fully upright starting position. | Reset your breathing and brace before beginning the next repetition.
tRu: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart and angle your toes outward at roughly 45 degrees. | Напрягите корпус, держите грудь расправленной и распределите вес равномерно на обе стопы. | Вдохните и начните опускать таз, сгибая колени, активно отталкивая их наружу в соответствии с носками. | Продолжайте опускаться, пока бёдра не станут параллельны полу или немного ниже, удерживая корпус прямо. | На мгновение задержитесь внизу, убедившись, что колени остаются над носками, а пятки остаются на полу. | Выдохните и оттолкнитесь обеими пятками, чтобы оттолкнуть пол, одновременно разгибая тазобедренные суставы и колени. | Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement as you return to the fully upright starting position. | Reset your breathing and brace before beginning the next repetition.
tHe: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart and angle your toes outward at roughly 45 degrees. | הדק את הליבה, שמור על חזה גבוה וחלק את המשקל שווה בשווה על שתי הרגליים. | Inhale and begin lowering your hips by bending your knees, actively pushing them outward in line with your toes. | המשילו לרדת עד שהירכיים מקבילות לרצפה או מעט מתחתיה, תוך שמירה על גוף זקוף. | Pause briefly at the bottom, ensuring your knees remain tracking over your toes and your heels stay flat on the floor. | נשוף ודחוף דרך שתי העקבים כדי לדחוף את הרצפה רחוק, מתיחת המותניים והברכיים בו-זמנית. | Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement as you return to the fully upright starting position. | Reset your breathing and brace before beginning the next repetition.

t: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart and turn your toes out at roughly 45 degrees, with your hands at your sides. | Brace your core and keep your chest tall as you begin to push your hips back and bend your knees to initiate the squat. | Lower yourself by tracking your knees out over your toes throughout the descent — do not let them cave inward. | Continue descending until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor, or as low as your mobility allows while keeping your heels flat. | At the bottom of the squat, reach both arms down and touch the floor between your feet with your fingertips. | Keep your back as upright as possible and your chest lifted while touching the floor — avoid rounding your lower back. | Drive through your heels and push your knees out to stand back up to the starting position. | Squeeze your glutes at the top to fully extend your hips before beginning the next repetition.
tRu: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart and turn your toes out at roughly 45 degrees, with your hands at your sides. | Напрягите корпус и держите грудь расправленной, начиная отводить бёдра назад и сгибать колени для начала приседа. | Опуститесь, отслеживая колени над носками на протяжении всего опускания — не позволяйте им заваливаться внутрь. | Продолжайте опускаться, пока бёдра не окажутся хотя бы параллельны полу или настолько низко, насколько позволяет ваша мобильность, удерживая пятки на полу. | В нижней точке приседа опустите обе руки и коснитесь кончиками пальцев пола между стопами. | Держите спину максимально прямой и грудь приподнятой, когда касаетесь пола — избегайте округления поясницы. | Отталкивайтесь пятками и сжимайте ягодицы, чтобы поднять таз от пола. | Squeeze your glutes at the top to fully extend your hips before beginning the next repetition.
tHe: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart and turn your toes out at roughly 45 degrees, with your hands at your sides. | הדק את הליבה ושמור על חזה זקוף כשאתה מתחיל לדחוף את האגן לאחור ולכופף את הברכיים כדי להתחיל את הסקוואט. | Lower yourself by tracking your knees out over your toes throughout the descent — do not let them cave inward. | המשילו לרדת עד שהירכיים שלכם מקבילות לפחות לרצפה, או לנמוך ככל שהגמישות מאפשרת תוך שמירה על עקבים שטוחים על הרצפה. | בתחתית הסקוואט, שלח את שתי הזרועות מטה וגע ברצפה בין הרגליים עם קצות האצבעות. | Keep your back as upright as possible and your chest lifted while touching the floor — avoid rounding your lower back. | דחוף דרך עקביך ודחוף את הברכים החוצה כדי לקום חזרה למצב ההתחלתי. | Squeeze your glutes at the top to fully extend your hips before beginning the next repetition.

t: Lie face-down on the floor with your legs straight, feet hip-width apart, and arms extended overhead so your body forms a long, straight line. | Rest your forehead lightly on the floor and keep your neck neutral — avoid cranking your head upward before the movement begins. | Take a breath in, then brace your core gently to protect the spine. | On your exhale, simultaneously lift your arms, chest, and both legs off the floor in one controlled motion, as if flying like Superman. | Squeeze your glutes and engage your lower back to drive the movement — your hips remain in contact with the floor throughout. | Hold the top position for 1–2 seconds, keeping your arms and legs extended and your gaze directed at the floor a short distance ahead. | Inhale as you slowly lower your arms, chest, and legs back to the starting position with control. | Reset your breath and repeat for the desired number of reps.
tRu: Лягте на живот на коврик с прямыми ногами, ногами на ширине таза и руками, вытянутыми над головой, чтобы тело образовало прямую линию. | Rest your forehead lightly on the floor and keep your neck neutral — avoid cranking your head upward before the movement begins. | Take a breath in, then brace your core gently to protect the spine. | На вашем выдохе одновременно поднимите руки, грудь и обе ноги от пола в одном контролируемом движении, словно летите, как Супермен. | Squeeze your glutes and engage your lower back to drive the movement — your hips remain in contact with the floor throughout. | Удерживайте верхнюю точку в течение 1–2 секунд, сохраняя руки и ноги выпрямленными, а взгляд направленным на пол на небольшом расстоянии впереди. | Вдыхайте, когда плавно опускаете руки, грудь и ноги обратно в исходное положение с контролем. | Восстановите дыхание и повторите желаемое количество повторений.
tHe: Lie face-down on the floor with your legs straight, feet hip-width apart, and arms extended overhead so your body forms a long, straight line. | Rest your forehead lightly on the floor and keep your neck neutral — avoid cranking your head upward before the movement begins. | Take a breath in, then brace your core gently to protect the spine. | On your exhale, simultaneously lift your arms, chest, and both legs off the floor in one controlled motion, as if flying like Superman. | Squeeze your glutes and engage your lower back to drive the movement — your hips remain in contact with the floor throughout. | Hold the top position for 1–2 seconds, keeping your arms and legs extended and your gaze directed at the floor a short distance ahead. | Inhale as you slowly lower your arms, chest, and legs back to the starting position with control. | אפס את הנשימה וחזור על התרגיל למספר החזרות הרצוי.

t: Lie face-down on a mat with your legs extended straight behind you and the tops of your feet flat on the floor. | Extend both arms overhead so your body forms one long line from fingertips to toes, palms facing down. | Take a deep breath in, then as you exhale, simultaneously lift your arms, chest, and head off the floor as high as you comfortably can. | Keep your legs on the floor and your core gently engaged to protect the lower back. | Draw your shoulder blades down and together so you feel a stretch across the chest and the front of the shoulders. | Hold the lifted position for 20–30 seconds, breathing steadily and deepening the stretch on each exhale. | Slowly lower your chest and arms back to the floor in a controlled manner. | Rest for a breath, then repeat for the desired number of sets.
tRu: Лягте на живот на коврик с ногами, полностью вытянутыми назад, и верхними сторонами стоп, лежащими на полу. | Вытяните обе руки над головой так, чтобы ваше тело образовывало одну прямую линию от кончиков пальцев до носков, ладонями вниз. | Take a deep breath in, then as you exhale, simultaneously lift your arms, chest, and head off the floor as high as you comfortably can. | Держите ноги на полу и корпус лёгким напряжением, чтобы защитить поясницу. | Отведите лопатки вниз и вместе, чтобы почувствовать растяжение в груди и передней части плеч. | Подержите поднятую позицию в течение 20–30 секунд, дыша ровно и углубляя растяжку с каждым выдохом. | Slowly lower your chest and arms back to the floor in a controlled manner. | Отдохните на один вдох, затем повторите желаемое количество подходов.
tHe: Lie face-down on a mat with your legs extended straight behind you and the tops of your feet flat on the floor. | פשוט את שתי הידיים מעל הראש כך שהגוף ייצור קו ארוך אחד מקצות האצבעות עד כפות הרגליים, כפות הידיים פונות מטה. | Take a deep breath in, then as you exhale, simultaneously lift your arms, chest, and head off the floor as high as you comfortably can. | Keep your legs on the floor and your core gently engaged to protect the lower back. | משוך את שכמותיך למטה ויחד כך שאתה מרגיש מתיחה על פני החזה וקדמת הכתפיים. | Hold the lifted position for 20–30 seconds, breathing steadily and deepening the stretch on each exhale. | Slowly lower your chest and arms back to the floor in a controlled manner. | נוח לנשימה אחת, ואז חזור על התרגיל למספר הסטים הרצוי.

t: Lie face-down on the floor with your arms extended fully overhead, legs straight, and toes pointing away from you. | Engage your core and glutes, then simultaneously lift your chest, arms, and legs off the floor into the Superman position. | Hold the Superman position briefly to stabilize your spine and confirm your glutes and lower back are fully contracted. | Bend both elbows and pull them back toward your hips in a rowing motion, squeezing your shoulder blades together at the top. | Pause for one count at the peak of the row, feeling the contraction across your upper and mid back. | Reverse the motion by extending your arms back overhead while keeping your chest and legs lifted off the floor. | Lower your chest, arms, and legs back to the floor in a controlled manner to complete one repetition.
tRu: Лягте на живот на пол с полностью вытянутыми над головой руками, прямыми ногами и носками, направленными от себя. | Напрягите мышцы кора и ягодицы, затем одновременно поднимите грудь, руки и ноги от пола в положение «Супермен». | Держите положение «Супермен» в течение короткого времени, чтобы стабилизировать позвоночник и убедиться, что ваши ягодицы и нижняя часть спины полностью сокращены. | Согните оба локтя и потяните их назад к бёдрам гребным движением, сводя лопатки вместе в верхней точке. | Пауза на один счёт в верхней точке тяги, почувствуйте сокращение в верхней и средней части спины. | Reverse the motion by extending your arms back overhead while keeping your chest and legs lifted off the floor. | Под контролем опустите грудь, руки и ноги обратно на пол, чтобы выполнить одно повторение.
tHe: Lie face-down on the floor with your arms extended fully overhead, legs straight, and toes pointing away from you. | הפעל את שרירי הליבה והירכים, ובמקביל הרם את החזה, הידיים והרגליים מהרצפה למצב הסופרמן. | Hold the Superman position briefly to stabilize your spine and confirm your glutes and lower back are fully contracted. | כופף את שני המרפקים ומשוך אותם לאחור לכיוון האגן בתנועת חתירה, תוך כיווץ השכמות יחד בנקודה העליונה. | Pause for one count at the peak of the row, feeling the contraction across your upper and mid back. | Reverse the motion by extending your arms back overhead while keeping your chest and legs lifted off the floor. | Lower your chest, arms, and legs back to the floor in a controlled manner to complete one repetition.

t: Lie face down on the floor with your body fully extended and a folded towel looped under a door or around a sturdy fixed object at floor level directly in front of you. | Grip one end of the towel in each hand with your arms extended overhead, palms facing each other, and take up the slack so there is light tension on the towel. | Brace your core and squeeze your glutes to prepare for the lift. | Exhale and simultaneously raise your chest, arms, and legs off the floor — entering the superman position — keeping your neck neutral and your gaze toward the floor rather than straight ahead. | From that suspended position, pull the towel toward your chest by driving your elbows back and down, squeezing your shoulder blades together at the end of the row. | Hold the top position for one count, feeling the contraction through your upper back, rear shoulders, and posterior chain. | Slowly extend your arms back out in front of you, then lower your chest and legs to the floor in a controlled manner. | Reset your body position fully before beginning the next rep, and repeat for the target number of reps.
tRu: Лягте на живот на пол, тело полностью вытянуто, и сложенное полотенце закреплено под дверью или вокруг прочного неподвижного объекта на уровне пола прямо перед вами. | Возьмите один конец полотенца в каждую руку, руки выпрямлены над головой, ладонями друг к другу, и уберите лишнее напряжение, чтобы на полотенце было легкое натяжение. | Напрягите корпус и сожмите ягодицы, чтобы подготовиться к подъёму. | Выдыхайте и одновременно поднимите грудь, руки и ноги от пола — принимая положение Супермена — сохраняя шею в нейтральном положении и взгляд направленным в пол, а не прямо перед собой. | Из этого подвешенного положения, подтяните полотенце к груди, отводя локти назад и вниз, сжимая лопатки в конце тяги. | Задержитесь в верхней позиции на один счёт, ощущая сокращение в верхней части спины, задних дельтах и задней цепи. | Slowly extend your arms back out in front of you, then lower your chest and legs to the floor in a controlled manner. | Reset your body position fully before beginning the next rep, and repeat for the target number of reps.
tHe: Lie face down on the floor with your body fully extended and a folded towel looped under a door or around a sturdy fixed object at floor level directly in front of you. | אחוז בקצה המגבת בכל יד כשהזרועות פשוטות מעל הראש, כפות פונות זו לזו, וקלוט את הרפיון כך שייווצר מתח קל במגבת. | הדק את הליבה וכווץ את הישבנים כהכנה להרמה. | נשף ובו-זמנית הרם את החזה, הידיים והרגליים מהרצפה — נכנס לתנוחת סופרמן — שומר על צוואר נייטרלי ומבט אל עבר הרצפה ולא ישר קדימה. | מעמדת התלייה הזו, משוך את המגבת לכיוון החזה על ידי הנעת המרפקים לאחור ומטה, וצבט את השכמות יחד בסוף החתירה. | Hold the top position for one count, feeling the contraction through your upper back, rear shoulders, and posterior chain. | Slowly extend your arms back out in front of you, then lower your chest and legs to the floor in a controlled manner. | Reset your body position fully before beginning the next rep, and repeat for the target number of reps.

t: Lie face-down on a mat with your legs straight and your forehead resting lightly on the floor. | Bring your arms into a W position: bend your elbows to roughly 90 degrees, pull them back toward your torso, and point your hands toward the ceiling with palms facing down. | Engage your core and squeeze your glutes before initiating the movement. | Exhale and simultaneously lift your chest, arms, and legs off the floor, keeping your neck neutral and gaze directed toward the floor. | At the top, hold the W arm shape — elbows wide and pulled toward your hips, hands near ear level — and avoid letting your arms drift forward into a Y position. | Hold the raised position for 1–2 seconds, focusing on squeezing the rear deltoids and mid-back muscles. | Inhale and slowly lower your chest, arms, and legs back to the starting position with control. | Repeat for the prescribed number of reps, maintaining consistent form throughout each repetition.
tRu: Лягте на живот на коврик с прямыми ногами и лбом, легко лежащим на полу. | Переместите руки в W-образную позицию: согните локти под углом примерно 90 градусов, отведите их назад к корпусу и направьте ладони вверх. | Напрягите корпус и сожмите ягодицы перед началом движения. | Выдыхайте и одновременно поднимите грудь, руки и ноги от пола, сохраняя шею в нейтральном положении и взгляд направленным в пол. | Вверху удерживайте W-позицию рук — локти широко и подтянуты к бёдрам, кисти у уровня ушей, — не давая рукам уходить вперёд в Y-позицию. | Держите поднятую положение в течение 1-2 секунд, концентрируясь на сжатии задних дельт и мышц средней части спины. | Вдохните и медленно опустите грудь, руки и ноги обратно в исходное положение с контролем. | Repeat for the prescribed number of reps, maintaining consistent form throughout each repetition.
tHe: Lie face-down on a mat with your legs straight and your forehead resting lightly on the floor. | הביא את הידיים למצב W: כפות הידיים למעלה, כופפים את המרפקים לכ-90 מעלות, מושכים אותם לכיוון הגוף ומכוונים את כפות הידיים לתקרה. | הפעל את שרירי הליבה וכווץ את הישבנים לפני שהתנועה מתחילה. | נשף ובו-זמנית הרם את החזה, הידיים והרגליים מהרצפה, שומר על צוואר נייטרלי ומבט מופנה אל עבר הרצפה. | בשיא החזק את צורת הדאבליו עם הידיים — מרפקים רחבים ומשוכים לכיוון האגן, ידיים בגובה האוזניים — והימנע מגלישת הידיים קדימה למצב וואי. | Hold the raised position for 1–2 seconds, focusing on squeezing the rear deltoids and mid-back muscles. | Inhale and slowly lower your chest, arms, and legs back to the starting position with control. | Repeat for the prescribed number of reps, maintaining consistent form throughout each repetition.

t: Lie face down on the floor with your legs straight, toes pointed, and arms extended overhead in a Y shape as your starting position. | Brace your core, squeeze your glutes, and simultaneously lift your chest, arms, and legs off the floor into the Superman hold — your body should form a gentle arc. | While holding the lift, bend your elbows and pull your arms back and down until they form a W shape — upper arms roughly in line with your shoulders, elbows bent about 90°, and hands near ear height. | Pause briefly in the W position, actively squeezing your shoulder blades together and keeping your chest and legs elevated. | Slowly extend your arms back overhead into the full Y position, keeping them off the floor throughout the movement. | Pause again in the Y position, maintaining the Superman lift with your chest and legs still raised. | Lower your chest, arms, and legs back to the floor with control to complete one repetition. | Reset your breath and repeat for the desired number of reps.
tRu: Лягте на живот на пол с ногами вместе и руками, вытянутыми над головой в форме буквы Y, как исходное положение. | Напрягите корпус, сожмите ягодицы и одновременно поднимите грудь, руки и ноги от пола в положение Супермена — ваше тело должно образовать мягкую дугу. | While holding the lift, bend your elbows and pull your arms back and down until they form a W shape — upper arms roughly in line with your shoulders, elbows bent about 90°, and hands near ear height. | Задержитесь на мгновение в положении W, активно сжимая лопатки и сохраняя грудь и ноги приподнятыми. | Slowly extend your arms back overhead into the full Y position, keeping them off the floor throughout the movement. | Снова сделайте паузу в положении Y, удерживая подъем Супермена с грудью и поднятыми ногами. | Под контролем опустите грудь, руки и ноги обратно на пол, чтобы выполнить одно повторение. | Восстановите дыхание и повторите желаемое количество повторений.
tHe: Lie face down on the floor with your legs straight, toes pointed, and arms extended overhead in a Y shape as your starting position. | תכווץ את שרירי הליבה, תכווץ את השרירים הגלוטיאליים, ובו-זמנית הרם את החזה, הידיים והרגליים מהרצפה למצב סופרמן - גופך צריך ליצור קשת עדינה. | While holding the lift, bend your elbows and pull your arms back and down until they form a W shape — upper arms roughly in line with your shoulders, elbows bent about 90°, and hands near ear height. | Pause briefly in the W position, actively squeezing your shoulder blades together and keeping your chest and legs elevated. | Slowly extend your arms back overhead into the full Y position, keeping them off the floor throughout the movement. | Pause again in the Y position, maintaining the Superman lift with your chest and legs still raised. | Lower your chest, arms, and legs back to the floor with control to complete one repetition. | אפס את הנשימה וחזור על התרגיל למספר החזרות הרצוי.

nR: Обратная тяга супинированным хватом в висе
t: Position a bar in a rack or on a Smith machine at roughly hip height — lower means harder; higher means easier. | Sit on the floor under the bar, grip it with both hands shoulder-width apart, palms facing toward you (supinated grip), and arms fully extended. | Extend your legs out in front of you so only your heels touch the floor, and lift your hips so your body forms a straight line from heels to shoulders. | Brace your core and squeeze your glutes to keep your hips level and your body rigid throughout the movement. | Initiate the pull by driving your elbows toward your hips and squeezing your shoulder blades together. | Pull your chest up to the bar in a controlled manner, keeping your body in a straight plank — avoid letting your hips drop or your lower back arch. | Hold the top position briefly when your chest reaches the bar and your elbows are fully bent. | Lower yourself back to the starting position with control until your arms are fully extended, then repeat for the desired number of reps.
tRu: Position a bar in a rack or on a Smith machine at roughly hip height — lower means harder; higher means easier. | Sit on the floor under the bar, grip it with both hands shoulder-width apart, palms facing toward you (supinated grip), and arms fully extended. | Вытяните ноги вперед так, чтобы касались пола только пятки, и поднимите таз, чтобы тело образовывало прямую линию от пяток до плеч. | Напрягите корпус и сожмите ягодицы, чтобы удерживать бёдра на одном уровне, а тело жёстким в течение всего движения. | Начните тягу, отводя локти вверх и назад, ведя верхним спиной, а не руками. | Pull your chest up to the bar in a controlled manner, keeping your body in a straight plank — avoid letting your hips drop or your lower back arch. | Удерживайте верхнюю точку в течение короткого времени, когда грудь касается перекладины и локти полностью согнуты. | Опуститесь обратно в исходное положение с контролем, пока ваши руки не будут полностью выпрямлены, затем повторите для желаемого количества повторений.
tHe: Position a bar in a rack or on a Smith machine at roughly hip height — lower means harder; higher means easier. | Sit on the floor under the bar, grip it with both hands shoulder-width apart, palms facing toward you (supinated grip), and arms fully extended. | פשוט את רגליך לפניך כך שרק העקבים נוגעים ברצפה, והרם את האגן כך שגופך ייצור קו ישר מהעקבים עד לכתפיים. | הדק את הליבה וכווץ את הישבנים כדי לשמור על אגן מאוזן וגוף נוקשה לאורך כל התנועה. | Initiate the pull by driving your elbows toward your hips and squeezing your shoulder blades together. | Pull your chest up to the bar in a controlled manner, keeping your body in a straight plank — avoid letting your hips drop or your lower back arch. | Hold the top position briefly when your chest reaches the bar and your elbows are fully bent. | Lower yourself back to the starting position with control until your arms are fully extended, then repeat for the desired number of reps.

t: Grip the pull-up bar with your palms facing toward you (supinated) and your hands shoulder-width apart or slightly closer. | Hang at full arm extension with your feet off the floor, allowing your shoulders to decompress fully into a dead hang. | Brace your core, engage your glutes, and cross your feet or bend your knees to stabilise your lower body. | Depress and retract your shoulder blades — pull them down and together — before initiating the pull. | Drive your elbows down and back toward your hips to pull your chin above the bar, leading with your chest. | Hold briefly at the top with your chin clear of the bar and your shoulder blades fully contracted. | Lower yourself under control back to a full dead hang before beginning the next repetition.
tRu: Возьмитесь за перекладину для подтягиваний ладонями к вам (supinated) и руками на расстоянии ширины плеч или немного ближе. | Повисните на полностью выпрямленных руках, ноги не касаясь пола, позволяя плечам полностью расслабиться в вис на прямых руках. | Напрягите корпус, включите ягодицы, скрестите стопы или согните колени, чтобы стабилизировать нижнюю часть тела. | Опустите и сведите лопатки — потяните их вниз и вместе — перед началом тяги. | Отведите локти вниз и назад к бедрам, чтобы подтянуть подбородок над перекладиной, ведя грудью. | Задержитесь на мгновение, затем опустите левую ногу, чтобы выполнить одно полное повторение. | Под контролем вернитесь в полный вис на прямых руках перед началом следующего повторения.
tHe: אחוז במוט המשיכה כשהכפות פונות אליך (סופינציה) והידיים ברוחב הכתפיים או מעט צרות יותר. | תלה בפשיטת זרועות מלאה כשהרגליים מהרצפה, ואפשר לכתפיים להתפרק מעומס לגמרי לתלייה חופשית. | הדק את הליבה, כווץ את הישבן, ושלב את הרגליים או כופף את הברכיים כדי לייצב את הפלג התחתון. | הורד והצמד את שכמות הכתפיים — משוך אותן למטה ויחד — לפני תחילת המשיכה. | דחוף את המרפקים למטה ואחורה לכיוון הירכיים כדי למשוך את הסנטר מעל המוט, מוביל עם החזה. | Hold briefly at the top with your chin clear of the bar and your shoulder blades fully contracted. | Lower yourself under control back to a full dead hang before beginning the next repetition.

nR: Растяжка в висе на перекладине супинацией
t: Stand beneath a pull-up bar or similar overhead bar so it is within easy reach overhead. | Reach up and grip the bar with both hands using an underhand (supinated) grip — palms facing toward you, hands roughly shoulder-width apart. | Bend your knees or lift your feet so your bodyweight hangs from the bar with your arms fully extended. | Let your bodyweight settle while keeping your shoulders packed down away from your ears and your elbows straight. | Relax into the hang and allow gravity to deepen the stretch through your biceps and forearms — keep the elbows extended and do not force the position. | Breathe slowly and steadily, easing a little deeper into the stretch with each exhale. | Hold the stretched position for 20–40 seconds, or as long as you can maintain a controlled, relaxed hang. | To finish, place your feet back on the floor to unload your arms before releasing the bar.
tRu: Stand beneath a pull-up bar or similar overhead bar so it is within easy reach overhead. | Reach up and grip the bar with both hands using an underhand (supinated) grip — palms facing toward you, hands roughly shoulder-width apart. | Согните ноги или оторвите стопы так, чтобы тело висело на перекладине на полностью выпрямленных руках. | Пусть ваш вес тела распределяется, держа плечи опущенными от ушей и локти прямыми. | Relax into the hang and allow gravity to deepen the stretch through your biceps and forearms — keep the elbows extended and do not force the position. | Дышите медленно и ровно, позволяя немного глубже войти в растяжку с каждым выдохом. | Держите растянутое положение 20–40 секунд, или столько, сколько можете сохранять контролируемое, расслабленное висение. | To finish, place your feet back on the floor to unload your arms before releasing the bar.
tHe: Stand beneath a pull-up bar or similar overhead bar so it is within easy reach overhead. | Reach up and grip the bar with both hands using an underhand (supinated) grip — palms facing toward you, hands roughly shoulder-width apart. | כופף את הברכיים או הרם את כפות הרגליים כך שמשקל הגוף ייתלה מהמוט עם ידיים ישרות לגמרי. | Let your bodyweight settle while keeping your shoulders packed down away from your ears and your elbows straight. | Relax into the hang and allow gravity to deepen the stretch through your biceps and forearms — keep the elbows extended and do not force the position. | נשם לאט ובצורה יציבה, מרפה עוד קצת לעומק המתיחה עם כל נשימת פליטה. | Hold the stretched position for 20–40 seconds, or as long as you can maintain a controlled, relaxed hang. | To finish, place your feet back on the floor to unload your arms before releasing the bar.

t: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and your arms resting at your sides. | Draw your right knee into your chest, wrapping both hands around your shin briefly to create a light compression through the hip. | Extend your right arm out to the side at shoulder height, palm facing up, to anchor that shoulder to the floor. | Use your left hand to gently guide your right knee across your body toward the floor on the left side, stacking the right knee roughly at hip height. | Turn your head to the right, away from the direction your knees are pointing, to extend the rotational stretch through the cervical spine. | Press your right knee gently downward with your left hand if it does not reach the floor, without allowing your right shoulder to lift. | Hold the position for 20–60 seconds, breathing slowly and letting your torso release further into the twist with each exhale. | Return your knee to center and lower your leg back to the floor, then repeat on the opposite side.
tRu: Лягте на спину с выпрямленными ногами и руками, лежащими вдоль тела. | Приведите правое колено к груди, обхватив обеими руками голень на мгновение, чтобы создать легкое сжатие в тазобедренном суставе. | Выпрямите правую руку в сторону на уровне плеч, ладонь обращена вверх, чтобы зафиксировать это плечо на полу. | Use your left hand to gently guide your right knee across your body toward the floor on the left side, stacking the right knee roughly at hip height. | Turn your head to the right, away from the direction your knees are pointing, to extend the rotational stretch through the cervical spine. | Press your right knee gently downward with your left hand if it does not reach the floor, without allowing your right shoulder to lift. | Задержите положение на 20-60 секунд, дыша медленно и позволяя вашему корпусу сильнее раскручиваться в скручивании с каждым выдохом. | Return your knee to center and lower your leg back to the floor, then repeat on the opposite side.

t: Lie flat on your back on a mat with your arms extended out to your sides at shoulder height, palms facing down. | Bend your knees to roughly 90 degrees and lift your feet off the floor so your thighs are vertical and your shins are parallel to the ground. | Brace your core lightly and keep your shoulders pressed flat against the mat throughout the movement. | Slowly lower both knees together to the right, letting them travel toward the floor while keeping your left shoulder from lifting. | Lower only as far as your range of motion allows without discomfort, pausing briefly at the end of the range. | Reverse the movement and sweep both knees back through center and over to the left side in a controlled arc. | Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions, moving at a slow, steady tempo.

tHe: Lie flat on your back on a mat with your arms extended out to your sides at shoulder height, palms facing down. | כופף את הברכיים לערך ל-90 מעלות והרם את כפות הרגליים מהרצפה כך שהירכיים אנכיות והשוקיים מקבילות לקרקע. | הדק קלות את הליבה ושמור על כתפיים לחוצות שטוח למזרן לאורך כל התנועה. | Slowly lower both knees together to the right, letting them travel toward the floor while keeping your left shoulder from lifting. | Lower only as far as your range of motion allows without discomfort, pausing briefly at the end of the range. | Reverse the movement and sweep both knees back through center and over to the left side in a controlled arc. | המשילו להחליף צדדים למספר החזרות הרצוי, זוזו בקצב איטי ויציב.

t: Kneel on the floor and interlace your fingers, placing your forearms flat on the mat shoulder-width apart to form a stable triangular base. | Set the crown of your head — not your forehead or the back of your skull — on the mat inside your cupped hands, so your hands cradle the back of your head. | Tuck your toes, lift your knees, and walk your feet in toward your elbows until your hips stack above your shoulders as much as possible. | Engage your shoulder blades by pressing your forearms firmly into the mat and lifting your shoulders away from your ears; this protects the neck throughout the pose. | If you are a beginner, position yourself facing a wall about one foot away so the wall can catch your feet if you go too far. | Draw your core in and up, then slowly lift one foot off the floor, bending the knee and bringing it toward your chest. | When you feel balanced, lift the second foot and bring both knees to your chest before gradually straightening the legs toward the ceiling. | Hold the inverted position for 5–30 seconds while breathing steadily, keeping your core firm and your shoulder blades active. | To come down, bend your knees back to your chest, lower your feet to the floor one at a time, and rest in Child's Pose for several breaths.
tRu: Встаньте на колени на полу и переплетите пальцы, положив предплечья на коврик на ширине плеч, чтобы создать устойчивую треугольную основу. | Set the crown of your head — not your forehead or the back of your skull — on the mat inside your cupped hands, so your hands cradle the back of your head. | Tuck your toes, lift your knees, and walk your feet in toward your elbows until your hips stack above your shoulders as much as possible. | Напрягите лопатки, уперев предплечья плотно в мат и отведя плечи от ушей; это защищает шею на протяжении всей позы. | Если вы новичок, займите положение лицом к стене на расстоянии примерно одного фута, чтобы стена могла поймать ваши ноги, если вы перегнёте. | Втяните и поднимите корпус, затем медленно поднимите одну стопу с пола, сгибая колено и bringing его к груди. | When you feel balanced, lift the second foot and bring both knees to your chest before gradually straightening the legs toward the ceiling. | Подержите перевёрнутое положение в течение 5–30 секунд, дыша ровно, сохраняя корпус напряженным и лопатки активными. | To come down, bend your knees back to your chest, lower your feet to the floor one at a time, and rest in Child's Pose for several breaths.

nR: Растяжка сгибателей бедра и разгибателей колена стоя на одной ноге с опорой
nH: מתיחת מכופפי ירך ופושטי ברך בעמידה על רגל אחת בתמיכה
t: Stand facing a wall or sturdy support and place one hand lightly on it for balance. | Shift your weight onto your left foot, keeping the knee soft rather than locked. | Bend your right knee and reach back with your right hand to grasp the top of your right foot or ankle. | Draw your right heel toward your right glute until you feel a stretch along the front of the thigh and hip. | Tuck your pelvis slightly under — posterior pelvic tilt — to deepen the hip flexor portion of the stretch without arching the lower back. | Stand tall with your chest up, shoulders relaxed, and your supporting knee tracking over your toes. | Hold the stretch for 20–40 seconds, breathing steadily throughout. | Slowly release your foot back to the floor, then repeat on the opposite side.
tRu: Stand facing a wall or sturdy support and place one hand lightly on it for balance. | Shift your weight onto your left foot, keeping the knee soft rather than locked. | Согните правое колено и дотянитесь правой рукой назад, чтобы взяться за подъём правой стопы или лодыжку. | Приведите правую пятку к правой ягодице, пока не почувствуете растяжение вдоль передней части бедра и тазобедренного сустава. | Tuck your pelvis slightly under — posterior pelvic tilt — to deepen the hip flexor portion of the stretch without arching the lower back. | Stand tall with your chest up, shoulders relaxed, and your supporting knee tracking over your toes. | Держите растяжку 20–40 секунд, дыша ровно на протяжении всего времени. | Slowly release your foot back to the floor, then repeat on the opposite side.
tHe: Stand facing a wall or sturdy support and place one hand lightly on it for balance. | Shift your weight onto your left foot, keeping the knee soft rather than locked. | כופף את ברך ימין והושט את יד ימין לאחור לאחיזת החלק העליון של כף רגל ימין או הקרסול. | משוך את עקב ימין לעבר הישבן ימין עד שאתה מרגיש מתיחה לאורך קדמת הירך והאגן. | Tuck your pelvis slightly under — posterior pelvic tilt — to deepen the hip flexor portion of the stretch without arching the lower back. | Stand tall with your chest up, shoulders relaxed, and your supporting knee tracking over your toes. | Hold the stretch for 20–40 seconds, breathing steadily throughout. | Slowly release your foot back to the floor, then repeat on the opposite side.

t: Stand facing a sturdy support — a wall, squat rack upright, or TRX straps held at arm's length — with your feet shoulder-width apart and toes turned out slightly. | Grip or lightly rest your hands on the support at chest height so it can assist balance without bearing significant load. | Brace your core and keep your chest tall before you begin the descent. | Push your hips back and bend your knees simultaneously, lowering your body as if sitting toward a chair behind you. | Continue descending until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor, or as deep as your mobility comfortably allows. | Pause briefly at the bottom, keeping your heels flat on the floor and knees tracking over your toes. | Drive through your entire foot to press the floor away, extending your hips and knees together to return to standing. | Squeeze your thighs and glutes at the top and reset your brace before beginning the next repetition.
tRu: Stand facing a sturdy support — a wall, squat rack upright, or TRX straps held at arm's length — with your feet shoulder-width apart and toes turned out slightly. | Возьмитесь или lightly rest your hands на опоре на уровне груди, чтобы она помогала сохранять равновесие, не неся значительной нагрузки. | Напрягите корпус и держите грудь расправленной перед началом опускания. | Push your hips back and bend your knees simultaneously, lowering your body as if sitting toward a chair behind you. | Продолжайте опускаться, пока бёдра не окажутся хотя бы параллельны полу или настолько глубоко, насколько позволяет ваша мобильность. | На мгновение задержитесь внизу, сохраняя пятки на полу и колени над носками. | Отталкивайтесь всей стопой, чтобы оттолкнуть пол, разгибая тазобедренный сустав и колено вместе, чтобы встать. | Squeeze your thighs and glutes at the top and reset your brace before beginning the next repetition.
tHe: Stand facing a sturdy support — a wall, squat rack upright, or TRX straps held at arm's length — with your feet shoulder-width apart and toes turned out slightly. | אחוז או הנח קלות את הידיים על התמיכה בגובה החזה כך שהיא תסייע לאיזון מבלי לשאת עומס משמעותי. | הדק את הליבה ושמור על חזה זקוף לפני תחילת הירידה. | Push your hips back and bend your knees simultaneously, lowering your body as if sitting toward a chair behind you. | המשילו לרדת עד שהירכיים שלכם מקבילות לפחות לרצפה, או לעומק הנוח עבור טווח התנועה שלכם. | Pause briefly at the bottom, keeping your heels flat on the floor and knees tracking over your toes. | דחוף דרך כף הרגל כולה כדי ללחוץ את הרצפה רחוק, מרחיב את האגן והברך יחד כדי לחזור לעמידה. | Squeeze your thighs and glutes at the top and reset your brace before beginning the next repetition.

t: Set the suspension straps to a height where, when you grip the handles and extend your arms, your body forms a straight line from head to heels at roughly a 20–45 degree angle to the floor — the more horizontal your body, the harder the exercise. | Face away from the anchor point, grip one handle in each hand with a neutral or slightly outward-facing grip, and walk your feet back until your arms are fully extended in front of you. | Brace your core, squeeze your glutes, and align your head, hips, and heels in a straight plank position before you begin. | Inhale and lower your chest toward the level of the handles by bending your elbows, allowing them to flare out to roughly 45 degrees from your torso. | Continue lowering until your chest passes the line of your hands and you feel a full stretch across your chest — handles should be near the outside of your chest. | Press your hands firmly into the handles and exhale as you push your body back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms without locking the elbows aggressively. | Keep the straps as still as possible throughout — resisting the natural sway of the handles is what drives the additional muscle demand. | Complete all reps, then step your feet forward to return to an upright position before releasing the handles.
tRu: Set the suspension straps to a height where, when you grip the handles and extend your arms, your body forms a straight line from head to heels at roughly a 20–45 degree angle to the floor — the more horizontal your body, the harder the exercise. | Станьте спиной от точки крепления, возьмите по рукоятке в каждую руку нейтральным или слегка развёрнутым хватом и сделайте шаг ногами назад, пока ваши руки не будут полностью выпрямлены перед вами. | Напрягите корпус, сожмите ягодицы и выровняйте голову, бёдра и пятки в прямое положение планки перед началом. | Выдохните и опустите грудь до уровня рукояток, сгибая локти, позволяя им разведься примерно под углом 45 градусов от корпуса. | Продолжайте опускаться, пока ваша грудь не прошла уровень ваших рук, и вы почувствовали полное растяжение по груди — рукоятки должны быть у внешних краёв груди. | Press your hands firmly into the handles and exhale as you push your body back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms without locking the elbows aggressively. | Держите ленты как можно более неподвижными на протяжении всего движения — сопротивление естественному раскачанию рукоятей и создаёт дополнительную нагрузку на мышцы. | Выполните все повторения, затем поставьте ноги вперед, чтобы вернуться в положение стоя, прежде чем ослабить рукоятки.
tHe: Set the suspension straps to a height where, when you grip the handles and extend your arms, your body forms a straight line from head to heels at roughly a 20–45 degree angle to the floor — the more horizontal your body, the harder the exercise. | פנה אחורה מהעוגן, תפוס את הידית בכל יד עם אחיזה נייטרלית או מעט כלפי חוץ, ולך עם הרגליים אחורה עד שהזרועות שלך מושכות למלמעלה בפנים. | תכווץ את שרירי הליבה, כווץ את הישבנים, ויישר את הראש, המותניים והעקבים בתנוחת פלאנק ישרה לפני שתתחיל. | Inhale and lower your chest toward the level of the handles by bending your elbows, allowing them to flare out to roughly 45 degrees from your torso. | המשך לרדת עד שהחזה שלך עובר את קו הידיים ואתה מרגיש מתיחה מלאה על חזה - הידיות צריכות להיות קרוב לחלק החיצוני של החזה. | Press your hands firmly into the handles and exhale as you push your body back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms without locking the elbows aggressively. | Keep the straps as still as possible throughout — resisting the natural sway of the handles is what drives the additional muscle demand. | בצע את כל החזרות, ואז צעד קדימה עם הרגליים כדי לחזור למצב זקוף לפני ששחרר את הידיות.

t: Set the suspension trainer straps to a low position, roughly 6–12 inches off the floor, and place both feet through the foot cradles so the straps sit across the tops of your ankles. | Walk your hands forward and lower yourself into a high plank position with your arms fully extended, wrists directly under your shoulders, and body forming a straight line from head to heels. | Brace your core tightly and ensure your hips are level — neither sagging toward the floor nor piked upward. | Initiate the movement by pressing your lower back into a posterior pelvic tilt and drawing your knees toward your chest, allowing the hips to curl upward naturally as the knees travel in. | Continue curling until your knees reach your chest and your pelvis has rotated fully under, squeezing the abdominals at the top of the movement. | Slowly reverse the motion, extending your hips and legs back to the starting plank position under full muscular control — do not let your hips drop or swing. | Maintain tension in your core throughout the return to prevent lower back hyperextension. | Complete all reps, then carefully step out of the foot cradles to dismount.
