nE: Weighted Lying Side Lifting Head (with head harness)
nR: Подъёмы головы лёжа на боку с весом (с упряжью)
nH: הרמות ראש בשכיבה על הצד עם משקל (עם רתמת ראש)
t: Attach the head harness securely and hang a light weight plate from its strap or chain. | Lie on your side on a flat bench, positioning your head and neck off the edge so they can move freely. | Keep your body straight and brace your core to stabilize your torso throughout the movement. | Allow your head to lower toward the floor in a controlled manner until you feel a gentle stretch along the side of your neck. | Exhale and slowly raise your head by laterally flexing your neck, bringing your ear toward your shoulder. | Pause briefly at the top of the movement, squeezing the sternocleidomastoid on the working side. | Inhale and lower your head back down under control to the starting position. | Complete all reps on one side, then reposition and repeat on the opposite side.
tRu: Надёжно закрепите головной ремень и подвесьте лёгкий диск к его лямке или цепи. | Лягте на бок на скамейном прессе, примите положение так, чтобы голова и шея находились за краем и могли свободно двигаться. | Держите тело прямым и напрягите корпус для стабилизации торса на протяжении всего движения. | Подконтрольно опускайте голову к полу, пока не почувствуете мягкую растяжку боковой поверхности шеи. | Выдыхайте и медленно поднимите голову, наклоняя шею в сторону, bringing your ear toward your shoulder. | Пауза в верхней точке движения, сжимая грудино-ключично-сосцевидную мышцу на рабочей стороне. | Выдохните и опустите голову обратно вниз под контролем в исходное положение. | Выполните все повторения на одну сторону, затем перенеситесь и повторите с противоположной стороны.
tHe: חבר את רתמת הראש היטב ותלה צלחת משקל קלה מהרצועה או מהשרשרת שלה. | Lie on your side on a flat bench, positioning your head and neck off the edge so they can move freely. | Keep your body straight and brace your core to stabilize your torso throughout the movement. | תן לראש לרדת לעבר הרצפה באופן מבוקר עד לתחושת מתיחה עדינה לאורך צד הצוואר. | נשף והרם באיטיות את הראש על ידי כיפוף צדדי של הצוואר, מביא את האוזן אל עבר הכתף. | Pause briefly at the top of the movement, squeezing the sternocleidomastoid on the working side. | Inhale and lower your head back down under control to the starting position. | בצע את כל החזרות בצד אחד, ואז שנה תנוחה וחזור על התרגיל בצד הנגדי.

nR: Подъёмы шеи лёжа на боку с весом
nH: הרמות צוואר בשכיבה על הצד עם משקל
t: Select a light weight plate and lie on your side on a flat bench so your head extends just off the end, with your ear parallel to the floor and your body in a straight line from head to toe. | Stack your legs or place the upper foot on the bench for balance, and rest your lower arm along the bench or behind your back. | Hold the weight plate against the side of your head at the temple, using your upper hand to keep it in place throughout the set. | Let your head lower under control toward the floor until you feel a gentle stretch along the side of your neck — this is your starting position. | Raise your head laterally toward your upper shoulder by contracting the neck muscles on the working side, keeping the movement smooth and deliberate. | Lift until your head is level or just slightly above horizontal — do not force a deep crunch into your shoulder. | Lower your head back to the starting position under full muscular control, resisting gravity the entire way down. | Complete all reps on one side, then switch positions and repeat on the other side.

t: Place a stability ball on the floor and sit on top of it, then walk your feet forward until your upper back and shoulders rest on the ball, with your hips raised so your body forms a table-top position. | Plant your feet flat on the floor at shoulder-width apart, with your knees bent at approximately 90 degrees and your hips level. | Hold a dumbbell or weight plate with both hands, extending your arms straight up toward the ceiling directly over your chest. | Brace your core and squeeze your glutes to stabilize your hips throughout the movement. | Exhale and rotate your torso to the right, allowing your arms and the weight to travel with your upper body while keeping your hips as level as possible. | Pause briefly at the end of the rotation, feeling the stretch through your left oblique. | Inhale and rotate back through center, then continue rotating to the left side to complete one full repetition. | Continue alternating sides in a controlled rhythm for the desired number of repetitions, then walk your feet back in to return to a seated position on the ball before standing up.
tRu: Поставьте мяч для стабилизации на пол и sit on top of it, then walk your feet forward until your upper back and shoulders rest on the ball, with your hips raised so your body forms a table-top position. | Поставьте ноги на пол на ширине плеч, колени согнуты примерно под 90 градусов, бёдра на одном уровне. | Держите гантель или весовой диск обеими руками и выпрямите руки прямо вверх к потолку непосредственно над грудью. | Напрягите корпус и сожмите ягодицы, чтобы стабилизировать бёдра в течение всего движения. | Выдыхайте и поверните корпус вправо, позволяя рукам и весу следовать за верхней частью тела, сохраняя таз как можно более ровным. | На мгновение остановитесь в конце поворота, чувствуя растяжение в левой косой мышце живота. | Вдохните и вернитесь через центр, затем продолжите вращение влево, чтобы выполнить одно полное повторение. | Продолжайте поочередно выполнять движения на разные стороны в контролируемом ритме в течение назначенного количества повторений, затем шагните ногами ближе, чтобы сесть на мяч, прежде чем встать.

nR: Ягодичный мостик на одной ноге с весом
nH: דחיפת אגן ברגל אחת עם משקל
t: Sit on the floor with your upper back against the long edge of a flat bench. Place a weight plate or dumbbell on the crease of one hip and hold it steady with both hands. | Plant the foot on the same side as the loaded hip flat on the floor, far enough forward that your shin will be vertical at the top of the rep. Extend the opposite leg straight out in front of you, keeping it off the floor. | Brace your core and press through the planted foot to lift your hips off the ground, driving upward until your torso forms a straight line from shoulder to knee. | At the top, squeeze your glutes hard and pause for one second. Your shin should be close to vertical and your knee should be bent at roughly 90°. | Lower your hips slowly under control — about two seconds — until they are just above the floor without touching it. | Complete all reps on one side before switching the foot position and weight to the other hip. | When finished, lower your hips fully to the floor and set the weight down before standing.

nR: Жим над головой с зашагиванием с весом
nH: לחיצה מעל הראש עם עלייה עם משקל
t: Stand facing a sturdy box or step, holding a weight at shoulder height with both hands. Set your feet hip-width apart and brace your core. | Place your right foot flat on top of the box so your heel is fully supported and your knee is roughly over your toes. | In one fluid motion, drive through your right heel to push your body up onto the box while pressing the weight directly overhead. | As you stand upright on the box, lock your arms out fully with the weight stacked directly above your shoulders — keep your ribs down and avoid arching your lower back. | Hold the top position for a brief moment with control, weight overhead and body tall. | Lower the weight back to shoulder height as you step your left foot down to the floor, returning to the starting position with control. | Complete all reps on the right leg, then switch sides: place your left foot on the box and repeat the same sequence for the same number of reps.

nR: Тяга в наклоне с блином с весом
nH: חתירה בכפיפה עם פלטה עם משקל
t: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a weight plate with both hands using an overhand grip on the sides of the plate. | Hinge at the hips until your torso is roughly parallel to the floor, maintaining a neutral spine with a slight arch in your lower back. | Let the plate hang at arm's length directly below your chest, arms fully extended. | Retract your shoulder blades and drive your elbows back and up, pulling the plate toward your lower sternum or upper abdomen. | Squeeze your upper back muscles hard at the top of the movement, holding the contraction for one count. | Lower the plate in a controlled manner over 2–3 seconds back to the starting position with arms fully extended. | Repeat for the desired number of repetitions without allowing your torso to rise or your lower back to round.

nR: Скручивания с блином с весом (руки над головой)
nH: כפיפות עם פלטה עם משקל (ידיים מעל הראש)
t: Lie flat on your back on the floor with your knees bent and feet planted hip-width apart. | Hold a weight plate with both hands, gripping the sides or the center hole, and extend your arms straight overhead so the plate hovers just above the floor. | Press your lower back gently into the floor to stabilize your lumbar spine before initiating the movement. | Exhale and curl your upper back off the floor by contracting your abdominals, keeping your arms extended overhead and the plate in line with your body. | Continue rising until your shoulder blades are fully lifted and you feel maximum contraction in your abs — do not pull with your neck or jerk the plate forward. | Pause briefly at the top of the movement while maintaining tension in your core. | Inhale and lower your upper back to the floor in a controlled manner, resisting the pull of the plate on the way down. | Reset your position if needed, then repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tRu: Лягте ровно на спину на пол, согните колени и поставьте стопы на ширине бёдер. | Держите конец эспандера в каждой руке и поднимите руки до уровня плеч, или закрепите эспандер на плечах, чтобы он был натянут в положении стоя. | Press your lower back gently into the floor to stabilize your lumbar spine before initiating the movement. | Выдохните и поднимите верхнюю часть спины от пола, сокращая мышцы пресса, сохраняя руки вытянутыми над головой и диском вровень с телом. | Продолжайте подниматься, пока лопатки будут полностью оторваны от пола, и вы почувствуете максимальное сокращение в мышцах живота — не тяните шеей или не рывком двигайте диск вперёд. | Пауза в верхней точке движения, сохраняя напряжение в корпусе. | Выдохните и опустите верхнюю часть спины на пол в контролируемом режиме, сопротивляясь натяжению диска на пути вниз. | Reset your position if needed, then repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

t: Sit upright on a bench or chair with your feet flat on the floor and your knees bent at roughly 90 degrees. | Hold a dumbbell or light weight in one hand with a neutral grip, thumb pointing up, and rest your forearm on your thigh so your wrist hangs just past your knee. | Rotate your wrist so your palm faces downward (pronation) — this is your starting position. | Keeping your elbow pressed into your thigh and your upper arm completely still, rotate your forearm so your palm turns upward (supination) in a slow, controlled arc. | Pause for one second at the top with your palm fully facing upward, squeezing the brachioradialis. | Slowly reverse the rotation back to the starting pronated position over 2–3 seconds, resisting the weight on the way down. | Complete all reps on one arm before switching to the other side, keeping the tempo consistent throughout.

t: Sit upright on a flat bench or an adjustable bench set to 90°, with your feet flat on the floor and your lower back in a neutral arch. | Hold a single dumbbell vertically by cupping both hands under the top plate, or grip a weight plate with both palms flat against its surface. | Press the weight overhead so your arms are fully extended, elbows pointing straight up toward the ceiling and upper arms framing your head. | Brace your core and keep your chest tall — avoid arching your lower back or flaring your ribs. | Take a breath in, then slowly lower the weight behind your head by bending only at the elbows, keeping your upper arms stationary and vertical. | Descend until you feel a deep stretch in the triceps — typically when your forearms reach parallel to the floor or slightly below, depending on your flexibility. | Pause briefly at the bottom, then exhale and extend your elbows to drive the weight back overhead in a controlled arc. | Lock out the elbows fully at the top without shrugging your shoulders or tilting your head forward. | Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, maintaining the same upper-arm position on every rep.

t: Lie on your back on a mat with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. | Hold a weight plate or dumbbell against your chest, or extend your arms overhead holding the weight with both hands. | Allow your knees to fall to one side so they rest on or near the floor at roughly a 45-degree angle — this tilts the pelvis and pre-loads the obliques on the opposite side. | Brace your core and exhale as you curl your upper torso diagonally toward your raised hip, contracting the obliques on the side you are crunching toward. | Pause briefly at the top, feeling a strong contraction in the obliques and rectus abdominis. | Inhale and lower your torso back to the mat under control, avoiding a sudden drop. | Complete all reps on one side, then reposition your knees to the opposite side and repeat for the same number of reps. | Keep the movement slow and deliberate throughout — momentum reduces oblique involvement and increases neck strain.
tRu: Лягте на спину на коврик, согните колени и поставьте стопы на пол на ширине бёдер. | Держите весовой диск или гантель обеими руками и вытяните руки прямо вверх над головой, удерживая их близко к ушам — они остаются в этом выпрямленном положении на протяжении всего подхода. | Позвольте коленям опуститься в сторону, чтобы они легли на пол или рядом с ним примерно под углом 45 градусов — это наклоняет таз и заранее нагружает косые мышцы противоположной стороны. | Напрягите корпус и на выдохе скрутите верх корпуса по диагонали к поднятому бедру, сокращая косые мышцы на стороне скручивания. | Задержитесь на мгновение в верхней точке, чувствуя сильное сокращение косых мышц пресса и прямой мышцы живота. | Выдохните и опустите корпус обратно на коврик под контролем, избегая резкого падения. | Выполните все повторения на одну сторону, затем перенесите колени на противоположную сторону и повторите то же количество повторений. | Держите движение медленным и осознанным на протяжении всего времени — импульс снижает вовлечение косых мышц и увеличивает нагрузку на шею.

t: Lie flat on your back on the floor or a bench with your legs extended and your arms resting at your sides for stability. | Attach an ankle weight to the working leg, or hold a light dumbbell between your feet if training both sides together — for single-leg work, secure it to one ankle only. | Bend your non-working leg and place that foot flat on the floor to stabilize your lower back and pelvis. | Brace your core and press your lower back gently toward the floor to prevent it from arching excessively. | Keeping the working leg straight (knee soft, not locked), lift it in a smooth arc until your thigh is roughly perpendicular to the floor or level with your opposite knee. | Pause briefly at the top, maintaining tension in your hip flexors and quads without letting your lower back lift off the surface. | Lower the leg back down slowly and under control, stopping just before it touches the floor to keep tension on the muscles. | Complete all reps on one side, then switch legs and repeat.

nH: הילה עם מייס פלדה עם משקל
t: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart, core braced and glutes lightly engaged. | Hold the steel mace (or weight) at chest height with both hands gripping the handle close together, mace head pointing upward. | Tilt the mace to one side and begin guiding it backward and upward, initiating the circular path around your head. | Keep your head still and chin slightly tucked as the mace passes behind your head — do not duck or crane the neck. | Continue the arc smoothly so the mace travels around the back of the skull, staying as close to the head as control allows. | Guide the mace forward and back to the starting position in front of your chest to complete one full circle. | Perform the prescribed number of reps in one direction, then reverse the direction for the same count. | Maintain an upright torso throughout — avoid leaning or rotating the trunk to compensate for the weight.

t: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes turned out slightly, and the steel mace held vertically in front of your body at chest height with both hands gripping the handle. | Brace your core, pull your shoulder blades back and down, and keep your chest tall throughout the movement. | Inhale and initiate the squat by pushing your hips back and bending your knees simultaneously, keeping the mace close to your body. | Descend until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor, or as low as your mobility comfortably allows, while maintaining an upright torso. | Keep your knees tracking in line with your toes and prevent them from caving inward as you lower. | Pause briefly at the bottom of the squat with your weight distributed evenly through both feet. | Exhale and drive through your heels to press the floor away, extending your hips and knees simultaneously to return to the starting position. | Fully extend at the top without hyperextending your lower back, then reset your brace before the next repetition. | Complete the desired number of repetitions, then carefully lower the mace before setting it down.

nE: Weighted Straight Leg Toe Touch Crunch

t: Lie flat on your back on the floor or a mat with your legs extended straight up toward the ceiling, perpendicular to your torso. | Hold a weight plate or dumbbell with both hands, arms extended overhead or resting on your chest — for maximum load, keep the weight extended directly above your chest as you prepare to crunch. | Press your lower back firmly into the floor and brace your core before initiating any movement. | Exhale and contract your abdominals, curling your upper back off the floor and reaching the weight upward toward your toes. | Drive the crunch from your abs — avoid pulling with your neck or jerking the weight to create momentum. | At the top, aim to bring the weight as close to your feet as your flexibility allows while keeping your legs fully straight and your lower back on the floor. | Pause briefly at the peak contraction, then slowly lower your upper back back to the floor under control. | Inhale as you descend and return to the starting position with your arms extended and upper back just touching the mat. | Repeat for the desired number of reps without losing tension in the abdominals between repetitions.

tHe: Lie flat on your back on the floor or a mat with your legs extended straight up toward the ceiling, perpendicular to your torso. | החזק לוחית משקולת או דאמבל בשתי הידיים, זרועות פשוטות מעל הראש או נחות על החזה — לעומס מרבי, החזק את המשקל פשוט ישירות מעל החזה בהכנה לכפיפת הבטן. | Press your lower back firmly into the floor and brace your core before initiating any movement. | נשוף וכווץ את שרירי הבטן, כופף את גבך העליון מהרצפה ומשוך את המשקולת כלפי מעלה לכיוון כפות רגליך. | הנע את הקראנצ' משרירי הבטן — חמוק ממשיכות בצוואר או מניפולציות במשקל כדי ליצור תנופה. | בשיא שאף לקרב את המשקל לכפות הרגליים ככל שהגמישות מאפשרת, תוך שמירה על רגליים ישרות לגמרי וגב תחתון על הרצפה. | Pause briefly at the peak contraction, then slowly lower your upper back back to the floor under control. | Inhale as you descend and return to the starting position with your arms extended and upper back just touching the mat. | Repeat for the desired number of reps without losing tension in the abdominals between repetitions.

t: Lie flat on a bench and select a light weight plate (5–10 lb to start). t: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart and close to your glutes. | Place your palms flat on the floor beside your ears, fingers pointing toward your shoulders and elbows stacked above your wrists. | Press firmly through your feet and engage your glutes to lift your hips off the floor. | Press into your palms to lift your head and shoulders, pausing with the crown of your head lightly resting on the mat as a checkpoint. | Continue pressing through hands and feet to fully extend your arms and lift your head clear of the floor, arching your back into a full bridge. | Roll your inner thighs toward the floor to keep your knees hip-width apart and avoid splaying outward. | Breathe steadily in the pose for 5–10 seconds, keeping your arms and legs actively engaged. | To exit, tuck your chin toward your chest and slowly lower yourself vertebra by vertebra back to the floor.
tRu: Лягте на спину, согните колени и поставьте стопы на пол на ширине бёдер и близко к ягодицам. | Положите ладони плоско на полу рядом с ушами, пальцами к плечам, и локти над запястьями. | Press firmly through your feet and engage your glutes to lift your hips off the floor. | Press into your palms to lift your head and shoulders, pausing with the crown of your head lightly resting on the mat as a checkpoint. | Продолжайте давить руками и ногами, чтобы полностью выпрямить руки и поднять голову над полом, прогнув спину в полный мост. | Roll your inner thighs toward the floor to keep your knees hip-width apart and avoid splaying outward. | Дышите ровно в позе 5–10 секунд, сохраняя активное вовлечение рук и ног. | To exit, tuck your chin toward your chest and slowly lower yourself vertebra by vertebra back to the floor.
tHe: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart and close to your glutes. | Place your palms flat on the floor beside your ears, fingers pointing toward your shoulders and elbows stacked above your wrists. | Press firmly through your feet and engage your glutes to lift your hips off the floor. | Press into your palms to lift your head and shoulders, pausing with the crown of your head lightly resting on the mat as a checkpoint. | המשיכו ללחוץ דרך כפות הידיים והכפות כדי להאריך את הזרועות לגמרי ולהרים את הראש מעל הרצפה, תוך עיקום הגב לגשר מלא. | Roll your inner thighs toward the floor to keep your knees hip-width apart and avoid splaying outward. | נשום בצורה יציבה בתנוחה ל־5–10 שניות, שמור על הזרועות והרגליים פעילות. | To exit, tuck your chin toward your chest and slowly lower yourself vertebra by vertebra back to the floor.

t: Kneel on a mat and grip the ab wheel handles with both hands, positioning the wheel directly beneath your shoulders. | Brace your core firmly, draw your ribs down, and tuck your pelvis slightly to create a neutral spine before you begin. | Squeeze your glutes to lock your hips in place and prevent your lower back from arching during the roll. | Inhale and slowly roll the wheel forward, extending your hips and arms simultaneously in a controlled arc toward the floor. | Keep your elbows locked straight as you descend — do not bend them or shift the work to your arms. | Roll out as far as you can while maintaining a neutral spine; stop the moment you feel your lower back begin to arch. | Hold the extended position for one count, maintaining full-body tension from your hands through your knees. | Exhale and drive your lats and abs to pull the wheel back toward your knees, leading with your hips rather than pushing with your arms. | Return to the starting position with your hips stacked over your knees and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tRu: Встаньте на колени на коврике и возьмите обеими руками рукоятки ab wheel, установив ролик прямо под плечами. | Сильно напрягите пресс, опустите рёбра и слегка подкрутите таз, создав нейтральное положение позвоночника перед началом. | Squeeze your glutes to lock your hips in place and prevent your lower back from arching during the roll. | Выдохните и медленно катите колесо вперед, одновременно разгибая бедра и руки в контролируемой дуге к полу. | Держите локти прямыми при опускании — не сгибайте их и не переносите нагрузку на руки. | Roll out as far as you can while maintaining a neutral spine; stop the moment you feel your lower back begin to arch. | Задержите конечное положение на один счёт, сохраняя напряжение во всем теле от рук до колен. | Выдохните и оттолкните широчайшие мышцы спины и пресс, чтобы тянуть колесо обратно к коленям, начиная движение тазом, а не толкая руками. | Return to the starting position with your hips stacked over your knees and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tHe: Kneel on a mat and grip the ab wheel handles with both hands, positioning the wheel directly beneath your shoulders. | הדק היטב את הליבה, משוך את הצלעות למטה ואסוף מעט את האגן כדי ליצור עמוד שדרה ניטרלי לפני שמתחילים. | Squeeze your glutes to lock your hips in place and prevent your lower back from arching during the roll. | Inhale and slowly roll the wheel forward, extending your hips and arms simultaneously in a controlled arc toward the floor. | Keep your elbows locked straight as you descend — do not bend them or shift the work to your arms. | Roll out as far as you can while maintaining a neutral spine; stop the moment you feel your lower back begin to arch. | Hold the extended position for one count, maintaining full-body tension from your hands through your knees. | נשוף והנע את השרירים הרחבים והבטן כדי למשוך את הגלגל חזרה לעבר הברכיים, מוביל במותניים במקום דחיפה עם הידיים. | Return to the starting position with your hips stacked over your knees and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

nR: Выкаты с колесом с опорой на стену
t: Position an ab wheel on the floor roughly two to three feet from a wall, oriented so the wall is directly in front of you. | Kneel behind the wheel on a mat with your knees hip-width apart and the wheel directly beneath your shoulders. | Grip both handles firmly with your arms straight and your wrists neutral. | Brace your core as if bracing for a punch, and keep your spine in a neutral position — neither rounded nor hyperextended. | Slowly roll the wheel forward, extending your arms and hips in a straight line until the wheel makes contact with the wall. | Pause at the wall for a moment, keeping your core tight and your body in a straight line from knees to shoulders. | Pull the wheel back toward your knees by contracting your core and drawing your arms back in, returning to the start position under control. | Release the brace briefly, reset, then repeat for the desired number of reps.

tHe: Position an ab wheel on the floor roughly two to three feet from a wall, oriented so the wall is directly in front of you. | Kneel behind the wheel on a mat with your knees hip-width apart and the wheel directly beneath your shoulders. | אחוז בשתי הידיות בחוזקה עם זרועות ישרות ופרקי ידיים ניטרליים. | הדק את הליבה כאילו אתה עומד לספוג מכה, ושמור על עמוד שדרה ניטרלי — לא מעוגל ולא מקושת יתר על המידה. | Slowly roll the wheel forward, extending your arms and hips in a straight line until the wheel makes contact with the wall. | Pause at the wall for a moment, keeping your core tight and your body in a straight line from knees to shoulders. | Pull the wheel back toward your knees by contracting your core and drawing your arms back in, returning to the start position under control. | Release the brace briefly, reset, then repeat for the desired number of reps.

t: Stand with your feet set wider than shoulder-width apart and toes turned out 30–45 degrees. | Stand tall with your chest up, shoulders back, and arms extended in front of you at chest height for balance. | Brace your core and begin to lower yourself by pushing your knees out in line with your toes while sending your hips back and down. | Descend until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor, keeping your chest upright and your heels flat on the ground. | Pause briefly at the bottom without collapsing your knees inward or rounding your lower back. | Drive through your entire foot to press the floor away, extending your hips and knees simultaneously as you rise. | Stand fully upright at the top, squeezing your glutes, before beginning the next rep.
tRu: Stand with your feet set wider than shoulder-width apart and toes turned out 30–45 degrees. | Stand tall with your chest up, shoulders back, and arms extended in front of you at chest height for balance. | Напрягите корпус и начните опускаться, разводя колени в линию с носками и одновременно отводя бёдра назад и вниз. | Опускайтесь, пока бёдра не окажутся хотя бы параллельны полу, сохраняя колени над пальцами ног на протяжении всего движения. | На мгновение задержитесь внизу, не сводя колени внутрь и не округляя поясницу. | Отталкивайтесь всей стопой, чтобы оттолкнуть пол, разгибая тазобедренный сустав и колено одновременно поднимаясь. | Stand fully upright at the top, squeezing your glutes, before beginning the next rep.
tHe: Stand with your feet set wider than shoulder-width apart and toes turned out 30–45 degrees. | Stand tall with your chest up, shoulders back, and arms extended in front of you at chest height for balance. | הדק את הליבה והתחל לרדת על ידי דחיפת הברכיים החוצה בקו האצבעות תוך שליחת האגן לאחור ולמטה. | רד עד שהירכיים לפחות מקבילות לרצפה, שומר על החזה זקוף והעקבים שטחים על הרצפה. | Pause briefly at the bottom without collapsing your knees inward or rounding your lower back. | דחוף דרך כף הרגל כולה כדי ללחוץ את הרצפה רחוק, מרחיב את האגן והברך בו זמנית תוך כדי עלייה. | Stand fully upright at the top, squeezing your glutes, before beginning the next rep.

t: Stand beside or over a bench and position your feet significantly wider than shoulder-width, with toes angled out 30–45°. | Stand tall with your chest up and arms extended forward or relaxed at your sides for balance. | Brace your core, take a breath in, and keep your spine in a neutral position. | Begin the descent by pushing your knees outward in line with your toes and sending your hips back and down. | Lower yourself in a controlled manner until your hips lightly touch the edge of the bench, keeping your chest up and torso as upright as possible. | Pause briefly at the bottom without collapsing your knees inward or relaxing your core. | Press through your full foot to drive back up to standing, extending the hips fully at the top. | Exhale as you return to the starting position, reset your brace, and begin the next rep.
tRu: Stand beside or over a bench and position your feet significantly wider than shoulder-width, with toes angled out 30–45°. | Stand tall with your chest up and arms extended forward or relaxed at your sides for balance. | Напрягите корпус, сделайте вдох и держите позвоночник в нейтральном положении. | Начните опускание с разведения коленей наружу в линию с носками и отведения бёдер назад и вниз. | Опуститесь под контролем, пока ваши бедра не коснутся края скамьи, сохраняя грудь поднятой, а туловище как можно более прямым. | На мгновение задержитесь внизу, не сводя колени внутрь и не расслабляя корпус. | Press through your full foot to drive back up to standing, extending the hips fully at the top. | Выдыхайте, когда возвращаетесь в исходное положение, восстановите напряжение корпуса и начните следующее повторение.
tHe: Stand beside or over a bench and position your feet significantly wider than shoulder-width, with toes angled out 30–45°. | Stand tall with your chest up and arms extended forward or relaxed at your sides for balance. | כווץ את שרירי הליבה, קח נשימה, ושמור על עמידה נייטרלית של החוליות. | התחל את הירידה בדחיפת הברכיים החוצה בקו האצבעות ושליחת האגן לאחור ולמטה. | Lower yourself in a controlled manner until your hips lightly touch the edge of the bench, keeping your chest up and torso as upright as possible. | Pause briefly at the bottom without collapsing your knees inward or relaxing your core. | Press through your full foot to drive back up to standing, extending the hips fully at the top. | לחץ אוויר בזמן שאתה חוזר למצב ההתחלתי, אסוף את עצמך מחדש, והתחל את החזרה הבאה.

t: Grip a pull-up bar with an underhand (supinated) grip, hands set wider than shoulder-width — typically 1.5 to 2 times shoulder width. | Hang at full arm extension with your shoulders relaxed and your body straight, crossing your ankles behind you if needed to keep your legs clear of the floor. | Depress and retract your shoulder blades slightly before you begin the pull — this pre-activates the lats and protects the shoulder joint. | Exhale and pull your chest toward the bar by driving your elbows down and back, keeping them flared slightly outward rather than tucking them in. | Continue pulling until your chin clears the bar and your chest approaches it, squeezing the lats and upper back at the top. | Pause briefly at the top, then slowly lower yourself back to a full hang over 2–3 seconds, resisting the descent rather than dropping. | Allow your arms to reach full extension at the bottom and your shoulders to rise slightly before initiating the next rep. | Repeat for the desired number of reps, maintaining control throughout without swinging or kipping.
tRu: Возьмитесь за перекладину для подтягиваний снизу (супинацией), руки расположены шире плеч — обычно в 1,5-2 раза шире плеч. | Повисните на полностью выпрямленных руках с расслабленными плечами и прямым телом, скрестите лодыжки за спиной, если нужно, чтобы ноги не касались пола. | Слегка опустите и retract лопатки перед началом тяги — это预先 активирует широчайшие мышцы и защищает плечевой сустав. | Выдыхайте и тяните грудь к штанге, отталкивая локти вниз и назад, сохраняя их слегка разведёнными в стороны, а не подбирая. | Продолжайте тянуть, пока ваш подбородок не окажется выше штанги, а грудь к ней приблизилась, сжимая широчайшие мышцы спины и верхнюю часть спины в верхней точке. | Задержитесь на мгновение в верхней точке, затем медленно опуститесь в вис за 2-3 секунды, сопротивляясь движению. | В нижней точке полностью выпрямляйте руки и слегка поднимайте плечи перед началом следующего повторения. | Repeat for the desired number of reps, maintaining control throughout without swinging or kipping.
tHe: אחוז במוט משיכה באחיזה מלמטה (סופינציה), הידיים רחבות יותר מרוחב הכתפיים — בדרך כלל פי 1.5 עד 2 מרוחב הכתפיים. | תלה בפשיטת זרועות מלאה כשהכתפיים רפויות והגוף ישר, והצלב את הקרסוליים מאחוריך במידת הצורך כדי לשמור על הרגליים ברורות מהרצפה. | הורד ומשוך את עצם הכתף מעט לפני שאתה מתחיל למשוך — זה מפעיל מראש את הגב ומגן על מפרק הכתף. | נשום החוצה ומשך את החזה לכיוון המוט על ידי דחיפת המרפקים למטה ואחורה, שומר עליהם מופרדים קלות החוצה במקום להכניס אותם פנימה. | המשך למשוך עד שהסנטר שלך מעל המוט והחזה מתקרב אליו, וכווץ את השרירים האחוריים של הגב הרחב והעליון בשיא התנועה. | Pause briefly at the top, then slowly lower yourself back to a full hang over 2–3 seconds, resisting the descent rather than dropping. | תן לידיים להגיע ליישור מלא בתחתית ולכתפיים לעלות קלות לפני תחילת החזרה הבאה. | Repeat for the desired number of reps, maintaining control throughout without swinging or kipping.

t: Lie on your back on a mat with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, set wider than hip-width apart and toes pointing slightly outward. | Place your arms along your sides with palms facing down for stability. | Brace your core and press through your heels to lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees. | Squeeze your glutes firmly at the top of the bridge position — this is your starting point for the pulses. | Lower your hips only 2–4 centimeters, keeping tension in the glutes the entire time. | Drive your hips back up to the full bridge height in a controlled, rhythmic motion. | Continue pulsing at this short range of motion for the prescribed number of repetitions or duration, keeping the glutes engaged throughout. | To finish, lower your hips slowly and with control all the way back to the mat.

t: Grasp a pull-up bar with an overhand grip (palms facing away) set noticeably wider than shoulder-width — roughly 1.5 times shoulder width. | Hang at full arm extension with your feet off the floor, legs straight or crossed at the ankles. | Depress and retract your shoulder blades, pulling them down and together before initiating any elbow bend. | Exhale and pull your chest toward the bar by driving your elbows down and back, keeping them flared slightly out to the sides. | Continue pulling until your chin clears the bar, focusing on squeezing the lats at the top. | Pause briefly at the top, then inhale as you lower yourself in a controlled manner back to a full dead hang. | Reset your shoulder position if needed, then repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

tHe: אחוז במוט משיכה באחיזה מלמעלה (כפות פונות הרחק) רחבה באופן ניכר מרוחב הכתפיים — כ-1.5 מרוחב הכתפיים. | תלה בפשיטת זרועות מלאה כשהרגליים מהרצפה, הרגליים ישרות או מוצלבות בקרסוליים. | הורד ומשוך את עצם הכתף, מושך אותם למטה וקרוב לפני כל כיפוף של המרפקים. | נשום החוצה ומשך את החזה לכיוון המוט על ידי דחיפת המרפקים למטה ואחורה, שומר עליהם מופרדים קלות לצדדים. | המשך למשוך עד שהסנטר שלך עובר מעל המוט, והתמקד בלכווץ את הגב התחתון בשיא התנועה. | Pause briefly at the top, then inhale as you lower yourself in a controlled manner back to a full dead hang. | Reset your shoulder position if needed, then repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

nE: Wide Grip Pull-Up on Dip Cage
nH: מתח באחיזה רחבה על מתקן מקבילים
t: Stand beneath the dip cage's pull-up bar and reach up to grip it with both hands, palms facing away from you, placed 4–6 inches wider than shoulder-width on each side. | Hang at full arm extension with your feet off the floor, allowing your shoulder blades to rise slightly into a dead hang. | Depress and retract your shoulder blades — pull them down and together — before initiating the pull. | Drive your elbows down and out to the sides, keeping them flared rather than tucking them in. | Pull your chest toward the bar, aiming to bring your chin above bar level at the top of the movement. | Squeeze your lats and upper back briefly at the top, holding the contracted position for one count. | Lower yourself in a controlled manner — taking 2–3 seconds on the descent — back to a full dead hang. | Reset your shoulder blades at the bottom before beginning the next repetition.

t: Grip a pull-up bar with both hands roughly 1.5 to 2 times shoulder-width apart, palms facing away from you (pronated grip). | Hang at full arm extension with your shoulders relaxed and your core lightly braced — this is the dead hang starting position. | Before you pull, tilt your head forward slightly and tuck your chin toward your chest so the bar has a clear path behind your head. | Initiate the pull by depressing and retracting your shoulder blades, then drive your elbows down and back toward your hips. | Continue pulling until the bar contacts the upper trapezius, just above the base of the neck — do not force the bar down to mid-neck level. | Pause briefly at the top with your elbows pointing down and slightly back, feeling the lats fully contracted. | Lower yourself under control over 2–3 seconds back to the full dead hang, letting your shoulder blades rise and upwardly rotate at the bottom. | Reset your head position on each rep and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tRu: Возьмитесь за перекладину обеими руками примерно в 1,5-2 раза шире плеч, ладонями от себя (пронация). | Повисните на полностью выпрямленных руках с расслабленными плечами и легким напряжением корпуса — это исходное положение вис на прямых руках. | Перед тягой слегка наклоните голову вперёд и прижмите подбородок к груди, чтобы гриф свободно прошёл за головой. | Начните тягу, опуская лопатки, затем отводите локти вниз и назад к бедрам. | Продолжайте тянуть, пока штанга не коснется верхней части трапеция, непосредственно над основанием шеи — не давите штангой к среднему уровню шеи. | Задержитесь на мгновение в верхней точке с локтями, направленными вниз и немного назад, ощущая полное сокращение широчайших мышц. | Под контролем в течение 2–3 секунд вернитесь в полный вис на прямых руках, позволяя лопатам подниматься и вращаться вверх в нижнем положении. | Reset your head position on each rep and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tHe: אחוז במוט משיכה בשתי הידיים ברוחב של פי 1.5 עד 2 מרוחב הכתפיים בקירוב, כפות פונות הרחק ממך (אחיזת פרונציה). | תלה בפשיטת זרועות מלאה כשהכתפיים רפויות והליבה מהודקת קלות — זו עמדת התלייה החופשית ההתחלתית. | לפני המשיכה, הטה את הראש מעט קדימה והצמד את הסנטר לחזה כדי לפנות למוט מעבר נקי מאחורי הראש. | Initiate the pull by depressing and retracting your shoulder blades, then drive your elbows down and back toward your hips. | המשך למשוך עד שהמוט נוגע בשריר הטרפזי העליון, מעל בסיס הצוואר — אל תכריח את המוט לרמת אמצע הצוואר. | Pause briefly at the top with your elbows pointing down and slightly back, feeling the lats fully contracted. | Lower yourself under control over 2–3 seconds back to the full dead hang, letting your shoulder blades rise and upwardly rotate at the bottom. | Reset your head position on each rep and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

nE: Wide legged Forward Bend Prasarita Padottanasana
nH: כפיפה קדימה ברגליים מפושקות פראסריטה פדוטנאסאנה
t: Stand at the center of your mat and step your feet 3–5 feet apart, with the outer edges of your feet parallel to the short edges of the mat and toes pointing forward or very slightly inward. | Place your hands on your hips, inhale to lengthen through the crown of your head, and feel the spine grow long. | On an exhale, hinge forward from the hips — not the waist — keeping your back flat and your torso long as you lower toward the floor. | Place your fingertips or palms on the floor directly beneath your shoulders, arms straight, and continue to lengthen the spine rather than rounding it. | On each subsequent exhale, allow the torso to descend further. If your flexibility allows, walk your hands back between your feet and let the crown of your head reach toward the floor. | Press the outer edges of both feet firmly into the floor, gently draw the inner thighs upward, and soften your knees slightly rather than locking them out. | Breathe slowly and hold the pose for 5–10 full breaths, using each exhale to release a little more tension through the hips and hamstrings. | To exit, place your hands back on your hips, engage your core, and rise slowly with a flat back on an inhale. Step your feet together and return to standing.

Step your feet together and return to standing.

t: Start in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your feet set wider than hip-width apart. | Brace your core, squeeze your glutes, and create a straight line from head to heels — no sagging hips or raised backside. | Keeping your hips level and your torso from rotating, lift your right foot and tap it out to the right, roughly 12–18 inches wider. | Return your right foot to the starting position with control. | Repeat on the left side — tap left foot out to the left, then return. | Continue alternating sides for the target number of reps or time, maintaining a rigid, non-rotating plank throughout. | To finish, lower your knees to the floor in a controlled manner.

t: Stand facing a wall at arm's length and place both hands flat on the wall at chest height, wider than shoulder-width apart — roughly 1.5 times shoulder width. | Step your feet back slightly so your body forms a straight diagonal line from head to heels, with your weight resting on the balls of your feet. | Brace your core and squeeze your glutes so your hips stay level and your body does not sag or pike. | Inhale and slowly bend your elbows, lowering your chest toward the wall at a controlled pace — aim for a 2-second descent. | Keep your elbows at roughly a 45–60° angle to your torso rather than flaring them straight out to the sides. | Lower until your nose or chest nearly touches the wall, maintaining that straight body line throughout. | Exhale and press both hands firmly into the wall, extending your elbows to push yourself back to the starting position. | Pause briefly at the top with arms fully extended but elbows not locked out, then begin the next rep.
tRu: Stand facing a wall at arm's length and place both hands flat on the wall at chest height, wider than shoulder-width apart — roughly 1.5 times shoulder width. | Step your feet back slightly so your body forms a straight diagonal line from head to heels, with your weight resting on the balls of your feet. | Напрягите корпус и сожмите ягодицы, чтобы бёдра оставались на одном уровне, а тело не провисало и не изгибалось вверх. | Вдохните и медленно согните локти, опуская грудь к стене в контролируемом темпе — стремитесь к 2-секундному опусканию. | Держите локоть под углом примерно 45–60° к корпусу, а не разводите их прямо в стороны. | Опустите, пока ваш нос или грудь почти не коснулись стены, сохраняя прямую линию тела на протяжении всего движения. | Выдыхайте и сильно надавливайте руками на стену, разгибая локти, чтобы вернуться в исходное положение. | На мгновение остановитесь в верхней точке с полностью выпрямленными, но не заблокированными локтями, затем начните следующее повторение.

t: Sit at the assisted pull-up or seated pull-up machine and adjust the knee pad or seat so your legs are secured and your arms can fully extend overhead when gripping the bar. | Reach up and grip the wide bar with an overhand (pronated) grip, placing your hands well outside shoulder-width — roughly 1.5 times shoulder-width is a useful starting point. | Sit tall, brace your core lightly, and let your arms fully extend so you feel a gentle stretch across your lats before you begin. | Inhale, then initiate the pull by depressing and retracting your shoulder blades — think 'pull your shoulder blades down and into your back pockets.' | Drive your elbows down and out to your sides, pulling the bar (or yourself) down until the bar reaches chin or upper-chest level. | Squeeze your lats and upper back at the bottom of the movement for a brief moment. | Exhale and slowly extend your arms, returning to the full overhead position with control — do not let the weight stack drop or your shoulders shrug up. | Complete all reps, then release the weight stack gently.

nE: Wide Stance Jump Squat to Narrow Stance Jump Squat
nH: סקוואט בקפיצה מעמידה רחבה לעמידה צרה
t: Stand with your feet set wider than shoulder-width, toes turned out slightly, and your arms hanging at your sides. | Push your hips back and lower into a squat until your thighs are roughly parallel to the floor, keeping your chest up and your knees tracking over your toes. | Drive through your feet explosively to jump straight up off the floor, extending your hips and knees fully at the top. | While in the air, bring your feet together so that you land with them hip-width apart or narrower — this is the narrow stance. | Absorb the landing by bending your knees and sitting your hips back immediately into a narrow-stance squat, keeping your heels flat and your chest upright. | Without pausing at the bottom, drive through your feet again and jump straight up, spreading your feet apart in the air so you land back in the wide stance. | Absorb this landing the same way — soft knees, hips back — and use the stretch-shortening response to flow directly into the next jump. | Continue alternating between wide and narrow landings in a controlled, rhythmic pattern for the desired duration or number of reps.

t: Place your hands wider than shoulder-width on the floor, fingers pointing forward, with your body in a straight line from head to heels — this is your starting position. | Brace your core, squeeze your glutes, and ensure your hips are level before beginning the movement. | Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows outward at roughly a 45° angle to your torso, keeping your body rigid throughout the descent. | Press back up to the top of the wide push-up position, fully extending your arms without locking the elbows. | Walk or hop both hands inward so they are roughly shoulder-width apart or closer, directly under your shoulders. | Lower your chest again toward the floor with your elbows tracking closer to your sides in the narrow position. | Press back up to the top of the narrow push-up position to complete one full rep cycle. | Walk or hop your hands back out to the wide position and repeat the sequence for the desired number of reps.
tRu: Положите руки шире плеч на полу, пальцами вперёд, тело в прямом линии от головы до пят — это ваше исходное положение. | Напрягите корпус, сожмите ягодицы и убедитесь, что бёдра на одном уровне перед началом движения. | Под контролем опустите грудь к полу, сгибая локти наружу под углом примерно 45° к корпусу, сохраняя тело прямым на всем протяжении опускания. | Press back up to the top of the wide push-up position, fully extending your arms without locking the elbows. | Walk or hop both hands inward so they are roughly shoulder-width apart or closer, directly under your shoulders. | Снова опустите грудь к полу, сохраняя локти ближе к бокам в узком положении. | Press back up to the top of the narrow push-up position to complete one full rep cycle. | Walk or hop your hands back out to the wide position and repeat the sequence for the desired number of reps.
tHe: Place your hands wider than shoulder-width on the floor, fingers pointing forward, with your body in a straight line from head to heels — this is your starting position. | הקשישו את שרירי הליבה, כווצו את הישבן, ווודאו שהאגן שלכם מאוזן לפני התחלת התנועה. | Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows outward at roughly a 45° angle to your torso, keeping your body rigid throughout the descent. | Press back up to the top of the wide push-up position, fully extending your arms without locking the elbows. | Walk or hop both hands inward so they are roughly shoulder-width apart or closer, directly under your shoulders. | Lower your chest again toward the floor with your elbows tracking closer to your sides in the narrow position. | Press back up to the top of the narrow push-up position to complete one full rep cycle. | Walk or hop your hands back out to the wide position and repeat the sequence for the desired number of reps.

t: Find a flat, open surface — a track, field, or clear stretch of pavement — at least 20–40 meters long. | Stand at your starting line with a staggered stance, one foot slightly in front of the other, leaning forward from the ankles. | Drive powerfully off your rear foot and accelerate to maximum speed as quickly as possible, pumping your arms in sync with your legs. | Run at full effort for the designated distance (typically 20–100 meters), maintaining an upright but slightly forward-leaning torso. | Decelerate gradually after crossing the finish line — never come to an abrupt stop. | Walk or lightly jog back to the start line as your recovery interval, then repeat for the target number of sprints.
tRu: Найдите ровную, открытую поверхность — дорожку, поле или чистый участок дорожного покрытия — длиной не менее 20–40 метров. | Stand at your starting line with a staggered stance, one foot slightly in front of the other, leaning forward from the ankles. | Сильно оттолкнитесь задней ногой и ускоряйтесь до максимальной скорости как можно быстрее, размахивая руками в такт ногам. | Run at full effort for the designated distance (typically 20–100 meters), maintaining an upright but slightly forward-leaning torso. | Постепенно замедляйтесь после пересечения финишной черты — никогда не останавливайтесь резко. | Walk or lightly jog back to the start line as your recovery interval, then repeat for the target number of sprints.
tHe: מצא משטח שטוח ופתוח — מסלול, מגרש או מקטע סלול צלול — באורך של לפחות 20–40 מטר. | Stand at your starting line with a staggered stance, one foot slightly in front of the other, leaning forward from the ankles. | הנע בכוח מהעקב האחורי והאץ למהירות המרבית במהירות האפשרית, מניע את ידיך בסנכרון עם הרגליים. | Run at full effort for the designated distance (typically 20–100 meters), maintaining an upright but slightly forward-leaning torso. | האט בהדרגה לאחר חציית קו הסיום — אף פעם אל תעצור לפתע. | Walk or lightly jog back to the start line as your recovery interval, then repeat for the target number of sprints.

t: Lie flat on your back with your arms extended out to the sides, palms pressed down for support. | Brace your core and lift both legs off the floor, raising them until they are perpendicular to the ground (straight up toward the ceiling). | Keep both legs fully straight and pressed together throughout the movement. | Slowly lower your legs to one side in a controlled arc, stopping a few inches above the floor or at the limit of your controlled range. | Pause briefly, then use your obliques to sweep the legs back up through vertical. | Continue the arc to the opposite side, lowering with the same controlled tempo. | Pause again, then sweep back to vertical to complete one full repetition. | Repeat for the desired number of reps, maintaining a slow, deliberate pace throughout.
tRu: Лягте на спину с руками, вытянутыми в стороны, ладонями, прижатыми вниз для опоры. | Напрягите корпус и оторвите обе ноги от пола, поднимая их до перпендикуляра к полу (строго вверх к потолку). | Держите обе ноги полностью прямыми и прижатыми друг к другу на протяжении всего движения. | Slowly lower your legs to one side in a controlled arc, stopping a few inches above the floor or at the limit of your controlled range. | Задержитесь на мгновение, затем используйте косые мышцы, чтобы поднять ноги обратно через вертикаль. | Продолжайте дугу на противоположную сторону, опуская с тем же контролируемым темпом. | Снова сделайте паузу, затем вернитесь в вертикальное положение, чтобы выполнить одно полное повторение. | Repeat for the desired number of reps, maintaining a slow, deliberate pace throughout.
tHe: Lie flat on your back with your arms extended out to the sides, palms pressed down for support. | הדק את הליבה והרם את שתי הרגליים מהרצפה עד שהן מאונכות לקרקע (ישר כלפי התקרה). | Keep both legs fully straight and pressed together throughout the movement. | Slowly lower your legs to one side in a controlled arc, stopping a few inches above the floor or at the limit of your controlled range. | Pause briefly, then use your obliques to sweep the legs back up through vertical. | המשך הקשת לצד הנגדי, מורידים באותו קצב מבוקר. | Pause again, then sweep back to vertical to complete one full repetition. | Repeat for the desired number of reps, maintaining a slow, deliberate pace throughout.

t: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your arms relaxed at your sides. | Step your right foot forward into a long lunge, lowering your left knee toward the floor and keeping your torso upright. | Place both hands flat on the floor just inside your right foot for support. | Reach your left arm up toward the ceiling, rotating your upper body and opening your chest to the left — follow your hand with your eyes. | Hold the rotated position for 1–2 seconds, then return your left hand to the floor. | Drive your right hip back and straighten your right leg, shifting your weight backward into a hamstring stretch with your right foot flat on the floor. | Pause for 1–2 seconds in the hamstring stretch, then return your hips forward to the lunge position. | Step your right foot back to the starting position and repeat the entire sequence leading with your left foot. | Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions, moving slowly and with control through each position.
tRu: Встаньте прямо, поставив ноги на ширине бёдер, руки свободно опущены вдоль тела. | Step your right foot forward into a long lunge, lowering your left knee toward the floor and keeping your torso upright. | Поставьте обе руки на пол внутри правой ноги для опоры. | Reach your left arm up toward the ceiling, rotating your upper body and opening your chest to the left — follow your hand with your eyes. | Держите повернутое положение в течение 1-2 секунд, затем верните левую руку на пол. | Отведите правое бедро назад и выпрямите правую ногу, перенеся вес назад в растяжку бицепса бедра с правой стопой на полу. | Задержитесь на 1–2 секунды в растяжке подколенных сухожилий, затем верните бёдра вперёд в положение выпада. | Step your right foot back to the starting position and repeat the entire sequence leading with your left foot. | Продолжайте попеременно менять стороны в течение заданного количества повторений, двигаясь медленно и с контролем в каждом положении.
tHe: עמוד זקוף עם רגליים ברוחב האגן וידיים רפויות לצדי הגוף. | Step your right foot forward into a long lunge, lowering your left knee toward the floor and keeping your torso upright. | Place both hands flat on the floor just inside your right foot for support. | Reach your left arm up toward the ceiling, rotating your upper body and opening your chest to the left — follow your hand with your eyes. | Hold the rotated position for 1–2 seconds, then return your left hand to the floor. | הנע את ירך ימיך אחורה וישר את רגל ימיך, מעביר את משקלך אחורה אל מתיחת השריר הארבע ראשי עם כף רגל ימיך שטוחה על הרצפה. | Pause for 1–2 seconds in the hamstring stretch, then return your hips forward to the lunge position. | Step your right foot back to the starting position and repeat the entire sequence leading with your left foot. | המשילו להחליף צדדים למספר החזרות הרצוי, זוזו לאט ובשליטה דרך כל תנוחה.

t: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your arms relaxed at your sides. | Step your right foot forward into a deep lunge, lowering your left knee toward the floor or hovering it just above the ground. | Place both hands on the floor inside your right foot, shoulder-width apart, and settle your hips toward the ground to feel the stretch through your hip flexor and groin. | Lift your right hand off the floor and rotate your torso to the right, reaching your arm toward the ceiling while keeping your hips square and your gaze following your hand. | Hold the rotated position for one to two seconds, then return your hand to the floor. | Press through your right heel and straighten your right leg as much as your hamstring allows, shifting your hips back slightly to deepen the hamstring stretch. | Return to the lunge position and lower both hands back to the floor. | Push back to standing and repeat the full sequence on the opposite side.
tRu: Встаньте прямо, поставив ноги на ширине бёдер, руки свободно опущены вдоль тела. | Step your right foot forward into a deep lunge, lowering your left knee toward the floor or hovering it just above the ground. | Поставьте обе руки на пол внутри правой ноги, на ширине плеч, и опустите бёдра к полу, чтобы почувствовать растяжку в сгибателе бёдр и паху. | Поднимите правую руку с пола и поверните корпус вправо, вытягивая руку к потолку, сохраняя таз параллельно полу, а взгляд — на руке. | Держите повернутое положение в течение одной-двух секунд, затем верните руку на пол. | Press through your right heel and straighten your right leg as much as your hamstring allows, shifting your hips back slightly to deepen the hamstring stretch. | Return to the lunge position and lower both hands back to the floor. | Push back to standing and repeat the full sequence on the opposite side.
tHe: עמוד זקוף עם רגליים ברוחב האגן וידיים רפויות לצדי הגוף. | Step your right foot forward into a deep lunge, lowering your left knee toward the floor or hovering it just above the ground. | Place both hands on the floor inside your right foot, shoulder-width apart, and settle your hips toward the ground to feel the stretch through your hip flexor and groin. | Lift your right hand off the floor and rotate your torso to the right, reaching your arm toward the ceiling while keeping your hips square and your gaze following your hand. | Hold the rotated position for one to two seconds, then return your hand to the floor. | Press through your right heel and straighten your right leg as much as your hamstring allows, shifting your hips back slightly to deepen the hamstring stretch. | Return to the lunge position and lower both hands back to the floor. | Push back to standing and repeat the full sequence on the opposite side.

t: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, spine long, and shoulders relaxed away from your ears. | Extend your right arm straight out in front of you at approximately shoulder height. | Sweep the right arm horizontally across your chest toward the left side of your body. | Hook your left forearm or hand under your right upper arm, just above the elbow — avoid gripping or pulling at the wrist. | Gently draw the right arm closer to your chest until you feel a firm but comfortable stretch in the back of the right shoulder and upper back. | Keep your right shoulder pressed down; do not allow it to rise toward your ear. | Hold the position for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and steadily. | Release the arm, shake it out briefly, then mirror the movement on the left side for the same duration.
tRu: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, spine long, and shoulders relaxed away from your ears. | Выпрямите правую руку прямо перед собой примерно на уровне плеч. | Sweep the right arm horizontally across your chest toward the left side of your body. | Зацепите левое предплечье или руку под правое плечо, чуть выше локтя — не хватайте и не тяните за запястье. | Плавно подтяните правую руку ближе к груди, пока не почувствуете ощутимую, но комфортную растяжку в задней части правого плеча и верхней части спины. | Держите правое плечо прижатым вниз; не позволяйте ему подниматься к уху. | Задержите положение на 20-30 секунд, дыша медленно и ровно. | Release the arm, shake it out briefly, then mirror the movement on the left side for the same duration.
tHe: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart, spine long, and shoulders relaxed away from your ears. | פשוט את ידיך ימינה ישר לפניך בגובה הכתף בערך. | Sweep the right arm horizontally across your chest toward the left side of your body. | Hook your left forearm or hand under your right upper arm, just above the elbow — avoid gripping or pulling at the wrist. | משוך בעדינות את זרוע ימין קרוב יותר לחזה עד שתרגיש מתיחה החלטית אך נוחה בחלק האחורי של הכתף הימנית והגב העליון. | Keep your right shoulder pressed down; do not allow it to rise toward your ear. | Hold the position for 20–30 seconds, breathing slowly and steadily. | Release the arm, shake it out briefly, then mirror the movement on the left side for the same duration.

t: Sit at a table or bench and rest your forearm flat on the surface, palm facing down, with your wrist and hand extended past the edge so the wrist can move freely. | Let your hand hang in a neutral position — thumb pointing up if your forearm is in a neutral grip, or palm down if pronated — whichever allows a clean radial deviation arc. | Without rotating your forearm, slowly tilt your hand toward your thumb side, moving only at the wrist joint. | Continue the movement until you reach the end of your comfortable range of motion, feeling a mild stretch along the pinky side of your wrist. | Pause for one second at the top of the range, keeping the movement deliberate and controlled. | Slowly return your hand to the neutral starting position, maintaining the same controlled tempo. | Repeat for the prescribed number of repetitions, then switch sides and perform the same drill on the opposite wrist.
tRu: Sit at a table or bench and rest your forearm flat on the surface, palm facing down, with your wrist and hand extended past the edge so the wrist can move freely. | Пусть ваша рука свисает в нейтральном положении — большой палец направлен вверх, если предплечье в нейтральном хвате, или ладонью вниз, если хват пронированный — whichever allows a clean radial deviation arc. | Without rotating your forearm, slowly tilt your hand toward your thumb side, moving only at the wrist joint. | Продолжайте движение, пока не достигнете предела своей комфортной амплитуды, чувствуя легкую растяжение по мизинцевой стороне запястья. | Пауза на одну секунду в верхней точке диапазона, сохраняя движение осознанным и контролируемым. | Slowly return your hand to the neutral starting position, maintaining the same controlled tempo. | Repeat for the prescribed number of repetitions, then switch sides and perform the same drill on the opposite wrist.
tHe: Sit at a table or bench and rest your forearm flat on the surface, palm facing down, with your wrist and hand extended past the edge so the wrist can move freely. | Let your hand hang in a neutral position — thumb pointing up if your forearm is in a neutral grip, or palm down if pronated — whichever allows a clean radial deviation arc. | Without rotating your forearm, slowly tilt your hand toward your thumb side, moving only at the wrist joint. | המשך את התנועה עד שאתה מגיע לקצה טווח התנועה הנוח שלך, תוך שאתה מרגיש מתיחה קלה לאורך צד הקמיצה של פרק כף היד. | Pause for one second at the top of the range, keeping the movement deliberate and controlled. | Slowly return your hand to the neutral starting position, maintaining the same controlled tempo. | Repeat for the prescribed number of repetitions, then switch sides and perform the same drill on the opposite wrist.

t: Sit or stand with your working arm extended in front of you at roughly chest height, elbow straight and palm facing down. | Relax your fingers and let your hand rest in a neutral, flat position aligned with your forearm. | Keeping your forearm completely still, slowly tilt your hand toward the little-finger (ulnar) side as far as you can go without pain. | Pause for one to two seconds at the end of your comfortable range, feeling a mild stretch along the thumb-side of the wrist and the forearm flexors. | Return your hand under control to the neutral starting position — do not let it snap back. | Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, moving at a slow, deliberate pace throughout. | When the set is complete, lower your arm and shake it out gently before switching sides.
tRu: Sit or stand with your working arm extended in front of you at roughly chest height, elbow straight and palm facing down. | Relax your fingers and let your hand rest in a neutral, flat position aligned with your forearm. | Держа предплечь совершенно неподвижной, медленно наклоняйте кисть в сторону мизинца (локтевую) насколько возможно без боли. | Пауза на одну-две секунды в конце вашего комфортного диапазона, почувствуйте лёгкое растяжение по большой стороне запястья и сгибателей предплечья. | Return your hand under control to the neutral starting position — do not let it snap back. | Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, moving at a slow, deliberate pace throughout. | When the set is complete, lower your arm and shake it out gently before switching sides.
tHe: Sit or stand with your working arm extended in front of you at roughly chest height, elbow straight and palm facing down. | Relax your fingers and let your hand rest in a neutral, flat position aligned with your forearm. | Keeping your forearm completely still, slowly tilt your hand toward the little-finger (ulnar) side as far as you can go without pain. | Pause for one to two seconds at the end of your comfortable range, feeling a mild stretch along the thumb-side of the wrist and the forearm flexors. | Return your hand under control to the neutral starting position — do not let it snap back. | Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, moving at a slow, deliberate pace throughout. | When the set is complete, lower your arm and shake it out gently before switching sides.

t: Stand or sit upright and extend both arms in front of you at shoulder height, or rest your elbows on your knees if seated. | Form a loose, relaxed fist with both hands, keeping your fingers curled gently without gripping tightly. | Hold your forearms completely still — all movement should come only from the wrist joint. | Slowly rotate both wrists in a clockwise direction, tracing the largest circle you can through your full range of motion. | Complete the desired number of repetitions clockwise, moving deliberately and without rushing. | Reverse the direction and rotate both wrists counter-clockwise for the same number of repetitions. | Lower your arms and shake out your hands gently to release any residual tension.
tRu: Stand or sit upright and extend both arms in front of you at shoulder height, or rest your elbows on your knees if seated. | Сформируйте расслабленный кулак обеими руками, сохраняя пальцы слегка согнутыми без сильного сжатия. | Удерживайте предплечья полностью неподвижно — все движение должно исходить только из запястного сустава. | Slowly rotate both wrists in a clockwise direction, tracing the largest circle you can through your full range of motion. | Выполните желаемое количество повторений по часовой стрелке, двигаясь осознанно и без спешки. | Reverse the direction and rotate both wrists counter-clockwise for the same number of repetitions. | Опустите руки и аккуратно встряхните кистями, чтобы снять остаточное напряжение.
tHe: Stand or sit upright and extend both arms in front of you at shoulder height, or rest your elbows on your knees if seated. | צור אגרוף רפוי ומשוחרר בשתי הידיים, תוך כריכת האצבעות בעדינות מבלי לאחוז בחוזקה. | Hold your forearms completely still — all movement should come only from the wrist joint. | Slowly rotate both wrists in a clockwise direction, tracing the largest circle you can through your full range of motion. | בצע את המספר הרצוי של החזרות בכיוון השעון, בתנועה מכוונת ובלי למהר. | Reverse the direction and rotate both wrists counter-clockwise for the same number of repetitions. | Lower your arms and shake out your hands gently to release any residual tension.

t: Sit or stand with your arm extended in front of you at roughly chest height, elbow straight or slightly soft, palm facing down. | Allow your wrist to drop into flexion so your fingers point toward the floor — this is your starting position. | Slowly raise your hand upward by extending the wrist, leading with the back of the hand, until your fingers point toward the ceiling or as far as your range allows without pain. | Pause briefly at the top of the extension range, feeling a gentle stretch through the forearm. | Slowly lower your hand back down through the arc into the flexed starting position under control. | Repeat the movement in a smooth, continuous rhythm for the desired number of repetitions. | Complete all reps on one side before switching to the other arm.
tRu: Sit or stand with your arm extended in front of you at roughly chest height, elbow straight or slightly soft, palm facing down. | Позвольте запястью опуститься в сгибание, чтобы пальцы смотрели в пол — это исходное положение. | Slowly raise your hand upward by extending the wrist, leading with the back of the hand, until your fingers point toward the ceiling or as far as your range allows without pain. | Пауза в верхней точке амплитуды разгибания, ощущая лёгкое растяжение предплечья. | Slowly lower your hand back down through the arc into the flexed starting position under control. | Repeat the movement in a smooth, continuous rhythm for the desired number of repetitions. | Выполните все повторения на одну сторону, затем перейдите на другую руку.
tHe: Sit or stand with your arm extended in front of you at roughly chest height, elbow straight or slightly soft, palm facing down. | תן לשורש כף היד לצנוח לכיפוף כך שהאצבעות פונות לעבר הרצפה — זוהי עמדת המוצא. | Slowly raise your hand upward by extending the wrist, leading with the back of the hand, until your fingers point toward the ceiling or as far as your range allows without pain. | Pause briefly at the top of the extension range, feeling a gentle stretch through the forearm. | Slowly lower your hand back down through the arc into the flexed starting position under control. | Repeat the movement in a smooth, continuous rhythm for the desired number of repetitions. | בצע את כל החזרות בצד אחד לפני המעבר ליד השנייה.

t: Stand or sit tall with your spine neutral and shoulders relaxed. | Extend one arm straight in front of you at shoulder height, palm facing down. | Use your free hand to gently grasp the fingers of the extended hand from above. | Curl the fingers and wrist of the extended arm downward, pointing your fingertips toward the floor. | Apply light steady pressure with your free hand to deepen the bend until you feel a mild stretch along the top of the forearm. | Keep the elbow of the extended arm straight but not locked throughout the stretch. | Hold the position for 20–30 seconds while breathing slowly and steadily. | Gradually release the pressure, straighten the wrist, and return to the starting position. | Repeat on the opposite arm, performing 2–3 rounds per side.
tRu: Stand or sit tall with your spine neutral and shoulders relaxed. | Вытяните одну руку прямо перед собой на уровне плеч, ладонью вниз. | Use your free hand to gently grasp the fingers of the extended hand from above. | Согните пальцы и запястье вытянутой руки вниз, направляя кончики пальцев к полу. | Мягко с постоянным усилием надавите свободной рукой, углубляя сгибание до лёгкого растяжения верхней части предплечья. | Держите локоть вытянутой руки прямым, но не заблокированным на протяжении всей растяжки. | Удерживайте положение 20–30 секунд, дыша медленно и ровно. | Постепенно ослабьте давление, выпрямите запястье и вернитесь в исходное положение. | Repeat on the opposite arm, performing 2–3 rounds per side.
tHe: Stand or sit tall with your spine neutral and shoulders relaxed. | פשוט יד אחת ישר קדימה בגובה הכתף, כף היד מופנת למטה. | Use your free hand to gently grasp the fingers of the extended hand from above. | כופף את אצבעות היד והפרק של הזרוע המושטת למטה, מכוון את קצות האצבעות לעבר הרצפה. | לחץ קלות ובאופן קבוע עם היד החופשית כדי להעמיק את הכיפוף עד שתרגיש מתיחה קלה לאורך גב האמה. | Keep the elbow of the extended arm straight but not locked throughout the stretch. | החזק את התנוחה 20–30 שניות תוך נשימה איטית וסדירה. | שחרר בהדרגה את הלחץ, יישר את פרק היד וחזור לעמדת ההתחלה. | Repeat on the opposite arm, performing 2–3 rounds per side.

t: Sit or stand with a tall spine, arms extended in front of you at approximately shoulder height, palms facing down. | Relax your fingers and allow your wrists to drop into full flexion so the backs of your hands face upward — this is your starting position. | Slowly extend your wrists back to a neutral position, keeping your forearms still and moving only at the wrist joint. | Continue past neutral into gentle wrist extension, feeling a mild stretch across the forearm flexors. | Reverse the direction and lower your wrists back through neutral and into full flexion again, moving with deliberate control. | Repeat this flexion-to-extension arc in a smooth, continuous rhythm for the target number of repetitions or time. | Keep the movement isolated to the wrist joint — your elbows and shoulders should remain relaxed and stationary throughout. | At the end of the set, hold the bottom of the flexion range for 2–3 seconds to deepen the stretch before releasing.

t: Stand or sit tall with your working arm extended straight in front of you at shoulder height, palm facing up. | With your free hand, grasp the fingers of the extended hand and gently pull them down toward the floor and back toward your body, extending the wrist so the palm turns to face away from you. | Keep your elbow fully extended so the stretch travels through the entire length of the forearm rather than bending at the joint. | Apply only light, steady pressure — you should feel a moderate pull along the inner forearm, not sharp pain. | Hold the stretch for 20–30 seconds while breathing slowly and letting the tissue relax into the position. | Release gradually, lower your arm, and give your wrist a brief shake to clear tension. | Repeat on the opposite side, then perform 2–3 rounds per side.

nH: שכיבות סמיכה מלאות על שורש כף היד
t: Kneel on the floor and place both hands in a fist position — knuckles down, thumbs alongside your index fingers — shoulder-width apart on the ground. | Extend your legs behind you to assume a full plank position, with your body forming a straight line from head to heels. | Align your fists directly beneath your shoulders and check that your wrists are straight (neutral), not bent or collapsed inward. | Brace your core, squeeze your glutes, and keep your hips level so your body stays rigid throughout the movement. | Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows at roughly a 45° angle to your torso, keeping your fists firmly planted. | Descend until your chest is an inch or two above the ground without letting your hips sag or pike. | Press through your knuckles to push the floor away and extend your arms back to the starting position. | Reset your brace at the top of each rep before beginning the next repetition.
tRu: Встаньте на колени на пола и поставьте обе руки в кулаке — костяшки вниз, большие пальцы вдоль указательных пальцев — на ширине плеч на полу. | Вытяните ноги назад, чтобы принять положение полной планки, тело образует прямую линию от головы до пяток. | Поставьте кулаки строго под плечами и проверьте, что запястья прямые (нейтральные), не согнуты и не завалены внутрь. | Напрягите корпус, сожмите ягодицы и удерживайте бёдра на одном уровне, чтобы тело оставалось жёстким в течение всего движения. | Под контролем опустите грудь к полу, сгибая локти под углом примерно 45° к корпусу, сохраняя кулаки плотно прижатыми. | Опускайтесь, пока грудь не окажется на один-два дюйма над полом, не давая бёдрам провисать или подниматься тазом. | Press through your knuckles to push the floor away and extend your arms back to the starting position. | Reset your brace at the top of each rep before beginning the next repetition.
